**〔G9〕小蓝书预测卷一 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：In 2008.**
1 题面：When did Huang Quande become a photo model；原文 "Huang gave up fishing and became a photo model in 2008."；两个动作并列，时间状语在句末。
2 候选：in 2008（原文）；in 1997（他篇年份）；on Feb 18, 2023（去世日）；at the age of 94（年龄）。
3 验算：in 2008→与 became a photo model in 2008 逐字对应→成立。in 1997→是小蓝书卷一 P4 中 Miao 开始学刻瓷的年份，跨篇污染→排除。on Feb 18, 2023→去世时间，事件不同→排除。at the age of 94→年龄，非年份→次优（可补注）。
4 干扰：首段末 "passed away at the age of 94 on Feb 18, 2023" 是全文最醒目的数字串，诱人取它；gave up fishing 与 became a photo model 并列，两个动作易混。
5 意图：考"多数字按事件配对"与"became＋身份＋in＋年"结构。区分抓最醒目数字的人与按事件定位的人。
6 边界：若问 When did Huang pass away? 答 on Feb 18, 2023；若问 How old was he when he died? 答 94。同段三个数字，事件决定取哪个。
7 错误：A 答 On Feb 18, 2023.（错因：去世日当成为模特日）；B 答 At 94.（错因：年龄当年份）；C 答 In 1997.（错因：跨篇串号）。
8 规则：R9.1 若题干含身份转变动词（became／turned），then 取该动词同句的时间状语，不取同段其它事件的数字；例外：同句两个时间时取紧邻该动词者。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间定位（事件配对）。与 R2.4（多数字排他）同族。
10 自检：①became 在哪句？②同段还有哪些数字？③我取的是哪个事件？

**27. 答案：A cultural symbol of Guilin landscape.**
1 题面：What does the image of the fisherman stand for, according to Guangming Daily；原文 "Instead, it is a cultural symbol of Guilin landscape, commented Guangming Daily."；stand for＝symbol。
2 候选：a cultural symbol of Guilin landscape（表语）；Huang Quande（人）；the 20-yuan banknote（载体）；Guilin（范围）。
3 验算：a cultural symbol of Guilin landscape→与 is a cultural symbol of… 逐字对应，stand for 与 symbol 同义→成立。Huang Quande→原文说 not just about one man，明确否定→不成立。the 20-yuan banknote→是图案所在，不是象征内容→排除。Guilin→只是象征的限定范围，不完整→次优。
4 干扰：首段大半写黄全德其人，诱人答 Huang Quande；not just about one man 的否定信息弱，易漏。
5 意图：考"not just A, instead B"取 B 与"according to＋出处"限定。区分答人物的人与答象征义的人。
6 边界：若问 Who is the fisherman on the banknote based on? 答 Huang Quande（原文 many believed…was based on him，"被认为"）；问 stand for 才答象征义。
7 错误：A 答 Huang Quande.（错因：忽略 not just about one man）；B 答 The 20-yuan banknote.（错因：载体当象征）；C 答 Guilin.（错因：范围不完整）。
8 规则：R9.2 若题干 What does X stand for／represent，then 取原文 symbol／stand for／represent 后的表语；遇 not just A, instead B 取 B；例外：be based on 问的是原型，不是象征。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.20 象征／定义。
10 自检：①stand for 对应原文哪个词？②not just…instead… 我取哪边？③出处句对不对？

**28. 答案：On the back of the 5-yuan banknote.**
1 题面：On which banknote is the picture of Mount Tai；原文 "For example, on the back of the 5-yuan banknote is Mount Tai in Shandong."；完全倒装（介词短语＋be＋主语）。
2 候选：the 5-yuan banknote（原文）；the 1-yuan banknote（西湖）；the 20-yuan banknote（渔民）；the 100-yuan（无图案）。
3 验算：the 5-yuan banknote→与 on the back of the 5-yuan banknote is Mount Tai 逐字对应→成立。the 1-yuan→那是 Three Pools Mirroring the Moon→不成立。the 20-yuan→渔夫图案→排除。the 100-yuan→全文只说 from 1 yuan to 100，未给图案→排除。
4 干扰：段内三个面额同构句（on the back of the N-yuan banknote is…），只换名词，扫读极易串行。
5 意图：考"完全倒装的成分还原"与"同构句的面额对应"。区分按行扫描的人与先还原主谓的人。
6 边界：若问 What is on the back of the 1-yuan banknote? 答 the Three Pools Mirroring the Moon in West Lake；倒装句须先找主语再配对。
7 错误：A 答 The 1-yuan banknote.（错因：同构句串行）；B 答 The 20-yuan banknote.（错因：首段渔民先入）；C 答 Mount Tai.（错因：题干问面额，答成图案）。
8 规则：R9.3 若原文是完全倒装（介词短语＋be＋主语），then 先把主语与介词短语配对，再按题干问的成分取答案；例外：题干问 What is on…? 时取主语。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.21 倒装句取成分。
10 自检：①这句主语在哪？②三个面额各配什么？③题干问面额还是图案？

**29. 答案：More tourists (than before).**
1 题面：What do the pictures on the banknotes bring to these places；原文 "Because of the renminbi pictures, these places have attracted more tourists than before."；bring 与 attract 不同动词，需同义转换。
2 候选：more tourists（结果宾语）；more money（无）；cultural value（图案自身的价值）；a banknote tour（个例）。
3 验算：more tourists→attract more tourists 与 bring…tourists 同义，且 Because of the renminbi pictures 正对题干的原因→成立。more money→原文无→排除。cultural value→Each of them carries its own cultural value 说的是图案／景观的价值，不是"带来"的结果→不成立。a banknote tour→潘金玉的个人行为，不是"带给这些地方"的普遍结果→排除。
4 干扰：carries its own cultural value 与题干 bring 语义相近，诱人答 cultural value；潘金玉的例子占一整段，诱人答游客行为。
5 意图：考"bring 与 attract 的同义转换"＋"结果 vs 价值"。区分按原词匹配的人与按因果句定位的人。
6 边界：若问 What do the pictures carry? 答 cultural value；若问 What did Pan Jinyu do? 答 had a "banknote tour"。题干动词决定答案。
7 错误：A 答 Cultural value.（错因：carry 与 bring 混）；B 答 A banknote tour.（错因：个例当普遍结果）；C 答 More money.（错因：无中生有）。
8 规则：R9.4 若题干动词在原文找不到（bring／cause／lead to），then 找语义等价动词（attract／make／result in）所在的因果句，取结果宾语；例外：原文有 because of 时其后名词是原因，不是结果。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.22 同义动词转换。与 R2.2（因果方向）串联：先定 because of 是原因，再取主句结果。
10 自检：①bring 对应原文哪个动词？②because of 后是原因还是结果？③我答的是结果还是价值？

**30. 答案：（开放题）They are meaningful. They show the most iconic landscapes of China and carry cultural value.（言之成理＋原文依据即可）**
1 题面：What do you think of these renminbi pictures；What do you think of 是评价类开放题，原文无直接答案；可用依据：the most iconic landscapes／Each of them carries its own cultural value／attracted more tourists。
2 候选：①正面评价＋依据（有意义、有文化价值）；②负面评价＋依据（设计普通、不便携带）；③只表态不举例（I like them.）。
3 验算：①表态＋依据→符合开放题"观点＋支撑"，依据可在原文找到→成立。②负面也可成立（开放题允许），但须同样给依据→次优。③只表态→信息量不足，只得表态分→不成立为完整答案。
4 干扰：原文通篇正面（cultural symbol／iconic／attracted more tourists），诱人只抄原文形容词而不表态；题干 What do you think 又易被误读成"原文怎么说"。
5 意图：考"开放题＝观点＋文本依据"的结构，与"复述原文"分界。区分只抄原文的人与会给理由的人。
6 边界：若题干是 What does the writer think of…? 则答原文观点（positive），不能换成"我"；主语是 you 才是开放题。
7 错误：A 只写 I like them.（错因：无依据）；B 抄 Cultural symbol of Guilin landscape.（错因：答成原文信息未表态）；C 写相反观点且无理由（错因：开放题也要依据）。
8 规则：R9.5 若题干含 What do you think of／Do you agree，then 按"表态＋原文依据（1—2 点）"作答；主语是 you 用第一人称，主语是 the writer 时复述原文观点；例外：要求 give your reasons 时须两点以上。
9 位置：04→RA-6 开放题→RA-6.1 评价类。与 RA-3 主旨题分界：主旨复述，开放题表态。
10 自检：①题干主语是 you 还是 the writer？②我表态了吗？③依据能在原文找到吗？

**组小结（G9 · 小蓝书预测卷一 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：事件配对取年份 1（26）；象征义 1（27）；倒装句取成分 1（28）；同义动词转换 1（29）；评价类开放题 1（30）。
- 规则：R9.1 身份转变动词配时间（26）；R9.2 stand for 取表语、not just A instead B 取 B（27）；R9.3 倒装先还原主谓（28）；R9.4 同义动词转换取结果（29）；R9.5 开放题表态＋依据（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R9.2 与"首段主角最像答案"冲突，象征句优先；R9.4 与"近义词 carry 最像 bring"冲突，因果句优先；R9.5 与"复述原文即答案"冲突，表态优先。
- 未归类：无（30 为开放题，已归 RA-6）。
- 覆盖检查：首次出现"倒装句取成分"与"开放题"，RA-6 节点建立；仍缺"词义猜测（生词）""推断（作者态度）"。



### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷一 · Passage 4

Over past five years, Miao Zhenjie has been teaching the skills of porcelain carving (刻瓷). Her students are children with hearing problems at a special school in Taiyuan, Shanxi Province.

Miao began learning to carve porcelain in 1997. One day, she saw a folk artist carving a cute dog on a white porcelain plate. She was amazed. Then she decided to learn the skills.

The art of porcelain carving has a long history and was popular during the Qing Dynasty. Different pictures and patterns, including humans, flowers, birds and buildings, can be created on



the surface of porcelain with special tools.

According to Miao, different from many traditional forms of art, porcelain carvings can be kept forever. However, it's not easy to carve on a very thin surface. It requires precision (精确) and great painting skills.

To spread the traditional culture, Miao began teaching at the school in 2018. She found that the students with hearing problems were good learners of the art, because they were not easily influenced by different sounds. They also had their own understanding.

With the help of other teachers, Miao had little difficulty communicating with her students. "They can read my lips and then think, describe and share their understanding and questions. They get lots of happiness from the process. I will continue to help the students learn the skills and create more beautiful works of art. I hope I can spread the traditional art and culture." she said.

31. Where did Miao teach the skills of porcelain carving?

____________________

32. When did Miao decide to learn porcelain carving?

____________________

33. Why were the students with hearing problems good learners of art?

____________________

34. Did Miao have little or much difficulty communicating with her students?

____________________

35. What is Miao's hope according to the passage?

____________________

**〔G10〕小蓝书预测卷一 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：At a special school in Taiyuan, Shanxi Province.**
1 题面：Where did Miao teach the skills of porcelain carving；原文 "Her students are children with hearing problems at a special school in Taiyuan, Shanxi Province." 与 "Miao began teaching at the school in 2018."；后者用 the school 回指。
2 候选：at a special school in Taiyuan, Shanxi（全称）；in Taiyuan（上位）；at a school（笼统）；in Shanxi Province（上位）。
3 验算：at a special school in Taiyuan, Shanxi→与首段逐字对应→成立。in Taiyuan→丢"特殊学校"这一关键限定→次优。at a school→丢地点，不可→排除。in Shanxi Province→丢学校类型与城市→信息不足。
4 干扰：首段那句的主语是 Her students，谓语是 are，地址藏在表语里，不像"答案句"；2018 句只说 at the school，不还原就看不出是哪所。
5 意图：考"定冠词 the school 回指前文全称"与"地点取最小完整表述"。区分抓最近地点的人与回指还原的人。
6 边界：若问 When did Miao begin teaching at the school? 答 in 2018；Where 才答地点。
7 错误：A 答 In Taiyuan.（错因：丢学校类型）；B 答 At the school.（错因：the 回指未还原）；C 答 In Shanxi.（错因：范围过大）。
8 规则：R10.1 若原文用 the＋名词 回指前文，then 回前文取该名词的完整表述（含修饰语）作答；地点题取"最小完整地点"，不取上位范围。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点定位（回指还原）。
10 自检：①the school 指哪所？②地点修饰语有哪些？③我取的是全称还是上位？

**32. 答案：In 1997.**
1 题面：When did Miao decide to learn porcelain carving；原文 "Miao began learning to carve porcelain in 1997. One day, she saw a folk artist carving a cute dog on a white porcelain plate. She was amazed. Then she decided to learn the skills."；decided 所在句无年份。
2 候选：in 1997（began learning 的年份）；one day（模糊叙事词）；in 2018（开始教书）；in the Qing Dynasty（刻瓷流行期）。
3 验算：in 1997→began learning 与 decided to learn 是同一决定的两次表述，年份共享→成立。one day→是叙事起点，不是年份→不成立。in 2018→教书年份→排除。in the Qing Dynasty→历史背景，与人物无关→排除。
4 干扰：decided to learn the skills 那句没有年份，诱人以为"原文未给"而答 one day；2018 也是 Miao 的年份，两个年份易混。
5 意图：考"同一事件的两次表述共享时间状语"与"人物多事件多时间的切分"。区分只在本句找年份的人与回上文取共享时间的人。
6 边界：若问 When did Miao begin teaching? 答 in 2018；若问 When did she see the folk artist? 答 one day（原文 only one day，不确指，不能补年份）。
7 错误：A 答 One day.（错因：叙事词当年份）；B 答 In 2018.（错因：教书年份）；C 答 In the Qing Dynasty.（错因：历史背景）。
8 规则：R10.2 若题干事件的句子无时间状语，then 回上一句找共享的年份／时间；同一人物多个年份按事件配对，不混用。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间定位（跨句共享）。
10 自检：①decided 那句有年份吗？②上文年份是多少？③2018 是哪个事件的？

**33. 答案：Because they were not easily influenced by different sounds (and had their own understanding).**
1 题面：Why were the students…good learners of art；原文 "She found that the students with hearing problems were good learners of the art, because they were not easily influenced by different sounds. They also had their own understanding."
2 候选：because they were not easily influenced by sounds（主因）；because they had their own understanding（追加）；because they could read lips（交流方式）；because Miao helped them（条件）。
3 验算：because they were not easily influenced by different sounds→because 从句直接给出→成立。because they had their own understanding→They also had… 是并列追加（also），可作第二点，单独作答则不完整→次优。because they could read lips→那是交流方式（how），不是"学艺术学得好"的原因→不成立。because Miao helped them→原文是 With the help of other teachers，属条件非原因→排除。
4 干扰：They also had their own understanding 紧接 because 句，also 表追加，易被当第二个 because；read my lips 段落长，诱人取它。
5 意图：考"because 从句的管辖范围"与"also 是追加不是原因"，以及"原因 vs 方式／条件"。区分见 also 就并列的人与分清 because 边界的人。
6 边界：若问 How did Miao communicate with them? 答 They read her lips（with other teachers' help）；问 Why good learners 才取 because。
7 错误：A 答 Because they could read lips.（错因：方式当原因）；B 只答 they had their own understanding（错因：漏主因）；C 答 Because Miao taught them.（错因：因果倒置）。
8 规则：R10.3 若题干 Why＋结果，then 只取 because／since 从句管辖的内容；also／besides 后是追加，可补不可替代主因；方式（by／read lips）与条件（with help）不入原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因定位（管辖范围）。
10 自检：①because 从句到哪结束？②also 后是原因吗？③read lips 是方式还是原因？

**34. 答案：Little.（She had little difficulty.）**
1 题面：选择疑问句 Did Miao have little or much difficulty communicating with her students；原文 "With the help of other teachers, Miao had little difficulty communicating with her students."；两个选项已内嵌题干。
2 候选：little（原文）；much（另一选项）；some（模糊）；no（绝对化）。
3 验算：little→had little difficulty 逐字对应，With the help of other teachers 提供解释→成立。much→与原文相反→不成立。some→原文用 little 而非 some，弱化了"几乎没有"→次优。no→little 是"几乎没有"不是"完全没有"，绝对化→次优。
4 干扰：With the help of other teachers 诱人以为"仍需帮助→有困难"，故选 much；little 与 a little 的差别也是隐藏坑。
5 意图：考"little＝否定倾向（几乎没有）"与"外部条件不改变结论"。区分把 help 读成"有困难"的人与按 little 判定的人。
6 边界：若原文是 a little difficulty，则答"有一点困难"（肯定）；little 与 a little 语义相反，是本题隐藏考点。
7 错误：A 答 Much.（错因：把 help 读成困难）；B 答 No difficulty.（错因：little≠none）；C 答 A little.（错因：little 与 a little 混）。
8 规则：R8.6 若题干是 A or B 选择疑问句，then 按原文择一，不因附带条件（with help）改判；遇 little／few（否定倾向）与 a little／a few（肯定）须分清。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 二选一（选择疑问句）。与 R1.2 同一规则族，题干形态相同。
10 自检：①原文是 little 还是 a little？②help 是条件还是反证？③我答的是选项之一吗？

**35. 答案：To spread the traditional art and culture.**
1 题面：What is Miao's hope according to the passage；原文段末引语 "I hope I can spread the traditional art and culture."；hope 后接省略 that 的宾语从句。
2 候选：to spread the traditional art and culture（hope 的内容）；to help students learn skills（前一句 will continue）；to create more works（并列）；to teach at the school（已发生）。
3 验算：to spread the traditional art and culture→与 I hope I can spread… 对应，改写为不定式→成立。to help students learn skills→是 I will continue to help… 的决心，不是 hope→不成立。to create more works→同上，will continue 的并列内容→排除。to teach at the school→2018 已发生的事实→排除。
4 干扰：引语内三句连排（will continue to help／create／hope），hope 在最后，诱人取前面的 help／create；hope 与 will 的情态差别易被忽略。
5 意图：考"引语内多层意愿的切分"（will／hope／want）与"hope 取其后内容"。区分抓引语第一个动词的人与定位 hope 的人。
6 边界：若问 What will Miao continue to do? 答 help the students learn the skills and create more works；问 hope 才答 spread the art and culture。
7 错误：A 答 To help students learn skills.（错因：will continue 当 hope）；B 答 To create more works.（错因：并列项误取）；C 答 To teach at the school.（错因：既成事实）。
8 规则：R10.4 若题干 What is sb's hope／wish／dream，then 只取 hope／wish／dream 后的从句或不定式内容，不取同段 will／continue／want 的其它意愿；例外：hope 与 want 并列时可合并作答。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.23 意愿动词切分。
10 自检：①hope 后面是什么？②前面还有哪些意愿动词？③我取的是希望还是决心？

**组小结（G10 · 小蓝书预测卷一 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：地点回指还原 1（31）；跨句共享时间 1（32）；原因管辖范围 1（33）；选择疑问句＋little 1（34）；hope 切分 1（35）。
- 规则：R10.1 the＋名词回指还原（31）；R10.2 时间跨句共享（32）；R10.3 because 管辖范围（33）；R8.6 二选一＋little／a little（34）；R10.4 hope 取后置内容（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R10.2 与"本句无年份即无答案"冲突，跨句共享优先；R10.3 与"also 即并列原因"冲突，because 管辖优先；R8.6 与"help 暗示有困难"冲突，little 字面优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：补齐"回指还原、跨句共享时间、原因管辖、意愿切分"；仍缺"词义猜测""推断（作者态度）"，这两类将在后续卷出现。



### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷七 · Passage 1

Around 30% of our planet is covered with trees. Trees do good to us and the earth in many ways, but we're cutting them down at a high speed. Since the start of human development, it is believed that we have cut down almost half the trees on Earth. So, what would happen if all of us planted a tree?

Everyone planting a tree would be an important step, but we would need to do more to



protect the environment. In fact, according to a report, if we planted 1.2 trillion trees, our environment would become much better. So that's more like 150 trees per person since there are 8 billion people now.

Trees planted near the equator (赤道) can be especially helpful, because they grow much faster in a warm and wet environment. Let's imagine that happened. In as little as 20 or 30 years, a whole forest will be built. And in 100 years, these trees would grow up, and they, along with dead trees, offer a place to all kinds of fungi (菌菇) and insects. On top of this, we could see a good influence on our mind, as studies have shown that trees can lower stress and make people happier.

But no matter how much trees offer to us, we're cutting them down at a high speed. And it does great harm to our environment. So, although tree planting is a useful way of dealing with climate change—a change in weather conditions, it won't be enough unless we lower the number we cut down in the beginning and make big changes to the way we live.

So, if everyone on the planet planted a tree, it would make a difference to the environment. And if we kept on planting them and stopped cutting them down, it could be a meaningful way to protect our world.

(one trillion = 1, 000, 000, 000, 000; one billion = 1, 000, 000, 000)

16. How many trees have we cut down on Earth since the start of human development?

We have cut down ______ on Earth.

17. What does the second paragraph mainly tell us?

It mainly tells us the ______ of trees everyone needs to plant.

18. What does the underlined word "it" refer to in Paragraph 4?

It refers to " ______ at a high speed".

19. What opinion does the writer express in the last paragraph about tree planting?

The writer thinks it would be ______ to our world.

20. What title can you make for this passage in no more than eight words using "what if, plant, tree"?

The title can be " ______ ".

**〔G11〕小蓝书预测卷七 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：almost half the trees**
1 题面：How many trees have we cut down…；框架 "We have cut down ______ on Earth."；原文 "Since the start of human development, it is believed that we have cut down almost half the trees on Earth."
2 候选：almost half the trees（原文比例）；3 trillion trees（无此数）；1.2 trillion trees（需种量）；150 trees per person（人均需种）。
3 验算：almost half the trees→与原文逐字对应，限定语 Since the start of human development 同句→成立。1.2 trillion trees→那是 if we planted…（需要种）的量，方向相反→不成立。150 trees per person→人均需种，非已砍→排除。3 trillion→全文无→排除。
4 干扰：第二段 1.2 trillion 与 150 trees per person 数字大、紧接出现，诱人取；题干 How many 让人期待精确数，而原文给的是"几乎一半"这一比例。
5 意图：考"数量答案可以是比例"，以及"砍伐量 vs 需种量"的方向区分。区分见数字就抄的人与按动词配对的人。
6 边界：若问 How many trees do we need to plant? 答 1.2 trillion；若问 How many trees per person? 答 150。同篇三个数量，动词决定取哪个。
7 错误：A 答 1.2 trillion trees（错因：需种量当砍伐量）；B 答 150 trees（错因：人均需种）；C 答 half the trees（错因：漏 almost，绝对化）。
8 规则：R11.1 若题干 How many 而原文给比例（half／most／30%），then 照抄比例短语，不换算成数字；多数量并存时按动词（cut down／plant／need）配对；例外：原文有括号换算说明时仍以正文表述为准。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（比例型）。与 R2.4（数字排他）互补：那条排数字，这条防"比例被改写成数字"。
10 自检：①原文给的是比例还是数字？②动词是 cut down 还是 plant？③almost 我漏了吗？

**17. 答案：number**
1 题面：What does the second paragraph mainly tell us；框架 "It mainly tells us the ______ of trees everyone needs to plant."——空在 the 与 of 之间，需名词；第二段讲 1.2 trillion trees／150 trees per person。
2 候选：number（可数数量）；amount（不可数数量）；importance（重要性）；way（方式）。
3 验算：number→the number of trees 固定搭配，第二段全在算"要种多少棵"→成立。amount→amount 配不可数名词（amount of water），trees 可数→不成立。importance→第二段没论证重要性（第一段才是）→排除。way→第二段未讲方式→排除。
4 干扰：第一段讲 trees do good to us（重要性），段意易串；amount 与 number 都可译"数量"，是最高频语法陷阱。
5 意图：考"段意概括＋可数/不可数选词"。区分按汉语"数量"直译的人与按可数性选词的人。
6 边界：若框架是 "the ______ of water"，用 amount；若问 What is the second paragraph about? 可答 How many trees we need to plant（从句），不必填名词。
7 错误：A 填 amount（错因：可数名词用 amount）；B 填 importance（错因：段意串到第一段）；C 填 number of trees（错因：把 of 后内容也填进空）。
8 规则：R11.2 若框架是 "the ______ of＋可数名词"，then 填 number；配不可数名词填 amount；概括段意时先看该段有无数字／列举，再定名词。
9 位置：04→RA-3 主旨题→RA-3.2 段意概括（数量型）。与 R7.5（全文主旨）分界：那条管全文，这条管单段。
10 自检：①第二段中心是数字吗？②trees 可数吗？③我填的是名词还是从句？

**18. 答案：cutting them down（cutting down trees）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "it" refer to in Paragraph 4；框架 "It refers to ' ______ at a high speed'."；第四段 "But no matter how much trees offer to us, we're cutting them down at a high speed. And it does great harm to our environment."；划线的 it 是 does great harm 的主语。
2 候选：cutting them down（动作）；trees（对象）；the environment（受影响者）；a high speed（状语）。
3 验算：cutting them down→it does great harm 指"我们高速砍树"这件事，代入框架 "cutting them down at a high speed" 语义完整→成立。trees→"trees at a high speed" 不成立（树不会以高速）→排除。the environment→"the environment at a high speed" 不成立→排除。a high speed→已出现在框架中，重复→排除。
4 干扰：trees 是全文高频词且紧挨 it 前，诱人取最近名词；框架已有 at a high speed，诱人只填 speed 造成重复。
5 意图：考"it 指代整个动作（动名词短语）"而非名词，以及"框架已给成分不重复"。区分只找最近名词的人与找整个动作的人。
6 边界：若框架是 "It refers to ' ______ '."（无 at a high speed），则填 cutting them down at a high speed；若 it 后接 is＋adj＋to do（形式主语），指代的是不定式。
7 错误：A 填 trees（错因：最近名词）；B 填 a high speed（错因：与框架重复）；C 填 cutting（错因：漏 them，动作不完整）。
8 规则：R11.3 若 it 后接"谓语＋宾语"且语义上需要"一件事"作主语，then 指代前文动作（V-ing 短语），动词与宾语一起还原；框架已给的成分不重复填。
9 位置：04→RA-2 指代题→RA-2.2 动作指代。与 R8.2（名词回指）并列。
10 自检：①it 后是 does great harm 吗？②框架已给了什么？③动作的宾语还原了吗？

**19. 答案：meaningful**
1 题面：What opinion does the writer express in the last paragraph about tree planting；框架 "The writer thinks it would be ______ to our world."；原文末段 "And if we kept on planting them and stopped cutting them down, it could be a meaningful way to protect our world."
2 候选：meaningful（末段定性）；useful（第三段，被 but 打折）；important（第一段主题）；difficult（无）。
3 验算：meaningful→a meaningful way to protect our world 与框架 be ______ to our world 对应（way 省去）→成立。useful→原文第三段 "tree planting is a useful way of dealing with climate change, it won't be enough unless…"，随即被否定式打折，且题干限定 last paragraph→次优。important→第一段讲树的好处，不是对"种树"的定性→排除。difficult→原文无→排除。
4 干扰：useful 同篇出现、语义接近，诱人取；末段 meaningful 前有 could be，语气弱，易被当成"不确定"跳过。
5 意图：考"作者定性词取题干限定段"与"被 but 打折的评价不作最终态度"。区分抓首次评价词的人与按段落限定定位的人。
6 边界：若问 What is the writer's attitude towards tree planting? 应答 positive but not enough（须带保留）；只答 meaningful 会丢"unless we cut down less"的条件。
7 错误：A 填 useful（错因：过渡评价）；B 填 important（错因：第一段主题）；C 填 meaningful way（错因：把 way 也填进空）。
8 规则：R11.4 若题干限定段落（in the last paragraph）＋opinion，then 只在该段找定性形容词，取作者最终评价，不取被 but／however 打折的过渡评价。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.3 作者态度（段落限定）。与 RA-6 开放题分界：态度题复述作者，开放题说"我"。
10 自检：①题干限定哪一段？②useful 那句有转折吗？③我填的是形容词还是短语？

**20. 答案：What if we all plant a tree?**
1 题面：What title can you make for this passage in no more than eight words using "what if, plant, tree"；框架 "The title can be ' ______ '."；三个给定词须全用、词数≤8。
2 候选：①What if we all plant a tree?（7 词，三词齐）；②Planting Trees（2 词，缺 what if）；③What If Everyone Plants a Tree（6 词，plant 变 plants）；④Why We Should Plant Trees（缺 what if）。
3 验算：①7 词、含 what if／plant／tree，疑问形式呼应首段末 So, what would happen if all of us planted a tree?→成立。②缺 what if，违反 using 要求→不成立。③plants 改变给定词形，且疑问句缺问号→次优、风险高。④缺 what if→不成立。
4 干扰：首段末整句 "So, what would happen if all of us planted a tree?" 就在文中，诱人照抄（超 8 词）；Planting Trees 最像"标题"，但漏给定词。
5 意图：考"标题＝形式合规＋要素齐全＋字数上限"三重约束，以及给定词须原形出现。区分凭感觉起标题的人与逐条核对约束的人。
6 边界：若题干只说 write a title（无给定词、无字数），可用名词短语 Planting Trees；一旦给了 what if，标题须为疑问句并在句末加问号。
7 错误：A 抄首段整句（错因：超 8 词）；B 写 Planting Trees（错因：漏给定词）；C 写 What if we plant trees?（错因：tree 变复数，词形不符）。
8 规则：R11.5 若题干给"不超过 N 词＋须用某几个词"，then 先凑齐给定词原形，再控制词数，最后按给定词性质定句式（what if→疑问句＋问号）；例外：题干允许 change the form 时才可变形。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.4 拟标题（约束型）。与 R7.5（how to 主旨）并列，同属 RA-3。
10 自检：①三个词都用了吗？②几个词（what if 算两词）？③要不要问号？

**组小结（G11 · 小蓝书预测卷七 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：比例型数量 1（16）；段意＋可数性 1（17）；动作指代 1（18）；作者态度（段落限定）1（19）；约束型拟标题 1（20）。
- 规则：R11.1 比例照抄、按动词配对（16）；R11.2 number／amount 按可数性（17）；R11.3 it 指动作（18）；R11.4 态度取限定段、排除被折价评价（19）；R11.5 标题三重约束（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R11.1 与"精确数字更保险"冲突，原文比例优先；R11.4 与"首次评价即态度"冲突，末段优先；R11.5 与"标题要简洁"冲突，给定词齐全优先于简洁。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：补齐"比例型数量、动作指代、拟标题"；RA-3 现有 how to／段意／态度／标题四子类。



### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷七 · Passage 2

The Spring Festival is coming soon! Will you try making some paper cuttings? Paper cutting is one of the traditional folk arts (民间艺术) in China. It has a long history of more



than 1,500 years. People always use paper, scissors and knives to make paper cuttings.

It's difficult to tell when it started. People found paper cut of animals in tombs (墓) in the Northern and Southern Dynasty (南北朝). By the Southern Song Dynasty, paper cutting had become an important part of everyday life. At that time, a young man would look at a young woman's paper-cutting skills before marrying her.

Paper cuttings are mostly used for decoration. In China, it is common to see paper cuttings on walls, windows, doors and mirrors during holidays. People make them to show their joy or their wishes for good luck and health. People also use paper cuttings as design patterns on clothing. They make the clothes look special and different. What's more, paper cuttings are made to be great gifts for friends and love ones.

It is easy to learn paper cutting but very difficult to make it perfect. We need to learn how to use the scissors and the engraving knife. Moreover, we need a lot of practice to learn paper-cutting skills.

A funny thing is that, in many parts of China nowadays, paper-cutting skills are still a must for women because people think they are a symbol of a clever mind.

21. How long is the history of paper cutting?

It has a history of more than ______.

22. What tools do we need to make paper cuttings?

We need paper, ______ to make paper cuttings.

23. When had paper cutting become an important part of everyday life?

It had become an important part of everyday life by the ______.

24. What does the underlined word "them", refer to in the third paragraph?

It refers to ______.

25. Why are paper-cutting skills still a must for women in many parts of China?

Because people think they are a symbol of ______.

**〔G12〕小蓝书预测卷七 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：1,500 years**
1 题面：How long is the history of paper cutting；框架 "It has a history of more than ______."；原文 "It has a long history of more than 1,500 years."
2 候选：1,500 years（数字＋单位）；1,500（缺单位）；more than 1,500 years（与框架重复）；the Northern and Southern Dynasty（朝代）。
3 验算：1,500 years→框架已有 more than，补成 more than 1,500 years→成立。1,500→缺单位 years，简答扣分→次优。more than 1,500 years→与框架 more than 重复→不成立。朝代→答非所问→排除。
4 干扰：框架自带 more than，诱人连它一起抄造成重复；下文 Northern and Southern Dynasty 是时间名词，易混。
5 意图：考"框架已给成分不重复"与"数量单位完整"。区分整句照抄的人与按空位裁剪的人。
6 边界：若框架是 "It has a history of ______." 则填 more than 1,500 years；空位前已有 more than 时只填 1,500 years。
7 错误：A 填 more than 1,500 years（错因：与框架重复）；B 填 1,500（错因：缺单位）；C 填 1,500-year（错因：形容词形式，此处需名词短语）。
8 规则：R12.1 若框架已含数量限定词（more than／about／over），then 空内只填"数字＋单位"，不重复限定词；例外：限定词在空后时须前置到空内。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（框架去重）。
10 自检：①框架有 more than 吗？②单位 years 带了吗？③我整句照抄了吗？

**22. 答案：scissors and knives**
1 题面：What tools do we need；框架 "We need paper, ______ to make paper cuttings."；原文 "People always use paper, scissors and knives to make paper cuttings."；框架已给 paper，空内补其余两项并用 and 连接。
2 候选：scissors and knives（两项）；scissors（漏 knives）；knives and scissors（顺序反）；the engraving knife（后文另一处工具）。
3 验算：scissors and knives→与 use paper, scissors and knives 对应，裁去已给的 paper→成立。scissors→漏 knives→次优。knives and scissors→顺序与原文反，语义不错但不符合照原文惯例→可接受的次优。the engraving knife→那是第四段"要学用"的工具，与"做剪纸用什么"部分重合但不全→不成立为完整答案。
4 干扰：第四段 "We need to learn how to use the scissors and the engraving knife" 也列工具、动词也是 need，诱人用 engraving knife 替换 knives。
5 意图：考"并列项按框架裁剪"与"同篇两处工具列表按动词区分"。区分见 need 就抄的人与按 use…to make 定位的人。
6 边界：若框架没给 paper，须填 paper, scissors and knives 三项；若问 What do we need to learn to use? 答 the scissors and the engraving knife。
7 错误：A 只填 scissors（错因：漏 knives）；B 填 engraving knife（错因：把"要学的工具"当"制作工具"）；C 填 paper, scissors and knives（错因：与框架 paper 重复）。
8 规则：R12.2 若框架已列部分并列项，then 只补剩余项并用 and 连接；同篇多处列举按题干动词（use…to make／learn to use）配对。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.15 并列宾语（框架裁剪）。
10 自检：①框架已给哪项？②原文并列几项？③我用 and 连接了吗？

**23. 答案：Southern Song Dynasty**
1 题面：When had paper cutting become an important part of everyday life；框架 "It had become…by the ______."；原文 "By the Southern Song Dynasty, paper cutting had become an important part of everyday life."
2 候选：Southern Song Dynasty（原文）；Northern and Southern Dynasty（前一句）；Song Dynasty（简写）；Southern Song（漏 Dynasty）。
3 验算：Southern Song Dynasty→与 By the Southern Song Dynasty 逐字对应，by 与框架 by the 呼应→成立。Northern and Southern Dynasty→那是"墓中发现动物剪纸"的朝代，事件不同→不成立。Song Dynasty→丢 Southern，朝代不精确→次优。Southern Song→漏 Dynasty，专名不完整→次优。
4 干扰：前一句 People found paper cut of animals in tombs in the Northern and Southern Dynasty 也带 Dynasty，时间更早，诱人取；两个朝代名只差 Southern。
5 意图：考"by＋朝代"与"同段两朝代按事件区分"。区分抓第一个朝代名的人与按事件定位的人。
6 边界：若问 When did people find paper cut of animals in tombs? 答 in the Northern and Southern Dynasty；框架 by the 提示要"到……为止"的朝代。
7 错误：A 填 Northern and Southern Dynasty（错因：事件错位）；B 填 Song Dynasty（错因：漏 Southern）；C 填 Southern Song（错因：专名不完整）。
8 规则：R12.3 若框架是 "by the ______"，then 取原文 by the＋时间的完整专名，不取同段其它朝代；专名中心词（Dynasty／Province）不可省。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间定位（专名完整）。
10 自检：①by the 后是哪个朝代？②前一句朝代属哪个事件？③Dynasty 带了吗？

**24. 答案：paper cuttings**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "them" refer to in the third paragraph；框架 "It refers to ______."；第三段 "People make them to show their joy or their wishes for good luck and health."；them 为复数。
2 候选：paper cuttings（本段主题，复数）；people（施动者）；walls, windows, doors and mirrors（张贴处，复数）；gifts（用途）。
3 验算：paper cuttings→make them 的 them 回指本段主题 paper cuttings，复数一致，"做剪纸表达喜悦"通顺→成立。people→make people to show 不成立（make sb do 不带 to）→排除。walls…mirrors→张贴位置，不是"做"的对象→不成立。gifts→原文 paper cuttings are made to be great gifts，是用途之一，非 them 的回指→次优。
4 干扰：同段 walls, windows, doors and mirrors 是四个并列名词、形式最像复数先行词；gifts 也在 make 的语义场。
5 意图：考"复数代词回指本段主题名词"与"排除同段其它复数名词"。区分找最近复数名词的人与找主题名词的人。
6 边界：若问 What are paper cuttings used as on clothing? 答 design patterns；若代词换成 it（单数），回指 paper cutting 这一概念。
7 错误：A 填 walls, windows, doors and mirrors（错因：最近复数名词）；B 填 people（错因：施动者）；C 填 gifts（错因：用途当先行词）。
8 规则：R12.4 若代词是复数 them／they，then 优先回指本段主题名词（复数），其次才考虑最近复数名词；判定法：把候选替换进原句，看语义是否仍然通顺。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.1 代词回指（复数）。与 R8.2（单数 it）同一节点。
10 自检：①them 是复数吗？②本段主题名词是哪个？③最近复数名词能替换吗？

**25. 答案：a clever mind**
1 题面：Why are paper-cutting skills still a must for women；框架 "Because people think they are a symbol of ______."；原文 "paper-cutting skills are still a must for women because people think they are a symbol of a clever mind."
2 候选：a clever mind（原文）；cleverness（同义改写）；a clever mind's symbol（与框架重复）；good luck and health（第二段祝愿）。
3 验算：a clever mind→与 a symbol of a clever mind 逐字对应，框架已给 a symbol of→成立。cleverness→语义等同但非原文措辞→次优。a clever mind's symbol→与框架 a symbol of 重复→不成立。good luck and health→那是剪纸表达的祝愿，不是"女性必须会剪纸"的原因→排除。
4 干扰：第二段 good luck and health 与"象征"语义接近，诱人取；框架已给 a symbol of，诱人加 's 造成重复。
5 意图：考"because 从句内 of 的宾语"与"框架去重"。区分抓象征词就填的人与按 because 管辖取宾语的人。
6 边界：若问 What do paper cuttings show? 答 people's joy or their wishes for good luck and health；问 why a must 才答 a clever mind。
7 错误：A 填 good luck and health（错因：第二段祝愿当原因）；B 填 cleverness（错因：非原文措辞，可给分）；C 填 a clever mind's symbol（错因：与框架重复）。
8 规则：R12.5 若框架是 "Because…a symbol of ______"，then 只填 of 后的名词短语，不加所有格；原因取 because 从句内表语的核心名词。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因定位（框架嵌套）。
10 自检：①because 从句到哪结束？②of 后是什么？③我加 's 了吗？

**组小结（G12 · 小蓝书预测卷七 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：数量框架去重 1（21）；并列项裁剪 1（22）；朝代专名 1（23）；复数回指 1（24）；原因框架嵌套 1（25）。
- 规则：R12.1 限定词不重复（21）；R12.2 并列项按框架裁剪（22）；R12.3 by the＋专名完整（23）；R12.4 复数回指主题名词（24）；R12.5 原因＋of 短语去重（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R12.1／R12.2／R12.5 与"整句照抄最保险"冲突，均以"框架已有成分不重复"优先；R12.3 与"最近朝代名"冲突，事件配对优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：本篇五题全是"框架去重／裁剪"变体，可并入"补全式简答"的形态规则族；仍缺词义猜测与推断。



### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷七 · Passage 3

We all know that Britain and the US are two countries connected by a common language. But in fact, the differences are more fun to study, as BBC did in a recent story called *8 Situations when Britons Behave Differently from Americans*. We have picked out four for you. Take a look.

**When someone knocks into you**



If someone knocks into an American, the victim (受害者) will probably look at the aggressor (冒失者) in the face and expect an expression of regret. If, however, the victim happens to be British, the victim will say "sorry" before the other person says it.

**When you get dressed for dinner**

Britons don't all change into evening dresses for supper like what you may have seen in popular TV shows. But they do try to make an effort when going out for dinner somewhere nice. Americans, however, will probably wear a common shirt to a nice restaurant.

**When you don't finish your food**

Britons wouldn't think to take the leftovers home when dining out at a restaurant. They think the food is somehow "tainted (污染的)" because they've stuck at it with a knife and fork. But in the US, packing it up to take home is a custom.

**When you get into a taxi**

Britons will give the taxi driver an address, then they don't say anything with the driver before it's time to pay. Sometimes they're being taken in a wrong way, they don't like to say anything, either. In the US, however, most passengers will tell the driver which way to go after telling him or her the address.

**〔G13〕小蓝书预测卷七 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：Four (4).**
1 题面：How many situations does the passage show us about different behaviors；原文 "We have picked out four for you."；后文四个加粗小标题：When someone knocks into you／When you get dressed for dinner／When you don't finish your food／When you get into a taxi。
2 候选：four（本文）；eight（出处标题）；two（英美两国）；three（数漏）。
3 验算：four→原文 picked out four 明写，且四个小标题可逐一复核→成立。eight→那是 BBC 原报道 8 Situations when Britons Behave Differently from Americans 的数目，本文只选四→不成立。two→问情境数不是国家数→排除。three→漏数一个标题→不成立。
4 干扰：标题里的 8 最醒目且就在首段，诱人答 eight；小标题加粗分行、跨页，最后一个（get into a taxi）易漏。
5 意图：考"本文数字 vs 出处标题数字"与"按小标题复核"。区分抓首个数字的人与数完再核对的人。
6 边界：若问 How many countries are mentioned? 答 two（Britain and the US）；若问 How many situations does BBC's story have? 答 eight。
7 错误：A 答 Eight.（错因：标题数字当本文数量）；B 答 Two.（错因：国家数当情境数）；C 答 Three.（错因：漏数标题）。
8 规则：R13.1 若题干 How many＋本文内容，then 先数本文列举项（小标题／编号）复核，再看有无明写数字；出处标题里的数字不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（清点型）。与 R7.2（清点＋量词）同族。
10 自检：①本文几个小标题？②8 是谁的数量？③我数漏了吗？

**27. 答案：The victim.**
1 题面：选择疑问句 Who will say sorry first if someone knocks into a Briton, the victim or the aggressor；原文 "If, however, the victim happens to be British, the victim will say 'sorry' before the other person says it."
2 候选：the victim（英国人即受害者）；the aggressor（撞人者）；both；neither。
3 验算：the victim→the victim will say "sorry" before the other person，与"先说"对应→成立。the aggressor→原文 the other person（即 aggressor）是被先说的一方→不成立。both／neither→原文只一方先说→排除。
4 干扰：前句写美国人 the victim will expect an expression of regret（要求对方道歉），与英国人相反；the other person 不叫 aggressor，须回上句对号。
5 意图：考"英美对比取英国一侧"与"the other person＝aggressor 的同义对号"。区分抓第一句（美国）的人与定位 however 后的人。
6 边界：若问 What will an American victim expect? 答 an expression of regret；问谁先说才答 the victim（英国人）。
7 错误：A 答 The aggressor.（错因：把 the other person 当先说者）；B 答 The American.（错因：答国家不答角色）；C 答 Both.（错因：无依据）。
8 规则：R13.2 若题干是 A or B 选择疑问句且原文有两国／两类对比，then 先按 however／In the US 划出对应一侧，再在该侧句内取角色；the other person 类指代须回上句对号。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 二选一（对比取侧）。
10 自检：①题干问哪国人？②however 后是哪一侧？③the other person 指谁？

**28. 答案：A common shirt.**
1 题面：What will Americans probably wear to a nice restaurant；原文 "Americans, however, will probably wear a common shirt to a nice restaurant."
2 候选：a common shirt（原文）；evening dresses（英国段否定）；a suit（常识）；casual clothes（上位）。
3 验算：a common shirt→与 will probably wear a common shirt 逐字对应→成立。evening dresses→原文 Britons don't all change into evening dresses，是英国段的否定内容→不成立。a suit→常识补白，原文无→排除。casual clothes→上位概括，common shirt 才是原文→次优。
4 干扰：本段先写 Britons don't all change into evening dresses…they do try to make an effort，让"正装"印象先入，诱人答 suit／evening dress。
5 意图：考"however 后取美国一侧的具体名词"与"上位概括 vs 原文具体"。区分按常识答正装的人与按原文取具体名词的人。
6 边界：若问 What do Britons do when going out for dinner somewhere nice? 答 They try to make an effort；问 Americans 才答 a common shirt。
7 错误：A 答 Evening dresses.（错因：否定句当答案）；B 答 A suit.（错因：常识补白）；C 答 Casual clothes.（错因：上位代具体）。
8 规则：R13.3 若问 What will sb wear／eat／do，then 取该侧句的具体名词短语，不取另一侧的否定内容，不用上位词替换原文具体词。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.24 具体名词取词（对比取侧）。与 R13.2 共用"对比取侧"。
10 自检：①主语是 Americans 吗？②evening dresses 在肯定还是否定句？③我答的是具体名词吗？

**29. 答案：Because they've stuck at it with a knife and fork.**
1 题面：Why do Britons think the leftover food is tainted；原文 "They think the food is somehow 'tainted' because they've stuck at it with a knife and fork."
2 候选：because they've stuck at it with a knife and fork（because 从句）；because they don't take leftovers home（表现）；because packing up is a custom in the US（美国侧）；because the food is dirty（常识）。
3 验算：because they've stuck at it with a knife and fork→because 从句直接给出→成立。because they don't take leftovers home→那是做法（结果／表现），不是"认为被污染"的原因→不成立。because packing up is a custom in the US→美国侧信息→排除。because the food is dirty→常识补白，原文用 tainted 并给了刀叉解释→排除。
4 干扰：前一句 Britons wouldn't think to take the leftovers home 与 tainted 紧邻，诱人把"不打包"当原因；tainted 的常识义（脏）也诱人答 dirty。
5 意图：考"because 从句取因"与"行为表现 ≠ 原因"。区分按常识解释的人与按 because 取句的人。
6 边界：若问 What do Americans do with leftovers? 答 They pack it up to take home；问 Why tainted 才答 stuck at it with a knife and fork。
7 错误：A 答 Because they don't take leftovers home.（错因：结果当原因）；B 答 Because the food is dirty.（错因：常识补白）；C 答 Because Americans pack it up.（错因：取美国侧）。
8 规则：R13.4 若题干 Why，then 只取 because／since 从句内容；同段行为句是结果或表现，不作原因；带引号的评价词要用原文解释，不用常识。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因定位（引号词解释）。
10 自检：①because 从句是什么？②前一句是原因还是表现？③tainted 原文怎么解释？

**30. 答案：After telling the driver the address.**
1 题面：When will most Americans tell the driver which way to go after they get on the taxi；原文 "In the US, however, most passengers will tell the driver which way to go after telling him or her the address."
2 候选：after telling the driver the address（原文时间）；before paying（英国侧）；at the end of the ride（常识）；as soon as they get in（近义改写）。
3 验算：after telling the driver the address→与 after telling him or her the address 逐字对应→成立。before paying→那是英国段 before it's time to pay 的对照→不成立。at the end of the ride→无依据→排除。as soon as→语义接近但抹掉"报完地址之后"的先后层→次优。
4 干扰：英国段 "they don't say anything with the driver before it's time to pay" 提供"付钱时才说话"的对照；题干自带 after they get on，诱人答 as soon as。
5 意图：考"after doing 时间状语的精确还原"与"英美两侧不串"。区分按常识（一上车就说）的人与按 after telling 定位的人。
6 边界：若问 When do Britons talk to the driver? 答 Only when it's time to pay；问 Americans 才答 after telling the address。
7 错误：A 答 Before paying.（错因：英国侧对照）；B 答 As soon as they get on.（错因：丢掉先后层次）；C 答 At the end of the ride.（错因：无依据）。
8 规则：R13.5 若题干 When＋after doing，then 取原文 after＋V-ing 的完整短语作答，不用 as soon as 抹掉先后；对比段不取另一侧时间。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间定位（先后层次）。
10 自检：①after 后是什么动作？②before paying 属哪国？③as soon as 丢了什么？

**组小结（G13 · 小蓝书预测卷七 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：清点型数量 1（26）；对比取侧二选一 1（27）；具体名词取词 1（28）；原因（引号词解释）1（29）；after doing 时间 1（30）。
- 规则：R13.1 本文数字≠标题数字（26）；R13.2 对比取侧＋指代对号（27）；R13.3 具体名词不换上位词（28）；R13.4 because 取因、表现不作因（29）；R13.5 after doing 保层次（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R13.1 与"标题数字最醒目"冲突，本文列举优先；R13.2／R13.3 与"第一句先入"冲突，however 后一侧优先；R13.4 与"常识解释"冲突，because 从句优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：补齐"对比取侧"这一新子类（同篇两类人对照），并复用数量／原因／时间规则；仍缺词义猜测与纯推断。



### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷七 · Passage 4

To many in the Gulf (海湾), Ghanim Al Muftah is a well-known face. Ghanim was born in May 2002 in Qatar, without the lower half of his body because of a serious illness. Even though the young boy was only given 15 years to live by his doctors, his parents didn't give up on him.



Ghanim was often very sad when he was at school. No one liked to play with him. His mother comforted him that his classmates were just afraid of hurting him, not scared of him. She also encouraged the boy to communicate more with his classmates and let them know more about his illness. His mother's words cheered him up and made him become more optimistic (乐观的).

Now, 21-year-old Ghanim is an example to the world and especially to those fighting with physical disabilities. He used his weakness to develop a strong will (意志). A surprising fact about Ghanim is that he loves sports and actively takes part in football, skateboarding, ice hockey and even scuba (潜水).

Ghanim is also one of the youngest businessmen in Qatar. His ice cream business provides jobs for the people in the city. At the same time, with his family's support, Ghanim has also set up an organization to give away free wheelchairs to those disabled people in need.

The young boy lives up to the meaning of his name. "Ghanim Al Muftah" means "the winner" in Arabic. He is an example of strength and courage who teaches the world that no difficulty is big enough to prevent someone from living the life of their expectations.

**〔G14〕小蓝书预测卷七 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：A serious illness.**
1 题面：What caused Ghanim to lose his legs；原文 "Ghanim was born in May 2002 in Qatar, without the lower half of his body because of a serious illness."
2 候选：a serious illness（because of 宾语）；an accident（常识）；his doctors（同句名词）；birth（状态）。
3 验算：a serious illness→because of a serious illness 直接给出原因→成立。an accident→原文无→排除。his doctors→given 15 years to live by his doctors 说的是预后判断，不是致残原因→不成立。birth→born without… 是状态描述，不是原因→次优。
4 干扰：同句末尾 by his doctors 提到医生，位置近、名词具体，诱人把"医生"当原因；born without… 的表述让人以为"天生"即原因。
5 意图：考"because of 取宾语"与"致残原因 vs 预后判断"。区分抓同句名词的人与按 because of 定位的人。
6 边界：若问 What did the doctors say about Ghanim? 答 They gave him only 15 years to live；问 caused 才答 a serious illness。
7 错误：A 答 An accident.（错因：常识补白）；B 答 His doctors.（错因：同句名词误取）；C 答 Birth.（错因：状态当原因）。
8 规则：R14.1 若题干 What caused／Why，then 取 because of／because 后的名词或从句；同句其它名词（人、机构）不因位置近而入选。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因定位（because of）。
10 自检：①because of 后是什么？②doctor 作什么成分？③born without 是原因吗？

**32. 答案：15 years.**
1 题面：How long might Ghanim live according to his doctor；原文 "Even though the young boy was only given 15 years to live by his doctors"
2 候选：15 years（原文）；21 years（现年）；2002（出生年）；a long life（概括）。
3 验算：15 years→与 given 15 years to live 逐字对应→成立。21 years→Now, 21-year-old Ghanim 是现年，与"能活多久"无关→不成立。2002→出生年份→排除。a long life→无依据→排除。
4 干扰：21 是全文第二个数字，且"现在 21 岁"与"医生说只能活 15 年"形成反差，诱人混用。
5 意图：考"数字按事件配对"（预后／现年／出生年）。区分抓任一数字的人与按 given…to live 定位的人。
6 边界：若问 How old is Ghanim now? 答 21；若问 When was he born? 答 in May 2002。
7 错误：A 答 21 years.（错因：现年当预后）；B 答 In 2002.（错因：出生年）；C 答 15.（错因：缺单位）。
8 规则：R14.2 若题干 How long＋might／was given，then 取数字＋单位，并与 to live／to do 搭配核对；同篇多个年龄／年份按事件配对。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（数字配对）。
10 自检：①15 修饰什么？②21 是哪个信息？③单位带了吗？

**33. 答案：Because no one liked to play with him.**
1 题面：Why did Ghanim's mother comfort him when he was at school；原文 "Ghanim was often very sad when he was at school. No one liked to play with him. His mother comforted him that his classmates were just afraid of hurting him, not scared of him."
2 候选：because no one liked to play with him（触发）；because his classmates were afraid of hurting him（安慰语）；because he was ill（背景）；because he lost his legs（背景）。
3 验算：because no one liked to play with him→紧接 sad 之后的原因句，comfort 由此触发→成立。because his classmates were afraid of hurting him→那是母亲安慰时说的话（内容），不是"为什么要安慰"→次优、最易混。because he was ill／lost his legs→背景，不是当下触发点→排除。
4 干扰：his classmates were just afraid of hurting him 紧跟 comfort，带解释性、信息具体，最像原因；题干 when he was at school 又提示"学校处境"，两个信息同段。
5 意图：考"触发原因（没人跟他玩）vs 安慰内容（同学怕弄伤他）"。区分把安慰语当原因的人与按事件链定位的人。
6 边界：若问 What did his mother tell him? 答 His classmates were just afraid of hurting him, not scared of him；问 Why comfort 才答 no one liked to play with him。
7 错误：A 答 Because his classmates were afraid of hurting him.（错因：安慰语当原因）；B 答 Because he was disabled.（错因：背景当触发）；C 答 Because his mother loved him.（错因：空泛）。
8 规则：R14.3 若题干 Why did sb comfort／encourage／help，then 取触发该行为的前一句事实（sad／no one played with him），不取安慰语；安慰语回答的是 What did sb say。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因定位（触发 vs 内容）。
10 自检：①comfort 前一句是什么？②母亲说的话算原因吗？③我答的是触发还是内容？

**34. 答案：His strong will.**
1 题面：What does the fact that Ghanim actively takes part in sports prove；原文 "He used his weakness to develop a strong will. A surprising fact about Ghanim is that he loves sports and actively takes part in football, skateboarding, ice hockey and even scuba."
2 候选：his strong will（前句论点）；his optimism（第二段）；his business success（第四段）；his name's meaning（末段）。
3 验算：his strong will→前句 He used his weakness to develop a strong will，紧接着以 sports 为例证，例证—论点关系成立→成立。his optimism→optimistic 在第二段（母亲鼓励之后），与本句证明对象不同→次优。his business success→第四段另一主题→排除。his name's meaning→末段→排除。
4 干扰：第二段 optimistic 也是性格评价且出现更早，诱人取；题干 prove 抽象，学生可能改答"他很乐观"。
5 意图：考"例证句证明前一句论点"与"同一人物多个品质按段落定位"。区分抓性格词的人与按例证—论点配对的人。
6 边界：若问 What does his ice cream business show? 答 He is a young businessman（provides jobs）；问 sports 才答 strong will。
7 错误：A 答 His optimism.（错因：第二段性格词）；B 答 He loves sports.（错因：复述例子）；C 答 His business.（错因：段外信息）。
8 规则：R14.4 若题干 What does the fact…prove／show，then 取该事实所在段的前一句论点句，答论点（抽象名词），不复述例子。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.5 例证—论点（推断）。与 RA-1 细节题分界：细节答事实，推断答事实背后的论点。
10 自检：①例子前一句是什么？②我答的是例子还是论点？③optimism 在哪段？

**35. 答案：Disabled people in need.**
1 题面：Who did the organization give away free wheelchairs to；原文 "Ghanim has also set up an organization to give away free wheelchairs to those disabled people in need."
2 候选：disabled people in need（to 后宾语）；the people in the city（另一句受益者）；children（无）；the poor（上位）。
3 验算：disabled people in need→与 to those disabled people in need 逐字对应→成立。the people in the city→那是 ice cream business provides jobs for… 的受益者，不同句→不成立。children→原文无→排除。the poor→上位替换，丢 disabled→次优。
4 干扰：同段 His ice cream business provides jobs for the people in the city 与赠轮椅句并列，两个"给人东西"的结构相似，易串。
5 意图：考"同段两个受益对象按动词区分"与"限定语不可省（disabled）"。区分抓 people 就答的人与按 to 后短语取全的人。
6 边界：若问 Who does the ice cream business provide jobs for? 答 the people in the city；问 wheelchairs 才答 disabled people in need。
7 错误：A 答 The people in the city.（错因：另一句受益者）；B 答 Disabled people.（错因：漏 in need，可给分）；C 答 Children.（错因：无中生有）。
8 规则：R14.5 若题干 Who…to／for，then 取该动词后 to／for 的完整名词短语（含限定语）；同段多个受益对象按动词配对。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物定位（受益者）。
10 自检：①to 后是什么？②另一句受益者是谁？③disabled 我漏了吗？

**组小结（G14 · 小蓝书预测卷七 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：cause 取宾语 1（31）；数字配对 1（32）；触发 vs 安慰内容 1（33）；例证—论点 1（34）；受益者取全 1（35）。
- 规则：R14.1 because of 取宾语（31）；R14.2 数字按事件配对（32）；R14.3 触发行为的前一句事实即原因（33）；R14.4 例证证明前句论点（34）；R14.5 to／for 后名词取全（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R14.1 与"同句名词最像答案"冲突，because of 优先；R14.3 与"安慰语最像原因"冲突，触发句优先；R14.4 与"性格词优先"冲突，例证前一端口优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：RA-3 新增"例证—论点"子类；仍缺"词义猜测（生词）"，下一卷补。



### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷三 · Passage 1

Chang'an Style Band is a traditional Chinese folk music band and it is popular in Douyin. This band is made up of two big music groups from Shaanxi and most of the members are young people. They play many traditional Chinese musical instruments such as the pipa, erhu, and guzheng. They play so well that many people online like them. Even some people who weren't interested in folk music before find that folk music can be this cool.

Blue man is the leader of the band. It's he who decided to use livestreaming (网络直播)



to make more people learn about folk music. However, it is a difficult job to make this happen. From finding performers and picking songs to making the livestream room look good and preparing the equipment, everything is hard. They also have to keep finding new songs to play, so the listeners won't get bored. Once, they even spent a month just making the sound right for each instrument.

<u>But all the hard work has been worth it.</u> Now, a lot of people love the band. And Song has a new idea. He wants to find new talented band members over the Internet and create an online Chinese traditional folk music orchestra (乐团). This way, more people can learn about this type of music. He also thinks it's important to teach young people about folk music now, and not wait until it's too late.

16. According to the passage, where is Chang'an Style Band popular?

Chang'an Style Band is popular in __________.

17. What kind of music instrument should you be good at if you want to join Chang'an Style Band?

You should be good at playing __________.

18. What did Blue man decide to use to make more people learn about folk music?

Blue man used __________.

19. What does the underlined sentence mean in the passage?

It means that __________.

20. What can be the best title for this passage in no more than 8 words?

The title can be "__________".

**〔G15〕小蓝书预测卷三 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：Douyin.**
1 题面：According to the passage, where is Chang'an Style Band popular；框架 "…is popular in __________."；原文首句 "Chang'an Style Band is a traditional Chinese folk music band and it is popular in Douyin."
2 候选：Douyin（原文）；Shaanxi（成员来源）；China（上位）；the Internet（上位）。
3 验算：Douyin→popular in Douyin 逐字对应→成立。Shaanxi→原文 from Shaanxi 指成员来自陕西，不是"受欢迎的地方"→不成立。China→原文未说 popular in China→次优。the Internet→many people online like them 是另一表述，且题干要 in＋平台→次优。
4 干扰：from Shaanxi 与 popular in Douyin 同段相邻，两个介词短语易混；online 与 Douyin 语义重叠，诱人以概括代具体。
5 意图：考"介词短语按动词配对"（popular in vs from）与"具体平台 vs 上位概括"。区分抓省份的人与按 popular in 定位的人。
6 边界：若问 Where are the band members from? 答 Shaanxi；问 popular 才答 Douyin。
7 错误：A 答 Shaanxi（错因：from 短语当 in 短语）；B 答 China（错因：上位）；C 答 The Internet（错因：概括代具体）。
8 规则：R15.1 若题干 Where＋be popular／famous，then 取原文 popular／famous in 后的地点或平台，不取 from／be made up of 后的来源；例外：原文用 among＋人群时答人群。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点定位（介词配对）。
10 自检：①popular in 后是什么？②Shaanxi 是哪个短语的宾语？③我答的是具体平台吗？

**17. 答案：traditional Chinese musical instruments (such as the pipa, erhu and guzheng)**
1 题面：What kind of music instrument should you be good at if you want to join…；框架 "You should be good at playing __________."；原文 "They play many traditional Chinese musical instruments such as the pipa, erhu, and guzheng."；题干 join 的条件原文未明写，须由"乐队演奏什么"反推。
2 候选：traditional Chinese musical instruments（类）；the pipa, erhu and guzheng（例）；the piano（常识）；any instrument（泛）。
3 验算：traditional Chinese musical instruments→与 play many traditional Chinese musical instruments 对应，such as 后为例证，答类更稳→成立。the pipa, erhu and guzheng→是例证，答例不错但不完整→次优（可补）。the piano→原文无→排除。any instrument→过泛，丢"中国传统"限定→不成立。
4 干扰：such as 后三个具体乐器名最醒目，诱人只答它们；题干用 join 而原文无 join 条件句，须做"演奏什么→要会什么"的推断。
5 意图：考"由事实反推条件"与"类 vs 例"取舍。区分抄例子的人与取类名的人。
6 边界：若框架是 "such as __________."，填 the pipa, erhu and guzheng；若问 What instruments do they play? 类名与例名均可。
7 错误：A 只答 the pipa, erhu and guzheng（错因：以例代类）；B 答 the piano（错因：常识补白）；C 答 music（错因：过泛）。
8 规则：R15.2 若题干问 kind／type，then 取原文类名词（…instruments），such as 后的例子只作补充；例外：原文只有例子无类名时，答例子并加 such as。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.25 类别取词（类 vs 例）。
10 自检：①原文有类名词吗？②such as 后是类还是例？③题干问 kind 吗？

**18. 答案：livestreaming（网络直播）**
1 题面：What did Blue man decide to use…；框架 "Blue man used __________."；原文 "It's he who decided to use livestreaming (网络直播) to make more people learn about folk music."
2 候选：livestreaming（原文，带中文注）；the Internet（上位）；Douyin（平台）；new songs（另一宾语）。
3 验算：livestreaming→与 decided to use livestreaming 逐字对应，括号中文注提示这是考点词→成立。the Internet→上位，原文具指→次优。Douyin→是"流行的平台"，不是"决定使用的手段"→不成立。new songs→见 keep finding new songs to play，另一动作→排除。
4 干扰：括号中文"网络直播"反而让学生以为要懂中文才答；Douyin 与 livestreaming 同语义场，易混。
5 意图：考"use＋手段名词"取词，以及"括号注释＝考点提示"。区分忽略括号的人与按 use 定位的人。
6 边界：若问 What did Blue man decide to do? 答 to use livestreaming to make more people learn about folk music（不定式整段）。
7 错误：A 答 Douyin（错因：平台≠手段）；B 答 The Internet（错因：上位代具体）；C 答 Folk music（错因：目的当手段）。
8 规则：R15.3 若题干 What did sb use／decide to use，then 取 use 后的名词（手段）；括号注释的词往往是答案；不取平台名或目的。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.26 手段取词（use）。
10 自检：①use 后是什么？②括号提示哪个词？③Douyin 是手段吗？

**19. 答案：It means that their hard work has paid off (and the band is now loved by many people).**
1 题面：划线句 "But all the hard work has been worth it."；框架 "It means that __________."；后文 "Now, a lot of people love the band." 给出解释。
2 候选：①their hard work has paid off／was worthwhile（worth it 释义）；②they spent a month making the sound right（前文细节）；③the band is popular in Douyin（首段事实）；④they will find new members（后文计划）。
3 验算：①worth it＝"值得"，与后句 Now, a lot of people love the band 构成"付出→回报"→成立。②那是 hard work 的例子，不是整句句意→次优。③首段事实，与 but 转折句的语义无关→排除。④后文计划→排除。
4 干扰：worth it 是习语，学生可能按字面译"值它"；前文"花一个月调音"的细节具体，诱人当句意。
5 意图：考"习语／评价句的释义要靠后文结果句"，以及"句意题答含义不答例子"。区分逐词直译的人与抓后文结果的人。
6 边界：若题干要求 translate the sentence，须给汉语译文（仍要体现"值得"）；问 mean 时用英文释义。
7 错误：A 直译"所有辛苦都值它"（错因：习语未消化）；B 答 they spent a month…（错因：例子当句意）；C 只答 the band is popular（错因：丢"值得"的评价义）。
8 规则：R15.4 若题干 What does the underlined sentence mean，then 先找该句的评价词／习语（worth it／pay off），再取后文结果句作支撑，答"含义＋结果"；不答前文细节例子。
9 位置：04→RA-2 句意题→RA-2.3 划线句释义。与 RA-4 译句题分界：mean 用英文释义，translate 用汉语。
10 自检：①worth it 什么意思？②后文哪句是结果？③我答的是含义还是例子？

**20. 答案：Chang'an Style Band: Folk Music Online（6 词，≤8 词）**
1 题面：What can be the best title for this passage in no more than 8 words；框架 "The title can be '__________'."；全文要点：长安风格乐队（传统民乐）＋抖音走红＋用直播推广。
2 候选：①Chang'an Style Band: Folk Music Online（6 词，含对象＋网络）；②Chang'an Style Band（3 词，缺"网络"）；③How to Make Folk Music Cool（6 词，偏方法）；④A Popular Folk Music Band Online（6 词，无专名）。
3 验算：①6 词、含乐队与 online，冒号结构是常见标题式→成立。②只有乐队名，缺"网络传播"主线→次优。③全文不是操作指南→不成立。④6 词、含 folk music 与 online，但丢专名→成立但不如①具体（并列可选）。
4 干扰：首句就是 Chang'an Style Band，诱人直接用它当标题；Douyin 具体平台写成标题会过窄。
5 意图：考"标题覆盖全文主线（乐队＋民乐＋网络）＋字数约束＋名词短语形态"。区分抓首句名词的人与概括主线的人。
6 边界：若题干给了 what if／plant 指定词，按 R11.5 处理；无指定词时用名词短语，实词首字母大写。
7 错误：A 只写 Chang'an Style Band（错因：漏主线）；B 写 Chang'an Style Band is popular in Douyin.（错因：完整句＋超词数）；C 写 Douyin（错因：过窄）。
8 规则：R15.5 若无给定词的拟标题题，then 用"核心对象＋核心特征"的名词短语，控制在词数内，实词首字母大写；不写完整句、不取单一细节（平台名）。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.4 拟标题（自由型）。与 R11.5（约束型）并列。
10 自检：①标题含几个要点？②几个词？③是不是完整句？

**组小结（G15 · 小蓝书预测卷三 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：介词配对地点 1（16）；类 vs 例 1（17）；手段取词 1（18）；划线句释义 1（19）；拟标题（自由型）1（20）。
- 规则：R15.1 popular in 取平台（16）；R15.2 kind 取类名（17）；R15.3 use 取手段、括号即提示（18）；R15.4 句意题取习语义＋结果句（19）；R15.5 标题名词短语（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R15.2 与"具体例子更保险"冲突，类名优先；R15.4 与"逐词直译"冲突，上下文结果优先；R15.5 与"标题越短越好"冲突，主线齐全优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：RA-2 新增"划线句释义"子类，与指代题并列；RA-3 拟标题两型（约束／自由）齐备。



### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷三 · Passage 2

94-year-old Chinese nurse Zhang Jinyuan won the 2023 International Achievement Award earlier this year. And on July 19th, her award ceremony was held in Beijing.

The award is one of the most prestigious awards in the global nursing and health fields. It is offered every two years to a nurse who has made great contributions (贡献) and had an important influence. Zhang is the first Chinese nurse to receive the award. She said she felt very proud because she thought the award was not to her but to Chinese.

Graduating from a nursing college in Nanchang, Jiangxi, Zhang started practicing nursing at a local hospital in 1951. She worked for over forty years as a nurse, throwing herself into developing new nursing care tools.



Zhang retired (退休) in 1992, but she didn't stop thinking of those in need of care. During a visit to a patient's home, Zhang found the patient often forgot to record his blood pressure. "Many families don't have simple medical care knowledge, and it is a weakness that must be solved," she said.

Then she came up with an idea of bringing nursing care from hospitals to families. Sixteen retired nurses joined her and then a volunteer nursing service center in Jiangxi was born in 2000. To improve her services, Zhang also set up a home-centered elderly care volunteer group in 2009.

Till now, nearly 20,000 volunteers have provided free care services for over 700,000 people in 350 neighborhoods under Zhang's guidance. "I feel like I'm just getting started and I'll keep on helping more people," she said.

21. Who won the 2023 International Achievement Award this year?

__________ did.

22. How often is the award offered?

It is offered __________.

23. When did Zhang retire?

She retired __________.

24. What did Zhang set up in 2009?

She set up a __________ volunteer group in 2009.

25. Why did Zhang feel proud after she won the award?

That's because she thought the award was not to her but to __________.

**〔G16〕小蓝书预测卷三 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：94-year-old Chinese nurse Zhang Jinyuan.**
1 题面：Who won the 2023 International Achievement Award this year；框架 "__________ did."；原文 "94-year-old Chinese nurse Zhang Jinyuan won the 2023 International Achievement Award earlier this year."
2 候选：Zhang Jinyuan（主语）；the International Achievement Award（宾语）；the EPA（他篇机构）；a nurse（泛称）。
3 验算：Zhang Jinyuan→与 won 的主语逐字对应，可带身份定语→成立。the award→是宾语不是主语→排除。a nurse→泛称，丢姓名→次优。the EPA→他篇机构（卷三 P3 有 EPA）→排除。
4 干扰：题干奖项名长而醒目，诱人答奖项；首句 94 与下段 July 19th 的数字也抢注意力。
5 意图：考"Who 取主语、可带身份定语"。区分答奖项的人与按 won 主语取人的人。
6 边界：若问 What did Zhang win? 答 the 2023 International Achievement Award；Who 与 What 一换，答案从人变物。
7 错误：A 答 The International Achievement Award.（错因：宾语当主语）；B 答 A Chinese nurse.（错因：丢姓名）；C 答 94.（错因：数字当人）。
8 规则：R16.1 若题干 Who＋及物动词，then 取该动词主语（姓名），可加原文身份定语；不取宾语（奖项／头衔）。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物定位（主语）。
10 自检：①won 的主语是谁？②奖项是主语还是宾语？③姓名带了吗？

**22. 答案：every two years.**
1 题面：How often is the award offered；框架 "It is offered __________."；原文 "It is offered every two years to a nurse who has made great contributions and had an important influence."
2 候选：every two years（频率）；two years（时长）；once（无）；in 2023（年份）。
3 验算：every two years→与 is offered every two years 逐字对应，how often 问频率→成立。two years→是时间段，缺 every 的频率义→不成立。once→原文无→排除。in 2023→获奖年份→排除。
4 干扰：two years 与 every two years 只差一词，删 every 就读成"持续两年"；2023 在首句，与频率形成干扰。
5 意图：考"how often 对应 every＋时间段"，以及"every 不可省"。区分抓数字的人与抓频率标记的人。
6 边界：若问 When was the award offered to Zhang? 答 in 2023；若问 How long has the award existed? 原文无→不能答。
7 错误：A 答 two years（错因：漏 every）；B 答 in 2023（错因：年份当频率）；C 答 every year（错因：数字记错）。
8 规则：R16.2 若题干 How often，then 取原文 every＋时间段／once／twice＋时间段等频率短语，every 不可省；例外：原文用 annually／monthly 时照抄副词。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.27 频率表达。与 R1.1（时间点）区别：问频率不是问时刻。
10 自检：①how often 要什么？②every 留了吗？③in 2023 是频率吗？

**23. 答案：in 1992.**
1 题面：When did Zhang retire；框架 "She retired __________."；原文 "Zhang retired (退休) in 1992, but she didn't stop thinking of those in need of care."
2 候选：in 1992（原文）；in 1951（从业）；in 2000（志愿中心）；in 2009（养老志愿团）。
3 验算：in 1992→与 retired in 1992 逐字对应→成立。in 1951→started practicing nursing 的年份→不成立。in 2000／2009→后文两个机构成立年→排除。
4 干扰：全篇四个年份（1951／1992／2000／2009），每个紧邻一个动作，扫读极易串行；括号"退休"的中文注提示这是考点。
5 意图：考"多事件多年份按动词配对"。区分抓任一近年份的人与按 retired 定位的人。
6 边界：若问 When did she start nursing? 答 in 1951；When was the volunteer center born? 答 in 2000。
7 错误：A 答 in 1951（错因：从业年当退休年）；B 答 in 2000（错因：中心成立年）；C 答 in 2009（错因：志愿团成立年）。
8 规则：R16.3 若题干 When＋动作，then 取该动词同句的年份，不取相邻句年份；同篇多年份按动词一一配对。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间定位（多年份配对）。
10 自检：①retired 在哪句？②同篇几个年份？③我对上号了吗？

**24. 答案：home-centered elderly care**
1 题面：What did Zhang set up in 2009；框架 "She set up a __________ volunteer group in 2009."；原文 "Zhang also set up a home-centered elderly care volunteer group in 2009."
2 候选：home-centered elderly care（前置定语）；a volunteer group（中心词，框架已给）；a nursing service center（2000 年）；an organization（泛称）。
3 验算：home-centered elderly care→set up a home-centered elderly care volunteer group，框架已给 volunteer group，空内只需定语→成立。a volunteer group→与框架重复→排除。a nursing service center→2000 年的事→不成立。an organization→泛称→次优。
4 干扰：框架只留 "a ______ volunteer group"，中间塞三个词，学生易整段照抄造成重复；2000 年的 volunteer nursing service center 也是"她建的"，年份易混。
5 意图：考"框架裁剪（只填定语）"与"两个机构按年份区分"。区分整段照抄的人与按框架留空的人。
6 边界：若框架是 "She set up __________ in 2009."（无 volunteer group），填 a home-centered elderly care volunteer group；若问 2000 年建了什么，答 a volunteer nursing service center。
7 错误：A 填 a home-centered elderly care volunteer group（错因：与框架重复）；B 填 a nursing service center（错因：2000 年的事）；C 填 elderly care（错因：漏 home-centered）。
8 规则：R16.4 若框架已给中心词（volunteer group），then 空内只填前置定语；同类机构按年份区分，不跨年取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.28 定语取词（框架裁剪）。
10 自检：①框架已给哪个中心词？②2009 对应哪件事？③home-centered 带了吗？

**25. 答案：Chinese.（the Chinese people）**
1 题面：Why did Zhang feel proud…；框架 "That's because she thought the award was not to her but to __________."；原文 "She said she felt very proud because she thought the award was not to her but to Chinese."
2 候选：Chinese（原文）；herself（被 not 否定）；her family（无）；the nurses（无）。
3 验算：Chinese→not to her but to Chinese 逐字对应，与"自豪"原因吻合→成立。herself→not to her 已否定→不成立。her family／the nurses→原文无→排除。
4 干扰：not…but… 中被否定的 her 就在空位前一格，漏看 not 即填 her；Chinese 此处指"中国人（集体）"，形式像形容词，诱人改写成 China。
5 意图：考"not A but B 取 B"与"Chinese 作名词表全体"。区分漏看 not 的人与按 but 后取词的人。
6 边界：若问 Who is Zhang? 答 a Chinese nurse；若框架无 not…but，仍须保留"不是给她"的语义，不能答 her。
7 错误：A 填 her（错因：漏 not）；B 填 China（错因：国名代"中国人"）；C 填 Chinese nurses（错因：加词改变原意）。
8 规则：R16.5 若原文是 not A but B，then 取 B（but 后成分）；Chinese／English 等作"全体人民"时用原形，不改写成国名。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.29 对比结构取后项。
10 自检：①有没有 not…but？②but 后是什么？③China 与 Chinese 分清了吗？

**组小结（G16 · 小蓝书预测卷三 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：Who 取主语 1（21）；频率表达 1（22）；多年份配对 1（23）；定语取词 1（24）；not…but 取后项 1（25）。
- 规则：R16.1 Who 取主语（21）；R16.2 how often 取频率短语（22）；R16.3 多年份按动词配对（23）；R16.4 框架裁剪只填定语（24）；R16.5 not A but B 取 B（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R16.3 与"最近年份最像答案"冲突，动词配对优先；R16.4 与"照抄全称最保险"冲突，框架裁剪优先；R16.5 与"空位前一格最像答案"冲突，but 后优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：补齐"频率表达"与"not…but 对比"；RA-1 细节题规则已扩到 29 条子规则。



### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷三 · Passage 3

If you wake up with a cough and a sore throat, you can go to the doctor. But when the soil is sick, it is not able to tell anyone! This is the concept that made the EPA take action. They formed a group of professional soil doctors to monitor the health of dirt.

Healthy soil is essential because it allows plants and animals to grow well. Healthy soil also prevent poisonous chemicals, holds water and gives some wastes time to be destroyed. But its ability to do these things is not unlimited. That's when a soil doctor is needed.

As the world's economies and certain industries grow, so does soil pollution. Sources of this pollution include waste from factories and farms and household garbage as well as agricultural waste. Water often carries poisonous chemical from this waste into the fields



where they work their way into the soil. These chemicals can cause plants to produce food that is harmful or prevents crops from growing at all.

People need to be on the lookout for soil pollution to protect themselves and others. In 1984 in Taoyuan County, a chemical company let out wastewater into a rice field. In order to keep people from eating the poisonous rice, all of the crops had to be destroyed.

In situations where soil is polluted, the first step soil doctors take is to stop the farming of the land. The EPA then treats the soil so that it can be used again. Some types of treatment take place onsite in the field and some are offsite. Eventually, crops can be planted again in the soil, but it could be years before that happens.

Soil doctors can treat "sick" soil, but they prefer to prevent soil pollution. They try to manage the risk of pollution by testing dirt regularly. Soil doctors play an important role in preventing poisonous chemicals from harming plants, animals and people. But ordinary people can do their part by ______________________.

27. When does soil need to see a doctor?

____________________

28. What usually causes the soil pollution?

____________________

29. Without the help of soil doctors, what may happen?

____________________

30. What responsibility should ordinary people take for keeping soil healthy? Complete the sentence in the last paragraph.

**〔G17〕小蓝书预测卷三 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：They formed a group of professional soil doctors.（to monitor the health of dirt）**
1 题面：What action did the EPA take to help soil；原文 "This is the concept that made the EPA take action. They formed a group of professional soil doctors to monitor the health of dirt."；They 回指 EPA。
2 候选：formed a group of professional soil doctors（具体动作）；took action（抽象，与题干同词）；to monitor the health of dirt（目的）；treated the soil（后文动作）。
3 验算：formed a group…→与 They formed… 逐字对应，且 They＝EPA→成立。took action→题干已含 take action，答它等于同义反复→不成立。monitor the health of dirt→是目的状语，可补充但非 action 本身→次优。treated the soil→那是土壤已污染后的处理（第五段），不是首段举措→排除。
4 干扰：题干 take action 与原文 made the EPA take action 同词，诱人只抄 take action；to monitor… 紧跟其后、像答案。
5 意图：考"They 回指 EPA"与"抽象动词 vs 具体举措"。区分抄题干词的人与找具体动作的人。
6 边界：若问 Why did the EPA form the group? 答 to monitor the health of dirt；问 What action 才答 formed a group…。
7 错误：A 答 They took action.（错因：抄题干，同义反复）；B 答 To monitor the health of dirt.（错因：目的当动作）；C 答 They treated the soil.（错因：后文动作）。
8 规则：R17.1 若题干 What action／What did sb do，then 取原文该主语后的具体动词短语（formed／set up／started），不抄题干的抽象动词（take action／do something）；目的状语另作补充。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（抽象 vs 具体）。
10 自检：①They 指谁？②题干动词原文已有吗？③我答的是动作还是目的？

**27. 答案：When its ability to do these things is limited.（When the soil is polluted.）**
1 题面：When does soil need to see a doctor；原文 "But its ability to do these things is not unlimited. That's when a soil doctor is needed."
2 候选：when its ability is not unlimited（原文，双重否定）；when the soil is polluted（后文概括）；when it is sick（首段比喻）；when chemicals get into it（第三段途径）。
3 验算：when its ability is not unlimited→与 That's when a soil doctor is needed 前的条件句对应，改为肯定义即"能力有限时"→成立。when the soil is polluted→与后文 In situations where soil is polluted 一致，语义正确但非该句原话→次优（可给分）。when it is sick→首段是比喻（soil is sick），非判定条件→次优。when chemicals get into it→是污染途径，不是"何时需要医生"的判定→排除。
4 干扰：not unlimited 是双重否定，易读成"无限"而答反；首段 sick 的比喻最形象，诱人直接答 when it is sick。
5 意图：考"双重否定还原"与"比喻 vs 判定条件"。区分照抄 not unlimited 的人与还原成肯定的人。
6 边界：若问 How does soil become polluted? 答 water carries poisonous chemicals into the fields；问 When need a doctor 才答能力受限／被污染时。
7 错误：A 答 When its ability is unlimited.（错因：漏 not，双重否定读反）；B 答 When it is sick.（错因：比喻当条件）；C 答 When people wake up with a cough.（错因：把人的病症套给土壤）。
8 规则：R17.2 若原文含 not＋否定词（not unlimited／not uncommon），then 先还原为肯定义（limited／common）再作答；比喻句（is sick）不作判定条件。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.31 双重否定还原。
10 自检：①not unlimited 是"有限"还是"无限"？②判定条件在哪句？③sick 是比喻吗？

**28. 答案：Waste from factories and farms, household garbage and agricultural waste.**
1 题面：What usually causes the soil pollution；原文 "Sources of this pollution include waste from factories and farms and household garbage as well as agricultural waste."
2 候选：三类废料并列（原文）；water（载体）；poisonous chemicals（成分）；industries（上位）。
3 验算：三类并列→与 Sources…include 的宾语逐项对应，as well as 连接第三项→成立。water→原文 Water often carries poisonous chemical…，是运输载体→不成立。poisonous chemicals→是污染物成分，来源是"废料"→次优。industries→原文只说 as economies and industries grow（背景）→排除。
4 干扰：前句 so does soil pollution（随经济与工业增长）诱人答 industries；water 句紧接来源句，诱人答 water。
5 意图：考"Sources include 后并列全取"与"来源 vs 载体 vs 成分"。区分抓最近名词的人与按 include 取全的人。
6 边界：若问 How do chemicals get into the soil? 答 Water carries them into the fields；问 causes 才答三类废料。
7 错误：A 答 Water.（错因：载体当来源）；B 答 Poisonous chemicals.（错因：成分当来源）；C 只答 waste from factories and farms（错因：漏 household garbage 与 agricultural waste）。
8 规则：R17.3 若题干 What causes／Sources of，then 取 include／such as 后的全部并列项（as well as 后的也算），不取载体（water／air）与成分（chemicals）。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.32 来源取全（并列＋as well as）。
10 自检：①include 后有几项？②as well as 后算不算？③water 是来源吗？

**29. 答案：Poisonous chemicals may harm plants, animals and people.（The soil may stay polluted.）**
1 题面：Without the help of soil doctors, what may happen；原文末段 "Soil doctors play an important role in preventing poisonous chemicals from harming plants, animals and people."；Without 要求把"防止"反转为"会发生"。
2 候选：chemicals harm plants, animals and people（反转 prevent from）；soil stays polluted；crops can't be planted；people eat poisonous rice（1984 例）。
3 验算：chemicals harm plants, animals and people→prevent A from doing B 的反面即"A 会发生 B"，与 Without 对应→成立。soil stays polluted→合理但原文未直说"没有医生就永远污染"→次优。crops can't be planted→是处理前的状态，非"没有医生"的直接结果→次优。people eat poisonous rice→是 1984 年个例→排除。
4 干扰：prevent…from… 是"阻止"，学生易直接抄原句，忘了 Without 要反转；1984 毒大米例子画面感强，诱人当答案。
5 意图：考"Without／If not 的反事实必须反转 prevent"。区分照抄 prevent 句的人与做反转的人。
6 边界：若问 What do soil doctors do? 答 They prevent poisonous chemicals from harming…（不需反转）；有 Without 才反转。
7 错误：A 照抄 preventing…from harming（错因：未反转，语义相反）；B 答 People will eat poisonous rice.（错因：个例当普遍）；C 答 Soil will be treated.（错因：与 Without 矛盾）。
8 规则：R17.4 若题干含 Without／If there were no，then 把原文 prevent／stop／protect…from 的宾语改为"会发生"的结果（去掉 prevent，保留 from 后的动作）；未反转即错。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.33 反事实反转。
10 自检：①Without 要不要反转？②prevent 后的动作是什么？③我抄的是原句还是反转后的？

**30. 答案：being on the lookout for soil pollution**
1 题面：Complete the sentence in the last paragraph："But ordinary people can do their part by ______________________."；原文 "People need to be on the lookout for soil pollution to protect themselves and others."；空在 by 后——必须 V-ing。
2 候选：being on the lookout for soil pollution（V-ing）；to be on the lookout（不定式）；on the lookout for soil pollution（缺 being）；testing dirt regularly（soil doctors 的做法）。
3 验算：being on the lookout…→by＋V-ing 成立，且与 People need to be on the lookout… 对应（ordinary people＝People）→成立。to be on the lookout→by 后不能接不定式→不成立。on the lookout…→缺 being，by 后无宾语→不成立。testing dirt regularly→原文 They（soil doctors）try to manage the risk by testing dirt regularly，主体错→不成立。
4 干扰：testing dirt regularly 也出现在 by 后、形式完全合规，但主语是 soil doctors，是最强干扰；be on the lookout 是习语，学生可能只写 lookout。
5 意图：考"补全句空位的语法（by＋V-ing）"＋"主体对齐（ordinary people＝People，不是 They＝soil doctors）"。
6 边界：若空位是 "ordinary people should ________________"，填 be on the lookout for soil pollution（原形）；by 后必须 -ing。
7 错误：A 填 testing dirt regularly（错因：主体错）；B 填 to be on the lookout（错因：by 后接不定式）；C 填 lookout（错因：习语不完整）。
8 规则：R17.5 若补全句空位在介词（by／without／in）后，then 填 V-ing 短语；同时核对该动作主语与题干主语一致，不一致即排除。
9 位置：04→RA-5 补全式简答→RA-5.6 介词后 V-ing＋主体对齐。
10 自检：①空位在 by 后吗？②这个动作谁做？③习语写全了吗？

**组小结（G17 · 小蓝书预测卷三 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：举措取词 1（26）；双重否定 1（27）；来源并列全取 1（28）；反事实反转 1（29）；介词后 V-ing＋主体对齐 1（30）。
- 规则：R17.1 具体举措不抄题干（26）；R17.2 not unlimited 还原肯定（27）；R17.3 来源取全、排除载体（28）；R17.4 Without 反转 prevent（29）；R17.5 介词后 V-ing＋主体对齐（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R17.1 与"题干同词最保险"冲突，具体动作优先；R17.2 与"照抄原句"冲突，还原义优先；R17.5 与"形式合规即对"冲突，主体对齐优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：新增"双重否定""反事实反转""介词后 V-ing"三个子类；仍缺词义猜测与纯推断。



### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷三 · Passage 4

July 19 in 2022 was a special day. On that day, Japanese figure skater (花滑运动员) Yuzuru Hanyu announced (宣告) his retirement (退役). However, this doesn't mean he has given up on the sport. Instead of competing in events, he has started giving performances. On Feb. 26, 2023, the "ice prince" returned with his biggest professional ice show yet—Gift.

More than 35,000 visitors poured into the Tokyo Dome, one of Japan's biggest event halls, to watch Hanyu's two-and-a-half hour solo (单独的) show. It's also the first time the



hall held a solo ice-skating show. Cheers filled the hall as Hanyu performed all 12 performances of *Gift* by himself.

He opened the show with *The Firebird*. Wearing wings of fire, he danced across the ice beautifully. Then along with the images (图像) of the sun, the moon, grass and other scenes from nature, Hanyu began to tell the story of *Gift*: loneliness and pain.

"I created *Gift* in the hope that it would be a gift to everyone's heart. What's more, it would provide a place for the people who feel lonely," Hanyu said.

"There are things that I could have done better. But *Gift* was a one-time-only event, and I'm very proud of the fact that I was able to give a once-in-a-lifetime performance. It is truly unique to figure skating. I would be happy if even a small piece of my performance will remain in your memory," he added.

**〔G18〕小蓝书预测卷三 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：On July 19, 2022.**
1 题面：When did Yuzuru Hanyu retire；原文 "July 19 in 2022 was a special day. On that day, Japanese figure skater Yuzuru Hanyu announced his retirement."
2 候选：on July 19, 2022（announced 的时间）；on Feb 26, 2023（Gift 演出）；in 2022（只到年）；two and a half hours（时长）。
3 验算：on July 19, 2022→announced his retirement 与 On that day 回指 July 19 in 2022→成立。on Feb 26, 2023→那是 Gift 回归演出→不成立。in 2022→丢月日→次优。时长→答非所问。
4 干扰：首句把日期与事件拆成两句，且写作 July 19 in 2022（非常见的 July 19, 2022），抄写易错位；2023 的演出日期同段出现。
5 意图：考"On that day 回指前句日期"与"英文日期两种写法"。区分抓最近日期的人与回指还原的人。
6 边界：若问 When did he return with Gift? 答 on Feb 26, 2023；两个日期按事件配对。
7 错误：A 答 On Feb 26, 2023（错因：演出日期）；B 答 In 2022（错因：丢月日）；C 抄整句 July 19 in 2022 was a special day.（错因：整句当答案）。
8 规则：R18.1 若原文用 On that day／Then 回指，then 回上一句取完整日期；July 19, 2022 与 July 19 in 2022 同义，作答统一为"on＋月日, 年"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间定位（回指日期）。
10 自检：①On that day 指哪天？②两个日期各属什么事件？③年月日写全了吗？

**32. 答案：Two and a half hours.**
1 题面：题干 "Hong long did Yuzuru Hanyu's solo show last?"（Hong 为原卷笔误，【复原】为 How long）；原文 "to watch Hanyu's two-and-a-half hour solo show"。
2 候选：two and a half hours（原文）；two hours（丢 half）；35,000（观众数）；12（表演段数）。
3 验算：two and a half hours→two-and-a-half hour solo show 还原为时长→成立。two hours→丢 half→次优。35,000→观众人数→排除。12→Gift 的段数→排除。
4 干扰：同句 35,000 visitors 数字更大且紧邻；12 performances 在下一句，都是数字干扰。
5 意图：考"复合形容词 two-and-a-half hour 还原为名词短语"与"数字按名词中心（last）配对"。区分抓最大数字的人与按 last 配对的人。
6 边界：若问 How many people watched the show? 答 More than 35,000；How many performances? 答 12。
7 错误：A 答 Two hours（错因：漏 half）；B 答 35,000（错因：观众数）；C 答 Two-and-a-half hour（错因：形容词形式未还原）。
8 规则：R18.2 若题干 How long＋last，then 取原文"数词-and-a-half hour"类复合形容词，还原为"数词 and a half hours"；同句其他数字按名词中心（visitors／performances）排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（复合形容词还原）。
10 自检：①last 问什么？②half 带了吗？③35,000 是什么数？

**33. 答案：Yes, he did.**
1 题面：一般疑问句 "Did Yuzuru Hanyu use different scenes to perform Gift?"；原文 "Then along with the images (图像) of the sun, the moon, grass and other scenes from nature, Hanyu began to tell the story of Gift"。
2 候选：Yes, he did.（完整简答）；Yes.（只答一词）；No, he didn't.（与原文相反）；He used the sun, the moon and grass.（细节句）。
3 验算：Yes, he did.→原文确用 images of the sun/moon/grass and other scenes→成立，且符合一般疑问句简答格式。Yes.→信息不足→次优。No→与原文相反→不成立。细节句→没答 Yes/No→次优。
4 干扰：原文用 along with 结构，没有直说 use different scenes，需把"伴随图像讲故事"读成"使用不同场景"；一般疑问句最易只写 Yes。
5 意图：考"一般疑问句答 Yes/No＋主语＋助动词"与"along with 结构转 use"。
6 边界：若题干是 Wh- 问句（What scenes did he use?），答 the sun, the moon, grass and other scenes from nature，不能只答 Yes。
7 错误：A 只写 Yes.（错因：简答不完整）；B 写 No, he didn't.（错因：与原文相反）；C 写 He used different scenes.（错因：未答 Yes/No，也未给原文场景）。
8 规则：R18.3 若题干是一般疑问句（Did／Is／Was…?），then 答"Yes, 主语＋助动词."或"No, 主语＋助动词 not."，可加一句原文依据；不用 Wh- 式细节替代 Yes/No。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答。
10 自检：①这是一般疑问句吗？②助动词用 did 吗？③要不要补依据？

**34. 答案：Loneliness and pain.**
1 题面：What did Yuzuru Hanyu want to tell us through the story of Gift；原文 "Hanyu began to tell the story of Gift: loneliness and pain."；冒号后即答案。
2 候选：loneliness and pain（冒号后）；a gift to everyone's heart（创作目的）；the sun, the moon and grass（舞台图像）；his retirement（首段）。
3 验算：loneliness and pain→tell the story of Gift: loneliness and pain，冒号解释直接给出→成立。a gift to everyone's heart→是创作目的（下段引语），问"故事讲了什么"不对→不成立。舞台图像→是表现手段→排除。retirement→背景→排除。
4 干扰：下段引语 I created Gift in the hope that it would be a gift to everyone's heart 更"正能量"，诱人取；sun/moon/grass 具体好记。
5 意图：考"冒号后解释即答案"与"故事内容 vs 创作目的"。区分抓引语的人与按冒号定位的人。
6 边界：若问 Why did he create Gift? 答 to be a gift to everyone's heart and provide a place for lonely people（R18.5）；问 story 才答 loneliness and pain。
7 错误：A 答 A gift to everyone's heart.（错因：目的当内容）；B 答 The sun, the moon and grass.（错因：手段当内容）；C 答 His retirement.（错因：背景）。
8 规则：R18.4 若题干 What did sb tell／say／show，then 优先取冒号、破折号、引号后的解释性内容；创作目的（in the hope that／to do）另属 why 题。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.10 引语定位（冒号解释）。
10 自检：①冒号后是什么？②引语讲的是目的还是内容？③图像是手段吗？

**35. 答案：To give a gift to everyone's heart and provide a place for people who feel lonely.**
1 题面：Why did Yuzuru Hanyu create Gift；原文 "I created Gift in the hope that it would be a gift to everyone's heart. What's more, it would provide a place for the people who feel lonely."
2 候选：两层目的（原文）；to tell the story of loneliness and pain（内容）；to give a once-in-a-lifetime performance（自我评价）；to retire（首段）。
3 验算：两层目的→in the hope that… 与 What's more, it would provide… 并列，均属创作目的→成立。tell the story…→是手段／内容→次优。once-in-a-lifetime performance→属 I'm proud of…（自我评价）→排除。retire→背景→排除。
4 干扰：What's more 是追加，易漏第二层；loneliness and pain 与 provide a place for the people who feel lonely 语义重叠，诱人只答一半。
5 意图：考"in the hope that 表目的"与"What's more 追加项不可漏"。区分只取第一句的人与取全两层的人。
6 边界：若问 What did he think of his performance? 答 He was proud of it／it was unique；问 why create 才答两层目的。
7 错误：A 只答 to be a gift to everyone's heart（错因：漏 What's more 项）；B 答 To tell the story of loneliness and pain.（错因：内容当目的）；C 答 To retire.（错因：因果倒置）。
8 规则：R18.5 若题干 Why＋create／build／write，then 取 in the hope that／to do／so that 后的目的；遇 What's more／Besides／Also 追加项一并取，漏项按不完整处理。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因定位（目的＋追加项）。
10 自检：①目的标记是哪个？②What's more 后还有一层吗？③我答的是目的还是内容？

**组小结（G18 · 小蓝书预测卷三 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：回指日期 1（31）；复合形容词数量 1（32）；一般疑问句简答 1（33）；冒号解释 1（34）；目的＋追加项 1（35）。
- 规则：R18.1 On that day 回指取日期（31）；R18.2 two-and-a-half hour 还原（32）；R18.3 Yes/No＋主语＋助动词（33）；R18.4 冒号后即内容（34）；R18.5 目的取全、含 What's more（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R18.3 与"只答 Yes 省事"冲突，完整简答优先；R18.4 与"引语最像答案"冲突，冒号解释优先；R18.5 与"取第一层即够"冲突，追加项必取。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：新增"一般疑问句简答"这一形态（此前全是 Wh- 问句），RA-1 的答题形态已有三类：Wh-、Yes/No、补全句。



### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷九 · Passage 1

On February 21 each year, UNESCO (联合国教科文组织) holds an International Mother Language Day. The event is to help people to pay attention to the disappearance of



the world's languages. Many of them are disappearing each year. UNESCO sees this as a terrible fact.

What happens when a language dies out? Something great is lost—not just sounds and marks but the way that people understand the world and communicate with each other. They keep different cultures and traditions through languages. Kill a language and all these are killed too.

Through International Mother Language Day, more and more people gradually realize the terrible situation and try to stop it. Many upload texts, audios and videos on the website of Google's 2018 Endangered Languages Project to spread ways of communication. Also, the Myaamia Project makes efforts to save the language of the Miami tribes by encouraging people to study and communicate with it.

These activities have one thing in common—they give life to those endangered languages. People who work to keep languages alive are not limited to the past. Many young people design apps and use social media to support their activities. They "share the word" to save the world.

So, while the problem of disappearing languages remains a very serious one, there is hope. We all have a special feeling of our mother language. This is why we should remember the wise words of late president of South Africa, Nelson Mandela: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head. If you talk to a man in his own language, that goes to his heart."

____________________

19. Why should we remember the wise words of Nelson Mandela?

____________________

20. Do you want to celebrate the International Mother Language Day? Why or why not?
