**〔G42〕小蓝书预测卷二十二 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：Because it is what he always wanted, and because he overcame health problems that could have interfered with his studies.**
1 题面：Why does Steiner attach great importance to this degree；原文 "Steiner values this degree because it is what he always wanted — and because he overcame health problems that could have interfered with his studies."；疑问词 Why…attach great importance（问原因）；诱导信号：第四段"母亲建议学医"是他当年选医的原因，语义上与"重视这个学位"很近。
2 候选：①always wanted it＋overcame health problems；②because it brings him money and fame；③because he wanted to be a professor；④because his mother advised him to study medicine。
3 验算：①→values this degree because…—and because…，两个 because 并列且与题干 importance 同义（values）→成立（两条都要）。②→原文无钱／名→排除。③→full professor 是医学阶段的职位事实，不是重视学位的原因→次优。④→母亲建议发生在二战后、针对"学医"，解释的是他为何从医，不是为何重视博士学位→排除。
4 干扰：母亲建议句在上一段、带 after World War II 的时间标记，因果感很强；两条并列原因中的第二条（overcame health problems）较抽象，常被漏掉。
5 意图：考"values…because…and because… 并列原因取全"＋"两个不同问题的原因不可互换"。
6 边界：若问 Why did Steiner study medicine? 答 Because after World War II his mother advised him that studying medicine would be a better choice。若问 What health problems did he have? 答 原文只说 health problems that could have interfered with his studies，未列病名。
7 错误：A 答 Because his mother told him to.（错因：答成"为何学医"）；B 答 Because he is 89.（错因：年龄不是原因）；C 答 Because it is what he always wanted.（错因：漏第二条）。
8 规则：R42.1 若问 Why does sb value／attach importance to sth，then 取 values…because…—and because… 的两个并列原因（一生所愿＋克服健康问题）；"母亲建议学医"只答"当年为何从医"，不能移作"为何重视这个学位"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（并列原因＋问题分工）；与 R36.2（并列原因取全）同法，本条多一层"两个问题不可换因"。
10 自检：①题干动词是 value 还是 study？②几条 because？③母亲建议回答的是哪个问题？

**32. 答案：It is mainly about Steiner's medical career — he followed his mother's advice, earned his medical degree in 1955, moved to the U.S. and became a successful blood researcher and professor until he retired from medicine in 2000.**
1 题面：What is paragraph 4 mainly about；该段原文 "But after World War II, his mother advised him that studying medicine would be a better choice. He earned his medical degree from the University of Vienna in 1955 and moved to the United States soon after. In the U.S., he had a successful career studying blood, became a full professor and led the hematology (血液学) department at Brown's medical school from 1985 to 1994. He helped establish a research program in hematology and directed that program until he retired from medicine in 2000."；段序核对：P1 达成目标、P2 重视学位、P3 少年想当物理学家、P4 医学之路、P5 医学研究不等于物理兴趣、P6 未了心愿、P7 70 岁读本科、P8 Marston 评价；疑问词 What is Paragraph N mainly about（问段意）。
2 候选：①医学之路（听母亲建议→学位→赴美→血液学教授→2000 退休）；②他的物理学习；③他在维也纳的童年；④第二次世界大战本身。
3 验算：①→段首 But after World War II 起，时间链 1955→1985—1994→2000 全是医学事实，末句 retired from medicine 收束→成立。②→物理是上一段与下一段的内容（wanted to become a physicist／not quite the same as his interest in physics）→排除。③→Vienna 只在上一段 As a young person in Vienna 出现→排除。④→World War II 只是时间状语，段内未展开战争→排除。
4 干扰：hematology、Brown's medical school 等专名密集，容易把段意写成"血液学研究"，漏掉"从医的人生选择"这一层；下一段的 physics 也容易串进来。
5 意图：考"段意＝一段连续事实链的概括"，起点看段首转折词 But，终点看末句 retired。
6 边界：若问 What did Steiner do from 1985 to 1994? 答 He led the hematology department at Brown's medical school。若问 When did he retire from medicine? 答 In 2000。
7 错误：A 答 It is about his interest in physics.（错因：串段）；B 答 It is about World War II.（错因：时间状语当主题）；C 答 It is about how to study blood.（错因：专业细节当段意）。
8 规则：R42.2 若问 What is Paragraph N mainly about，then 以段首转折词（But after…）为起点、以末句（retired from…）为终点，概括这一段的"生涯事实链"；上下段的物理梦、童年、战争背景都不搬入。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.2 段意概括（生涯链）；与 R39.2（人物＋论点）、R28.3（段落边界）同族，本条是"纯事实链"型段意。
10 自检：①段从哪个词开始？②末句落在什么事件？③我把 physics 串进来了吗？

**33. 答案：It means the unfulfilled wish to study physics stayed in his mind all the time — he could never forget it.（那个未了的心愿一直萦绕在他脑海里）**
1 题面：What does the underlined sentence in paragraph 5 mean；划线部分为 "that always stuck in the back of my head"，所在句 "'It was something like a wish that was never fulfilled, *that always stuck in the back of my head*,' he said."；原卷该处有下划线，转写以斜体保留；疑问词 What does…mean（句意／习语题）。
2 候选：①那个未实现的心愿一直记挂在心（念念不忘）；②有东西卡在他后脑勺（字面）；③他经常头痛；④他早已忘了这个心愿。
3 验算：①→It was something like a wish that was never fulfilled，that 回指这个 wish；stuck in the back of my head 表"一直留在脑中"→成立。②→字面无医学描写，且与 wish 无法衔接→不成立。③→headache 原文无→排除。④→always 与 forget 相反，且后文 70 岁读本科正是"没忘"的证据→不成立。
4 干扰：head 的字面义强烈；句子里两个 that 从句嵌套（a wish that was never fulfilled, that always stuck…），容易读成"两件不同的事"。
5 意图：考"身体部位习语＋回指还原"：先定 that 回指 wish，再定习语义。
6 边界：若问 What was the wish? 答 To become a physicist。若问 Did he realize the wish? 答 Yes — he earned his doctor's degree and became a physicist at 89。
7 错误：A 答 Something was stuck in his head.（错因：字面义）；B 答 He had a headache.（错因：无据引申）；C 答 He forgot his old wish.（错因：与 always／后文相反）。
8 规则：R42.3 若划线为身体部位习语（stick in the back of one's head），then 取"一直记挂／念念不忘"义，先还原 that 的回指对象（a wish that was never fulfilled）；不译字面"卡在后脑勺"，也不与 forget 混。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（习语·记挂义）；习语族已足，04 单列 RA-2，本条只作例证。
10 自检：①that 回指什么？②always 说明记没记住？③我译成字面动作了吗？

**34. 答案：Marston said Steiner already had a scientific way of thinking that younger students have to develop, and that he perseveres — he was serious about the subject and worked hard.**
1 题面：What is Marston's comment on Steiner after he joined the doctoral program；原文 "Physics professor Brad Marston soon realized how serious Steiner was about the subject and how hard he worked. 'He already had a scientific way of thinking that younger students have to develop,' Marston said. 'One thing that's really true about Manfred is he perseveres.'"；疑问词 What is sb's comment（问他人评价）；诱导信号：realized 句是叙述，引号内才是原话。
2 候选：①already had a scientific way of thinking＋he perseveres；②he is too old to study；③he is a genius；④he is lucky to have good teachers。
3 验算：①→引号内两点：scientific way of thinking（younger students have to develop）＋he perseveres；引号前 realized 句（serious／hard-working）可作概括→成立（原话两点都写）。②→年龄原文未作评价对象，Marston 只谈思维与毅力→排除。③→genius 原文无→排除。④→good teachers 原文无→排除。
4 干扰：realized how serious…how hard he worked 是叙述句，读起来更像"评论"；引号内的两点反而被跳过。
5 意图：考"评论取引号原话＋叙述句只作概括"。
6 边界：若问 What did Marston think of Steiner's way of thinking? 答 He already had a scientific way of thinking that younger students have to develop。若问 What does "he perseveres" mean? 答 He keeps working hard and never gives up。
7 错误：A 答 He is very old.（错因：年龄不是评论）；B 答 He is a genius.（错因：无据拔高）；C 答 He works hard.（错因：只取叙述句，漏原话两点）。
8 规则：R42.4 若问 What is sb's comment on…，then 取引号内原话的分点（scientific way of thinking／he perseveres），引号前的 realized 句只作概括性复述；年龄、天才、运气等原文未提的评价不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.14 他人评论（引语分点）；与 R34.2（special 举证取全）同族，本条主体是第三方评价者。
10 自检：①哪句是原话？②原话有几点？③我是否只写了叙述句？

**35. 答案：（开放题，≤20 词）He is determined and brave: he kept his childhood dream and got his doctor's degree at 89.（17 words）**
1 题面：What do you think of Steiner? Please explain. (no more than 20 words)——评价＋解释＋**词数上限 20 词**；可用依据：he spent 20 years working toward the goal／he overcame health problems／At age 70, he started taking undergraduate classes／he perseveres／Do what you love to do。
2 候选：①determined／brave＋"守住童年梦想、89 岁拿到博士学位"（17 词）；②He is great.（3 词）；③He is an old man who studies physics.（8 词，无评价）；④长篇复述生平（60 词以上）。
3 验算：①→品质词 determined／brave＋最短行为证据（kept his dream／degree at 89），17 词＜20→成立。②→只有评价无解释→不成立。③→是身份复述，不是评价→排除。④→超词数，直接不合格→排除。
4 干扰：题干两个要求（评价＋解释）叠一条词数限制，学生常写足理由却超词，或为压词数只剩形容词。
5 意图：考"评价题在词数上限内的取舍"：先保品质词＋一个最强证据。
6 边界：若题干无词数限制（What do you think of Steiner? Please explain.），可写两句、给两条证据。若问 What can we learn from Steiner? 答 道理型（follow your dream／never too old to learn）。
7 错误：A 答 He is great.（错因：无解释）；B 答 He is 89 years old and a physicist.（错因：复述身份）；C 写满三句生平（错因：超 20 词）。
8 规则：R42.5 若题干给词数上限（no more than 20 words），then 用"品质词＋一个最短行为证据"一句收束，全句≤20 词；超词数与只给形容词同样不合格；先数词再定稿。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（限词版）；与 R37.5、R31.5 同族，本条补"词数上限"这一硬约束。
10 自检：①我的答案几词？②有没有品质词？③证据是不是最短的那个？

**组小结（G42 · 小蓝书预测卷二十二 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：并列原因 1（31）；段意（生涯链）1（32）；习语释义 1（33）；他人评论 1（34）；评价＋限词 1（35）。
- 规则：R42.1 并列原因＋问题分工（31）；R42.2 生涯链段意（32）；R42.3 stuck in the back of my head＝记挂（33）；R42.4 评论取引语分点（34）；R42.5 限词版评价（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R42.1 与"母亲建议最像原因"冲突，题干动词优先；R42.2 与"专名最密"冲突，事实链覆盖优先；R42.3 与"字面身体动作"冲突，回指＋习语义优先；R42.4 与"叙述句更像评论"冲突，引号原话优先；R42.5 与"理由写全"冲突，词数上限优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**词数限制首见**（no more than 20 words，R42.5），为 RA-6 增加"限词"约束；习语第 5 例（记挂义），习语族已足，04 单列 RA-2；段意补"纯事实链"型。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷二十五 · Passage 1

Yang Jun'ao, a 16-year-old student from No. 1 Middle School in Nanxian County, Hunan province, invented a "lotus root harvesting robot (采藕机器人)".

"I got the idea when I saw my grandmother, in her 70s, working hard to harvest lotus roots under the hot sun," Yang said. Sometimes, his grandmother would badly hurt her fingers using her harvesting tools.



To make things easier for his grandmother, Yang thought of creating a machine that could harvest lotus roots. With guidance from his teacher Hong Wei, Yang spent nearly a year building a model of the machine.

The robot moves on its own through the muddy field. It uses image recognition (识别) to find mature (成熟的) roots by looking at the color of the lotus leaves. The robot's arm then cuts the mature lotus roots without damaging them.

During the invention process, Yang faced challenges like collecting parts for the model, putting them together and using a hot glue gun for bonding."The first time I used a hot glue gun, my hands were shaking," Yang laughed. At first, he planned to use rotating blades (旋转叶片) for harvesting lotus roots, but it was hard to find them, so he used more common blades instead .

When Yang showed the machine to his grandmother, she was happy and gave helpful suggestions for improvement. She suggested using the audio player to show the machine's location in thick lotus leaves. "My grandmother's suggestion reminded me that any technological invention must be practical to have true value," said Yang.

Although Yang still needs to make improvements, like finding cheaper ways to make the machines, his teacher Hong spoke highly of Yang's creative thinking and working on helping his hometown.

16. What does Yang Jun'ao do?

______

17. Why did Yang want to create such a machine?

______

18. Was his grandmother happy when he showed the machine to her?

______

19. What did he understand from his grandmother's suggestion?

______

20. What do you think of Yang Jun'ao?

______

**〔G43〕小蓝书预测卷二十五 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：He is a 16-year-old student at No. 1 Middle School in Nanxian County, Hunan province (and the inventor of a lotus root harvesting robot).**
1 题面：What does Yang Jun'ao do；原文 "Yang Jun'ao, a 16-year-old student from No. 1 Middle School in Nanxian County, Hunan province, invented a 'lotus root harvesting robot (采藕机器人)'."；疑问词 What does sb do（问身份／职业，不是问成就）；诱导信号：同一句里 invented a robot 是全文最醒目的信息。
2 候选：①a 16-year-old student（姓名后的同位语）；②an inventor（由 invented 反推）；③a teacher（Hong Wei）；④a farmer。
3 验算：①→Yang Jun'ao, a 16-year-old student from No. 1 Middle School…，同位语直接给身份→成立。②→invented 是成就，不是职业；可作补充，单独作身份则把成就当身份→次优。③→With guidance from his teacher Hong Wei，老师是洪伟，不是他→排除。④→文中的农活属于 his grandmother→排除。
4 干扰：invented a robot 太亮眼，学生一看到就答"发明家"；Hong Wei 有 teacher 一词，容易张冠李戴。
5 意图：考"身份取同位语，成就与身份分层"。
6 边界：若问 What did Yang invent? 答 A lotus root harvesting robot。若问 Who helped him? 答 His teacher Hong Wei。
7 错误：A 答 He is an inventor.（错因：成就当身份）；B 答 He is a teacher.（错因：人物错位）；C 答 He is a farmer.（错因：把祖母的活计安到他身上）。
8 规则：R43.1 若问 What does sb do，then 取姓名后的同位语（a 16-year-old student from…）；动词成就（invented／built）只作补充，不单独当身份；文中他人身份（teacher／farmer）须按人名对号，不张冠李戴。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.37 职业（同位语）；复用 R25.4（职业取同位语），本条加"成就≠身份"与"同名对号"两条。
10 自检：①同位语在哪？②invented 是身份还是成就？③teacher 是谁？

**17. 答案：Because he saw his grandmother, in her 70s, working hard to harvest lotus roots under the hot sun and sometimes badly hurting her fingers — he wanted to make things easier for her.**
1 题面：Why did Yang want to create such a machine；原文 "'I got the idea when I saw my grandmother, in her 70s, working hard to harvest lotus roots under the hot sun,' Yang said. Sometimes, his grandmother would badly hurt her fingers using her harvesting tools."＋"To make things easier for his grandmother, Yang thought of creating a machine that could harvest lotus roots."；疑问词 Why（问动机）；诱导信号：With guidance from his teacher Hong Wei 紧跟其后，像"因为老师指导"。
2 候选：①to make things easier for his grandmother（看见她辛苦、常伤手指）；②because his teacher guided him；③to win a prize／become famous；④to sell the machine and make money。
3 验算：①→To make things easier for his grandmother 是不定式目的句，前一段两句是"辛苦＋伤手指"的举证，动机链完整→成立（目的句＋至少一条举证）。②→指导是条件（With guidance from…），原文未说"因为老师要求"→次优。③→全文无比赛／成名→排除。④→末段 finding cheaper ways 是待改进项，不是初衷→排除。
4 干扰：teacher 句紧接目的句，因果容易被"指导"吸走；伤手指的细节具体，学生只抄这一条而丢掉"让祖母轻松些"的目的。
5 意图：考"动机＝不定式目的句＋前文举证"。
6 边界：若问 What did his grandmother do with lotus roots? 答 She harvested them（her job／farm work）。若问 What problem did the machine solve? 答 It harvests mature lotus roots without damaging them。
7 错误：A 答 Because his teacher asked him to.（错因：条件当动机）；B 答 To make money.（错因：把改进项当前提）；C 答 Because his grandmother was old.（错因：只给背景，无目的）。
8 规则：R43.2 若问 Why did sb create／invent sth，then 取 To make things easier for… 的不定式目的句＋前文"看到对方辛苦／受伤"的举证；With guidance from… 是条件，不作动机；末段的 cheaper ways 属待改进，不作出初动机。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因／目的（不定式目的＋举证）；复用 R20.1（句首 To do 即目的），本条加"条件≠动机"。
10 自检：①目的句是哪个？②老师那句是原因还是条件？③举证至少写一条了吗？

**18. 答案：Yes, she was. She was happy and gave helpful suggestions for improvement.**
1 题面：Was his grandmother happy when he showed the machine to her；原文 "When Yang showed the machine to his grandmother, she was happy and gave helpful suggestions for improvement. She suggested using the audio player to show the machine's location in thick lotus leaves."；疑问词 Was…（一般疑问句，要求 Yes/No＋事实）；诱导信号：后面她提了改进建议，容易被读成"不满意"。
2 候选：①Yes, she was＋happy and gave suggestions；②No, she wasn't（因为要改进）；③Yes, but she didn't like it。
3 验算：①→she was happy and gave helpful suggestions，态度与行为同向；suggestions for improvement 是"有帮助的建议"而非不满→成立。②→原文用 happy 明确肯定，No 与原文冲突→不成立。③→but she didn't like it 原文无，且与 helpful 矛盾→排除。
4 干扰：suggestions for improvement 字面像"指出毛病"，学生据此判 No；题干问 happy 而非"满意不满意"。
5 意图：考"一般疑问句先表态再补事实"，以及"提改进建议≠不满意"。
6 边界：若问 What did his grandmother suggest? 答 Using the audio player to show the machine's location in thick lotus leaves。若问 Did she think the machine was perfect? 答 No — she gave suggestions for improvement（原文未用 perfect，只说她给了建议）。
7 错误：A 答 No, because she gave suggestions.（错因：建议＝不满）；B 答 Yes.（错因：漏事实）；C 答 Yes, she was surprised.（错因：surprised 原文无）。
8 规则：R43.3 若题干为 Was／Did 一般疑问句，then 先答 Yes／No＋主语＋be／助动词（Yes, she was.），再补原文事实（happy and gave helpful suggestions）；"提出改进建议"不等于不满意，不得据此翻转态度。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答；复用 R18.3（Yes/No＋主语＋助动词），本条加"表态后必补事实"与"建议≠否定"。
10 自检：①表态句完整吗？②happy 出现在哪？③我把建议当不满了吗？

**19. 答案：He understood that any technological invention must be practical to have true value.**
1 题面：What did he understand from his grandmother's suggestion；原文 "'My grandmother's suggestion reminded me that any technological invention must be practical to have true value,' said Yang."；疑问词 What did he understand（问领悟内容）；诱导信号：祖母的建议本身是"用音频播放器显示位置"，很具体。
2 候选：①invention must be practical to have true value；②audio players are useful in fields；③inventions should be cheaper；④his grandmother knows technology well。
3 验算：①→reminded me that any technological invention must be practical to have true value，that 从句就是"领悟"→成立。②→audio player 是建议的手段，不是领悟→次优。③→finding cheaper ways 在末段，是"仍需改进"处，不是由祖母建议得出的领悟→排除。④→原文无此评价→排除。
4 干扰：祖母建议的具体内容（audio player）最容易被抄成"理解"；末段 cheaper ways 也像"领悟"。
5 意图：考"领悟取 reminded me that 宾语从句"，具体建议是手段。
6 边界：若问 What was his grandmother's suggestion? 答 To use the audio player to show the machine's location in thick lotus leaves。若问 What does Yang still need to improve? 答 Finding cheaper ways to make the machines。
7 错误：A 答 He understood audio players are useful.（错因：手段当领悟）；B 答 He understood machines should be cheap.（错因：末段改进项前移）；C 答 He understood his grandmother was clever.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R43.4 若问 What did sb understand／learn from X，then 取 reminded me that／learned that 后的宾语从句原意（must be practical to have true value）；X 的具体内容（audio player）是手段，末段待改进项（cheaper）是后续，都不作领悟。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.15 领悟（宾语从句）；与 R29.4（learn 取全含 also）同族，本条取"that 从句"而非并列宾语。
10 自检：①that 从句在哪里？②audio player 是手段还是结论？③cheaper 属哪一段？

**20. 答案：（开放题）I think he is caring, creative and practical. He invented a robot to make things easier for his grandmother, and he accepted her suggestion that inventions must be practical.**
1 题面：What do you think of Yang Jun'ao?——评价；可用依据：made a machine to help his grandmother／spent nearly a year building a model／faced challenges like collecting parts, hot glue gun／learned that inventions must be practical／his teacher spoke highly of his creative thinking and helping his hometown。
2 候选：①caring／creative／practical＋行为；②He is great／good（空评价）；③He is lucky to have a teacher；④复述发明过程。
3 验算：①→每个品质词都能配原文行为（为祖母发明＝caring；自制模型、解决零件＝creative；听取实用建议＝practical）→成立。②→great／good 无依据，等于没答→不成立。③→lucky 与"spent nearly a year"的努力相反→排除。④→复述过程没有评价词→排除。
4 干扰：全文以叙事为主，褒词只在老师评语里出现（creative thinking），学生容易只抄这一句而漏掉"关心家人""务实"两层。
5 意图：考"评价＝品质词＋行为证据"，与 R31.5／R37.5 同族，本题不给 reasons 仍须带证据。
6 边界：若问 What does his teacher think of him? 答 He spoke highly of Yang's creative thinking and working on helping his hometown。若问 What is Yang's invention like? 答 It moves on its own, uses image recognition and cuts mature roots without damaging them。
7 错误：A 答 He is great.（错因：空评价）；B 答 He is a student.（错因：复述身份）；C 答 He is lucky.（错因：与一年努力相反）。
8 规则：R43.5 若问 What do you think of sb（即使未写 Give your reasons），then 至少一个品质词＋一条行为证据；空评价（great／good）与身份复述都不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（品质＋行为）；复用 R37.5，本条说明"无 reasons 字样时仍要证据"。
10 自检：①品质词是什么？②配的行为在哪句？③我是不是只写了 great？

**组小结（G43 · 小蓝书预测卷二十五 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：身份（同位语）1（16）；发明动机 1（17）；一般疑问句（表态＋事实）1（18）；领悟（that 从句）1（19）；人物评价 1（20）。
- 规则：R43.1 身份取同位语、成就分层（16）；R43.2 目的句＋举证、条件不作动机（17）；R43.3 Yes/No＋补事实、建议≠否定（18）；R43.4 领悟取 that 从句（19）；R43.5 品质＋行为（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R43.1 与"invented 最醒目"冲突，同位语优先；R43.2 与"老师指导紧邻"冲突，目的句优先；R43.3 与"改进建议像不满"冲突，原文 happy 优先；R43.4 与"建议内容具体"冲突，宾语从句优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：本组 5 题全部复用既有子类（RA-1.37／RA-1.4／RA-1.34／RA-3.15 新增／RA-6.1），验证"规则可迁移"；新增 RA-3.15 领悟；差值与图表仍无。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷二十五 · Passage 2

Smartphones have become a big part of people's lives. When we temporarily can't find them, it makes a feeling of anxiety or panic. Some psychologists have called it



"nomophobia".

When I got my first smartphone over a decade ago, I loved it. But over time, I became increasingly ambivalent about its role in my life. I would repeatedly refresh my email, shop online for stuff I didn't need and constantly scroll through the latest news. I'd often complain to my husband and to my seven-year-old son, Louis, that I felt trapped by it.

Then, one day last summer, while I was playing with Louis, I was once again distracted by dings and pings. He finally reminded me of my complaints, but rephrased them as a plea: "Mommy, just give it up already!"

I decided to try. Instead of going cold turkey — no cellphone at all — I bought a flip phone. With no touch screen, texting is time-consuming. Once, while trying to catch up on texts with a friend, I finally got frustrated and called her. I realized I hadn't spoken to her since her big move.

Nowadays, people may prefer text-based communication over using the phone because they fear that the call will be awkward. But, just as I learned, when we were forced to connect voice to voice, we would find ourselves more bonded to that person.

Ultimately, though, that sense of dependence is false. As I've found, you can do all the things you need to do in other ways. It's not always convenient, but I know I'm much calmer on a regular basis without my smartphone.

21. What does "nomophobia" refer to?

______

22. Why did the author decide to give up her smartphone?

______

23. How did the author give up her smartphone?

______

24. What do we find when we connect voice to voice?

______

25. Apart from the ways mentioned in the passage, what can you do to avoid "nomophobia"?

______

**〔G44〕小蓝书预测卷二十五 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：It refers to the feeling of anxiety or panic people get when they temporarily can't find their smartphones.**
1 题面：What does "nomophobia" refer to；原文 "Smartphones have become a big part of people's lives. When we temporarily can't find them, it makes a feeling of anxiety or panic. Some psychologists have called it 'nomophobia'."；疑问词 What does X refer to（术语定义）；诱导信号：后文作者自述 ambivalent／trapped，情绪词多，容易被当成定义。
2 候选：①找不到手机时的焦虑或恐慌（anxiety or panic）；②害怕接电话；③沉迷网购；④害怕新技术。
3 验算：①→Some psychologists have called it "nomophobia"，it 回指前句 a feeling of anxiety or panic；them 回指 smartphones→成立（定义＝情绪＋条件）。②→害怕接电话是后文 the call will be awkward 的内容，属另一回事→排除。③→shop online for stuff I didn't need 是作者行为，不是术语义→排除。④→全文未提 technology 恐惧→排除。
4 干扰：新词由 no＋phobia 构成，容易按词形猜"恐惧症"而不写"找不到手机"这个条件；后文情绪词密集，也容易把作者感受当定义。
5 意图：考"引号新词取其前一句的完整定义（情绪＋触发条件）"。
6 边界：若问 What do some psychologists call it? 答 Nomophobia。若问 What did the author feel about her smartphone? 答 She felt ambivalent and trapped by it。
7 错误：A 答 It means being afraid of phones.（错因：只取 phobia，丢"找不到"条件）；B 答 It refers to shopping online.（错因：行为当定义）；C 答 It means loving smartphones.（错因：褒义，与 anxiety／panic 相反）。
8 规则：R44.1 若问引号内新词 refer to，then 取其前一句的定义句（情绪名词＋when／if 条件），并还原代词（them＝smartphones，it＝该情绪）；后文作者的自述情绪不作定义。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（术语定义）；按 RA-2 四步：①搭配（called it）②前后定义句 ③语域（心理学术语）④词形（no＋phobia 只作辅助）。
10 自检：①定义句是哪句？②it／them 各指什么？③我按词形猜了吗？

**22. 答案：Because her son Louis pleaded with her — "Mommy, just give it up already!" — after she was once again distracted by dings and pings while playing with him.**
1 题面：Why did the author decide to give up her smartphone；原文 "Then, one day last summer, while I was playing with Louis, I was once again distracted by dings and pings. He finally reminded me of my complaints, but rephrased them as a plea: 'Mommy, just give it up already!' I decided to try."；疑问词 Why did sb decide（问触发点）；诱导信号：前段 I felt trapped by it 也是抱怨，且出现更早。
2 候选：①儿子的请求＋当场又被提示音打断；②她早就觉得被手机困住（felt trapped）；③手机太贵；④丈夫要求她戒手机。
3 验算：①→once again distracted＋plea "just give it up already"＋I decided to try，触发—请求—决定三句相连→成立。②→felt trapped 是长期背景抱怨，原文用 He finally reminded me of my complaints 把它降为"旧抱怨"，真正促成决定的是被改成 plea 的那句→次优（可作背景，不单独作答案）。③→原文无价格问题→排除。④→husband 只出现在 complain to my husband，是倾诉对象→排除。
4 干扰：felt trapped 情绪更强、位置更早；孩子的话是口语，容易被当成"细节"跳过。
5 意图：考"决定点取最近触发＋直接引语请求"，区分背景抱怨与触发事件。
6 边界：若问 Who is Louis? 答 The author's seven-year-old son。若问 What did the author complain about? 答 That she felt trapped by her smartphone。
7 错误：A 答 Because she felt trapped by it.（错因：背景当触发）；B 答 Because her husband asked her to.（错因：人物错位）；C 答 Because her phone was broken.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R44.2 若问 Why did sb decide to do sth，then 取决定句前最近的触发场景（once again distracted）＋直接引语中的请求（just give it up already）；更早的长期抱怨（felt trapped）只作背景，由 reminded me of my complaints 标记为旧事。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（触发 vs 背景）；复用 R14.3（触发行为的前一句事实即原因），本条加"旧抱怨被降级"的标记识别。
10 自检：①决定句是哪句？②哪句被标成旧抱怨？③谁提的要求？

**23. 答案：She didn't go cold turkey; instead she bought a flip phone, which has no touch screen and makes texting time-consuming, so she often ended up calling people instead.**
1 题面：How did the author give up her smartphone；原文 "I decided to try. Instead of going cold turkey — no cellphone at all — I bought a flip phone. With no touch screen, texting is time-consuming. Once, while trying to catch up on texts with a friend, I finally got frustrated and called her."；疑问词 How（问方式）；诱导信号：give up her smartphone 字面像"彻底不用手机"，而 going cold turkey 恰好指这种做法。
2 候选：①bought a flip phone（instead of going cold turkey）；②彻底不用手机（going cold turkey）；③删掉所有 App；④让丈夫把手机藏起来。
3 验算：①→Instead of A — B 结构中 B 是实际做法（I bought a flip phone），后两句说明运作方式（无触屏→发短信慢→改为打电话）→成立。②→going cold turkey 是 Instead of 的宾语，即未采用的做法→不成立。③→原文无删 App→排除。④→原文无→排除。
4 干扰：going cold turkey 紧跟在 Instead of 后，学生常把它当作答案；"give up her smartphone" 的题面也诱导"完全不用"。
5 意图：考"Instead of A — B 取 B"，以及"降级使用也算 give up（方式）"。
6 边界：若问 Why did she buy a flip phone? 答 Because she wanted to give up her smartphone without going cold turkey。若问 What happened when she tried to text? 答 She got frustrated and called her friend instead。
7 错误：A 答 She gave up all cellphones.（错因：把 Instead of 的宾语当做法）；B 答 She deleted the apps.（错因：无据）；C 答 She asked her husband to keep it.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R44.3 若问 How did sb do sth 且原文有 Instead of A — B，then 取 B 的实际做法（bought a flip phone），A 是未采用项；再用紧随的结果句（no touch screen→texting time-consuming→called instead）补足运作方式。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（Instead of 取后项）；复用 R16.5（not A but B 取 B）与 R9.2（instead B 取 B），本条标记词是 Instead of。
10 自检：①Instead of 后是什么？②实际做法是哪句？③结果句说明了什么？

**24. 答案：We would find ourselves more bonded to that person.**
1 题面：What do we find when we connect voice to voice；原文 "Nowadays, people may prefer text-based communication over using the phone because they fear that the call will be awkward. But, just as I learned, when we were forced to connect voice to voice, we would find ourselves more bonded to that person."；疑问词 What do we find when…（问发现）；诱导信号：紧邻前句 the call will be awkward 是"担心"，与 find 只隔一个 But。
2 候选：①ourselves more bonded to that person；②the call is awkward；③texting is faster；④we feel anxious。
3 验算：①→we would find ourselves more bonded to that person，find＋宾语＋补足语结构完整→成立。②→awkward 是 people fear，位于 But 之前，是"担心"而非"发现"→不成立。③→原文未比较速度→排除。④→anxiety 属首段 nomophobia，不是打电话的结果→排除。
4 干扰：But 前的 awkward 与 find 距离最近，最易被抄；bonded 是生词，学生可能回避。
5 意图：考"but 转折后为作者结论，转折前为他人担心"。
6 边界：若问 Why do people prefer texting? 答 Because they fear that the call will be awkward。若问 What does "bonded" mean here? 答 Closer／more connected。
7 错误：A 答 We find the call awkward.（错因：担心当发现）；B 答 We find texting better.（错因：与作者结论相反）；C 答 We feel more anxious.（错因：串首段）。
8 规则：R44.4 若问 What do we find when…，then 取 find＋宾语＋补足（ourselves more bonded to that person）；but 前他人 fear（awkward）不作"发现"，转折词是分界线。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.6 结果／发现（but 后为结论）；与 R26.5（末段转折定态度）同法，落点在"find 的补足语"。
10 自检：①but 在哪？②find 的宾语补足是什么？③awkward 是谁的心理？

**25. 答案：（开放题）For example, I can set a fixed time to check my phone, turn off notifications, keep the phone out of my bedroom, and spend more time on outdoor activities with my family — instead of buying a flip phone or making voice calls, which the passage has already mentioned.**
1 题面：Apart from the ways mentioned in the passage, what can you do to avoid "nomophobia"?——半开放题，且**排除原文做法**；原文已给的做法：bought a flip phone／connect voice to voice（打电话代替发短信）／不用智能手机；疑问词 what can you do（要具体、可执行）。
2 候选：①限时查看＋关通知＋手机不进卧室＋户外活动（原文之外）；②买翻盖手机／多打电话（原文已有）；③只写 "use phones less"；④写"多睡觉"等无关项。
3 验算：①→四条都是原文未提的具体做法，且指向"减少依赖"→成立（给 2—3 条即可）。②→题干 Apart from the ways mentioned 已排除，重复即违规→不成立。③→less 太笼统，无具体动作，不能算"办法"→次优。④→与手机依赖无关→排除。
4 干扰：原文的 flip phone 与 voice call 太好用，学生顺手照抄；题干前半 Apart from… 是硬条件，却常被读成"结合原文"。
5 意图：考"半开放题＝原文之外的具体做法"，而不是复述原文。
6 边界：若问 What ways did the author use? 答 She bought a flip phone and called instead of texting。若问 Is the sense of dependence on smartphones true? 答 No, it is false — you can do the things you need in other ways。
7 错误：A 答 I will buy a flip phone.（错因：原文已有）；B 答 I will use my phone less.（错因：无具体动作）；C 答 I will never use a computer.（错因：跑题）。
8 规则：R44.5 若题干含 Apart from the ways mentioned，then 只给原文之外的具体做法（限时查看／关通知／手机不进卧室／户外活动／家人互相提醒）并说明目的；照抄原文做法（flip phone／voice call）即违规；只写 use less 这类笼统话不算办法。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.6 半开放列举（排除原文法）；复用 R30.5（半开放），本条加"原文已有项必须剔除"的硬条件。
10 自检：①我写的是原文已有的吗？②每条具体吗？③有没有说明目的？

**组小结（G44 · 小蓝书预测卷二十五 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：术语定义 1（21）；决定触发 1（22）；方式（Instead of）1（23）；发现（find＋补足）1（24）；半开放（排除原文法）1（25）。
- 规则：R44.1 术语取定义句（21）；R44.2 触发＋引语请求（22）；R44.3 Instead of 取 B（23）；R44.4 find 取补足、but 前不作发现（24）；R44.5 排除原文法（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R44.1 与"词形联想"冲突，定义句优先；R44.2 与"更早的强情绪"冲突，最近触发优先；R44.3 与"字面彻底不用"冲突，Instead of 取 B；R44.4 与"最近分句"冲突，but 后优先；R44.5 与"原文做法最省事"冲突，排除条件优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：术语定义题第 2 例（R24.2 反向词义另计）；半开放题补"排除原文"型（R30.5 只给一半，R44.5 剔除已有）；差值仍无。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷二十五 · Passage 3

Table manners are how to behave when you eat a meal. They include how to handle knives, forks and spoons and how to eat in a polite manner. To behave well abroad, you are to



know some table manners.

**EATING MANNERS**

Japan: It is "perfectly" okay to slurp (发出啧啧声) when you eat noodles. Unlike making big noises, slurping slightly is not rude. Japanese also say it tastes better if you slurp.

Russia: Your wrists should be placed on the edge of the table while eating, fork in left hand, and knife in the right. It is not good manners to rest them on your lap. Keep your elbows off the table.

France: Never discuss money or religion over dinner. What is different from the manners in Russia is that finishing everything on your plate is considered good manners.

Mexico: Whenever you catch the eye of someone who's eating, even a stranger, it's good manners to say "provecho", which means enjoy. In Mexico, dining is more than a meal. It's a social occasion — lunches are seldom quick and suppers can last for hours.

**DRINKING MANNERS**

America: If you empty a bottle into someone's glass, it obliges that person to buy the next bottle. It's polite to put the last drops into your own glass.

Australia: In a pub it's usual to buy a round of drinks for everyone in your group. When it's your turn, say "It's my round". When it's their round, they will buy it for you. Don't leave before you've bought a round.

Japan: Don't fill your own glass of alcohol. Instead, you should pour for others and wait for them to do it for you.

26. What do table manners include?

______

27. How many countries are mentioned in the article?

______

28. Which country is mentioned in both eating manners and drinking manners?

______

29. Why does the writer tell us the table manners in many countries?

______

30. What is the best title for this passage?

______

**〔G45〕小蓝书预测卷二十五 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：They include how to handle knives, forks and spoons and how to eat in a polite manner.**
1 题面：What do table manners include；原文 "Table manners are how to behave when you eat a meal. They include how to handle knives, forks and spoons and how to eat in a polite manner."；疑问词 What do X include（问清单）；诱导信号：首句是定义（how to behave），include 后才是清单，两句紧邻易混。
2 候选：①handle knives, forks and spoons＋eat in a polite manner；②how to cook different food；③what to eat for dinner；④where to sit at table。
3 验算：①→They include how to handle…and how to eat in a polite manner，两个 how to 并列，与 include 直接对应→成立（两项都要）。②→全文无烹饪内容→排除。③→文中只谈礼仪，不谈菜单→排除。④→座位安排在 eating manners 各国条目里未涉及→排除。
4 干扰：定义句 how to behave when you eat a meal 概括性更强，容易被当成"清单"整句抄；两个 how to 中，第二个（eat in a polite manner）较抽象，常被漏。
5 意图：考"include 后并列项取全，定义句不等于清单"。
6 边界：若问 What are table manners? 答 How to behave when you eat a meal（定义可整句）。若问 What does the passage mainly talk about? 答 Table manners in different countries（见 30 题）。
7 错误：A 答 How to behave when you eat a meal.（错因：定义当清单）；B 答 How to handle knives and forks.（错因：漏第二项）；C 答 How to cook.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R45.1 若问 What do X include，then 直取 include 后的全部并列项（两个 how to）；其前的定义句（X are…）只作背景，不代替清单，并列项缺一即不完整。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.15 并列宾语全取；复用 R5.1／R22.2（include 取全），本条标记是"定义句 vs 清单"。
10 自检：①include 后有几项？②定义句在哪？③我漏了第二项吗？

**27. 答案：Six — Japan, Russia, France, Mexico, America and Australia.**
1 题面：How many countries are mentioned in the article；原文分两栏：EATING MANNERS 下列 Japan／Russia／France／Mexico，DRINKING MANNERS 下列 America／Australia／Japan；疑问词 How many（要求清点去重）；诱导信号：Japan 在两栏各出现一次，最易被计两次。
2 候选：①6（去重：Japan, Russia, France, Mexico, America, Australia）；②7（按出现次数：4＋3）；③4（只数 eating 栏）；④8（估数）。
3 验算：①→eating 栏 4 国＋drinking 栏 3 国＝7 次出现，Japan 重复 1 次，去重后 6→成立。②→7 是出现次数，把 Japan 算了两次；题干问 countries（国家实体）→不成立。③→漏掉 drinking 栏 3 国→不成立。④→无论文依据→排除。
4 干扰：两栏标题（EATING／DRINKING MANNERS）都是小标题，读快了会只数一栏；Japan 在 drinking 栏再次出现，正好构成"计两次"的陷阱。
5 意图：考"清点＋去重"，与 28 题的"交集"是同一张清单的两次使用。
6 边界：若问 How many countries are mentioned in the eating manners? 答 Four（Japan, Russia, France, Mexico）。若问 How many in the drinking manners? 答 Three（America, Australia, Japan）。
7 错误：A 答 Seven.（错因：Japan 计两次）；B 答 Four.（错因：只数一栏）；C 答 Five.（错因：漏 Mexico 或漏 Japan）。
8 规则：R45.2 若问 How many X are mentioned，then 先按小节逐条登记（eating 4＋drinking 3＝7 次），再对重复实体去重（Japan 只计一次）→6；不得按出现次数作答。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（清点去重）；与 R20.2（序数标记清点）、R25.3（数词加 1）同族，本条是"跨栏去重"。
10 自检：①两栏各几国？②哪国重复？③我数的是次数还是国家？

**28. 答案：Japan.**
1 题面：Which country is mentioned in both eating manners and drinking manners；原文 EATING 栏 Japan／Russia／France／Mexico，DRINKING 栏 America／Australia／Japan；疑问词 Which country…in both（问交集）；诱导信号：Russia 与 France 的条目最长、内容最具体，Mexico 段还带引语 provecho。
2 候选：①Japan；②America；③Russia；④Mexico。
3 验算：①→Japan 在 eating 栏（slurp noodles）与 drinking 栏（don't fill your own glass）各有一条→成立。②→America 只在 drinking 栏（empty a bottle into someone's glass）→排除。③→Russia 只在 eating 栏（wrists on the edge）→排除。④→Mexico 只在 eating 栏（provecho）→排除。
4 干扰：条目越具体的国家越像"重点"，但题干问的是"两栏都出现"，与篇幅无关。
5 意图：考"交集判定"：先分栏建清单，再取公共项。
6 边界：若问 What does Japan say about eating noodles? 答 It is perfectly okay to slurp。若问 What is Japan's drinking manner? 答 Don't fill your own glass; pour for others。
7 错误：A 答 America.（错因：只在一栏）；B 答 Russia.（错因：只在一栏）；C 答 France.（错因：只在一栏）。
8 规则：R45.3 若问 Which X is mentioned in both A and B，then 分两栏各列清单（eating：Japan／Russia／France／Mexico；drinking：America／Australia／Japan），取交集（Japan）；单栏国家与篇幅长短都不作依据。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.49 交集（两栏共现）；与 R45.2 共用同一份清单，先清点再取交。
10 自检：①两栏清单各是什么？②哪国两栏都有？③我按篇幅选了吗？

**29. 答案：To help readers behave well when they eat abroad (in other countries).**
1 题面：Why does the writer tell us the table manners in many countries；原文首段 "Table manners are how to behave when you eat a meal… To behave well abroad, you are to know some table manners."；疑问词 Why does the writer tell us（问写作目的）；诱导信号：正文按国家罗列，看起来像"介绍各国饮食文化"。
2 候选：①to help readers behave well abroad；②to introduce food culture；③to compare countries for fun；④to teach readers how to cook。
3 验算：①→To behave well abroad, you are to know some table manners，句首 To do 就是目的，且与全文"礼仪"主题一致→成立。②→food culture 是附带效果，原文没有"文化介绍"的表述→次优。③→compare 是手段（分国列举），不是目的→排除。④→无烹饪内容→排除。
4 干扰：分国罗列的结构像"文化比较"；provecho／"It's my round" 等异国表达也强化"文化介绍"的错觉。
5 意图：考"写作目的取首段 To do 句"，并用全文结构验证。
6 边界：若问 What should you know to behave well abroad? 答 Some table manners。若问 What is the passage mainly about? 答 Table manners in different countries。
7 错误：A 答 To introduce food culture.（错因：效果当目的）；B 答 To compare different countries.（错因：手段当目的）；C 答 To teach table manners at home.（错因：丢 abroad 这一限定）。
8 规则：R45.4 若问 Why does the writer tell us…，then 取首段句首 To do 目的句（To behave well abroad），并用正文结构（分 eating／drinking 列举）验证；"介绍文化／比较国家"是手段或附带效果，不作目的。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.4 标题／目的（写作目的取首段 To do）；复用 R20.1（句首 To do 即目的）与 R27.4（purpose 看首段总起）。
10 自检：①首段 To do 是什么？②abroad 这个限定我丢了吗？③我写成"介绍文化"了吗？

**30. 答案：Table Manners in Different Countries（或 Table Manners Around the World）**
1 题面：What is the best title for this passage；全文结构：首段定义＋目的（To behave well abroad）→EATING MANNERS（Japan／Russia／France／Mexico）→DRINKING MANNERS（America／Australia／Japan）；疑问词 best title（要求覆盖全文）；诱导信号：各国条目里细节极多（slurp／provecho／It's my round），任一条都像标题素材。
2 候选：①Table Manners in Different Countries；②How to Eat Noodles in Japan；③Drinking Manners in Australia；④A Trip Around the World。
3 验算：①→含关键词 table manners＋different countries，同时罩住 eating 与 drinking 两栏及六国→成立。②→只覆盖 Japan 的 eating 一条，且 noodles 是细节→不成立。③→只覆盖 drinking 一栏的一国→不成立。④→无 table manners 关键词，范围过宽，罩不住"礼仪"主题→排除。
4 干扰：细节标题（noodles／pub／round）都具体生动；"Around the World"式标题看似大气，却丢掉关键词。
5 意图：考"标题三重检验：关键词＋双栏覆盖＋范围不过宽"。
6 边界：若题干限定"title for the EATING MANNERS part"，答 Eating Manners in Different Countries。若问 What is the passage mainly about? 答 同上（table manners in different countries）。
7 错误：A 答 How to Eat Noodles.（错因：一条细节）；B 答 Drinking Manners.（错因：只罩一栏）；C 答 Customs Around the World.（错因：范围过宽、丢关键词）。
8 规则：R45.5 若问 best title，then 用"关键词（table manners）＋覆盖检验（eating＋drinking 两栏、多国）＋范围检验（不过宽、不只一国）"三重筛；单一国家、单一条目、无关键词的宽标题都不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.4 拟标题（覆盖型）；复用 R11.5（标题三重约束）与 R15.5，本条把"覆盖"具体化为"两栏＋多国"。
10 自检：①标题含 table manners 吗？②eating 与 drinking 都罩住了吗？③是否只写了一国？

**组小结（G45 · 小蓝书预测卷二十五 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：清单取全 1（26）；清点去重 1（27）；交集 1（28）；写作目的 1（29）；标题覆盖 1（30）。
- 规则：R45.1 include 取全（26）；R45.2 清点去重＝6（27）；R45.3 两栏交集＝Japan（28）；R45.4 目的取 To do（29）；R45.5 标题三检验（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R45.1 与"定义句更概括"冲突，include 清单优先；R45.2 与"按出现次数计"冲突，实体去重优先；R45.3 与"篇幅最长的国家"冲突，两栏共现优先；R45.4 与"分国罗列像文化比较"冲突，To do 目的优先；R45.5 与"细节最生动"冲突，覆盖检验优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**数字类新增"清点去重"1 例（27）与"交集"1 例（28）**，与 R20.2（序数清点）、R25.3（加 1）并列；**差值／换算仍无**。标题题补"覆盖型"（两栏＋多国）。本组为纯信息罗列型说明文，可作为"应用文"的过渡样本，但**图表类仍缺**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷二十五 · Passage 4

The boss of a big company needed to call one of his employees about an urgent problem on one of the main computers. He dialed the employee's home phone number and was greeted with a child's whisper, "Hello?"

Feeling it was inconvenient to talk to a youngster, the boss asked, "Is your daddy home?" "Yes," whispered the small voice. "May I talk with him?" the man asked. To the surprise of the boss, the small voice whispered, "No."

Wanting to talk with an adult. the boss asked. "Is your mommy there?" "Yes," came the answer, "May I talk with her?" Again the small voice whispered, "No."

Knowing that it was not likely that a young child would be left home alone, the boss decided he would just leave a message with the person who should be there watching over the child. "Is there any one there besides you?" the boss asked the child. "Yes," whispered the child, "a policeman."

Wondering what a policeman would be doing at his employee's home, the boss asked, "May I speak with the policeman?" "No, he is busy," whispered the child. "Busy doing what?" asked the boss. "Talking to Daddy and Mommy and the fireman," came the whispered answer.

Growing concerned and even worried as he heard what sounded like a helicopter through the earpiece on the phone, the boss asked, "What is that noise?" "A hello-copper," answered the whispering voice. "What is going on there?" asked the boss, now alarmed. In a low whispering voice the child answered, "The search team just landed the hello-copper!"

Alarmed and concerned the boss asked, "The search team?Why are they there?" Still *murmuring*, the young voice replied, "They are looking for me!"

31. Why did the boss call his employee?

______

32. Who did the boss want to talk to?

______

33. Who called the police most possibly

______

34. What does the underlined word "murmuring" in the last paragraph probably mean?

______

35. What do you think will happen next?(no more than 20 words)

______

**〔G46〕小蓝书预测卷二十五 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：Because there was an urgent problem with one of the main computers, and he needed to talk to the employee about it.**
1 题面：Why did the boss call his employee；原文 "The boss of a big company needed to call one of his employees about an urgent problem on one of the main computers."；疑问词 Why（问打电话的原因）；诱导信号：后文全是电话里的对话（policeman／fireman／hello-copper），情节更强。
2 候选：①urgent problem on one of the main computers；②to ask about the child；③to invite the employee to a meeting；④to fire the employee。
3 验算：①→needed to call…about an urgent problem on one of the main computers，about 短语就是目的，首句即答案→成立。②→问孩子是被接电话的人带出来的，不是打电话的原因→排除。③→原文无 meeting→排除。④→原文无 fire→排除。
4 干扰：故事后半（警察、消防员、搜救队）戏剧性强，读者容易把"找人"当成打电话的目的；首句的 computer problem 反而被当成背景。
5 意图：考"call sb about sth 的目的取 about 短语"，不被后续情节带走。
6 边界：若问 What was wrong with the computer? 答 There was an urgent problem on one of the main computers（原文未给具体故障）。若问 Who answered the phone? 答 A child（the employee's child）。
7 错误：A 答 Because he wanted to find the child.（错因：情节当原因）；B 答 Because the computer was broken by the child.（错因：无据联想）；C 答 Because he missed his employee.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R46.1 若问 Why did sb call／phone，then 取首句 call sb about sth 中的 about 短语（urgent problem on the main computer）；电话里后续发生的事（child／policeman／helicopter）是事件发展，不作打电话的原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（about 短语即目的）；复用 R33.2（目的取 as part of／to），本条标记是 about。
10 自检：①首句的 about 后是什么？②后续情节能当原因吗？③我写"找孩子"了吗？

**32. 答案：His employee — the child's father (an adult in the house he could leave a message with).**
1 题面：Who did the boss want to talk to；原文依次 "Is your daddy home?" "May I talk with him?"→"Is your mommy there?" "May I talk with her?"→"Is there any one there besides you?"→"May I speak with the policeman?"；疑问词 Who（问对象）；诱导信号：最后一次问的是 the policeman，且被明确拒绝。
2 候选：①his employee（the child's daddy）；②the child；③the policeman；④the child's mommy。
3 验算：①→needed to call one of his employees＋首问 Is your daddy home／May I talk with him，daddy 即 employee→成立（后面改问 mommy、policeman，都是为了"找一个大人留口信"）。②→Feeling it was inconvenient to talk to a youngster，他明确不想跟孩子谈→排除。③→policeman 是最后才问到的对象，且 No, he is busy 被拒；只答他＝取了过程末端→次优。④→mommy 是中间一次尝试，同样被拒→次优。
4 干扰：情节推进使人以为"他最终想找警察"；其实题干问 want to talk to，主诉是员工本人。
5 意图：考"多次改口时取主诉对象（首问），其余为替代尝试"。
6 边界：若问 Who did the boss finally ask to speak with? 答 The policeman（但被拒绝）。若问 Why did he ask for the policeman? 答 Because he wanted to leave a message with the adult watching the child。
7 错误：A 答 The policeman.（错因：过程末端当目的）；B 答 The child.（错因：与 inconvenient to talk to a youngster 相反）；C 答 The fireman.（错因：fireman 从未被要求通话）。
8 规则：R46.2 若问 Who did sb want to talk to 且原文多次改口，then 取主诉对象（首问：daddy＝employee），其余（mommy／policeman）标为"替代尝试"；只答最后一次问到的对象算过程末端，不完整。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（主诉 vs 替代）；复用 R31.1（结论 vs 过程），本条把"过程"换成"改口序列"。
10 自检：①首问问的是谁？②policeman 是第几次尝试？③我取的是主诉还是末端？

**33. 答案：The child's parents (his daddy and mommy) most possibly called the police, because the child was lost — as he whispers, "They are looking for me!"**
1 题面：Who called the police most possibly；原文线索："a policeman" 在场、"Talking to Daddy and Mommy and the fireman"、"The search team just landed the hello-copper!"、末句 "They are looking for me!"；疑问词 Who…most possibly（推断题，须给依据）；诱导信号：policeman 是被孩子提到的人，容易被答成"警察自己来的"。
2 候选：①his parents；②the child himself；③the boss；④the fireman。
3 验算：①→搜救队、警察、消防员同时在找孩子（They are looking for me），而孩子躲着不出声、父母在场与警察交谈——最合理的报警人就是发现孩子不见的父母→成立（须带依据）。②→孩子是被找的人，且一直低声躲藏，不可能自己报警→不成立。③→老板在电话另一端，此时还不知道真相（Alarmed and concerned）→排除。④→消防员属救援方，不是报警人→排除。
4 干扰：policeman 是文中反复出现的词，读者容易把"谁报了警"答成"警察"；孩子那句 They are looking for me 若读不出"我是被找的人"，整题就断线。
5 意图：考"由结尾悬念＋在场人员角色反推行为人"。
6 边界：若问 Why are they looking for the child? 答 Because the child is lost／missing（原文只说 looking for me，未交代走失细节）。若问 What is the policeman busy doing? 答 Talking to Daddy and Mommy and the fireman。
7 错误：A 答 The policeman called the police.（错因：角色混淆）；B 答 The child called the police.（错因：他是被找的人）；C 答 The boss called the police.（错因：他尚未知情）。
8 规则：R46.3 若问 Who…most possibly（推断），then 先定各人角色（policeman／fireman／search team＝救援方；daddy／mommy＝在场家长；child＝被找的人），再由结尾悬念（They are looking for me）反推行为人＝发现孩子不见的父母；答案须附一句依据。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.16 推断（反推行为人）；与 R32.4（might 允许贴文本推测）同族，本条要求"角色表＋悬念"双证。
10 自检：①各人是什么角色？②谁最可能报警？③我给依据了吗？

**34. 答案：It means "whispering" — speaking in a very low voice.（低声说、嘟囔）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "murmuring" in the last paragraph probably mean；原文 "Still *murmuring*, the young voice replied, 'They are looking for me!'"；原卷该词有下划线，转写以斜体保留；疑问词 probably mean（词义题）；诱导信号：murmur 与 whisper 形不同，但同段 whisper 出现五次以上。
2 候选：①whispering／speaking in a low voice；②shouting loudly；③crying；④laughing。
3 验算：①→同段 greeted with a child's whisper／whispered the small voice（多次）／In a low whispering voice，murmuring 与它们同指"低声"→成立。②→shout 与 whisper 相反，且孩子躲着说话（怕被搜救队听到）→不成立。③→原文无哭的描写→排除。④→原文无笑；情节是躲藏→排除。
4 干扰：murmur 的词典义含"抱怨地低声说"，学生可能答 complain；但本句 replied 是回答，内容也不是抱怨。
5 意图：考"词义由同段复现词与情境定"，按 RA-2 四步走。
6 边界：若问 Why did the child whisper? 答 Because he was hiding (the search team was looking for him)。若问 How did the boss feel at the end? 答 Alarmed and concerned。
7 错误：A 答 Shouting.（错因：与全文 whisper 相反）；B 答 Complaining.（错因：词典义硬套）；C 答 Crying.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R46.4 若问划线词词义，then 按 RA-2 四步：①搭配（Still murmuring, the young voice replied）②同段复现（whisper／in a low whispering voice）③语域（躲藏、怕被听见）④词面义；取"低声说"，不取 shout，也不硬套"抱怨"义。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（同段复现定值）；词义族已停止扩类，本条只示范 RA-2 四步。
10 自检：①同段复现词是什么？②情境允许大声吗？③我套了哪个词典义？

**35. 答案：（开放题，≤20 词）The boss will realize the child is lost and tell the police at once.（14 words）**
1 题面：What do you think will happen next?(no more than 20 words)——预测＋**词数上限 20 词**；悬念来自末句 "They are looking for me!" 与老板 Alarmed and concerned 的状态；疑问词 What…will happen next（开放预测）。
2 候选：①老板明白孩子走失→立刻告知警察（14 词）；②孩子被父母惩罚（无据）；③老板大笑（与 alarmed 相反）；④长篇描述搜救过程（超 20 词）。
3 验算：①→承接"孩子是被找的人＋老板已 alarmed"，一句内给出最可能动作，14 词＜20→成立。②→原文无惩罚线索，且走失不是过错→排除。③→与 Alarmed and concerned 相反→不成立。④→超词数，直接不合格→排除。
4 干扰：题干两个约束（预测合理＋≤20 词）叠在一起，学生常写足情节却超词；也容易写成"警察抓住了孩子"这类误读。
5 意图：考"悬念续写＋限词"，与 R42.5 同一硬约束。
6 边界：若无词数限制，可写两句（老板明白真相→通知救援队／向员工说明情况）。若问 What did the child think of the search? 答 原文未表态，不可编。
7 错误：A 答 The police will arrest the child.（错因：误读角色）；B 答 The boss will laugh.（错因：与 alarmed 相反）；C 写 30 词以上（错因：超限）。
8 规则：R46.5 若问 What do you think will happen next 且限词，then 由最后一句悬念（They are looking for me!）＋人物状态（alarmed）推出一个最可能动作（老板明白孩子走失→告知警察／救援队），一句≤20 词；不写惩罚、搞笑等与悬念无关的结局；先数词再定稿。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.8 限词版评价／预测；复用 R42.5（先数词再定稿），本条把"评价"换成"预测"。
10 自检：①悬念句是哪句？②我的预测与前文冲突吗？③几词？

**组小结（G46 · 小蓝书预测卷二十五 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：打电话原因 1（31）；通话对象（主诉 vs 改口）1（32）；推断行为人 1（33）；词义（murmuring）1（34）；续写预测＋限词 1（35）。
- 规则：R46.1 about 短语即目的（31）；R46.2 改口取主诉（32）；R46.3 角色表＋悬念反推（33）；R46.4 按 RA-2 四步取"低声说"（34）；R46.5 悬念续写＋限词（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R46.1 与"后半情节更戏剧"冲突，首句 about 优先；R46.2 与"最后问到的对象"冲突，主诉优先；R46.3 与"policeman 字面"冲突，角色表优先；R46.4 与"词典'抱怨'义"冲突，同段复现优先；R46.5 与"情节写全"冲突，词数上限优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：推断题补"反推行为人"（RA-3.16）；限词第 2 例（R42.5／R46.5）；词义题严格按 RA-2 四步、不扩类。**小蓝书卷二十五 4 篇至此完成（G43—G46）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷二十四 · Passage 1

China is universally acknowledged as the birthplace of kites. Kites originated in the Spring and Autumn Period over 2,000 years ago. Legend has it that the wooden bird made by the ancient philosopher(哲学家) Mozi was the earliest kite.

Folklorists(民俗学家) hold that ancient people invented kites to be in memory of dead family members and friends. That's why they would fly kites on the Qingming Festival, a day ancient



people believed the gate of hell would throw open, to send their greetings to their loved ones who passed away via the kite. In the Tang and Song Dynasties, due to the booming of paper making industry, people began to make kites with paper. In the late Tang Dynasty, some people added musical strings to kites.

In ancient times, apart from being an entertainment article, a kite could also be used for military purposes, such as distance measuring, information transmitting and dangerous spot crossing etc. And during the Battle of Gaixia, when Xiang Yu's troops were surrounded by Liu Bang's troops, Han Xin ordered the making of a cowhide kite, with a bamboo flute attached to it. When the kite was flown in the wind, the Han army sang some Chu songs with the flute, breaking up the Chu army's morale. The Han army won the battle in the end. This was the origin of the Chinese idiom "Simian Chuge" (literally meaning "Chu songs all around", it's a phrase that means "under attack from all directions").

Today, on the Qingming Festival, people fly kites as high and far as possible and cut the line on purpose, allowing the kites to drift in the sky with the wind. This is a symbol of letting go the unhappiness and sadness accumulated in the previous year, which is believed to keep illnesses at bay during the whole year.

16. According to the text who invented the first kite?

______

17. What was the kite used for in ancient times? Please answer one use.

______

18. Why would the ancient people fly kites on the Qingming Festival?

______

19. Explain the Chinese idiom "Simian Chuge" in English.

______

20. Why do people fly kites as high and far as possible and cut the line deliberately?

______

**〔G47〕小蓝书预测卷二十四 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：According to the legend, Mozi, the ancient philosopher, made the earliest kite — a wooden bird.**
1 题面：According to the text who invented the first kite；原文 "Legend has it that the wooden bird made by the ancient philosopher(哲学家) Mozi was the earliest kite."；疑问词 who（问人）；诱导信号：第四段出现 Han Xin ordered the making of a cowhide kite，也是一个"造风筝的人"。
2 候选：①Mozi（ancient philosopher）；②Han Xin；③Xiang Yu；④Liu Bang。
3 验算：①→Legend has it that the wooden bird made by…Mozi was the earliest kite，主语＋"最早的"直接对应→成立（须带 Legend has it 的"传说"限定）。②→Han Xin 造的是 cowhide kite，用于 Battle of Gaixia 的战术，不是"最早的风筝"→不成立。③→Xiang Yu 是被围的一方→排除。④→Liu Bang 的军队围困楚军，与造风筝无关→排除。
4 干扰：Han Xin 段落最长、情节最完整，容易被当成"风筝发明人"；题干 According to the text 又让人以为必须找一个"事实"，而原文给的是传说。
5 意图：考"最早／起源取 Legend has it 句"与"传说限定语不丢"。
6 边界：若问 What was the earliest kite made of? 答 Wood（a wooden bird）。若问 Who ordered a cowhide kite in the Battle of Gaixia? 答 Han Xin。
7 错误：A 答 Han Xin.（错因：后文造风筝者当发明人）；B 答 Mozi, and it was a fact.（错因：丢传说限定）；C 答 Xiang Yu.（错因：人物错位）。
8 规则：R47.1 若问 who invented the first／earliest X according to the text，then 取 Legend has it that 后的主语＋同位语（the ancient philosopher Mozi），并保留"传说"限定；后文另一处"造同类物"的人（Han Xin）不作发明人。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（起源／传说）；复用 R15.2（kind 取类名），本条标记是 Legend has it。
10 自检：①"最早"出现在哪句？②Han Xin 造的是什么？③传说限定丢了吗？

**17. 答案：It was used for military purposes — for example, distance measuring (or information transmitting, or crossing dangerous spots); it was also an entertainment article.**
1 题面：What was the kite used for in ancient times? Please answer one use；原文 "In ancient times, apart from being an entertainment article, a kite could also be used for military purposes, such as distance measuring, information transmitting and dangerous spot crossing etc."；疑问词 What was it used for（问用途，且只要一项）；诱导信号：第二段的 Qingming 放风筝（纪念亡者）也是一个"古代用途"，容易被当成唯一答案。
2 候选：①military purposes——distance measuring／information transmitting／dangerous spot crossing；②entertainment；③Qingming 纪念亡者；④decorating houses。
3 验算：①→could also be used for military purposes, such as distance measuring…，such as 后任取一项即满足"one use"→成立。②→apart from being an entertainment article 明确列为用途之一→成立（并列答案）。③→第二段说的是"纪念亡者"的民俗用途，也在古代，可算一用→次优（与本题第三段清单不同源，答题时优先第三段）。④→原文无装饰用途→排除。
4 干扰：题干 Please answer one use 降低了门槛，学生反而容易把"纪念亡者"整段抄来；military purposes 后的三项是 such as 列举，抄全也无妨但非必需。
5 意图：考"用途题取 used for／such as 清单，任一项即可；跨段同类信息分清来源"。
6 边界：若问 What are the military uses of kites? 答 Distance measuring, information transmitting and dangerous spot crossing。若问 What did people do with kites on Qingming in ancient times? 答 They flew them to send greetings to the dead。
7 错误：A 答 To send greetings to the dead.（错因：跨段取民俗用途，未答 military 清单）；B 答 To decorate the house.（错因：无据）；C 答 To measure distance and to sing Chu songs.（错因：唱楚歌是战术，不是用途项）。
8 规则：R47.2 若问 What was X used for 且题干允许 one use，then 取 used for 后的类别（military purposes）＋such as 清单中任一项（distance measuring／information transmitting／dangerous spot crossing），或并列的 entertainment；跨段的民俗用途可作次优，不与本段清单混抄。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.42 用途（used for）；复用 R34.1（用途取动词短语），本条加"such as 任取一项"与"跨段来源分清"。
10 自检：①used for 后是什么类别？②such as 有几项？③我抄的是哪一段？

**18. 答案：To be in memory of dead family members and friends — to send their greetings to their loved ones who had passed away via the kite.**
1 题面：Why would the ancient people fly kites on the Qingming Festival；原文 "Folklorists(民俗学家) hold that ancient people invented kites to be in memory of dead family members and friends. That's why they would fly kites on the Qingming Festival, a day ancient people believed the gate of hell would throw open, to send their greetings to their loved ones who passed away via the kite."；疑问词 Why（问节日行为的原因）；诱导信号：同段还有"纸业繁荣→改用纸做风筝""晚唐加琴弦"两条，都是工艺变化，不是节日原因。
2 候选：①to be in memory of the dead＋send greetings via the kite；②to celebrate the coming of spring；③for military training；④because paper making boomed。
3 验算：①→invented kites to be in memory of…＋to send their greetings…via the kite，两个 to do 目的与题干"Qingming 放风筝"直接对应→成立。②→原文无春天／丰收→排除。③→军事用途在第三段，与节日无关→排除。④→paper making 解释的是"改用纸做风筝"，不是"为什么放"→次优。
4 干扰：That's why 前的 folklorists 句与后面的 hell gate 从句都很长，学生容易只抄"纸业繁荣"这类显眼变化。
5 意图：考"节日行为的原因取 to do 目的链"，同段工艺变化不参与因果。
6 边界：若问 Why did people begin to make kites with paper? 答 Because of the booming of paper making industry in the Tang and Song Dynasties。若问 What did people believe about Qingming? 答 That the gate of hell would throw open。
7 错误：A 答 Because paper making boomed.（错因：工艺变化当节日原因）；B 答 To send greetings to the emperor.（错因：对象错，是 loved ones）；C 答 For military purposes.（错因：串段）。
8 规则：R47.3 若问 Why would people do sth on a festival，then 取 to be in memory of… 的不定式目的＋to send their greetings…via… 的目的从句（对象是 passed-away loved ones）；同段的工艺变化（paper／musical strings）不作节日原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（节日行为的 to do 目的链）；复用 R20.1（To do 即目的），本条是"双 to 目的链"。
10 自检：①两个 to do 各是什么？②对象是谁？③纸业那句解释什么？

**19. 答案：It literally means "Chu songs all around", and it is used to mean "under attack from all directions" (being surrounded by enemies on all sides).**
1 题面：Explain the Chinese idiom "Simian Chuge" in English；原文 "This was the origin of the Chinese idiom 'Simian Chuge' (literally meaning 'Chu songs all around', it's a phrase that means 'under attack from all directions')."；疑问词 Explain…in English（要求用英语释义，非讲典故）；诱导信号：前文 Battle of Gaixia 的战术故事很长，容易被当答案。
2 候选：①字面 Chu songs all around＋喻义 under attack from all directions；②Chu songs are beautiful；③the Battle of Gaixia；④singing in four directions。
3 验算：①→括号内已给两层（literally meaning…／it's a phrase that means…），照取即成立（字面＋喻义各一句最好）。②→只取字面又改成"好听"，无喻义→不成立。③→战役是成语来源，不是释义→次优。④→字面误译（四面＝四个方向，唱歌≠Chu songs）→排除。
4 干扰：故事部分细节最丰富（cowhide kite／bamboo flute／Chu songs），诱人复述故事；括号注释反而被跳过。
5 意图：考"成语题取括号内的字面＋喻义两层"，不复述典故。
6 边界：若问 What is the origin of "Simian Chuge"? 答 The Battle of Gaixia, when Han Xin's army flew a cowhide kite with a bamboo flute and sang Chu songs。若问 Why did the Han army sing Chu songs? 答 To break up the Chu army's morale。
7 错误：A 答 It means the Han army won the battle.（错因：复述结果）；B 答 It means singing Chu songs in four places.（错因：只取字面且误译）；C 答 It means a kind of kite.（错因：对象错）。
8 规则：R47.4 若题干要求 Explain an idiom in English 且原文括号已给释义，then 直取括号内的 literal meaning＋phrase meaning（Chu songs all around／under attack from all directions）；典故（战役、牛皮风筝）只说明来源，不作释义。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.3 划线句／习语释义；复用 R30.4（习语对译）与 R36.4（段末直白句校验），本条校验件是括号注释。
10 自检：①括号里给了几层？②我讲成故事了吗？③喻义写对了吗？

**20. 答案：Because it is a symbol of letting go the unhappiness and sadness accumulated in the previous year, which is believed to keep illnesses at bay during the whole year.**
1 题面：Why do people fly kites as high and far as possible and cut the line deliberately；原文 "Today, on the Qingming Festival, people fly kites as high and far as possible and cut the line on purpose, allowing the kites to drift in the sky with the wind. This is a symbol of letting go the unhappiness and sadness accumulated in the previous year, which is believed to keep illnesses at bay during the whole year."；疑问词 Why（问习俗的象征意义）；诱导信号：第二段"纪念亡者"也是一条 Qingming 理由，易与今俗混。
2 候选：①让不快与悲伤随风筝而去→全年不生病；②为了纪念死去的亲友；③为了比赛谁飞得高；④为了庆祝纸业的繁荣。
3 验算：①→This is a symbol of letting go the unhappiness and sadness…which is believed to keep illnesses at bay，象征＋结果齐全→成立。②→那是古代起源（in memory of the dead），本段讲"今天"的今俗，题干问 cut the line deliberately，对应"放下不快"→次优。③→原文无比赛→排除。④→纸业句在第二段讲工艺，与今俗无关→排除。
4 干扰：两段都写 Qingming，纪念亡者与送走不快容易混；letting go／keep illnesses at bay 两个短语都较抽象。
5 意图：考"今俗象征义取 This is a symbol of＋which is believed to 结果句"，并与古代的起源动机区分。
6 边界：若问 What do people do with the kite after cutting the line? 答 They let it drift in the sky with the wind。若问 What do people believe cutting the line can do? 答 Keep illnesses at bay during the whole year。
7 错误：A 答 To send greetings to the dead.（错因：古代起源当今俗原因）；B 答 To see whose kite flies highest.（错因：编造比赛）；C 答 To let the kite drift away for fun.（错因：只描述动作，无象征义）。
8 规则：R47.5 若问 Why do people do sth（象征性习俗），then 取 This is a symbol of… 的同位句＋which is believed to 的结果（keep illnesses at bay）；同一节目的古代起源（in memory of the dead）不作今俗原因。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.17 象征义（习俗）；与 R35.4（比喻式观点）、R38.5（象征动作）同族，本条标记是 This is a symbol of。
10 自检：①象征句在哪？②结果是什么？③我混了古代的纪念动机吗？

**组小结（G47 · 小蓝书预测卷二十四 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：发明人（传说）1（16）；用途（such as 任取）1（17）；节日原因（双 to 目的）1（18）；成语释义 1（19）；象征习俗 1（20）。
- 规则：R47.1 起源取 Legend has it（16）；R47.2 used for＋such as 任取一项（17）；R47.3 节日原因取 to do 链（18）；R47.4 成语取括号两层（19）；R47.5 象征取 This is a symbol of（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R47.1 与"后文造风筝者"冲突，earliest 优先；R47.2 与"跨段民俗用途"冲突，本段 used for 优先；R47.3 与"工艺变化显眼"冲突，目的链优先；R47.4 与"典故细节丰富"冲突，括号注释优先；R47.5 与"古代起源动机"冲突，今俗象征优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：文化类说明文第 3 篇（G41 饮食／G45 礼仪／本条风筝），三条"跨段来源分清"规则可合并进 04；新增 RA-3.17 象征义；差值与图表仍无。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷二十四 · Passage 2

Ben Saunders was the last kid in his class picked for any sports team. "Football, Tennis, Cricket — anything with a round ball, I was useless." he says now with a laugh. But back then he



was the object of jokes in school gym classes in England's rural Devonshire.

It was a mountain bike he received for his 15th birthday that changed him. At first the teen went biking alone in a nearby forest. Then he began to cycle along with a runner friend. Gradually, Saunders set his mind on building up his body, increasing his speed, strength and endurance. At age 18, he ran his first marathon.

The following year, he met John Ridgway, who became famous in the 1960s for rowing an open boat across the Atlantic Ocean. Saunders was hired as an instructor at Ridgway's school of Adventure, where he learned about the older man's cold-water exploits ( 成就 ): *Intrigued*, Saunders read all he could about Arctic explorers and North Pole expeditions, then decided that this would be his future.

Journey s to the Pole aren't the usual holidays for British country boys, and many people dismissed his dream as fantasy. "John Ridgway was one of the few who didn't say, 'You are completely crazy,'" Saunders says.

In 2001, after becoming a skilled skier, Saunders started his first long-distance expedition toward the North Pole. He suffered frostbite (冻疮), had a closer encounter with a polar bear and pushed his body to the limit.

Saunders has since become the youngest person to ski alone to the North Pole,  and he's skied more in the Arctic by himself than any other Briton.

This October, Saunders, 27, heads south to explore from the coast of Antarctica to the South Pole and back, an 1800-mile journey that has never been completed on skis.
