25. How are you inspired by Saunders? Please explain in your own words.

______

**〔G48〕小蓝书预测卷二十四 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：A mountain bike he received for his 15th birthday.**
1 题面：What was the turning point at which Saunders took to sports；原文 "It was a mountain bike he received for his 15th birthday that changed him. At first the teen went biking alone in a nearby forest. Then he began to cycle along with a runner friend."；疑问词 turning point（问转折点）；诱导信号：后文 at age 18 he ran his first marathon、meeting John Ridgway 都像"转折"。
2 候选：①a mountain bike for his 15th birthday；②meeting John Ridgway；③his first marathon at 18；④his school gym classes。
3 验算：①→It was a mountain bike…that changed him，强调句焦点正是"转折点"，后两句 biking／cycling 是其展开→成立。②→Ridgway 让他转向"极地探险之梦"，是下一阶段的方向，不是"开始运动"的转折→次优。③→first marathon 是 bike 改变后的结果（At age 18），时间在后→不成立。④→gym classes 里他是 the object of jokes，是起点前的处境→排除。
4 干扰：强调句 It was…that 的结构不熟，容易读成普通句；Ridgway 段落信息量最大，像"人生转折"。
5 意图：考"强调句焦点＝转折点"，以及"结果不能倒果为因"。
6 边界：若问 How old was Saunders when he got the bike? 答 15。若问 What did he do at 18? 答 He ran his first marathon。
7 错误：A 答 Meeting John Ridgway.（错因：下一阶段方向当转折）；B 答 His first marathon.（错因：结果当原因）；C 答 A runner friend.（错因：同伴是后续，不是转折物）。
8 规则：R48.1 若问 turning point／What changed sb，then 取 It was X that changed him 强调句的焦点 X（a mountain bike for his 15th birthday）；后文的导师、首个马拉松是结果或下一阶段，不倒果为因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.40 事件核（转折点 vs 结果）；复用 R31.1（结论 vs 过程），本条标记是强调句 It was…that。
10 自检：①强调句在哪？②first marathon 是前是后？③Ridgway 改的是什么？

**22. 答案：It means "interested" or "fascinated" — Saunders was so interested that he read everything he could about Arctic explorers.（被激起兴趣的、着迷的）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "intrigued" in Para 3 mean；原文 "*Intrigued*, Saunders read all he could about Arctic explorers and North Pole expeditions, then decided that this would be his future."；原卷该词有下划线，转写以斜体保留；疑问词 mean（词义题）；诱导信号：前句讲 John Ridgway 的 cold-water exploits，语境是"别人的成就"。
2 候选：①interested／fascinated（被激起兴趣）；②bored（厌倦）；③frightened（害怕）；④confused（困惑）。
3 验算：①→Intrigued 作原因状语，后接 read all he could＋decided this would be his future，行为链只与"兴趣"相容→成立。②→bored 与read all he could／决定以此为业相反→不成立。③→frightened 与"决定将来做这个"相反→排除。④→confused 无法解释"读完并下决心"→排除。
4 干扰：intrigue 的常见义"阴谋"（名）会带偏；cold-water exploits 里的 cold 也可能诱导"害怕"。
5 意图：考"情感分词作状语时，由后文行为定褒贬"。
6 边界：若问 Why did Saunders read about Arctic explorers? 答 Because he was intrigued by Ridgway's cold-water exploits。若问 What did he decide? 答 That polar exploration would be his future。
7 错误：A 答 Bored.（错因：与行为相反）；B 答 Frightened.（错因：cold 的联想）；C 答 Confused.（错因：无法解释下决心）。
8 规则：R48.2 若问情感分词（Intrigued／Interested）词义，then 按 RA-2 四步：①搭配（Intrigued, sb read all he could）②后文行为（读尽＋决定以此为业）③语域（探险成就）④词面义；取 interested／fascinated，不取 bored／frightened。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（情感分词）；词义族已停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步示范。
10 自检：①后文他做了什么？②intrigue 的名词义干扰了吗？③我取了"怕"吗？

**23. 答案：They made him so interested that he read all he could about polar exploration and then decided that this would be his future.**
1 题面：How did books about the Arctic explorers and expeditions influence Saunders；原文 "Intrigued, Saunders read all he could about Arctic explorers and North Pole expeditions, then decided that this would be his future."；疑问词 How did X influence sb（问影响结果）；诱导信号：read all he could 是过程动作，最容易被当成"影响"。
2 候选：①使他决定以极地探险为未来；②使他成为作家；③使他害怕寒冷；④没有影响。
3 验算：①→then decided that this would be his future 是影响的落点，Intrigued 是起点→成立（写"读了很多书并决定以此为业"最完整）。②→原文无写作→排除。③→与后文 2001 年出发探险相反→不成立。④→与 decided 矛盾→排除。
4 干扰：read all he could 具体可抄，decided 抽象；学生常只写"读了很多书"而丢掉"决定未来"。
5 意图：考"影响取 decided 后的结果句，过程动作不作影响"。
6 边界：若问 What did Saunders decide? 答 That polar exploration would be his future。若问 Who was John Ridgway? 答 A man famous for rowing an open boat across the Atlantic, who hired Saunders as an instructor。
7 错误：A 答 He read many books.（错因：过程当影响）；B 答 He became a writer.（错因：无据）；C 答 He was afraid of the Arctic.（错因：与决定相反）。
8 规则：R48.3 若问 How did X influence sb，then 取 then decided that… 的结果句＋前置状态（Intrigued）；"读了很多书"是过程，不单独作影响。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.6 结果（影响落点）；复用 R43.4（领悟取宾语从句），本条落点是 decide 的宾语。
10 自检：①结果句在哪？②read all he could 是过程还是结果？③他决定了什么？

**24. 答案：Because he became the youngest person to ski alone to the North Pole, and he has skied more in the Arctic by himself than any other Briton.**
1 题面：Why is Saunders' journey to the North Pole special；原文 "Saunders has since become the youngest person to ski alone to the North Pole, and he's skied more in the Arctic by himself than any other Briton."；疑问词 Why is X special（问特殊之处）；诱导信号：上一段写了他 suffered frostbite、closer encounter with a polar bear、pushed his body to the limit，困难描写很抢眼。
2 候选：①youngest to ski alone＋skied more than any other Briton；②他冻伤、遇北极熊；③1800 英里的行程；④他 27 岁出发。
3 验算：①→两个最高级／比较级（the youngest／more…than any other Briton）直接构成"特别"→成立（两点并列）。②→困难是过程经历，别人也可能遇到，不构成"特别"→次优。③→1800 miles 是"南极往返"的行程数据（下一段），与"到北极"的特别之处不同→排除。④→27 岁是南极之行时的年龄，不是北极纪录→排除。
4 干扰：冻伤与北极熊画面感强；1800-mile 数字很大，容易被当成"特别"。
5 意图：考"special 取最高级／比较级记录，困难体验不作特别"。
6 边界：若问 What difficulties did he meet on his first expedition? 答 Frostbite, a close encounter with a polar bear and pushing his body to the limit。若问 What is he going to do this October? 答 To explore from the coast of Antarctica to the South Pole and back。
7 错误：A 答 Because he suffered frostbite.（错因：困难当特别）；B 答 Because the journey is 1800 miles.（错因：串到南极之行）；C 答 Because he was 27.（错因：年龄错位）。
8 规则：R48.4 若问 Why is X special／unusual，then 取最高级／比较级记录句（the youngest person to ski alone to the North Pole；more…than any other Briton）；冻伤、北极熊、里程数属困难与数据，不构成"特别"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.19 最高级指向；复用 R34.2（special 取全部举证）与 R33.1（最高级），本条要求"两条记录都写"。
10 自检：①最高级有几个？②冻伤属什么？③1800 英里是去哪的？

**25. 答案：（开放题）He inspires me to keep going even when others laugh at my dream. In my own words, I should start small, build up my strength step by step and never give up when things get hard.**
1 题面：How are you inspired by Saunders? Please explain in your own words.——启示＋改写；可用依据：was the object of jokes／It was a mountain bike…that changed him／set his mind on building up his body／many people dismissed his dream as fantasy, but he kept going／suffered frostbite…pushed his body to the limit。
2 候选：①不被嘲笑动摇＋从小处做起＋坚持（改写）；②只写 I am moved；③复述他从 15 岁到 27 岁的经历；④跑题讲环保。
3 验算：①→"道理（不怕嘲笑、逐步积累、坚持）＋自用（start small／never give up）"，且改写为第一人称→成立。②→只有情绪，无道理与自用→不成立。③→复述生平，不是"我受到什么启发"，且未改写→排除。④→本文与环保无关（那是下一篇文章）→排除。
4 干扰：生平时间线完整好抄；in your own words 又被忽略。
5 意图：考"启示＝道理＋自用"＋改写约束，与 R39.5 同法。
6 边界：若问 What did people think of his dream? 答 Many people dismissed it as fantasy。若问 What did he do to build up his body? 答 He cycled alone and with a runner friend, increasing his speed, strength and endurance。
7 错误：A 只写 I am deeply moved.（错因：漏道理）；B 抄 "many people dismissed his dream as fantasy"（错因：未改写、且是别人的态度）；C 写 I will buy a mountain bike.（错因：具体物当启示）。
8 规则：R48.5 若问 How are you inspired by sb，then 先给"我得到的道理"（不怕嘲笑／从小处开始／坚持），再说"我会怎么做"；只写 moved 或复述生平不合格；题干 in your own words 要求改写（复用 R39.5／R36.5）。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.5 启示类；复用 R39.5，本条补"生平型文本"的启示取材（嘲笑／积累／坚持三点）。
10 自检：①道理是什么？②我会怎么做？③我改写了吗？

**组小结（G48 · 小蓝书预测卷二十四 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：转折点（强调句）1（21）；词义（intrigued）1（22）；影响落点 1（23）；special 取记录 1（24）；启示＋改写 1（25）。
- 规则：R48.1 强调句焦点即转折点（21）；R48.2 情感分词按四步取"着迷"（22）；R48.3 影响取 decided 结果（23）；R48.4 special 取最高级记录（24）；R48.5 启示＝道理＋自用（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R48.1 与"导师段落最像转折"冲突，强调句优先；R48.2 与"intrigue＝阴谋"冲突，后文行为优先；R48.3 与"读书过程具体"冲突，决定句优先；R48.4 与"冻伤北极熊更惊险"冲突，最高级优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：人物生平型文本再添一例（与 G42 Steiner 同型、取材不同）；词义题仍按 RA-2 四步；差值与图表仍无。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷二十四 · Passage 3

One year before, at age 18, Leszyeski had aged out of foster care (寄养中心), having been in the system since she was four when her single mother was no longer able to care for her. Leszyeski was now enrolled in college, hoping to become a doctor.

Then she learned about an organization Chairity. The organization provides furniture and household goods for young adults who have left foster care. Leszyeski reached out to Chairity, a nonprofit (非营利性的)formed by 23-year-old Maria Paparella.

Paparella first became aware of foster care when her parents were considering adopting a child. The plan didn't work out, but Paparella often found herself thinking about that child. "I'm really close with my family, and I just couldn't imagine being completely on my own at 18," she says.

At 16, Paparella visited Summit County Children Services, with a list of questions, trying to understand what aging out looked like. One of her questions was "What's not being met for these young people?" Near the top of the list was furniture. "That struck home," says Paparella. The idea of "moving into an apartment without a bed to sleep on or a so fa to sit on" pulled at her heartstrings.

Paparella contacted her parents' friends, asking if they had spare furniture to donate. A local furniture store offered free ware-house space and its delivery truck. Watching the recipients' (接受者) faces when they received a bed or a couch was amazing.

Today, Chairity has given furniture to nearly 200 young adults in homes across six Ohio counties. Paparella is sure these contributions give the recipients hope and confidence. Leszyeski agrees. "It makes me feel like I'm not different from other people. My whole life, I've felt abnormal," she says, "Now, I feel normal."

26. When did Leszyeski enter the foster care system?

______

27. What does Leszyeski hope to be in the future?

______

28. What does Chairity provide for young people?

______



29. What did Paparella try to understand when she visited Summit County Services at 16?

______

30. What does Leszyeski think of Chairity?

______

**〔G49〕小蓝书预测卷二十四 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：She entered the foster care system at the age of four, when her single mother was no longer able to care for her.**
1 题面：When did Leszyeski enter the foster care system；原文 "One year before, at age 18, Leszyeski had aged out of foster care (寄养中心), having been in the system since she was four when her single mother was no longer able to care for her."；疑问词 When（问进入时间）；诱导信号：句首 at age 18 与 aged out 更醒目，数字也更大。
2 候选：①at four（since she was four）；②at 18（aged out）；③one year before（时间参照）；④as a baby。
3 验算：①→having been in the system since she was four，since 后即进入时间→成立。②→at age 18＋aged out 是"超龄退出"的时间，方向相反→不成立。③→One year before 是"她 18 岁那年"的叙述参照，不是进入时间→排除。④→原文无 baby→排除。
4 干扰：at age 18 在句首、与 aged out 连用，读快了会当成"进入"；aged out of foster care 这个短语若不认识，两个时间就分不清。
5 意图：考"进入／退出两个时间点按动词定向"，since 与 aged out 是方向标记。
6 边界：若问 When did she age out of foster care? 答 At 18（one year before the story）。若问 Why was she in foster care? 答 Because her single mother was no longer able to care for her。
7 错误：A 答 At 18.（错因：退出时间当进入）；B 答 One year before.（错因：叙述参照当时间点）；C 答 When she went to college.（错因：串后文）。
8 规则：R49.1 若问 When did sb enter a system，then 取 since／from＋时间（since she was four）；at age 18＋aged out 是退出时间，方向相反；One year before 这类叙述参照不作时间点。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（进入 vs 退出）；复用 R4.1（时段隔离），本条标记是 since／aged out。
10 自检：①since 后是几岁？②aged out 是进还是出？③One year before 指什么？

**27. 答案：She hopes to become a doctor.**
1 题面：What does Leszyeski hope to be in the future；原文 "Leszyeski was now enrolled in college, hoping to become a doctor."；疑问词 What does sb hope to be（问将来职业）；诱导信号：enrolled in college 是当下状态，且与"hope"同句。
2 候选：①a doctor；②a college student；③a social worker；④a nurse。
3 验算：①→hoping to become a doctor，hope 后直接给职业→成立。②→enrolled in college 是现状（已是大学生），不是"将来希望成为"→不成立。③→原文未提 social worker（Paparella 才是办机构的人）→排除。④→nurse 原文无→排除。
4 干扰：college 与 doctor 同句，学生易把"大学生"当成答案；Paparella 的公益身份也可能被安到她身上。
5 意图：考"hope to become 后的名词＝将来职业，现状动词不作答案"。
6 边界：若问 What is Leszyeski doing now? 答 She is enrolled in college。若问 Who founded Chairity? 答 Maria Paparella。
7 错误：A 答 A college student.（错因：现状当将来）；B 答 A social worker.（错因：人物错位）；C 答 A teacher.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R49.2 若问 What does sb hope／want to be，then 取 hoping／wanting to become 后的名词（a doctor）；be enrolled in／be studying 是现状，不答"将来希望成为"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.37 职业（hope to become）；复用 R23.5（to 后填原形短语）、R25.4（职业取表语）。
10 自检：①hope 后是什么？②college 是现状还是将来？③Paparella 是谁？

**28. 答案：It provides furniture and household goods for young adults who have left foster care.**
1 题面：What does Chairity provide for young people；原文 "The organization provides furniture and household goods for young adults who have left foster care."；疑问词 What does X provide（问提供物）；诱导信号：末段 hope and confidence 是"效果"，分量很重。
2 候选：①furniture and household goods；②money and clothes；③college education；④jobs and training。
3 验算：①→provides furniture and household goods for young adults who have left foster care，宾语＋对象齐全→成立。②→原文无 money／clothes→排除。③→college 是 Leszyeski 自己的事→排除。④→原文无 job training→排除。
4 干扰：末段 give the recipients hope and confidence 与 provide 同义场，容易被当成"提供物"；具体物件（bed／couch／warehouse／truck）也在文中出现。
5 意图：考"provide 取并列宾语（物质）＋对象"，效果句不作提供物。
6 边界：若问 What did a local furniture store offer? 答 Free warehouse space and its delivery truck。若问 How many young adults has Chairity helped? 答 Nearly 200, in six Ohio counties。
7 错误：A 答 Hope and confidence.（错因：效果当提供物）；B 答 Beds and sofas only.（错因：以例代类，漏 household goods）；C 答 Money.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R49.3 若问 What does an organization provide，then 取 provides 后的并列宾语（furniture and household goods）＋对象从句（young adults who have left foster care）；hope／confidence 与具体例子（bed／couch）是效果与例证，不作提供物。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.15 并列宾语全取；复用 R22.2（include 取全），本条标记是 provide。
10 自检：①provides 后有几项？②hope 属效果还是提供物？③对象是谁？

**29. 答案：She tried to understand what "aging out" looked like — what was not being met for these young people (furniture was near the top of the list).**
1 题面：What did Paparella try to understand when she visited Summit County Services at 16；原文 "At 16, Paparella visited Summit County Children Services, with a list of questions, trying to understand what aging out looked like. One of her questions was 'What's not being met for these young people?'"；疑问词 What did sb try to understand（问理解对象）；诱导信号：题干把机构名简写成 Summit County Services（原文多一个 Children），且她带的是"一列问题"。
2 候选：①what aging out looked like（＋what was not being met）；②how to adopt a child；③how to start a nonprofit；④how much furniture cost。
3 验算：①→trying to understand what aging out looked like，宾语从句直接给出；后一句 her question 是同一目标的具体化→成立。②→adopting 是父母当年的考虑，不是她的调查目标→排除。③→founding 是后来的结果→排除。④→家具价格原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：机构名与题干不完全一致（Children Services），容易让人怀疑"是不是另一个地方"；"一列问题"也可能被当成答案本身。
5 意图：考"try to understand 的宾语从句＋同段自问句的具体化"。
6 边界：若问 What was near the top of her list? 答 Furniture。若问 What did she do with her parents' friends? 答 She asked if they had spare furniture to donate。
7 错误：A 答 How children are adopted.（错因：父母的事）；B 答 What furniture she needed.（错因：答成她自己）；C 答 How to set up Chairity.（错因：结果当目标）。
8 规则：R49.4 若问 What did sb try to understand，then 取 trying to understand 后的宾语从句（what aging out looked like），并用同段她自己的问句（What's not being met…）补足；机构名的小差异不改题意，收养／办机构等背景不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容主题（understand 的宾语从句）；复用 R24.1（because 框架取完整宾语），本条标记是 try to understand。
10 自检：①understand 后是什么？②她的问句是什么？③我答成"收养"了吗？

**30. 答案：She thinks it makes her feel normal — not different from other people. It gives her hope and confidence.**
1 题面：What does Leszyeski think of Chairity；原文 "Paparella is sure these contributions give the recipients hope and confidence. Leszyeski agrees. 'It makes me feel like I'm not different from other people. My whole life, I've felt abnormal,' she says, 'Now, I feel normal.'"；疑问词 What does sb think of（问评价）；诱导信号：紧邻前句是 Paparella 的判断（hope and confidence），不是 Leszyeski 的话。
2 候选：①makes her feel normal（not different）＋hope and confidence；②it is too small；③it only gives beds；④she doesn't care about it。
3 验算：①→Leszyeski agrees（同意前句 hope and confidence）＋两条直接引语（not different／Now I feel normal）→成立（同意句＋引语都要）。②→原文无规模评价→排除。③→only gives beds 与她收到的"床或沙发"具体例子不符，且丢了 household goods→排除。④→agrees 明确表态，不关心与之矛盾→排除。
4 干扰：Paparella 的判断在前，读者容易把它当成 Leszyeski 的看法；abnormal／normal 两词对立，也容易只取一半。
5 意图：考"评价题取该人引语，前句靠 agrees 回指并入"。
6 边界：若问 What does Paparella think her contributions give? 答 Hope and confidence。若问 How did Leszyeski feel before? 答 She felt abnormal／different from other people。
7 错误：A 答 It gives her furniture.（错因：事实当评价）；B 答 Paparella thinks it gives hope.（错因：主体错位）；C 答 She feels abnormal now.（错因：引语取反）。
8 规则：R49.5 若问 What does sb think of an organization，then 取该人直接引语（not different from other people／Now I feel normal），并用 agrees 把前一句他人判断（hope and confidence）并入；provide 的事实（bed／couch）不作评价。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.14 他人评论（agrees 回指）；复用 R37.3（that 回指），本条标记是 agrees。
10 自检：①引语在哪？②agrees 指哪句？③我把 Paparella 的话当成她的了吗？

**组小结（G49 · 小蓝书预测卷二十四 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：进入时间（since）1（26）；将来职业 1（27）；提供物 1（28）；调查目标 1（29）；受益者评价 1（30）。
- 规则：R49.1 进入取 since、退出取 aged out（26）；R49.2 hope to become 取职业（27）；R49.3 provide 取并列宾语（28）；R49.4 understand 取宾语从句（29）；R49.5 评价取引语＋agrees（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R49.1 与"at 18 更醒目"冲突，动词方向优先；R49.2 与"college 同句"冲突，hope 后优先；R49.3 与"hope and confidence 同义场"冲突，provide 宾语优先；R49.4 与"机构名小差异"冲突，题意优先；R49.5 与"紧邻他人判断"冲突，引语主体优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：公益／机构类文本首见，五题全部落在既有子类（RA-1.1／1.37／1.15／1.5、RA-3.14）；差值与图表仍无。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷二十四 · Passage 4

When Simon Cane was in the second grade, he began learning about all the ways humans have an impact on the environment and really took those classroom lessons to heart. "He told me we drove too much and made too much pollution," his dad, Jonathan Cane, told *Runner's World*. So Simon convinced his parents to start hanging their clothes to dry, taking the stairs instead of elevators, and other "green" measures.

"For much of kindergarten and the first grade I rode my bike to Simon's school with him on the back," Jonathan said. As Simon got bigger, though, it wasn't practical for him to ride on his father's back, but it also didn't make sense to ride together — both because of safety concerns and because there was no place to put away Simon's bike. So, most of the time they drove the 1.5 miles to school.

But in 2019, when Simon was going into the third grade, the 8-year-old came up with a new way to help the planet: running the 1.5 miles to P. S. 81. And Jonathan promised his son he'd join him for as long as he wanted.

"We did a test run one day in August, and decided to give it a go. To be honest, *I thought he'd blink* after it got really cold or rainy, but he never did," Jonathan said. He recalled one day when the weather was particularly bad. "It's really raining out there today," he told Simon. "And Simon said, 'Well then we're going to get wet!' He took pride in toughing it out, and it became a really fun family routine."

Since the start, Simon has run with his dad and their black dog, and has even inspired his mom, Nicole Sin Quee, to join in. They soon became known as "the family that runs to school".

31. What made Simon different from his classmates?

______

32. Why did Simon usually go to school by car in the second grade?

______



33. How do you understand the underlined part in the fourth paragraph?

______

34. How did Simon inspire his mom?

______

35. What are your "green" measures? Please explain. (no more than 20 words)

______

**〔G50〕小蓝书预测卷二十四 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：He really took the environmental lessons to heart and acted on them — he told his parents they drove too much and made too much pollution, and convinced them to take "green" measures such as hanging clothes to dry and taking the stairs instead of elevators.**
1 题面：What made Simon different from his classmates；原文 "When Simon Cane was in the second grade, he began learning about all the ways humans have an impact on the environment and really took those classroom lessons to heart. 'He told me we drove too much and made too much pollution,' his dad, Jonathan Cane, told Runner's World. So Simon convinced his parents to start hanging their clothes to dry, taking the stairs instead of elevators, and other 'green' measures."；疑问词 What made sb different（问他做了什么不一样的事）；诱导信号：后文 running the 1.5 miles to school 画面最强，且是全文重点。
2 候选：①把课堂内容当真并付诸行动（说服父母采取绿色措施）；②他每天跑 1.5 英里上学；③他有一辆山地自行车；④他体育很好。
3 验算：①→really took those classroom lessons to heart＋He told me…＋convinced his parents…green measures，行为链完整，且发生在"二年级"这一题干时点→成立。②→running 出现在 2019 年（三年级）之后，晚于题干时点，也不是与同学比较的点→次优（可作后文发展，不答本题）。③→山地自行车是另一篇（Ben Saunders）的内容，跨篇污染→排除。④→原文未提体育→排除。
4 干扰：跑步上学的画面贯穿后半篇，容易抢答；如果同时读过多篇，"山地自行车"这类细节会串篇。
5 意图：考"different 取'他做了什么'的行为链，并按题干时点截断"，同时防跨篇取材。
6 边界：若问 What did Simon ask his parents to do? 答 To hang clothes to dry, take the stairs instead of elevators and take other green measures。若问 When did Simon begin running to school? 答 In 2019, when he was going into the third grade。
7 错误：A 答 He ran 1.5 miles to school.（错因：后文发展当面答、时点错）；B 答 He had a mountain bike.（错因：跨篇串题）；C 答 He was good at sports.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R50.1 若问 What made sb different／special，then 取"他把所学当真并付诸行动"的行为链（took…to heart→told parents→convinced them of green measures），并按题干时点截断（二年级）；后文才出现的做法（running）与别篇细节（mountain bike）都不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.43 举证取全（behaviour chain）；复用 R34.2（special 取全部举证），本条加"时点截断＋防跨篇"。
10 自检：①题干锁在哪一年？②行为链有几环？③山地自行车是哪篇的？

**32. 答案：Because he had grown too big to ride on his father's back, and riding together didn't make sense — both because of safety concerns and because there was no place to put away his bike.**
1 题面：Why did Simon usually go to school by car in the second grade；原文 "As Simon got bigger, though, it wasn't practical for him to ride on his father's back, but it also didn't make sense to ride together — both because of safety concerns and because there was no place to put away Simon's bike. So, most of the time they drove the 1.5 miles to school."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：1.5 miles 这个距离反复出现，像"因为路远"。
2 候选：①太大不能坐在父亲背上＋同行不安全＋无处放车；②因为学校有 1.5 英里远；③因为父亲工作忙；④因为天天下雨。
3 验算：①→it wasn't practical…＋didn't make sense…both because of safety…and because there was no place，两个 because 并列，So 引出结果→成立（两条都要）。②→1.5 miles 是距离事实，跑步上学同样是 1.5 英里，说明距离不是"必须开车"的原因→不成立。③→原文无→排除。④→雨天只是后文的一次测试情形→排除。
4 干扰：1.5 miles 出现两次（开车／跑步），最容易被当原因；"both because…and because…"两个并列原因较长，常只抄一条。
5 意图：考"So 前并列原因取全"，以及"同一距离不能解释两种相反做法"。
6 边界：若问 How far is the school from their home? 答 1.5 miles。若问 What did they decide in August? 答 They did a test run and decided to give it a go。
7 错误：A 答 Because the school was 1.5 miles away.（错因：距离当原因，同一距离也用于跑步）；B 答 Because his father was too busy.（错因：无据）；C 答 Because it rained every day.（错因：以一次天气代全年）。
8 规则：R50.2 若问 Why did sb usually do X，then 取 So 前的并列原因（not practical…＋didn't make sense…because of safety…and because no place to park the bike），两条并列都要；距离／天气等背景数字不自动成为原因（同一距离下存在相反做法即可反证）。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（并列 because 取全）；复用 R36.2（并列原因取全），本条加"背景数字反证法"。
10 自检：①So 前有几个原因？②1.5 英里是原因吗？③我漏了哪一条？

**33. 答案：It means the father thought Simon would give up (back down) when it turned really cold or rainy — but he never did.**
1 题面：How do you understand the underlined part in the fourth paragraph；划线部分 "I thought he'd blink"，原文 "We did a test run one day in August, and decided to give it a go. To be honest, *I thought he'd blink* after it got really cold or rainy, but he never did," Jonathan said.；原卷该处有下划线，转写以斜体保留；疑问词 How do you understand（释义题）；诱导信号：blink 的字面义"眨眼"。
2 候选：①以为他会退缩／放弃；②以为他会眨眼；③以为他会哭；④以为他会迟到。
3 验算：①→but he never did＋He took pride in toughing it out，反向证明"以为他会退缩"→成立。②→字面"眨眼"与天气条件、与 toughing it out 都接不上→不成立。③→原文无哭→排除。④→原文无迟到→排除。
4 干扰：blink 的本义太具体；but he never did 的 did 指代需要还原（did＝blink），不还原则读不出"始终没退缩"。
5 意图：考"喻义动词由 but 后的反证＋toughing it out 定值"。
6 边界：若问 What did Simon say on the rainy day? 答 "Well then we're going to get wet!"。若问 What did the family become known as? 答 "The family that runs to school"。
7 错误：A 答 He thought Simon would blink his eyes.（错因：字面义）；B 答 He thought Simon would cry.（错因：无据）；C 答 He thought Simon would stop running forever.（错因：过度延伸，原文只指那次天气）。
8 规则：R50.3 若问划线部分含义且含喻义动词（blink），then 用 but＋never did 的反证与 took pride in toughing it out 定值为"退缩／放弃"，并限定在"天冷或下雨时"；不译字面"眨眼"，也不扩大为"永远不跑"。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.3 划线句释义（喻义动词）；复用 R35.3（后文行为定褒贬），本条的反证件是 but…never did。
10 自检：①but 后是什么？②did 指代什么？③我把范围扩大了吗？

**34. 答案：He inspired her to join in the running to school — she became one of "the family that runs to school".**
1 题面：How did Simon inspire his mom；原文 "Since the start, Simon has run with his dad and their black dog, and has even inspired his mom, Nicole Sin Quee, to join in."；疑问词 How did sb inspire another（问被启发后做了什么）；诱导信号：第一段"说服父母晾衣服、走楼梯"也是 Simon 带动父母，容易被当答案。
2 候选：①她加入跑步上学；②她买了一辆自行车；③她开始晾衣服、走楼梯；④她成了马拉松选手。
3 验算：①→inspired his mom, Nicole Sin Quee, to join in（join in＝the running to school），下一句 They soon became known as "the family that runs to school"→成立。②→原文无→排除。③→green measures 在第一段，是"说服"而非"因跑步受启发"，且题干问 inspire→次优（对象与事件都不同）。④→原文无马拉松→排除。
4 干扰：晾衣／走楼梯同样是"Simon 影响父母"，但那是第一段的 convinced，不是本句 inspired；两个动词分工要分清。
5 意图：考"inspire sb to do 的不定式补足＋上下文活动还原"。
6 边界：若问 What did Simon convince his parents to do? 答 To hang their clothes to dry and take the stairs instead of elevators。若问 Who else runs with Simon? 答 His dad and their black dog。
7 错误：A 答 She began to hang clothes to dry.（错因：convinced 与 inspired 混）；B 答 She bought a bike.（错因：无据）；C 答 She ran a marathon.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R50.4 若问 How did sb inspire another，then 取 inspired sb to do 的不定式补足（to join in），再用下一句的活动名（the family that runs to school）还原具体行为；同段其他"说服"类影响（convinced…green measures）不混入。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.6 结果（inspire 的补足）；复用 R5.4（promise to do）、R14.4（例证证明前句），本条标记是 inspire sb to do。
10 自检：①inspired 后是什么？②join in 指什么活动？③convinced 与 inspired 混了吗？

**35. 答案：（开放题，≤20 词）I take the stairs instead of the elevator, cycle to school and never leave the lights on.（17 words）**
1 题面：What are your "green" measures? Please explain. (no more than 20 words)——开放题＋**词数上限 20 词**；原文可借鉴的绿色措施：hanging clothes to dry／taking the stairs instead of elevators／running instead of driving；疑问词 What are your measures（要具体做法）。
2 候选：①走楼梯／骑车／随手关灯（3 条，17 词）；②抄原文整句（Hanging their clothes to dry, taking the stairs instead of elevators…）；③只写 I am a green person.；④写"多种树"等与日常无关的口号。
3 验算：①→三条具体做法，均属日常绿色行为，17 词＜20→成立（可含一条自己的：关灯）。②→抄原文长句易超词，且是"他们的"措施→不成立。③→只表态，无措施→排除。④→空泛口号，不是"我的措施"→次优。
4 干扰：题干两个约束（具体＋≤20 词），学生常写足三条却加解释而超词；"green"也可能被理解成"绿色植物"。
5 意图：考"限词＋具体做法"，与 R42.5／R46.5 同一硬约束。
6 边界：若无词数限制，可写三条并各加一句理由。若问 What green measures did Simon's family take? 答 They hang clothes to dry, take the stairs and run to school。
7 错误：A 只写 I am green.（错因：无措施）；B 抄整段原文（错因：超词且非"我的"）；C 写 I plant trees every day.（错因：与日常出行无关、且不可信）。
8 规则：R50.5 若问 What are your "green" measures 且限词，then 给 2—3 条具体可执行的日常做法（走楼梯／骑车／关灯／晾衣），全句≤20 词；抄原文长句与只写 I am green 都不合格；先数词再定稿。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.8 限词版评价／列举；复用 R42.5、R46.5，本条把"评价／预测"换成"列举"。
10 自检：①有几条具体做法？②几词？③我抄原文了吗？

**组小结（G50 · 小蓝书预测卷二十四 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：different（行为链＋时点）1（31）；原因（并列取全）1（32）；划线喻义（blink）1（33）；inspire 补足 1（34）；限词列举 1（35）。
- 规则：R50.1 行为链＋时点截断＋防跨篇（31）；R50.2 并列原因＋背景数字反证（32）；R50.3 blink＝退缩（33）；R50.4 inspire 取 to do 补足（34）；R50.5 限词列举（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R50.1 与"跑步画面最强"冲突，题干时点优先；R50.2 与"1.5 英里反复出现"冲突，并列 because 优先；R50.3 与"blink 字面"冲突，but 反证优先；R50.4 与"第一段 convinced"冲突，inspire 动词优先；R50.5 与"解释写全"冲突，词数上限优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：限词题第 4 例（R42.5／R46.5／R50.5），已可归纳为 RA-6.8 一条通用约束；**小蓝书卷二十四 4 篇至此完成（G47—G50）**；差值与图表仍无。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷五 · Passage 1

What do you think is the most common illness? Do you get ill sometimes? We are lucky to live now, because there are lots of medicines to make people better.

The most common illness in the world is the cold. It often begins with a sore throat. Then you sneeze and your nose runs. You usually have a headache too. Often you cough later. It's not a very bad illness, but you can feel quite ill.

There isn't a cure (治愈方法) for a cold, but you can take medicines to make you feel



better. For instance, aspirin (阿斯匹林) can stop your headache. It is good to rest, and to drink a lot of water too. A doctor once said to me, "With the proper medicine, a cold will continue for seven days. With no medicine, it will continue for two weeks or longer!"

Where does our medicine come from? A long time ago, people in ancient times knew that some plants made them feel better. <u>They</u> ate the leaves, the roots, the fruit, or the seeds of plants. For instance, the juice of lemons will make a sore throat feel better.

In modern times, scientists have looked at these plants, and found out which chemicals(化学物质 ) are in them. Many of our medicines today are made from those chemicals.

There are some illnesses which we can't cure yet. And nobody has found a cure for old age. But because of modern medicines, people now live longer than their grandparents.

16. What's the most common illness in the world?

The most common illness in the world is __________.

17. According to the passage, what medicine can stop the headache?

__________ can stop the headache.

18. What does the underlined word "They" refer to(指代)?

It refers to "__________".

19. Where do many modern medicines come from?

Many of them come from __________ in the plants.

20. Why do people now live longer than their grandparents?

Because there are __________ when they are ill.

**〔G51〕小蓝书预测卷五 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

> 本组为**补全式简答**（题干已给框架，空位为横线），五题全部按 RA-5 处理：先锁空位词性，再与原文配对。

**16. 答案：the cold（The most common illness in the world is the cold.）**
1 题面：What's the most common illness in the world?；题干框架 "The most common illness in the world is __________."；空位在系动词 is 之后，只能是名词性成分（表语）；原文 "The most common illness in the world is the cold."；诱导信号：问题词 What's 让人想答形容词（common／bad）。
2 候选：①the cold（名词短语，原文表语）；②a cold（冠词不同）；③cold（裸形容词／不可数用法）；④ill（形容词）。
3 验算：①→the cold 代入后与原文完全一致，且 the 特指"那种病"→成立。②→a cold 语法可通，但原文用 the，且此处指"感冒这一疾病"这一类别→次优（改冠词属改写原文）。③→cold 作名词表示"感冒"时通常需冠词；裸用在此不成立→排除。④→ill 是形容词，不能作 is 的表语名词→排除。
4 干扰：题干问 What 且首句 three 个疑问句连用，学生容易用形容词回答"common"；框架里已有 the most common illness，重复抄题干也会踩"框架已有成分不重复"。
5 意图：考"补全式先锁空位词性（系动词后→名词表语）"，再取原文表语。
6 边界：若问题是 What is the most common illness? 答 The cold（可整句）。若问 What are the symptoms of a cold? 答 A sore throat, sneezing, a running nose, a headache and a cough。
7 错误：A 填 common.（错因：形容词占名词位）；B 填 a cold.（错因：改原文冠词）；C 填 the illness.（错因：上位词替换具体名词）。
8 规则：R51.1 若补全式的空位在系动词 is 后（表语位），then 填原文的名词短语（the cold），保留原文冠词 the；形容词与上位词（illness）都不占名词位；题干已给的 the most common illness 不重复。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（系动词位）；复用 R7.1（系动词位填形容词／此处为名词表语的反向情形）与 R12.1（框架不重复）。
10 自检：①空位在什么词后？②原文表语是什么？③冠词抄对了吗？

**17. 答案：Aspirin（Aspirin can stop the headache.）**
1 题面：According to the passage, what medicine can stop the headache?；框架 "__________ can stop the headache."；空位在句首作主语，须为名词（药名）；原文 "For instance, aspirin (阿斯匹林) can stop your headache."；诱导信号：aspirin 后有括号中文注释，学生可能只写中文。
2 候选：①Aspirin（药名，专有名词）；②the medicine（上位词）；③headache（题干已含）；④阿司匹林（中文）。
3 验算：①→Aspirin can stop the headache，与原文 aspirin can stop your headache 对应（your→the 随题干框架调整）→成立。②→the medicine 太泛，原文给的是具体药名→次优。③→headache 是宾语，不是主语→排除。④→题干要求英语作答，中文注释只是提示→不成立（除非题干允许中文）。
4 干扰：括号里的"阿斯匹林"最省事；原文还有 proper medicine／no medicine 的对比，也像"药"的答案。
5 意图：考"空位在句首→主语位→取具体药名"，以及"括号中文不作答案"。
6 边界：若问 What can aspirin do? 答 It can stop your headache。若问 What will happen to a cold with proper medicine? 答 It will continue for seven days。
7 错误：A 填 The medicine.（错因：上位词）；B 填 Headache.（错因：宾语当主语）；C 填 阿斯匹林.（错因：用中文注释作答）。
8 规则：R51.2 若补全式空位在句首作主语，then 取原文该谓语（can stop the headache）的主语名词（Aspirin）；括号内的中文只作提示，不用中文作答；上位词（the medicine）不作具体药名。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（主语位）；复用 R16.1（Who 取主语），本条是"药名作主语"。
10 自检：①空位是主语吗？②原文主语是谁？③我用中文了吗？

**18. 答案：people in ancient times（It refers to "people in ancient times".）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "They" refer to(指代)?；框架 "It refers to "__________"."；原文 "A long time ago, people in ancient times knew that some plants made them feel better. <u>They</u> ate the leaves, the roots, the fruit, or the seeds of plants."；原卷该词有下划线（转写以 <u> 保留）；诱导信号：同句后半出现 plants，且 They 后紧接 the leaves…of plants。
2 候选：①people in ancient times；②plants；③the leaves, roots, fruit or seeds；④scientists（下一段）。
3 验算：①→They ate the leaves…of plants，吃植物的是人；上一句主语正是 people in ancient times→成立。②→plants 是 ate 的宾语所有格（of plants），不能自己吃自己→排除。③→leaves／roots／fruit／seeds 是被吃的对象→排除。④→scientists 是下一段"现代"的主语，与 A long time ago 冲突→排除。
4 干扰：plants 在同一句反复出现（plants made them feel better／seeds of plants），最近名词原则会指向它；复数 They 与 plants 数一致，更具迷惑性。
5 意图：考"代词回指按动作施受关系定，不按最近名词"。
6 边界：若问 What did ancient people eat? 答 The leaves, roots, fruit or seeds of plants。若问 What did ancient people know? 答 That some plants made them feel better。
7 错误：A 填 plants.（错因：最近名词＋数一致）；B 填 the leaves and roots.（错因：宾语当主语）；C 填 scientists.（错因：串段）。
8 规则：R51.3 若问代词 They 指代且后接动作动词，then 按"谁发出该动作"定回指（people in ancient times），不取最近的复数名词（plants，它是动作对象）；跨段主语（scientists）不参与。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.1 代词回指（施受关系优先）；复用 R12.4（复数回指），本条加"最近名词陷阱"的反例。
10 自检：①They 做什么动作？②谁吃植物？③plants 是主语还是宾语？

**19. 答案：the chemicals（Many of them come from the chemicals in the plants.）**
1 题面：Where do many modern medicines come from?；框架 "Many of them come from __________ in the plants."；空位在介词 from 后、后置定语 in the plants 之前，须为名词；原文 "In modern times, scientists have looked at these plants, and found out which chemicals(化学物质) are in them. Many of our medicines today are made from those chemicals."；诱导信号：plants 一词既在题干框架里（in the plants），又是原文的宾语。
2 候选：①the chemicals（those chemicals）；②plants；③scientists；④medicines（题干已含）。
3 验算：①→are made from those chemicals＝come from the chemicals；框架后的 in the plants 正好限定"植物里的化学物质"→成立。②→plants 已被 in the plants 占用，再填 plants 成"来自植物里的植物"→不成立。③→scientists 是发现者，不是来源→排除。④→medicines come from medicines 循环→排除。
4 干扰：括号里的"化学物质"提供中文提示；plants 在原文与框架中各出现一次，最容易被重复填入。
5 意图：考"空位后有后置定语时，不能填被定语修饰的那个名词"。
6 边界：若问 Who found out the chemicals in plants? 答 Scientists。若问 What are many of our medicines made from? 答 Those chemicals（in the plants）。
7 错误：A 填 plants.（错因：与 in the plants 重复）；B 填 scientists.（错因：施动者当来源）；C 填 medicines.（错因：循环）。
8 规则：R51.4 若空位后紧跟 in／of＋名词作后置定语，then 该名词已被框架占用，空位应填被它限定的中心名词（the chemicals）；施动者（scientists）与循环项（medicines）都不作来源。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.6 介词后成分＋后置定语（此处为介词宾语位）；复用 R12.2（并列项按框架裁剪），本条是"后置定语占位"。
10 自检：①from 后要名词吗？②in the plants 修饰谁？③我重复填 plants 了吗？

**20. 答案：（modern）medicines（Because there are modern medicines when they are ill.）**
1 题面：Why do people now live longer than their grandparents?；框架 "Because there are __________ when they are ill."；空位在 there are 后作主语，须为复数名词；原文 "But because of modern medicines, people now live longer than their grandparents."；诱导信号：there are 后容易顺手填 doctors／hospitals 这类"医疗条件"。
2 候选：①（modern）medicines；②doctors；③hospitals；④cures（末段说 some illnesses we can't cure yet）。
3 验算：①→because of modern medicines＝because there are modern medicines，介词短语与 there be 框架对应，且用复数与 are 一致→成立。②→doctors 原文未提（文中只有 a doctor once said），且不是"更长寿"的原因→排除。③→hospitals 原文未提→排除。④→末段明确 there are some illnesses which we can't cure yet，与"更长寿的原因"相反→不成立。
4 干扰：there are 的框架天然吸引"人／机构"（doctors／hospitals）；cures 与"治病"语义近，但原文对 cure 是保留态度。
5 意图：考"there be 框架把介词短语原因转写为主语"，以及"不引入原文没有的医疗条件"。
6 边界：若问 What can't we cure yet? 答 Some illnesses, and nobody has found a cure for old age。若问 Why did people in ancient times eat plant parts? 答 Because some plants made them feel better。
7 错误：A 填 doctors.（错因：常识补入）；B 填 hospitals.（错因：无据）；C 填 cures.（错因：与末段否定冲突）。
8 规则：R51.5 若补全式为 Because there are __________ when they are ill，then 把原文 because of＋名词（modern medicines）转写成 there be 的主语（复数 medicines）；不得补入原文没有的 doctors／hospitals，也不取被原文否定的 cures。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.2 数量／存在句（there be 主语位）；复用 R14.1（because of 取宾语），本条把宾语转成 there be 主语。
10 自检：①there are 后要复数吗？②原文 because of 后是什么？③我加了原文没有的词吗？

**组小结（G51 · 小蓝书预测卷五 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：表语位 1（16）；主语位（药名）1（17）；代词回指 1（18）；介词宾语＋后置定语 1（19）；there be 主语位 1（20）。**五题全为补全式简答（RA-5）**。
- 规则：R51.1 表语位取 the cold（16）；R51.2 主语位取 Aspirin、中文不作答（17）；R51.3 They＝people in ancient times（18）；R51.4 后置定语占位→the chemicals（19）；R51.5 because of 转 there be→medicines（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R51.1 与"What 问形容词"冲突，名词位优先；R51.2 与"括号中文最省事"冲突，英语原文优先；R51.3 与"最近名词 plants"冲突，施受关系优先；R51.4 与"重复填 plants"冲突，后置定语占位优先；R51.5 与"常识补 doctors"冲突，原文名词优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：本组把 RA-5.1 的"空位词性锁定"在五种句法位上走了一遍（表语／主语／介词宾语／there be 主语），可作 04 建模的 RA-5 样本组；文中数字仅 seven days／two weeks 作引语照录，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷五 · Passage 2

When you want to buy a new T-shirt, will you pick Adidas or Li-Ning? Many people have been through (经历) these moments. These are those moments when you need to choose between local and foreign brands. But things seem clearer in these days. In fact, Chinese brands are now winning the hearts of people in China and abroad.

*Time* magazine shows a list of the 100 greatest companies in the world. Some Chinese companies are on the list, such as Huawei, DJI and TikTok.

For a long time, "made in China" made people think of ugly (丑的) or poor things. Now, more and more people think things of Chinese brand are fashionable (时尚的), well-made and cheap. China products are a symbol of good quality, good creativity, and good art. Here



are some examples.

**Technology**

Huawei is the world's second biggest mobile phone company. Its mobile phones are used in more than 170 countries. Huawei is also a leader in 5G technology.

DJI is the world's leading manufacturer of drones (无人机制造商). It produces all kinds of drones and has more than 70% of the world's drone market.

**Entertainment**

Do you know what the most popular App in America is? It's TikTok. It's said that about 50 million US users spend 45 minutes on it every day. People know it because it is fun and its videos seem to be endless. But it's not just a time-killer. People can buy things on it, too.

The Chinese brands will develop in a quick way. The best time for the local brands is coming.

21. What do more and more people think of things of Chinese brand now?

They think things of Chinese brand are __________, and cheap.

22. How many countries are using Huawei mobile phones?

Huawei mobile phones are used in __________ countries.

23. What does DJI produce?

It produces all kinds of __________.

24. Why do people in America know TikTok?

Because it is fun and its videos seem to be __________.

25. How will Chinese brands develop?

The Chinese brands will develop __________.

**〔G52〕小蓝书预测卷五 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

> 本组同为**补全式简答**。与 G51 的区别：空位全部落在"中国品牌"这篇说明文的并列项与修饰语上，考"框架已有成分不重复"与"数量、方式状语照抄"。

**21. 答案：fashionable and well-made（They think things of Chinese brand are fashionable and well-made, and cheap.）**
1 题面：What do more and more people think of things of Chinese brand now?；框架 "They think things of Chinese brand are __________, and cheap."；空位在 are 后（表语），且后面已有 "and cheap"；原文 "Now, more and more people think things of Chinese brand are fashionable (时尚的), well-made and cheap."；诱导信号：三个并列形容词，框架已给出最后一个 cheap。
2 候选：①fashionable and well-made；②fashionable, well-made and cheap（含框架已有项）；③good quality（原文另一句的概括）；④ugly（旧印象）。
3 验算：①→与原文并列顺序一致，且框架后面的 ", and cheap" 已占位→成立。②→重复 cheap，违反"框架已有成分不重复"→次优（语义不错，形式冗余）。③→good quality 出自 China products are a symbol of good quality，是后一句的概括，不是本句表语→次优。④→ugly 是"For a long time"的旧印象，与 now 相反→排除。
4 干扰：三个形容词一起抄最省事；ugly 与 fashionable 形成时间对比，容易被误取为"现在"的看法。
5 意图：考"补全式并列项按框架裁剪"，即框架已给的项不再重复。
6 边界：若问 What did "made in China" make people think of for a long time? 答 Ugly or poor things。若问 What are China products a symbol of? 答 Good quality, good creativity and good art。
7 错误：A 填 fashionable, well-made and cheap.（错因：重复 cheap）；B 填 ugly.（错因：旧印象）；C 填 good quality.（错因：串后句）。
8 规则：R52.1 若补全式空位在 are 后且框架已给末项（", and cheap"），then 只填前面的并列项 fashionable and well-made，不重复框架已有成分；同段用于对比的旧印象（ugly／poor）不作"现在"的看法。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.5 框架去重与裁剪；复用 R12.1（限定词不重复）与 R12.2（并列项按框架裁剪），本条是形容词并列。
10 自检：①框架已给了哪一项？②原文三项顺序是什么？③ugly 属于哪个时间？

**22. 答案：more than 170（Huawei mobile phones are used in more than 170 countries.）**
1 题面：How many countries are using Huawei mobile phones?；框架 "Huawei mobile phones are used in __________ countries."；空位在介词 in 后、名词 countries 前，须为数量定语；原文 "Its mobile phones are used in more than 170 countries."；诱导信号：170 这个数字很醒目，more than 两个词容易被丢掉。
2 候选：①more than 170；②170；③about 170；④170% 。
3 验算：①→与原文完全对应，保留 more than 的约量→成立。②→170 丢掉了"超过"这一限定，变成精确数→次优（数字对，范围错）。③→about 是改写，原文没有→不成立。④→170% 与此处"国家数"不搭→排除。
4 干扰：more than 是功能词，抄写时最易漏；同一篇还有 70%（DJI 市场份额）与 50 million／45 minutes，数字密集，容易串。
5 意图：考"数量照抄，含约量限定词"，以及"同篇数字按对象配对"。
6 边界：若问 What percentage of the world's drone market does DJI have? 答 More than 70%。若问 How many US users does TikTok have? 答 About 50 million。
7 错误：A 填 170.（错因：丢 more than）；B 填 70%.（错因：DJI 的数字串到华为）；C 填 50 million.（错因：TikTok 用户数）。
8 规则：R52.2 若补全式空位在 in＋数字＋countries 前，then 填原文数量短语并保留约量词（more than 170）；不得改写成 about，也不得把同篇其他对象（70%／50 million）的数字移来。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.2 数量＋量词；复用 R26.2（约数词照抄）与 R40.1（数字照抄不改算），本条是"约量词不可省"。
10 自检：①量词是什么？②more than 抄了吗？③这个数字属于谁？

**23. 答案：drones（It produces all kinds of drones.）**
1 题面：What does DJI produce?；框架 "It produces all kinds of __________."；空位在 all kinds of 后，须为可数名词复数（或不可数名词）；原文 "DJI is the world's leading manufacturer of drones (无人机制造商). It produces all kinds of drones…"；诱导信号：括号里的"无人机制造商"是 manufacturer 的注释，不是产品名。
2 候选：①drones；②drone；③manufacturers；④machines。
3 验算：①→all kinds of drones，复数与 all kinds of 搭配→成立。②→单数 drone 在 all kinds of 后可通，但原文用复数，且种类多→次优（改数属改写）。③→manufacturers 是对 DJI 的定性（leading manufacturer），不是它生产的东西→排除。④→machines 是上位词，原文没有→不成立。
4 干扰：括号里的"无人机制造商"让人以为答案与制造商有关；all kinds of 后的空位也可能被填成形容词。
5 意图：考"all kinds of 后取复数名词"，并区分"制造商"与"产品"。
6 边界：若问 What is DJI? 答 The world's leading manufacturer of drones。若问 What share of the world's drone market does DJI have? 答 More than 70%。
7 错误：A 填 manufacturers.（错因：身份当产品）；B 填 machines.（错因：上位词替换）；C 填 drone manufacturers.（错因：把注释当答案）。
8 规则：R52.3 若补全式空位在 all kinds of 后，then 填原文的复数名词（drones）；同一句括号注释里的定性词（manufacturer）与上位词（machines）都不作产品名。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（数量短语后名词）；复用 R15.2（kind 取类名），本条是"类名复数"。
10 自检：①all kinds of 后要什么词性？②原文用单数还是复数？③manufacturer 是产品吗？

**24. 答案：endless（Because it is fun and its videos seem to be endless.）**
1 题面：Why do people in America know TikTok?；框架 "Because it is fun and its videos seem to be __________."；空位在 seem to be 后（表语），须为形容词；原文 "People know it because it is fun and its videos seem to be endless."；诱导信号：fun 已在框架中给出，空位只剩第二个并列项。
2 候选：①endless；②fun（重复）；③time-killer；④popular。
3 验算：①→its videos seem to be endless，与原文一致，且与 fun 并列→成立。②→fun 已在框架中（it is fun），重复→不成立。③→time-killer 是名词，且原文说 it's not just a time-killer→排除。④→popular 原文未用（只说 the most popular App，属另一句）→次优。
4 干扰：fun 是最近形容词，容易被再抄一次；time-killer 在下一句出现，像"原因"。
5 意图：考"seem to be 后取形容词，且不与框架已给的 fun 重复"。
6 边界：若问 What can people do on TikTok besides watching videos? 答 They can buy things on it。若问 How long do US users spend on TikTok every day? 答 About 45 minutes。
7 错误：A 填 fun.（错因：重复框架项）；B 填 time-killer.（错因：名词占形容词位，且被原文否定）；C 填 popular.（错因：串句）。
8 规则：R52.4 若补全式空位在 seem to be 后，then 填形容词（endless）；框架已给的并列形容词（fun）不再重复；下一句被否定的名词（time-killer）不占表语位。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（表语形容词）；复用 R17.2（否定还原），本条是"seem to be 表语"。
10 自检：①seem to be 后要什么词性？②fun 重复了吗？③time-killer 被肯定还是否定？

**25. 答案：in a quick way（The Chinese brands will develop in a quick way.）**
1 题面：How will Chinese brands develop?；框架 "The Chinese brands will develop __________."；空位在不及物动词 develop 后，须为状语（方式／程度）；原文 "The Chinese brands will develop in a quick way. The best time for the local brands is coming."；诱导信号：How 问方式，学生容易只填形容词 quick。
2 候选：①in a quick way；②quick；③quickly（副词，也合语法）；④fast。
3 验算：①→develop in a quick way，与原文一致，介词短语作方式状语→成立（首选，因原文如此）。②→quick 是形容词，不能直接修饰 develop→不成立。③→quickly 语法正确、意思相同，但属改写原文→次优（若题干未限定照抄，可接受）。④→fast 同上，改写→次优。
4 干扰：How 问方式时，副词 quickly 是最自然的填法；题干框架没有介词提示，学生可能不知道要填 in a quick way。
5 意图：考"不及物动词后的方式状语取介词短语"，以及"改写与照抄的取舍"。
6 边界：若问 When will the best time for local brands come? 答 It is coming（原文只说 is coming，未给具体时间）。若问 What does the writer think of Chinese brands' future? 答 They will develop quickly。
7 错误：A 填 quick.（错因：形容词占状语位）；B 填 quick way.（错因：缺介词 in）；C 填 in quick.（错因：缺冠词 a）。
8 规则：R52.5 若补全式空位在不及物动词后且题干为 How，then 优先填原文的介词短语（in a quick way）；形容词（quick）不能占状语位；副词（quickly／fast）语法可通但属改写，照抄优先。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（方式状语）；复用 R6.5（多状语语序）、R15.3（use 取手段），本条是"方式状语照抄"。
10 自检：①develop 是及物还是不及物？②原文用什么状语？③我填成形容词了吗？

**组小结（G52 · 小蓝书预测卷五 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：并列形容词裁剪 1（21）；数量定语（约量）1（22）；all kinds of 复数名词 1（23）；seem to be 表语 1（24）；方式状语 1（25）。
- 规则：R52.1 并列项去重（21）；R52.2 约量词不可省（22）；R52.3 类名复数（23）；R52.4 表语形容词不重复（24）；R52.5 方式状语取介词短语（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R52.1 与"三项全抄"冲突，框架裁剪优先；R52.2 与"170 更醒目"冲突，约量词优先；R52.3 与"括号注释"冲突，复数名词优先；R52.4 与"fun 最近"冲突，不重复优先；R52.5 与"quickly 最自然"冲突，原文照抄优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：与 G51 合成"补全式五型"样本（表语／主语／介词宾语／there be／并列形容词／数量定语／复数名词／表语形容词／方式状语）；本篇数字三个（170／70%／50 million）均只作照抄，**无换算、无差值**；TikTok 段还有 45 minutes，亦只照录。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷五 · Passage 3

A while ago I sent out a couple of hundred letters for information on subjects that interest me. One of the questions I asked was "When you think of love, what color comes to your mind?"

One person said "money". I didn't know what color that was, maybe green, but I wasn't sure, so, I didn't give it a color. Two people said love didn't have any color. Two other people said love was the color of the rainbow. That's a nice thought. Now only 3 people chose red as the color they thought of as love. This surprised me, since that is the color used most on Valentines' Day (情人节). I guess passion doesn't necessarily mean love. There was a tie of 4



each for white and yellow. I can understand wanting a pure love (white) or a wise and happy love (yellow). Pink is the choice of 5 people who I think need beauty in their lives. Six people said either lavender, lilac (紫丁香) or violet was the color of love. I think all of them want some magic and mystery in their love lives. Green was the color chosen by 7 people as the color they thought of as love. These people must want a balanced love and maybe some money too.

The most surprising answer was that 14 people picked blue. I think these people may know about love. Love should be sincere and true. Maybe if you have "the blues", it is because you don't have love. Most blues music is about lost love. Maybe blue is the color of love. I just can't see sending a blue heart to my lover next Valentines' Day.

This little survey is not scientific, but it is very interesting. Did you know not all people dream in color? Well, I hope everyone makes sure to daydream in the most wonderful and wild colors possible.

27. Why was the writer surprised at only 3 people's choosing red?

____________________

28. How many people choose pink as the color of love?

____________________

29. What was the most surprising answer?

____________________

30. Can the writer send a blue heart to his lover next Valentines' Day? Why or why not?

**〔G53〕小蓝书预测卷五 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：A couple of hundred letters (asking for information on subjects that interest him).**
1 题面：What did the writer send out a while ago；原文 "A while ago I sent out a couple of hundred letters for information on subjects that interest me. One of the questions I asked was 'When you think of love, what color comes to your mind?'"；疑问词 What did sb send out（问物品）；诱导信号：紧接着是小调查与问题，容易被答成"a survey／questions"。
2 候选：①a couple of hundred letters；②a survey；③questions about love；④hundreds of emails。
3 验算：①→sent out a couple of hundred letters，send out 的宾语直接给出→成立（可补 for information…）。②→survey 是这封信的结果（This little survey is not scientific），不是 send out 的宾语→次优。③→questions 在信里，不是信本身→排除。④→emails 原文无（letters）→排除。
4 干扰：末段 This little survey 让"调查"更像答案；a couple of hundred 是数量，学生可能只写 hundred letters 而丢"couple of"。
5 意图：考"send out 取宾语"，以及"调查／问题属内容，不属所寄之物"。
6 边界：若问 How many letters did the writer send out? 答 A couple of hundred。若问 What was one of the questions? 答 "When you think of love, what color comes to your mind?"
7 错误：A 答 A survey.（错因：结果当寄出物）；B 答 Questions about love.（错因：内容当载体）；C 答 Emails.（错因：改写载体）。
8 规则：R53.1 若问 What did sb send out，then 取 send out 的宾语（a couple of hundred letters）；同段出现的 survey／questions 是内容与结果，不作寄出物；数量短语（a couple of hundred）不裁剪。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.15 并列宾语／宾语取词；复用 R22.2（include 取全），本条是"载体 vs 内容"。
10 自检：①send out 的宾语是什么？②survey 是信还是结果？③couple of 丢了吗？

**27. 答案：Because red is the color used most on Valentines' Day (yet only 3 people chose it).**
1 题面：Why was the writer surprised at only 3 people's choosing red；原文 "Now only 3 people chose red as the color they thought of as love. This surprised me, since that is the color used most on Valentines' Day (情人节). I guess passion doesn't necessarily mean love."；疑问词 Why was sb surprised（问原因）；诱导信号：紧随其后的 I guess passion doesn't necessarily mean love 是作者推论，语气更像"原因"。
2 候选：①red is the color used most on Valentines' Day；②passion doesn't necessarily mean love；③only 3 people chose red（重复题干）；④red is a passionate color。
3 验算：①→This surprised me, since that is the color used most on Valentines' Day，since 引导原因→成立。②→I guess… 是作者由此得出的结论，不是"惊讶"的成因→次优。③→重复题干事实，零信息→排除。④→原文未直接说 red is passionate，且 passion 句是推论→次优。
4 干扰：since 在此是"因为"，不是"自从"，功能词误读会让句子结构崩；passion 句紧邻且更像解释。
5 意图：考"since 引导的原因"＋"推论≠原因"。
6 边界：若问 What did the writer guess from this? 答 That passion doesn't necessarily mean love。若问 How many people chose white? 答 Four。
7 错误：A 答 Because passion doesn't mean love.（错因：推论当原因）；B 答 Because only 3 people chose it.（错因：重复题干）；C 答 Because red is a boring color.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R53.2 若问 Why was sb surprised，then 取 surprised 句后 since 引导的原因（red is the color used most on Valentines' Day）；紧随的 I guess… 是推论，不作原因；重复题干事实的答案零信息。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（since 引导）；复用 R30.3（so 前为因），本条标记是 since。
10 自检：①since 是"因为"还是"自从"？②推论句是哪句？③我重复题干了吗？

**28. 答案：Five (people).**
1 题面：How many people choose pink as the color of love；原文 "Pink is the choice of 5 people who I think need beauty in their lives."；疑问词 How many（问人数）；诱导信号：同段颜色与数字密集（red 3／white 4／yellow 4／pink 5／lavender 6／green 7／blue 14），相邻数字极易串。
2 候选：①5；②4（white／yellow）；③6（lavender／lilac／violet）；④14（blue）。
3 验算：①→Pink is the choice of 5 people，颜色与数字同句配对→成立。②→4 属 white 与 yellow（a tie of 4 each）→排除。③→6 属 lavender／lilac／violet→排除。④→14 属 blue（The most surprising answer）→排除。
4 干扰：所有数字都在同一段、句式相似（X was the color chosen by N people），不按颜色名配对就会串；three／four 等小数字也出现过。
5 意图：考"颜色—人数按名配对"，是清点类数字题的最小单位。
6 边界：若问 How many people chose blue? 答 Fourteen。若问 Which color was chosen by 7 people? 答 Green。
7 错误：A 答 4.（错因：white／yellow 的数字）；B 答 6.（错因：lavender 一组）；C 答 14.（错因：blue 的数字）。
8 规则：R53.3 若问 How many people choose X，then 在同一段内按颜色名配对取数（pink→5），不取相邻颜色的数字；颜色与数字必须同句对应。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（按名配对）；复用 R14.2（数字按事件配对）、R45.2（清点），本条是"颜色—人数"配对。
10 自检：①pink 与哪个数字同句？②4 属于谁？③我串色了吗？

**29. 答案：That fourteen people picked blue (as the color of love).**
1 题面：What was the most surprising answer；原文 "The most surprising answer was that 14 people picked blue. I think these people may know about love."；疑问词 What was the most surprising answer（问答案内容）；诱导信号：后句 I think these people may know about love 与 Maybe blue is the color of love 是对该答案的评论，语气更像结论。
2 候选：①14 people picked blue；②blue is the color of love；③people who pick blue know about love；④the answer "money"。
3 验算：①→The most surprising answer was that 14 people picked blue，表语从句直接给出→成立。②→Maybe blue is the color of love 是作者的推测（Maybe），不是"答案"本身→次优。③→是作者对这些人的评价→排除。④→"money" 出现在开头，作者说 I didn't know what color that was，并未称其"最令人惊讶"→排除。
4 干扰：blue 段的评论句最多（sincere／blues music／Maybe blue is the color of love），容易把评论当答案；"money" 这个回答本身也很怪，像"最 surprising"。
5 意图：考"表语从句取答案内容，评论句不作答案"。
6 边界：若问 What does the writer think of people who chose blue? 答 They may know about love（love should be sincere and true）。若问 Why does the writer mention blues music? 答 Because most blues music is about lost love。
7 错误：A 答 Blue is the color of love.（错因：推测当答案）；B 答 Money.（错因：错把首答当最惊讶）；C 答 People who chose blue know about love.（错因：评价当答案）。
8 规则：R53.4 若问 What was the most surprising answer，then 取 The most surprising answer was that… 的表语从句（14 people picked blue）；其后的 I think／Maybe 句是评论与推测，不作答案；开头 "money" 未被作者称为最惊讶。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容主题（表语从句）；复用 R43.4（领悟取 that 从句），本条是"答案内容取 that 从句"。
10 自检：①表语从句在哪？②Maybe 句是什么？③money 被称最惊讶了吗？

**30. 答案：No, he can't. Because he just can't see himself sending a blue heart to his lover next Valentines' Day.**
1 题面：Can the writer send a blue heart to his lover next Valentines' Day? Why or why not?——两问：Yes/No＋理由；原文 "Maybe blue is the color of love. I just can't see sending a blue heart to my lover next Valentines' Day."；疑问词 Can…? Why or why not（一般疑问＋理由）；诱导信号：前句 Maybe blue is the color of love 是正面推测，容易被当成"会送"的依据。
2 候选：①No＋I just can't see sending a blue heart…；②Yes＋blue is the color of love；③No＋blue means sadness（外推）；④Yes＋因为他喜欢蓝色（无据）。
3 验算：①→I just can't see sending a blue heart to my lover，can't see doing＝无法想象自己做，等于"不会送"；表态与理由同源→成立。②→Maybe 是推测，且紧接着就是"无法想象送蓝心"，方向相反→不成立。③→blue 在文中与 the blues／lost love 关联，但作者没把它当作"不送"的理由→次优。④→原文无→排除。
4 干扰：Maybe blue is the color of love 是最"正面"的一句，读者容易据此答 Yes；can't see doing 这个结构（无法想象）也常被误读为"看不见"。
5 意图：考"can't see sb doing＝不会做"的语义，以及"两问都要答（表态＋理由）"。
6 边界：若问 Does the writer think blue can be the color of love? 答 Maybe（he says maybe blue is the color of love）。若问 What does "the blues" mean here? 答 A feeling of sadness, often about lost love。
7 错误：A 答 Yes, because blue is the color of love.（错因：Maybe 当结论）；B 答 No, because he can't see the blue heart.（错因：can't see 误作"看不见"）；C 答 No.（错因：漏理由）。
8 规则：R53.5 若题干为 Can…? Why or why not，then 先表态（No, he can't.），再取 can't see doing（无法想象做）作理由；前句 Maybe… 是推测，不作"Yes"的依据；两问缺一即不完整。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.2 双问（Yes/No＋理由）；复用 R18.3（Yes/No＋主语＋助动词）、R30.2（表态＋理由），本条加"can't see doing 的语义"。
10 自检：①我表态了吗？②can't see 是"看不见"吗？③Maybe 句能用来说 Yes 吗？

**组小结（G53 · 小蓝书预测卷五 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：寄出物（载体 vs 内容）1（26）；原因（since）1（27）；人数按名配对 1（28）；最惊讶答案（表语从句）1（29）；双问（Can…＋理由）1（30）。
- 规则：R53.1 send out 取宾语（26）；R53.2 since 后为因、推论不作因（27）；R53.3 颜色—人数同句配对（28）；R53.4 答案取表语从句（29）；R53.5 can't see doing＝不会做（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R53.1 与"survey 更像主题"冲突，send out 宾语优先；R53.2 与"passion 句更像解释"冲突，since 优先；R53.3 与"相邻数字"冲突，同名同句优先；R53.4 与"评论句最多"冲突，表语从句优先；R53.5 与"Maybe 句正面"冲突，can't see doing 优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：本组是**数字最密集**的一组（3／4／4／5／6／7／14 七个数），但全部为"同句配对取数"，**仍无换算与差值**——若知本出现"两类人数相减""占比换算"，即补 RA-1.7 的差值子类。调查类文本首见，可作 04 的"小样本调查"样本。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷五 · Passage 4

Dr. Lin Qiaozhi graduated from Peking Union Medical College (PUMC) with the Wenhai Scholarship, the highest prize given to graduates. After working for a few years, she was sent to study in Europe and then, in 1939, in the US. She had a great influence on her American workmates, who invited her to stay after graduatings. However, she refused. She wanted to serve the women and children at home.

Thinking of all the people in need of help, Dr. Lin opened a private clinic (诊所) after going back to China. She asked very little money to treat patients and often cut costs for poor



patients. At times she was even seen riding a donkey (驴) to faraway villages to provide medical care.

The new People's Republic of China saw Dr. Lin Qiaozhi playing a key role. In 1954, she was chosen to the first National People's Congress (全国人民代表大会). She was more interested in taking care of patients, doing medical research on care for women and children, and training the other doctors. "We care for two lives," she told new staff. "As doctors, we should be responsible for the patients and treat them as our sisters."

Though Lin Qiaozhi never married, she was known as the "mother of ten thousand babies", having helped mothers to give birth to over 50,000 babies in her lifetime. Dr. Lin did not stop working until the day she died, 22 April 1983. Since she had no children of her own, she left her money to a kindergarten (幼儿园) and a fund for new doctors. And even as she was dying, her final thoughts were for others. "I'm ready to go," she said. "Don't try to save me any more. Don't waste the medicine any more."

**〔G54〕小蓝书预测卷五 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：In 1939.**
1 题面：When was Dr. Lin Qiaozhi sent to study in the US；原文 "After working for a few years, she was sent to study in Europe and then, in 1939, in the US."；疑问词 When（问年份）；诱导信号：同一句里 Europe 与 US 并列，只有一个年份 in 1939。
2 候选：①in 1939；②after working for a few years；③1954（另一段）；④after graduating。
3 验算：①→she was sent to study in Europe and then, in 1939, in the US，in 1939 紧贴 in the US→成立（年份与国别配对）。②→after working for a few years 是去欧洲前的时间说明，不是赴美年份→排除。③→1954 是她被选入第一届全国人大的年份→排除。④→after graduating 指美国同事邀她留下，不是她去的时间→次优。
4 干扰：句中两个地点（Europe／US）容易错配；after working for a few years 也像"时间答案"。
5 意图：考"多个地点一个年份时按地点配对"。
6 边界：若问 Where was she sent to study first? 答 To Europe。若问 What happened in 1954? 答 She was chosen to the first National People's Congress。
7 错误：A 答 After working for a few years.（错因：时段当具体年份）；B 答 In 1954.（错因：串段）；C 答 In 1939, in Europe.（错因：年份与地点错配）。
8 规则：R54.1 若一句中出现两个地点而只有一个年份，then 按"年份紧贴哪个地点"配对（in 1939, in the US）；时段短语（after working for a few years）不作具体年份；别段年份（1954／1983）不参与。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（年份—地点配对）；复用 R16.3（多年份按动词配对），本条是"多地点单年份"。
10 自检：①年份紧贴哪个地点？②1954 是什么事件？③我答成时段了吗？

**32. 答案：Because she wanted to serve the women and children at home.**
1 题面：Why did Dr. Lin refuse to stay in the US；原文 "She had a great influence on her American workmates, who invited her to stay after graduatings. However, she refused. She wanted to serve the women and children at home."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：workmates invited her to stay 是"被邀请"的事实，紧贴 refused。
2 候选：①she wanted to serve the women and children at home；②her workmates invited her（事实，非原因）；③she didn't like America；④her family was in China（外推）。
3 验算：①→She wanted to serve…at home，紧随 refused 的动机句→成立。②→invited her to stay 是她拒绝的对象，不是原因→不成立。③→原文无不喜欢→排除。④→原文只说 at home，未提家人→次优（属外推）。
4 干扰：However, she refused 前一句的 invited 太近，容易被当原因；at home 若译成"在家里"会读不通，须理解为"在国内／祖国"。
5 意图：考"refuse 后取动机句"，并正确理解 at home（在国内）。
6 边界：若问 What did her American workmates think of her? 答 She had a great influence on them。若问 What did she do after returning to China? 答 She opened a private clinic。
7 错误：A 答 Because her workmates invited her to stay.（错因：拒绝对象当原因）；B 答 Because she didn't like the US.（错因：无据）；C 答 Because she wanted to be with her family.（错因：外推，原文说 serve）。
8 规则：R54.2 若问 Why did sb refuse to do sth，then 取 refused 后的动机句（wanted to serve the women and children at home）；邀请句（invited her to stay）是拒绝的对象而非原因；at home 译"在国内"，不译"在家"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（refuse 的动机）；复用 R32.3（动机取引语自述），本条动机为叙述句而非引语。
10 自检：①动机句在哪？②invited 是原因吗？③at home 怎么译？

**33. 答案：To faraway villages.**
1 题面：Where was Dr. Lin seen riding a donkey to provide medical care；原文 "At times she was even seen riding a donkey (驴) to faraway villages to provide medical care."；疑问词 Where（问地点）；诱导信号：donkey 与 China 都在附近，China 在上一段（after going back to China）。
2 候选：①to faraway villages；②China；③the private clinic；④on a donkey。
3 验算：①→riding a donkey to faraway villages，to 短语即目的地→成立。②→China 是"回国"的国别，范围过大，且题干问"去哪里看病"→次优。③→clinic 是她开的诊所，与"骑驴去"的目的地相反→排除。④→on a donkey 是方式，不是地点→排除。
4 干扰：Where 问地点，donkey 是"载具"，学生容易答成"on a donkey"；China 虽对但过泛。
5 意图：考"Where 取 to 后的目的地，不取方式状语"。
6 边界：若问 How did she go to faraway villages? 答 By riding a donkey。若问 Why did she go there? 答 To provide medical care。
7 错误：A 答 On a donkey.（错因：方式当地点）；B 答 In China.（错因：范围过大，未答目的地）；C 答 In her clinic.（错因：方向相反）。
8 规则：R54.3 若问 Where was sb seen doing sth，then 取 to＋地点（faraway villages）作目的地；方式状语（on a donkey／riding）与国别（China）不作具体地点。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（目的地 vs 方式）；复用 R32.2（目的地按进入动作），本条标记是 to。
10 自检：①to 后是什么？②donkey 是地点吗？③China 够具体吗？

**34. 答案：The patients (she said doctors should treat them as their sisters).**
1 题面：According to Dr. Lin, who should doctors be responsible for；原文 "'We care for two lives,' she told new staff. 'As doctors, we should be responsible for the patients and treat them as our sisters.'"；疑问词 who…be responsible for（问对象）；诱导信号：前一句 We care for two lives 里 two lives 很醒目。
2 候选：①the patients；②two lives；③new staff；④women and children only。
3 验算：①→be responsible for the patients，介词宾语直接给出，后接 treat them as our sisters 同指→成立。②→two lives 是她对"母婴"的形象说法，出现在上一句，不是 responsible for 的宾语→次优（可作补充）。③→she told new staff 是说话对象，不是负责对象→排除。④→women and children 是她回国的服务对象，题干问"医生应对谁负责"→次优。
4 干扰：two lives 形象好记，且与母婴主题贴；new staff 是听者，容易被当成"对象"。
5 意图：考"be responsible for 取介词宾语"，并区分"说话对象／服务对象／负责对象"三者。
6 边界：若问 What did she say to new staff? 答 "We care for two lives… we should be responsible for the patients and treat them as our sisters."。若问 Who did she want to serve? 答 The women and children at home。
7 错误：A 答 Two lives.（错因：形象说法占宾语位）；B 答 New staff.（错因：听者当对象）；C 答 Her workmates.（错因：串段）。
8 规则：R54.4 若问 According to sb, who should…be responsible for，then 取引语中 be responsible for 的介词宾语（the patients）；同段的形象说法（two lives）、说话对象（new staff）、服务对象（women and children）各归其位，不混用。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.17 介词宾语；复用 R6.1（介词前置取宾语），本条是"责任对象"。
10 自检：①responsible for 后是谁？②two lives 是什么？③new staff 是谁？

**35. 答案：Over 50,000.**
1 题面：How many babies did Dr. Lin help mothers to give birth to in her lifetime；原文 "she was known as the 'mother of ten thousand babies', having helped mothers to give birth to over 50,000 babies in her lifetime."；疑问词 How many（问数字）；诱导信号：同一句有两个数字表达——称号里的 ten thousand 与实际的 over 50,000。
2 候选：①over 50,000；②ten thousand；③50,000（丢 over）；④10,000。
3 验算：①→having helped mothers to give birth to over 50,000 babies，与题干 in her lifetime 对应→成立。②→ten thousand 出自称号 "mother of ten thousand babies"，是比喻性称号，不是统计数字→不成立。③→丢 over，改精确数→次优。④→同上，且与称号混。
4 干扰：称号 ten thousand 更像"整数答案"，且 mother of ten thousand babies 是全文最动人的一句；over 也常被漏。
5 意图：考"统计数字与称号数字分开"，以及约量词不丢。
6 边界：若问 Why was she called "mother of ten thousand babies"? 答 Because she helped mothers give birth to over 50,000 babies。若问 How old was she when she died? 答 82（原文只说 died on 22 April 1983，未给年龄）。
7 错误：A 答 Ten thousand.（错因：称号当统计）；B 答 50,000.（错因：漏 over）；C 答 5,000.（错因：数字抄错）。
8 规则：R54.5 若问 How many…in her lifetime，then 取统计句的数字并保留约量词（over 50,000）；称号里的数字（mother of ten thousand babies）不代统计数；原文未给的派生数字（年龄等）不推算。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（统计 vs 称号）；复用 R26.2（约数词照抄）、R52.2（约量词不可省）。
10 自检：①统计句的数字是多少？②ten thousand 出自哪里？③over 抄了吗？

**组小结（G54 · 小蓝书预测卷五 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：年份—地点配对 1（31）；refuse 动机 1（32）；目的地 vs 方式 1（33）；责任对象（介词宾语）1（34）；统计数字 vs 称号 1（35）。
- 规则：R54.1 年份按地点配对（31）；R54.2 refuse 取动机、at home＝国内（32）；R54.3 Where 取 to 后目的地（33）；R54.4 responsible for 取宾语（34）；R54.5 统计数字保留 over（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R54.1 与"after working for a few years 也像时间"冲突，年份紧贴地点优先；R54.2 与"invited 紧邻"冲突，动机句优先；R54.3 与"donkey 醒目"冲突，to 后目的地优先；R54.4 与"two lives 形象"冲突，介词宾语优先；R54.5 与"ten thousand 是整数"冲突，统计句优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：人物传记类第 3 篇（G42 Steiner／G48 Saunders／本条），三篇的取材分别是"学位—健康""转折—记录""时间—对象"，可作 04 传记类的三条取样；本篇数字（1939／1954／22 April 1983／50,000／ten thousand）均为照录或配对，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷八 · Passage 1

In our life, we may meet people with different personalities. People with different personalities will do things in different ways, and some people may find these differences interesting. What is your personality type? Read about the following introduction and find



out.

The first type is called a Dreamer. A Dreamer thinks there is a "right" way to do everything. This person wants to live in a "perfect world". Many are good listeners and like to help others. Many work as teachers, and often lead others. Famous Dreamers include Mohandas Gandhi, Angelina Jolie.

Secondly, a Partner wants to be in a group. For this kind of people, rules are important. They consider traditions to be of great value. Partners are often serious, careful people. Many do well as teachers, managers and police officers. Some famous partners include Queen Elizabeth II, Mother Teresa.

For Thinkers, understanding things is very important. They like to deal with problems and make new things. Thinkers can also be active. They like to win. They have very strong opinions. Many thinkers work as scientists, inventors and engineers. There are some famous thinkers such as Bill Gates, Stephen Hawking.

Lastly, artists want to be free. They don't want to follow the rules all the time. They also like trying new things. Like Thinkers, many Artists have strong opinions. They are creative and do well as musicians and actors. Famous Artists: Cristiano Ronaldo, Madonna.

These are some typical personalities. Understanding the similarities and differences between people can be very interesting and inspiring. We are born to be different; the only thing we can do is to respect each other and learn from each other.

16. How many personality types are mentioned in the passage?

____________________

17. Who may give you a hand when you need help according to the passage?

____________________

18. If you are active and like to win, what kind of job is the best choice?

____________________

19. Do Bill Gates and Stephen Hawking have the same personality in some ways?

____________________

20. What is a Partner like?

____________________

**〔G55〕小蓝书预测卷八 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：Four（a Dreamer, a Partner, a Thinker and an Artist）.**
1 题面：How many personality types are mentioned in the passage；原文依次给出 "The first type is called a Dreamer."／"Secondly, a Partner…"／"For Thinkers…"／"Lastly, artists want to be free."；疑问词 How many（问数量）；诱导信号：四个人名（Gandhi／Jolie／Elizabeth II／Bill Gates…）也成串出现，容易被当成"数量"。
2 候选：①4（Dreamer／Partner／Thinker／Artist）；②5（把 These are some typical personalities 当第五类）；③8（把八个名人当类型）；④3（漏 Lastly）。
3 验算：①→四个类型标记词（The first／Secondly／For Thinkers／Lastly）各引一类，共 4 类→成立。②→These are some typical personalities 是总结句，不是新类型→不成立。③→名人是各类的举例（Famous Dreamers include…）→排除。④→Lastly 段确为一类（Artists），漏则少数→排除。
4 干扰：段首标记不统一（The first／Secondly／For Thinkers／Lastly），第三个没有序数词，容易数错；名人名单长度也会干扰。
5 意图：考"按类型标记词清点，不按专名数"。
6 边界：若问 What are the four personality types? 答 Dreamer, Partner, Thinker and Artist。若问 Which type does Bill Gates belong to? 答 Thinkers。
7 错误：A 答 Five.（错因：总结句当类型）；B 答 Eight.（错因：名人数当类型数）；C 答 Three.（错因：漏 Lastly 段）。
8 规则：R55.1 若问 How many types／kinds are mentioned，then 按类型标记词（The first／Secondly／For Thinkers／Lastly）逐段清点，共 4 类；总结句与名人举例都不计入；标记词形式不统一时逐段读首句。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（清点类型）；复用 R45.2（清点去重），本条是"标记词不统一"的情形。
10 自检：①四段的类型标记各是什么？②总结句算类型吗？③名人数能当类型数吗？

**17. 答案：A Dreamer — Dreamers are good listeners and like to help others.**
1 题面：Who may give you a hand when you need help according to the passage；原文 "Many are good listeners and like to help others."（在 Dreamer 段）；疑问词 Who（问哪类人）；诱导信号：Partner 段有 police officers、Thinker 段有 scientists，这些职业也"帮人"。
2 候选：①a Dreamer；②a Partner（police officers）；③a Thinker（scientists）；④an Artist。
3 验算：①→Many are good listeners and like to help others，主语回指本段类型 Dreamer，"help others"与 give you a hand 同义→成立。②→Partner 段只说 rules important／serious, careful，职业里虽有 police officers，但原文未说"帮人"→次优。③→Thinker 段讲 understanding／make new things→排除。④→Artist 段讲 free／creative→排除。
4 干扰：police officers 天然带"助人"联想，职业细节比性格描述更具体；give you a hand 是习语，学生若按字面理解会找不到对应。
5 意图：考"习语 give sb a hand＝help"＋"按段落主体配对"。
6 边界：若问 What are Dreamers like? 答 They think there is a "right" way, want a perfect world, are good listeners and like to help others。若问 What jobs do Partners often do? 答 Teachers, managers and police officers。
7 错误：A 答 A Partner.（错因：police officers 的职业联想）；B 答 A Thinker.（错因：scientists 联想）；C 答 A teacher.（错因：职业当类型）。
8 规则：R55.2 若题干含习语（give sb a hand＝help），then 先还原习语义，再按段落主体配对取该类人（Dreamer：good listeners／like to help others）；同段职业举例（police officers／scientists）不作依据。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（按类型配对）；复用 R33.3（多主体按主体配对），本条主体是"性格类型"。
10 自检：①give a hand 是什么意思？②help others 出现在哪段？③我按职业选了吗？

**18. 答案：Being a scientist, an inventor or an engineer (the jobs of Thinkers).**
1 题面：If you are active and like to win, what kind of job is the best choice；原文 "For Thinkers… Thinkers can also be active. They like to win… Many thinkers work as scientists, inventors and engineers."；疑问词 what kind of job（问职业）；诱导信号：active 一词也在 Artist 段（trying new things）近义出现，但 like to win 只属 Thinker。
2 候选：①scientists／inventors／engineers；②musicians／actors（Artists）；③teachers／managers／police officers（Partners）；④teachers（Dreamers）。
3 验算：①→active＋like to win 两句都在 Thinker 段，紧随其后的职业句即答案→成立（三选一即可，写全更稳）。②→Artists creative／musicians and actors，但原文未说 like to win→排除。③→Partners serious, careful→排除。④→Dreamers good listeners→排除。
4 干扰：四个类型各配一组职业，若不先定类型就会串；active 与 creative 语义相近，容易误判为 Artist。
5 意图：考"先由性格特征定类型，再取该类型职业"的两步法。
6 边界：若问 What do Thinkers like to do? 答 They like to deal with problems, make new things and win。若问 What are Artists good at? 答 They are creative and do well as musicians and actors。
7 错误：A 答 A musician or an actor.（错因：特征混淆）；B 答 A teacher.（错因：多类型共有，未定类型）；C 答 A police officer.（错因：Partner 的职业）。
8 规则：R55.3 若问 If you are X, what job is the best，then 先用题干特征（active and like to win）定位类型（Thinker），再取该段的职业并列项（scientists, inventors and engineers）；不要跳过定类型直接猜职业，也不取别类型的职业组。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.37 职业（类型→职业两步）；复用 R25.4（职业取同位语），本条是"按特征定类再取职业"。
10 自检：①active／like to win 在哪段？②该段职业有哪几个？③我串类了吗？

**19. 答案：Yes, they do. Both of them are (famous) Thinkers.**
1 题面：Do Bill Gates and Stephen Hawking have the same personality in some ways；原文 "There are some famous thinkers such as Bill Gates, Stephen Hawking."；疑问词 Do…（一般疑问，复数主语）；诱导信号：两人在文中只以"名人举例"出现，没有单独描述。
2 候选：①Yes, they do（both are Thinkers）；②No, they don't；③Yes, they are（be 动词错配）；④无法判断。
3 验算：①→两人同列在 famous thinkers such as 之后，即同属 Thinker 型；主语复数用 do→成立。②→与同列举例矛盾→不成立。③→题干用 Do…have，答语须用 do，不用 are→次优（内容对、助动词错）。④→原文已给同一类别，可判断→排除。
4 干扰：两人没有单独段落，读者可能觉得"没写就不能判断"；Yes/No 的助动词也容易与 be 混。
5 意图：考"同一列举中的成员共享类别"，以及"Yes/No＋同形助动词"。
6 边界：若问 What type of personality do Bill Gates and Stephen Hawking have? 答 Thinkers。若问 Who are famous Dreamers? 答 Mohandas Gandhi and Angelina Jolie。
7 错误：A 答 No, they don't.（错因：忽略同列关系）；B 答 Yes, they are.（错因：助动词错配）；C 答 We don't know.（错因：放弃可判断信息）。
8 规则：R55.4 若问 Do A and B have the same X，then 先看两人是否同列于同一举例（famous thinkers such as…），同列即同类→Yes；答语用与题干一致的助动词（do）；be 动词不与 have 混。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答；复用 R43.3（Yes/No＋补事实），本条加"同列即同类"与"助动词同形"。
10 自检：①两人在哪句同列？②答语用 do 还是 are？③我要不要补一句依据？

**20. 答案：A Partner wants to be in a group; rules are important to them, they consider traditions to be of great value, and they are often serious and careful people.**
1 题面：What is a Partner like；原文 "Secondly, a Partner wants to be in a group. For this kind of people, rules are important. They consider traditions to be of great value. Partners are often serious, careful people."；疑问词 What is X like（问特征，要求覆盖该段）；诱导信号：同段末尾的职业句（teachers, managers, police officers）与名人（Queen Elizabeth II, Mother Teresa）也像"描述"。
2 候选：①want to be in a group＋rules important＋traditions valuable＋serious, careful；②only serious and careful；③teachers, managers and police officers；④Queen Elizabeth II and Mother Teresa。
3 验算：①→段内四句特征全取，构成完整画像→成立（至少写两条，写全最好）。②→只取末句形容词，漏"群体／规则／传统"三条→次优。③→职业是特征的结果，不是性格本身→次优。④→名人是举例→排除。
4 干扰：serious, careful 是形容词，最像"性格"；职业与名人更具体，容易替代特征。
5 意图：考"What is X like 取整段特征，职业与例子不作性格"。
6 边界：若问 What jobs do Partners often do? 答 Teachers, managers and police officers。若问 What do Partners think of traditions? 答 They consider them to be of great value。
7 错误：A 答 They are serious and careful.（错因：只取一条）；B 答 They are teachers and police officers.（错因：职业当性格）；C 答 They are famous.（错因：名人是举例）。
8 规则：R55.5 若问 What is X like，then 取该类型段内的全部特征句（群体归属／重视规则／看重传统／serious and careful），至少两条；该段的职业句与名人举例只作结果与例证。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.10 人物性格推断（单一类型段）；复用 R32.5（性格双面用 but），本条是"单一类型多特征"。
10 自检：①本段有几条特征？②职业句算特征吗？③我漏了"传统"吗？

**组小结（G55 · 小蓝书预测卷八 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：清点类型 1（16）；习语＋类型配对 1（17）；特征→职业两步 1（18）；同列即同类（Yes/No）1（19）；类型特征取全 1（20）。
- 规则：R55.1 按标记词清点四类（16）；R55.2 give a hand＝help、按类型配对（17）；R55.3 先定类型再取职业（18）；R55.4 同列即同类、助动词同形（19）；R55.5 特征取全（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R55.1 与"名人成串"冲突，标记词优先；R55.2 与"police officers 联想"冲突，原文 help others 优先；R55.3 与"active≈creative"冲突，like to win 优先；R55.4 与"没单写不能判断"冲突，同列关系优先；R55.5 与"形容词最像性格"冲突，整段特征优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：分类说明文首见（与 G45 多国礼仪同为"分栏罗列"，但本条是"分类＋举例"）；数字仅 4 类，无换算与差值；Yes/No 题再添"同列即同类"型。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷八 · Passage 2

It's common for us to take a train. But have you ever thought of having a special place to



study on the train? This will surely be a very unusual experience.

The train No. 5609/5610, which runs between Chongqing and Xiushan, is a slow train. In some carriages (车厢), there are no hard seats (硬座) but some desks and chairs next to the windows. They became bright "study carriages" for passengers in need.

Some other slow trains also have their own bright "study carriages", including No. 5619/5620 and No. 5633/5634. Many students from nearby schools often take the trains between school and home at weekends. The trains are their "school buses" and many of them use the travel time to finish their homework.

On the train No. Z150, which runs between Guiyang and Beijing, a "book bar" carriage has been welcomed by college students. There are nearly 400 universities and colleges in the cities along the rail line, making No. Z150 the first choice for most students. Since 2015, the train's dining car has been open at night to provide students with a lending library and some tea. There students enjoy reading books and drinking tea for free. They even start discussions on some topics in groups.

These small measures were made to provide a comfortable environment for learners to continue their studies. And they are well welcomed by many passengers. Many students say it's meaningful to set up such carriages and they'd like to share them with their friends.

21. What do "study carriages" on the train No.5609/5610 look like?

____________________

22. Does only the train No.5609/5610 have "study carriages"?

____________________

23. Which train has a "book bar" carriage?

____________________

24. What can students do on the train No. Z150 besides starting discussions on some topics in groups?

____________________

25. What do you think of setting up "study carriages"?

____________________

**〔G56〕小蓝书预测卷八 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：In these carriages there are no hard seats but some desks and chairs next to the windows.**
1 题面：What do "study carriages" on the train No.5609/5610 look like；原文 "In some carriages (车厢), there are no hard seats (硬座) but some desks and chairs next to the windows. They became bright 'study carriages' for passengers in need."；疑问词 What do…look like（问外观／陈设）；诱导信号：carriages 与 seats 是同一语义场，容易只写"没有硬座"。
2 候选：①no hard seats but desks and chairs next to the windows；②no hard seats（只取前半）；③desks and chairs（只取后半）；④bright and new（bright 的字面义）。
3 验算：①→no hard seats but some desks and chairs next to the windows，not A but B 结构完整，正是"外观"→成立（两层都要）。②→只说没有硬座，读者不知道里面有什么→不完整。③→只说有桌椅，漏"没有硬座"这一改造点→次优。④→bright 在此是"明亮的／温馨的"修饰 study carriages，不是陈设→排除。
4 干扰：but 两侧一否一肯，学生常只抄一侧；bright 形容词容易被当成"看起来明亮"的答案。
5 意图：考"look like 取陈设描写，not A but B 两侧都写"。
6 边界：若问 What are these carriages used for? 答 They are used as "study carriages" for passengers in need（students do their homework）。若问 Which trains also have study carriages? 答 No. 5619/5620 and No. 5633/5634。
7 错误：A 答 They have no hard seats.（错因：只取 not 侧）；B 答 They look bright.（错因：bright 当外貌）；C 答 They have desks and chairs only.（错因：漏"取消硬座"）。
8 规则：R56.1 若问 What do X look like，then 取描写陈设的 not A but B 全句（no hard seats but desks and chairs next to the windows），两侧都写；修饰性的 bright 不作外观描述。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.38 外形／陈设描写；复用 R26.3（look like 取外形层次），本条是"一否一肯"结构。
10 自检：①not 侧是什么？②but 侧是什么？③bright 修饰谁？

**22. 答案：No, it doesn't. Other slow trains such as No. 5619/5620 and No. 5633/5634 also have "study carriages".**
1 题面：Does only the train No.5609/5610 have "study carriages"；原文 "Some other slow trains also have their own bright 'study carriages', including No. 5619/5620 and No. 5633/5634."；疑问词 Does only…（含 only 的一般疑问）；诱导信号：首段只提 5609/5610，读者容易以为独有。
2 候选：①No＋其他车次也有；②Yes（只有它）；③No（不给反例）；④Yes, and Z150 too。
3 验算：①→Some other slow trains also have…including No. 5619/5620 and No. 5633/5634，直接否证 only→成立（答语 No, it doesn't＋反例）。②→与 some other trains also have 矛盾→不成立。③→表态对但无依据，且题干 only 要求给反例→次优。④→Yes 与事实相反；Z150 是"book bar"不是"study carriage"→排除。
4 干扰：only 是排除词，读题时最易漏；5609/5610 在首段独占一段，强化"独有"错觉。
5 意图：考"only 型一般疑问＝找反例"，并区分 study carriage 与 book bar carriage。
6 边界：若问 How many slow trains are mentioned with study carriages? 答 Three（5609/5610、5619/5620、5633/5634）。若问 What is special about No. Z150? 答 It has a "book bar" carriage for college students。
7 错误：A 答 Yes, it does.（错因：漏 only）；B 答 No.（错因：无依据）；C 答 Yes, and No. Z150 has one too.（错因：混淆两种车厢）。
8 规则：R56.2 若题干含 only 的一般疑问，then 到原文找 also／including 的反例，答 No＋其他车次（5619/5620、5633/5634）；studying carriage 与 book bar carriage 是两类，不可互换。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答（only 型）；复用 R43.3（Yes/No＋补事实），本条加"only 必找反例"。
10 自检：①only 在哪？②反例车次是哪两个？③Z150 是同一种车厢吗？

**23. 答案：The train No. Z150 (which runs between Guiyang and Beijing).**
1 题面：Which train has a "book bar" carriage；原文 "On the train No. Z150, which runs between Guiyang and Beijing, a 'book bar' carriage has been welcomed by college students."；疑问词 Which train（问车次）；诱导信号：前两段都是 slow trains（5609/5610、5619/5620、5633/5634），车次密集。
2 候选：①No. Z150；②No. 5609/5610；③No. 5619/5620；④No. 5633/5634。
3 验算：①→On the train No. Z150…a "book bar" carriage，车次与车厢名同句→成立。②③④→三趟都是 study carriages（slow trains），不是 book bar→排除。
4 干扰：四趟车次连续出现，只有 Z150 属"书吧"；Z150 前的 On the train 结构也与前文的 In some carriages 相似。
5 意图：考"车次—车厢类型同名配对"。
6 边界：若问 What is the book bar carriage used for? 答 It provides students with a lending library and some tea（at night in the dining car）。若问 How many universities are along the Z150 line? 答 Nearly 400。
7 错误：A 答 No. 5609/5610.（错因：study carriage 当 book bar）；B 答 The slow train.（错因：类型当车次）；C 答 No. 5633/5634.（错因：串车次）。
8 规则：R56.3 若问 Which train has X，then 按"车次＋车厢名"同句配对（No. Z150→book bar carriage）；同段其他车次（slow trains 三趟）不作答案；车次照抄（含 Z／斜杠）。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.45 专名配对（车次）；复用 R41.4（按名配对），本条主体是车次。
10 自检：①book bar 出现在哪句？②另外三趟是什么车厢？③车次抄对了吗？

**24. 答案：They can enjoy reading books and drinking tea for free (in the "book bar" carriage).**
1 题面：What can students do on the train No. Z150 besides starting discussions on some topics in groups；原文 "There students enjoy reading books and drinking tea for free. They even start discussions on some topics in groups."；题干 besides 已排除"讨论"；疑问词 What can students do（问活动）；诱导信号：lending library／tea／dining car 三个名词都像活动。
2 候选：①enjoy reading books and drinking tea for free；②start discussions in groups（题干已排除）；③borrow books from a lending library（同义改写）；④have dinner in the dining car。
3 验算：①→enjoy reading books and drinking tea for free，与题干 besides 后的"讨论"并列且不同→成立。②→题干 besides 已排除→不成立。③→lending library 是"读书免费"的载体，语义与①重叠，可作补充→次优。④→dining car 是场地（open at night to provide…），不是活动→排除。
4 干扰：dining car 出现两次（the train's dining car has been open at night），像"在餐车吃饭"；besides 的排除条件也常被忽略。
5 意图：考"besides 排除已给项＋活动取动词短语"。
6 边界：若问 When is the dining car open? 答 At night（since 2015）。若问 What is provided for free? 答 Books（a lending library）and tea。
7 错误：A 答 They can start discussions.（错因：题干已排除）；B 答 They can have meals in the dining car.（错因：场地当活动）；C 答 They can borrow books.（错因：改写可接受但不完整）。
8 规则：R56.4 若题干含 besides＋已给活动，then 只取与之并列的其他活动（enjoy reading books and drinking tea for free）；被排除项（start discussions）不得重写；场地（dining car／lending library）不作活动。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.48 排除域（besides）；复用 R41.5（besides 剔除同域），本条活动域是"车上可做的事"。
10 自检：①besides 后给了什么？②还有哪些活动？③dining car 是活动吗？

**25. 答案：（开放题）I think it is a good and meaningful idea. It provides a comfortable environment for students to continue their studies, and students can use the travel time to finish their homework instead of wasting it.**
1 题面：What do you think of setting up "study carriages"?——评价；可用依据：made to provide a comfortable environment for learners to continue their studies／well welcomed by many passengers／students say it's meaningful and would like to share with friends／students use the travel time to finish homework。
2 候选：①正面＋理由（舒适环境／利用旅途时间／受欢迎）；②负面＋理由（占座、影响其他乘客）；③只写 It is good；④复述车次与陈设。
3 验算：①→判断明确，两条理由都能落到原文句→成立。②→开放题允许，但须给理由（如 seats may be taken by non-students），原文未提，属外推→次优。③→空评价→不成立。④→复述事实未评价→排除。
4 干扰：全文正面（well welcomed／meaningful），诱人只写 good；陈设与车次细节多，也容易代替理由。
5 意图：考"评价＝判断＋理由"，可用原文依据也可合理外推（但须标明）。
6 边界：若问 Why were these carriages set up? 答 To provide a comfortable environment for learners to continue their studies。若问 How do students feel about them? 答 They say it's meaningful and would like to share them with friends。
7 错误：A 只写 It is good.（错因：无理由）；B 答 The train is slow.（错因：复述事实）；C 答 I don't like trains.（错因：跑题）。
8 规则：R56.5 若问 What do you think of X（措施类），then 先给判断（good／meaningful／not practical），再给 1—2 条理由，优先引原文（comfortable environment／use travel time／well welcomed）；只写 good 或复述事实都不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（措施评价）；复用 R37.5（品质＋行为）的思路，本条对象是"措施"而非人物。
10 自检：①我的判断是什么？②理由有几条？③我复述事实了吗？

**组小结（G56 · 小蓝书预测卷八 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：陈设描写（not A but B）1（21）；only 型 Yes/No 1（22）；车次—车厢配对 1（23）；besides 排除 1（24）；措施评价 1（25）。
- 规则：R56.1 陈设两侧都写（21）；R56.2 only 必找反例（22）；R56.3 车次同名配对（23）；R56.4 besides 只取并列活动（24）；R56.5 措施评价＝判断＋理由（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R56.1 与"只抄一半"冲突，两侧优先；R56.2 与"首段只提一趟"冲突，also／including 优先；R56.3 与"车次密集"冲突，同名同句优先；R56.4 与"dining car 像活动"冲突，活动动词优先；R56.5 与"全文正面"冲突，理由优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：说明文（措施类）第 2 篇；besides 排除第 3 例（R41.5／R44.5／R56.4），已可归并为一条通用规则；数字（400 universities／2015／6 or 7 p.m.）均照录，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷八 · Passage 3
