Do you ever find yourself standing in front of rubbish bins, not sure whether the piece of waste in your hand is recyclable or not? To solve this problem, four Hong Kong students have



invented a smart rubbish bin that uses AI to divide the waste. The students called the bin Waste Collection Point.

The bin uses a camera to know the kind of the waste and divides it into plastic, paper, glass or other kinds. To make sure the bin can divide waste correctly, the team tested every product in the school shop and took over 500 pictures of each one. "To train the AI, we had to take many photos from different angles, so it has a better rate of accuracy (精确度)," said one of the students.

The students had the idea of the smart bin two years ago because they saw a lot of rubbish here and there in their village. Every weekend, they had to join the villagers in picking up the waste.

The students decided to invent a special recycling bin that would encourage people to protect the environment. Although the school ended at 2 p.m., the team members would continue to work on their invention until 6 or 7 p.m. at school.

"Our bin is now in its third generation (代). Before graduation, we hope that it can be widely used in the city." The students said, "Then it will be easier than ever for people to recycle waste and protect our environment."

26. What's the name of the smart rubbish bin?

____________________

27. How can the smart rubbish bin know the kind of the waste?

____________________

28. What made the four students have the idea of the smart rubbish bin?

____________________

29. Where did the four students work on their invention?

____________________

30. Is the smart rubbish bin in its third generation?

____________________

**〔G57〕小蓝书预测卷八 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：Waste Collection Point.**
1 题面：What's the name of the smart rubbish bin；原文 "The students called the bin Waste Collection Point."；疑问词 What's the name（问专名）；诱导信号：同段有 AI／camera／plastic／paper／glass 等词，专名反而不显眼。
2 候选：①Waste Collection Point；②smart rubbish bin；③AI bin；④recycling bin。
3 验算：①→called the bin Waste Collection Point，called＋宾语＋宾补结构直接给名→成立（专名首字母大写照抄）。②→smart rubbish bin 是类别描述，不是名字→次优。③→AI bin 是读者概括，原文无→排除。④→recycling bin 出自"decided to invent a special recycling bin"，是泛称→次优。
4 干扰：Waste Collection Point 是三个普通词组合，容易被当成"垃圾收集点"这一普通名词而不敢当名字；括号外的专名也没有引号。
5 意图：考"called＋宾补取专名，且专名照抄"。
6 边界：若问 Who invented the bin? 答 Four Hong Kong students。若问 What can the bin divide waste into? 答 Plastic, paper, glass or other kinds。
7 错误：A 答 A smart rubbish bin.（错因：类别当名字）；B 答 Waste collection point.（错因：大小写改动专名）；C 答 AI.（错因：技术当名字）。
8 规则：R57.1 若问 What's the name of X，then 取 called＋宾语＋宾补中的专名（Waste Collection Point），大小写照抄；类别描述（smart rubbish bin）与泛称（recycling bin）不作名字。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.45 专名（命名结构 called）；复用 R23.1（称号不入空的反向：此处称号正是答案）。
10 自检：①called 后面是什么？②专名大小写抄对了吗？③我写的是类别吗？

**27. 答案：It uses a camera to know the kind of the waste (and then divides it into plastic, paper, glass or other kinds).**
1 题面：How can the smart rubbish bin know the kind of the waste；原文 "The bin uses a camera to know the kind of the waste and divides it into plastic, paper, glass or other kinds."；疑问词 How（问手段）；诱导信号：后文 AI／500 pictures／different angles 都在解释"怎么更准"，容易把训练过程当识别手段。
2 候选：①uses a camera（to know the kind）；②takes over 500 pictures of each product；③uses AI to divide the waste；④trains the AI from different angles。
3 验算：①→uses a camera to know the kind of the waste，How 与 uses 直接对应→成立。②→500 pictures 是测试／训练过程，不是识别手段→次优。③→uses AI 是首段的概括（a smart rubbish bin that uses AI），与 camera 并存，可作补充→次优。④→different angles 是拍照方式，属训练细节→排除。
4 干扰：AI 是全文关键词（uses AI to divide the waste），最容易被当"怎么知道"；500 张照片的数字也醒目。
5 意图：考"How 取 uses＋工具的不定式目的"，区分"识别手段"与"训练过程"。
6 边界：若问 Why did the team take many photos? 答 To train the AI so that it has a better rate of accuracy。若问 What does the bin divide waste into? 答 Plastic, paper, glass or other kinds。
7 错误：A 答 By taking over 500 pictures.（错因：训练过程当识别手段）；B 答 By using AI.（错因：概括可作补充，但未答"怎么知道"）；C 答 By testing every product.（错因：测试当手段）。
8 规则：R57.2 若问 How can X do sth，then 取 uses＋工具＋to do 目的（uses a camera to know the kind）；测试／训练细节（500 pictures／different angles）是保证准确度的过程，不作识别手段；AI 可作概括补充。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（uses 工具）；复用 R15.3（use 取手段），本条是"手段＋目的"。
10 自检：①uses 后是什么？②500 张照片属哪一步？③AI 与 camera 什么关系？

**28. 答案：Because they saw a lot of rubbish here and there in their village and had to join the villagers in picking up the waste every weekend.**
1 题面：What made the four students have the idea of the smart rubbish bin；原文 "The students had the idea of the smart bin two years ago because they saw a lot of rubbish here and there in their village. Every weekend, they had to join the villagers in picking up the waste."；疑问词 What made sb have the idea（问起因）；诱导信号：下一句"decided to invent a special recycling bin that would encourage people to protect the environment"是目的，语气更像"原因"。
2 候选：①saw much rubbish＋had to pick up waste every weekend；②to encourage people to protect the environment；③to solve the problem of bins（首段设问）；④because the school shop sold many products。
3 验算：①→because they saw a lot of rubbish…＋Every weekend, they had to join…picking up，because 从句＋补充事实，是起因→成立。②→that would encourage people… 是发明的目的，不是"产生想法"的起因→次优。③→首段设问是全文引子，指向"垃圾该不该回收"，非这四个学生的具体起因→排除。④→school shop 是测试地点→排除。
4 干扰：encourage people to protect the environment 价值更高，容易被当作"动机"；首段的设问句也像"起因"。
5 意图：考"have the idea 后的 because 从句＋补充事实"，区分起因与目的。
6 边界：若问 What did they decide to invent? 答 A special recycling bin that would encourage people to protect the environment。若问 What did they do every weekend? 答 They joined the villagers in picking up the waste。
7 错误：A 答 To encourage people to protect the environment.（错因：目的当起因）；B 答 Because the bins were too small.（错因：无据）；C 答 Because they wanted to win a prize.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R57.3 若问 What made sb have the idea，then 取 have the idea…because 后的起因句＋紧邻的补充事实（saw rubbish／picked up waste）；that would… 引导的目的是结果，不作起因；首段设问只是引子。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（起因 vs 目的）；复用 R14.3（触发行为的前一句事实即原因），本条触发是"看到垃圾"。
10 自检：①because 从句在哪？②encourage 句是原因还是目的？③我用了首段设问吗？

**29. 答案：At school — they continued to work on their invention at school until 6 or 7 p.m.**
1 题面：Where did the four students work on their invention；原文 "Although the school ended at 2 p.m., the team members would continue to work on their invention until 6 or 7 p.m. at school."；疑问词 Where（问地点）；诱导信号：in their village 出现在上一段（起因），Hong Kong 在第一段（身份）。
2 候选：①at school；②in their village；③in Hong Kong；④in the school shop。
3 验算：①→continue to work on their invention until 6 or 7 p.m. at school，地点状语 at school 直接给出→成立（可补时段）。②→village 是捡垃圾／产生想法的地方→排除。③→Hong Kong 是身份来源（four Hong Kong students），范围过大→次优。④→school shop 是测试产品的地方→排除。
4 干扰：village 与 school 都在文中出现且都与"干活"有关；Hong Kong 作为地名出现两次。
5 意图：考"Where 取工作句的地点状语，不取起因／身份地点"。
6 边界：若问 When did they work on the invention? 答 After school, until 6 or 7 p.m.（学校 2 点放学）。若问 Where did they test products? 答 In the school shop。
7 错误：A 答 In their village.（错因：起因地点）；B 答 In Hong Kong.（错因：身份地点、范围过大）；C 答 In the school shop.（错因：测试地点）。
8 规则：R57.4 若问 Where did sb work on sth，then 取工作句的地点状语（at school），可补时段（until 6 or 7 p.m.）；同段的起因地点（village）／身份地点（Hong Kong）／测试地点（shop）不混用。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（工作地点 vs 起因地点）；复用 R54.3（Where 取 to 后目的地），本条是 at 状语。
10 自检：①工作句在哪？②village 是什么地点？③我写 Hong Kong 了吗？

**30. 答案：Yes, it is. The bin is now in its third generation.**
1 题面：Is the smart rubbish bin in its third generation；原文 "Our bin is now in its third generation (代). Before graduation, we hope that it can be widely used in the city."；疑问词 Is…（一般疑问）；诱导信号：紧随其后是"希望毕业后推广"，读者可能把"希望"误当成"还没做到第三代"。
2 候选：①Yes, it is（third generation）；②No, it isn't（只是希望）；③Yes, it is widely used in the city；④Yes, it will be in its third generation。
3 验算：①→Our bin is now in its third generation，now＋is 表示已完成的事实→成立。②→与 now is 矛盾→不成立。③→widely used 是 hope，尚未实现→不成立（把希望当事实）。④→will be 与 now is 时态冲突→排除。
4 干扰：hope that it can be widely used 是未来愿望，紧接在"第三代"之后，容易把两件事合并；third generation 的括号注释也可能被忽略。
5 意图：考"Yes/No 只按题干事实答，未来愿望不作现状"。
6 边界：若问 Will the bin be widely used in the city? 答 They hope so, before graduation（尚未发生）。若问 How many generations has the bin had? 答 Three。
7 错误：A 答 No, it isn't.（错因：把 hope 当否定现状）；B 答 Yes, and it is widely used now.（错因：愿望当事实）；C 答 Yes, it will be.（错因：时态错）。
8 规则：R57.5 若题干为 Is…?（现状），then 只按原文现状句（is now in its third generation）答 Yes, it is；同段的 hope／will 句属未来愿望，不作现状证据，也不改答语。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答（现状 vs 愿望）；复用 R43.3（Yes/No＋补事实）与 R20.4（情态不升格）。
10 自检：①现状句是哪句？②hope 句属现在还是将来？③我的答语与时态一致吗？

**组小结（G57 · 小蓝书预测卷八 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：专名（called）1（26）；手段（uses）1（27）；起因 vs 目的 1（28）；工作地点 1（29）；Yes/No（现状 vs 愿望）1（30）。
- 规则：R57.1 专名照抄（26）；R57.2 手段取 uses＋to do（27）；R57.3 起因取 because＋事实（28）；R57.4 工作地点 at school（29）；R57.5 现状答 Yes、愿望不作证（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R57.1 与"类别描述像名字"冲突，called 宾补优先；R57.2 与"AI 是关键词"冲突，uses a camera 优先；R57.3 与"encourage 价值更高"冲突，because 优先；R57.4 与"village 也干活"冲突，工作句优先；R57.5 与"hope 紧邻"冲突，now is 优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：发明类说明文第 2 篇（G43 采藕机器人／本条智能垃圾桶），两篇结构一致（起因→做法→测试→展望），可作 04 的"发明类模板"；数字（500 pictures／third generation／6 or 7 p.m.）均照录，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷八 · Passage 4

It was a cold January morning. A man sat at a subway station in Washington DC and started to play the violin. When the musician played, thousands of people went through the station, but most of them didn't stop.

A few minutes went by and a middle-aged man noticed there was a musician playing



music. He slowed down and stopped for a few seconds and then he walked away hurriedly. Four minutes after he played the violin, the violinist received his first tip. A woman threw the money in the violin case without stopping and continued to walk.

In the musician's 45-minute performance, only 6 people stopped and stayed for a while. About 20 gave him money but continued to walk. He collected $32 in all. When he finished playing and silence took over, no one noticed it.

No one knew the violinist was Joshua Bell, one of the best musicians in the world. Two days before his playing at the subway station, the tickets for Joshua Bell's performance were sold out at a theater in Boston and the seats each cost 100 dollars.

Joshua Bell's playing in the subway station was a social experiment. It asks questions: in a common environment at a wrong hour, do we enjoy beauty? Do we stop to make a response? If we do not have a moment to stop and listen to one of the best musicians in the world playing the best music, how many things are we missing? So don't miss the wonderful moment in life!

31. What was the weather like that day?

____________________

32. When did the musician get his first tip?

____________________

33. How long did the musician play?

____________________

34. How many people recognized (认出) the musician at the subway station?

____________________

35. What does the writer suggest?

____________________

**〔G58〕小蓝书预测卷八 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：It was cold (it was a cold January morning).**
1 题面：What was the weather like that day；原文 "It was a cold January morning."；疑问词 What was the weather like（问天气）；诱导信号：January 是月份，morning 是时段，都不是天气。
2 候选：①cold；②January（月份）；③morning（时段）；④windy／rainy（外推）。
3 验算：①→cold 是 weather 的直接描写→成立（可写成 It was cold）。②→January 是时间，不是天气→不成立。③→morning 是时段→排除。④→原文无风／雨→排除。
4 干扰：cold January morning 三个词连写，学生容易把整个短语当答案或只抄 January；cold 与后文"没人停下"的氛围也容易被忽略。
5 意图：考"weather 只取形容词，时间词不作天气"。
6 边界：若问 When did the story happen? 答 On a cold January morning。若问 Where did it happen? 答 At a subway station in Washington DC。
7 错误：A 答 January.（错因：月份当天气）；B 答 A morning.（错因：时段当天气）；C 答 Sunny.（错因：外推）。
8 规则：R58.1 若问 What was the weather like，then 只取形容词性描写（cold）；同句的月份（January）与时段（morning）属时间，不作天气；原文没有的天气（windy／rainy）不补。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.38 环境／外观描写；复用 R26.3（look like 取外形层次），本条是天气词。
10 自检：①哪个词是天气？②January 是什么？③我加原文没有的天气了吗？

**32. 答案：Four minutes after he began playing (the violin).**
1 题面：When did the musician get his first tip；原文 "Four minutes after he played the violin, the violinist received his first tip."；疑问词 When（问时间点）；诱导信号：上一段有 A few minutes went by 与 stopped for a few seconds，都是"几分钟"。
2 候选：①four minutes after he played；②a few minutes later；③a few seconds；④after 45 minutes。
3 验算：①→Four minutes after he played the violin, the violinist received his first tip，时间＋事件同句→成立。②→A few minutes went by 是叙述推进，指中年前经过，不是第一次收到钱的时间→排除。③→a few seconds 是他停留的时长→排除。④→45 minutes 是整场演出时长→排除。
4 干扰：段落里多个时间短语（a few minutes／a few seconds／Four minutes／45-minute），不按事件配对就会串。
5 意图：考"时间点按事件配对（first tip 对应 four minutes）"。
6 边界：若问 How long did the middle-aged man stop? 答 For a few seconds。若问 How long did the performance last? 答 45 minutes。
7 错误：A 答 A few minutes later.（错因：叙述推进当时间点）；B 答 After a few seconds.（错因：停留时长）；C 答 After 45 minutes.（错因：总时长）。
8 规则：R58.2 若问 When did sb get／do sth，then 取与该事件同句的时间短语（Four minutes after he played the violin）；段落里其他时间（a few minutes／a few seconds／45-minute）按各自事件归属，不串用。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（按事件配对）；复用 R16.3（多年份按动词配对），本条是"多时间短语按事件配对"。
10 自检：①first tip 与哪个时间同句？②a few minutes 指什么？③45 minutes 是什么？

**33. 答案：For 45 minutes.**
1 题面：How long did the musician play；原文 "In the musician's 45-minute performance, only 6 people stopped and stayed for a while."；疑问词 How long（问时长）；诱导信号：同段还有 a while、a few seconds、four minutes，都是时长／时点。
2 候选：①45 minutes；②a while；③a few seconds；④four minutes。
3 验算：①→45-minute performance 是整场演出时长→成立。②→only 6 people stopped and stayed for a while 指 6 人的停留，不是演出时长→排除。③→a few seconds 是中年前停留→排除。④→four minutes 是首次收到钱的时间点→排除。
4 干扰：45-minute 是复合形容词（带连字符），学生可能答成 45 minute 或只答 45。
5 意图：考"时长取复合形容词／for＋时长"，且不与个别观众的停留时长混淆。
6 边界：若问 How long did the 6 people stay? 答 For a while。若问 How much money did he collect? 答 $32 in all。
7 错误：A 答 For a while.（错因：观众停留时长）；B 答 45.（错因：漏单位）；C 答 Four minutes.（错因：时点当长度）。
8 规则：R58.3 若问 How long did X last／play，then 取整体时长的表达（45-minute performance／for 45 minutes），单位不丢；个别对象的停留时长（a while／a few seconds）不作整体时长。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（时长）；复用 R6.4（频率句取同句成分），本条是"复合形容词转时长"。
10 自检：①45-minute 修饰谁？②a while 是谁的时长？③单位写了吗？

**34. 答案：None (no one recognized him — no one knew the violinist was Joshua Bell).**
1 题面：How many people recognized (认出) the musician at the subway station；原文 "No one knew the violinist was Joshua Bell, one of the best musicians in the world."；疑问词 How many（问人数）；诱导信号：前段有 only 6 people stopped、About 20 gave him money、$32，都是数字。
2 候选：①none／no one；②6；③20；④32。
3 验算：①→No one knew the violinist was Joshua Bell，即无人认出→成立。②→6 是停下并停留的人，不一定认出→排除。③→20 是给钱的人→排除。④→32 是金额，不是人数→排除。
4 干扰：三个数字连续出现，最容易被当成"认出的人数"；但原文的 No one 才是关键。
5 意图：考"recognized 取 No one 句，不取行为人数"，并识别"给出数字≠回答问题"。
6 边界：若问 How many people stopped and stayed for a while? 答 Six。若问 How many people gave him money? 答 About 20。
7 错误：A 答 6.（错因：停留人数当认出人数）；B 答 20.（错因：给钱人数）；C 答 32.（错因：金额当人数）。
8 规则：R58.4 若问 How many people recognized sb，then 取明确否定的 No one／None 句（No one knew the violinist was Joshua Bell）；同段的行为人数（6 stopped／20 gave money）与金额（$32）各归其题，不作认出人数。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（否定数量）；复用 R45.2（清点），本条是"零数量由 No one 表达"。
10 自检：①哪句说"没人认出"？②6 和 20 各是什么？③$32 是人数吗？

**35. 答案：The writer suggests that we should not miss the wonderful moments in life — we should stop and enjoy beauty when it appears.**
1 题面：What does the writer suggest；原文 "If we do not have a moment to stop and listen to one of the best musicians in the world playing the best music, how many things are we missing? So don't miss the wonderful moment in life!"；疑问词 What does the writer suggest（问写作建议）；诱导信号：全文主体是"地铁站实验"，读者容易答"做社会实验"。
2 候选：①don't miss the wonderful moment in life（停下来欣赏美）；②do a social experiment in the subway；③listen to Joshua Bell's concerts；④give money to street musicians。
3 验算：①→So don't miss the wonderful moment in life!，So 引出建议，与前面反问同向→成立。②→social experiment 是这件事的性质，不是给读者的建议→次优。③→听 Bell 的音乐会是具体化过头，原文建议是"别错过生活中的美好"→次优。④→给钱是文中路人的行为，不是建议→排除。
4 干扰：社会实验的设问句（do we enjoy beauty? do we stop?）很有思辨感，容易被当成"建议"；$32 与 100 美元票价的对比也抢注意。
5 意图：考"suggest 取 So 后的祈使句，实验性质不作建议"。
6 边界：若问 What was the social experiment about? 答 Whether people would stop to enjoy beauty in a common environment at a wrong hour。若问 How much were the concert tickets? 答 100 dollars each。
7 错误：A 答 To do a social experiment.（错因：性质当建议）；B 答 To buy concert tickets.（错因：具体化过头）；C 答 To give money to musicians.（错因：行为当建议）。
8 规则：R58.5 若问 What does the writer suggest，then 取 So 后的祈使句（don't miss the wonderful moment in life），并与前文反问同向理解；社会实验的性质、票价、给钱行为都不作建议。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.18 建议／启示（So 祈使句）；复用 R28.5（启示＝道理＋解释），本条建议由 So 引出。
10 自检：①So 后是什么？②反问句与它同向吗？③实验是建议吗？

**组小结（G58 · 小蓝书预测卷八 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：天气 1（31）；首次小费时间 1（32）；演出时长 1（33）；认出人数（零数量）1（34）；写作建议 1（35）。
- 规则：R58.1 天气取形容词（31）；R58.2 时间按事件配对（32）；R58.3 时长取整体表达（33）；R58.4 认出人数取 No one（34）；R58.5 建议取 So 祈使句（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R58.1 与"January 是时间"冲突，形容词优先；R58.2 与"多个时间短语"冲突，同句配对优先；R58.3 与"a while 也是时长"冲突，整体时长优先；R58.4 与"数字密集"冲突，No one 优先；R58.5 与"实验性质"冲突，So 祈使句优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：叙事＋社会实验类首见；本篇数字最密（45 minutes／6／20／$32／100 dollars／2 days），但全部按事件配对或作对比，**无一题需要换算或相减**——差值题在小蓝书 58 篇内仍为 0；**小蓝书卷八 4 篇至此完成（G55—G58）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷六 · Passage 1

Iceland (冰岛) is a northern European country with amazing natural beauty and oceans around. There are lots of volcanoes (火山). It has a short summer which lasts from June to August. The long winter starts from September and ends next May.

Summer in Iceland is a golden season for tourists. Every year, people from all over the world come here to see the beautiful sights and enjoy the exciting whale-seeing (观鲸).



In winter, when people in Iceland complete their daily work, they will have a lot of special activities to spend the long dark night. Skating, riding snow motorbikes and having parties can really make an exciting night. After all the fun, a hot bath must be the first thing they want to do. There are also story telling activities for children, which can teach them to be strong and kind. The most popular stories are about Christmas in Iceland.

Because of a long cold winter, Iceland has a short growing season. Food problem was always a headache for Iceland in the past. It had to buy most of its food from other countries. Later, when farmers learned to use lights and underground heat to grow crops (庄稼) all year round in the greenhouse, things changed a lot.

Living in such a nice environment, most people in Iceland live a happy life. According to a survey about happiness made each year in Europe, Iceland is always among the top 3.

16. When is summer in Iceland?

It is from __________.

17. How can people spend an exciting night in winter?

People can skate, __________ and have parties.

18. What are the most popular stories about in Iceland?

The most popular stories are about __________ in Iceland.

19. Why does Iceland have a short growing season?

Because they have __________.

20. What does this passage mainly talk about?

It mainly talks about some information about __________.

**〔G59〕小蓝书预测卷六 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

> 本组为**补全式简答**（RA-5），五题分别落在时间段、并列动词、介词宾语、have 宾语、about 宾语五个位置。

**16. 答案：June to August（It is from June to August.）**
1 题面：When is summer in Iceland?；框架 "It is from __________."；空位在介词 from 后，须为时间起点＋终点；原文 "It has a short summer which lasts from June to August."；诱导信号：上句还有 northern European／volcanoes 等地理信息。
2 候选：①June to August；②June；③August；④summer。
3 验算：①→lasts from June to August，与 from…（to…）框架严丝合缝→成立。②→只给起点，缺终点，from 悬空→不成立。③→只给终点，无起点→排除。④→summer 是季节名，题干已给 summer，重复且非时段→排除。
4 干扰：from 后容易只抄第一个月份 June；题干 When 也可能诱导答"in summer"。
5 意图：考"from 框架必须补成 from A to B 的完整时段"。
6 边界：若问 How long does summer last? 答 From June to August（约三个月）。若问 When does winter start? 答 In September。
7 错误：A 填 June.（错因：缺终点）；B 填 summer.（错因：重复题干）；C 填 June to August, 2017.（错因：加原文没有的年份）。
8 规则：R59.1 若补全式以 from __________ 结尾，then 必须填"起点 to 终点"的完整时段（June to August），只填一端即不成立；季节名与题干重复，不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（介词 from 的时段宾语）；复用 R8.4（时间介词层级），本条是"from…to…"框架。
10 自检：①from 后要几段？②原文的起点终点各是什么？③我重复 summer 了吗？

**17. 答案：ride snow motorbikes（People can skate, ride snow motorbikes and have parties.）**
1 题面：How can people spend an exciting night in winter?；框架 "People can skate, __________ and have parties."；空位在并列谓语中，前有 can skate、后有 have parties，须为**动词原形**；原文 "Skating, riding snow motorbikes and having parties can really make an exciting night."；诱导信号：原文用动名词（Skating／riding／having），框架改成 can＋原形。
2 候选：①ride snow motorbikes；②riding snow motorbikes（照抄原文形式）；③snow motorbikes（只取名词）；④to ride snow motorbikes。
3 验算：①→can skate, ride…and have parties，三个原形并列，与 can 一致→成立。②→can skating 不成立（情态动词后须原形）→排除。③→缺谓语，与 skate／have 不并列→排除。④→can…to ride 不成立→排除。
4 干扰：原文三处都是动名词，直接照抄最省事；框架中间的空位也容易被当成名词位。
5 意图：考"补全式须随框架改形式"：原文动名词→框架 can＋原形。
6 边界：若问 What can make an exciting night? 答 Skating, riding snow motorbikes and having parties。若问 What do people want to do after the fun? 答 (To take) a hot bath。
7 错误：A 填 riding snow motorbikes.（错因：形式未随框架改）；B 填 snow motorbikes.（错因：缺动词）；C 填 to ride snow motorbikes.（错因：不定式与 can 冲突）。
8 规则：R59.2 若补全式空位处在情态动词 can＋并列谓语中，then 填动词原形（ride snow motorbikes），原文的动名词形式须改写；只填名词或不定式都破坏并列。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（情态动词后原形）；复用 R16.4（框架裁剪只填定语）的反向情形：本条是"形式随框架改"。
10 自检：①空位在 can 后吗？②原文是什么形式？③我照抄动名词了吗？

**18. 答案：Christmas（The most popular stories are about Christmas in Iceland.）**
1 题面：What are the most popular stories about in Iceland?；框架 "The most popular stories are about __________ in Iceland."；空位在介词 about 后，须为名词性成分；原文 "The most popular stories are about Christmas in Iceland."；诱导信号：上一句 story telling activities for children 也像"故事"的答案。
2 候选：①Christmas；②story telling activities；③children；④the long dark night。
3 验算：①→The most popular stories are about Christmas，与框架逐字对应→成立。②→story telling activities 是活动形式，不是"故事内容"→排除。③→children 是听故事的人→排除。④→the long dark night 是时间背景→排除。
4 干扰：story telling 与 stories 同根，容易被当成答案；Christmas 是节日名，学生可能犹豫要不要加 stories。
5 意图：考"about 后取内容名词，不取活动名／听众"。
6 边界：若问 What can story telling teach children? 答 To be strong and kind。若问 When do people have these activities? 答 In winter（during the long dark night）。
7 错误：A 填 story telling.（错因：活动名当内容）；B 填 children.（错因：听众）；C 填 Christmas stories.（错因：加原文没有的 stories，重复）。
8 规则：R59.3 若补全式空位在 about 后，then 填故事／话题的内容名词（Christmas）；同句的活动名（story telling）、听众（children）与时间背景（the long dark night）都不作内容。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（介词 about 的宾语）；复用 R6.1（介词前置取宾语）。
10 自检：①about 后要名词吗？②原文 about 后是什么？③我加了 stories 吗？

**19. 答案：a long cold winter（Because they have a long cold winter.）**
1 题面：Why does Iceland have a short growing season?；框架 "Because they have __________."；空位在 have 后作宾语，须为名词短语；原文 "Because of a long cold winter, Iceland has a short growing season."；诱导信号：原文用 because of＋名词，框架改成 because they have＋宾语，须把介词短语转为宾语。
2 候选：①a long cold winter；②because of a long cold winter（整段照搬）；③long cold（只取形容词）；④a short growing season（题干已含）。
3 验算：①→Because they have a long cold winter，have＋名词宾语，与原文 because of 的宾语一致→成立。②→have because of… 不成立（介词短语不能作 have 宾语）→排除。③→have long cold 缺名词中心→排除。④→循环（用结果解释结果）→排除。
4 干扰：原文 because of 结构完整，整段照抄最省事；winter 与 growing season 的因果方向也容易倒。
5 意图：考"because of＋名词 → because＋主语＋have＋名词"的框架转换。
6 边界：若问 What is the weather like in winter in Iceland? 答 Long and cold（from September to next May）。若问 How did farmers solve the food problem? 答 They used lights and underground heat to grow crops all year round in the greenhouse。
7 错误：A 填 because of a long cold winter.（错因：介词短语占 have 宾语位）；B 填 long and cold.（错因：缺名词）；C 填 a short growing season.（错因：循环）。
8 规则：R59.4 若补全式为 Because they have __________，then 把原文 because of＋名词的宾语（a long cold winter）转成 have 的宾语，保留限定词 a；不得整段照搬 because of，也不得用结果（short growing season）作答。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.2 数量／名词短语位；复用 R51.5（because of 转 there be），本条是"because of 转 have"。
10 自检：①have 后要什么？②原文 because of 后是什么？③我照搬 because of 了吗？

**20. 答案：Iceland（It mainly talks about some information about Iceland.）**
1 题面：What does this passage mainly talk about?；框架 "It mainly talks about some information about __________."；空位在 about 后，须为国家／地点名；诱导信号：全文分写 summer／winter／food／happiness 四块，容易答"冰岛的冬天"或"冰岛的食物"。
2 候选：①Iceland；②Iceland's winter；③Icelandic food；④the happiness survey。
3 验算：①→四段都在写冰岛（地理、夏冬、农业、幸福感），about Iceland 能罩住全文→成立。②→只罩第三段→排除。③→只罩第四段一半→排除。④→只罩末段一句→排除。
4 干扰：四个小主题各自成段，抓一段就答会过窄；题干 some information about 也提示要"上位对象"。
5 意图：考"主旨补全式取上位对象，局部主题不作主旨"。
6 边界：若问 What is the passage mainly about?（无框架）答 Iceland — its natural beauty, seasons, food and happy life。若问 Which country is always among the top 3 in the happiness survey? 答 Iceland。
7 错误：A 填 Iceland's winter.（错因：局部主题）；B 填 volcanoes.（错因：首段细节）；C 填 the happiness survey.（错因：末段一句）。
8 规则：R59.5 若补全式为 It mainly talks about some information about __________，then 填能覆盖全部段落的上位对象（Iceland）；分述主题（winter／food／happiness）与首段细节（volcanoes）都不作主旨。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（about 宾语）＋RA-3.1 主旨；复用 R41.2（主旨取总＋分范围）。
10 自检：①四段共同对象是谁？②我的答案罩得住四段吗？③我抓了哪一段？

**组小结（G59 · 小蓝书预测卷六 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：时段（from…to…）1（16）；并列谓语原形 1（17）；about 内容 1（18）；because of→have 1（19）；主旨上位对象 1（20）。**整组为补全式（RA-5）**。
- 规则：R59.1 from 补全时段（16）；R59.2 情态动词后改原形（17）；R59.3 about 取内容（18）；R59.4 because of 转 have 宾语（19）；R59.5 主旨取上位对象（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R59.1 与"只抄 June"冲突，两端齐全优先；R59.2 与"照抄动名词"冲突，框架形式优先；R59.3 与"story telling 同根"冲突，about 宾语优先；R59.4 与"整段照搬"冲突，have 宾语位优先；R59.5 与"局部主题最具体"冲突，覆盖优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：补全式样本第 3 组（G51／G52／G59），本组新增"形式随框架改"（动名词→原形）与"because of→have"两种转换；数字（June／August／September／top 3）均照录，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷六 · Passage 2

Traveling to another country is exciting and fun. But if you don't learn about local customs, your trip may get into trouble. Here are some cultural taboos (禁忌) in several countries.

**Mexico**

In Mexico, bringing an expensive gift to someone's home is a no-no. For local people, some simple things like flowers are good gifts. But you shouldn't take along red flowers, because in Mexican culture, <u>they</u> are symbols of death and can be connected with witchcraft (巫术).

**The US**



Americans have a custom of tipping (给小费 ). You should tip nearly anyone with a service job, such as waiters, taxi drivers, hotel doormen, etc.

Pay attention when you talk with Americans. Questions like "How old are you?" may be common between friends. But as tourists in the US, it is not polite to ask people's age.

**Britain**

From the supermarket to the underground station, queuing (排队) is very common in Britain. Usually, it takes a British person six months of his or her life in queues. If you jump the queue there, you may make them angry.

**Japan**

You should never wear shoes indoors in Japan. When visiting someone's home, it is rude to enter with shoes on. Shoes should be taken off at the door and replaced with indoor slippers. This is also the same when you try clothes on in a clothes shop. You should take off your shoes before going into the fitting room. There are indoor shoes prepared for customers inside.

21. What does the underlined word "they" in Paragraph 2 refer to?

It refers to "__________".

22. Who should be tipped in the US?

__________ should be tipped in the US.

23. How long does it usually take a British person in queues?

It usually takes a British person __________ of his or her life in queues.

24. Which word means "粗鲁的" in the last paragraph?

It's "__________".

25. What is the passage mainly about?

It is mainly about __________.

**〔G60〕小蓝书预测卷六 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

> 补全式（RA-5）第二组。特色：**第 24 题是"中文释义→英文找词"的反向词义题**，与前面"英文词→释义"方向相反。

**21. 答案：red flowers（It refers to "red flowers".）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "they" in Paragraph 2 refer to?；框架 "It refers to "__________"."；原文 "But you shouldn't take along red flowers, because in Mexican culture, <u>they</u> are symbols of death and can be connected with witchcraft (巫术)."；原卷该词有下划线（转写以 <u> 保留）；诱导信号：symbols of death 在 they 之后，且是复数。
2 候选：①red flowers；②flowers；③symbols of death；④witchcraft。
3 验算：①→they are symbols of death，回指前一分句的宾语 red flowers（复数）→成立。②→flowers 丢 red，原文特意强调"红花"→次优（不完整）。③→symbols of death 是 they 的表语，不是 they 本身→排除。④→witchcraft 在并列谓语 can be connected with 之后→排除。
4 干扰：symbols of death 与 they 数一致、位置最近，最易被当回指对象；flowers 少了 red 也读得通。
5 意图：考"代词回指取前句的完整名词短语，不取本句表语"。
6 边界：若问 Why shouldn't you take red flowers to a Mexican home? 答 Because they are symbols of death and can be connected with witchcraft。若问 What gifts are good in Mexico? 答 Simple things like flowers（but not red ones）。
7 错误：A 填 symbols of death.（错因：表语当回指）；B 填 flowers.（错因：丢限定词 red）；C 填 witchcraft.（错因：并列宾语）。
8 规则：R60.1 若问代词 they 指代，then 取前一分句的完整名词短语（red flowers，含限定词），不取本句表语（symbols of death）与并列宾语（witchcraft）；限定词 red 不能省。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.1 代词回指（完整短语优先）；复用 R51.3（施受关系优先），本条强调"限定词不省"。
10 自检：①they 前一句的宾语是什么？②symbols 是表语吗？③red 丢了吗？

**22. 答案：Nearly anyone with a service job (such as waiters, taxi drivers and hotel doormen).**
1 题面：Who should be tipped in the US?；框架 "__________ should be tipped in the US."；空位在句首作主语，须为"人"的名词短语；原文 "You should tip nearly anyone with a service job, such as waiters, taxi drivers, hotel doormen, etc."；诱导信号：such as 后的三个职业很具体，容易被直接抄成答案。
2 候选：①nearly anyone with a service job；②waiters, taxi drivers and hotel doormen；③Americans；④tourists。
3 验算：①→nearly anyone with a service job 作主语，主动改被动后语义不变→成立（后半可补举例）。②→只举三例，漏 "nearly anyone" 的总括，答案偏窄→次优。③→Americans 是被给小费的一方，不是给的人→排除。④→tourists 是行为主体（You），不是被给对象→排除。
4 干扰：三个职业具体好抄，但原文用 nearly anyone 先总括再举例；被动句的主语位也容易让人误填"给小费的人"。
5 意图：考"被动框架下主动句宾语→主语"的转换，并保留总括词。
6 边界：若问 What is the custom of tipping in the US? 答 You should tip nearly anyone with a service job。若问 What question is not polite to ask Americans? 答 How old are you?
7 错误：A 填 Waiters and taxi drivers.（错因：只举例、漏总括）；B 填 Americans.（错因：把受事当施事）；C 填 You.（错因：主动句主语直接搬入被动框架）。
8 规则：R60.2 若补全式为 __________ should be tipped（被动），then 把原文主动句的宾语（nearly anyone with a service job）提为主语，保留总括限定（nearly anyone）；such as 举例可补但不替代总括；原主动句主语 You 不入位。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（被动主语位）；复用 R51.2（主语位取名词），本条加"主动改被动"。
10 自检：①空位是主语吗？②原文动词的宾语是谁？③总括词 nearly 丢了吗？

**23. 答案：six months（It usually takes a British person six months of his or her life in queues.）**
1 题面：How long does it usually take a British person in queues?；框架 "It usually takes a British person __________ of his or her life in queues."；空位在 takes sb 后、of his or her life 前，须为时长；原文 "Usually, it takes a British person six months of his or her life in queues."；诱导信号：框架已含 of his or her life，抄全句会重复。
2 候选：①six months；②six months of his or her life（重复框架）；③six years；④half a year。
3 验算：①→takes a British person six months of his or her life，与原文一致且不重复框架→成立。②→框架已有 of his or her life，重复→次优（冗余）。③→six years 与原文不符→排除。④→half a year 是换算改写，原文用 six months→次优（改算）。
4 干扰：of his or her life 紧跟在数字后，抄写时容易带上；six months 也可换算成 half a year，诱发"改写"。
5 意图：考"take sb＋时长＋of one's life 的框架裁剪"。
6 边界：若问 How long does a British person spend in queues in his life? 答 Six months。若问 What may happen if you jump the queue? 答 You may make them angry。
7 错误：A 填 six months of his or her life.（错因：重复框架）；B 填 six years.（错因：数字错）；C 填 half a year.（错因：换算法）。
8 规则：R60.3 若补全式空位在 take sb 之后、of one's life 之前，then 只填时长（six months），不重复框架已给的 of his or her life，也不改算成 half a year；数字照原文。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.5 框架去重与裁剪；复用 R12.5（原因＋of 短语去重），本条是"时长＋of 短语"。
10 自检：①空位后已有什么？②我重复了吗？③我把 six months 换算了没？

**24. 答案：rude（It's "rude".）**
1 题面：Which word means "粗鲁的" in the last paragraph?；框架 "It's "__________"."；末段原文（Japan）"You should never wear shoes indoors in Japan. When visiting someone's home, it is rude to enter with shoes on."；疑问方式：给中文释义找英文词（**反向词义**）；诱导信号：前文 US 段有 it is not polite to ask people's age，polite 与 rude 是反义对，且 polite 反复出现。
2 候选：①rude；②impolite；③polite；④no-no。
3 验算：①→it is rude to enter with shoes on，rude 与"粗鲁的"直接对应，且位置在末段→成立。②→impolite 原文未出现（US 段用的是 not polite）→排除。③→polite 是"有礼貌的"，与"粗鲁的"相反，且 not polite 在 US 段不在末段→不成立。④→no-no 出现在第二段（Mexico），且意为"禁忌"→排除。
4 干扰：not polite 与 rude 同义，读者可能把它"合并"成 impolite；US 段的 politeness 讨论也抢注意。
5 意图：考"给中文释义找词，须原文确有该词且在指定段落"。
6 边界：若问 Which word means "not polite" in the US paragraph? 答 polite（in "it is not polite to ask people's age"，not 否定）。若问 What does "no-no" mean? 答 Something you must not do。
7 错误：A 填 impolite.（错因：原文无此词）；B 填 polite.（错因：反义）；C 填 no-no.（错因：段落与词义都不符）。
8 规则：R60.4 若题干给中文释义要求在指定段落找英文词，then 到该段找与释义同义的原文词（rude），原文没有的词（impolite）不得自造；同篇其他段落的反义／近义词（polite／no-no）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（反向：释义→词，见 R24.2）；词义族停止扩类，本条示范"反向查找"。
10 自检：①该段有哪个词＝粗鲁？②impolite 原文有吗？③polite 在哪段？

**25. 答案：cultural taboos in several countries（It is mainly about cultural taboos in several countries.）**
1 题面：What is the passage mainly about?；框架 "It is mainly about __________."；原文首段 "Here are some cultural taboos (禁忌) in several countries."，随后分列 Mexico／The US／Britain／Japan 四节；诱导信号：四节标题清晰，任取一节都像"主旨"。
2 候选：①cultural taboos in several countries；②tipping in the US；③queuing in Britain；④how to travel abroad。
3 验算：①→首段已给总起句，四节都是它的分述→成立。②③→各只覆盖一节→排除。④→traveling 是背景（首句），文章主体是"禁忌"→次优。
4 干扰：四节标题（Mexico／The US／Britain／Japan）本身就像四个主旨；首段的 traveling 也容易被扩大成"如何出国旅行"。
5 意图：考"主旨取总起句，分节标题不作主旨"。
6 边界：若问 What is the passage mainly about in Mexico? 答 The taboo of bringing red flowers（and expensive gifts）。若问 Why should you learn about local customs? 答 Because your trip may get into trouble without them。
7 错误：A 填 tipping customs.（错因：一节当主旨）；B 填 how to travel abroad.（错因：背景当主旨）；C 填 Mexican culture.（错因：一国当全部）。
8 规则：R60.5 若问 main idea 且文首有 some…in several countries 的总起句，then 取该总起句（cultural taboos in several countries）；分节标题与单国内容只作分述，traveling 背景不扩大为主旨。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.1 主旨（总起句）；复用 R41.2（总—分主旨）与 R59.5（上位对象）。
10 自检：①首段总起句是什么？②四节各是什么？③我取了哪一节？

**组小结（G60 · 小蓝书预测卷六 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：代词回指（完整短语）1（21）；被动主语位 1（22）；时长裁剪 1（23）；**反向词义（释义→词）**1（24）；主旨总起句 1（25）。
- 规则：R60.1 they＝red flowers（21）；R60.2 主动宾语提为被动主语（22）；R60.3 时长不重复 of 短语（23）；R60.4 释义→词须原文有该词（24）；R60.5 主旨取总起句（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R60.1 与"symbols 数一致且最近"冲突，前句完整短语优先；R60.2 与"三职业最具体"冲突，总括优先；R60.3 与"抄全句"冲突，框架裁剪优先；R60.4 与"not polite≈impolite"冲突，原文用词优先；R60.5 与"分节标题清晰"冲突，总起句优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：补全式第 4 组；**反向词义第 2 例**（R24.2 按 called／引号取词 → 本条按中文释义找词），与"英文词→释义"方向互补；数字仅 six months，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷六 · Passage 3

Recently, a shocking piece of news went popular on China's media. Wu Yishu, a 16-year-old student from Shanghai, won a Chinese poetry (诗）competition in the second season of the Chinese Poetry Conference on Feb 7th, 2017. She beat other competitors because of her learning about Chinese culture and works. "I get feelings from ancient poetry that modern people cannot give me. I pay little attention to the competition result, but I love poetry, and it is enough as long as I enjoy the happiness brought by the poetry," Wu said.



In the final, Wu performed strongly in many parts, such as competitors recalling poems by looking at sand paintings and reciting (背诵) poems about the Chinese character "Jiu" as many as possible.

As early as Feb 1st, when Wu recited an ancient Chinese poem about the months of the year, someone said that Wu must have remembered at least more than 2,000 Chinese poetry. Wu's strong performance in the Chinese ancient rhythm works earned (赢得) her many fans and inspired (鼓舞) others to learn ancient works. The 1.8-meter-tall Wu said that she kept only one ancient poetry book on the bookshelf at her dormitory room instead of other books such as math, physics and chemistry books that her classmates have kept on their bookshelves.

She is known among her classmates and teachers as she loves reading poetry and wearing ancient Chinese clothes.

Wu's excellent performance pushed more and more people to learn Chinese poetry.

26. How do people know Wu Yishu?

____________________

27. Did Wu care much about the competition result?

____________________

28. From which side can we see that Wu loves poetry?

____________________

29. Why is Wu famous among her classmates and teachers?

____________________

30. What is Wu's influence in China?

____________________

**〔G61〕小蓝书预测卷六 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：Through the news that she won a Chinese poetry competition — the news went popular on China's media.**
1 题面：How do people know Wu Yishu；原文 "Recently, a shocking piece of news went popular on China's media. Wu Yishu, a 16-year-old student from Shanghai, won a Chinese poetry competition in the second season of the Chinese Poetry Conference on Feb 7th, 2017."；疑问词 How do people know（问成名途径）；诱导信号：年龄 16、身高 1.8 米、学校等身份信息也在文中。
2 候选：①她赢得诗词比赛、新闻上了中国媒体；②因为她 16 岁；③因为她身高 1.8 米；④因为她穿古装。
3 验算：①→a shocking piece of news went popular＋won a Chinese poetry competition，两句合起来正是"怎么被知道"→成立。②→年龄是身份细节，不是成名途径→排除。③→1.8-meter-tall 是外貌细节→排除。④→wearing ancient Chinese clothes 是同学习惯（第 29 题的内容），不是成名原因→次优。
4 干扰：16 岁、1.8 米这些"冷知识"很抢眼，但都不是"怎么知道她"；穿古装也像她的标志。
5 意图：考"成名途径取事件＋传播渠道（media）"。
6 边界：若问 What did Wu win? 答 A Chinese poetry competition（the second season of the Chinese Poetry Conference）。若问 How old is she? 答 Sixteen。
7 错误：A 答 Because she is 16 years old.（错因：年龄当途径）；B 答 Because she is 1.8 metres tall.（错因：外貌当途径）；C 答 Because she wears ancient clothes.（错因：串到 29 题）。
8 规则：R61.1 若问 How do people know sb，then 取"成名事件＋传播渠道"（won a Chinese poetry competition＋the news went popular on China's media）；年龄、身高、穿着等身份细节不作途径。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因／途径（成名事件）；复用 R21.2（影响力按重复出现），本条是"事件＋媒体"。
10 自检：①新闻句说了什么？②她赢了什么？③我答年龄了吗？

**27. 答案：No, she didn't. She paid little attention to the competition result.**
1 题面：Did Wu care much about the competition result；原文 "'I get feelings from ancient poetry that modern people cannot give me. I pay little attention to the competition result, but I love poetry…' Wu said."；疑问词 Did…care much（一般疑问，含程度词 much）；诱导信号：little attention 中的 little 表否定，字面像"一点关注"。
2 候选：①No, she didn't（paid little attention）；②Yes, she did（因为有 attention 一词）；③No, she didn't care at all（绝对化）；④Yes, because she won。
3 验算：①→pay little attention＝几乎不注意，much 与 little 相反，答 No＋事实→成立。②→little 是否定词，答 Yes 与原文相反→不成立。③→little 是"很少"，不是"完全不"，绝对化过头→次优。④→winning 是结果，不能证明她在意→排除。
4 干扰：attention 这个词的正面感容易让人答 Yes；little／a little 的差别也是常见失分点。
5 意图：考"little＝否定"＋"程度词 much 对应 little"。
6 边界：若问 What does Wu love? 答 Poetry（she loves poetry and enjoys the happiness it brings）。若问 Why did she win? 答 Because of her learning about Chinese culture and works。
7 错误：A 答 Yes, she did.（错因：little 当肯定）；B 答 No, she didn't care at all.（错因：绝对化）；C 答 She cared about the prize money.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R61.2 若题干含 care much 且原文用 little／few 类否定词，then 答 No＋主语＋didn't，并补原文事实（paid little attention）；little 不作"完全不"，也不因 attention 一词改答 Yes。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答（否定词 little）；复用 R43.3（Yes/No＋补事实）与 R17.2（否定还原），本条是"程度否定词"。
10 自检：①little 是肯定还是否定？②much 对应什么？③我绝对化了吗？

**28. 答案：From the fact that she kept only one ancient poetry book on her bookshelf instead of the math, physics and chemistry books her classmates kept (and from her words that she loves poetry).**
1 题面：From which side can we see that Wu loves poetry；原文 "The 1.8-meter-tall Wu said that she kept only one ancient poetry book on the bookshelf at her dormitory room instead of other books such as math, physics and chemistry books that her classmates have kept on their bookshelves."＋她的自述 "I love poetry"；疑问词 From which side（问证据来源）；诱导信号：题库式问法像要"哪个方面"这种抽象词。
2 候选：①书架只放一本诗集（不放数理化）；②她的自述 I love poetry；③她赢了比赛；④她穿古装。
3 验算：①→kept only one ancient poetry book…instead of math/physics/chemistry books，用对比行为证明"爱诗"→成立（最具体的证据）。②→自述也是证据，但属"说了什么"，本题问 side（从哪方面看得出），行为证据更贴→次优（可并列）。③→赢比赛是能力结果→排除。④→穿古装是另一条"出名"原因（29 题）→排除。
4 干扰：I love poetry 是直接表态，最省事；但题干 From which side 要的是"从哪个侧面看出来"，行为对比更合题意。
5 意图：考"证据题取具体行为（对比项），表态句只作辅助"。
6 边界：若问 How many ancient poetry books did Wu keep? 答 Only one。若问 What books do her classmates keep? 答 Math, physics and chemistry books。
7 错误：A 答 Because she said she loves poetry.（错因：只取表态，未答"从哪方面"）；B 答 Because she won the competition.（错因：能力结果）；C 答 Because she wears ancient clothes.（错因：串题）。
8 规则：R61.3 若问 From which side can we see that…，then 取具体行为证据（书架只放一本诗集、不放数理化书），表态句（I love poetry）可并列但不单独作答；比赛成绩与穿着不作"爱诗"的证据。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.13 判断依据（行为证据）；复用 R37.3（that 回指依据），本条依据是"对比行为"。
10 自检：①原文给了什么对比？②表态句能单独作答吗？③我串到穿着了吗？

**29. 答案：Because she loves reading poetry and wearing ancient Chinese clothes.**
1 题面：Why is Wu famous among her classmates and teachers；原文 "She is known among her classmates and teachers as she loves reading poetry and wearing ancient Chinese clothes."；疑问词 Why is sb famous among…（问在小范围内的出名原因）；诱导信号：全文大主题是"诗词比赛夺冠"，容易把全国出名当答案。
2 候选：①loves reading poetry and wearing ancient clothes；②won the poetry competition；③recited over 2,000 poems；④is 1.8 metres tall。
3 验算：①→is known among…as she loves reading poetry and wearing ancient Chinese clothes，as 引导原因，两句并列→成立（两条都要）。②→全国性成名，题干限定 among classmates and teachers→次优（范围不符）。③→背诗数量是全国成名的支撑→排除。④→身高是细节→排除。
4 干扰：夺冠是全文主线，读者容易忽略题干"among her classmates and teachers"这个小范围限定；两条原因中的"穿古装"很生活化，常被漏。
5 意图：考"范围限定（among…）改变原因"，全国成名≠同学间出名。
6 边界：若问 Why is Wu famous in China? 答 Because she won a Chinese poetry competition（and recited over 2,000 poems）。若问 What is she known for among classmates? 答 Reading poetry and wearing ancient clothes。
7 错误：A 答 Because she won the competition.（错因：范围不符）；B 答 Because she is tall.（错因：无据）；C 答 Because she loves poetry.（错因：漏"穿古装"）。
8 规则：R61.4 若问 Why is sb famous among a group，then 取 is known among…as 后的原因并列项（loves reading poetry＋wearing ancient Chinese clothes），范围限定优先于全文主线（夺冠）；并列两项缺一即不完整。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（范围限定）；复用 R40.2（段落限定）的思路，本条是"人群范围限定"。
10 自检：①题干限定哪个范围？②as 后有几项？③我漏了穿古装吗？

**30. 答案：Her excellent performance pushed more and more people to learn Chinese poetry (and inspired others to learn ancient works).**
1 题面：What is Wu's influence in China；原文 "Wu's strong performance in the Chinese ancient rhythm works earned her many fans and inspired others to learn ancient works."＋末句 "Wu's excellent performance pushed more and more people to learn Chinese poetry."；疑问词 What is sb's influence（问影响）；诱导信号：earned her many fans 也是"影响"的一种，但主体是她自己。
2 候选：①pushed more and more people to learn Chinese poetry（inspired others to learn ancient works）；②earned her many fans；③she won the competition；④she is 1.8 metres tall。
3 验算：①→pushed more and more people to learn／inspired others to learn，pushed／inspired 的宾语是"别人"→成立（两句同向，可合并）。②→fans 是影响的结果之一，但"影响力"更指对他人行为的作用→次优（可补充）。③→夺冠是原因，不是影响→排除。④→身高→排除。
4 干扰：earned her many fans 与 inspired others 并列在同一句，容易被只抄前半；末句 pushed 在全文最后，也容易被忽略。
5 意图：考"influence 取 pushed／inspired＋他人行为"，成名结果是次层。
6 边界：若问 What did Wu's performance earn her? 答 Many fans。若问 What does the writer think of Wu's performance? 答 It was strong／excellent。
7 错误：A 答 She earned many fans.（错因：只取结果之一）；B 答 She won the competition.（错因：原因当影响）；C 答 She became famous.（错因：笼统）。
8 规则：R61.5 若问 What is sb's influence，then 取 pushed／inspired＋others to do（more and more people learn Chinese poetry／others learn ancient works）；earned her many fans 属个人收获，可补充但非核心；夺冠原因不作影响。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.16 推断／影响（他人行为）；复用 R48.3（影响取结果句），本条影响对象是"公众"。
10 自检：①pushed 的宾语是谁？②fans 算什么？③我把原因当影响了吗？

**组小结（G61 · 小蓝书预测卷六 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：成名途径 1（26）；否定疑问（little）1（27）；证据来源 1（28）；范围限定原因 1（29）；影响力 1（30）。
- 规则：R61.1 事件＋媒体（26）；R61.2 little＝否定（27）；R61.3 证据取对比行为（28）；R61.4 among 限定优先（29）；R61.5 影响取 pushed＋他人（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R61.1 与"年龄／身高抢眼"冲突，事件优先；R61.2 与"attention 正面感"冲突，little 优先；R61.3 与"表态最省事"冲突，行为证据优先；R61.4 与"夺冠是主线"冲突，范围限定优先；R61.5 与"fans 同句"冲突，他人行为优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：人物报道类（与 G54 传记、G48 生平并列）；本组三处"限定"（媒体／范围／行为）可并入 04 的限定清单；数字（16／1.8 米／2,000 首／Feb 7th）均照录，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷六 · Passage 4

Face-to-face with a mother who doesn't immediately praise every gift, my children have learned to be very careful in choosing gifts. But a couple of weeks ago, they came together to give me a gift that really blew me away.

For years now, I've been wanting to sell our house where my children grew up. But there are the funny little love hearts they drew just near their beds. The attic (阁楼) is full of the old clothes they couldn't wear. The high shelves still have lots of novels for children, like *The Night Before Christmas* and *The Muddle-Headed Wombat*.



But those are not the reasons for being sad about leaving this house. There is much more to tie me to the home where I brought up our kids. In the front room, there is a wall. On that wall are hundreds of pencil marks, names and dates. They recorded the way the children grew.

Of all the objects, all the memories, it's this one place in our home that makes it hard for me to leave. Over dinner, over the years, I've talked about how much I would hate leaving that wall, even though the last marks were made ten years ago when my kids stopped growing. So one day, while I was at work, my children decided to do something about the wall. Here was a chance to remove the last traces (痕迹) of their babyhood, but they didn't do that. Instead, they hired Jack, a professional photographer, to come to our house to take photos of the pencil marks, names and dates and then changed them into one photo.

At last, the gift made its way to me, one meaningful photo. Representing love and growth, it's a gift that I will cherish forever.

31. When did the mother get the surprising gift?

____________________

32. What is the attic filled with?

____________________

33. Why are the marks on the wall so important to the mother?

____________________

34. How did Jack make the traces on the wall into a gift?

____________________

35. Do you like this kind of gift? Why or why not?

____________________

**〔G62〕小蓝书预测卷六 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：A couple of weeks ago.**
1 题面：When did the mother get the surprising gift；原文 "But a couple of weeks ago, they came together to give me a gift that really blew me away."；疑问词 When（问时间点）；诱导信号：后文有 Over dinner, over the years／ten years ago／one day, while I was at work 等时间短语。
2 候选：①a couple of weeks ago；②over the years；③ten years ago；④one day while she was at work。
3 验算：①→a couple of weeks ago, they came together to give me a gift，时间与"送礼"同句→成立。②→over the years 是她反复说"舍不得那面墙"的时间跨度→排除。③→ten years ago 是墙上最后一道刻痕的时间→排除。④→one day while I was at work 是孩子们动手做礼物的时间→次优（不是"收到"的时间）。
4 干扰：ten years ago 与 one day while I was at work 都在后文，且都与"礼物"有关；a couple of weeks ago 在首段，离题干较远。
5 意图：考"时间点按事件配对：收到礼物 vs 制作礼物 vs 最后刻痕"。
6 边界：若问 When did the children make the gift? 答 One day while the mother was at work。若问 When were the last marks made? 答 Ten years ago。
7 错误：A 答 Ten years ago.（错因：刻痕时间）；B 答 Over the years.（错因：跨度当时间点）；C 答 While she was at work.（错因：制作时间）。
8 规则：R62.1 若问 When did sb get／receive sth，then 取与该事件同句的时间（a couple of weeks ago）；制作时间、刻痕时间与"多年来"的跨度都不作收到时间。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（按事件配对）；复用 R58.2（时间按事件配对），本条三个时间同段并列。
10 自检：①"送礼"与哪个时间同句？②ten years ago 是什么？③制作是哪天？

**32. 答案：The old clothes they couldn't wear.**
1 题面：What is the attic filled with；原文 "The attic (阁楼) is full of the old clothes they couldn't wear."；疑问词 What is the attic filled with（问内容）；诱导信号：紧接着 "The high shelves still have lots of novels for children"，也是"存放物"。
2 候选：①the old clothes they couldn't wear；②novels for children；③pencil marks and dates；④gifts。
3 验算：①→The attic is full of the old clothes，full of 的宾语直接给出→成立。②→novels 在 The high shelves 上，不是阁楼里→排除。③→marks 在 the front room 的墙上→排除。④→gifts 是另一回事→排除。
4 干扰：novels 与 old clothes 相邻两句，地点（attic／high shelves）容易混；novels 还有书名举例，更像"内容"。
5 意图：考"filled with／full of 取宾语，并按地点分辨"。
6 边界：若问 What is on the high shelves? 答 Lots of novels for children。若问 What did the children draw near their beds? 答 Funny little love hearts。
7 错误：A 答 Novels for children.（错因：地点错位）；B 答 Pencil marks and names.（错因：在墙上）；C 答 Old furniture.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R62.2 若问 What is X filled with，then 取 full of／filled with 的宾语（the old clothes they couldn't wear）；同段其他地点的存放物（novels on the high shelves）按地点排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（场所内容物）；复用 R22.2（include 取全），本条是"地点—内容配对"。
10 自检：①full of 后是什么？②novels 在哪？③marks 在哪？

**33. 答案：Because the marks recorded the way the children grew — that wall is the one place that makes it hard for her to leave the house.**
1 题面：Why are the marks on the wall so important to the mother；原文 "They recorded the way the children grew."＋"Of all the objects, all the memories, it's this one place in our home that makes it hard for me to leave."＋"I've talked about how much I would hate leaving that wall"；疑问词 Why…important（问原因）；诱导信号：the funny little love hearts／old clothes／novels 都在前面列举，也像"重要"的理由。
2 候选：①they recorded the children's growth；②the children drew hearts near their beds；③the attic has old clothes；④the shelves have novels。
3 验算：①→They recorded the way the children grew＋it's this one place…makes it hard for me to leave，两句同向→成立。②→love hearts 是墙外另一处（near their beds），不是墙上的刻痕→排除。③④→都是"其他物件"，原文明确 But those are not the reasons for being sad about leaving→排除。
4 干扰：love hearts／old clothes／novels 列举在前，且都带感情色彩；原文用 But those are not the reasons 把它们排除，这一句最易漏读。
5 意图：考"原因取 recorded…／it's this one place… 两句，前文的物件被明文排除"。
6 边界：若问 What is on the wall? 答 Hundreds of pencil marks, names and dates。若问 What did the children draw near their beds? 答 Funny little love hearts。
7 错误：A 答 Because the children drew hearts.（错因：未读 But those are not the reasons）；B 答 Because the attic is full of old clothes.（错因：被排除项）；C 答 Because the house is old.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R62.3 若问 Why is X important to sb，then 取紧随的原因句（recorded the way the children grew）＋强调句（it's this one place…makes it hard to leave）；前文列举的其他物件若被 But those are not the reasons 排除，一律不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（明文排除项）；复用 R34.4（排除被否定项），本条是否定句在前、原因在后。
10 自检：①哪句说 recorded？②But those are not the reasons 指哪些？③我取了 hearts 吗？

**34. 答案：He took photos of the pencil marks, names and dates and then changed them into one photo.**
1 题面：How did Jack make the traces on the wall into a gift；原文 "Instead, they hired Jack, a professional photographer, to come to our house to take photos of the pencil marks, names and dates and then changed them into one photo."；疑问词 How did Jack（问做法）；诱导信号：a professional photographer 是身份同位语，紧跟 Jack。
2 候选：①took photos of the marks…and changed them into one photo；②he is a professional photographer；③he removed the traces from the wall；④he repainted the wall。
3 验算：①→to take photos…and then changed them into one photo，两个动作构成"怎么做"→成立。②→身份不是做法→次优。③→原文明确 Here was a chance to remove the last traces, but they didn't do that→排除。④→原文无→排除。
4 干扰：professional photographer 就在 Jack 后，最容易被当答案；remove the traces 也像"把痕迹变成礼物"的做法，但被 but they didn't do that 否定。
5 意图：考"How 取动作链，身份与被否定项不作答案"。
6 边界：若问 Who is Jack? 答 A professional photographer (hired by the children)。若问 What did the children do with the traces? 答 They didn't remove them; they had them photographed。
7 错误：A 答 He is a photographer.（错因：身份当作法）；B 答 He removed the traces.（错因：被 but didn't 否定）；C 答 He drew new marks.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R62.4 若问 How did sb make X，then 取动词动作链（take photos of…＋change them into one photo）；同位语身份（a professional photographer）不作做法；被 but…didn't 否定的动作（remove the traces）排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（动作链）；复用 R50.4（inspire 取 to do），本条是"to do 目的＋动作链"。
10 自检：①Jack 做了什么动作？②photographer 是身份吗？③remove 被肯定还是否定？

**35. 答案：（开放题）Yes, I like it very much. Because it is a meaningful gift: it keeps the marks of the children's growth and represents love and growth, and the mother will cherish it forever.**
1 题面：Do you like this kind of gift? Why or why not?——两问：表态＋理由；可用依据：one meaningful photo／Representing love and growth／a gift that I will cherish forever／they hired a photographer to keep the traces instead of removing them。
2 候选：①Yes＋理由（有纪念意义、代表爱与成长、留住痕迹）；②No＋理由（照片不如原件、缺乏实用价值）；③只写 Yes；④复述制作过程。
3 验算：①→表态明确，理由能落到原文（meaningful／love and growth／cherish）→成立。②→开放题允许，但须给理由（如 a photo cannot replace the real wall），属外推→次优。③→漏 Why→不成立。④→复述过程无评价→排除。
4 干扰：题干 Why or why not 说明两种态度都行，但学生常只表态；原文情感浓，容易整段抒情而少了"理由"。
5 意图：考"两问都答：表态＋理由"，并允许与作者不同的立场。
6 边界：若问 What does the gift represent? 答 Love and growth。若问 Why will the mother cherish it? 答 Because it is meaningful and represents love and growth。
7 错误：A 只写 Yes, I do.（错因：漏理由）；B 答 It is a photo.（错因：复述事实）；C 答 Because the mother is old.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R62.5 若题干为 Do you like…? Why or why not，then 先表态（Yes, I do.／No, I don't.），再给 1—2 条理由，优先引原文评价（meaningful／representing love and growth／cherish forever）；只表态或复述事实都不合格；允许与作者相反，但同样要给理由。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.2 双问（表态＋理由）；复用 R30.2（表态＋理由）与 R53.5（Can…? Why），本条是"喜好型双问"。
10 自检：①我表态了吗？②理由在原文哪句？③我只写了 Yes 吗？

**组小结（G62 · 小蓝书预测卷六 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：收到时间 1（31）；阁楼内容物 1（32）；重要原因（排除项）1（33）；动作链 1（34）；喜好双问 1（35）。
- 规则：R62.1 时间按事件配对（31）；R62.2 filled with 取宾语、按地点分辨（32）；R62.3 原因取 recorded＋强调句、排除被否定项（33）；R62.4 动作链、身份不作做法（34）；R62.5 喜好＝表态＋理由（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R62.1 与"ten years ago 更醒目"冲突，同句配对优先；R62.2 与"novels 有书名"冲突，地点优先；R62.3 与"hearts／clothes 带感情"冲突，But those are not the reasons 优先；R62.4 与"photographer 紧邻"冲突，动作链优先；R62.5 与"只表态"冲突，理由优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：家庭叙事类首见；本篇是"一物多指"（hearts／clothes／novels／marks）的典型，R62.3 的"明文排除项"可作为 04 的排除样本；数字（a couple of weeks／ten years／hundreds of marks／one photo）均照录，**无换算、无差值**；**小蓝书卷六 4 篇至此完成（G59—G62）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十 · Passage 1

A Chinese dance drama, *Li Bai* has become popular on social media platforms abroad recently. Millions of people outside of China have watched it. Many people were amazed at it and started to appreciate the beauty traditional Chinese's culture.

This is not the first time that a symphony orchestra (管弦交响乐队) and traditional



Chinese music have been put together. Two other great dance dramas, *Confucius* (《孔子》) and *Princess Zhaojun*, were also arranged this way. The musicians believe that this is the best way to introduce Chinese music and culture to the world.

*Li Bai* has gotten many likes from people around the world. Someone described it as "beautiful and interesting", while another said, "It was amazing!"

The dance drama shows a few important moments of Li Bai's life. It helps people understand him better as a persistent (坚持不懈的) and brave person. People may also know that Li Bai is a man with talent. Although the dance drama doesn't tell a 100% true story, it does introduce a true Li Bai to the world.

More importantly, *Li Bai* does not only show the beauty of Chinese music and culture, it also tells the world that we are not that different. No matter which part of the world we come from, we are all human beings and share the same feelings when we see beautiful things. As Hu Yang, the actor playing *Li Bai*, said, "Each person has their own Li Bai."

16. What two things did the team behind *Li Bai* put together?

____________________

17. How many other dance dramas were arranged like *Li Bai*?

____________________

18. Who has given the dance drama *Li Bai* many likes?

____________________

19. What kind of person is Li Bai according to the passage?

____________________

20. Does the dance drama *Li Bai* show the beauty of Chinese music or culture?

____________________

**〔G63〕小蓝书预测卷十 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：A symphony orchestra and traditional Chinese music.**
1 题面：What two things did the team behind Li Bai put together；原文 "This is not the first time that a symphony orchestra (管弦交响乐队) and traditional Chinese music have been put together."；疑问词 What two things（明确要两项）；诱导信号：上一段讲 dance drama 本身，下一句讲 Confucius／Princess Zhaojun，也像"两样东西"。
2 候选：①a symphony orchestra＋traditional Chinese music；②Confucius＋Princess Zhaojun（另两部舞剧）；③music＋dance；④Chinese culture＋foreign culture。
3 验算：①→a symphony orchestra and traditional Chinese music have been put together，put together 的主语正是这两项→成立。②→Confucius 与 Princess Zhaojun 是"另外两部也这样编排"的例子，不是被结合的两样→排除。③→music＋dance 是舞剧的组成，原文未用 put together 表述→次优。④→Chinese culture＋foreign culture 是全文主题的扩大化→排除。
4 干扰：管弦交响乐队（symphony orchestra）是生词，学生容易跳过整句；两款舞剧名并列出现，形似"两项"。
5 意图：考"two things 取 put together 的并列主语"，且不被例子句干扰。
6 边界：若问 What is Li Bai? 答 A Chinese dance drama。若问 What were Confucius and Princess Zhaojun arranged like? 答 They were also arranged with a symphony orchestra and traditional Chinese music。
7 错误：A 答 Confucius and Princess Zhaojun.（错因：例子当答案）；B 答 Music and dance.（错因：扩大化）；C 答 Chinese and foreign cultures.（错因：主题扩大）。
8 规则：R63.1 若问 What two things did sb put together，then 取 put together 的并列主语（a symphony orchestra＋traditional Chinese music），两项都要；同段的例子（Confucius／Princess Zhaojun）与上位概念（music and dance）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.15 并列项取全；复用 R5.1（并列宾语全取），本条是"并列主语"。
10 自检：①put together 的主语是谁？②Confucius 是什么例子？③两项写全了吗？

**17. 答案：Two (Confucius and Princess Zhaojun).**
1 题面：How many other dance dramas were arranged like Li Bai；原文 "Two other great dance dramas, Confucius (《孔子》) and Princess Zhaojun, were also arranged this way."；疑问词 How many other（问数量，other 是排除词）；诱导信号：若把 Li Bai 也算进去就是三部。
2 候选：①two（Confucius／Princess Zhaojun）；②three（含 Li Bai）；③one；④many。
3 验算：①→Two other…Confucius and Princess Zhaojun，数字与两个名字同句→成立（other 已排除 Li Bai）。②→other 明确排除本体，含 Li Bai 即错→不成立。③→原文写 two→排除。④→many 与具体数字冲突→排除。
4 干扰：other 是排除词，最易漏；三部舞剧名连续出现（Li Bai／Confucius／Princess Zhaojun），容易数成三。
5 意图：考"other 排除本体"＋"数字与列举同句对应"。
6 边界：若问 How many dance dramas are mentioned in the passage? 答 Three（Li Bai, Confucius and Princess Zhaojun）。若问 Which two were arranged this way? 答 Confucius and Princess Zhaojun。
7 错误：A 答 Three.（错因：漏 other 的排除义）；B 答 One.（错因：数字错）；C 答 Two, Li Bai and Confucius.（错因：把本体算入）。
8 规则：R63.2 若问 How many other X are mentioned，then other 排除题干所指本体，只数其余项（two：Confucius／Princess Zhaojun）；若题干无 other 问"共提几部"，则要把本体算上（three）。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（other 排除本体）；复用 R25.3（数词＋other 需加 1）的反向情形：本条是"other 须减本体"。
10 自检：①other 指排除谁？②列举了几个名字？③题干有没有 other？

**18. 答案：People around the world.**
1 题面：Who has given the dance drama Li Bai many likes；原文 "Li Bai has gotten many likes from people around the world."；疑问词 Who（问施动者）；诱导信号：上一句 Millions of people outside of China have watched it 也含人群。
2 候选：①people around the world；②millions of people outside of China；③the actor Hu Yang；④Chinese people。
3 验算：①→has gotten many likes from people around the world，from 后的来源就是"给赞的人"→成立。②→millions outside China 是"观看人数"，不是"点赞来源"；范围也比 around the world 窄→次优。③→Hu Yang 是饰演李白的演员（末段引语）→排除。④→Chinese people 范围不符（文中强调 abroad／around the world）→排除。
4 干扰：Millions of people outside of China 就在上一句、数字醒目；two 个引语（beautiful and interesting／amazing）也像"点赞者"。
5 意图：考"Who 取 from 后的来源"，并区分"观看人数"与"点赞来源"。
6 边界：若问 How many people outside China have watched it? 答 Millions。若问 What did people say about it? 答 Someone described it as "beautiful and interesting", another said "It was amazing!"
7 错误：A 答 Millions of people outside of China.（错因：观看人数当点赞者）；B 答 Hu Yang.（错因：演员）；C 答 Chinese people.（错因：范围不符）。
8 规则：R63.3 若问 Who has given X many likes，then 取 from 后的来源（people around the world）；同段的观看人数（millions outside China）与演员（Hu Yang）不作来源。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（来源）；复用 R6.1（介词前置取宾语），本条是 from 来源。
10 自检：①from 后是谁？②millions 是人数还是来源？③Hu Yang 是谁？

**19. 答案：A persistent and brave person, and also a man with talent.**
1 题面：What kind of person is Li Bai according to the passage；原文 "It helps people understand him better as a persistent (坚持不懈的) and brave person. People may also know that Li Bai is a man with talent."；疑问词 What kind of person（问品质）；诱导信号：末段 Hu Yang 的话 Each person has their own Li Bai 也像"评价"。
2 候选：①persistent and brave＋talented；②a poet（常识）；③a man everyone knows；④beautiful and interesting。
3 验算：①→as a persistent and brave person＋a man with talent，两个品质句都在文中→成立（可写两到三个词）。②→poet 是常识与身份，原文未用品质词表述→次优。③→everyone knows 不是品质→排除。④→beautiful and interesting 是观众对该剧的评价，不是对李白的→排除。
4 干扰：beautiful and interesting／amazing 是原文仅有的两个直接引语评价，最像"品质"；李白的诗人身份也容易顺手写上。
5 意图：考"kind of person 取品质形容词，评价语与身份不作品质"。
6 边界：若问 What is the dance drama about? 答 It shows a few important moments of Li Bai's life。若问 How does the drama help people understand Li Bai? 答 As a persistent and brave person with talent。
7 错误：A 答 Beautiful and interesting.（错因：观众评剧当人物品质）；B 答 A poet.（错因：身份非品质）；C 答 A man everyone knows.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R63.4 若问 What kind of person is X，then 取 as＋品质形容词（persistent and brave）与 with＋特质（a man with talent）；观众对作品的评价（beautiful／amazing）与身份（poet）不作人物品质。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.10 人物性格推断（单一）；复用 R32.5（性格看行为），本条品质由原文直接给出。
10 自检：①原文的品质词有哪几个？②beautiful 评的是谁？③poet 是品质吗？

**20. 答案：Yes, it does. It shows the beauty of both Chinese music and Chinese culture.**
1 题面：Does the dance drama Li Bai show the beauty of Chinese music or culture；原文 "More importantly, Li Bai does not only show the beauty of Chinese music and culture, it also tells the world that we are not that different."；疑问词 Does…A or B（一般疑问，or 列举两项）；诱导信号：or 让人以为要二选一。
2 候选：①Yes, it does（both music and culture）；②Yes, it shows music.（只取一项）；③No, it doesn't；④Yes, but only culture。
3 验算：①→does not only show the beauty of Chinese music and culture，not only…also 结构说明两者都有；答 Yes 后用 both 收束→成立。②③④→都只取一项或否定，与 not only…also 冲突→次优或排除。
4 干扰：or 是选择连词，读者容易二选一；not only…also 若读成"不仅…而且"，会漏掉"两者都"的结论。
5 意图：考"一般疑问＋or 时，若原文是 both／not only…also，则答 Yes 并点明两者"。
6 边界：若问 What else does Li Bai tell the world? 答 That we are not that different — we share the same feelings before beautiful things。若问 What did Hu Yang say? 答 "Each person has their own Li Bai."
7 错误：A 答 Yes, it shows music.（错因：只取一项）；B 答 No, it doesn't.（错因：与 not only 结构冲突）；C 答 It shows culture, not music.（错因：二选一误读）。
8 规则：R63.5 若一般疑问句用 or 并列两项且原文为 both／not only…also，then 答 Yes, it does，并明确两项都有；or 不构成二选一，不得只留一项或答 No。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答（or 型）；复用 R43.3（Yes/No＋补事实），本条加"or 型不二选一"。
10 自检：①原文是 both 还是 either？②or 要不要二选一？③我答 No 了吗？

**组小结（G63 · 小蓝书预测卷十 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：并列两项 1（16）；other 排除本体 1（17）；来源 1（18）；人物品质 1（19）；or 型 Yes/No 1（20）。
- 规则：R63.1 put together 取并列主语（16）；R63.2 other 须减本体（17）；R63.3 from 取来源（18）；R63.4 品质词不作评价语（19）；R63.5 or 型答 Yes 并给两项（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R63.1 与"两部舞剧名并列"冲突，put together 主语优先；R63.2 与"三部都提到"冲突，other 优先；R63.3 与"millions 醒目"冲突，from 来源优先；R63.4 与"引语评价最像品质"冲突，as＋形容词优先；R63.5 与"or 二选一"冲突，not only…also 优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：文化传播类首见；"other 排除本体"与 R25.3（other 加 1）构成一对互补规则，建议 04 合并为一条"other 双向校正"；数字（millions／two／not the first time）均照录，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十 · Passage 2

Our world is in danger. We must do something to protect the environment. But, what are the main problems we face?

**The greenhouse effect**

The atmosphere (大气) around the Earth is necessary for all living things. It is like the glass of a greenhouse, letting sunlight in and keeping heat from getting out. Without it, the Earth would be the same as the Moon—cold and lifeless.

When we burn fuels such as petrol and coal, we produce a gas called carbon dioxide



(CO₂). Too much of this gas pollutes the atmosphere and causes it to keep in too much heat. As a result of the greenhouse effect, the Earth's temperature is increasing. This causes sea level to rise, and in the future may cause cities to disappear.

**Cutting down forests**

Every year, we destroy nature by cutting down huge areas of forests. This makes the greenhouse effect worse because trees take in CO₂ and produce oxygen. Cutting down trees also destroys the homes of the animals that live in our forests, and causes the surface of the soil to be easily destroyed by rain. This can result in floods and even more damage to the environment.

**Bad habits**

Many of our habits cause pollution. People often use things once and then throw them away, or leave them on the ground as litter. This creates mountains of rubbish and pollutes our land and seas.

In order to protect the environment, we need to take proper action. We should be different from many consumers and become "green consumers". This means that we should only buy and use products friendly to the environment. We should also recycle as many things as we can. We can reuse things for the same purpose as before, or we can use them for new purposes. If we just learn to live in new and different ways, we can make a difference.

**〔G64〕小蓝书预测卷十 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：The greenhouse effect, cutting down forests and bad habits (which cause pollution).**
1 题面：What problems does the article discuss；原文 "But, what are the main problems we face?"，随后三个小标题 **The greenhouse effect**／**Cutting down forests**／**Bad habits**；疑问词 What problems（问问题清单）；诱导信号：每节内容都很长，抓一节就能写出一个"像样"的答案。
2 候选：①greenhouse effect＋cutting down forests＋bad habits；②only the greenhouse effect；③rubbish and pollution（末节细节）；④carbon dioxide（成因）。
3 验算：①→三个小标题即三个问题，末节还总结 In order to protect the environment…→成立（三项都要）。②→只取首节→不完整。③→rubbish／pollution 是 Bad habits 一节的具体表现→次优。④→CO₂ 是温室效应的成因，不是"讨论的问题"→排除。
4 干扰：三节篇幅不等（温室效应最长），容易只答第一节；小标题是加粗的，但排版上夹在正文里。
5 意图：考"问题清单按小标题取全"，三节缺一不可。
6 边界：若问 What causes the greenhouse effect? 答 Burning fuels such as petrol and coal, which produce CO₂。若问 What problems do bad habits cause? 答 They create mountains of rubbish and pollute land and seas。
7 错误：A 答 The greenhouse effect.（错因：只取一节）；B 答 Pollution.（错因：上位词，未列三项）；C 答 Carbon dioxide.（错因：成因当问题）。
8 规则：R64.1 若问 What problems does the article discuss，then 按小标题取全三项（greenhouse effect／cutting down forests／bad habits）；单节内容、上位词（pollution）与成因（CO₂）都不作清单。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.2 段意／全文结构（小标题清单）；复用 R45.1（include 取全），本条是小标题清点。
10 自检：①几个小标题？②CO₂ 是哪一节的内容？③我只写了一节吗？

**22. 答案：The Earth's temperature is increasing — this makes sea level rise and may cause cities to disappear in the future.**
1 题面：What does greenhouse effect cause；原文 "As a result of the greenhouse effect, the Earth's temperature is increasing. This causes sea level to rise, and in the future may cause cities to disappear."；疑问词 What does X cause（问结果）；诱导信号：同段前半 "Too much of this gas pollutes the atmosphere and causes it to keep in too much heat" 也用了 cause。
2 候选：①temperature increasing→sea level rising→cities disappearing；②too much heat kept in（same cause 的上游）；③CO₂ produced by burning fuels（更上游）；④floods（另一节）。
3 验算：①→As a result of the greenhouse effect, temperature is increasing；This causes sea level to rise…→结果链完整→成立（至少写温度上升，最好带后两级）。②→keep in too much heat 是"温室效应"的形成环节，位于 As a result 之前→次优。③→CO₂ 是成因，不是结果→排除。④→floods 属"砍树"一节→排除。
4 干扰：cause it to keep in too much heat 与 This causes… 两个 cause 相邻，容易取上游那一环；CO₂ 是全文高频词。
5 意图：考"结果取 As a result of 之后，上游成因不作结果"。
6 边界：若问 What causes the Earth's temperature to increase? 答 Too much CO₂ in the atmosphere（the greenhouse effect）。若问 What may happen to cities in the future? 答 They may disappear。
7 错误：A 答 It keeps in too much heat.（错因：取上游环节）；B 答 It produces CO₂.（错因：因果倒置）；C 答 It causes floods.（错因：串节）。
8 规则：R64.2 若问 What does X cause，then 取 As a result of X 之后的结果链（temperature increasing→sea level rising→cities disappearing）；同一段中形成 X 自身的环节（keep in too much heat）与其成因（CO₂）都不作结果。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因／结果（因果链分层）；复用 R30.3（so 前为因）的反向：本条是"结果取标记后"。
10 自检：①As a result of 在哪？②结果链有几级？③我取了上游吗？

**23. 答案：Because cutting down trees causes the surface of the soil to be easily destroyed by rain, which can result in floods.**
1 题面：Why does cutting down trees result in floods；原文 "Cutting down trees also destroys the homes of the animals that live in our forests, and causes the surface of the soil to be easily destroyed by rain. This can result in floods and even more damage to the environment."；疑问词 Why…result in floods（问因果链）；诱导信号：同段前句 "This makes the greenhouse effect worse because trees take in CO₂ and produce oxygen" 也含 because，且与"洪水"同段。
2 候选：①soil surface easily destroyed by rain→floods；②trees take in CO₂ and produce oxygen（另一条因果）；③trees destroy animals' homes；④bad habits create rubbish。
3 验算：①→causes the surface of the soil to be easily destroyed by rain. This can result in floods，两句直接相连→成立。②→这是"加重温室效应"的原因，与洪水无直接因果→次优（写它会串因）。③→毁掉动物家园是并列后果，不导致洪水→排除。④→另一节→排除。
4 干扰：同一段有两个 because／因果（温室效应加重、土壤被雨冲毁），只按"最近 because"取会答成 CO₂；This can result in floods 的 This 需要还原为"土壤被毁"。
5 意图：考"洪水取紧邻的 This 回指链，不取同段另一条因果"。
6 边界：若问 Why does cutting down trees make the greenhouse effect worse? 答 Because trees take in CO₂ and produce oxygen。若问 What else does cutting down trees destroy? 答 The homes of the animals in the forests。
7 错误：A 答 Because trees take in CO₂.（错因：另一条因果）；B 答 Because animals lose their homes.（错因：并列后果）；C 答 Because there is too much rubbish.（错因：串节）。
8 规则：R64.3 若问 Why does X result in Y，then 取与 Y 紧邻的 This 回指内容（the surface of the soil easily destroyed by rain）；同段另一条因果（trees take in CO₂）与并列后果（animals' homes）都不作本问原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（This 回指链）；复用 R37.3（that 回指依据），本条是 This 回指"土壤被毁"。
10 自检：①This 指哪句？②同段另一条 because 讲什么？③我串因了吗？

**24. 答案：A "green consumer" is a consumer who only buys and uses products that are friendly to the environment.**
1 题面：A consumer is someone who buys and uses things. Can you guess what a "green consumer" is?；原文 "We should be different from many consumers and become 'green consumers'. This means that we should only buy and use products friendly to the environment."；疑问词 guess what X is（猜词／定义）；诱导信号：green 的字面义"绿色"。
2 候选：①a consumer who buys and uses environment-friendly products；②a consumer who buys green-coloured things；③a consumer who grows plants；④a consumer who recycles only。
3 验算：①→This means that we should only buy and use products friendly to the environment，This 回指 green consumers→成立。②→green 的颜色义在此不成立→排除。③→种植物原文未提→排除。④→recycle 是紧随其后的另一条建议，不是 green consumer 的定义→次优。
4 干扰：green 的颜色义与"环保"义同形；recycle／reuse 紧跟定义句，容易被并入定义。
5 意图：考"猜词取 This means that 的定义句，颜色义不取"。
6 边界：若问 What else should we do besides buying green products? 答 We should recycle as many things as we can and reuse them。若问 What can we do if we learn to live in new ways? 答 We can make a difference。
7 错误：A 答 A consumer who likes green.（错因：颜色义）；B 答 A consumer who recycles.（错因：把后续建议当定义）；C 答 A person who protects animals.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R64.4 若题干要求 guess what a term means 且紧随 This means that，then 取该定义句（only buy and use products friendly to the environment）；green 不取颜色义；后文的 recycle／reuse 是补充建议，不并入定义。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（术语定义）；复用 R44.1（术语取定义句），本条定义由 This means that 引出。
10 自检：①This 回指什么？②green 是颜色吗？③recycle 属定义还是建议？

**25. 答案：We can become "green consumers" — buy and use only environment-friendly products, recycle as many things as we can, and reuse things for the same or new purposes.**
1 题面：What can we do to protect the environment as teenagers；原文 "In order to protect the environment, we need to take proper action… become 'green consumers'… only buy and use products friendly to the environment. We should also recycle as many things as we can. We can reuse things for the same purpose as before, or we can use them for new purposes."；疑问词 What can we do（问做法，复数）；诱导信号：前四段全是"问题"，最后一段才是"做法"。
2 候选：①green consumers＋recycle＋reuse（三条做法）；②stop the greenhouse effect（问题本身）；③plant trees（外推）；④buy nothing。
3 验算：①→三条都是 We should／We can 的祈使性建议，且与 protect the environment 同段→成立（写 2—3 条即可）。②→是问题，不是做法→排除。③→原文未提种树（只提砍树之害）→次优（属外推）。④→原文说 buy green products，不是不买→排除。
4 干扰：前四段问题描述占八成篇幅，学生容易把"问题"当"做法"；reuse／recycle 两条并列，容易只写一条。
5 意图：考"做法取最后一段的 We should／We can 句，问题描述不作做法"。
6 边界：若问 What are the main problems? 见 21 题。若问 What does "make a difference" mean here? 答 To have a good effect on the environment。
7 错误：A 答 We should stop polluting.（错因：问题当做法）；B 答 We should plant more trees.（错因：外推，原文无）；C 答 We should buy fewer things.（错因：与"买环保产品"不同）。
8 规则：R64.5 若问 What can we do to protect the environment，then 取末段 We should／We can 的三条并列做法（green products／recycle／reuse），至少两条；问题清单与外推做法（plant trees）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.5 启示／做法（建议列举）；复用 R61.5（影响取他人行为）的反向：本条取"自己做法"。
10 自检：①做法在哪一段？②有几条？③我把问题当做法了吗？

**组小结（G64 · 小蓝书预测卷十 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：问题清单（小标题）1（21）；结果链 1（22）；This 回指因果 1（23）；术语定义（green consumer）1（24）；做法列举 1（25）。
- 规则：R64.1 小标题三项取全（21）；R64.2 结果取 As a result of 之后（22）；R64.3 洪水取 This 回指链（23）；R64.4 定义取 This means that（24）；R64.5 做法取 We should／can（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R64.1 与"首节最长"冲突，三节取全；R64.2 与"两个 cause 相邻"冲突，As a result 之后优先；R64.3 与"同段另一 because"冲突，紧邻 This 优先；R64.4 与"green 颜色义"冲突，定义句优先；R64.5 与"问题占篇幅"冲突，末段建议优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：环保说明文首见（与 G57 发明类、G56 措施类并列）；本篇是"问题—做法"两段式，R64.2／R64.3 两条因果分层规则对 04 的"因果链"节点很有用；数字（CO₂／1,000 times 无）均照录，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十 · Passage 3

In China, writing brushes, ink sticks, paper and inkstones are called the Four Treasures



of Study. Among the high-quality treasures, the writing brush produced in Huzhou, the ink stick produced in Huizhou, the Xuan paper made in Xuancheng and the inkstone made in Duanxi are the best-known.

Writing brushes can be used to draw pictures on painted pottery (陶器). They are mainly made of the hair of animals. Those made of wool are called *yanghao* and those made of the weasel's (鼬的) tail hair are called *langhao*. Their artistic effects in writing and painting cannot be copied by any other pens.

The ink stick is the pigment (颜料) used in writing and painting. The ink stick produced in Huizhou is of high quality. A story goes like this: Two famous skilled men Xi Chao and his son produced a kind of high-quality ink stick. As a result, Emperor Li Yu in the Southern Tang Dynasty agreed to give them the family name "Li". From then on, the fame of the Li Ink Stick was widespread. In the Song Dynasty, its producing area was changed into Huizhou, and it was then called the Hui Ink Stick.

Paper is among the four great inventions in ancient China. The famous Xuan paper appeared in the Sui and Tang Dynasties. In Xuanzhou, Anhui Province where Xuan paper is produced, it's said that Cai Lun's pupil Kong Dan took the job of producing paper but failed to make perfect white paper. Later he happened to see the ebony (黑檀木) in the rivers. It was wet with the water and turned white. Then he used the bark (树皮) to produce the world-famous Xuan paper.

The inkstone was already very popular in the Han Dynasty. The Ming and Qing Dynasties saw the appearance of the Four Famous Inkcstones—Duan Inkstone, She Inkstone, Tao Inkstone and Chengni Inkstone. They can be used not only in writing and painting but also for admiration.
