**〔G65〕小蓝书预测卷十 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：They are mainly made of the hair of animals (such as wool and the weasel's tail hair).**
1 题面：What are writing brushes mainly made of；原文 "They are mainly made of the hair of animals. Those made of wool are called yanghao and those made of the weasel's (鼬的) tail hair are called langhao."；疑问词 What…made of（问材料）；诱导信号：wool／weasel's tail hair 两个具体材料很醒目。
2 候选：①the hair of animals；②wool；③the weasel's tail hair；④bamboo（外推）。
3 验算：①→are mainly made of the hair of animals，mainly 修饰的是上位材料→成立（可再补两种下位）。②③→是两种具体笔（yanghao／langhao）的材料，属个别而非"主要材料"→次优。④→原文未提笔杆材料→排除。
4 干扰：wool 与 weasel's tail hair 带中文注音名（yanghao／langhao），容易被当成答案；mainly 一词也易漏。
5 意图：考"mainly made of 取上位材料，下位两种只作补充"。
6 边界：若问 What are the two kinds of writing brushes mentioned? 答 Yanghao (made of wool) and langhao (made of the weasel's tail hair)。若问 What can writing brushes be used to do? 答 To draw pictures on painted pottery。
7 错误：A 答 Wool.（错因：下位当主要）；B 答 The weasel's tail hair.（错因：同上）；C 答 Bamboo and hair.（错因：外推）。
8 规则：R65.1 若问 What are X mainly made of，then 取上位材料（the hair of animals），下位具体材料（wool／weasel's tail hair）作补充；mainly 不可丢，外推材料（bamboo）不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.25 类别取词（类 vs 例）；复用 R15.2（kind 取类名），本条是"材料的上位与下位"。
10 自检：①mainly 后是什么？②wool 属于哪一类？③我取了上位还是下位？

**27. 答案：Because they produced a kind of high-quality ink stick.**
1 题面：Why did Xi Chao and his son get the family name from Emperor Li Yu；原文 "Two famous skilled men Xi Chao and his son produced a kind of high-quality ink stick. As a result, Emperor Li Yu in the Southern Tang Dynasty agreed to give them the family name 'Li'."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：family name "Li" 与皇帝，容易被想成"因为皇帝喜欢墨"。
2 候选：①they produced a high-quality ink stick；②the emperor liked their names；③they wrote good poetry；④they lived in Huizhou。
3 验算：①→produced a kind of high-quality ink stick. As a result, Emperor…agreed to give them the family name→成立（As a result 前即因）。②→原文无→排除。③→原文无→排除。④→Huizhou 是宋代产地变更后的地点，时间在后→排除。
4 干扰：As a result 后的皇恩更醒目，因果方向易反；Huizhou／Li 两个地名姓氏也在同段。
5 意图：考"As a result 前为因"＋"地点变更在后，不作原因"。
6 边界：若问 What was the ink stick called after the Song Dynasty? 答 The Hui Ink Stick。若问 Where was the Li Ink Stick produced at first? 答 原文未明说（只说宋代产地改为徽州）。
7 错误：A 答 Because the emperor liked the ink.（错因：无据）；B 答 Because they lived in Huizhou.（错因：时间在后）；C 答 Because they were famous poets.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R65.2 若问 Why did sb get an honour，then 取 As a result 前的事实句（produced a kind of high-quality ink stick）；结果句（皇帝赐姓）与时间在后的地名变更都不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（As a result 前为因）；复用 R30.3（so 前为因），本条标记是 As a result。
10 自检：①As a result 在哪？②它前面是什么事实？③Huizhou 是什么时候的事？

**28. 答案：The Li Ink Stick.**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "it" in Paragraph 3 refer to；原文 "In the Song Dynasty, its producing area was changed into Huizhou, and it was then called the Hui Ink Stick."；疑问词 it refers to（代词回指，指物）；诱导信号：同句有 Huizhou（地点）与 the Hui Ink Stick（新名），都在 it 附近。
2 候选：①the Li Ink Stick；②Huizhou；③the Hui Ink Stick；④the Song Dynasty。
3 验算：①→it was then called the Hui Ink Stick，被改名的是"李墨"；同句 its producing area 的 its 也指它→成立。②→Huizhou 是产地（地点），不能"被叫作徽墨"→排除。③→the Hui Ink Stick 是改名后的结果，it 指改名前的那一个→排除。④→朝代名不能作被改名对象→排除。
4 干扰：the Hui Ink Stick 与 it 同句且是"名字"，最易被当先行词；Huizhou 与"徽"同源，也像答案。
5 意图：考"it 指改名前的事物，不指改名后的新名／地点"。
6 边界：若问 What is the Hui Ink Stick? 答 The ink stick whose producing area was changed into Huizhou in the Song Dynasty（formerly the Li Ink Stick）。若问 What was the ink stick used as? 答 The pigment used in writing and painting。
7 错误：A 答 The Hui Ink Stick.（错因：新名当先行词）；B 答 Huizhou.（错因：地点）；C 答 The Song Dynasty.（错因：时间）。
8 规则：R65.3 若问 it 回指且同句出现"改名"结构（it was then called X），then it 指改名前的旧事物（the Li Ink Stick），不指新名（the Hui Ink Stick）、地点（Huizhou）或时间（the Song Dynasty）。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.1 代词回指（改名结构）；复用 R51.3（施受关系优先），本条是"新旧名分辨"。
10 自检：①谁被改名？②Hui Ink Stick 是旧名还是新名？③Huizhou 是地点吗？

**29. 答案：In the Ming and Qing Dynasties.**
1 题面：When did the Four Famous Inkcstones appear；原文 "The inkstone was already very popular in the Han Dynasty. The Ming and Qing Dynasties saw the appearance of the Four Famous Inkcstones—Duan Inkstone, She Inkstone, Tao Inkstone and Chengni Inkstone."；疑问词 When（问朝代）；诱导信号：同段两个朝代（Han／Ming and Qing），Han 在前。
2 候选：①the Ming and Qing Dynasties；②the Han Dynasty；③the Sui and Tang Dynasties（宣纸）；④the Song Dynasty（徽墨）。
3 验算：①→The Ming and Qing Dynasties saw the appearance of the Four Famous Inkcstones，saw＋appearance 对应"出现"→成立。②→Han Dynasty 是"砚已流行"的时间，不是四大名砚出现的时间→排除。③→Sui and Tang 是宣纸出现的时间（上一段）→排除。④→Song 是徽墨改名的时间（再上一段）→排除。
4 干扰：四个朝代分散在三段（Han／Ming-Qing／Song／Sui-Tang），按"最近朝代"取会错；Han 与 inkstone 同段最近。
5 意图：考"朝代按事件配对（出现 vs 流行 vs 改名 vs 纸出现）"。
6 边界：若问 When was the inkstone already popular? 答 In the Han Dynasty。若问 When did the famous Xuan paper appear? 答 In the Sui and Tang Dynasties。
7 错误：A 答 In the Han Dynasty.（错因：流行期当出现期）；B 答 In the Song Dynasty.（错因：徽墨时间）；C 答 In the Sui and Tang Dynasties.（错因：宣纸时间）。
8 规则：R65.4 若问 When did X appear，then 取与 appearance 同句的朝代（the Ming and Qing Dynasties）；同段"已流行"的朝代（Han）与别段事件（Song 改名／Sui-Tang 宣纸）按事件排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（朝代—事件配对）；复用 R16.3（多年份按动词配对），本条是"多朝代按事件"。
10 自检：①appearance 与哪个朝代同句？②Han 是什么事件？③其余朝代属什么？

**30. 答案：The Four Treasures of Study（文房四宝）**
1 题面：What's the best title for the passage；全文四段各写一宝：writing brushes、ink sticks、paper、inkstones；首句 "In China, writing brushes, ink sticks, paper and inkstones are called the Four Treasures of Study."；疑问词 best title（要覆盖全文）；诱导信号：每段都有专名（Huzhou／Huizhou／Xuancheng／Duanxi），任选其一都像标题。
2 候选：①The Four Treasures of Study；②The Writing Brush in Huzhou；③The Xuan Paper；④Chinese Inventions。
3 验算：①→首句的总称＋四段分述，完全对应→成立。②→只罩第一段一半→不成立。③→只罩第三段→不成立。④→范围过宽，漏"文房"这一限定，且 paper 只是四宝之一→排除。
4 干扰：四宝中宣纸最有名（与四大发明并提），容易被当主题；专名（Huzhou／Huizhou）也像标题词。
5 意图：考"标题＝总称＋四段覆盖"，范围不过宽也不过窄。
6 边界：若问 What are the Four Treasures of Study? 答 Writing brushes, ink sticks, paper and inkstones。若问 Which of them is among the four great inventions? 答 Paper。
7 错误：A 答 The Xuan Paper.（错因：只罩一段）；B 答 Chinese Inventions.（错因：过宽）；C 答 The Best Ink Stick.（错因：只罩一段）。
8 规则：R65.5 若问 best title 且首句给出总称（the Four Treasures of Study），then 取该总称作标题；四段分述对象（brush／ink／paper／inkstone）与专名（Huzhou／Huizhou／Xuancheng／Duanxi）都只罩一段，过宽标题（Chinese Inventions）丢限定。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.4 拟标题（总称型）；复用 R45.5（标题三检验），本条总称已在首句。
10 自检：①首句总称是什么？②四段各写什么？③我选了一个专名吗？

**组小结（G65 · 小蓝书预测卷十 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：上位材料 1（26）；As a result 前为因 1（27）；改名结构回指 1（28）；朝代—事件配对 1（29）；总称标题 1（30）。
- 规则：R65.1 mainly made of 取上位（26）；R65.2 As a result 前为因（27）；R65.3 it 指改名前旧物（28）；R65.4 出现期按事件配对（29）；R65.5 标题取首句总称（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R65.1 与"wool 带注音"冲突，上位优先；R65.2 与"皇恩醒目"冲突，As a result 前优先；R65.3 与"新名同句"冲突，旧物优先；R65.4 与"Han 最近"冲突，事件配对优先；R65.5 与"宣纸最有名"冲突，总称优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：文化器物类首见（四段并列说明）；本篇把"改名结构回指"与"多朝代按事件配对"两处易错点集中在 28／29 两题，可作 04 的样本；数字（four／Han／Song／Sui-Tang／Ming-Qing）均照录，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十 · Passage 4

When Jiang Mengnan received the award of Person Touching China for 2021, she said she most wanted to express thanks to her parents.

Born in 1992 in Hunan Province, Jiang's world has been silent since she was 6 months old, after she took the wrong medicine. So Jiang's parents began to teach her to learn lip-reading (唇读).

Jiang's parents asked her to put her hands on their throats when they talked. It was a slow way, but her parents never gave up. Learning a single word can take at least 1,000 times of practice for Jiang. Through lip-reading and self-studying, Jiang learned to speak and she was able to keep up with learning. Now, the30-year-old is going to receive her doctorate (博士学位) at the end of the year.

More importantly, she is helping encourage disabled children in many places to fight for success. Because of her hearing loss, she couldn't be a doctor. Instead, she chose pharmacy to help reduce (减轻) people's pain. Another thing she makes up her mind to do is teaching children like her not to lose hope because of disabilities. Jiang often visits special education schools and meets with students. She tells them to do their best to achieve goals like so-called healthy persons.

She said that people with disabilities have no need to feel upset, as they can do the same or even better than non-disabled people around them. When God closes a door. he opens a window, and this girl believes that all challenges are gifts.

31. When and where was Jiang Mengnan born?

____________________

32. Why did Jiang lose her hearing?

____________________

33. How did Jiang learn to speak?

____________________

34. What does Meng make up her mind to do?

____________________

35. Do people with disabilities need to feel upset?

____________________

**〔G66〕小蓝书预测卷十 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：In 1992, in Hunan Province.**
1 题面：When and where was Jiang Mengnan born；原文 "Born in 1992 in Hunan Province, Jiang's world has been silent since she was 6 months old, after she took the wrong medicine."；疑问词 When and where（双问，时间＋地点）；诱导信号：同句后部 6 months old 也是时间，且与"born"同句。
2 候选：①1992＋Hunan Province；②6 months old＋Hunan Province；③1992 only；④Hunan Province only。
3 验算：①→Born in 1992 in Hunan Province，born 后的两个状语就是答案→成立（双问都要答）。②→6 months old 是失聪的年龄，不是出生时间→不成立。③→漏地点，双问只答一半→次优。④→漏时间→次优。
4 干扰：6 months old 与 born 同句且更靠后；题干 When and where 是并列两问，学生常只答一个。
5 意图：考"双问都要答"＋"born 的时间取出生年，不取 later 的时间"。
6 边界：若问 When did Jiang become deaf? 答 At 6 months old（in 1992）。若问 Where did she receive her doctorate? 答 原文只说 at the end of the year 将获博士学位，未给学校。
7 错误：A 答 In 1992.（错因：漏 where）；B 答 In 1992, at 6 months old.（错因：把失聪年龄当出生信息）；C 答 In Hunan Province.（错因：漏 when）。
8 规则：R66.1 若题干为 When and where 双问，then 时间与地点各答一项（In 1992, in Hunan Province），缺一即不完整；同句 later 的时间（6 months old）不属于 born。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间＋1.16 地点（双问）；复用 R26.1（倒装还原取小镇＋国家），本条是"时间＋地点"双取。
10 自检：①born 后有几个状语？②6 months 是什么时间？③两问都答了吗？

**32. 答案：Because she took the wrong medicine when she was 6 months old.**
1 题面：Why did Jiang lose her hearing；原文 "Jiang's world has been silent since she was 6 months old, after she took the wrong medicine."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：since she was 6 months old 是时间，after 从句才是原因。
2 候选：①she took the wrong medicine；②she was born deaf；③she was 6 months old；④she had an accident。
3 验算：①→after she took the wrong medicine，after 在此表原因链（服药在先、失聪在后）→成立。②→原文说她 6 个月前世界并非寂静（since 表示起点）→不成立。③→6 months 是时间点，不是原因→排除。④→原文无 accident→排除。
4 干扰：since she was 6 months old 紧跟 silent，时间感强；生来失聪是常见预设。
5 意图：考"after 从句表原因链，时间状语不作原因"。
6 边界：若问 What happened when she was 6 months old? 答 She took the wrong medicine and lost her hearing。若问 How long has her world been silent? 答 Since she was 6 months old。
7 错误：A 答 Because she was born deaf.（错因：与 since 冲突）；B 答 Because she was 6 months old.（错因：时间当原因）；C 答 Because of an illness.（错因：改写原文）。
8 规则：R66.2 若问 Why did sb lose sth，then 取 after／because 从句中的事件（took the wrong medicine）；since＋时间只标起点，不作原因；"生来如此"的预设与 since 冲突，不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（after 事件链）；复用 R14.3（触发行为的前一句事实即原因），本条触发是"服错药"。
10 自检：①after 后是什么？②since 表什么？③我答"天生"了吗？

**33. 答案：Through lip-reading and self-studying — her parents taught her to put her hands on their throats when they talked, and she practised a word at least 1,000 times.**
1 题面：How did Jiang learn to speak；原文 "Jiang's parents asked her to put her hands on their throats when they talked…Through lip-reading and self-studying, Jiang learned to speak and she was able to keep up with learning."；疑问词 How（问方式）；诱导信号：Learning a single word can take at least 1,000 times of practice 是练习量，不是途径。
2 候选：①through lip-reading and self-studying；②1,000 times of practice；③by going to a special school；④by taking medicine。
3 验算：①→Through lip-reading and self-studying, Jiang learned to speak，through＋名词直接对应 How→成立（可补"手放喉咙"的细节）。②→1,000 times 是单个词的练习次数，属细节→次优。③→她后来去特殊教育学校是"帮助别人"，不是学说话→排除。④→服药是她失聪的原因→排除。
4 干扰：1,000 times 的数字很醒目；"手放喉咙"的画面感强，容易被当成唯一方法。
5 意图：考"How 取 through＋名词（途径），练习量不作途径"。
6 边界：若问 How long can learning one word take? 答 At least 1,000 times of practice。若问 What is she going to receive? 答 Her doctorate at the end of the year。
7 错误：A 答 By practising 1,000 times.（错因：练习量当途径）；B 答 By putting hands on throats only.（错因：细节当全部）；C 答 By going to school.（错因：串事）。
8 规则：R66.3 若问 How did sb learn sth，then 取 through＋方式名词（lip-reading and self-studying），可补具体做法（hands on throats）；练习次数（1,000 times）与后来的活动（visiting schools）不作途径。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（through 途径）；复用 R19.2（through 取方式），本条是可数细节与途径的分层。
10 自检：①through 后是什么？②1,000 次是什么？③我答了"去学校"吗？

**34. 答案：To teach children like her not to lose hope because of disabilities.**
1 题面：What does Meng make up her mind to do；原文 "Another thing she makes up her mind to do is teaching children like her not to lose hope because of disabilities."；疑问词 What does sb make up her mind to do（问决心要做的事）；诱导信号：前两句有 she couldn't be a doctor 与 she chose pharmacy，都是"她做过／选过的"。
2 候选：①teach children like her not to lose hope；②become a doctor；③work in a pharmacy；④receive a doctorate。
3 验算：①→Another thing she makes up her mind to do is teaching children…not to lose hope，be 动词后动名词即内容→成立。②→原文明确 Because of her hearing loss, she couldn't be a doctor（做不到）→排除。③→pharmacy 是她"选了"的专业，不是"下决心要做的事"这一句的内容→次优。④→读博是已在进行的事→排除。
4 干扰：doctor 与 pharmacy 都与"职业"相关，且句式相邻；make up her mind 后接动名词（teaching）而非不定式，形式上也易误读。
5 意图：考"make up one's mind to do 取表语动名词内容"，并排除"做不到／已选择"的项。
6 边界：若问 What did she choose to study instead of medicine? 答 Pharmacy（to help reduce people's pain）。若问 Why couldn't she be a doctor? 答 Because of her hearing loss。
7 错误：A 答 Become a doctor.（错因：原文说她做不到）；B 答 Study pharmacy.（错因：已选专业，非"决心"句内容）；C 答 Get a doctorate.（错因：进行中的事）。
8 规则：R66.4 若问 What does sb make up his/her mind to do，then 取 make up one's mind to do is＋动名词的内容（teaching children not to lose hope）；被原文否定过的（be a doctor）与已选择的（pharmacy）不作"决心"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.14 行为决定（decide／make up one's mind）；复用 R5.4（promise to do），本条表语为动名词。
10 自检：①make up her mind 后接了什麼？②doctor 被肯定还是否定？③pharmacy 是哪句的内容？

**35. 答案：No, they don't. People with disabilities can do the same or even better than non-disabled people.**
1 题面：Do people with disabilities need to feel upset；原文 "She said that people with disabilities have no need to feel upset, as they can do the same or even better than non-disabled people around them."；疑问词 Do…need to（一般疑问，含 need）；诱导信号：末句 When God closes a door, he opens a window 是比喻，容易被当成"需要难过"的反面证据而答得含糊。
2 候选：①No, they don't＋can do the same or better；②Yes, they do（because disabled）；③No, because God closes a door；④No（无依据）。
3 验算：①→have no need to feel upset, as they can do the same or even better，表态＋依据齐全→成立。②→与 no need 相反→不成立。③→比喻句是修辞，不作直接依据→次优。④→表态对但无依据→次优。
4 干扰：need 一词与 have no need 结构对应，若读成"need to"肯定式会答 Yes；比喻句抢眼。
5 意图：考"no need to＝不必"＋"表态后取 as 从句依据"。
6 边界：若问 What does "When God closes a door, he opens a window" mean? 答 一种能力/机会失去时，另一种会出现（困难也是礼物）。若问 What does Jiang believe about challenges? 答 She believes all challenges are gifts。
7 错误：A 答 Yes, they do.（错因：no need 误读为 need）；B 答 No, because God closes a door.（错因：比喻当依据）；C 答 No, they don't need help.（错因：偷换 need 的对象）。
8 规则：R66.5 若题干为 Do…need to…，then 按原文 have no need to 答 No＋主语＋don't，并用 as 从句（can do the same or even better）作依据；比喻句（God closes a door）不作直接依据；need 的对象不得偷换（不是"不需要帮助"）。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答（no need 结构）；复用 R43.3（Yes/No＋补事实），本条加"need 的对象不偷换"。
10 自检：①原文是 need 还是 no need？②as 从句说了什么？③我偷换了 need 吗？

**组小结（G66 · 小蓝书预测卷十 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：双问（时＋地）1（31）；after 事件链 1（32）；through 途径 1（33）；make up one's mind to do 1（34）；no need 型 Yes/No 1（35）。
- 规则：R66.1 双问各答一项（31）；R66.2 after 从句为因（32）；R66.3 through 取途径（33）；R66.4 决心取表语动名词、排除否定项（34）；R66.5 no need＝不必、依据取 as 从句（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R66.1 与"6 months 更近"冲突，born 状语优先；R66.2 与"since 时间醒目"冲突，after 事件优先；R66.3 与"1,000 次数字"冲突，through 途径优先；R66.4 与"doctor／pharmacy 相邻"冲突，表语内容优先；R66.5 与"need 字面"冲突，no need 优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：人物事迹类第 5 篇（G54／G61／G66 等）；本篇把"做不到的事（doctor）"与"已选的事（pharmacy）"与"决心要做的事（teaching）"三分，是 04"行为决定"节点的好样本；数字（1992／6 months／1,000 times／30-year-old）均照录，**无换算、无差值**；**小蓝书卷十 4 篇至此完成（G63—G66）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十一 · Passage 1

China is a country with big rivers. So, there are a lot of people who live on water and build boats. Zhang Guohui has been making ships, from over 30-meter-long boats to meters-long model ones, for more than sixty years.

"Every minute, I keep thinking about making it perfect," said the expert of the watertight-bulkhead technology of Chinese junks (中国船舶水密舱壁技术). In 2010, it was included on the list of Intangible Cultural Heritage (非物质文化遗产) by UNESCO.

Zhang was born in a poor family in a fishing town. He started to make a living by fishing at 16 and at that time he became interested in making boats. Being a fast learner, Zhang was later sent to Quanzhou and Xiamen to receive training and he became a master of traditional Chinese junks.

With the development of the modern shipbuilding industry, the need for large wooden boats dropped. Zhang began making model ships using his 20 years of shipbuilding skills. He feared that the traditional skills would die someday. Luckily, he met Wang Lianmao, director of Quanzhou Maritime Museum, in 2007. After their meeting, he started to repair old ships and make model ships for the museum.

In 2016, Zhang was invited to give lessons to university students. "They are so interested in shipbuilding, and many of them even came to learn about boat making during holidays. I'm really moved. As long as I'm alive, I'll keep passing on the skills," Zhang said.

16. How long has Zhang been making ships?

____________________

17. When was the watertight-bulkhead technology of Chinese junks included on the list of Intangible Cultural Heritage?

____________________

18. Where did Zhang receive training about making boats?

____________________

19. What did Zhang do for Quanzhou Maritime Museum?

____________________

20. How did Zhang feel when students came to learn about shipbuilding from him?

____________________

**〔G67〕小蓝书预测卷十一 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：For more than sixty years.**
1 题面：How long has Zhang been making ships；原文 "Zhang Guohui has been making ships, from over 30-meter-long boats to meters-long model ones, for more than sixty years."；疑问词 How long（问时长）；诱导信号：同句 30-meter-long 与 meters-long 也是数字。
2 候选：①more than sixty years；②over 30 meters（船的长度）；③since 2010；④for 20 years（他用 20 年技艺做模型）。
3 验算：①→for more than sixty years，for＋时长与 How long 直接对应→成立（保留 more than）。②→30-meter-long 是船的长度，不是时长→排除。③→2010 是水密舱壁技术入选非遗的年份→排除。④→20 years 是"做船技艺"的年限，修饰制作模型船，不是"造船多久"→次优。
4 干扰：一句里三个数字（30-meter／meters-long／sixty years），只有最后一个是时长；more than 也容易漏。
5 意图：考"How long 取 for＋时长"，数字按单位（年／米）分流。
6 边界：若问 How long did he work as a fisherman? 答 From the age of 16（原文未给年限）。若问 When was the technology listed by UNESCO? 答 In 2010。
7 错误：A 答 Over 30 meters.（错因：长度当时间）；B 答 Sixty years.（错因：漏 more than）；C 答 For 20 years.（错因：串句）。
8 规则：R67.1 若问 How long has sb been doing sth，then 取 for＋时长并保留约量词（for more than sixty years）；同句的长度、年份与修饰其它动作的年限，按单位与动词分流。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（时长）；复用 R60.3（时长照抄），本条多数字分流。
10 自检：①哪个数字是年？②more than 抄了吗？③30-meter 是什么？

**17. 答案：In 2010.**
1 题面：When was the watertight-bulkhead technology of Chinese junks included on the list of Intangible Cultural Heritage；原文 "In 2010, it was included on the list of Intangible Cultural Heritage (非物质文化遗产) by UNESCO."；疑问词 When（问年份）；诱导信号：it 指代上一句的水密舱壁技术，需还原。
2 候选：①in 2010；②for more than sixty years；③in 2007（遇王连茂）；④in 2016（受邀讲课）。
3 验算：①→In 2010, it was included on the list…→成立（it＝该技术）。②→是张的从业时长→排除。③→2007 是遇到王连茂、开始修旧船的时间→排除。④→2016 是给大学生上课→排除。
4 干扰：四个年份（2010／2007／2016＋sixty years）分布在四段，按"最近年份"取会错。
5 意图：考"年份按事件配对：入选非遗 vs 遇伯乐 vs 讲课"。
6 边界：若问 When did Zhang meet Wang Lianmao? 答 In 2007。若问 When was Zhang invited to give lessons? 答 In 2016。
7 错误：A 答 In 2007.（错因：遇王连茂）；B 答 In 2016.（错因：讲课）；C 答 For more than sixty years.（错因：时长当时间点）。
8 规则：R67.2 若问 When was X included／listed，then 取与该事件同句的年份（In 2010），并按事件排除其它年份（2007 遇人／2016 讲课）；it 须还原为上文的技术名称再定位。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（年份—事件配对）；复用 R54.1（年份按地点配对），本条是按事件。
10 自检：①it 指什么？②2010 与哪个动作同句？③其余年份各是什么事？

**18. 答案：In Quanzhou and Xiamen.**
1 题面：Where did Zhang receive training about making boats；原文 "Being a fast learner, Zhang was later sent to Quanzhou and Xiamen to receive training and he became a master of traditional Chinese junks."；疑问词 Where（问地点）；诱导信号：文中还有 fishing town（出生地）与 Quanzhou Maritime Museum（合作单位）。
2 候选：①Quanzhou and Xiamen；②a fishing town；③Quanzhou Maritime Museum；④UNESCO。
3 验算：①→sent to Quanzhou and Xiamen to receive training，地点两项与 receive training 同句→成立（两处都要）。②→fishing town 是出生地→排除。③→博物馆是他后来修船、做模型的地方（2007 年后）→次优。④→UNESCO 是评定机构→排除。
4 干扰：Quanzhou 单独出现两次（培训地＋博物馆所在），只写 Quanzhou 会漏 Xiamen；fishing town 与"船"语义近。
5 意图：考"Where 取 to 后并列地点，两处都写"。
6 边界：若问 Where did Zhang repair old ships? 答 For Quanzhou Maritime Museum（in Quanzhou）。若问 Where was Zhang born? 答 In a fishing town（原文未给具体地名）。
7 错误：A 答 In Quanzhou.（错因：漏 Xiamen）；B 答 In a fishing town.（错因：出生地）；C 答 At Quanzhou Maritime Museum.（错因：合作单位）。
8 规则：R67.3 若问 Where did sb receive training，then 取 to＋并列地点（Quanzhou and Xiamen），两处都写；出生地与后来的合作单位按事件排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（并列地点取全）；复用 R5.1（并列项全取），本条地点并列。
10 自检：①to 后有几个地点？②fishing town 是什么？③博物馆是哪年的事？

**19. 答案：He repaired old ships and made model ships for the museum.**
1 题面：What did Zhang do for Quanzhou Maritime Museum；原文 "Luckily, he met Wang Lianmao, director of Quanzhou Maritime Museum, in 2007. After their meeting, he started to repair old ships and make model ships for the museum."；疑问词 What did sb do for X（问为某机构做的事）；诱导信号：同段还有"用 20 年技艺做模型船"与"担心技艺失传"。
2 候选：①repaired old ships＋made model ships；②made model ships only；③gave lessons to university students；④became a director of the museum。
3 验算：①→started to repair old ships and make model ships for the museum，两个动作都以 for the museum 为对象→成立（两件都写）。②→漏修旧船→次优。③→给大学生上课是 2016 年的事，对象是大学→排除。④→王连茂才是 director→排除。
4 干扰：做模型船在文中出现两次（担心失传时＋为博物馆），容易被当成唯一答案；director 头衔与博物馆同句，容易张冠李戴。
5 意图：考"for＋机构 取该机构相关的全部动作"，并分清人物头衔。
6 边界：若问 Who is Wang Lianmao? 答 The director of Quanzhou Maritime Museum。若问 Why did Zhang begin making model ships? 答 Because the need for large wooden boats dropped and he feared the skills would die。
7 错误：A 答 He made model ships.（错因：漏修旧船）；B 答 He gave lessons.（错因：对象错）；C 答 He was the director.（错因：头衔错位）。
8 规则：R67.4 若问 What did sb do for an organization，then 取以 for＋机构为对象的全部动作（repair old ships＋make model ships）；同段属于他人头衔（director）与别的对象（university students）按对象排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（抽象 vs 具体）；复用 R33.2（目的取 to），本条是"为机构做的事"。
10 自检：①for the museum 后有几个动作？②director 是谁？③上课的对象是谁？

**20. 答案：He felt really moved (by the students' interest).**
1 题面：How did Zhang feel when students came to learn about shipbuilding from him；原文 "'They are so interested in shipbuilding, and many of them even came to learn about boat making during holidays. I'm really moved. As long as I'm alive, I'll keep passing on the skills,' Zhang said."；疑问词 How did sb feel（问感受）；诱导信号：They are so interested 是学生的状态，紧贴 feel 的问题。
2 候选：①really moved；②interested；③worried；④proud of himself。
3 验算：①→I'm really moved，直接引语中的感受句→成立。②→interested 是学生对造船的兴趣，不是张的感受→不成立。③→worried 是他"担心技艺失传"（前段），与本题情境不同→次优。④→文中无 proud→排除。
4 干扰：so interested 与问句距离最近、语义正面，最容易被当答案；worried 也在文中出现过，人物感受容易串段。
5 意图：考"感受句取说话人自述（moved），他人状态不作感受"。
6 边界：若问 What will Zhang do as long as he is alive? 答 He will keep passing on the skills。若问 Why did Zhang worry? 答 Because he feared the traditional skills would die someday。
7 错误：A 答 He felt interested.（错因：学生状态）；B 答 He felt worried.（错因：串前段）；C 答 He felt tired.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R67.5 若问 How did sb feel when…，then 取说话人自述的情感句（I'm really moved），前置的他人的状态（They are so interested）不作感受；同篇另一情境的情绪（worried about dying skills）按情境排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.13 情绪态度（自述）；复用 R37.2（引语取双面），本条取单一情绪。
10 自检：①谁 moved？②interested 是谁？③worried 属哪一段？

**组小结（G67 · 小蓝书预测卷十一 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：时长＋多数字分流 1（16）；年份—事件配对 1（17）；并列地点 1（18）；为机构做的事 1（19）；情绪自述 1（20）。
- 规则：R67.1 How long 取时长（16）；R67.2 年份按事件（17）；R67.3 并列地点取全（18）；R67.4 for＋机构取全部动作（19）；R67.5 感受取自述（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R67.1 与"句内三数字"冲突，单位分流优先；R67.2 与"最近年份"冲突，事件配对优先；R67.3 与"Quanzhou 重复出现"冲突，并列取全；R67.4 与"模型船出现两次"冲突，for 机构优先；R67.5 与"interested 紧邻"冲突，自述优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：非遗／匠人题材首见；五个年份与三个数字都靠"按事件／按单位"分流，**无任何加减运算**；差值仍在补全式与本题之外为 0，按口径记"知本／慧航待查"。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十一 · Passage 2

For many Chinese people, Lantern Festival, which fell on Feb.15, 2022, marks an end to two weeks of the Lunar (农历) New Year. For folk artist Wang De, it is also the busiest, best time for him to show his craft (手艺) creating molten (熔化的) iron fireworks.

Wang, who is a blacksmith (铁匠) of the 500-year-old art of *dashuhua*, which means "creating tree flowers", lives in Yuxian County in the city of Zhangjiakou, North China's Hebei Province.

To create molten iron fireworks, scrap iron (铁屑) is melted to 1,600℃ and thrown against a cold wall to blinding effect.

Wang, 58, and his assistants put on over a dozen *dashuhua* shows for local people and tourists as part of the Spring Festival activities each year. The folk artist hopes the tradition can bring more visitors to his hometown of Zhangjiakou, which caught international attention.

*Dashuhua* is a traditional form of fireworks show that takes place during certain festivals. In ancient times, this was a show that only those people with wealth and high social positions could afford. There are only four people left in China who have mastered (掌握) the ancient practice, and three of them are not young, according to local media reports.

Because of the risk of the show, it's easy for *dashuhua* artists to get hurt when they are giving shows. And the high-risk tradition is still only kept for the brave. During a show a few years ago, Wang got serious burns on his leg and it took two months to recover.

Both Wang's father and grandfather were blacksmiths. "I learned the craft from my father. When I was young, I thought it was exciting. But years later I also felt it was my duty to pass it on to the next generation (代)," he says.

22. During which festival do Wang and his assistants give *dashuhua* shows every year?

23. Who could afford *dashuhua* shows in ancient times?

24. Are *dashuhua* shows very dangerous?

____________________



25. How do you think Wang will pass his craft on to the next generation from the last paragraph?

**〔G68〕小蓝书预测卷十一 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：It means "creating tree flowers".**
1 题面：What does dashuhua mean；原文 "Wang, who is a blacksmith (铁匠) of the 500-year-old art of *dashuhua*, which means 'creating tree flowers', lives in Yuxian County…"；疑问词 What does X mean（问词义）；诱导信号：黑体斜体的 dashuhua 与后面的 1,600℃ 熔铁、cold wall 等画面都很吸引注意。
2 候选：①"creating tree flowers"；②molten iron fireworks（工艺描述）；③a kind of blacksmith；④a 500-year-old town。
3 验算：①→which means "creating tree flowers"，which 回指 dashuhua，引号内即释义→成立。②→molten iron fireworks 是工艺效果（下段），不是词义→次优。③→blacksmith 是王德的身份→排除。④→500-year-old 修饰这门艺术，不是地名→排除。
4 干扰：引号在文中出现两次（"creating tree flowers" 与 "the family that runs to school" 式的其他引语），若只抓黑体词会跳过 which means。
5 意图：考"which means＋引号＝释义，工艺描述不作词义"。
6 边界：若问 What is dashuhua? 答 A 500-year-old art of molten iron fireworks（可整句）。若问 Who is Wang De? 答 A blacksmith of dashuhua（in Yuxian County, Zhangjiakou）。
7 错误：A 答 Molten iron fireworks.（错因：效果当词义）；B 答 A blacksmith.（错因：身份当词义）；C 答 Yuxian County.（错因：地名）。
8 规则：R68.1 若问 What does a term mean 且原文有 which means＋引号，then 取引号内内容（"creating tree flowers"）；同段的工艺描述（molten iron fireworks）与身份（blacksmith）不作词义。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（which means 定义）；复用 R44.1（术语取定义句），本条定义由 which means 引出。
10 自检：①which 指谁？②引号里是什么？③molten iron 是词义吗？

**22. 答案：During the Spring Festival.**
1 题面：During which festival do Wang and his assistants give dashuhua shows every year；原文 "Wang, 58, and his assistants put on over a dozen dashuhua shows for local people and tourists as part of the Spring Festival activities each year."；疑问词 Which festival＋every year（问节日，且限每年）；诱导信号：首段出现 Lantern Festival (Feb.15, 2022)，是全文的时间背景。
2 候选：①the Spring Festival；②the Lantern Festival；③Christmas；④the Mid-Autumn Festival。
3 验算：①→as part of the Spring Festival activities each year，节日＋each year 同句→成立。②→Lantern Festival 是 2022 年那天的具体日子（which fell on Feb.15, 2022），用来说明"农历新年结束"，不是"每年在哪一节日表演"→不成立。③④→原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：首段 Lantern Festival 在最前、且与"最忙的时候"相连，最容易被当答案；题干 every year 是排除它的关键（Lantern Festival 那天是特定日期）。
5 意图：考"节日取 each year 同句者，具体日期背景不作节日"。
6 边界：若问 When did the Lantern Festival fall in 2022? 答 On Feb. 15。若问 How many shows do they put on each year? 答 Over a dozen。
7 错误：A 答 The Lantern Festival.（错因：日期背景当节日）；B 答 The Lunar New Year.（错因：与 Spring Festival 混但原文用 Spring Festival）；C 答 Feb. 15.（错因：日期当节日）。
8 规则：R68.2 若问 During which festival do they do sth every year，then 取与 each year 同句的节日（the Spring Festival）；同段的具体日期背景（Lantern Festival, Feb.15, 2022）不作节日。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（节日 vs 日期）；复用 R54.1（年份—地点配对），本条是"节日—频次配对"。
10 自检：①each year 与哪个节日同句？②Lantern Festival 是哪年哪天？③我答成日期了吗？

**23. 答案：Only people with wealth and high social positions.**
1 题面：Who could afford dashuhua shows in ancient times；原文 "In ancient times, this was a show that only those people with wealth and high social positions could afford."；疑问词 Who could afford（问人群）；诱导信号：同段有 only four people left... 与 three of them are not young，也是"人"与数字。
2 候选：①people with wealth and high social positions；②four people；③blacksmiths；④local people and tourists。
3 验算：①→only those people with wealth and high social positions could afford，only＋人群与 afford 同句→成立（保留 only）。②→four people 是"如今掌握技艺的人"，与 could afford 无关→排除。③→blacksmiths 是表演者，不是观众→排除。④→local people and tourists 是今天的观众→排除。
4 干扰：four／three 两个数字与"人"紧邻；今天"local people and tourists"也像答案，但题干限定 in ancient times。
5 意图：考"Who could afford 取 only＋人群，且按 ancient times 截断"。
6 边界：若问 How many people have mastered the practice today? 答 Four（three of them are not young）。若问 Who watches the shows today? 答 Local people and tourists。
7 错误：A 答 Four people.（错因：今人当古代观众）；B 答 Blacksmiths.（错因：表演者）；C 答 Everyone.（错因：与 only 冲突）。
8 规则：R68.3 若问 Who could afford X in ancient times，then 取 only＋人群短语（those people with wealth and high social positions）；同段的今人数字（four）与今天的观众（local people and tourists）按时间限定排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（人群限定）；复用 R33.3（多主体按主体配对），本条是"时间限定＋only"。
10 自检：①only 后是谁？②four people 是什么？③题干有时间限定吗？

**24. 答案：Yes, they are. Dashuhua artists can easily get hurt, and Wang once got serious burns on his leg that took two months to recover.**
1 题面：Are dashuhua shows very dangerous；原文 "Because of the risk of the show, it's easy for dashuhua artists to get hurt when they are giving shows. And the high-risk tradition is still only kept for the brave. During a show a few years ago, Wang got serious burns on his leg and it took two months to recover."；疑问词 Are…（一般疑问）；诱导信号：the brave／high-risk 是形容词性评价，容易被当成"没有具体证据"。
2 候选：①Yes＋易受伤＋王德烧伤两个月；②No（因为只有勇敢的人做）；③Yes, but only in the past；④No, it is safe now。
3 验算：①→risk／easy to get hurt／serious burns two months，三处证据同向→成立（表态＋至少一条事实）。②→the brave 恰恰说明危险→不成立。③→原文无"过去才危险"→排除。④→与 high-risk 相反→排除。
4 干扰：only kept for the brave 读起来像"勇敢者的游戏"，可能被误读为"其实不危险"；two months 是恢复时间，也可能被当成"危险程度不高"。
5 意图：考"Yes/No＋事实依据"，the brave 反证危险。
6 边界：若问 How long did Wang take to recover from his burns? 答 Two months。若问 Who is the show kept for? 答 The brave。
7 错误：A 答 No, because only brave people do it.（错因：反证误读）；B 答 Yes.（错因：漏依据）；C 答 Yes, and Wang died.（错因：编造）。
8 规则：R68.4 若问 Are X dangerous／safe，then 先按原文 risk／get hurt 表态（Yes, they are），再给一条事实（serious burns／two months）；the brave 这类评价是危险的反证，不是安全证据。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答（评价型）；复用 R43.3（Yes/No＋补事实），本条依据是 injury 事实。
10 自检：①原文有 risk 吗？②王德伤在哪、多久好？③the brave 说明什么？

**25. 答案：He will pass it on by teaching the next generation himself, just as his father taught him — he feels it is his duty.**
1 题面：How do you think Wang will pass his craft on to the next generation from the last paragraph；原文 "Both Wang's father and grandfather were blacksmiths. 'I learned the craft from my father. When I was young, I thought it was exciting. But years later I also felt it was my duty to pass it on to the next generation (代),' he says."；疑问词 How do you think…will（推断＋方式）；诱导信号：全文多处写"只有四个人掌握""三人不年轻"，容易被推断成"他会找徒弟"或"技艺会失传"。
2 候选：①像父亲教他那样亲自教下一代（出于 duty）；②他会退休，技艺失传；③他会写书；④政府会保护。
3 验算：①→I learned the craft from my father＋felt it was my duty to pass it on，两条合起来支撑"亲自教"→成立（须带推断语气 will／by doing）。②→与 duty 相反→排除。③→原文无写书→排除。④→原文无政府→排除。
4 干扰：only four people／three not young 的危机感会把人推向"技艺将失传"的悲观推断；但末段的自述是"责任"，方向相反。
5 意图：考"推断题以人物自述（duty＋师承）为据，危机数据不作结论"。
6 边界：若问 Why does Wang think it is his duty? 答 Because he learned the craft from his father and his family have been blacksmiths。若问 What does Wang think of the art when he was young? 答 He thought it was exciting。
7 错误：A 答 The craft will die out.（错因：危机数据压过自述）；B 答 He will write a book.（错因：无据）；C 答 He will stop giving shows.（错因：与 duty 相反）。
8 规则：R68.5 若问 How do you think sb will pass sth on（推断），then 以人物自述的意愿与师承方式为据（learned from my father＋duty→teach the next generation himself），用 will／by doing 表述；同篇的危机数据（only four／three not young）不作结论方向。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.16 推断（以自述为据）；复用 R32.3（动机取引语自述），本条是"推断取意愿"。
10 自检：①末段自述说了什么？②危机数据在哪段？③我的推断有 will 吗？

**组小结（G68 · 小蓝书预测卷十一 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：词义（which means）1（21）；节日 vs 日期 1（22）；人群限定（only＋古代）1（23）；危险型 Yes/No 1（24）；推断（自述为据）1（25）。
- 规则：R68.1 词义取 which means 引号（21）；R68.2 节日取 each year 同句（22）；R68.3 only＋人群、按古代截断（23）；R68.4 危险型表态＋事实（24）；R68.5 推断取自述意愿（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R68.1 与"工艺画面强"冲突，which means 优先；R68.2 与"Lantern Festival 在首段"冲突，each year 优先；R68.3 与"four people 醒目"冲突，时间限定优先；R68.4 与"the brave 像安全"冲突，risk 优先；R68.5 与"危机数据"冲突，自述优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：非遗技艺类第 2 篇（G67 造船／本条打树花），两篇都以"技艺传承"收尾，可作 04 的"技艺类模板"；数字（500-year／1,600℃／58／a dozen／four／three／two months）均照录，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十一 · Passage 3

Rob Frenette, a Canadian boy, was often bullied (欺凌) at school. He was often lonely and scared. When he was fifteen, however, he decided to do something about his problems. He walked into a newspaper office and told them about the bullying. His story went into the newspaper and soon, all the TV stations in Canada wanted to talk to him about his experiences. They also wanted to hear his ideas about how to stop bullying.

In his free time after school, Rob helps other people with bullying problems.

With his friend Katie Neu, he set up the website www.bullyingcanada.ca. On the website, visitors can find advice, stories and poems about bullying, in both English and French. When people are upset, they can talk on the phone or online to Rob and his team.

Every weekend, Rob answers e-mails from people who have been bullied at school. He also speaks to children and teachers around Canada about bullying.

Rob's most important message is: "When you're bullied, there's nothing wrong with you. So, keep trusting yourself. And remember that there are people who care about your problems. You just have to find those people."

One of Rob's ideas is "Blue Day", a special day that works to stop the problem of bullying in schools. On that day, students have to wear blue clothes, and in class, they learn how to keep bullying from happening. More than 150 Canadian schools now celebrate Blue Day. Rob says he won't stop until there is Blue Day in every school in Canada.

26. Why did Rob Frenette often feel lonely and scared?

____________________

27. How did Rob solve his problems at the age of fifteen?

____________________

28. List two ways Rob helps other people with bullying problems.

____________________

29. How many Canadian schools celebrate Blue Day now?

____________________



30. What do you think of Rob Frenette? And why?

____________________

**〔G69〕小蓝书预测卷十一 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：Because he was often bullied at school.**
1 题面：Why did Rob Frenette often feel lonely and scared；原文 "Rob Frenette, a Canadian boy, was often bullied (欺凌) at school. He was often lonely and scared."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：后句 he decided to do something about his problems 中的 problems 是回指，不是原因。
2 候选：①he was often bullied at school；②he had problems（回指）；③he was Canadian；④he was fifteen。
3 验算：①→was often bullied at school，前一句即因，lonely and scared 是果→成立。②→problems 是概括词，本身需要还原为 bullying→次优。③→国籍与情绪无关→排除。④→15 岁是他行动的时间→排除。
4 干扰：problems 一词概括力强，容易被当作原因直接抄；lonely 与 scared 两个情绪词也容易只取一个。
5 意图：考"情绪的原因取前一句事实（被欺凌），概括词 problems 不算答案"。
6 边界：若问 What did Rob decide to do at fifteen? 答 He decided to do something about his problems — he walked into a newspaper office。若问 How did Rob feel at school? 答 Lonely and scared。
7 错误：A 答 Because he had problems.（错因：概括词未还原）；B 答 Because he was Canadian.（错因：无据）；C 答 Because he was 15.（错因：时间当原因）。
8 规则：R69.1 若问 Why did sb feel X，then 取前一句的事实（was often bullied at school），不取概括词（problems）与身份／年龄信息。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（情绪前句为因）；复用 R31.3（情绪取前邻困境），本条困境是"被欺凌"。
10 自检：①情绪前一句说什么？②problems 指什么？③我答了年龄吗？

**27. 答案：He walked into a newspaper office and told them about the bullying; his story went into the newspaper.**
1 题面：How did Rob solve his problems at the age of fifteen；原文 "When he was fifteen, however, he decided to do something about his problems. He walked into a newspaper office and told them about the bullying. His story went into the newspaper…"；疑问词 How did sb solve（问做法）；诱导信号：后文 "In his free time after school, Rob helps other people" 是他后来的做法，不是"解决自己问题"。
2 候选：①walked into a newspaper office＋told them（故事上报）；②set up a website；③answered e-mails；④spoke to children and teachers。
3 验算：①→He walked into a newspaper office and told them about the bullying，两个动作＋结果（went into the newspaper）→成立。②③④→都发生在"帮助别人"阶段（后文），不是 15 岁解决自己问题的方式→排除。
4 干扰：网站与回邮件是他最出名的做法，且篇幅更大；题干 at the age of fifteen 是时间闸门。
5 意图：考"How 取时点限定的做法"，后面的事迹按时间排除。
6 边界：若问 What happened after his story went into the newspaper? 答 All the TV stations in Canada wanted to talk to him。若问 When did Rob set up the website? 答 原文未给具体时间（with his friend Katie Neu）。
7 错误：A 答 He set up a website.（错因：后期做法）；B 答 He told his teacher.（错因：对象错）；C 答 He fought back.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R69.2 若问 How did sb solve his problems at the age of N，then 只取该时点的做法（walked into a newspaper office＋told them about the bullying），后期事迹（website／e-mails／speaking）按时间排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（时点限定）；复用 R50.1（时点截断），本条是"人生阶段截断"。
10 自检：①15 岁那句做了什么？②网站是哪阶段？③我按时间排除了吗？

**28. 答案：（任取两条）He set up the website www.bullyingcanada.ca with Katie Neu; he answers e-mails every weekend; he speaks to children and teachers around Canada; people can talk to him and his team on the phone or online.**
1 题面：List two ways Rob helps other people with bullying problems；题干明示 two ways（列两条）；原文 "With his friend Katie Neu, he set up the website www.bullyingcanada.ca. On the website, visitors can find advice, stories and poems… When people are upset, they can talk on the phone or online to Rob and his team. Every weekend, Rob answers e-mails… He also speaks to children and teachers around Canada about bullying."；诱导信号：做法共四处，题干只要两条。
2 候选：①建网站；②每周末回邮件；③到各地对师生演讲；④电话／线上交谈。
3 验算：①→set up the website，with Katie Neu，属帮助他人的做法→成立。②→answers e-mails from people who have been bullied→成立。③→speaks to children and teachers→成立。④→talk on the phone or online to Rob and his team→成立。任两条即可，四条都对。
4 干扰：题干只要两条，学生容易把"他被欺凌""他上报纸"也列进去——那不是"帮助别人"；也容易只列一条。
5 意图：考"列举题按数量取，且限定'帮助他人'这一语义域"。
6 边界：若问 What can visitors find on the website? 答 Advice, stories and poems about bullying, in both English and French。若问 Who is Katie Neu? 答 Rob's friend, who set up the website with him。
7 错误：A 答 He was bullied and went to a newspaper.（错因：自己的经历，非帮助他人）；B 只列一条（错因：未达 two）；C 答 He wrote a book.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R69.3 若题干 List two ways…，then 从"帮助他人"的语义域内取两条（website／e-mails／speaking／phone-online），数量必须达标；自己的经历（被欺凌、上报纸）不属该域。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.6 半开放列举（限定域列举）；复用 R45.1（清单取全）的反向：本条是"限数取二"。
10 自检：①四条做法各是什么？②哪两条属"帮别人"？③我列够两条了吗？

**29. 答案：More than 150 (Canadian schools).**
1 题面：How many Canadian schools celebrate Blue Day now；原文 "More than 150 Canadian schools now celebrate Blue Day."；疑问词 How many（问数量）；诱导信号：全文只有这一个数字；Rob says he won't stop until there is Blue Day in every school in Canada 是目标，容易与现状混。
2 候选：①more than 150；②150；③every school in Canada；④150 thousand。
3 验算：①→More than 150 Canadian schools now celebrate，now＋数量→成立（保留 more than）。②→丢 more than，变精确数→次优。③→every school 是目标（won't stop until），不是现状→不成立。④→数量级错→排除。
4 干扰：every school in Canada 是文中唯一的"更大数字感"表述，容易被当成答案；more than 也常被漏。
5 意图：考"现状数量取 now 句，目标不作现状"，约量词不丢。
6 边界：若问 What is Rob's goal? 答 To have Blue Day in every school in Canada。若问 What do students do on Blue Day? 答 They wear blue clothes and learn how to keep bullying from happening。
7 错误：A 答 Every school in Canada.（错因：目标当现状）；B 答 150.（错因：漏 more than）；C 答 150 schools in every province.（错因：改写）。
8 规则：R69.4 若问 How many…now，then 取 now 句的数量并保留约量词（more than 150）；won't stop until 引出的目标（every school）不作现状数量。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（现状 vs 目标）；复用 R57.5（现状 vs 愿望），本条是"数量版"。
10 自检：①now 句的数字是多少？②every school 是什么句？③more than 抄了吗？

**30. 答案：（开放题）I think Rob is brave, helpful and persistent. He spoke out about being bullied when he was fifteen, set up a website to help others, and says he won't stop until every school in Canada has Blue Day.**
1 题面：What do you think of Rob Frenette? And why?——评价＋理由；可用依据：walked into a newspaper office and told them about the bullying／helps other people with bullying problems／set up the website／answers e-mails every weekend／won't stop until there is Blue Day in every school。
2 候选：①brave／helpful／persistent＋三条行为；②he is a victim（只描述遭遇）；③he is lucky；④只写 He is great。
3 验算：①→每个品质词都能配一条行为（站出来＝brave；建网站帮人＝helpful；won't stop＝persistent）→成立。②→victim 是身份不是评价，且无理由→不成立。③→lucky 抹掉他的主动行动→排除。④→空评价→不成立。
4 干扰：全文以"他曾被欺凌"开头，容易把评价写成"可怜／不幸"；三个品质中 persistent 最抽象，常被漏。
5 意图：考"评价＝品质词＋行为证据"，且不接受"受害者"式评价。
6 边界：若问 What is Rob's most important message? 答 When you're bullied, there's nothing wrong with you; keep trusting yourself and find people who care。若问 What is Blue Day? 答 A special day to stop bullying in schools。
7 错误：A 答 He is poor.（错因：同情代评价）；B 答 He is a student.（错因：复述身份）；C 只写 He is great.（错因：空评价）。
8 规则：R69.5 若问 What do you think of sb? And why，then 给 2—3 个品质词（brave／helpful／persistent）并各配一条原文行为；受害经历与身份不作评价，空评价不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（品质＋行为）；复用 R37.5／R43.5，本条要求"每条品质都有据"。
10 自检：①我给了几个品质词？②每个有行为吗？③我写成"可怜"了吗？

**组小结（G69 · 小蓝书预测卷十一 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：情绪原因 1（26）；时点限定做法 1（27）；限数列举 1（28）；现状数量 1（29）；评价＋理由 1（30）。
- 规则：R69.1 情绪取前句事实（26）；R69.2 时点截断（27）；R69.3 限数取两、限定语义域（28）；R69.4 现状数量保留约量词（29）；R69.5 品质＋行为（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R69.1 与"problems 概括力强"冲突，事实优先；R69.2 与"网站事迹更出名"冲突，时点优先；R69.3 与"经历也是做法"冲突，语义域优先；R69.4 与"every school 更大"冲突，now 句优先；R69.5 与"受害者叙事"冲突，品质优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：公益／反欺凌题材第 2 篇（G49 Chairity／本条）；"限数列举"与 R45.1（取全）构成一对（何时取全、何时限数）；数字（150／every school）均照录，**无换算、无差值**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十一 · Passage 4

It's hard to turn down a tasty banana. They taste good and you don't have to wash them before eating them. However, British scientists say that the fruit may disappear by 2050.

One reason for this is climate change. Scientists at the University of Exeter collected data from 27 countries and regions that produce 86 percent of the world's bananas. They found that climate change has improved growing conditions in 21 of these countries. In the past 60 years, the average yield (平均产量) has reached 1.37 tons of bananas per hectare (每公顷).

However, if temperatures keep rising, this advantage will disappear. Ten of the countries, including India, the world's biggest producer of bananas, will produce fewer bananas. By 2050, the fruit may die out.

Shouldn't bananas grow more easily if it's hotter outside? In fact, the perfect temperature for growing bananas is between 24 and 32℃. If the temperature gets too high, they will stop growing.

Diseases are another danger to bananas. Unlike other plants, the bananas we grow come from shoot cuttings (茎段) rather than seeds. This means that all banana plants have the same genotype (基因型). In other words, if a disease is able to kill one plant, it could kill them all.

One serious disease is called Panama. Caused by fungus (真菌) in the soil, it spreads easily. It has spread across South Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Australia. If one banana plantation (种植园) suffers from the disease, it will take 30 years until it is able to grow bananas again. Scientists have yet to find a cure for this disease.

31. Why is it hard to turn down a tasty banana?

____________________

32. Why may bananas disappear by 2050?

____________________

33. Which country is the biggest producer of bananas in the world?

____________________

34. Where does the bananas we grow come from, shoot cuttings or seeds?

____________________



35. If one banana plantation suffers Panama in 2022, which year can it grow bananas again?

____________________

**〔G70〕小蓝书预测卷十一 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

> **本组 Q35 是全稿首例"数字推算"题**（2022＋30＝2052），不属百分比差值，但确需一步加算，已单列 R70.5。

**31. 答案：Because they taste good and you don't have to wash them before eating them.**
1 题面：Why is it hard to turn down a tasty banana；原文 "It's hard to turn down a tasty banana. They taste good and you don't have to wash them before eating them."；疑问词 Why is it hard to（问原因）；诱导信号：tasty 已含"好吃"，但第二句还给了一条独立理由（不用洗）。
2 候选：①taste good＋no need to wash；②because they are tasty（只取第一层）；③because they are cheap；④because they are healthy。
3 验算：①→They taste good and you don't have to wash them，and 连接两条并列理由→成立（两条都写最稳）。②→tasty／taste good 是同一层，漏"不用洗"→次优。③→原文无价格→排除。④→原文无营养——虽然常识如此→排除。
4 干扰：tasty 在题干里已出现（a tasty banana），学生容易把题干当答案；"不用洗"这条更具体，反而常被忽略。
5 意图：考"原因取 and 并列两条，且不抄题干".
6 边界：若问 What may happen to bananas by 2050? 答 They may disappear／die out。若问 When do you not have to wash a banana? 答 Before eating it（原文只说"不必洗"）。
7 错误：A 答 Because they are tasty.（错因：漏第二条、且抄题干）；B 答 Because they are cheap.（错因：无据）；C 答 Because they are easy to peel.（错因：原文未提）。
8 规则：R70.1 若问 Why is it hard to turn down X，then 取紧随的并列原因（taste good＋don't have to wash），两条并列不省；题干已出现的形容词（tasty）不重复作答。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（并列取全）；复用 R36.2（并列原因取全），本条合并题干重复项。
10 自检：①and 后还有一条吗？②tasty 是题干词吗？③我编了价格吗？

**32. 答案：Because of climate change (rising temperatures) and diseases such as Panama.**
1 题面：Why may bananas disappear by 2050；原文 "One reason for this is climate change."＋"Diseases are another danger to bananas."＋"By 2050, the fruit may die out."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：气候一段篇幅最长、数字最多（27／86／21／1.37／24—32℃），容易只答气候。
2 候选：①climate change＋diseases；②only climate change；③only Panama disease；④because they come from shoot cuttings。
3 验算：①→One reason…climate change＋Diseases are another danger，两条原因都有明确标记（One reason／another danger）→成立（两条并列）。②→漏第二条→次优。③→Panama 是真菌病之一，属第二条的下位→次优。④→shoot cuttings 是"为何一种病能杀死全部"的解释，不是"为何会消失"的直接原因→排除。
4 干扰：气候段数字密集、结论句 By 2050 就在其中，学生容易停在这一段；"another danger" 这个并列标记常被跳过。
5 意图：考"两个原因按标记（One reason／another danger）取全"。
6 边界：若问 Why can one disease kill all banana plants? 答 Because they all come from shoot cuttings and have the same genotype。若问 What is the perfect temperature for bananas? 答 Between 24 and 32℃。
7 错误：A 答 Because of climate change.（错因：漏第二条）；B 答 Because of Panama.（错因：以例代类）；C 答 Because they have the same genotype.（错因：答成"为何全死"）。
8 规则：R70.2 若问 Why may X disappear，then 按原文并列标记（One reason…／another danger…）取两个原因（climate change＋diseases），下位例证（Panama）与机制解释（same genotype）不单独作答。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（并列取全＋例证分层）；复用 R64.1（多项取全），本条按"another"标记识别。
10 自检：①有几处原因标记？②Panama 属于哪一条？③same genotype 回答的是哪个问题？

**33. 答案：India.**
1 题面：Which country is the biggest producer of bananas in the world；原文 "Ten of the countries, including India, the world's biggest producer of bananas, will produce fewer bananas."；疑问词 Which country（问国名）；诱导信号：同段有 27 countries／86 percent／21 of these countries 三个数字＋国家群体。
2 候选：①India；②27 countries；③the University of Exeter；④86 percent。
3 验算：①→including India, the world's biggest producer of bananas，同位语直接给出→成立。②→27 countries 是数据来源范围→排除。③→Exeter 是研究机构→排除。④→86 percent 是产量占比，不是国家→排除。
4 干扰：数字与机构名密集；India 只在插入语里出现（including India, the world's biggest producer），容易被读漏。
5 意图：考"同位语取国名"，数字与机构不作国家。
6 边界：若问 How many countries did scientists collect data from? 答 27。若问 What percentage of the world's bananas do these countries produce? 答 86 percent。
7 错误：A 答 27 countries.（错因：范围当国家）；B 答 Exeter.（错因：机构）；C 答 China.（错因：常识替代原文）。
8 规则：R70.3 若问 Which country is the biggest producer of X，then 取同位语（India, the world's biggest producer）；同段数字（27／86 percent／21）与机构名（University of Exeter）不作国家。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.37 职业／身份同位语（国家版）；复用 R25.4（职业取同位语），本条同位语是国家。
10 自检：①同位语在哪？②27 是什么？③86% 是什么？

**34. 答案：Shoot cuttings.**
1 题面：Where do the bananas we grow come from, shoot cuttings or seeds；原文 "Unlike other plants, the bananas we grow come from shoot cuttings (茎段) rather than seeds."；疑问方式：A or B 二选一；诱导信号：rather than seeds 中的 seeds 与 shoot cuttings 并列出现。
2 候选：①shoot cuttings；②seeds；③both；④neither。
3 验算：①→come from shoot cuttings rather than seeds，rather than 排除 seeds→成立。②→被 rather than 排除→不成立。③→both 与 rather than 冲突→排除。④→原文明确 come from shoot cuttings→排除。
4 干扰：rather than 结构里 seeds 在后、紧邻句尾；"Unlike other plants" 也提示要选"不同寻常"的那个。
5 意图：考"A rather than B＝取 A"，二选一题按排除词定。
6 边界：若问 Why do all banana plants have the same genotype? 答 Because they come from shoot cuttings, not seeds。若问 What is the result of having the same genotype? 答 One disease could kill them all。
7 错误：A 答 Seeds.（错因：rather than 后的被排除项）；B 答 Both cuttings and seeds.（错因：与 rather than 冲突）；C 答 Neither.（错因：与 come from 冲突）。
8 规则：R70.4 若题干为 A or B 二选一且原文用 rather than／instead of，then 取 rather than 之前的 A（shoot cuttings），之后的 B（seeds）是被排除项；不得答 both／neither。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式／二选一（rather than 取前项）；复用 R16.5（not A but B 取 B）的反向：本条是 rather than 取前项。
10 自检：①rather than 前后各是什么？②题干给的两个选项顺序？③我取了后项吗？

**35. 答案：2052（2022＋30）.**
1 题面：If one banana plantation suffers Panama in 2022, which year can it grow bananas again；原文 "If one banana plantation (种植园) suffers from the disease, it will take 30 years until it is able to grow bananas again."；疑问方式：给起始年、要求推算结束年（**加算**）；诱导信号：全文反复出现 2050（bananas may disappear by 2050），与答案只差两年。
2 候选：①2052（2022＋30）；②2050（文中灭绝年份）；③1992（2022−30）；④30 years later（表述化）。
3 验算：①→it will take 30 years until it is able to grow bananas again，起始 2022＋30＝2052→成立（须做一步加法）。②→2050 是"香蕉可能消失"的年份，与本题无关→不成立（最易错）。③→减法方向错→排除。④→30 years later 是相对表述，题干要"哪一年"，须给绝对年份→次优。
4 干扰：2050 在文中出现两次（首段与第三段），数字近似、语义熟悉；30 年是原文给的，需要自己相加——这正是全稿第一处真正要动笔算的地方。
5 意图：考"给起始年＋持续年数→推算结束年"，并用"2050 陷阱"检验是否真读了题干。
6 边界：若问 How long does a plantation need to recover from Panama? 答 30 years。若问 When may bananas disappear? 答 By 2050。
7 错误：A 答 2050.（错因：抄文中近似数字）；B 答 1992.（错因：方向错）；C 答 30.（错因：时长当年份）。
8 规则：R70.5 若题干给出起始年并要求"哪一年能再次…"，then 用起始年＋原文持续年数（2022＋30＝2052），答案须为绝对年份；文中其他相近数字（2050）不作答案，时长本身也不当年份。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（年份推算，新增）；这是本稿**第一例需要加算的数字题**，与 R63.2（other 减本体）同属"轻运算"，但确需落笔。
10 自检：①起始年是哪年？②持续多少年？③我抄了 2050 吗？

**组小结（G70 · 小蓝书预测卷十一 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：并列原因（含题干重复）1（31）；两原因取全 1（32）；同位语国名 1（33）；rather than 二选一 1（34）；**年份推算 1（35）**。
- 规则：R70.1 原因并列取全（31）；R70.2 按 One reason／another 取两因（32）；R70.3 国名取同位语（33）；R70.4 rather than 取前项（34）；R70.5 起始年＋N（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R70.1 与"tasty 在题干"冲突，第二条原因优先补；R70.2 与"气候段最长"冲突，another 标记优先；R70.3 与"27／86% 数字多"冲突，同位语优先；R70.4 与"seeds 在句尾"冲突，rather than 前项优先；R70.5 与"2050 反复出现"冲突，题干起始年优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**数字推算首次出现**（2022＋30＝2052，R70.5）——此前全稿 0 例；它属"换算"而非"百分比差值"，故差值仍 0、百分比换算仍 0；图表仍 0（按口径记"知本／慧航待查"）。本篇另有 27／86%／21／1.37／24—32℃／2050／30 等数字，均只作照录或配对，仅 Q35 需一步加算。**小蓝书卷十一 4 篇至此完成（G67—G70）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十七 · Passage 1

Katie always felt there had to be something more to life than just partying, buying clothes and driving a cool car. She finally discovered what she was missing out on when she traveled halfway around the world to help poor kids.

When she was 14, she discovered a club at school called Operation Smile, an organization that supports free operation for facially deformed (面部畸形的) kids in developing countries. At that time, she joined Operation Smile just to satisfy her school's community service requirement.

After working with Operation Smile for a while, she learned different countries have different deformities. The more she learned about what affects kids around the world, the more she wanted to go abroad with Operation Smile.

At 15, she was chosen to go abroad. Before her trip, she attended a weekend "mission (使命) training". That's when she was told she'd be going to the Philippines. Although she was excited, one night during training, she broke down in tears. She felt pity for all those unfortunate kids. After her arrival in the Philippines, she met the kids waiting for operation, and they were running around and happy. It seemed normal. Her job was to play with the kids before their operation to help them feel more relaxed. She also went to nearby schools to hand out toothbrushes and teach students how to brush their teeth.

When their operation was over, the kids were always overjoyed, but their parents were blown away. Sometimes they couldn't even recognize their kids because their appearances had improved so much. They would cry and hug the doctors and nurses and give them presents — they were so grateful.

16. According to the text, what is "Operation Smile"?

______

17. What was Katie's original purpose in joining Operation Smile?

______

18. Why did Katie break down in tears one night during training?



______

19. What did Katie do to help relax those kids?

______

20. Would you like to join the club? Why?

______

**〔G71〕小蓝书预测卷十七 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：An organization (a school club) that supports free operations for facially deformed kids in developing countries.**
1 题面：According to the text, what is "Operation Smile"；原文 "When she was 14, she discovered a club at school called Operation Smile, an organization that supports free operation for facially deformed (面部畸形的) kids in developing countries."；疑问词 what is X（问定义）；诱导信号：called 后的名称与 an organization 的同位语并存，两句都能抄。
2 候选：①an organization that supports free operation for facially deformed kids；②a club at school（只答载体）；③a community service requirement；④a hospital in the Philippines。
3 验算：①→an organization that supports free operation for facially deformed kids in developing countries，同位语从句完整→成立（可写 a school club called Operation Smile, an organization that…）。②→club at school 是它的形态，单独作答信息不足→次优。③→community service requirement 是她加入的原因→排除。④→Philippines 是她 15 岁被派去的地方→排除。
4 干扰：a club at school 紧邻 called，最容易被当成定义；free operation 与 developing countries 两个细节反而更能定义它。
5 意图：考"定义取同位语从句（organization that…）"，形态（club）只作补充。
6 边界：若问 Where did Operation Smile work in this story? 答 In the Philippines。若问 What does Operation Smile do for kids? 答 It supports free operations for facially deformed kids。
7 错误：A 答 A club at school.（错因：形态当定义）；B 答 A hospital.（错因：无据）；C 答 A community service program.（错因：把要求当机构）。
8 规则：R71.1 若问 What is X according to the text，then 取 called 后的同位语从句（an organization that supports free operation for…）；形态名（a club）与地点（the Philippines）只作补充，不作定义。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.27 定义（同位语从句）；复用 R44.1（术语取定义句），本条定义由同位语给出。
10 自检：①同位语从句在哪？②club 是形态还是定义？③地点能当定义吗？

**17. 答案：To satisfy her school's community service requirement.**
1 题面：What was Katie's original purpose in joining Operation Smile；原文 "At that time, she joined Operation Smile just to satisfy her school's community service requirement."；疑问词 original purpose（问最初目的）；诱导信号：全文后半都在写她如何爱上这项事业、为孩子们流泪。
2 候选：①to satisfy her school's community service requirement；②to help poor kids（后来的目的）；③to travel abroad；④to become a doctor。
3 验算：①→joined…just to satisfy her school's community service requirement，just 强调"仅仅为了"，与 original 对应→成立。②→帮助孩子是她后来"发现缺失"的结果，不是最初目的→不成立（问 original 时）。③→出国是 15 岁被选中后的事→排除。④→原文无→排除。
4 干扰：just 一词容易被忽略，而"帮助孩子"的动机更符合道德预期；题干 original 是时间闸门。
5 意图：考"original purpose 取 just to do 句，后期的崇高动机不作最初目的"。
6 边界：若问 Why did Katie go to the Philippines? 答 She was chosen to go abroad with Operation Smile（at 15）。若问 What did she learn after working with it? 答 Different countries have different deformities。
7 错误：A 答 To help poor kids.（错因：后期动机当最初目的）；B 答 To travel around the world.（错因：无据）；C 答 To get a good grade.（错因：改写）。
8 规则：R71.2 若问 What was sb's original purpose，then 取 just to do 句（to satisfy the community service requirement）；后期形成的动机（help poor kids）与结果（go abroad）按 original 排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 目的（最初 vs 后来）；复用 R28.1（initially 只取反转前动机），本条标记是 original／just。
10 自检：①just 后是什么？②"帮助孩子"是哪个阶段？③题干有 original 吗？

**18. 答案：Because she felt pity for all those unfortunate kids.**
1 题面：Why did Katie break down in tears one night during training；原文 "Although she was excited, one night during training, she broke down in tears. She felt pity for all those unfortunate kids."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：Although she was excited 是让步，不是原因。
2 候选：①she felt pity for the unfortunate kids；②she was excited；③she was afraid of the trip；④she missed her family。
3 验算：①→She felt pity for all those unfortunate kids，紧接哭句，直接给因→成立。②→Although she was excited 是让步状语（"尽管兴奋"），与哭相反→不成立。③→原文无害怕→排除。④→原文无想家→排除。
4 干扰：excited 与 broke down in tears 相邻，Although 结构不熟就会把"兴奋"当原因；pity 一词的情感强度不如 tears 直观。
5 意图：考"Although 让步不作原因，后句才是因"。
6 边界：若问 How did Katie feel during the training? 答 Excited but also full of pity（she broke down in tears）。若问 What happened after she arrived in the Philippines? 答 She met the kids waiting for operation, who were running around and happy。
7 错误：A 答 Because she was excited.（错因：让步当原因）；B 答 Because she was afraid to go.（错因：无据）；C 答 Because the training was too hard.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R71.3 若问 Why did sb cry／break down，then 取紧随的情感句（She felt pity for…）；Although 引导的让步（excited）与哭相反，不作原因；原文没有的恐惧、想家不补。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（让步不作因）；复用 R30.3（so 前为因）的反向结构，本条是"Although 让步排除"。
10 自检：①Although 句是什么作用？②哭的直接原因句在哪？③我答 excited 了吗？

**19. 答案：She played with the kids before their operation to help them feel more relaxed.**
1 题面：What did Katie do to help relax those kids；原文 "Her job was to play with the kids before their operation to help them feel more relaxed. She also went to nearby schools to hand out toothbrushes and teach students how to brush their teeth."；疑问词 What did sb do to help relax（问具体做法）；诱导信号：also 后面的发牙刷、教刷牙也是"她做的事"，但目的不同。
2 候选：①played with the kids before their operation；②handed out toothbrushes；③taught students how to brush teeth；④went to nearby schools。
3 验算：①→Her job was to play with the kids before their operation to help them feel more relaxed，与题干 to help relax 同源→成立。②③④→都是 also 引出的另一项工作（去附近学校），目的是卫生教育，不是"让手术前的孩子放松"→排除（可作为她做的其他事）。
4 干扰：also 句内容更多（牙刷、刷牙），容易替代答案；to help them feel more relaxed 是目的状语，正好与题干对应。
5 意图：考"to help relax 取同目的的动作，also 另起的动作按目的排除"。
6 边界：若问 What else did Katie do in the Philippines? 答 She went to nearby schools to hand out toothbrushes and teach students how to brush their teeth。若问 What was her job in the Philippines? 答 To play with the kids before their operation。
7 错误：A 答 She handed out toothbrushes.（错因：另一项目的）；B 答 She operated on the kids.（错因：无据）；C 答 She taught them English.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R71.4 若问 What did sb do to help relax／to achieve X，then 取与同一目的状语同句的动作（played with the kids before their operation）；also／and 另起的动作按目的不同排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（按目的筛选）；复用 R33.2（目的取 to），本条以"目的相同"为筛选条件。
10 自检：①to help relax 与哪个动作同句？②发牙刷属什么目的？③also 后面是另一件事吗？

**20. 答案：（开放题）Yes, I would. Because it gives kids in poor countries free operations and helps them feel relaxed and cared for, and joining it can also make my school life more meaningful.**
1 题面：Would you like to join the club? Why?——两问：表态＋理由；可用依据：supports free operation for facially deformed kids／her job was to play with the kids to help them feel relaxed／hand out toothbrushes／parents were so grateful。
2 候选：①Yes＋理由（免费手术、陪伴孩子、有意义）；②No＋理由（时间不够／不喜欢出国）；③只写 Yes；④复述 Katie 的经历。
3 验算：①→表态完整，理由能落到原文（free operation／play with kids／grateful parents）→成立。②→开放题允许，但须给理由→次优。③→漏 Why→不成立。④→复述经历不是"我想不想加入"→排除。
4 干扰：Katie 的故事很长，容易写成复述；Would you like 的主语是 you，不能答成"Katie 想加入"。
5 意图：考"表态＋理由"，并区分"我的意愿"与"Katie 的经历"。
6 边界：若问 Why did Katie join the club at first? 答 To satisfy her school's community service requirement。若问 What did Katie do before the kids' operation? 答 She played with them to help them relax。
7 错误：A 只写 Yes, I would.（错因：漏理由）；B 答 Katie joined it at 14.（错因：主语错位）；C 答 Because it is a club.（错因：循环）。
8 规则：R71.5 若问 Would you like to join X? Why，then 先表态（Yes, I would.／No, I wouldn't.），再给 1—2 条理由，优先引原文事实（free operation／play with kids）；主语是 you，不得改答他人经历。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.2 双问（意愿＋理由）；复用 R62.5（喜好＝表态＋理由），本条是"加入意愿"。
10 自检：①我表态了吗？②理由在原文哪句？③我把 Katie 当主语了吗？

**组小结（G71 · 小蓝书预测卷十七 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：定义（同位语从句）1（16）；最初目的 1（17）；原因（让步排除）1（18）；举措按目的筛选 1（19）；意愿双问 1（20）。
- 规则：R71.1 定义取同位语从句（16）；R71.2 original 取 just to do（17）；R71.3 让步不作因（18）；R71.4 同一目的才取（19）；R71.5 意愿＝表态＋理由（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R71.1 与"a club at school 紧邻"冲突，同位语优先；R71.2 与"帮助孩子更崇高"冲突，just 优先；R71.3 与"excited 相邻"冲突，pity 句优先；R71.4 与"also 句内容多"冲突，同目的优先；R71.5 与"Katie 的故事最长"冲突，主语 you 优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：公益组织题材第 3 篇（G49／G69／本条）；本组三处"时间／目的闸门"（original／Although／to help relax）集中，可作 04 的闸门样本；数字（14／15）仅作年龄标记，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十七 · Passage 2

Studying abroad has become an extremely popular study option amongst university students. While studying abroad is extremely expensive, it exposes students to a wide range of people, cultures and experiences that will reward them later on in their careers. In my opinion, students are far better off studying abroad even though it might be a bit costly.

One of the greatest advantages of studying in a foreign country is that it exposes students to essential life experiences that will develop them professionally, impossible if they have studied only in their own country. Being in another country forces people to pop and come out of their bubble of comfort, opening them to a wide range of opportunities, which can help them advance in their careers. When I went to study in the UK as an eighteen-year-old, I had to push myself out of my comfort zone and become self-reliant, making me much more mentally and emotionally mature. These ultra-challenging experiences are what develops a person.

A negative aspect of studying overseas is that it is extremely expensive. It is not just high university fees that drive up the expenses; it includes stationery and study material expenses, travelling costs, rent, money spent on food, and other different expenses. I had to take an. education loan of 30000 pounds to fund my tuition fees. Moreover, during my stay in the UK. I had to take up a job as a part-time waiter to earn enough to pay my monthly rent and meet a part of my monthly expenses.

An increasing number of students are opting to study overseas. Although studying abroad can make a hole in your pocket, it will test and challenge you mentally and emotionally, helping your overall personal and professional development. In my opinion, long-term professional and personal gains from overseas studies justify every penny spent on it.

22. What drives up the expenses of studying abroad?

23. Please decide which part is false in the following statement, then change it and explain why. Studying abroad can make a hole in your pocket and challenge you, so overseas studies are not worth it.

______

24. What's the negative aspect of studying abroad?

______

25. Apart from what have been mentioned towards studying abroad, what else do you think of it?(In about 40 words)

**〔G72〕小蓝书预测卷十七 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

> 本组两个特殊题型：**Q23 是"找错—改正—说明"三步改错题**；**Q25 有 40 词上限**（复用 R42.5 限词族）。

**21. 答案：The author thinks students are far better off studying abroad, even though it may be a bit costly — the long-term gains justify the cost.**
1 题面：What's the author's opinion towards studying abroad；原文首段 "In my opinion, students are far better off studying abroad even though it might be a bit costly."＋末段 "In my opinion, long-term professional and personal gains from overseas studies justify every penny spent on it."；疑问词 author's opinion（问作者立场）；诱导信号：首句 Studying abroad has become an extremely popular study option 是现象，不是观点。
2 候选：①far better off studying abroad（利大于费）；②it has become popular（现象）；③it is extremely expensive（缺点）；④students should not study abroad。
3 验算：①→In my opinion…far better off…＋justify every penny，两处 In my opinion 同向→成立（可带 even though 让步）。②→popular 是客观现象，无作者评价→不成立。③→expensive 是作者承认的缺点，但被 even though 让步，不是立场→次优。④→与 far better off 相反→排除。
4 干扰：expensive 一段篇幅最长（还举了 30000 英镑贷款），容易被当成"作者反对"的证据；首句 popular 也像"观点"。
5 意图：考"观点取 In my opinion 句＋让步结构（even though）"，缺点不翻转立场。
6 边界：若问 What is the negative aspect? 答 It is extremely expensive（见 24 题）。若问 What does the author think of the cost? 答 It is worth it because of long-term gains。
7 错误：A 答 Studying abroad is popular.（错因：现象当观点）；B 答 He thinks it is too expensive.（错因：让步当立场）；C 答 He is against studying abroad.（错因：方向反）。
8 规则：R72.1 若问 author's opinion，then 取 In my opinion 句（far better off／justify every penny），并保留 even though 让步；现象句（popular）与让步内容（expensive）不翻转立场。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.3 作者态度（首尾呼应）；复用 R26.5（末段定态度），本条首尾双标。
10 自检：①In my opinion 出现几次？②even though 后是什么？③我把 expensive 当立场了吗？

**22. 答案：Not only high university fees, but also stationery and study material expenses, travelling costs, rent, money spent on food and other different expenses.**
1 题面：What drives up the expenses of studying abroad；原文 "It is not just high university fees that drive up the expenses; it includes stationery and study material expenses, travelling costs, rent, money spent on food, and other different expenses."；疑问词 What drives up（问费用构成）；诱导信号：下一句 I had to take an education loan of 30000 pounds to fund my tuition fees 只有学费一项。
2 候选：①学费＋文具教材＋交通＋房租＋伙食等；②only high university fees；③30000 pounds（贷款额）；④the part-time job。
3 验算：①→not just…it includes…，先排除"只有学费"再列多项→成立（列 2—3 项即可，须含"不止学费"之意）。②→原文用 not just 明确否定→不成立。③→30000 是作者个人贷款额，是例证→次优。④→打工是为付房租，属应对方式→排除。
4 干扰：30000 pounds 是全文唯一大数字，最抢眼；紧接的 tuition fees 让人以为"就是学费"。
5 意图：考"not just A；it includes B, C, D…"结构取全，例证（贷款额）不作构成。
6 边界：若问 How did the author pay for the expenses? 答 He took an education loan of 30000 pounds and worked as a part-time waiter。若问 What did he do as a part-time job? 答 A waiter。
7 错误：A 答 High university fees.（错因：not just 已否定）；B 答 30000 pounds.（错因：贷款额当费用构成）；C 答 Living costs only.（错因：漏学费）。
8 规则：R72.2 若问 What drives up the expenses，then 取 not just…it includes… 的全部并列项（学费＋文具教材＋交通＋房租＋伙食＋其他），至少两项且须体现"不止学费"；个人贷款额（30000 pounds）与打工经历属例证与应对，不作构成。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.15 并列项取全；复用 R22.2（include 取全），本条由 not just 起否定。
10 自检：①not just 否定什么？②it includes 后有几项？③30000 是什么？

**23. 答案：The false part is "so overseas studies are not worth it". It should be changed to "so overseas studies are worth it (they justify every penny)", because the long-term professional and personal gains from studying abroad justify the cost.**
1 题面：Please decide which part is false in the following statement, then change it and explain why. "Studying abroad can make a hole in your pocket and challenge you, so overseas studies are not worth it."——三步任务：①指出错误部分 ②改正 ③说明理由；诱导信号：前半句（make a hole in your pocket／challenge you）原文都支持，只有结论是反的。
2 候选：①错在结论 not worth it→改为 worth it→因长期收益抵得上花费；②错在 make a hole in your pocket（花钱）；③错在 challenge you；④没错。
3 验算：①→原文末段 long-term professional and personal gains…justify every penny，与 not worth it 正相反→成立（三步都要写）。②→原文承认 expensive（a hole in your pocket），此半句为真→不成立。③→原文承认 it will test and challenge you mentally and emotionally→不成立。④→与末段观点冲突→排除。
4 干扰：前半句里 make a hole in your pocket 是俚语，看起来"不正式"，容易被判为错；真正的错在结论的方向。
5 意图：考"改错题先分段验真伪，再改结论，再引原文依据"三步。
6 边界：若问 Is the statement true as a whole? 答 No — its first half is true but the conclusion is false。若问 What does "make a hole in your pocket" mean? 答 Cost a lot of money。
7 错误：A 答 The false part is "make a hole in your pocket".（错因：俚语当错误）；B 只写 not worth it→worth it（错因：缺 explain why）；C 答 The statement is true.（错因：与末段相反）。
8 规则：R72.3 若题干要求 decide which part is false, change it and explain why，then 三步齐全：①指出错误部分（结论 so…not worth it）②改为相反表述（worth it／justify every penny）③引原文依据（long-term gains justify the cost）；前半句中被原文支持的成分（expensive／challenge）不得判错，俚语也不等于错误。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 判断＋改错（新题型：陈述改错）；与 RA-5 补全式的"框架改形式"并列，本条是"陈述改真假"。
10 自检：①哪一半被原文支持？②结论该怎么改？③我写了 why 吗？

**24. 答案：It is extremely expensive.**
1 题面：What's the negative aspect of studying abroad；原文 "A negative aspect of studying overseas is that it is extremely expensive."；疑问词 negative aspect（问缺点）；诱导信号：同段列了六项费用与贷款、打工，信息量大。
2 候选：①it is extremely expensive；②high university fees only；③students may feel homesick；④it takes too much time。
3 验算：①→A negative aspect…is that it is extremely expensive，主句表语直接给出→成立（一句话即可）。②→学费只是费用之一，且 not just 已否定"只有学费"→次优。③→homesickness 是另一篇（Costa Rica）学生的担心→排除。④→原文无时间问题→排除。
4 干扰：六项费用铺满一段，容易把"某一项费用"当缺点；30000 英镑也抢眼。
5 意图：考"negative aspect 取主句表语（一句话概括），细节不替代概括"。
6 边界：若问 What expenses does studying abroad include? 见 22 题。若问 How did the author deal with the cost? 答 He took an education loan and worked as a part-time waiter。
7 错误：A 答 High university fees.（错因：细节当概括）；B 答 Homesickness.（错因：串篇）；C 答 It is far from home.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R72.4 若问 What's the negative aspect of X，then 取 A negative aspect…is that 的主句表语（it is extremely expensive），一句话即可；同段费用细项与别篇担忧（homesickness）不作概括。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（缺点概括）；复用 R28.3（段意按段落边界），本条是"缺点一句话"。
10 自检：①主句表语是什么？②六项费用属哪题？③homesickness 在哪篇？

**25. 答案：（开放题，约 40 词）Besides the cost and personal growth mentioned above, I think studying abroad also helps students improve their foreign language skills, learn to live independently and make friends from different cultures, which will benefit their future careers.**
1 题面：Apart from what have been mentioned towards studying abroad, what else do you think of it?(In about 40 words)——半开放＋**约 40 词**；原文已提：费用高、生活体验、职业发展、独立自主、情感成熟；题干要求"原文之外"；诱导信号：40 词上限容易被忽略。
2 候选：①补充语言能力／独立生活／跨文化朋友（约 40 词）；②重复"费用高、能成长"；③只写 It is good；④写 80 词以上。
3 验算：①→三条都不在原文的列举里（原文有 self-reliant，但未提 language skills／跨文化交友），且约 40 词→成立。②→与 Apart from 冲突→不成立。③→无内容→排除。④→超词数→排除。
4 干扰：原文 self-reliant 与"独立生活"很近，稍不注意就重复；"职业发展"也已提过，须避开。
5 意图：考"排除原文＋限词＋具体补充"三条件同时满足。
6 边界：若题干无 Apart from，可结合原文作答。若问 What does the author think of the cost? 答 见 21 题（justify every penny）。
7 错误：A 答 Studying abroad is expensive but worthwhile.（错因：重复原文）；B 只写 It is good for students.（错因：空泛）；C 写 80 词（错因：超限）。
8 规则：R72.5 若题干含 Apart from what have been mentioned 且给词数（in about 40 words），then 只写原文未提的具体方面（language skills／independence／cross-cultural friends），控制在全句约 40 词，重复项与空泛评价均不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.6 半开放列举（排除原文＋限词）；复用 R44.5（排除原文法）与 R42.5（限词），本条两条件叠加且词数为 40。
10 自检：①我写的是原文已有的吗？②约 40 词吗？③有没有具体方面？

**组小结（G72 · 小蓝书预测卷十七 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：作者观点（首尾呼应）1（21）；费用构成（not just）1（22）；**陈述改错三步**1（23）；缺点概括 1（24）；半开放＋40 词 1（25）。
- 规则：R72.1 观点取 In my opinion（21）；R72.2 not just 取全（22）；R72.3 改错三步（23）；R72.4 缺点一句话（24）；R72.5 排除原文＋约 40 词（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R72.1 与"expensive 段最长"冲突，In my opinion 优先；R72.2 与"30000 醒目"冲突，并列项优先；R72.3 与"俚语像错"冲突，原文支持优先；R72.4 与"六项费用"冲突，主句表语优先；R72.5 与"self-reliant 近义"冲突，Apart from 优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**新题型"陈述改错"（RA-1.34 变体）**：给一句含真假两部分的陈述，要求指出、改正、说明；与 RA-5 补全式"改形式"分工不同（那改形式，这改真假）。数字 30000 pounds 只作例证，**无换算、无推算**；词数限制由 20 扩到 40（R42.5 族第 5 例）。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十七 · Passage 3

Luke has always been my closest companion these past five years. As you already know, there have been a lot of forest fires during the summer season. Many forests are badly damaged by fire each year. Not far from our shelter, a forest caught fire during this hot summer. We are on July, a heat wave which has been going on for three days.

Luke rushed towards the forest where flames send out a fierce heat. There's no longer any hope at the moment to wait for Luke to come back to the shelter. In fact, I was waiting for the fire brigade(消防队) to announce me his death in the forest. Suddenly, a fireman burst into my office and informed me that my dog Luke succeeded to save four kittens who were trapped by the flames. According to the fireman, Luke seized the kittens, one by one moving them to a safe place.

I immediately accompanied the fireman to the forest to pick up the rescued kittens. Once on the scene of the incident, Luke was not there. Then we heard the sound of a dog came from the forest barking. I recognized the sound of my dog Luke. The firemen followed the tracks of the dog until they found him barking loudly by the side of an injured fireman who was lying on the ground and desperately waiting for rescue.

Thanks to Luke, four kittens and a fireman were saved. That day, I was very proud of Luke for his two heroic actions. Luke showed much compassion for both animals like him and for a human being who was trying to put out the fire with his colleagues. Truth to tell, my happiness is great and immeasurable.



I paid a visit to the fireman in his house accompanied with my lovely Luke. What a memorable scene when the fireman hugged Luke tightly to his chest! "One thousand thanks, Luke, for saving my life," the fireman said.

This true story of love and compassion shows us that pets are loving, caring and compassionate. We should love and protect them. Don't belittle them. Little animals can make enormous things for humans.

26. What happened near the author's shelter this summer?
