27. What did the author think when Luke rushed towards the burning forest?

______

28. Why was Luke heard barking loudly in the forest after picking up the rescued kittens?

______

29. What does the underlined "belittle" mean?

______

30. How can you describe Luke? Please give your reasons.

______

**〔G73〕小蓝书预测卷十七 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：A forest near the author's shelter caught fire (during a hot summer, in a heat wave that had lasted three days).**
1 题面：What happened near the author's shelter this summer；原文 "Not far from our shelter, a forest caught fire during this hot summer. We are on July, a heat wave which has been going on for three days."；疑问词 What happened（问事件）；诱导信号：首段前两句 Many forests are badly damaged by fire each year 是一般现象。
2 候选：①a forest caught fire（＋heat wave three days）；②forest fires happen every year（一般现象）；③Luke ran away；④the fire brigade came。
3 验算：①→Not far from our shelter, a forest caught fire during this hot summer，地点＋事件＋时间齐全→成立（可补 heat wave）。②→是每年的一般情况，不是"今年这个夏天"的具体事件→不成立。③→Luke 是冲进火场救猫，不是逃跑→排除。④→消防队是后文来救火／通知的人→排除。
4 干扰：Many forests are badly damaged by fire each year 就在前一句，概括性强；题干 this summer 是时间闸门。
5 意图：考"具体事件取 this summer 句，一般现象不作答案"。
6 边界：若问 How long had the heat wave lasted? 答 Three days。若问 What did Luke do when the forest caught fire? 答 He rushed towards the forest。
7 错误：A 答 Forest fires damage many forests.（错因：一般现象）；B 答 Luke was lost.（错因：无据）；C 答 A house caught fire.（错因：对象错）。
8 规则：R73.1 若问 What happened near X this summer，then 取该时间地点句的具体事件（a forest caught fire）；同段的一般现象（many forests are damaged each year）不作具体事件。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.40 事件核（具体 vs 一般）；复用 R31.1（结论性事件），本条是"具体事件"。
10 自检：①this summer 与哪句连？②each year 句是什么？③火在哪？

**27. 答案：He thought there was no longer any hope for Luke to come back — he was waiting for the fire brigade to announce Luke's death.**
1 题面：What did the author think when Luke rushed towards the burning forest；原文 "There's no longer any hope at the moment to wait for Luke to come back to the shelter. In fact, I was waiting for the fire brigade(消防队) to announce me his death in the forest."；疑问词 What did sb think（问当时想法）；诱导信号：后文 I was very proud of Luke 是结局感受，不是当时的想法。
2 候选：①no hope／waiting for death announcement；②he was proud of Luke；③Luke would save the kittens；④the fire was not serious。
3 验算：①→no longer any hope＋waiting for…his death，两句同向→成立。②→proud 出现在获救之后（That day, I was very proud）→不成立（时点错）。③→他当时并不知道 Luke 能救猫，反而在等死讯→排除。④→fierce heat／no hope 说明火势严重→排除。
4 干扰：proud 是全文情感高点，最容易被当"想法"；悬念式写法（waiting for death）也容易被读成"他真的死了"。
5 意图：考"当时想法取当时句，事后感受按时间排除"。
6 边界：若问 How did the author feel after Luke was found? 答 He was very proud of Luke。若问 Who told the author about Luke? 答 A fireman。
7 错误：A 答 He was proud of Luke.（错因：事后感受）；B 答 He thought Luke was dead.（错因：夸大，原文是"等死讯"）；C 答 He thought Luke would save someone.（错因：当时不知道）。
8 规则：R73.2 若问 What did sb think when…，then 取当时的心理句（no longer any hope／waiting for the death announcement），事后感受（proud）与上帝视角的结局按时间排除；"等死讯"不等于"已死"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.13 情绪／想法（时点）；复用 R69.2（时点截断），本条是"想法 vs 事后感受"。
10 自检：①当时句在哪？②proud 是什么时候？③"等死讯"等于死了吗？

**28. 答案：Because he was barking by the side of an injured fireman who was lying on the ground and waiting for rescue.**
1 题面：Why was Luke heard barking loudly in the forest after picking up the rescued kittens；原文 "Then we heard the sound of a dog came from the forest barking… The firemen followed the tracks of the dog until they found him barking loudly by the side of an injured fireman who was lying on the ground and desperately waiting for rescue."；疑问词 Why was Luke heard barking（问行为原因）；诱导信号：前文说他救出四只小猫，读者容易以为他还在找猫或报喜。
2 候选：①by the side of an injured fireman waiting for rescue；②he was happy about the kittens；③he wanted food；④he was afraid of fire。
3 验算：①→found him barking loudly by the side of an injured fireman…waiting for rescue，位置＋对象直接给出→成立。②→原文无"为猫高兴而叫"→排除。③→无据→排除。④→他敢冲进火场，与"怕火"相反→排除。
4 干扰：救猫先发生，容易被当成叫的原因；barking loudly 的字面也像"兴奋"。
5 意图：考"叫的原因取所在位置与人（by the side of an injured fireman）"，即第二次救援。
6 边界：若问 How many kittens did Luke save? 答 Four。若问 How many people did Luke help save? 答 One（an injured fireman）。
7 错误：A 答 Because he was happy about the kittens.（错因：编造情绪）；B 答 Because he was lost.（错因：与 found him 矛盾）；C 答 Because he wanted to go home.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R73.3 若问 Why was an animal heard doing sth，then 取"被发现时的位置＋对象"句（by the side of an injured fireman waiting for rescue）；先前完成的动作（救猫）不作本次叫声的原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（位置＋对象）；复用 R33.3（多主体配对），本条是"叫声—对象"配对。
10 自检：①他被发现时在哪？②旁边是谁？③救猫是本次原因吗？

**29. 答案：It means "to look down on" — to think someone or something is unimportant.（轻视、贬低）**
1 题面：What does the underlined "belittle" mean；原文 "We should love and protect them. Don't belittle them. Little animals can make enormous things for humans."；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 mean（词义题）；诱导信号：little 与 belittle 同根，容易被按字面理解为"使变小"。
2 候选：①look down on／think unimportant（轻视）；②make something small（字面"使变小"）；③love and protect；④feed and train。
3 验算：①→Don't belittle them 与前面 We should love and protect them 相对，后句 Little animals can make enormous things for humans 又强调"别小看"→成立。②→字面"使变小"在此无对应动作，句子不成立→排除。③→love and protect 是正面做法，belittle 是它的反面→排除。④→原文无→排除。
4 干扰：be＋little 的构词联想（"使变小"）最强；little animals 的 little 也强化这层误读。
5 意图：考"按上下文（正反对照＋后句反转）定词义"，构词不作依据。
6 边界：若问 What can little animals do for humans? 答 They can make enormous things（e.g. save lives）。若问 How should we treat pets according to the writer? 答 We should love and protect them。
7 错误：A 答 To make animals smaller.（错因：构词直译）；B 答 To love them.（错因：与 Don't 冲突）；C 答 To train them.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R73.4 若划线词含 little／small 等构词线索，then 仍按上下文定值：Don't belittle them 与 love and protect 相对、Little animals can make enormous things 反转"小＝无用"→取"轻视／贬低"；构词义（使变小）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（构词陷阱）；词义族已停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（Don't＋动词原形）→正反对照（love and protect）→语域（动物保护呼吁）→词面义（be＋little 只作干扰）。
10 自检：①前后哪句是反义？②后句怎样反转"小"？③我按构词译了吗？

**30. 答案：Luke is brave, compassionate and caring. He rushed into the burning forest to save four kittens one by one, and later he stayed barking by an injured fireman until the firemen found him.**
1 题面：How can you describe Luke? Please give your reasons.——评价＋理由；可用依据：rushed towards the forest where flames send out a fierce heat／succeeded to save four kittens／barking loudly by the side of an injured fireman／showed much compassion for both animals and a human being。
2 候选：①brave／compassionate／caring＋两件英雄事迹；②he is a dog（身份）；③he is lucky；④只写 He is great。
3 验算：①→每个品质词都有行为支撑（冲进火场＝brave；救人救猫＝compassionate／caring）→成立（两件事最好都提）。②→身份不是评价→不成立。③→lucky 抹掉主动性→排除。④→空评价→不成立。
4 干扰：末段现成的三个形容词（loving, caring and compassionate）可以直接抄，但题干要求 reasons，须配行为；两件事（猫／消防员）容易只写一件。
5 意图：考"评价＝品质词＋行为证据"，且两件英雄事迹都可作证据。
6 边界：若问 What did the fireman say to Luke? 答 "One thousand thanks, Luke, for saving my life."。若问 What does the story want to tell us? 答 Pets are loving, caring and compassionate; we should love and protect them。
7 错误：A 答 He is a lovely dog.（错因：空评价）；B 答 He is lucky.（错因：无据）；C 只写 He saved four kittens.（错因：只有事实、无评价词）。
8 规则：R73.5 若问 How can you describe X? Please give your reasons，then 给 2—3 个品质词（brave／compassionate／caring）并各配一条行为（救猫／守伤者）；现成的形容词可直接用，但必须配证据；身份与空评价不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（品质＋行为）；复用 R69.5／R37.5，本条对象是动物。
10 自检：①我给了几个品质词？②配了哪两件事？③只写事实没评价吗？

**组小结（G73 · 小蓝书预测卷十七 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：具体事件 1（26）；当时想法 1（27）；叫声原因 1（28）；词义（构词陷阱）1（29）；动物评价 1（30）。
- 规则：R73.1 具体事件 vs 一般现象（26）；R73.2 当时想法 vs 事后感受（27）；R73.3 叫声取位置＋对象（28）；R73.4 构词不作词义（29）；R73.5 品质＋行为（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R73.1 与"each year 概括句"冲突，this summer 优先；R73.2 与"proud 情感高点"冲突，时点优先；R73.3 与"救猫在先"冲突，发现位置优先；R73.4 与"be＋little 构词"冲突，上下文优先；R73.5 与"现成形容词"冲突，证据优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：动物叙事类首见；本篇三处"时点／位置闸门"（this summer／when he rushed／after picking up）集中，可作 04 的叙事类样本；数字（four kittens／three days／one fireman）均为清点，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十七 · Passage 4

My students and I were ready for a challenge — a trip to Costa Rica. As we were waiting at the airport, we talked about our hopes and fears for our ten — day trip. My students worried about homesickness and felt uneasy with their homestay families. But strange foods or meeting new people didn't concern me. What terrified me was the best part of the trip — a zip lining(滑缆绳) flight over the jungle valley bordering Arenal Volcano. I made a secret pact(协议) with myself to find an excuse to get out of it at the last minute.

When the fateful day arrived, we got to the peak to enjoy the breathtaking view of the volcano. When seeing the activity, my students raised a cheerful shout. How I wished I had had the same feeling as them. However, I was afraid of heights.

My student Eileen sidled up to me. Her face was pale. "I'm scared," she whispered. "Will you stay back with me?" Here was my chance! I could get out of zip lining and still save face!

"I'm scared, too," I said quietly.

"Yeah," she said. "I thought you would be the right person to ask because you are really



white, and you are sweating." Her words woke me up, and something clicked into place. If I couldn't step outside of my comfort zone, how could I ask the kids to do so?

"Maybe we should give it a try," I said. I felt a little sick, but I couldn't believe my body was actually moving toward the launch point.

"Come on," I said. "OK," she agreed.

Eileen zipped past me, screaming with fear or delight, which I was not sure of. Once she was across, I followed. The attempt was not as terrible as I had thought. From that moment on, I knew there was nothing to fear as long as I walked out of my comfort zone and had a try.

31. What worried the author's students about the trip?

______

32. What did the author's students think of the activity of a zip lining fight?

______

33. What's the meaning of the underlined word?

______

34. Why did Eileen come up to the author on the day of the activity?

______

35. What do you think of the author's attempt? Give your reasons.

______

**〔G74〕小蓝书预测卷十七 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：Homesickness and feeling uneasy with their homestay families.**
1 题面：What worried the author's students about the trip；原文 "My students worried about homesickness and felt uneasy with their homestay families."；疑问词 What worried（问担忧内容）；诱导信号：下一句 But strange foods or meeting new people didn't concern me 是"作者不担心"的部分。
2 候选：①homesickness＋uneasy with homestay families；②strange foods；③meeting new people；④the zip lining flight。
3 验算：①→worried about homesickness and felt uneasy with their homestay families，两个担忧并列→成立（两条都写）。②③→原文明确 didn't concern me（作者），且不是学生的担忧→排除。④→zip lining 让作者恐惧，学生反而兴奋→排除。
4 干扰：strange foods 与 meeting new people 紧跟 worried 句，且都以"人"为中心；作者与学生的担忧对象容易互换。
5 意图：考"担忧按主体配对（学生 vs 作者）"。
6 边界：若问 What terrified the author? 答 The zip lining flight over the jungle valley。若问 What did the students do when they saw the activity? 答 They raised a cheerful shout。
7 错误：A 答 Strange foods.（错因：作者不担心的项）；B 答 The zip lining flight.（错因：主体错位）；C 答 Meeting new people.（错因：同上）。
8 规则：R74.1 若问 What worried sb's students，then 取 worried about 后的两项（homesickness＋uneasy with homestay families），两条并列不省；同段作者自己的态度（didn't concern me）按主体排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.41 多主体配对（担忧）；复用 R33.3（多主体担忧配对），本条主体是"学生 vs 作者"。
10 自检：①worried 后有几项？②strange foods 是谁的态度？③作者怕什么？

**32. 答案：They were excited about it — they raised a cheerful shout when they saw the activity.**
1 题面：What did the author's students think of the activity of a zip lining flight；原文 "When seeing the activity, my students raised a cheerful shout. How I wished I had had the same feeling as them."；疑问词 What did sb think of（问态度）；诱导信号：紧接的 However, I was afraid of heights 是作者的态度。
2 候选：①excited／cheerful（raised a cheerful shout）；②afraid（作者的态度）；③bored；④worried about homesickness。
3 验算：①→raised a cheerful shout＋How I wished I had had the same feeling as them，说明学生兴奋→成立。②→afraid of heights 是作者→不成立（主体错）。③→原文无 bored→排除。④→homesickness 是行前担忧，不是对该活动的看法→排除。
4 干扰：However, I was afraid of heights 就在下一句，且情绪更强；How I wished… 虚拟句也容易被读成"学生害怕"。
5 意图：考"态度按主体配对，虚拟句表作者羡慕"。
6 边界：若问 How did the author feel about the activity? 答 He was terrified／afraid of heights。若问 What did the author do at last? 答 He gave it a try and zipped across。
7 错误：A 答 They were afraid.（错因：作者态度）；B 答 They were bored.（错因：无据）；C 答 They worried about it.（错因：与 cheer 相反）。
8 规则：R74.2 若问 What did sb's students think of X，then 取学生行为的情绪标记（raised a cheerful shout）与作者的羡慕句（wished I had had the same feeling）；下一句作者自己的 afraid 按主体排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.13 情绪态度（主体配对）；复用 R32.1（情绪看体态＋引语），本条看群体动作。
10 自检：①学生做了什么动作？②afraid 是谁？③wished 句说明什么？

**33. 答案：It means "pale" — her face had no colour because she was scared.（脸色苍白）**
1 题面：What's the meaning of the underlined word；划线所在句 "I thought you would be the right person to ask because you are really white, and you are sweating."；前文 "Her face was pale. 'I'm scared,' she whispered."；疑问词 meaning（词义题，需先定划线词）；诱导信号：white 的常义"白色"。
2 候选：①pale（脸色苍白、害怕）；②white colour（白色）；③white-haired（年老）；④honest（清白）。
3 验算：①→Her face was pale＋I'm scared＋you are sweating，white 与 pale 同指"吓得脸白"→成立。②→颜色义在此与"害怕、出汗"无因果关系→不成立。③→原文无年龄线索→排除。④→"清白"义与害怕无关→排除。
4 干扰：white 的字面义最强；pale 出现在前一段，若不回看就抓不到对应。
5 意图：考"颜色词在情绪语境中转义（white＝pale）"，需回看前文的 pale。
6 边界：若问 Why did Eileen look white? 答 Because she was scared（of the zip lining）。若问 What did the author look like then? 答 He was white and sweating, too。
7 错误：A 答 White colour.（错因：字面义）；B 答 Old.（错因：无据）；C 答 Calm.（错因：与 sweating 矛盾）。
8 规则：R74.3 若划线词是颜色词且同段有情绪线索（pale／scared／sweating），then 取情绪转义（pale＝脸色苍白、害怕）；字面颜色义与环境无关时不取；须回看前一段找对应词。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（颜色词转义）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（you are really white）→同段情绪线索（pale／scared／sweating）→语域（惊吓）→词面义（只作干扰）。
10 自检：①前一段有 pale 吗？②sweating 说明什么？③我按颜色译了吗？

**34. 答案：Because she was scared and wanted the author to stay back with her.**
1 题面：Why did Eileen come up to the author on the day of the activity；原文 "My student Eileen sidled up to me. Her face was pale. 'I'm scared,' she whispered. 'Will you stay back with me?'"；疑问词 Why did sb come up（问原因）；诱导信号：作者把这当成"逃避的借口"（Here was my chance!），容易把作者的动机当成 Eileen 的。
2 候选：①she was scared and asked the author to stay back with her；②she wanted to encourage the author；③she wanted to take photos；④she was ill。
3 验算：①→Her face was pale／I'm scared／Will you stay back with me，三句同向→成立。②→鼓励作者是后来发生的事（作者反而被她说服）→时点在后。③→原文无拍照→排除。④→pale 是害怕不是生病→次优。
4 干扰：作者的心理（Here was my chance! I could get out of zip lining）紧接其后，最容易把"想逃避"安到 Eileen 身上；pale 也可能被读成"生病"。
5 意图：考"动机取说话人自述（scared／stay back），作者的心理活动不作他人动机"。
6 边界：若问 What did the author answer? 答 "I'm scared, too."（then "Maybe we should give it a try"）。若问 Who zipped first? 答 Eileen。
7 错误：A 答 Because she wanted to encourage the author.（错因：时点在后）；B 答 Because she was ill.（错因：pale 误读）；C 答 Because she wanted to avoid the activity for the author.（错因：作者心理）。
8 规则：R74.4 若问 Why did sb come up to another，then 取该人自述（I'm scared／Will you stay back with me）；紧随的作者心理（Here was my chance）属另一主体，不作他人动机；pale 在此表害怕而非生病。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（主体动机）；复用 R32.3（动机取引语自述），本条主体是学生。
10 自检：①Eileen 说了什么？②"机会"是谁的想法？③pale 是病吗？

**35. 答案：（开放题）I think the author's attempt was brave and meaningful. He was afraid of heights, but he stepped out of his comfort zone and set an example for his students, and the attempt turned out not as terrible as he had thought.**
1 题面：What do you think of the author's attempt? Give your reasons.——评价＋理由；可用依据：What terrified me was…zip lining／I made a secret pact to find an excuse／If I couldn't step outside of my comfort zone, how could I ask the kids to do so?／The attempt was not as terrible as I had thought。
2 候选：①brave／meaningful＋理由（走出舒适区、做榜样、没想象中可怕）；②foolish（明知害怕还去）；③只写 It was good；④复述滑缆绳过程。
3 验算：①→三条理由都能落到原文（afraid of heights／set an example／not as terrible）→成立。②→开放题允许，但须给理由（如 risky），原文未支持→次优。③→空评价→不成立。④→复述过程无评价→排除。
4 干扰：作者一开始想找借口逃避（secret pact），这段"不勇敢"的描写容易被当成负面评价的依据；但转折在 he gave it a try。
5 意图：考"评价取转折后的行为＋心理转变"，前期的怯懦只作对比。
6 边界：若问 Why did the author decide to try? 答 Because he realized he couldn't ask the kids to step out of their comfort zone if he didn't。若问 How did the attempt feel? 答 Not as terrible as he had thought。
7 错误：A 只写 It was good.（错因：漏理由）；B 答 He was foolish.（错因：无据、且与转折相反）；C 答 He was forced to do it.（错因：他是自己决定）。
8 规则：R74.5 若问 What do you think of sb's attempt，then 先给评价（brave／meaningful／worth trying），再给 1—2 条理由，优先用转折后的行为与心理（stepped out of comfort zone／set an example／not as terrible）；前期怯懦只作对比，不作评价依据。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（行为评价）；复用 R56.5（措施评价），本条对象是个人尝试。
10 自检：①我给了评价词吗？②理由用了转折后的事吗？③我复述过程了吗？

**组小结（G74 · 小蓝书预测卷十七 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：学生担忧（主体配对）1（31）；学生对活动的态度 1（32）；颜色词转义 1（33）；学生动机 1（34）；尝试评价 1（35）。
- 规则：R74.1 担忧按主体配对（31）；R74.2 态度按主体配对（32）；R74.3 white＝pale（33）；R74.4 动机取自述、作者心理不作他人动机（34）；R74.5 评价取转折后行为（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R74.1 与"strange foods 紧邻"冲突，主体优先；R74.2 与"afraid 更强"冲突，主体优先；R74.3 与"white 字面"冲突，pale 线索优先；R74.4 与"作者的 chance"冲突，自述优先；R74.5 与"secret pact 怯懦"冲突，转折优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：教育旅行叙事首见；本组四题都靠"主体"或"时点"分流（学生 vs 作者、行前 vs 活动当天），与 G73 的时点闸门互补；数字（ten-day／eighteen-year-old 见 P2）无换算，**本组无推算**；**小蓝书卷十七 4 篇至此完成（G71—G74）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十三 · Passage 1

When 16-year-old Colin Moore is out on the football field, he is putting his heart into the game and looks just like any other teenage athlete out there. But what makes him different than the rest, is that he's playing without part of his arm.

Moore was born without the lower part of his right arm, but he's never let that stop him from achieving anything he's put his mind to in his life, including football. "I've always had to have a mind of steel, heart of gold, and just move forward no matter what." Moore said.

Although his arm difference has never got in the way of anything, it's been a challenge for him. But in everything he does, he's worked twice as hard as everyone else to make sure he would succeed. Moore's goal is to be a starting center, which requires a lot of body strength. Even though he is missing an arm, he makes up for it with his fast movements and strength, making him the perfect choice for this position.

Moore looks up to the Philadelphia Eagles center Jason Kelce, and aims to be just like him one day. Moore's hard work even got him noticed by his hero. After seeing a video of Moore playing football, Kelce sent him one back. Kelce told Moore that his perseverance is a great encouragement to him. He even invited Moore to join him and the Eagles at their training camp so they could meet him.

Moore's coach Frank Holmes agrees with Kelce and compliments Moore's perseverance. "The thing I can say about Colin is this: he was born with a challenging situation, but every day he has a positive attitude and focuses fully on whatever he does. He trains hard."

**〔G75〕小蓝书预测卷十三 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：He is playing (football) without the lower part of his right arm — he was born without it.**
1 题面：What makes Moore different from other athletes；原文 "But what makes him different than the rest, is that he's playing without part of his arm."＋"Moore was born without the lower part of his right arm"；疑问词 What makes sb different（问差异点）；诱导信号：下一段 works twice as hard 是他应对差异的方式。
2 候选：①playing without part of his arm（born without the lower right arm）；②he works twice as hard；③he has a mind of steel；④he looks up to Jason Kelce。
3 验算：①→what makes him different…is that he's playing without part of his arm，表语从句直接给出；下一段补充"出生时缺右臂下半部"→成立。②→努力加倍是"如何弥补"，不是差异本身→次优。③→mind of steel 是他自述的心态→排除。④→偶像是激励来源→排除。
4 干扰：twice as hard 与 positive attitude 更励志，容易被当成"不同之处"；但题干问的是"与别人不一样在哪"这一客观差异。
5 意图：考"different 取客观差异（身体条件），努力方式不作差异"。
6 边界：若问 How did Moore make up for his missing arm? 答 With his fast movements and strength。若问 What is Moore's goal? 答 To be a starting center。
7 错误：A 答 He works twice as hard.（错因：应对方式当差异）；B 答 He is 16 years old.（错因：年龄不独特）；C 答 He looks like any other athlete.（错因：与 different 相反）。
8 规则：R75.1 若问 What makes sb different from others，then 取表语从句／客观条件（playing without part of his arm／born without the lower right arm）；努力程度、心态与偶像属"应对与激励"，不作差异点。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（差异点）；复用 R50.1（different 取行为链）的反向：本条取客观条件。
10 自检：①表语从句说什么？②twice as hard 是哪类信息？③题干问的是差异还是努力？

**17. 答案：He worked twice as hard as everyone else and made up for his missing arm with his fast movements and strength.**
1 题面：How did Moore achieve his goal；原文 "But in everything he does, he's worked twice as hard as everyone else to make sure he would succeed. Moore's goal is to be a starting center… Even though he is missing an arm, he makes up for it with his fast movements and strength."；疑问词 How did sb achieve（问方式）；诱导信号：上一句 it's been a challenge for him 只是困难描述。
2 候选：①worked twice as hard＋made up with fast movements and strength；②he had a mind of steel（心态）；③Kelce invited him to the camp（外部机会）；④his coach praised him。
3 验算：①→worked twice as hard＋makes up for it with fast movements and strength，两条都是"如何做到"→成立（两条都写）。②→mind of steel 是态度，可作补充但不具体→次优。③→被邀请是结果与鼓励，不是他达成目标的方式→排除。④→教练表扬是评价→排除。
4 干扰：mind of steel, heart of gold 的引语很动人；Kelce 的邀请是全文高潮，容易被当"成功原因"。
5 意图：考"方式取具体做法（加倍努力＋用速度与力量弥补）"。
6 边界：若问 What does the position of starting center require? 答 A lot of body strength。若问 Why is Moore the perfect choice for the position? 答 Because he makes up for his missing arm with fast movements and strength。
7 错误：A 答 He had a mind of steel.（错因：心态当方式）；B 答 Jason Kelce invited him.（错因：机会当方式）；C 答 He was born with one arm.（错因：条件当方式）。
8 规则：R75.2 若问 How did sb achieve his goal，then 取具体做法两条（worked twice as hard＋made up for it with fast movements and strength）；心态（mind of steel）、外部机会（invitation）与先天条件不作方式。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（做法链）；复用 R69.2（取做法），本条是"努力＋弥补"双做法。
10 自检：①两处做法在哪？②mind of steel 是做法吗？③邀请是结果吗？

**18. 答案：He sent Moore a video back, told him that his perseverance was a great encouragement to him, and invited him to join the Eagles at their training camp.**
1 题面：What did Jason Kelce do after seeing Moore play；原文 "After seeing a video of Moore playing football, Kelce sent him one back. Kelce told Moore that his perseverance is a great encouragement to him. He even invited Moore to join him and the Eagles at their training camp so they could meet him."；疑问词 What did sb do（问动作链）；诱导信号：Kelce 是美国职业队中锋（Philadelphia Eagles center），身份信息多。
2 候选：①sent a video back＋said perseverance encouraged him＋invited him to training camp；②he is a center of the Eagles（身份）；③he watched a video（题干已给）；④he praised Moore's coach。
3 验算：①→三个动作依次出现（sent…back／told…／invited…）→成立（至少写两件，写全最好）。②→身份不是"做了什么"→排除。③→看视频是题干预设，不是新动作→排除。④→是 Holmes 赞同 Kelce，方向相反→排除。
4 干扰：身份（Eagles center）与"偶像"关系抢注意；三件事中 invited 最具体，容易只写这一件。
5 意图：考"动作链取全（回视频／肯定毅力／邀训练营）"。
6 边界：若问 Who is Jason Kelce? 答 The center of the Philadelphia Eagles（and Moore's hero）。若问 What did Kelce think of Moore? 答 His perseverance is a great encouragement。
7 错误：A 答 He invited Moore to the training camp.（错因：只取一件）；B 答 He is Moore's hero.（错因：身份关系）；C 答 He praised Moore's coach.（错因：方向错）。
8 规则：R75.3 若问 What did sb do after seeing X，then 取该段动作链全部（sent a video back＋told him his perseverance encouraged him＋invited him to the camp），至少两件；身份（center／hero）与题干已给的动作（watched a video）不计。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.15 动作链取全；复用 R67.4（for 机构取全部动作），本条是"人物动作链"。
10 自检：①有几件动作？②身份算动作吗？③我漏了回视频吗？

**19. 答案：It means "praises" — the coach speaks highly of Moore's perseverance.（表扬、称赞）**
1 题面：What is the meaning of the underlined word in the last paragraph；原文末段 "Moore's coach Frank Holmes agrees with Kelce and compliments Moore's perseverance."；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 meaning（词义题）；诱导信号：compliment 与 complement（补充）形近，易混。
2 候选：①praises（表扬）；②complements（补充）；③criticizes（批评）；④compares（比较）。
3 验算：①→agrees with Kelce and compliments Moore's perseverance，与 agrees 同向、后接"毅力"作宾语→成立。②→complement 是"补充／互补"，与 agrees 并列不搭→排除（形近陷阱）。③→criticizes 与 agrees 相反→不成立。④→compares 需 with／to 结构，句中无→排除。
4 干扰：compliment／complement 只差一个字母，是本题核心陷阱；coach 的引语里也有 compliments（名词）出现，需区分词性。
5 意图：考"形近词按搭配与语境辨义"，并与上文 agrees 同向校验。
6 边界：若问 What does the coach think of Moore? 答 He thinks Moore has a positive attitude and trains hard。若问 What is the coach's name? 答 Frank Holmes。
7 错误：A 答 Complements.（错因：形近词）；B 答 Criticizes.（错因：与 agrees 相反）；C 答 Compares.（错因：搭配不符）。
8 规则：R75.4 若划线词有常见形近词（compliment／complement），then 按搭配与同向线索辨义（agrees with＋compliments＋sb's perseverance→praises）；形近词的义项（补充）不取，反义（criticizes）不取。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（形近词）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（compliments＋名词宾语）→同向线索（agrees with）→语域（教练评价）→词面义（形近陷阱）。
10 自检：①与哪个词形近？②agrees 是正向还是负向？③我取了"补充"吗？

**20. 答案：（开放题）His story inspires me not to let physical limits decide what I can do. He was born without part of his arm but worked twice as hard and became a perfect choice for his position, so I should also keep moving forward instead of making excuses.**
1 题面：How does Moore's story inspire you? Please explain.——启示＋解释；可用依据：born without the lower part of his right arm／never let that stop him／worked twice as hard／makes up for it with fast movements and strength／mind of steel。
2 候选：①不因先天条件设限＋加倍努力（道理＋自用）；②只写 I am moved；③复述他的生平；④跑题讲足球规则。
3 验算：①→道理（不设限、加倍努力）＋自用（我也会…）→成立。②→只有情绪，无道理与自用→不成立。③→复述不是"inspire you"→排除。④→与启示无关→排除。
4 干扰：mind of steel, heart of gold 的引语最像"启示句"，直接抄会缺"我"的落点；全文励志词密集，容易写成通篇赞美。
5 意图：考"启示＝道理＋自用"，与 R39.5／R48.5 同族。
6 边界：若问 What can we learn from Moore? 答 We should never let difficulties stop us and should work hard。若问 How did Moore's hero respond? 见 18 题。
7 错误：A 只写 I am deeply moved.（错因：漏道理）；B 抄 "mind of steel, heart of gold"（错因：未落到自己、也未解释）；C 写 I want to be a football player.（错因：跑题）。
8 规则：R75.5 若问 How does sb's story inspire you，then 先给"我得到的道理"（不因条件设限／加倍努力），再说"我会怎么做"；只写 moved、只抄金句或复述生平均不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.5 启示类；复用 R48.5（启示＝道理＋自用），本条取材"身体条件"。
10 自检：①道理是什么？②我说了自己会怎么做吗？③我抄金句了吗？

**组小结（G75 · 小蓝书预测卷十三 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：差异点 1（16）；达成方式 1（17）；动作链取全 1（18）；形近词词义 1（19）；启示 1（20）。
- 规则：R75.1 差异取客观条件（16）；R75.2 方式取双做法（17）；R75.3 动作链取全（18）；R75.4 形近词按搭配辨义（19）；R75.5 启示＝道理＋自用（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R75.1 与"twice as hard 更励志"冲突，客观差异优先；R75.2 与"心态／机会"冲突，做法优先；R75.3 与"邀请最具体"冲突，动作链优先；R75.4 与"complement 形近"冲突，搭配优先；R75.5 与"金句最像启示"冲突，自用优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：残障运动员题材首见（与 G48 生平、G66 事迹并列）；本组把"差异—方式—动作链"三层拆开，是 04 人物类的好样本；数字（16／twice）无换算，**本组无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十三 · Passage 2

For most of her life, Suanne Laqueur's passion for storytelling was shown on the dance floor.

Although Laqueur began writing at a young age, dancing always took center stage. She majored in dance and theater at Alfred University and taught at her mother's dance studio in Croton-on-Hudson, New York, for years. But when her mother was ready to retire and an opportunity opened for Laqueur to take over the studio, she realized she had no interest in taking on the business side of her art: "Owning a studio is a lot of work — financially, logistically. I love the teaching, the choreographing (编舞), the staging, but I didn't want to own it."

Yet Laqueur's disinterest in running the studio changed when she became a self-published author. In the fall of 2013, she decided to pursue self-publishing as a way of sharing her first completed novel with friends and family. During the process, she realized that following her true passion-telling stories through writing — made the business of the art worthwhile, and owning that business meant she could direct her writing career however she chose.

Starting with her second self-published novel, she began investing more time in marketing and building her audience. Her investment paid off. Since 2014, Laqueur, now 49, has self-published six novels, which collectively have hundreds of ratings and reviews on Goodreads. Gradually, readers pay more attention to her works. In particular, her 2016 novel *An Exaltation of Larks* stole the show and won the grand prize at the 25th Annual Writer's Digest Self-Published Book Awards, topping more than 2,300 entries.

"You have to write the most truthful story to you, and I think self-publishing allows that freedom," she says, "If you work with traditional publishing, it's more about what's marketable. There are trade-offs, which everyone will tell you, but by self-publishing I have control of the book, I have control of the story, and I'm cool with that."

21. Why didn't Laqueur take over her mother's studio?

____________________

22. What made Laqueur change her attitude to business?

____________________

23. What does the underlined part "stole the show" mean in paragraph 4 ?

____________________

24. How does Laqueur enjoy the way of self-publishing?

____________________



25. Which do you think is the most important factor when pursuing your career? Please explain.

____________________

**〔G76〕小蓝书预测卷十三 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：Because she had no interest in the business side of her art — owning a studio is a lot of work financially and logistically, and she didn't want to own it.**
1 题面：Why didn't Laqueur take over her mother's studio；原文 "when her mother was ready to retire and an opportunity opened for Laqueur to take over the studio, she realized she had no interest in taking on the business side of her art: 'Owning a studio is a lot of work — financially, logistically. I love the teaching, the choreographing (编舞), the staging, but I didn't want to own it.'"；疑问词 Why didn't（问拒绝原因）；诱导信号：I love the teaching, the choreographing, the staging 是"她喜欢"的部分，容易被当成原因。
2 候选：①no interest in the business side＋owning is a lot of work（financially／logistically）；②she didn't like teaching；③she wanted to be a writer only；④her mother didn't ask her。
3 验算：①→she had no interest in taking on the business side＋Owning a studio is a lot of work — financially, logistically→成立（两条并列）。②→我 love the teaching 与"不喜欢教学"相反→不成立。③→写小说是后来（2013 年）的事，时点在后→次优。④→she was ready to retire and an opportunity opened 说明母亲愿意交→排除。
4 干扰：but I didn't want to own it 的"拥有"容易被读成"不喜欢经营"，需与 business side 合并；love the teaching 的正面情感也会误导。
5 意图：考"拒绝原因取 business side＋work 两句，喜欢的部分不作原因"。
6 边界：若问 What did Laqueur love about the studio? 答 The teaching, the choreographing and the staging。若问 What did she do after refusing? 答 She became a self-published author。
7 错误：A 答 Because she didn't like teaching.（错因：与 I love the teaching 相反）；B 答 Because her mother refused to give it to her.（错因：方向反）；C 答 Because she had no money.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R76.1 若问 Why didn't sb take over／accept X，then 取拒绝理由两条（no interest in the business side＋owning is a lot of work financially and logistically）；同段"她喜欢的部分"（teaching／choreographing／staging）与她的后来选择不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（拒绝理由）；复用 R54.2（refuse 取动机），本条是"不愿接手"。
10 自检：①拒绝理由在哪两句？②teaching 是她喜欢还是不喜欢？③时点对不对？

**22. 答案：She became a self-published author and realized that following her true passion — telling stories through writing — made the business of the art worthwhile.**
1 题面：What made Laqueur change her attitude to business；原文 "Yet Laqueur's disinterest in running the studio changed when she became a self-published author… During the process, she realized that following her true passion-telling stories through writing — made the business of the art worthwhile, and owning that business meant she could direct her writing career however she chose."；疑问词 What made sb change attitude（问转变原因）；诱导信号：前段她明确 no interest in business，容易答成"她一直不喜欢"。
2 候选：①成为自出版作者＋意识到追随真正的热爱让"艺术生意"值得；②她一直不喜欢经营；③她赚了很多钱；④她母亲劝她。
3 验算：①→changed when she became a self-published author＋realized that following her true passion made the business worthwhile，两句构成转变链→成立（两环都写）。②→是转变前的状态，与 changed 相反→不成立。③→钱不是原文给的原因（investing paid off 是后文结果）→次优。④→母亲"准备退休"是背景→排除。
4 干扰：changed 与 disinterest 在同一句里（disinterest…changed when…），否定词与转折词相邻，容易读反。
5 意图：考"转变原因取 changed when＋realized 两环"，转变前的状态不作原因。
6 边界：若问 What does "the business of the art" mean? 答 The business side of writing/publishing（marketing, audience, sales）。若问 Why did she start self-publishing in 2013? 答 To share her first completed novel with friends and family。
7 错误：A 答 She has always been uninterested in business.（错因：转变前状态）；B 答 She earned a lot of money.（错因：结果当原因）；C 答 Her mother asked her to.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R76.2 若问 What made sb change his/her attitude，then 取 changed when＋realized that 的两环（成为自出版作者→意识到追随热爱使生意值得）；转变前的状态（disinterest）与后文收益（paid off）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（态度转变）；复用 R29.3（still 换时点换动机），本条标记是 changed when。
10 自检：①changed when 后是什么？②realized 后是什么？③我把转变前状态当原因了吗？

**23. 答案：It means her novel was the most outstanding — it attracted the most attention and won the grand prize.（抢尽风头、最受瞩目）**
1 题面：What does the underlined part "stole the show" mean in paragraph 4；原文 "In particular, her 2016 novel *An Exaltation of Larks* stole the show and won the grand prize at the 25th Annual Writer's Digest Self-Published Book Awards, topping more than 2,300 entries."；原卷该短语有下划线；疑问词 meaning（习语释义）；诱导信号：steal 的字面义"偷"。
2 候选：①抢尽风头／最受瞩目；②偷了演出（字面）；③被取消（偷走节目）；④卖得最便宜。
3 验算：①→stole the show and won the grand prize…topping more than 2,300 entries，后文直接给出"最出众"的证据→成立。②→字面义与 won the grand prize 不搭→排除。③→与获奖相反→排除。④→原文无价格→排除。
4 干扰：steal 的字面义最强；in particular 与 topping 2,300 entries 两个数字也抢注意。
5 意图：考"习语按后文结果定值（获奖＋超越 2300 部）"。
6 边界：若问 What prize did her 2016 novel win? 答 The grand prize at the 25th Annual Writer's Digest Self-Published Book Awards。若问 How many entries did it top? 答 More than 2,300。
7 错误：A 答 It was stolen.（错因：字面义）；B 答 It was the cheapest.（错因：无据）；C 答 It was cancelled.（错因：与获奖相反）。
8 规则：R76.3 若划线为演出类习语（steal the show），then 按后文结果（won the grand prize／topping N entries）定为"最出众、抢尽风头"；steal 不取"偷"，也不与取消／价格挂钩。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（习语·出众义）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（stole the show and won）→后文结果（grand prize／2,300 entries）→语域（评奖）→词面义（偷）。
10 自检：①后文给了什么结果？②steal 的字面义能用吗？③"最出众"有依据吗？

**24. 答案：She enjoys it because she has control of the book and the story, and self-publishing gives her the freedom to write the most truthful story to herself.**
1 题面：How does Laqueur enjoy the way of self-publishing；原文 "'You have to write the most truthful story to you, and I think self-publishing allows that freedom,' she says… 'by self-publishing I have control of the book, I have control of the story, and I'm cool with that.'"；疑问词 How does sb enjoy（问"为何享受"）；诱导信号：traditional publishing 的对比（more about what's marketable）也在同段。
2 候选：①control of the book／story＋freedom to write the truthful story；②she can make more money；③traditional publishing is easier；④she likes marketing。
3 验算：①→allows that freedom＋I have control of the book／the story，两处同向→成立（control＋freedom 都要）。②→原文未提收入比较→排除。③→原文说 traditional 更看市场性，并未说更容易→排除。④→marketing 是她"投入更多时间"的事，不是享受的原因→次优。
4 干扰：traditional publishing 的 trade-offs 段落长，容易被当成"她不喜欢传统出版"的单一理由；marketing／audience 也像"享受"。
5 意图：考"享受原因取 control＋freedom 两点，对比项不作原因"。
6 边界：若问 What is the disadvantage of traditional publishing according to her? 答 It is more about what's marketable。若问 What did she invest more time in from her second novel? 答 Marketing and building her audience。
7 错误：A 答 Because she can earn more money.（错因：无据）；B 答 Because traditional publishing is too hard.（错因：改写）；C 答 Because she likes marketing.（错因：手段当原因）。
8 规则：R76.4 若问 How does sb enjoy X，then 取 control（of the book／story）＋freedom（to write the most truthful story）两点；与传统出版的对比（marketable）与手段（marketing）不作享受原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（享受理由）；复用 R33.5（态度正反兼顾），本条是"正面理由取两点"。
10 自检：①control 指什么？②freedom 指什么？③marketable 是哪边的特点？

**25. 答案：（开放题）I think passion is the most important factor. If you truly love what you do, like Laqueur who kept telling stories through writing, you will be willing to do the boring business side and keep improving, so your career can last long.**
1 题面：Which do you think is the most important factor when pursuing your career? Please explain.——开放（选择＋解释）；可用依据：following her true passion made the business of the art worthwhile／write the most truthful story to you／she invested more time in marketing。
2 候选：①passion／interest＋解释（愿意做枯燥部分、能持久）；②money＋解释；③luck＋解释；④只写 passion。
3 验算：①→选择明确，解释能落到原文（passion 让 business worthwhile）→成立。②→开放题允许，但须给理由（收入保障生活）；与原文倾向相反，可作次优→次优。③→luck 难解释、原文未支持→次优。④→只有选择无解释→不成立。
4 干扰：题干 Which…most important 要"选一个"，学生常列三四个因素而不作选择；Please explain 又要求展开。
5 意图：考"选择＋解释"，允许与作者不同的立场但要自圆其说。
6 边界：若问 What is Laqueur's most important factor? 答 Following her true passion（telling stories through writing）。若问 What does she think of traditional publishing? 答 It is more about what's marketable。
7 错误：A 只写 Passion.（错因：无解释）；B 答 Money, passion and luck are all important.（错因：未作选择）；C 答 I don't know.（错因：未作答）。
8 规则：R76.5 若问 Which do you think is the most important factor…，then 先明确选一个（passion／interest），再给 1—2 条解释，可引原文人物为例；并列多个因素不作选择，只写名词不解释均不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.2 双问（选择＋解释）；复用 R20.5（选择＋理由），本条是"职业因素"。
10 自检：①我选了哪一个？②解释有几条？③我列了一堆没选吗？

**组小结（G76 · 小蓝书预测卷十三 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：拒绝接手理由 1（21）；态度转变原因 1（22）；习语（steal the show）1（23）；享受原因 1（24）；职业因素选择 1（25）。
- 规则：R76.1 拒绝取 business side＋work（21）；R76.2 转变取 changed when＋realized（22）；R76.3 steal the show＝最出众（23）；R76.4 享受取 control＋freedom（24）；R76.5 选择＋解释（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R76.1 与"I love the teaching"冲突，business side 优先；R76.2 与"disinterest 同句"冲突，changed when 优先；R76.3 与"steal 字面"冲突，获奖结果优先；R76.4 与"marketing 出现两次"冲突，control／freedom 优先；R76.5 与"多因素并列"冲突，单选优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：自出版／职业选择题材首见；"disinterest…changed when…"这种"否定＋转折同句"结构是 04 的好样本；数字（2013／2014／six novels／49／25th／2,300 entries）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十三 · Passage 3

Putting on weight could be a side-effect of loneliness, research suggests. Women, who feel lonely, are hungrier, and they even find a big meal less satisfying. This could be the body's way of telling them to seek company, for eating has been a sociable activity throughout human evolution.

The researchers asked 42 women not to eat overnight, and then gave them a large breakfast. The women rated their hunger before and after their meal and blood samples which revealed their levels of ghrelin --- the "hunger hormone (激素)". As expected, levels of ghrelin fell after eating and then started to rise. However, the rise was much quicker in the lonely women, and they made much more of the hormone. They also said they felt hungrier. They said: "The need for social connection is essential to human nature. As a result, people may feel hungrier when they feel socially disconnected."

Interestingly, loneliness only makes thin women hungrier. It has no effect on the appetite of those who are corpulent. It isn't clear why this is, but it is possible that the shame related with being fat makes socializing less valuable for them. Other studies suggest you should choose your company carefully at mealtimes. It has been shown that we tend to mimic (模仿) our dining companion's eating habits, taking mouthfuls at the same time and eating more when our companion does. The link with appetite could help explain the range of devastating effects loneliness can have on health.

Being cut off from friends and family can raise blood pressure, stress and the risk of depression, as well as weakening the immune system (免疫系统) and a person's resistance to disease (早老性痴呆). Overall, loneliness is as damaging as smoking or not exercising.

**〔G77〕小蓝书预测卷十三 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：They will be hungrier and find a big meal less satisfying.**
1 题面：How will the lonely people react, according to Paragraph 1；原文 "Putting on weight could be a side-effect of loneliness, research suggests. Women, who feel lonely, are hungrier, and they even find a big meal less satisfying."；疑问词 How will…react（问反应）；诱导信号：首句 putting on weight could be a side-effect 是研究的总体结论，离 react 更近。
2 候选：①hungrier＋less satisfying；②they will put on weight；③they will eat less；④they will feel happier。
3 验算：①→are hungrier, and they even find a big meal less satisfying，两个反应并列→成立（两条都写）。②→putting on weight 是 side-effect（长期结果），不是本段的"反应"→次优。③→与 hungrier 相反→排除。④→与孤独语境相反→排除。
4 干扰：首句 putting on weight 是文章标题句式的结论，最像"答案"；less satisfying 是否定表达，容易被忽略。
5 意图：考"反应取 are hungrier＋less satisfying 两句，总体结论不作即时反应"。
6 边界：若问 What may loneliness lead to physically? 答 Putting on weight（could be a side-effect）。若问 Why does loneliness make people hungry? 答 Because eating has been a sociable activity and the body tells them to seek company。
7 错误：A 答 They will put on weight.（错因：结论当反应）；B 答 They will eat less.（错因：与原文相反）；C 答 They will feel satisfied.（错因：与 less satisfying 相反）。
8 规则：R77.1 若问 How will lonely people react，then 取描述即时反应的两项（hungrier＋find a big meal less satisfying）；研究总体结论（putting on weight）与相反表述不作反应。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.6 结果（即时反应 vs 长期结论）；复用 R28.3（段落边界），本条是"反应 vs 结论"。
10 自检：①hungrier 与谁并列？②putting on weight 是什么？③less satisfying 抄了吗？

**27. 答案：It wants to tell them to seek company (because eating has been a sociable activity throughout human evolution).**
1 题面：What does the body want to tell by being hungry；原文 "This could be the body's way of telling them to seek company, for eating has been a sociable activity throughout human evolution."；疑问词 What does the body want to tell（问信号含义）；诱导信号：前面说 they are hungrier，容易被答成"多吃"。
2 候选：①to seek company；②to eat more；③to lose weight；④to sleep more。
3 验算：①→the body's way of telling them to seek company，tell sb to do 后的内容直接给出；for 从句补充理由→成立。②→eat more 是表象，不是"身体想告诉"的内容→不成立。③→原文谈发胖风险，未建议减肥→排除。④→无据→排除。
4 干扰：hungrier 与 eating 都在附近，字面上像"身体让你吃"；for 从句（sociable activity）是理由，容易被当答案。
5 意图：考"tell sb to do 取不定式内容（seek company），理由从句只作补充"。
6 边界：若问 Why is eating called a sociable activity? 答 Because it has been sociable throughout human evolution。若问 What did the researchers find about ghrelin? 答 Its level fell after eating and then rose faster and higher in lonely women。
7 错误：A 答 To eat more.（错因：表象当信号）；B 答 To put on weight.（错因：结果当信号）；C 答 To stay alone.（错因：与 seek company 相反）。
8 规则：R77.2 若问 What does the body want to tell／show，then 取 tell sb to do 的不定式内容（to seek company）；for 从句（eating is sociable）是理由，hungrier／eat more 是表象，都不作信号内容。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（tell sb to do）；复用 R51.5（because of 转主语），本条是"信号内容"。
10 自检：①tell sb to do 后是什么？②for 从句起什么作用？③我答"多吃"了吗？

**28. 答案：The need for social connection (is essential to human nature).**
1 题面：What is essential to human nature；原文研究者原话 "The need for social connection is essential to human nature. As a result, people may feel hungrier when they feel socially disconnected."；疑问词 What is essential to human nature（问主语）；诱导信号：As a result 后的"hungrier when disconnected"是推论。
2 候选：①the need for social connection；②feeling hungry；③eating a big meal；④putting on weight。
3 验算：①→The need for social connection is essential to human nature，主语直接给出→成立。②→hungrier 是结果→排除。③→eating 是社会性活动的例证→次优。④→side-effect→排除。
4 干扰：句子里 As a result 之后的内容更贴近"孤独与饥饿"的主题，容易替代主语；social connection 是抽象名词，抄写时易漏 need。
5 意图：考"基本句型 S is essential to O 取主语 S"。
6 边界：若问 What happens when people feel socially disconnected? 答 They may feel hungrier。若问 What is the "hunger hormone"? 答 Ghrelin。
7 错误：A 答 Feeling hungry.（错因：结果当主语）；B 答 Eating with others.（错因：例证）；C 答 Social media.（错因：无据改写）。
8 规则：R77.3 若问 What is essential to human nature，then 取该句主语（the need for social connection），保留 need for 这一限定；As a result 后的推论（hungrier）不作主语内容。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（主语取词）；复用 R34.3（抽象名词取同位解释），本条是"主语即答案"。
10 自检：①主语是什么？②As a result 后是什么？③need for 丢了吗？

**29. 答案：It means "fat" or "overweight".（肥胖的）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "corpulent" probably mean；原文 "Interestingly, loneliness only makes thin women hungrier. It has no effect on the appetite of those who are corpulent. It isn't clear why this is, but it is possible that the shame related with being fat makes socializing less valuable for them."；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 probably mean（词义题）；诱导信号：thin women 与 corpulent 形成对照，后文又出现 being fat。
2 候选：①fat／overweight；②thin；③lonely；④healthy。
3 验算：①→后文 the shame related with being fat 直接对应 corpulent，且与 thin 对照→成立。②→thin 是它的反义（前句 thin women）→不成立。③→lonely 是全文主题词，但 corpulent 修饰 those（另一组人）→排除。④→healthy 与 shame／fat 语境不符→排除。
4 干扰：lonely 在上下句高频出现，容易被当成词义；thin 与 corpulent 相邻，也易混。
5 意图：考"用同段同义词（being fat）与反义对照（thin）定词义"。
6 边界：若问 Which women does loneliness affect? 答 Thin women only（it has no effect on corpulent women）。若问 Why might corpulent women socialize less? 答 Possibly because of the shame related with being fat。
7 错误：A 答 Thin.（错因：反义）；B 答 Lonely.（错因：主题词干扰）；C 答 Rich.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R77.4 若划线形容词与同段另一形容词构成对照（thin vs corpulent），then 用同段同义表达（being fat）定值，取"肥胖的"；反义词（thin）与主题词（lonely）不取。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（对照定值）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（those who are corpulent）→同段同义（being fat）／反义（thin）→语域（健康研究）→词面义。
10 自检：①同段哪个词＝corpulent？②thin 是什么关系？③lonely 能取吗？

**30. 答案：（开放题）When I feel lonely, I tend to feel hungrier and eat more, and I may want to find someone to have a meal with — as the study says, the body is telling me to seek company.**
1 题面：What do you tend to do while feeling lonely?——半开放（落到"我"）；原文依据：lonely women are hungrier and find a big meal less satisfying／the body tells them to seek company／eating has been a sociable activity；诱导信号：题干用 you，不能照抄研究结论的第三人称。
2 候选：①更饿、吃得多、想找人一起吃饭；②照抄 not clear why this is；③只写 I feel lonely；④写"我会去运动"（外推但无关联）。
3 验算：①→把研究结论转成第一人称（I tend to feel hungrier／eat more／seek company），与原文同向→成立。②→那是研究的未解之处，不是"我的做法"→不成立。③→重复题干，无内容→排除。④→外推但与该研究无关联，可作次优（须说明为什么）→次优。
4 干扰：题干 tend to 提示"通常倾向"，容易答成"我从不这样"；研究结论用第三人称，转第一人称时容易照抄。
5 意图：考"半开放题把研究结论转成自身经验，并用 as the study says 交代依据"。
6 边界：若问 What does the study suggest about lonely people? 答 They feel hungrier and may eat more, because the body tells them to seek company。若问 What should you do at mealtimes according to other studies? 答 Choose your company carefully（we mimic our companion's eating habits）。
7 错误：A 答 I don't know.（错因：未作答）；B 抄 "It isn't clear why this is."（错因：研究的空白当答案）；C 答 Lonely people are fat.（错因：与原文相反）。
8 规则：R77.5 若问 What do you tend to do（半开放，主语 you），then 把原文结论转为第一人称的具体行为（feel hungrier／eat more／seek company），并可用 as the study says 交代依据；照抄第三人称结论、重复题干或引用研究空白均不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.6 半开放列举（自身经验）；复用 R44.5（半开放加限定），本条限定"我"。
10 自检：①我用第一人称了吗？②有具体行为吗？③依据交代了吗？

**组小结（G77 · 小蓝书预测卷十三 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：即时反应 1（26）；信号内容 1（27）；主语取词 1（28）；对照定词义 1（29）；半开放（第一人称）1（30）。
- 规则：R77.1 反应取两项（26）；R77.2 信号取 tell sb to do（27）；R77.3 主语即答案（28）；R77.4 对照定值（29）；R77.5 结论转第一人称（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R77.1 与"putting on weight 是首句"冲突，反应句优先；R77.2 与"hungrier 相邻"冲突，tell sb to do 优先；R77.3 与"As a result 句更贴题"冲突，主语优先；R77.4 与"lonely 高频"冲突，同段同义优先；R77.5 与"照抄结论"冲突，第一人称优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：科研报道类首见；本组把"结论—机制—主语—词义—自述"五层拆开，是 04 科研类的样本；数字（42 women／ghrelin／5% 无）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十三 · Passage 4

Hi there, Aunt Joan!

How are you? Mum said you asked how I was doing, so let me tell you about my life here.

As you know, I've been in China for around a month now. I want to study in a local university, which is why I took those after-school Chinese classes. I decided on China because it's a fast-developing country with trade links all over the world. Studying here could be useful in finding a good job in trade or business. What's more, Chinese culture is really interesting, so choosing to come here was a no-brainer for me! Having said that, China isn't like I thought it might be. I thought it would be quite old and traditional, but in many ways, the cities are just as modern as back home in Vancouver, only with lots more people! There's so much more food to try, too, and it's all delicious! Everywhere I go, I see restaurants and snack stalls — it seems to be a big part of their culture. Food here is very reasonably priced, so it's great for my budget. The people I meet are all very welcoming towards me as a foreigner, and I even seem to be a point of interest! However, hardly anyone speaks English in my area, so it can be a bit overwhelming at times. But I guess that's why I'm here — to learn.

Right now, I'm studying every day for my HSK exam (a Chinese language qualification). But I also get a chance to explore the city. I usually get up extra early each morning to enjoy a freshly made breakfast on the street, and then I often visit a park. There's a lot of traditional culture still alive in China. The parks are full of people playing traditional instruments, playing Chinese chess, and even writing calligraphy on the ground with giant paintbrushes!

My long-term plan is to take a degree course here. But it all depends on my expenses, so I intend to find some work first. I'm staying in a hostel (招待所) dormitory right now, but I've put an ad online to find a friendly Chinese family for a home-stay. That way, my Chinese will improve much faster, especially my written Chinese, which I find the most difficult to grasp.



Well, that's all for now. I hope you guys can visit China sometime!

Take care!

Jim
