**〔G78〕小蓝书预测卷十三 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

> **本组是全稿第一篇"应用文"（私人书信体）**：Jim 写给 Aunt Joan 的信，含称呼、正文与署名。文体虽变，设问仍是细节／词义／人物评价五型。

**31. 答案：He wants to study in a local university.**
1 题面：What is the author's purpose in taking after-school classes；原文 "I want to study in a local university, which is why I took those after-school Chinese classes."；疑问词 purpose in taking（问目的）；诱导信号：after-school Chinese classes 字面像"为了学中文"。
2 候选：①to study in a local university；②to learn Chinese（手段）；③to find a job；④to pass the HSK exam。
3 验算：①→I want to study in a local university, which is why I took those classes，which is why 前的目的句→成立。②→学中文是课程内容，不是报班的目的（目的在更高一层）→次优。③→找工作是他的"长期打算"之一（intend to find some work first），与报班不同层→排除。④→HSK 是他现在每天准备的事，不是当初报班目的→次优。
4 干扰：学中文最直接、最省事；HSK 与"中文"同域，也容易被当目的。
5 意图：考"which is why 前为因／目的，手段（学中文）不作目的"。
6 边界：若问 Why is he preparing for the HSK exam? 答 Because he is studying every day for a Chinese language qualification（to take a degree course）。若问 What is his long-term plan? 答 To take a degree course in China。
7 错误：A 答 To learn Chinese.（错因：手段当目的）；B 答 To pass the HSK exam.（错因：时点在后）；C 答 To find a job.（错因：另一层打算）。
8 规则：R78.1 若问 purpose in doing X 且原文有 which is why，then 取 which is why 之前的目的句（study in a local university）；手段（learn Chinese）与后文另一层打算（work／HSK）不作本目的。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 目的（which is why）；复用 R39.4（目的取 so that），本条标记是 which is why。
10 自检：①which is why 前是什么？②学中文是目的还是手段？③HSK 是什么时候的事？

**32. 答案：（任答两条）①China is a fast-developing country with trade links all over the world, which may help him find a good job in trade or business; ②Chinese culture is really interesting.**
1 题面：Why did the author decide on China? Give two of the reasons.；题干明示 two of the reasons（列两条）；原文 "I decided on China because it's a fast-developing country with trade links all over the world. Studying here could be useful in finding a good job in trade or business. What's more, Chinese culture is really interesting, so choosing to come here was a no-brainer for me!"；诱导信号：What's more 引出第二条，标志词易漏。
2 候选：①经济发展＋贸易联系（利于就业）；②中国文化有趣；③离家近；④学费便宜。
3 验算：①→because it's a fast-developing country with trade links…＋useful in finding a good job，第一条理由（含结果）→成立。②→What's more, Chinese culture is really interesting，第二条理由→成立。③④→原文无（food 便宜是后来的观察，不是"决定来中国"的理由）→排除。
4 干扰：What's more 是并列追加标志，漏读就只剩一条；food reasonably priced 也在文中，但属落地后的感受。
5 意图：考"Give two reasons 取 because＋What's more 两条，数量要达标"。
6 边界：若问 What did he think China would be like before coming? 答 Quite old and traditional。若问 What surprised him about Chinese cities? 答 They are just as modern as Vancouver, only with lots more people。
7 错误：A 只写 fast-developing country.（错因：只一条）；B 答 Because food is cheap.（错因：落地后观察）；C 答 Because his aunt lives there.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R78.2 若题干 Give two of the reasons，then 取 because 与 What's more 引出的两条（fast-developing＋trade links／culture interesting）；数量必须达标；落地后的感受（food cheap／people friendly）不作"决定来"的理由。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（并列两条）；复用 R69.3（限数取足），本条限定"决定的原因"。
10 自检：①because 后是什么？②What's more 后是什么？③我列够两条了吗？

**33. 答案：It means "an easy decision" — a choice that needs no thinking.（不用多想的选择、显而易见的选择）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word mean in Paragraph 2；划线词为 "no-brainer"，原文 "…Chinese culture is really interesting, so choosing to come here was a no-brainer for me!"；疑问词 mean（词义题）；诱导信号：no＋brain 的构词容易被读成"没脑子的人／傻事"。
2 候选：①an easy decision（不用多想）；②a stupid choice（傻事）；③a brainless person（没脑子的人）；④a hard decision。
3 验算：①→Chinese culture is really interesting, so choosing…was a no-brainer，so 前是正面理由，结论应是"很容易决定"→成立。②→"傻事"与正面理由相反→不成立。③→指人，句中指 choosing 这件事→排除。④→hard 与 easy 相反→排除。
4 干扰：no-brainer 的构词（no brain）诱导"没脑子／傻"；汉译"不用动脑"也易被读成贬义。
5 意图：考"构词不作词义，按 so 前的正面理由定褒义"。
6 边界：若问 Why did he think choosing China was easy? 答 Because Chinese culture is really interesting（and China is fast-developing）。若问 What is a "brainer"? 答 英语中无此常用词（no-brainer 为固定说法）。
7 错误：A 答 A stupid choice.（错因：构词误读）；B 答 A hard decision.（错因：反义）；C 答 A person without a brain.（错因：指人）。
8 规则：R78.3 若划线词为 no-brainer 类构词短语，then 按 so／because 前的正面理由定为"容易的决定"；no＋名词的构词（没脑子／傻）不作词义，反义（hard）不取。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（构词陷阱）；复用 R73.4（构词不作词义），本条取褒义"容易"。
10 自检：①so 前是正面还是负面？②句中指人还是指事？③我译成"傻事"了吗？

**34. 答案：So that his Chinese will improve much faster, especially his written Chinese.**
1 题面：Why is Jim looking for a home-stay；原文 "I've put an ad online to find a friendly Chinese family for a home-stay. That way, my Chinese will improve much faster, especially my written Chinese, which I find the most difficult to grasp."；疑问词 Why（问目的）；诱导信号：广告内容（put an ad online）与住宿现状（hostel dormitory）都在附近。
2 候选：①Chinese will improve much faster（especially written）；②to save money；③because the hostel is dirty；④to find a friendly family only。
3 验算：①→That way, my Chinese will improve much faster, especially my written Chinese，That way 回指 home-stay，目的明确→成立（可补 written Chinese）。②→原文说住在 hostel dormitory 现在，home-stay 未提省钱；反而 food 便宜是优点→排除。③→原文无抱怨宿舍→排除。④→friendly 是修饰语，不是目的→次优。
4 干扰：friendly Chinese family 的"友好"很动人；written Chinese 从句较长，容易被省略。
5 意图：考"That way 回指＋目的取回指后的句子"。
6 边界：若问 What does Jim find most difficult? 答 Written Chinese。若问 Where is he staying now? 答 In a hostel dormitory。
7 错误：A 答 To save money.（错因：无据）；B 答 Because the hostel is bad.（错因：无据）；C 答 To make friends.（错因：目的改写）。
8 规则：R78.4 若问 Why is sb looking for／doing X 且后文有 That way，then 取 That way 之后的目的句（Chinese will improve much faster, especially written Chinese）；修饰语（friendly）与无据理由（省钱）不作目的。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 目的（That way 回指）；复用 R19.4（This is why 前句为因），本条是"that way 后为目的"。
10 自检：①That way 指什么？②目的句在哪？③我答省钱了吗？

**35. 答案：（开放题）I think Jim is open-minded, curious and independent. He chose to study in a country very different from his own, he tries local food and explores parks and traditional culture, and he plans to find work and a home-stay to support his study.**
1 题面：What kind of person do you think the author is? Please explain.——评价＋解释；可用依据：decided on China because it's fast-developing／culture interesting／tries street breakfast and visits parks／plans to find work first／put an ad for a home-stay to improve Chinese／hardly anyone speaks English but he accepts it as a chance to learn。
2 候选：①open-minded／curious／independent＋行为；②he is a student（身份）；③he is rich；④只写 He is nice。
3 验算：①→三条品质各有行为（选陌生国家＝open-minded；尝街边早餐、逛公园＝curious；打算打工＋找寄宿家庭＝independent）→成立（至少两条）。②→身份不是性格→排除。③→他担心 expenses，说明不富裕→排除。④→空评价→不成立。
4 干扰：信末 I hope you guys can visit China sometime 很热情，容易只写 friendly 而漏掉独立与好奇；hardly anyone speaks English 那段是"困难"，不是缺点。
5 意图：考"评价＝品质词＋行为"，书信体里行为散落在各段，须自己归并。
6 边界：若问 What is Jim's long-term plan? 答 To take a degree course in China。若问 What does he find overwhelming? 答 Hardly anyone speaks English in his area。
7 错误：A 答 He is a student.（错因：身份）；B 答 He is rich.（错因：与 depends on my expenses 相反）；C 只写 He is friendly.（错因：单一且无据）。
8 规则：R78.5 若问 What kind of person do you think sb is，then 给 2—3 个品质词（open-minded／curious／independent）并各配一条书信中的行为；身份（student）、经济状况（rich）与单字评价都不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（书信体取材）；复用 R63.4（品质取行为），本条须跨段归并。
10 自检：①我给了几个品质词？②行为散在哪几段？③我把身份当性格了吗？

**组小结（G78 · 小蓝书预测卷十三 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：报班目的 1（31）；两条理由 1（32）；构词词义（no-brainer）1（33）；寄宿目的 1（34）；人物评价（书信体）1（35）。
- 规则：R78.1 which is why 取目的（31）；R78.2 两条理由取足（32）；R78.3 no-brainer＝容易的决定（33）；R78.4 That way 后为目的（34）；R78.5 跨段取行为作评价（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R78.1 与"学中文最直接"冲突，上层目的优先；R78.2 与"只抄 because 一条"冲突，What's more 补足；R78.3 与"构词＝傻"冲突，so 前正面理由优先；R78.4 与"friendly 动人"冲突，That way 目的优先；R78.5 与"身份最省事"冲突，品质优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**应用文（私人书信）首见**，体裁含称呼 Hi there, Aunt Joan!／正文四段／署名 Jim；设问仍为五型，未出现图表题。至此"应用文"一类可记为"已有 1 例（书信体）"，"图表"仍 0。数字（around a month／HSK 无分值）均照录，**无换算、无推算**；**小蓝书卷十三 4 篇至此完成（G75—G78）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十九 · Passage 1

Jim is on holiday in Australia. There are bushfires in the area where he is staying. He is telling his friend Mark about the fires.

Mark: We saw the news about the bushfires. Are they close to you?

Jim: Yes. They are very close. The weather is hot and windy. The conditions are ideal for bushfires and once they get started they spread quickly. Yesterday the temperatures hit 44℃ and there were reports of over 50 fires in the area. It will take days to put them out.

Mark: Have you seen any fires?

Jim: Yes, I have. I'm staying with my uncle Ted. He's a volunteer firefighter. He says the fires have killed a lot of animals, but no people. He says that the safest thing is to stay inside unless your house catches fire!

Mark: Is it safe where you are?

Jim: We're fine. We listen to the radio to keep up to date with the latest news. So we know if a fire is coming our way. One got very close yesterday. Three houses nearby caught fire. Luckily, the families put the fires out before they did too much damage.

Mark: Are you worried? Do you think you will need to move to a safer place?

Jim: Bushfires are normal in Australia.They are a fact of life here. It's a bit scary, but I am sure I'll be fine.

Mark: Well, you look after yourself! We don't want you to be the first human victim of the year!

16. Where is Jim on holiday?

______

17. What's the weather like today?

______

18. What problems have the fires caused?

______

19. How do people get the latest news about the bushfires?

______

20. Why doesn't Jim think he will need to move to a safer place?

______

**〔G79〕小蓝书预测卷十九 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

> **本组是对话体**（Mark 问、Jim 答），问答按说话人切分；引用时须写明"Jim 说"，不能把 Mark 的话当事实来源。

**16. 答案：In Australia.**
1 题面：Where is Jim on holiday；原文 "Jim is on holiday in Australia. There are bushfires in the area where he is staying."；疑问词 Where（问地点）；诱导信号：in the area where he is staying 也在首段出现。
2 候选：①Australia；②in the area where he is staying；③with his uncle Ted；④at Mark's home。
3 验算：①→Jim is on holiday in Australia，on holiday 与 Where 直接对应→成立。②→the area 是山火范围，不是度假国别→次优（太笼统）。③→uncle Ted 家是他住的地方，不是"度假在哪国"→次优。④→Mark 是朋友，不在同地→排除。
4 干扰：the area where he is staying 紧跟 bushfires，像"地点答案"；uncle Ted 的 volunteer firefighter 身份也抢注意。
5 意图：考"Where 取 on holiday 后的国别，居住点不作国别"。
6 边界：若问 Who is Jim staying with? 答 His uncle Ted。若问 Where are the bushfires? 答 In the area where Jim is staying（Australia）。
7 错误：A 答 In the area where he is staying.（错因：笼统、非国别）；B 答 With his uncle Ted.（错因：人物当地点）；C 答 In America.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R79.1 若问 Where is sb on holiday，then 取 on holiday in＋国别（Australia）；"他住的那一带"与"住谁家"都是次级信息，不能替代国别。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（国别 vs 居住点）；复用 R67.3（地点取全），本条要求"层级正确"。
10 自检：①on holiday 后是什么？②the area 指哪一层？③uncle Ted 是地点吗？

**17. 答案：It is hot and windy (the temperature hit 44℃).**
1 题面：What's the weather like today；原文 "The weather is hot and windy. The conditions are ideal for bushfires… Yesterday the temperatures hit 44℃"；疑问词 What's the weather like（问天气）；诱导信号：ideal for bushfires 是对天气的评价，不是天气本身。
2 候选：①hot and windy；②ideal for bushfires；③44℃ only；④dry and cold。
3 验算：①→The weather is hot and windy，主系表结构直接给天气→成立（可补 44℃）。②→ideal for bushfires 是"这种天气的后果评价"→次优。③→44℃ 是昨日气温，可作补充，单独作答不完整→次优。④→cold 与 hot 相反→排除。
4 干扰：Yesterday the temperatures hit 44℃ 数字醒目，但题干问 today 的天气状况，原文没给"今天的温度"，只给 hot and windy。
5 意图：考"天气取 hot and windy，评价（ideal for）与单点数字不作天气"。
6 边界：若问 What temperature did it hit yesterday? 答 44℃。若问 Why do bushfires spread quickly? 答 Because the weather is hot and windy（the conditions are ideal）。
7 错误：A 答 Ideal for bushfires.（错因：评价当天气）；B 答 44℃.（错因：昨日气温、且不完整）；C 答 Cold and wet.（错因：与原文相反）。
8 规则：R79.2 若问 What's the weather like，then 取 hot and windy（形容词并列），昨日气温（44℃）可补但不单独作答；"ideal for bushfires"是评价，不作天气。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.38 环境描写（天气）；复用 R58.1（天气取形容词），本条并列两个形容词。
10 自检：①天气句在哪？②44℃ 是哪天？③ideal for 是天气吗？

**18. 答案：They have killed a lot of animals (but no people), and three houses nearby caught fire.**
1 题面：What problems have the fires caused；原文 Jim: "He says the fires have killed a lot of animals, but no people."＋"One got very close yesterday. Three houses nearby caught fire."；疑问词 What problems（问后果，复数）；诱导信号：开头 Mark 只问"火离你近吗"，后果散在两次回答里。
2 候选：①killed many animals（no people）＋three houses caught fire；②only animals died；③Jim's house burned down；④people were killed。
3 验算：①→killed a lot of animals, but no people＋Three houses nearby caught fire，两条后果→成立（两条都写）。②→漏"三所房子着火"→次优。③→原文说 families put the fires out before too much damage，Jim 家未烧→不成立。④→but no people 明确否定→排除。
4 干扰：but no people 是对比信息，容易被忽略；three houses 在后一次回答里，不连读就漏。
5 意图：考"后果跨两轮对话取全，且保留 no people 的限定"。
6 边界：若问 Did any people die in the fires? 答 No（the fires have killed a lot of animals, but no people）。若问 How many houses caught fire nearby? 答 Three。
7 错误：A 答 Many people died.（错因：与 but no people 相反）；B 答 Three houses burned down.（错因：漏动物死亡）；C 答 Jim's house caught fire.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R79.3 若问 What problems have the fires caused，then 跨两轮回答取全（killed a lot of animals／no people＋three houses caught fire）；no people 的限定要保留，不能反说成人员死亡。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.6 结果（跨轮取全）；复用 R45.1（清单取全），本条是对话体跨轮。
10 自检：①动物与房子各在哪轮？②no people 抄了吗？③三所房子烧毁了吗？

**19. 答案：By listening to the radio (to keep up to date with the latest news).**
1 题面：How do people get the latest news about the bushfires；原文 "We listen to the radio to keep up to date with the latest news. So we know if a fire is coming our way."；疑问词 How（问方式）；诱导信号：开篇 Mark 说 We saw the news（电视新闻），是 Mark 的方式。
2 候选：①by listening to the radio；②by watching TV news；③by asking uncle Ted；④through the Internet。
3 验算：①→We listen to the radio to keep up to date with the latest news，方式直接给出→成立。②→We saw the news 是 Mark 的说法，Jim 用的是 radio（主体不同）→不成立。③→uncle Ted 提供信息（says…），但不是"最新消息的渠道"→次优。④→原文无网络→排除。
4 干扰：Mark 第一句 We saw the news about the bushfires 就在开头，容易被当答案；主体不同正是本题考点。
5 意图：考"方式按主体取（Jim 用 radio，Mark 看电视）"。
6 边界：若问 How does Mark know about the fires? 答 He saw the news (on TV)。若问 Why do they listen to the radio? 答 To know if a fire is coming their way。
7 错误：A 答 By watching TV.（错因：Mark 的方式）；B 答 By reading newspapers.（错因：无据）；C 答 By asking the fire brigade.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R79.4 若问 How do people get the latest news，then 取 Jim 自述的渠道（listen to the radio），并注意 Mark 的 saw the news 属另一主体；渠道与目的（know if a fire is coming）可一并写。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（主体配对）；复用 R74.2（态度按主体配对），本条是"渠道按主体配对"。
10 自检：①Jim 用什么？②Mark 用什么？③我混主体了吗？

**20. 答案：Because bushfires are normal in Australia — they are a fact of life there — and he is sure that he will be fine.**
1 题面：Why doesn't Jim think he will need to move to a safer place；原文 Mark: "Do you think you will need to move to a safer place?" Jim: "Bushfires are normal in Australia.They are a fact of life here. It's a bit scary, but I am sure I'll be fine."；疑问词 Why doesn't sb think（问理由）；诱导信号：Mark 末句 We don't want you to be the first human victim 是朋友的担忧，不是 Jim 的理由。
2 候选：①bushfires are normal／a fact of life＋sure I'll be fine；②因为他很勇敢（推断）；③because he is a firefighter；④because his uncle protects him。
3 验算：①→Bushfires are normal…a fact of life here＋I am sure I'll be fine，两句同向→成立。②→brave 是读者推断，原文只说 a bit scary →不成立（推论不作理由）。③→volunteer firefighter 是他 uncle，不是他→排除。④→uncle 提供安全建议，但 Jim 的理由是"常态＋自信"→次优。
4 干扰：uncle Ted 的身份让人以为"有人保护"；It's a bit scary 又像"其实害怕"，容易把理由写成"他不怕"。
5 意图：考"理由取当事人自述（normal／fact of life＋sure I'll be fine）"，推断与亲属身份不作理由。
6 边界：若问 How does Jim feel about the fires? 答 A bit scary but he is sure he'll be fine。若问 What is the safest thing to do according to uncle Ted? 答 To stay inside unless your house catches fire。
7 错误：A 答 Because he is brave.（错因：推断当理由）；B 答 Because he is a firefighter.（错因：人物错位）；C 答 Because the fires are far away.（错因：与 very close 相反）。
8 规则：R79.5 若问 Why doesn't sb think／feel X，then 取当事人自述的两句（bushfires are normal／a fact of life＋I am sure I'll be fine）；读者的性格推断（brave）与亲属身份（uncle is a firefighter）不作理由。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（自述）；复用 R32.3（动机取引语自述），本条是对话体自述。
10 自检：①Jim 自己怎么说？②uncle 的身份是他的理由吗？③我推断"勇敢"了吗？

**组小结（G79 · 小蓝书预测卷十九 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：度假国别 1（16）；天气 1（17）；后果跨轮取全 1（18）；渠道按主体 1（19）；不搬家的理由 1（20）。
- 规则：R79.1 Where 取国别（16）；R79.2 天气取形容词并列（17）；R79.3 后果跨轮取全（18）；R79.4 渠道按主体（19）；R79.5 理由取自述（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R79.1 与"the area 紧跟山火"冲突，on holiday 优先；R79.2 与"44℃ 醒目"冲突，today 的天气优先；R79.3 与"只读一轮"冲突，跨轮合并；R79.4 与"Mark 的 saw the news"冲突，主体优先；R79.5 与"uncle 是消防员"冲突，自述优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**对话体首见**（问答以说话人切分）；本组三处都靠"主体"分流（Jim vs Mark、Jim vs uncle Ted、today vs yesterday），与 R74.1／R74.2 同法，可作 04 的对话体样本；数字（44℃／50 fires／three houses）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十九 · Passage 2

Last year I worked in Nepal for three months. During breaks at work, I like to use exercise to relax and reduce stress.When I had a few days off, I decided to go into the jungle (丛林). I asked a Nepalese guide, Kamal Rai to go with me.

We started our trip at six in the morning with two elephants carrying our things. This made it much easier on ourselves. It was hot, but Kamal made me wear shoes and trousers to protect me from snakes. In the jungle there was a lot of wildlife, but we were trying to find tigers. We climbed onto the elephants' backs to see better. However, it is unusual to find tigers in the afternoon because they sleep in the daytime.

Then, in the distance, we saw a tiger, and Kamal told me to be very quiet. We immediately became very quiet. We moved nearer and found a dead deer. This was the tiger's lunch! Suddenly, I started to feel very frightened. I was thinking about a lot of scary stories.

Then a huge tiger jumped out suddenly. It caught Kamal's leg between its teeth, but I managed to pull Kamal away. One of our elephants ran at the tiger and made it go back into the grass, so we quickly ran away to let the tiger eat its lunch. That night it was impossible to sleep! It really was an exciting and scary trip. We were all impressed.

21. Where did the writer want to go during the days off?

______

22. When did they start their trip?

______

23. Why did they climb onto the elephants' backs?

______

24. What did they find when they moved nearer?

______

25. Who drove the tiger away?

______

**〔G80〕小蓝书预测卷十九 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：Into the jungle.**
1 题面：Where did the writer want to go during the days off；原文 "Last year I worked in Nepal for three months… When I had a few days off, I decided to go into the jungle (丛林)."；疑问词 Where（问目的地）；诱导信号：首句 Nepal 是工作地，紧邻在同一个时间框架里。
2 候选：①into the jungle；②Nepal；③to find tigers；④to a Nepalese guide's home。
3 验算：①→I decided to go into the jungle，go into 后即目的地→成立。②→Nepal 是"工作三个月"的地方，范围过大且不是"休假去哪"→次优。③→find tigers 是目的，不是地点→排除。④→guide 是同行者→排除。
4 干扰：Nepal 出现在首句且紧邻 days off；"找老虎"的目的也很明确，容易被当"去哪"。
5 意图：考"Where 取 go into 后的目的地，工作地不作休假地"。
6 边界：若问 Why did the writer go into the jungle? 答 To find tigers（and to relax）。若问 Who went with the writer? 答 A Nepalese guide, Kamal Rai。
7 错误：A 答 Nepal.（错因：工作地）；B 答 To find tigers.（错因：目的当地点）；C 答 To the mountains.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R80.1 若问 Where did sb want to go during the days off，then 取 go into＋目的地（into the jungle）；工作／居住国（Nepal）与目的（find tigers）都不作目的地。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（目的地 vs 工作地）；复用 R54.3（Where 取 to 后目的地），本条是 into。
10 自检：①go into 后是什么？②Nepal 是什么地方？③find tigers 是地点吗？

**22. 答案：At six in the morning.**
1 题面：When did they start their trip；原文 "We started our trip at six in the morning with two elephants carrying our things."；疑问词 When（问时间点）；诱导信号：首段 Last year／for three months 与后文 in the afternoon／that night 都是时间词。
2 候选：①at six in the morning；②last year；③for three months；④in the afternoon。
3 验算：①→started our trip at six in the morning，时间与 start 同句→成立。②→last year 是工作年份，范围过大→次优。③→three months 是工作时长→排除。④→afternoon 是"老虎睡觉、不寻常的时刻"，与出发无关→排除。
4 干扰：时间词共五处（last year／three months／six in the morning／afternoon／that night），按"最近时间"取容易错。
5 意图：考"时间点按事件配对（start→six in the morning）"。
6 边界：若问 How long did the writer work in Nepal? 答 For three months。若问 Why is it unusual to find tigers in the afternoon? 答 Because they sleep in the daytime。
7 错误：A 答 Last year.（错因：年份范围）；B 答 For three months.（错因：时长）；C 答 In the afternoon.（错因：串事件）。
8 规则：R80.2 若问 When did they start their trip，then 取与 start 同句的时间（at six in the morning），保留 at＋钟点；年份（last year）、时长（three months）与其它事件的时间（afternoon／that night）按事件排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（事件配对）；复用 R58.2（时间按事件配对），本条多时间词并列。
10 自检：①start 与哪个时间同句？②three months 是什么？③afternoon 讲的是谁？

**23. 答案：To see better (while they were trying to find tigers).**
1 题面：Why did they climb onto the elephants' backs；原文 "In the jungle there was a lot of wildlife, but we were trying to find tigers. We climbed onto the elephants' backs to see better."；疑问词 Why（问目的）；诱导信号：前句 we were trying to find tigers 也是目的，层级在上。
2 候选：①to see better；②to find tigers（上位目的）；③because elephants are tall（推断）；④to carry their things。
3 验算：①→We climbed onto the elephants' backs to see better，to do 直接给目的→成立。②→find tigers 是整体行程目的，与"爬上象背"这一动作的上位关系；可作补充→次优。③→elephants are tall 是常识推断，原文用 to see better 表述→次优。④→carrying our things 是两头大象的功能，不是"爬上象背"的原因→排除。
4 干扰：find tigers 出现两次（前句＋全文主题），最容易被当答案；carrying things 与 elephants 也相关。
5 意图：考"to do 目的取动作同一句，上位目的只作补充"。
6 边界：若问 What did the elephants carry? 答 Their things。若问 What did they see in the distance later? 答 A tiger。
7 错误：A 答 To find tigers.（错因：上位目的）；B 答 Because elephants are tall.（错因：推断）；C 答 To carry things.（错因：对象错）。
8 规则：R80.3 若问 Why did sb do a specific action，then 取与该动作同句的 to do 目的（to see better）；上位目的（find tigers）可补充，但不能替代；常识推断（elephants are tall）不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 目的（同句 to do）；复用 R33.2（目的取 to），本条区分动作目的与行程目的。
10 自检：①to do 与哪个动作同句？②find tigers 是哪一层？③carrying 是谁的功能？

**24. 答案：A dead deer — the tiger's lunch.**
1 题面：What did they find when they moved nearer；原文 "We moved nearer and found a dead deer. This was the tiger's lunch!"；疑问词 What did they find（问发现物）；诱导信号：同段前面 "in the distance, we saw a tiger"，后面 "a huge tiger jumped out suddenly"。
2 候选：①a dead deer；②a tiger；③a deer's lunch；④a castle。
3 验算：①→We moved nearer and found a dead deer，found 的宾语直接给出→成立（可补 the tiger's lunch）。②→tiger 是"远处看见"（saw）与"突然跳出"（jumped out），不是 moved nearer 后的发现→次优。③→是 tiger's lunch（老虎的午餐），不是 deer's lunch→排除。④→castle 是另一篇（山与台阶）的想象→排除。
4 干扰：saw a tiger 在 found a dead deer 之前，两个动作近；the tiger's lunch 的所属关系也易写反。
5 意图：考"moved nearer 后的发现取 found 的宾语，saw 的对象不作"。
6 边界：若问 What did they see in the distance first? 答 A tiger。若问 What did the tiger do then? 答 It jumped out and caught Kamal's leg between its teeth。
7 错误：A 答 A tiger.（错因：saw 的对象）；B 答 A deer's lunch.（错因：所属反）；C 答 A castle.（错因：串篇）。
8 规则：R80.4 若问 What did they find when they moved nearer，then 取 found 的宾语（a dead deer）；同段的 saw（in the distance）与 jumped out 属不同动作，不替代 found 的结果；所有格（the tiger's lunch）不可写反。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.6 结果（动作—宾语配对）；复用 R31.1（事件核），本条区分 saw／found／jumped。
10 自检：①found 后是什么？②saw 的是什么？③lunch 是谁的？

**25. 答案：One of their elephants.**
1 题面：Who drove the tiger away；原文 "Then a huge tiger jumped out suddenly. It caught Kamal's leg between its teeth, but I managed to pull Kamal away. One of our elephants ran at the tiger and made it go back into the grass…"；疑问词 Who（问施动者）；诱导信号：I managed to pull Kamal away 也是"对抗老虎"的动作。
2 候选：①one of their elephants；②the writer（I）；③Kamal；④the guide's friend。
3 验算：①→One of our elephants ran at the tiger and made it go back into the grass，ran at＋made it go back＝赶走→成立。②→I managed to pull Kamal away 是救人，不是赶虎→次优。③→Kamal 被咬住腿，是被救者→排除。④→原文无→排除。
4 干扰：I managed to pull Kamal away 紧跟被咬句，动作强烈，容易被当成"赶走老虎"；三个施动者（tiger／I／elephant）连续出现。
5 意图：考"Who 取 ran at＋made it go back 的主语，救人动作不等同赶虎"。
6 边界：若问 What happened to Kamal? 答 The tiger caught his leg between its teeth, but the writer pulled him away。若问 Where did the tiger go? 答 Back into the grass。
7 错误：A 答 The writer.（错因：救人当赶虎）；B 答 Kamal.（错因：被救者）；C 答 The two elephants.（错因：只有 one of them）。
8 规则：R80.5 若问 Who drove the tiger away，then 取 ran at／made it go back 的主语（one of their elephants）；同段的救人动作（I pulled Kamal away）与受害者（Kamal）不作赶虎者；数量限定（one of）不写成 two。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（施动者）；复用 R22.1（Who 取主语），本条是"救人 vs 赶虎"分工。
10 自检：①谁 ran at the tiger？②I 做了什么？③是一头还是两头？

**组小结（G80 · 小蓝书预测卷十九 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：目的地 1（21）；出发时间 1（22）；动作目的 1（23）；发现物 1（24）；赶虎者 1（25）。
- 规则：R80.1 目的地取 go into（21）；R80.2 时间按事件（22）；R80.3 动作目的取同句 to do（23）；R80.4 found 取宾语（24）；R80.5 赶虎取 ran at 主语（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R80.1 与"Nepal 在首句"冲突，go into 优先；R80.2 与"多时间词"冲突，start 同句优先；R80.3 与"find tigers 是主题"冲突，同句 to do 优先；R80.4 与"saw a tiger 在前"冲突，found 优先；R80.5 与"pull Kamal away 强烈"冲突，ran at 主语优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：丛林探险叙事首见；本组五题都靠"动作—宾语／主语"配对（saw／found／ran at／pull），是 04 的动词配对样本；数字（three months／six in the morning／two elephants）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十九 · Passage 3

Some people live to climb the highest mountains. Some people live only dreaming about it while others live to avoid ever climbing at all. But one thing is certain — all people meet mountains in their life.

When I was a little girl, my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain.



One day after school, while exploring the green woods of this amazing mountain, I almost fell on a set of stairs. What could these steps lead to? Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon. I started climbing up those strangely mysterious (神秘的) steps. I climbed and climbed. I had to reach the top. But it was now getting real dark. If I kept going I might not be able to see my way back. My mom would be worried sick if I didn't come home soon. So I ran back home almost in the dark while trying not to get too scared.

Anxiously I went to bed dreaming about what I would find at the top of this magical mountain. Could there be a castle up there? Maybe I would find a monster (怪物). Or, maybe all I would find was absolutely nothing! But something inside me was going to climb that mountain at all cost. I could hardly wait to try this adventure again.

Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes. We all fall down. We all have doubts and regrets. Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain. Monsters may appear or the night will fall. But never ever give up on your dream! Never let anyone tell you, "You can't." Dream big and climb high!

26. What made the author start to climb up the stairs to the mountain top?

______

27. Why did the author hurry back home without reaching the top of the mountain? Give one reason.

______

28. How did the author feel that night?

______

29. What does the author want to tell us?

______

30. What's your attitude towards the "mountain" in your life?

______

**〔G81〕小蓝书预测卷十九 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：Curiosity — she wanted to know what the steps led to.**
1 题面：What made the author start to climb up the stairs to the mountain top；原文 "What could these steps lead to? Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon. I started climbing up those strangely mysterious (神秘的) steps."；疑问词 What made sb start（问起因）；诱导信号：it would be starting to get dark 是时间压力，不是动机。
2 候选：①curiosity；②she wanted to reach the top（结果）；③because it was getting dark；④because her mother asked her。
3 验算：①→Curiosity got the best of me…I started climbing，cause→effect 相邻→成立（可补"想知道台阶通向哪里"）。②→I had to reach the top 是爬的过程中的执念→次优。③→天黑是"必须回去"的原因（27 题），不是"开始爬"的原因→排除。④→母亲担心是她回去的原因→排除。
4 干扰：What could these steps lead to? 与 Curiosity 之间隔了一个时间从句；天黑的紧迫感也像动机。
5 意图：考"起因取 Curiosity 句，时间压力与结果不作起因"。
6 边界：若问 Why did she stop climbing? 答 Because it was getting dark and her mother would worry。若问 What did she think might be at the top? 答 A castle, a monster, or nothing。
7 错误：A 答 Because it was getting dark.（错因：时间压力）；B 答 Because she wanted to reach the top.（错因：结果）；C 答 Because her mother asked her.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R81.1 若问 What made sb start doing X，then 取 Curiosity got the best of me 一类起因句；时间压力（getting dark）是"何时停"的原因，结果（reach the top）不作起因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（起因）；复用 R57.3（起因取 because＋事实），本条起因是心理（curiosity）。
10 自检：①Curiosity 句在哪？②getting dark 解释什么？③reach the top 是原因吗？

**27. 答案：Because it was getting dark and she might not be able to see her way back (her mother would also be worried).**
1 题面：Why did the author hurry back home without reaching the top of the mountain? Give one reason；原文 "But it was now getting real dark. If I kept going I might not be able to see my way back. My mom would be worried sick if I didn't come home soon."；题干明示 Give one reason（答一条即可）；诱导信号：三个理由并列，容易写成长段。
2 候选：①getting dark／might not see the way back；②mother would be worried；③she was tired；④she found a monster。
3 验算：①→it was now getting real dark. If I kept going I might not be able to see my way back，一条完整理由→成立。②→My mom would be worried sick，另一条也成立→成立（并列，任选其一）。③→原文无 tired→排除。④→monster 只是想象（Maybe I would find a monster）→排除。
4 干扰：三条理由（天黑／看不见路／妈妈担心）连写，学生容易写三条而题干只要一条；monster 的想象也很具体。
5 意图：考"Give one reason 时答一条完整理由即可，不必全列"。
6 边界：若问 How did she go back? 答 She ran back home almost in the dark。若问 Would her mother be worried? 答 Yes, worried sick。
7 错误：A 答 Because she found a monster.（错因：想象当事实）；B 答 Because she was tired.（错因：无据）；C 只写 Because it was dark and her mother would worry and she couldn't see the way.（错因：冗余，题干只要一条）。
8 规则：R81.2 若题干 Give one reason，then 只答一条完整理由（getting dark／mother worried 任选），不必罗列全部；想象内容（monster）与无据项（tired）不作理由。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（限一）；复用 R69.3（限数），本条是"限一下限"。
10 自检：①有几条理由？②题干要几条？③monster 是真的吗？

**28. 答案：She felt anxious — she went to bed anxiously, dreaming about what she would find at the top.**
1 题面：How did the author feel that night；原文 "Anxiously I went to bed dreaming about what I would find at the top of this magical mountain."＋"I could hardly wait to try this adventure again."；疑问词 How did sb feel（问情绪）；诱导信号：前段 "trying not to get too scared" 是回家路上的情绪。
2 候选：①anxious（＋eager，could hardly wait）；②scared；③angry；④calm。
3 验算：①→Anxiously I went to bed＋could hardly wait，两句同向（既紧张又期待）→成立。②→scared 是跑回家时"尽量不害怕"，不是当晚情绪→次优（时点错）。③→原文无生气→排除。④→anxious 与 calm 相反→排除。
4 干扰：trying not to get too scared 在时间上更靠近"那晚"；anxious 也可译"渴望"，若只译"焦虑"会丢"期待"这一面。
5 意图：考"情绪按时点取（当晚 anxious／路上 scared），并注意 anxious 的双面义"。
6 边界：若问 How did she feel on the way home? 答 She tried not to get too scared。若问 What did she dream about? 答 What she would find at the top (a castle, a monster or nothing)。
7 错误：A 答 Scared.（错因：路上情绪）；B 答 Angry.（错因：无据）；C 答 She felt nothing.（错因：与 anxiously 矛盾）。
8 规则：R81.3 若问 How did sb feel that night，then 取当晚情绪句（Anxiously I went to bed）并可补 eagerly（could hardly wait）；路上或白天的情绪（scared）按时点排除；anxious 兼"紧张＋渴望"，两面都可写。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.13 情绪（时点＋双面）；复用 R73.2（当时 vs 事后），本条是"当晚 vs 路上"。
10 自检：①当晚句在哪？②scared 是什么时候？③anxious 要译几层？

**29. 答案：She wants to tell us never to give up on our dreams — dream big and climb high, and never let anyone tell us "You can't".**
1 题面：What does the author want to tell us；原文末段 "Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain. Monsters may appear or the night will fall. But never ever give up on your dream! Never let anyone tell you, 'You can't.' Dream big and climb high!"；疑问词 What does the author want to tell us（问主旨／寓意）；诱导信号：全文前半是爬山故事，容易被答成"她爬了一座山"。
2 候选：①never give up on your dream, dream big and climb high；②she climbed a mountain as a girl；③monsters are everywhere；④we should avoid climbing mountains。
3 验算：①→never ever give up on your dream＋Dream big and climb high，两处祈使句同向→成立（可带 never let anyone tell you "You can't"）。②→是情节，不是"想告诉我们"→排除。③→monster 是比喻（困难），不是警告→排除。④→与 climb 相反→排除。
4 干扰：Monsters may appear or the night will fall 的比喻很有画面感，容易被当"告诫"；"can't do" attitudes 也在末段。
5 意图：考"寓意取末段祈使句，故事情节不作寓意"。
6 边界：若问 What does the "mountain" stand for? 答 Difficulties／dreams in life（比喻义）。若问 What did she find at the top that night? 答 Nothing — she never reached the top that night。
7 错误：A 答 She climbed a mountain.（错因：情节当寓意）；B 答 Monsters are dangerous.（错因：比喻当实指）；C 答 We should stop dreaming.（错因：与原文相反）。
8 规则：R81.4 若问 What does the author want to tell us，then 取末段祈使句（never give up on your dream／dream big and climb high／never let anyone tell you "You can't"）；故事情节与比喻字面（monster／night）不作寓意。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.19 寓意（启示型主旨）；复用 R58.5（建议取 So 祈使句），本条是"never＋祈使"双重。
10 自检：①末段祈使句有几句？②monster 实指吗？③我写了情节吗？

**30. 答案：（开放题）I think I should face the "mountain" in my life bravely and keep climbing. Difficulties may appear like monsters or the night, but as the author says, I should never give up on my dream and never let anyone tell me "You can't".**
1 题面：What's your attitude towards the "mountain" in your life?——态度（比喻义）＋理由／做法；"mountain" 指生活中的困难与梦想（全文以山为喻）；诱导信号：题干用引号，提示不是真的山。
2 候选：①勇敢面对、坚持攀登（引原文道理）；②逃避；③只写 I like mountains；④无所谓。
3 验算：①→态度明确，且把"山"解为困难／梦想，引 never give up 作依据→成立。②→开放题允许，但须给理由（如换条路），且与原文基调相反→次优。③→把比喻当实指，答非所问→不成立。④→无态度→排除。
4 干扰：引号容易被忽略，学生可能真的写"我喜欢爬山"；题干 attitude 也容易只写形容词（positive）而无做法。
5 意图：考"比喻义理解＋态度＋依据"三合一。
6 边界：若问 What is the "mountain" in the passage? 答 The stairs／the big mountain she tried to climb（字面）与 difficulties（比喻）两解，答题时须按题目要求选一。若问 Did she reach the top? 答 No, she ran back home almost in the dark。
7 错误：A 答 I like climbing mountains.（错因：比喻当实指）；B 只写 Positive.（错因：无依据）；C 答 I will avoid it.（错因：与原文相反且无理由）。
8 规则：R81.5 若问 What's your attitude towards the "mountain" in your life，then 先把引号词解为比喻（困难／梦想），再给态度（face／climb／never give up）与一条依据（引原文或自身经历）；字面义（爬山）与单一形容词都不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.7 态度类（比喻词）；复用 R33.5（态度正反兼顾），本条要求"先解比喻"。
10 自检：①引号是什么意思？②我给了态度还是只给形容词？③依据是什么？

**组小结（G81 · 小蓝书预测卷十九 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：起因（curiosity）1（26）；限一理由 1（27）；当晚情绪 1（28）；寓意取祈使句 1（29）；比喻态度 1（30）。
- 规则：R81.1 起因取 Curiosity（26）；R81.2 Give one reason 只答一条（27）；R81.3 情绪按时点、anxious 双面（28）；R81.4 寓意取祈使句（29）；R81.5 比喻词先解义（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R81.1 与"getting dark 紧迫"冲突，curiosity 优先；R81.2 与"三条理由都想写"冲突，限一优先；R81.3 与"scared 更近"冲突，当晚句优先；R81.4 与"monster 画面强"冲突，祈使句优先；R81.5 与"字面爬山"冲突，比喻义优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**比喻体叙事首见**（山＝困难／梦想）；本组"字面 vs 比喻"与"路上 vs 当晚"两层分流，可作 04 的隐喻类样本；数字无，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十九 · Passage 4

Just like everyone, I have experienced ups and downs in my life. I am an aerospace engineer from India. I was told by my relatives, close friends and others that it was hard for a non-IT student to pursue a master's degree in IT and graduate from a US university.

I had never taken courses related to computers or programming. I was never interested in being a programmer, but things changed. I became so captivated by the convenience IT has



brought to our life that I made up my mind to chase a master's degree in IT.

At first, I came across too many difficulties and setbacks. Coming from a middle-class family, the huge cost per credit was a big issue. My English accent was terrible. Most importantly, the course seemed impossible at first. Although I felt so discouraged and frustrated, I never thought of giving up.

Then I decided to choose my university because it promised its students to help them learn practically. During my first month, it was difficult to understand the Americans' accent and finish my assignments. But I never gave in. I walked two miles to the university every day so that I could use my travel money to buy a meal. I started looking for jobs and I got an offer to work as a student assistant.

I took all these challenges as my chances, and I believed that hard work was my strength. Right now I am graduating with a GPA of 3.96/4 and a job offer from a multinational company that has asked me to start right after graduation.

When you have a dream to realize, there is nothing that can stop you. All you need is the diligence and persistence. Hard work always pays off. Having a determined will is also necessary.

31. Why did the author's family and friends say that it was hard for him to pursue a master's degree in IT?

______

32. What does the underlined part "captivated by" in paragraph 2 mean?

______

33. What is the main idea of paragraph 3?

______

34. What made the author graduate with a higher GPA and a good job offer?

______

35. What do you learn from the author's story?

______

**〔G82〕小蓝书预测卷十九 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：Because he was a non-IT student — he had never taken courses related to computers or programming.**
1 题面：Why did the author's family and friends say that it was hard for him to pursue a master's degree in IT；原文 "I was told by my relatives, close friends and others that it was hard for a non-IT student to pursue a master's degree in IT and graduate from a US university."＋"I had never taken courses related to computers or programming."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：下一段 Coming from a middle-class family, the huge cost per credit was a big issue 也是困难。
2 候选：①he was a non-IT student（never taken computer courses）；②he came from a middle-class family（费用）；③his English accent was terrible；④he was from India。
3 验算：①→it was hard for a non-IT student＋I had never taken courses related to computers，两条同指"专业背景缺失"→成立。②→middle-class／cost 是他自己遇到的困难，不是亲友预言的理由→次优。③→accent 是入读后的困难→次优。④→India 是国籍，不是"难"的理由→排除。
4 干扰：费用与口音都在下一段，且都是真实困难；题干问的是"亲友为什么说难"，理由在引述句里。
5 意图：考"理由取引述句的限定语（a non-IT student），后文困难不作预言依据"。
6 边界：若问 What difficulties did he face at first? 答 The high cost per credit, his terrible English accent and the seemingly impossible course。若问 What did he study before? 答 Aerospace engineering。
7 错误：A 答 Because he was poor.（错因：后文困难）；B 答 Because his English was poor.（错因：后文困难）；C 答 Because he was from India.（错因：国籍）。
8 规则：R82.1 若问 Why did others say it was hard for sb to do X，then 取引述句中的限定（a non-IT student／never taken computer courses）；后文他自己遇到的困难（cost／accent）不作他人预言的依据。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（他人预言的依据）；复用 R61.1（成名取事件），本条是"预言取限定"。
10 自检：①引述句限定了什么？②费用与口音属哪一层？③国籍是理由吗？

**32. 答案：It means "attracted" or "fascinated" by — he was so drawn to the convenience of IT that he decided to study it.（被…吸引、着迷）**
1 题面：What does the underlined part "captivated by" in paragraph 2 mean；原文 "I was never interested in being a programmer, but things changed. I became so captivated by the convenience IT has brought to our life that I made up my mind to chase a master's degree in IT."；原卷该短语有下划线；疑问词 mean（词义题）；诱导信号：前句 I was never interested 是过去状态，与 captivated 形成反转。
2 候选：①attracted／fascinated by；②bored by；③confused by；④forced by。
3 验算：①→so captivated by…that I made up my mind to chase a master's degree，结果句证明是"被吸引"→成立。②→bored 与"下决心去读"相反→不成立。③→confused 无法解释 so…that 的结果→排除。④→forced 与 made up my mind（主动）相反→排除。
4 干扰：前句 never interested 与 captivated 只隔一句，否定词容易被带过来；captivate 的词根（captive 俘虏）也可能被译成"被俘"。
5 意图：考"情感动词由 so…that 的结果句定褒贬"。
6 边界：若问 What did he decide to do? 答 To chase a master's degree in IT。若问 Why did he change his mind? 答 Because he was captivated by the convenience IT brought to life。
7 错误：A 答 Bored by.（错因：前句否定词干扰）；B 答 Forced by.（错因：与主动决心矛盾）；C 答 Captured by the enemy.（错因：词根直译）。
8 规则：R82.2 若划线为情感动词短语（be captivated by），then 用 so…that 的结果句（made up my mind to chase）定褒义，取"被吸引／着迷"；前句的否定状态（never interested）与词根义（captive）不作依据。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（情感动词）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（be captivated by＋事物）→后文结果（so…that decided）→语域（求学动机）→词面义（词根只作干扰）。
10 自检：①so…that 的结果是什么？②never interested 是现在还是过去？③我译成"被俘"了吗？

**33. 答案：It is mainly about the difficulties and setbacks the author met at first — such as the high cost, his poor English accent and the seemingly impossible course — and his refusal to give up.**
1 题面：What is the main idea of paragraph 3；该段原文 "At first, I came across too many difficulties and setbacks. Coming from a middle-class family, the huge cost per credit was a big issue. My English accent was terrible. Most importantly, the course seemed impossible at first. Although I felt so discouraged and frustrated, I never thought of giving up."；疑问词 main idea of paragraph N（问段意）；诱导信号：下一段（第 4 段）写他如何选择学校、打工、走路省钱，容易串进来。
2 候选：①困难与挫折＋不放弃；②他如何选择大学；③他毕业时的 GPA；④他家人反对他。
3 验算：①→段首 too many difficulties and setbacks＋三项具体困难＋Although…never thought of giving up，首尾都在讲"困难＋不放弃"→成立。②→选大学是第 4 段内容→排除。③→GPA 是第 5 段→排除。④→家人只是"说难"，不是反对→排除。
4 干扰：三项困难具体（cost／accent／impossible course），容易只写困难而漏"never give up"；第 4 段的"选择大学"也像同段。
5 意图：考"段意＝首句概括＋段末转折，不能串段"。
6 边界：若问 What was his biggest problem at first? 答 Most importantly, the course seemed impossible at first。若问 What did he do to save money? 答 He walked two miles to the university every day。
7 错误：A 答 He chose a good university.（错因：串段）；B 答 He got a high GPA.（错因：串段）；C 答 He gave up at first.（错因：与 never thought of giving up 相反）。
8 规则：R82.3 若问 main idea of paragraph N，then 取该段首句概括（difficulties and setbacks）＋段末转折（never thought of giving up），中段举例（cost／accent／course）可列 1—2 项；下一段内容（选校／打工／GPA）不串入。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.2 段意概括（首句＋段末）；复用 R39.2（段意取论点句），本条加"段末转折"。
10 自检：①段首概括是什么？②段末转折是什么？③选校在第几段？

**34. 答案：His hard work — diligence and persistence. He took all the challenges as chances, never gave in, and worked as a student assistant while studying.**
1 题面：What made the author graduate with a higher GPA and a good job offer；原文 "I took all these challenges as my chances, and I believed that hard work was my strength. Right now I am graduating with a GPA of 3.96/4 and a job offer from a multinational company"＋"All you need is the diligence and persistence. Hard work always pays off."；疑问词 What made（问原因）；诱导信号：GPA 3.96/4 与 job offer 都很具体，容易被当"原因"。
2 候选：①hard work（diligence and persistence）；②his high GPA；③his university's promise；④his family's money。
3 验算：①→I believed that hard work was my strength＋diligence and persistence＋Hard work always pays off，三处同向→成立（可补"把挑战当机会"）。②→GPA 是结果，循环→排除。③→学校承诺"实践教学"是外部条件→次优。④→middle-class 家庭、cost 是困难→排除。
4 干扰：GPA 3.96/4 与 multinational company 的结果最醒目，因果容易倒置；学校的 promise 也像原因。
5 意图：考"原因取 hard work 三处同向表述，结果（GPA／offer）不反推原因"。
6 边界：若问 What was his GPA? 答 3.96/4。若问 Where will he work after graduation? 答 At a multinational company（原文未给公司名）。
7 错误：A 答 His high GPA.（错因：结果当原因）；B 答 His university's promise.（错因：外部条件）；C 答 His family's support.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R82.4 若问 What made sb achieve X，then 取 hard work／diligence and persistence 等自述原因（可补"把挑战当机会"）；结果本身（GPA／job offer）与外部条件（学校承诺）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（自述归因）；复用 R48.3（影响取结果句）的反向：本条取"结果的原因"。
10 自检：①自述原因在哪三处？②GPA 是原因吗？③学校承诺算什么？

**35. 答案：（开放题）I learn that hard work always pays off. Like the author, who came from a non-IT background and faced cost, accent and course difficulties, I should take challenges as chances, keep diligent and never give up on my dream.**
1 题面：What do you learn from the author's story?——启示＋自用；可用依据：I took all these challenges as my chances／hard work was my strength／All you need is the diligence and persistence／Hard work always pays off／Having a determined will is also necessary。
2 候选：①努力终有回报＋把挑战当机会（道理＋自用）；②只写 I am moved；③复述他的经历；④写"IT 专业很好找工作"。
3 验算：①→道理（hard work pays off／diligence and persistence）＋自用（take challenges as chances）→成立。②→只有情绪→不成立。③→复述生平不是"我学到什么"→排除。④→跑题到专业选择→排除。
4 干扰：末段三句格言（nothing can stop you／diligence and persistence／hard work pays off）都可直接抄，容易只抄不联系自己。
5 意图：考"启示＝道理＋自用"，与 R75.5／R48.5 同族。
6 边界：若问 What is the author's advice? 答 When you have a dream, nothing can stop you; all you need is diligence and persistence。若问 What did he think of the challenges? 答 He took them as his chances。
7 错误：A 只写 I am moved.（错因：漏道理）；B 抄 "Hard work always pays off."（错因：未落到自己）；C 写 I want to study IT.（错因：跑题）。
8 规则：R82.5 若问 What do you learn from sb's story，then 先给道理（hard work pays off／diligence and persistence），再说自己会怎么做（take challenges as chances／never give up）；只抄格言或复述生平均不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.5 启示类；复用 R75.5（启示＝道理＋自用），本条取材"逆境求学"。
10 自检：①道理是哪句？②我说了自己怎么做吗？③我是只抄格言吗？

**组小结（G82 · 小蓝书预测卷十九 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：他人预言的依据 1（31）；情感词义（captivated）1（32）；段意（首句＋段末）1（33）；成功原因 1（34）；启示 1（35）。
- 规则：R82.1 预言取限定（31）；R82.2 captivated by＝被吸引（32）；R82.3 段意取首句＋段末转折（33）；R82.4 原因取 hard work（34）；R82.5 启示＝道理＋自用（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R82.1 与"费用／口音都真实"冲突，引述句优先；R82.2 与"never interested 在前"冲突，结果句优先；R82.3 与"选校段相邻"冲突，段落边界优先；R82.4 与"GPA 醒目"冲突，因果方向优先；R82.5 与"格言好抄"冲突，自用优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：励志自述类第 3 篇（G66／G75／本条）；数字（3.96/4／two miles）均照录，**无换算、无推算**；**小蓝书卷十九 4 篇至此完成（G79—G82）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十二 · Passage One

I've always been creative since I was a little girl. My childhood was filled with arts, crafts (手工) and music, and every day was an exciting adventure of creation.

Somewhere along the way, however, I lost touch with my creative self. At 21, I landed a job at a big insurance company out of my business degree. I would go to the office, sit at my desk and repeat the same work five days a week 9 to 5. The days were long and tedious. Working this way for one year was painful enough, let alone a lifetime. Before long I decided to make a change.

One thing I had developed an interest in was sewing, so I took a sewing course at a community college. It was only a five-week course but it awakened my interest and got my confidence up.

As I dream bigger, I began looking into college courses for Fashion Design and three months later I signed up for a part-time design course. I attended classes two nights a week. Although exhausting, it gave me energy, enthusiasm and happiness.

As it became clearer that fashion was what I wanted to do full time, the reality of my day-to-day work at the insurance company became harder. I felt bored. No energy, no motivation and zero fulfillment (满足感).

I knew I needed to make a bigger change. After struggling for quite a while, I made a difficult decision—leaving my job and studying my design course full time. Two years later I got my diploma.

The last few years have been exciting because I've been following my heart to do what I love. Today I am living a creative life as the designer of my own fashion brand.

Sometimes it's hard to make a change, but I'm so glad I set the wheels of change in motion with that very small first step because it has led me to where I am today.

**〔G83〕小蓝书预测卷十二 · Passage One（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：Arts, crafts and music.**
1 题面：What was the author interested in when she was a little girl；原文 "My childhood was filled with arts, crafts (手工) and music, and every day was an exciting adventure of creation."；疑问词 What was sb interested in（问兴趣内容）；诱导信号：首句 I've always been creative 是概括，末段 sewing／fashion 是她后来的兴趣。
2 候选：①arts, crafts and music；②sewing（后来的兴趣）；③fashion design；④business。
3 验算：①→My childhood was filled with arts, crafts and music，三项并列与"小时候"对应→成立（三项都写）。②→sewing 是 21 岁后"developed an interest in"，时点在后→不成立。③→Fashion Design 是更后的课程→排除。④→business degree 是她读的专业，不是童年的兴趣→排除。
4 干扰：sewing 与 fashion 在全文占大半篇幅，主题感强；arts／crafts／music 只在首段一句出现。
5 意图：考"童年兴趣取首段并列三项，后期兴趣按时间排除"。
6 边界：若问 What did she study at college? 答 Business（her business degree）。若问 What was her first job? 答 At a big insurance company。
7 错误：A 答 Sewing.（错因：时点错）；B 答 Fashion design.（错因：后期）；C 答 Music only.（错因：漏两项）。
8 规则：R83.1 若问 What was sb interested in when he/she was little，then 取童年段的并列三项（arts, crafts and music），三项不省；后期的兴趣（sewing／fashion design）与所学专业（business）按时间排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（童年兴趣）；复用 R67.3（并列取全），本条以时点筛。
10 自检：①童年段在哪？②sewing 是什么时候？③三项写全了吗？

**17. 答案：It means "boring" or "dull" — the days were long and uninteresting.（冗长乏味的）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word in Paragraph 2 mean；原文第 2 段 "I would go to the office, sit at my desk and repeat the same work five days a week 9 to 5. The days were long and tedious."；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 mean（词义题）；诱导信号：long 已给"长"，tedious 与之并列，须译"乏味"而非"长"。
2 候选：①boring／dull；②long；③busy；④exciting。
3 验算：①→repeat the same work＋The days were long and tedious，重复同一工作→"乏味"；and 与 long 并列但不同义→成立。②→long 是并列词，不是 tedious 的释义→次优（同义反复）。③→busy 与"重复、漫长"无必然联系，且下文说 no energy／bored→排除。④→exciting 与整段相反→排除。
4 干扰：long and tedious 连写，学生容易把两个词当一个意思；后文 boring／no motivation 也提示词义。
5 意图：考"并列形容词取不同义（long≠tedious）"，并用后文 bored／no motivation 校验。
6 边界：若问 How did she feel about the office job? 答 She felt bored — no energy, no motivation and zero fulfillment。若问 How long did she work there? 答 For one year。
7 错误：A 答 Long.（错因：并列词同义化）；B 答 Busy.（错因：无据）；C 答 Exciting.（错因：与整段相反）。
8 规则：R83.2 若划线形容词与另一形容词并列（long and tedious），then 两者取不同义（tedious＝boring／dull）；不把并列词当同义词，也不取反义（exciting）；后文情绪词（bored／no motivation）可作校验。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（并列形容词）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（days were…）→并列（long）→后文（bored／zero fulfillment）→词面义。
10 自检：①与哪个词并列？②long 能当释义吗？③后文哪个词可校验？

**18. 答案：She felt exhausted but also energetic and happy — the course gave her energy, enthusiasm and happiness.**
1 题面：How did the author feel when she was taking the part-time design course；原文 "I attended classes two nights a week. Although exhausting, it gave me energy, enthusiasm and happiness."；疑问词 How did sb feel（问感受，双面）；诱导信号：Although exhausting 在前，容易被只取"累"。
2 候选：①exhausting but gave energy, enthusiasm and happiness；②only exhausted；③bored；④confident only。
3 验算：①→Although exhausting, it gave me energy, enthusiasm and happiness，让步＋转折双面→成立（两面都写）。②→只取 exhausting，漏转折→次优。③→bored 是她对保险工作的感受→排除。④→confident 出自 sewing course（got my confidence up），不是设计课→次优。
4 干扰：Although 结构不熟就会只读"累"；confidence 在上一段出现，容易串段。
5 意图：考"Although 让步＋转折双面都要写"，并区分两门课的感受。
6 边界：若问 How did the sewing course help her? 答 It awakened her interest and got her confidence up。若问 How did she feel about the insurance job? 答 Bored, with no energy, no motivation and zero fulfillment。
7 错误：A 答 She felt exhausted.（错因：只取让步）；B 答 She felt bored.（错因：串到保险工作）；C 答 She felt confident.（错因：串到缝纫课）。
8 规则：R83.3 若问 How did sb feel during a course，then 取 Although＋让步与转折双面（exhausting／energy, enthusiasm and happiness）；上一门课的感受（confidence）与另一份工作的感受（bored）按对象排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.13 情绪（让步双面）；复用 R37.2（but 两侧都写），本条是 Although。
10 自检：①Although 后是什么？②转折后是什么？③confidence 属哪门课？

**19. 答案：（任答两条）She took a sewing course at a community college; she signed up for a part-time design course and attended classes two nights a week; she left her job and studied her design course full time.**
1 题面：What did the author do to get back to her creative life? Give two of the facts.；题干明示 two of the facts（列两条）；原文依次：took a sewing course at a community college（five-week）／signed up for a part-time design course（two nights a week）／made a difficult decision—leaving my job and studying my design course full time；诱导信号：三步都在不同段落，容易只写第一步。
2 候选：①缝纫课；②兼职设计课；③辞职全日制读设计；④在保险公司升职。
3 验算：①→I took a sewing course at a community college，第一步→成立。②→I signed up for a part-time design course…attended classes two nights a week，第二步→成立。③→leaving my job and studying my design course full time，第三步→成立。④→原文无升职，且与"离开"相反→排除。
4 干扰：三步跨四段（3／4／6 段），题干只要两条，容易漏第二步；five-week／two nights a week 等细节也容易占篇幅。
5 意图：考"Give two facts 从事件链取两条，跨段找齐"。
6 边界：若问 How long was the sewing course? 答 Five weeks。若问 When did she get her diploma? 答 Two years after she began studying design full time。
7 错误：A 只写 She took a sewing course.（错因：只一条）；B 答 She got a business degree.（错因：不是"回到创意生活"的做法）；C 答 She opened a shop.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R83.4 若题干 Give two of the facts，then 从跨段事件链中取两条（sewing course／part-time design course／left job and studied full time），数量达标；与"回到创意生活"无关的经历（business degree）不作事实。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（跨段取两）；复用 R78.2（限数取足），本条跨段。
10 自检：①事件链有几环？②我列够两条了吗？③business degree 算吗？

**20. 答案：（开放题）Yes, I do. She gave up a stable job at an insurance company and went back to what she loved step by step — first a sewing course, then a part-time design course, and finally full-time study — and now she has her own fashion brand, which shows that a small first step can change a life.**
1 题面：Do you consider the author as your role model? Please explain.——表态＋解释；可用依据：decided to make a change／took a sewing course／signed up for a part-time design course／left her job and studied full time／following my heart to do what I love／set the wheels of change in motion with that very small first step。
2 候选：①Yes＋理由（勇敢改变、分步行动、追随内心）；②No＋理由（太冒险、不值得）；③只写 Yes；④复述她的经历。
3 验算：①→表态明确，三条理由能落到原文（left her job／step by step／following my heart）→成立。②→开放题允许，须给理由（如 stability matters），可作次优→次优。③→漏 explain→不成立。④→复述不是"她是不是我的榜样"→排除。
4 干扰：原文励志句多（set the wheels of change in motion），容易整段抄；题干 role model 要求"我"的判断。
5 意图：考"表态＋理由"，并允许与作者路径不同。
6 边界：若问 What is the author's advice? 答 Sometimes it's hard to make a change, but a very small first step can lead you to where you are today。若问 What does she do now? 答 She is the designer of her own fashion brand。
7 错误：A 只写 Yes, I do.（错因：漏理由）；B 答 She is a designer.（错因：复述身份）；C 答 Because she is rich.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R83.5 若问 Do you consider sb as your role model? Please explain，then 先表态（Yes, I do.／No, I don't.），再给 1—2 条理由，优先引其关键选择（left her job／step by step／followed her heart）；只表态或复述经历都不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.2 双问（表态＋理由）；复用 R62.5（喜好＝表态＋理由），本条是"榜样判断"。
10 自检：①我表态了吗？②理由落在哪几件事？③我复述经历了吗？

**组小结（G83 · 小蓝书预测卷十二 Passage One）**
- 考点分布：童年兴趣 1（16）；并列形容词词义 1（17）；让步双面情绪 1（18）；限数取两（跨段）1（19）；榜样判断 1（20）。
- 规则：R83.1 童年兴趣取三项（16）；R83.2 并列形容词取不同义（17）；R83.3 Although 双面都写（18）；R83.4 Give two facts 跨段取两（19）；R83.5 榜样＝表态＋理由（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R83.1 与"sewing 是主题"冲突，时点优先；R83.2 与"long and 连写"冲突，并列不同义优先；R83.3 与"exhausting 在前"冲突，转折优先；R83.4 与"只写第一步"冲突，数量优先；R83.5 与"励志句好抄"冲突，表态优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：职业转变自述第 2 篇（G76 Laqueur／本条）；本篇把"童年兴趣—工作乏味—分步改变"写成时间链，是 04 的时间闸门样本；数字（21／five-week／two nights／two years）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十二 · Passage Two

For many teenagers, a job is a way to earn a little extra money. For me, it is more than that.

At the age of 16, I was offered my very first job as a shopgirl in a clothing store. On the first day, my manager was training me how to fold and organize platform after platform of clothes. The work seemed overwhelming, and everything had to be done in an accurate way. I got so impatient because I couldn't get it right the first couple of times. After about ten tries, I had the clothes folded perfectly. Then it took me thirty minutes to get them all looking uniform. Now, I fold and organize clothes every day, and I'm able to do them well. Through this experience, I've learned to be patient.

Helping customers and establishing connections with them is one of the things I love most about my job. About two months ago, I helped a woman who was looking for a dress. She told me exactly what she was picturing—a blue dress with long sleeves and a lace neck. We didn't have any such dress, and when I explained that to her, she wasn't very happy. Instead of getting annoyed, I tried getting to know her a bit better and asked what the dress was for, so I could find other items in her size that could work. We shared our love of the Netflix fashion show, and she ended up buying $200 worth of new clothes, having found other items she liked. This experience has taught me to be more open with strangers.

Every job has its share of frustrations and challenges; to do well you must learn to deal with them. I've learned this from my own experience, and it has helped me in other aspects of my life as well.

21. What was the author's first job?

____________________

22. What is the meaning of the underlined word in Para. 2?

____________________

23. How did the author manage to meet the customer's needs in Para. 3?

____________________

24. How has the author's work experience changed her in personality?

____________________

25. What job would you like to do? How can you help people in your work?

____________________

**〔G84〕小蓝书预测卷十二 · Passage Two（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：A shopgirl in a clothing store.**
1 题面：What was the author's first job；原文 "At the age of 16, I was offered my very first job as a shopgirl in a clothing store."；疑问词 What was sb's first job（问职位）；诱导信号：下一句 my manager was training me 里有 manager 一词。
2 候选：①a shopgirl in a clothing store；②a manager；③a fashion designer；④a customer assistant（改写）。
3 验算：①→my very first job as a shopgirl in a clothing store，as 后即职位→成立。②→manager 是给她培训的人→排除。③→designer 是另一篇（卷十二 P1）的职业→排除。④→customer assistant 是改写，原文用 shopgirl→次优。
4 干扰：my manager 紧跟其后；全文讲"服务顾客"，也像"客服"。
5 意图：考"first job 取 as 后的职位名，管理者不作职位"。
6 边界：若问 Who trained the author on the first day? 答 Her manager。若问 How old was she when she got the job? 答 Sixteen。
7 错误：A 答 A manager.（错因：人物错位）；B 答 A designer.（错因：串篇）；C 答 A cashier.（错因：无据改写）。
8 规则：R84.1 若问 What was sb's first job，then 取 as＋职位名（a shopgirl in a clothing store）；同句/邻句的管理者（manager）与改写词（assistant）不作职位。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.37 职业（as 后职位）；复用 R43.1（身份取同位语），本条是 as 短语。
10 自检：①as 后是什么？②manager 是谁？③我改写了职位名吗？

**22. 答案：It means "too much to handle" — the work was very hard and seemed impossible to do well at first.（难以应付的、压倒性的）**
1 题面：What is the meaning of the underlined word in Para. 2；原文 "On the first day, my manager was training me how to fold and organize platform after platform of clothes. The work seemed overwhelming, and everything had to be done in an accurate way."；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 meaning（词义题）；诱导信号：下一句 I got so impatient because I couldn't get it right 是情绪结果。
2 候选：①too much to handle（难以应付）；②very easy；③interesting；④well-paid。
3 验算：①→The work seemed overwhelming＋everything had to be done accurately＋I got so impatient，三处同向→成立。②→easy 与 impatient／couldn't get it right 相反→不成立。③→interesting 原文未提，且与 impatient 不搭→排除。④→原文无工资信息→排除。
4 干扰：overwhelm 的字面"淹没"可能被译成"被淹没"；platform after platform 的重复感也容易被当成"多"而已。
5 意图：考"形容词按前后文（accurately／impatient）定'难以应付'"。
6 边界：若问 Why did she get impatient? 答 Because she couldn't get the folding right the first couple of times。若问 How long did it take her to make the clothes look uniform? 答 Thirty minutes（after about ten tries）。
7 错误：A 答 Very easy.（错因：与 impatient 相反）；B 答 Very interesting.（错因：无据）；C 答 Very cheap.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R84.2 若划线形容词后紧跟"要求严格／情绪受挫"的句子（accurately／impatient），then 取"难以应付"义；字面"淹没"与反义（easy）不取；无据评价（interesting／well-paid）排除。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（语境定强度）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（work seemed…）→后文（accurately／impatient）→语域（第一天培训）→词面义。
10 自检：①后文情绪是什么？②字面"淹没"能用吗？③我译成"简单"了吗？

**23. 答案：Instead of getting annoyed, she got to know the customer better, asked what the dress was for, and found other items in her size that the woman liked.**
1 题面：How did the author manage to meet the customer's needs in Para. 3；原文 "We didn't have any such dress, and when I explained that to her, she wasn't very happy. Instead of getting annoyed, I tried getting to know her a bit better and asked what the dress was for, so I could find other items in her size that could work."；疑问词 How did sb manage（问做法）；诱导信号：末尾 she ended up buying $200 worth of new clothes 是结果，不是做法。
2 候选：①got to know her＋asked purpose＋found other items in her size；②found the exact dress she wanted；③gave her a discount；④$200 worth of clothes。
3 验算：①→Instead of getting annoyed, I tried getting to know her…asked what the dress was for, so I could find other items in her size，三步做法→成立。②→原文明确 We didn't have any such dress→不成立。③→原文无折扣→排除。④→是结果（她买了 200 美元衣服）→排除。
4 干扰：$200 数字醒目；"顾客想要蓝裙"的细节也很具体，容易答成"她找到了蓝裙"。
5 意图：考"做法取 Instead of…I tried…so I could… 的动作链，结果与不存在的物不作做法"。
6 边界：若问 What did the customer want at first? 答 A blue dress with long sleeves and a lace neck。若问 What did they share? 答 Their love of the Netflix fashion show。
7 错误：A 答 She found the blue dress.（错因：原文说没有）；B 答 She gave a discount.（错因：无据）；C 答 She sold $200 of clothes.（错因：结果当做法）。
8 规则：R84.3 若问 How did sb manage to meet sb's needs，then 取 Instead of…I tried…so I could… 的动作链（了解顾客／问用途／找同尺码替代品）；结果（营业额）与原文明确没有的物（the exact dress）不作做法。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（动作链）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do 目的），本条是"替代方案"。
10 自检：①Instead of 后是什么？②她做了哪三步？③蓝裙找到了吗？

**24. 答案：She has learned to be patient and to be more open with strangers.**
1 题面：How has the author's work experience changed her in personality；原文 "Through this experience, I've learned to be patient."＋"This experience has taught me to be more open with strangers."；疑问词 How has…changed her（问性格变化）；诱导信号：文中还有 I got so impatient（变化前）与 she wasn't very happy（顾客情绪）。
2 候选：①patient＋more open with strangers；②impatient（变化前）；③hard-working；④rich。
3 验算：①→learned to be patient＋taught me to be more open with strangers，两处 learned／taught 同向→成立（两条都写）。②→impatient 是"first couple of times"的旧状态→不成立。③→hard-working 原文未直接说→次优。④→收入不是性格→排除。
4 干扰：I got so impatient 在第二段，与变化句同段，容易被当答案；$200 的营业额也可能被当成"变化"。
5 意图：考"性格变化取 learned／taught 两句，变化前的状态反证"。
6 边界：若问 What did she learn from folding clothes? 答 To be patient。若问 What did she learn from helping the customer? 答 To be more open with strangers。
7 错误：A 答 She became impatient.（错因：变化前状态）；B 答 She became rich.（错因：营业额不是性格）；C 答 She became a manager.（错因：职位不是性格）。
8 规则：R84.4 若问 How has X changed sb in personality，then 取 learned to／taught me to 两句（patient／more open with strangers），两条并列不省；变化前的旧状态（impatient）反证而非答案。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.10 性格推断（变化型）；复用 R28.4（性格看行为），本条是"learned to"直接给出。
10 自检：①learned to 后是什么？②taught me to 后是什么？③impatient 是现在吗？

**25. 答案：（开放题，两问都答）I would like to be a teacher. In my work, I can help students understand difficult things patiently, and I can also be open with them so that they are willing to ask for help.**
1 题面：What job would you like to do? How can you help people in your work?——两问：想做什么工作＋如何帮人；可用依据：be patient（fold clothes）／be more open with strangers／helping customers and establishing connections。
2 候选：①教师＋耐心讲解＋开放沟通；②只说 I want to be a teacher；③只答 how to help；④写"想赚钱"。
3 验算：①→两问都答，且"耐心／open"呼应原文所学→成立。②→漏第二问→不成立。③→漏第一问→不成立。④→"赚钱"没答如何帮人→排除。
4 干扰：题干两个问号，学生常只答一个；原文的"耐心、开放"是现成素材，也可能被直接抄成"我的工作"而没有具体职业。
5 意图：考"双问都要答：职业＋助人方式"，并可与原文品格呼应。
6 边界：若问 What does the author love most about her job? 答 Helping customers and establishing connections with them。若问 What has every job got? 答 Its share of frustrations and challenges。
7 错误：A 只写 I want to be a teacher.（错因：漏第二问）；B 只写 I will help people.（错因：漏第一问）；C 答 I want to earn money.（错因：未答助人）。
8 规则：R84.5 若题干为 What job would you like to do? How can you help people，then 两问各答一项（职业＋具体助人方式），可呼应原文品格（patient／open）；只答一问或只谈收入均不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.2 双问（职业＋助人）；复用 R62.5（双问都答），本条是"职业规划"。
10 自检：①两问都答了吗？②助人方式具体吗？③我只写了职业吗？

**组小结（G84 · 小蓝书预测卷十二 Passage Two）**
- 考点分布：第一份工作 1（21）；语境词义（overwhelming）1（22）；满足需求的做法 1（23）；性格变化 1（24）；双问（职业＋助人）1（25）。
- 规则：R84.1 first job 取 as 后职位（21）；R84.2 overwhelming＝难以应付（22）；R84.3 动作链取三步（23）；R84.4 性格取 learned／taught（24）；R84.5 双问各答一项（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R84.1 与"manager 紧邻"冲突，as 后优先；R84.2 与"字面淹没"冲突，后文情绪优先；R84.3 与"$200 醒目"冲突，动作链优先；R84.4 与"impatient 同段"冲突，变化句优先；R84.5 与"只答一问"冲突，两问都要。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：兼职打工自述首见；本篇三题靠"变化前／变化后"分流（impatient vs patient／没有蓝裙 vs 找到替代品），与 G83 的时间链互补；数字（16／ten tries／thirty minutes／$200／two months）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十二 · Passage Three

After being evacuated (疏散) from her Florida home following Hurricane Michael. Amber Gee was attempting to get an idea of the destruction left behind when she discovered a sign of trouble. As reported by ABC News, Gee was using NOAA's interactive aerial map (交互式航拍地图) to check the damage done to her and her family's homes when she spotted the word "H-E-L-L-P" spelled out in the yard.

The NOAA website allows those impacted in the hurricane look at the aerial photos of the affected area. According to ABC News, Gee was looking at one of these photos when she noticed a cry for help spelled out in wood in the front yard of her grandmother's Bay County home.

Though her grandmother had evacuated, several other family members, including Gee's uncle, John, had stayed behind. After spotting the message, Gee alerted (向……报警) Bay County Emergency Services.

After the rescue, Bay County Emergency Services posted the incident on their Facebook page, writing, "This is an incredible story of how people are working together in this situation. Someone from another county was using the mapping app to check property in rural Bay County and noticed the word 'help' spelled out in the grass in wood. That person immediately contacted us and sent the picture and we dispatched emergency workers."

Meanwhile, Gee says she is thankful that she was able to use the mapping tool to get her family to safety. "The hurricane has turned everything upside down everywhere. Some were more fortunate than others. I'm just happy that everybody is safe and sound and, hopefully, soon we will all get through this together and recover from this storm," she said.

27. Who can look at the NOAA website's aerial photos of the affected area?

____________________

28. Who spelled out "Help" to cry for help?

____________________

29. What does the underlined word "dispatched" in Para. 5 probably mean?

____________________

30. What lesson can you learn from this story? Please explain.

**〔G85〕小蓝书预测卷十二 · Passage Three（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：To check the damage done to her and her family's homes.**
1 题面：What did Gee use the mapping app to do；原文 "Gee was using NOAA's interactive aerial map (交互式航拍地图) to check the damage done to her and her family's homes when she spotted the word 'H-E-L-L-P' spelled out in the yard."；疑问词 What did sb use X to do（问目的）；诱导信号：后半句 when she spotted the word 是她"顺便发现"的。
2 候选：①to check the damage to her and her family's homes；②to spot the word HELP；③to rescue her uncle；④to post on Facebook。
3 验算：①→using…to check the damage done to her and her family's homes，to do 直接给目的→成立。②→spot 是 when 从句里的意外发现，不是使用目的→次优。③→救援是后文（alerted Emergency Services）→排除。④→Facebook 是应急部门发的→排除。
4 干扰：HELP 太戏剧化，最容易被当目的；when 从句与 to do 在同一句，结构易混。
5 意图：考"use X to do 取不定式目的，when 从句的意外发现不作目的"。
6 边界：若问 What did she notice while checking the map? 答 The word "H-E-L-L-P" spelled out in the yard。若问 Who did she alert? 答 Bay County Emergency Services。
7 错误：A 答 To look for the word HELP.（错因：发现当目的）；B 答 To rescue her family.（错因：结果当目的）；C 答 To post photos.（错因：主体错）。
8 规则：R85.1 若问 What did sb use X to do，then 取 to do 不定式（to check the damage）；when 从句里的意外发现（spotted the word）与后续结果（alerted／rescued）不作使用目的。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 目的（use…to do）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条区分目的与意外发现。
10 自检：①to do 是什么？②HELP 是在哪个从句？③alert 是目的吗？

**27. 答案：People impacted in the hurricane (those affected by the hurricane).**
1 题面：Who can look at the NOAA website's aerial photos of the affected area；原文 "The NOAA website allows those impacted in the hurricane look at the aerial photos of the affected area."；疑问词 Who can look at（问人群）；诱导信号：同段还有 Gee、her grandmother's Bay County home 等具体人物。
2 候选：①those impacted in the hurricane；②everyone（the public）；③only Gee；④the emergency workers。
3 验算：①→allows those impacted in the hurricane look at…，allows 后的人群直接给出→成立。②→原文限定 those impacted，未说对所有人开放→不成立。③→Gee 只是其中一人→次优。④→emergency workers 是接到报警后出动的人→排除。
4 干扰：Gee 是全文主角，容易被当"唯一能看的人"；"allows" 后省略 to 的用法也可能让人读不全。
5 意图：考"Who 取 allows 后的人群限定（those impacted），个体不作群体"。
6 边界：若问 What does the NOAA website allow people to do? 答 To look at the aerial photos of the affected area。若问 How did Gee check the damage? 答 By using NOAA's interactive aerial map。
7 错误：A 答 Everyone.（错因：丢限定）；B 答 Only Gee.（错因：个体当群体）；C 答 The emergency services.（错因：主体错）。
8 规则：R85.2 若问 Who can look at／use X，then 取 allows 后的限定人群（those impacted in the hurricane）；个体（Gee）与机构（Emergency Services）不作群体；限定词 those 不省略成 everyone。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（限定人群）；复用 R60.2（被动主语取总括），本条是"限定人群"。
10 自检：①allows 后是谁？②说了 everyone 吗？③Gee 是群体吗？

**28. 答案：Her uncle John (and the other family members who stayed behind).**
1 题面：Who spelled out "Help" to cry for help；原文 "Though her grandmother had evacuated, several other family members, including Gee's uncle, John, had stayed behind."＋"Gee was looking at one of these photos when she noticed a cry for help spelled out in wood in the front yard of her grandmother's Bay County home."；疑问词 Who spelled out（问施动者）；诱导信号：Gee 是"发现者"，全文主角。
2 候选：①her uncle John（stayed behind）；②Gee herself；③her grandmother；④the emergency workers。
3 验算：①→her grandmother had evacuated, but several other family members, including Gee's uncle, John, had stayed behind＋spotted a cry for help in her grandmother's yard，留下的人＝拼字的人→成立（可写 uncle John）。②→Gee 是"发现字样"的人（spotted／noticed）→不成立。③→grandmother 已撤离→排除。④→workers 是被派出救援的→排除。
4 干扰：Gee 是主角且"发现"动作强烈；grandmother 的院子是地点，容易把屋主当拼字者。
5 意图：考"施动者按'留下／撤离'区分，发现者不是拼字者"。
6 边界：若问 Who noticed the message? 答 Gee。若问 Who had evacuated? 答 Her grandmother。
7 错误：A 答 Gee.（错因：发现者当拼字者）；B 答 Her grandmother.（错因：已撤离）；C 答 The rescue team.（错因：救援方）。
8 规则：R85.3 若问 Who spelled out／wrote a message，then 按"留下 vs 撤离"定施动者（uncle John 等留下的家人）；发现者（Gee）与已撤离者（grandmother）不作拼字者；救援人员属受信方。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（施动者）；复用 R80.5（Who 取主语），本条靠"去留"分流。
10 自检：①谁留下了？②Gee 做了什么动作？③祖母在哪？

**29. 答案：It means "sent (out)" — the emergency services sent workers to the area.（派出）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "dispatched" in Para. 5 probably mean；原文（Bay County Emergency Services 的 Facebook 原文）"That person immediately contacted us and sent the picture and we dispatched emergency workers."；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 probably mean（词义题）；诱导信号：同段有 contacted／sent the picture 两个动作，容易混。
2 候选：①sent out（派出）；②contacted（联系）；③stopped（阻止）；④trained（培训）。
3 验算：①→we dispatched emergency workers，宾语是"应急人员"，与"派出"搭配→成立。②→contacted 已在前半句（that person contacted us），重复且主语不同→排除。③→stopped workers 与救援目的相反→不成立。④→trained 与"立即救援"语境不符→排除。
4 干扰：contacted／sent the picture 与 dispatched 在同一句连写，动作容易串；dispatch 的"发送（消息）"义也可能被套成"发照片"。
5 意图：考"按宾语（emergency workers）定'派出'，不取同句已出现的 contacted／sent"。
6 边界：若问 Who contacted the emergency services? 答 The person who noticed the message（Gee）。若问 What did the emergency services do after getting the picture? 答 They dispatched emergency workers。
7 错误：A 答 Contacted.（错因：同句已有、主语不同）；B 答 Stopped.（错因：与救援相反）；C 答 Trained.（错因：语境不符）。
8 规则：R85.4 若划线动词后接"人员／队伍"类宾语（dispatched emergency workers），then 取"派出"义；同句已出现的近义动作（contacted／sent the picture）不复用，反义（stopped）与无关义（trained）排除。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（搭配定值）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（dispatch＋workers）→同句动作（contact／send）→语域（应急响应）→词面义。
10 自检：①宾语是什么？②contacted 是谁做的？③我译成"联系"了吗？

**30. 答案：（开放题）I learn that modern technology can save lives. Gee used an aerial map to check her home and spotted the "HELP" sign, and the emergency services sent workers as soon as they got the picture, so tools and quick action together made the rescue possible.**
1 题面：What lesson can you learn from this story? Please explain.——启示＋解释；可用依据：using NOAA's interactive aerial map to check the damage／spotted the word "H-E-L-L-P"／alerted Bay County Emergency Services／we dispatched emergency workers／people are working together in this situation。
2 候选：①科技能救命（＋及时行动）；②飓风很可怕（现象）；③只写 I am moved；④复述事件经过。
3 验算：①→道理（technology helps rescue／quick action）＋解释（map→spot→alert→dispatch）→成立。②→是背景，不是"学到什么"→次优。③→只有情绪→不成立。④→复述不是启示→排除。
4 干扰：事件本身戏剧性强（航拍图上看到 HELP），容易写成经过；结尾 everybody is safe and sound 也像"启示"。
5 意图：考"启示＝道理＋解释（用事件链作证）"。
6 边界：若问 How did Gee help her family? 答 By spotting the "HELP" sign on the aerial map and alerting the emergency services。若问 What did the Emergency Services post? 答 The incident on their Facebook page。
7 错误：A 只写 Hurricanes are dangerous.（错因：现象当启示）；B 只写 I am moved.（错因：无道理）；C 答 We should not use maps.（错因：与原文相反）。
8 规则：R85.5 若问 What lesson can you learn from this story，then 先给道理（technology can save lives／quick action and cooperation matter），再用事件链（map→spot→alert→dispatch）作解释；现象（hurricane）与纯情绪不作启示。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.5 启示类；复用 R75.5（启示＝道理＋自用），本条解释部分用事件链。
10 自检：①道理是什么？②我用事件链解释了吗？③我只写了"飓风可怕"吗？

**组小结（G85 · 小蓝书预测卷十二 Passage Three）**
- 考点分布：使用目的 1（26）；限定人群 1（27）；拼字施动者 1（28）；搭配词义（dispatched）1（29）；启示 1（30）。
- 规则：R85.1 use…to do 取目的（26）；R85.2 限定人群取 those impacted（27）；R85.3 施动者按去留（28）；R85.4 dispatched＝派出（29）；R85.5 启示＝道理＋事件链（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R85.1 与"HELP 戏剧化"冲突，to do 优先；R85.2 与"Gee 是主角"冲突，限定人群优先；R85.3 与"发现者最强"冲突，去留分流优先；R85.4 与"同句 contacted"冲突，宾搭配优先；R85.5 与"事件精彩"冲突，道理优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：灾害新闻类首见；本组"目的—人群—施动者—词义—启示"五层齐全，其中"发现者 vs 拼字者"是 04 的好样本；数字（H-E-L-L-P／$200 见前篇）无换算，**本组无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十二 · Passage Four

Having established himself as one of the greatest magicians over the last three decades, David Copperfield remains hailed by audiences and critics because his magic still leaves most puzzles unsolved — not only for ordinary people but counterparts in the field of illusion (错觉). He believes he's remained at the top because of an undiminished passion for magic. "I'm among the few who are lucky enough to know what they want to do at early age," he said.

Copperfield discovered an interest in magic at the age of 8 when he learned some simple tricks from his parents who were both magicians. "When I showed those tricks to other kids, I found they all liked them very much, and they thought I was great. This made me very willing to learn new magic," he recalled. "Such a feeling still supports me now. I like to see the audiences become amazed and go crazy for my performance."

He began performing professionally at the age of 12 and became the youngest person to be admitted to the Society of American Magicians. By 16, he was teaching a course in magic at New York University. He was among the first magicians to pioneer the TV spectacular, helping boost the appeal for the craft (职业) worldwide.

His love for magic also turned him from a shy, timid boy to a risk-taker prepared to challenge limits. "Magic provides me a channel to express myself, just like singers through their songs and poets through poems," he said, "And I think everyone needs to dream. Magic offers me the chance to make true my dreams and those of other people."

Now 68, Copperfield has no thought of retiring from his beloved career. "I really enjoy what I'm doing. I enjoy the process of creating and sharing my creation with others. I dream that my career will last forever. Dreams aren't a matter of chance, but a matter of choice."

35. How does Copperfield's story inspire you?
