**〔G86〕小蓝书预测卷十二 · Passage Four（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：Because his magic still leaves most puzzles unsolved, and because of his undiminished passion for magic.**
1 题面：What makes David Copperfield one of the greatest magicians for decades；原文 "David Copperfield remains hailed by audiences and critics because his magic still leaves most puzzles unsolved — not only for ordinary people but counterparts in the field of illusion (错觉). He believes he's remained at the top because of an undiminished passion for magic."；疑问词 What makes sb one of the greatest（问原因）；诱导信号：首句 having established himself…over the last three decades 是时间背景。
2 候选：①puzzles unsolved＋undiminished passion；②he is 68／lucky；③his parents were magicians；④he teaches at NYU。
3 验算：①→because his magic still leaves most puzzles unsolved＋because of an undiminished passion，两处 because 同向→成立（两条都写）。②→年龄与运气原文未作原因→排除。③→父母是魔术师是他"接触魔术"的原因，不是"长盛不衰"的原因→次优。④→16 岁任教是里程碑，不是原因→排除。
4 干扰：I'm among the few who are lucky enough 里的 lucky 容易被当成原因；父母身份也像"家学渊源"。
5 意图：考"原因取两处 because（谜题未解＋热情不减），lucky／家世不作原因"。
6 边界：若问 What did he learn from his parents? 答 Some simple magic tricks。若问 When did he begin performing professionally? 答 At the age of 12。
7 错误：A 答 He is lucky.（错因：引语中的自谦当原因）；B 答 His parents were magicians.（错因：接触原因）；C 答 He is old.（错因：年龄）。
8 规则：R86.1 若问 What makes sb one of the greatest／keeps sb at the top，then 取 because 与 because of 两处（puzzles unsolved＋undiminished passion）；lucky、家世（parents were magicians）与年龄都只解释"接触／背景"，不作长盛原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（双 because）；复用 R34.2（举证取全），本条是"双原因"。
10 自检：①两处 because 各是什么？②lucky 能用吗？③父母是哪种原因？

**32. 答案：At 8 he learned some simple tricks from his parents, and when he showed them to other kids they liked them and thought he was great, which made him willing to learn more.**
1 题面：How did David Copperfield discover an interest in magic at an early age；原文 "Copperfield discovered an interest in magic at the age of 8 when he learned some simple tricks from his parents who were both magicians. 'When I showed those tricks to other kids, I found they all liked them very much, and they thought I was great. This made me very willing to learn new magic,' he recalled."；疑问词 How did sb discover an interest（问起因链）；诱导信号：at the age of 8 只是时间，两环起因在后。
2 候选：①8 岁从父母学简单戏法＋给同伴表演获赞→愿意学更多；②he was born a magician；③he watched a TV show；④his parents forced him。
3 验算：①→learned some simple tricks from his parents＋showed those tricks to other kids…they liked them…made me willing to learn new magic，两环→成立。②→原文无天生→排除。③→TV spectacular 是他的创新（后来），不是起因→排除。④→parents 是教他戏法，不是逼迫→不成立。
4 干扰：parents who were both magicians 的家世感强；This made me very willing 的"这个"需要还原为"同伴的赞美"。
5 意图：考"起因链两环：家中学戏法→同伴称赞→愿意学"。
6 边界：若问 What did other kids think of his tricks? 答 They liked them very much and thought he was great。若问 How old was he when he discovered the interest? 答 Eight。
7 错误：A 答 His parents forced him to learn.（错因：与 willing 相反）；B 答 He watched TV.（错因：无据）；C 答 He was born with magic talent.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R86.2 若问 How did sb discover an interest at an early age，then 取两环（从父母学简单戏法→给同伴表演获赞→愿意学更多），This 指代"同伴的称赞"须还原；家世（parents were magicians）只作背景，逼迫／天赋不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（起因链）；复用 R82.2（情感词由结果句定），本条是"兴趣的两环起因"。
10 自检：①两环各是什么？②This 指什么？③父母是逼迫吗？

**33. 答案：It is mainly about Copperfield's professional career milestones — he began performing professionally at 12, became the youngest person admitted to the Society of American Magicians, taught magic at New York University at 16, and pioneered the TV spectacular.**
1 题面：What is mainly talked about in the third paragraph；该段原文 "He began performing professionally at the age of 12 and became the youngest person to be admitted to the Society of American Magicians. By 16, he was teaching a course in magic at New York University. He was among the first magicians to pioneer the TV spectacular, helping boost the appeal for the craft (职业) worldwide."；疑问词 What is mainly talked about in Paragraph N（问段意）；诱导信号：上一段讲 8 岁起因、下一段讲性格转变，容易串。
2 候选：①职业里程碑（12 岁职业表演／最年轻会员／16 岁任教／开创电视魔术秀）；②他 8 岁的兴趣；③他从害羞到冒险的性格转变；④他的退休计划。
3 验算：①→四件事都是"职业成就与时间节点"，且段内无其他主题→成立（列 2—3 件即可）。②→8 岁在上一段→排除。③→shy, timid boy to a risk-taker 在下一段→排除。④→退休在末段（no thought of retiring）→排除。
4 干扰：段内专名与数字密集（12／16／Society of American Magicians／New York University／TV spectacular），容易只写一件；年龄数字与"最年轻"也易混。
5 意图：考"段意＝同段的多个里程碑的概括，不串段"。
6 边界：若问 When did he become the youngest member of the Society? 答 At 12（began performing professionally at 12 and became the youngest person to be admitted）。若问 What did he pioneer? 答 The TV spectacular。
7 错误：A 答 His interest at 8.（错因：串上段）；B 答 His shy character.（错因：串下段）；C 答 His retirement.（错因：串末段）。
8 规则：R86.3 若问 What is mainly talked about in Paragraph N，then 概括该段的多项里程碑（12 岁职业表演／最年轻会员／16 岁任教／电视魔术秀），列 2—3 件；上段（8 岁起因）、下段（性格转变）、末段（退休）按段落边界排除。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.2 段意概括（里程碑型）；复用 R82.3（段意取首句＋段末），本条以"时间＋事件"列举为段意。
10 自检：①本段有几件事？②8 岁在哪段？③退休在哪段？

**34. 答案：It means "praised" or "acclaimed" — audiences and critics speak highly of him.（受到赞扬、被誉为）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "hailed" mean in paragraph 1；原文 "Having established himself as one of the greatest magicians over the last three decades, David Copperfield remains hailed by audiences and critics because his magic still leaves most puzzles unsolved…"；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 mean（词义题）；诱导信号：hail 的常见义"冰雹／欢呼"。
2 候选：①praised／acclaimed；②criticized；③ignored；④hired。
3 验算：①→remains hailed by audiences and critics＋one of the greatest magicians，正面语境→成立。②→criticized 与"最伟大之一"相反→不成立。③→ignored 与 remains hailed（持续被称颂）相反→排除。④→hired 需雇主，by audiences and critics 不搭→排除。
4 干扰：hail 作名词"冰雹"最常见；hail a taxi（叫车）义也可能被套成"叫来"。
5 意图：考"hail 作动词被动式（be hailed by）取'受赞扬'，不取天气义／叫车义"。
6 边界：若问 Who hails Copperfield? 答 Audiences and critics。若问 Why does he remain at the top? 答 Because of his undiminished passion（and unsolved puzzles）。
7 错误：A 答 Criticized.（错因：反义）；B 答 Called a taxi.（错因：hail a taxi 义）；C 答 Hit by hail.（错因：天气义）。
8 规则：R86.4 若划线词为多义动词的被动式（be hailed by＋人），then 取"受赞扬／被誉为"义；天气义（冰雹）与"叫车"义不取，反义（criticized）排除。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（多义动词被动式）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（be hailed by audiences）→语境（one of the greatest）→语域（演艺评论）→词面义（冰雹／叫车）。
10 自检：①by 后是谁？②语境是褒还是贬？③我取了"冰雹"吗？

**35. 答案：（开放题）His story inspires me to keep the passion for what I love. He discovered magic at 8, kept performing and creating for decades, and still says that dreams are a matter of choice, so I should choose my dream and keep working on it instead of waiting for chances.**
1 题面：How does Copperfield's story inspire you?——启示；可用依据：undiminished passion for magic／I'm among the few who are lucky enough to know what they want to do at early age／Magic offers me the chance to make true my dreams／Dreams aren't a matter of chance, but a matter of choice／enjoys the process of creating and sharing。
2 候选：①保持热情＋梦想是选择（道理＋自用）；②只写 I am moved；③复述他的成就；④写"我也想当魔术师"（跑题）。
3 验算：①→道理（passion／dreams are a matter of choice）＋自用（choose and keep working）→成立。②→只有情绪→不成立。③→复述不是"inspire you"→排除。④→职业模仿，非启示→次优。
4 干扰：Dreams aren't a matter of chance, but a matter of choice 是最亮的一句，直接抄会缺"我"；"lucky enough to know early" 也可能被误读成"靠运气"。
5 意图：考"启示＝道理＋自用"，并正确理解"dreams are a choice"（反 chance）。
6 边界：若问 What does Copperfield think of dreams? 答 Dreams aren't a matter of chance, but a matter of choice。若问 Why does he keep working at 68? 答 Because he enjoys what he is doing and the process of creating and sharing。
7 错误：A 只写 I am moved.（错因：漏道理）；B 抄 "Dreams aren't a matter of chance"（错因：未落到自己）；C 答 He is lucky.（错因：与 choice 相反）。
8 规则：R86.5 若问 How does sb's story inspire you，then 先给道理（keep the passion／dreams are a matter of choice），再说自己会怎么做（choose and keep working）；只写 moved、只抄金句或模仿职业都不合格；注意"lucky"在原文是自谦，不可当结论。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.5 启示类；复用 R82.5（启示＝道理＋自用），本条金句含"chance vs choice"对比。
10 自检：①道理是哪句？②我说了自己怎么做吗？③我把 lucky 当结论了吗？

**组小结（G86 · 小蓝书预测卷十二 Passage Four）**
- 考点分布：长盛原因（双 because）1（31）；兴趣起因链 1（32）；段意（里程碑）1（33）；多义动词词义（hailed）1（34）；启示 1（35）。
- 规则：R86.1 双 because 取全（31）；R86.2 兴趣两环起因（32）；R86.3 段意取里程碑（33）；R86.4 hailed＝praised（34）；R86.5 启示＝道理＋自用（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R86.1 与"lucky 在引语里"冲突，because 优先；R86.2 与"家世感强"冲突，起因链优先；R86.3 与"专名数字密"冲突，段落边界优先；R86.4 与"hail 冰雹义"冲突，搭配优先；R86.5 与"金句好抄"冲突，自用优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：名人传记类第 5 篇（G42／G48／G54／G61／本条）；本篇"lucky＝自谦、choice＝主张"的对比是 04 的好样本；数字（three decades／8／12／16／68）均照录，**无换算、无推算**；**小蓝书卷十二 4 篇至此完成（G83—G86）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十五 · Passage One

We would all love to learn how to be happy. And sometimes, the solution comes from a surprising place.

During his fieldwork in a remote African village, an anthropologist (人类学家) had



devoted himself to studying the unique habits and culture of the local tribe（部落）. He had been working in the village for quite some time and on the day before his scheduled return home, he composed a gift—a basket full of delightful fruits from the area, wrapped thoughtfully in a piece of cloth. He placed this offering beneath a tree and then gathered the village children around.

The man drew a line in the dirt, looked at the children, and said, "As soon as I signal to start, run to the tree; the first to arrive will claim the basket of fruits." However, when he signaled, instead of racing against each other, the children joined hands and ran together to the tree. Then They settled around the basket and enjoyed their treat as a group.

Bewildered by their act of unity, the anthropologist asked why they chose to run collectively when any one of them could have seized all the fruits. A young girl looked up at him and said innocently, "How can one of us be happy if all the other ones are sad?"

Years later, Desmond Tutu, the well -known South African activist, remembered how a girl once thought about things in a simple yet deep way. He used the word "ubuntu" to describe her thinking. "Ubuntu" means "I exist because we all do." In other words, we are who we are because of our relationships with others. For that tribe, to be human is to relate with and through others. They think that our happiness comes from the union of our joys and the meaningful impact they have on the community.

16. What gift did the anthropologist prepared?

______

17. How did the children reach the tree?

______

18. What does the underlined word "bewildered" probably mean in Paragraph 4?

______

19. Where does the happiness of this tribe come from?

______

20. Do you agree with the tribe's belief about happiness? Please give your reason (s).

______

**〔G87〕小蓝书预测卷十五 · Passage One（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：A basket full of delightful fruits (from the area), wrapped in a piece of cloth.**
1 题面：What gift did the anthropologist prepared?（原题 prepared 用过去式形式，照抄）；原文 "he composed a gift—a basket full of delightful fruits from the area, wrapped thoughtfully in a piece of cloth."；疑问词 What gift（问礼物内容）；诱导信号：下一句 He placed this offering beneath a tree 里的 offering 是回指。
2 候选：①a basket of delightful fruits（wrapped in cloth）；②a tree；③a piece of cloth；④a line in the dirt。
3 验算：①→a basket full of delightful fruits from the area, wrapped…in a piece of cloth，破折号后即礼物内容→成立（可补包装）。②→tree 是放置地点→排除。③→cloth 是包装材料→次优。④→line 是比赛起点线→排除。
4 干扰：a piece of cloth 与 wrapped thoughtfully 靠得近，容易被当礼物；offering 一词也抽象。
5 意图：考"礼物取破折号后的名词短语，地点与包装不作礼物"。
6 边界：若问 Where did he place the gift? 答 Beneath a tree。若问 What did he ask the children to do? 答 To run to the tree when he signaled。
7 错误：A 答 A piece of cloth.（错因：包装当礼物）；B 答 A tree.（错因：地点）；C 答 A basket of money.（错因：无据改写）。
8 规则：R87.1 若问 What gift did sb prepare，then 取 gift／offering 后破折号或同位语的名词短语（a basket of fruits），包装（cloth）与放置地点（tree）只作补充。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.15 宾语取词；复用 R47.2（清单取项），本条是"同位语取礼物"。
10 自检：①破折号后是什么？②cloth 是什么？③tree 是地点吗？

**17. 答案：They joined hands and ran together to the tree (instead of racing against each other).**
1 题面：How did the children reach the tree；原文 "However, when he signaled, instead of racing against each other, the children joined hands and ran together to the tree."；疑问词 How（问方式）；诱导信号：前一句 the first to arrive will claim the basket 是规则，容易被当做法。
2 候选：①joined hands and ran together；②raced against each other；③the first one ran fastest；④walked slowly。
3 验算：①→instead of racing against each other, the children joined hands and ran together，instead of 排除前者、后者为实际做法→成立。②→被 instead of 明确否定→不成立。③→the first to arrive 是奖励规则，未发生→排除。④→walked slowly 与 ran 不符→排除。
4 干扰：the first to arrive will claim the basket 是全文最像"做法"的句子；instead of 结构也易只读前半。
5 意图：考"instead of A，B 取 B"，规则句不作事实。
6 边界：若问 What was the rule of the game? 答 The first to arrive would claim the basket of fruits。若问 What did they do after reaching the tree? 答 They settled around the basket and enjoyed their treat as a group。
7 错误：A 答 They raced against each other.（错因：被否定的做法）；B 答 The fastest child got the fruits.（错因：规则当事实）；C 答 They walked to the tree one by one.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R87.2 若问 How did sb do X 且原文用 instead of A，then 取 B 的实际做法（joined hands and ran together）；A（raced against each other）与未发生的规则（the first to arrive）不作事实。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（instead of 取后项）；复用 R44.3（Instead of 取 B），本条是"群体做法"。
10 自检：①instead of 前是什么？②实际做法是哪半？③规则句发生了吗？

**18. 答案：It means "confused" or "puzzled".（困惑的）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "bewildered" probably mean in Paragraph 4；原文 "Bewildered by their act of unity, the anthropologist asked why they chose to run collectively when any one of them could have seized all the fruits."；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 probably mean（词义题）；诱导信号：下文 asked why 是"不明白"的行为表现。
2 候选：①confused／puzzled；②angry；③moved；④amused。
3 验算：①→Bewildered by their act…asked why they chose to run collectively，因不解而发问→成立。②→angry 与 asked（求解释）不搭→排除。③→moved 会写成 was moved by，且不会追问"为什么"→次优。④→amused 与"追问原因"不符→排除。
4 干扰：act of unity 的正面色彩可能让人答"感动"；bewilder 的词根 wild（荒野）也可能被误读。
5 意图：考"情绪分词由后文行为（asked why）定'困惑'"。
6 边界：若问 Why did the anthropologist ask the question? 答 Because he was bewildered by their act of unity。若问 What did the girl answer? 答 "How can one of us be happy if all the other ones are sad?"
7 错误：A 答 Moved.（错因：正面色彩）；B 答 Angry.（错因：与追问不符）；C 答 Excited.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R87.3 若划线为情绪分词（Bewildered）且后文是"追问原因"，then 取 confused／puzzled；感动（moved）与生气（angry）不符合"求解释"的行为。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（情绪分词）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（bewildered by＋事）→后文（asked why）→语域（跨文化观察）→词面义。
10 自检：①后文他做了什么？②moved 会怎么写？③我答"生气"了吗？

**19. 答案：From the union of their joys and the meaningful impact they have on the community.**
1 题面：Where does the happiness of this tribe come from；原文 "They think that our happiness comes from the union of our joys and the meaningful impact they have on the community."；疑问词 Where does…come from（问来源）；诱导信号：同段前文有 ubuntu 的定义（I exist because we all do），像答案。
2 候选：①the union of their joys＋the meaningful impact on the community；②"I exist because we all do"（定义）；③relationships with others（同义转述）；④the basket of fruits。
3 验算：①→our happiness comes from the union of our joys and the meaningful impact…，comes from 后两项并列→成立（两条都写）。②→是 ubuntu 的字面定义，属上位理念→次优（可作解释，不替代来源句）。③→relationships 是 ubuntu 的另一种表述→次优。④→fruits 是故事道具→排除。
4 干扰：ubuntu 的定义句最醒目、最像"标准答案"；relationships 也很抽象正面。
5 意图：考"来源取 comes from 后的并列两项，定义句只作背景"。
6 边界：若问 What does "ubuntu" mean? 答 I exist because we all do（we are who we are because of our relationships with others）。若问 What did the girl say? 见 17 题边界。
7 错误：A 答 From the basket of fruits.（错因：道具）；B 只写 From relationships.（错因：同义转述、不够具体）；C 答 From winning the race.（错因：与全文相反）。
8 规则：R87.4 若问 Where does X come from，then 取 comes from 后的并列两项（the union of joys＋the meaningful impact on the community）；ubuntu 的定义（I exist because we all do）与抽象转述（relationships）只作背景。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 来源（并列两项）；复用 R70.2（两原因取全），本条是"来源"。
10 自检：①comes from 后有几项？②定义句能替代吗？③两条都写了吗？

**20. 答案：（开放题）Yes, I do. As the girl said, "How can one of us be happy if all the other ones are sad?" — our happiness is connected with the people around us, so I think sharing joys with others makes happiness more real and lasting.**
1 题面：Do you agree with the tribe's belief about happiness? Please give your reason (s).——表态＋理由；可用依据：joined hands and ran together／the girl's words／ubuntu＝I exist because we all do／happiness comes from the union of joys。
2 候选：①Yes＋理由（幸福与他人相连、分享更持久）；②No＋理由（个人幸福不必依赖他人）；③只写 Yes；④复述故事。
3 验算：①→表态明确，理由能落到原文（girl's words／union of joys）→成立。②→开放题允许，须给理由（如 individual goals matter），可作次优→次优。③→漏 reasons→不成立。④→复述故事不是"我是否同意"→排除。
4 干扰：题干 explicitly 要 reasons，只表态是常见失分；故事感人，容易写成叙述。
5 意图：考"表态＋理由"，并允许与部落观念不同的立场。
6 边界：若问 What is the tribe's belief? 答 That happiness comes from the union of joys and their impact on the community。若问 How did the children behave? 见 17 题。
7 错误：A 只写 Yes, I do.（错因：漏理由）；B 答 The children ran together.（错因：复述）；C 答 Because the tribe is poor.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R87.5 若问 Do you agree with sb's belief? Please give your reason(s)，then 先表态（Yes, I do.／No, I don't.），再给 1—2 条理由，优先引原文依据（girl's words／union of joys）；只表态或复述故事均不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.2 双问（表态＋理由）；复用 R62.5（表态＋理由），本条对象是"观念"。
10 自检：①我表态了吗？②理由引了哪句？③我复述故事了吗？

**组小结（G87 · 小蓝书预测卷十五 Passage One）**
- 考点分布：礼物取同位语 1（16）；instead of 取后项 1（17）；情绪分词词义 1（18）；来源两项 1（19）；观念表态 1（20）。
- 规则：R87.1 礼物取名词短语（16）；R87.2 instead of 取 B（17）；R87.3 bewilder＝困惑（18）；R87.4 来源取两项（19）；R87.5 表态＋理由（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R87.1 与"cloth 紧邻"冲突，礼物核心优先；R87.2 与"规则句最像做法"冲突，instead of 后项优先；R87.3 与"act of unity 正面"冲突，追问行为优先；R87.4 与"ubuntu 定义最醒目"冲突，comes from 句优先；R87.5 与"故事感人"冲突，表态优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：跨文化寓言首见（ubuntu）；本篇"定义句 vs 来源句 vs 故事道具"三层分明，是 04 的哲学类样本；数字（a basket／a piece of cloth）无换算，**本组无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十五 · Passage Two

When I think of the hardest moments of my life, ironically many have turned out to be blessings. The most severe one was being pretty much kicked out of my PhD program at the University of Georgia in 2016.



The program in Georgia turned out not to be the right fit for me despite my best efforts. The whole year was riddled with exhaustion, insecurity, fear, and exclusion. I was in therapy myself for most of the year to cope, and the only thing that made it tolerable was a lot of support from my family and friends.

I was utterly devastated when I went back home; it felt like my career was over. Fast forward to today, however, and I can see that getting driven out of the Georgia program was one of the best things that ever happened to me. In 2017, when I transferred to a doctoral program in San Diego, I began to thrive and now my business is doing exceptionally well. I am deeply grateful I studied in San Diego and happy that I didn't stay in Georgia. It was great that I was driven out! As the saying goes, "What seems like good or bad news now can turn out to be the opposite in the future."

Ironically, the research and writing training from the University of Georgia significantly helped me develop my academic, professional, and personal writing. I worked hard in Georgia and it paid off: The learning and growth I experienced were incomparable.

As my personal example demonstrates, life is a total roller coaster（过山车）. Every now and then you are able to discover a new high, a ceiling-breaking moment, whereas in other moments you may feel like you're falling deeper and deeper into hell. While these experiences can be incredibly tough, they present us with valuable opportunities to trust life and cultivate personal growth and learning.

21. What was the author's most severe moment of his life?

______

22. How was the year at Georgia according to the author?

______

23. What message does the author want to convey with his personal experience in the 3rd paragraph?

______

24. Why did the author thank the University of Georgia?

______

25. What will you do if you are in a dark moment? Please explain.

______

**〔G88〕小蓝书预测卷十五 · Passage Two（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：Being (pretty much) kicked out of his PhD program at the University of Georgia in 2016.**
1 题面：What was the author's most severe moment of his life；原文 "When I think of the hardest moments of my life, ironically many have turned out to be blessings. The most severe one was being pretty much kicked out of my PhD program at the University of Georgia in 2016."；疑问词 What was the most severe moment（问事件）；诱导信号：下一段 The whole year was riddled with… 是过程描述。
2 候选：①being kicked out of the PhD program（2016）；②the whole year at Georgia；③transferring to San Diego；④his business doing well。
3 验算：①→The most severe one was being pretty much kicked out of my PhD program，表语直接给出→成立。②→The whole year was riddled with… 是这一年怎么过的，不是"最严重时刻"本身→次优。③→转学是后文转机→排除。④→生意是现在的成功→排除。
4 干扰：The whole year was riddled with exhaustion 描述更具体、篇幅更长；ironically 的反讽语气也可能让人找错重点。
5 意图：考"最严重时刻取 The most severe one was 后的表语，过程描述不作事件"。
6 边界：若问 Where was the author's PhD program? 答 At the University of Georgia。若问 When was he kicked out? 答 In 2016。
7 错误：A 答 The whole year at Georgia.（错因：过程当事件）；B 答 Transferring to San Diego.（错因：转机）；C 答 Losing his business.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R88.1 若问 What was sb's most severe／hardest moment，then 取 The most severe one was 后的表语（being kicked out of the program）；同一段的过程描述（the whole year was riddled with…）与后来的转机都不作事件。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.40 事件核（事件 vs 过程）；复用 R31.1（结论性事件），本条是"最严重时刻"。
10 自检：①表语是什么？②the whole year 属哪一层？③转学是转机吗？

**22. 答案：It was riddled with exhaustion, insecurity, fear and exclusion — it was not the right fit for him.**
1 题面：How was the year at Georgia according to the author；原文 "The program in Georgia turned out not to be the right fit for me despite my best efforts. The whole year was riddled with exhaustion, insecurity, fear, and exclusion."；疑问词 How was the year（问状况）；诱导信号：下一句 I was in therapy 是应对方式。
2 候选：①riddled with exhaustion／insecurity／fear／exclusion（not the right fit）；②wonderful and productive；③the right fit for him；④full of support。
3 验算：①→not to be the right fit＋was riddled with exhaustion, insecurity, fear, and exclusion，两句同向→成立（至少写两项）。②→与 not the right fit 相反→不成立。③→原文说 not the right fit→排除。④→support 来自家人朋友，不是"这一年"的状况→次优。
4 干扰：the only thing that made it tolerable was a lot of support 里的 support 也像答案；despite my best efforts 可能被误读成"很努力所以不错"。
5 意图：考"状况取 riddled with 后四项（至少两项）＋not the right fit"。
6 边界：若问 Why was the program hard for him? 答 Because it was not the right fit（and he felt exhausted, insecure, fearful and excluded）。若问 What helped him through the year? 答 Therapy and support from family and friends。
7 错误：A 答 Wonderful.（错因：与原文相反）；B 答 Full of support only.（错因：support 是外部、不是这一年状况）；C 答 It was the right fit.（错因：not 漏读）。
8 规则：R88.2 若问 How was the year／period，then 取 riddled with 后的负面并列项（exhaustion／insecurity／fear／exclusion）并与 not the right fit 合并；外部支持（family and friends）与"努力"不作状况。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.13 情绪／状况（并列取项）；复用 R45.1（清单取全），本条是负面清单。
10 自检：①riddled with 后有几项？②support 来自谁？③not 丢了吗？

**23. 答案：He wants to convey that what seems like good or bad news now can turn out to be the opposite in the future — a setback can become a blessing.**
1 题面：What message does the author want to convey with his personal experience in the 3rd paragraph；第 3 段原文 "Fast forward to today, however, and I can see that getting driven out of the Georgia program was one of the best things that ever happened to me… As the saying goes, 'What seems like good or bad news now can turn out to be the opposite in the future.'"；疑问词 What message（问寓意）；诱导信号：段中间写了他转学、生意好等事实。
2 候选：①坏事可能变好事（引语）；②他转学到了圣地亚哥；③他的生意做得很好；④Georgia 项目不好。
3 验算：①→As the saying goes, "What seems like good or bad news now can turn out to be the opposite in the future."，As the saying goes 直接标记寓意→成立。②③→是支撑事实→次优。④→是对项目的评价，不是"想传达的信息"→排除。
4 干扰：事实部分（transferred／business doing well）篇幅更长；It was great that I was driven out! 情绪强烈，也像寓意。
5 意图：考"寓意取 As the saying goes 引出的格言，事实只作例证"。
6 边界：若问 What does the author think of being driven out now? 答 It was one of the best things that ever happened to him。若问 Where did he transfer to? 答 A doctoral program in San Diego（2017）。
7 错误：A 答 He transferred to San Diego.（错因：事实当寓意）；B 答 Georgia was a bad school.（错因：评价当寓意）；C 答 He regrets being kicked out.（错因：与 grateful 相反）。
8 规则：R88.3 若问 What message does sb want to convey，then 取段内 As the saying goes／In other words 引出的格言（good or bad news can turn out to be the opposite）；转学、生意等事实只作例证。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.19 寓意（格言式）；复用 R81.4（寓意取标记句），本条标记是 As the saying goes。
10 自检：①格言句在哪？②转学是事实还是寓意？③我写"Georgia 不好"了吗？

**24. 答案：Because the research and writing training at the University of Georgia significantly helped him develop his academic, professional and personal writing.**
1 题面：Why did the author thank the University of Georgia；原文 "Ironically, the research and writing training from the University of Georgia significantly helped me develop my academic, professional, and personal writing. I worked hard in Georgia and it paid off: The learning and growth I experienced were incomparable."；疑问词 Why did sb thank（问原因）；诱导信号：首段被 Georgia 项目"赶出来"的负面叙述，容易让人以为他恨这所学校。
2 候选：①research and writing training helped his writing；②because he got his PhD there；③because the program was a good fit；④because he met his family there。
3 验算：①→the research and writing training from…significantly helped me develop my academic, professional, and personal writing，原因直接给出→成立（可补 learning and growth were incomparable）。②→他在 Georgia 被赶出项目，未获学位→不成立。③→原文说 not the right fit→排除。④→家人支持是另一回事→排除。
4 干扰：Ironically 一词提示"看似矛盾"，但不改变原因；worked hard…paid off 也可能被当原因。
5 意图：考"原因取 helped me develop 句，并用 Ironically 理解反常识"。
6 边界：若问 What did he gain from Georgia? 答 Research and writing training（learning and growth）。若问 Was the Georgia program a good fit? 答 No, it was not the right fit for him。
7 错误：A 答 Because he graduated there.（错因：与 kicked out 矛盾）；B 答 Because it was a good fit.（错因：与 not the right fit 相反）；C 答 Because it was cheap.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R88.4 若问 Why did sb thank a place where sth bad happened，then 取 helped me develop 句（research and writing training），并用 Ironically 提示"坏事中的收获"；毕业、适合、费用等无据理由不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（反常识原因）；复用 R62.3（排除被否定项），本条是"感谢否定过他的机构"。
10 自检：①helped 后是什么？②他毕业了吗？③not the right fit 说明什么？

**25. 答案：（开放题）If I am in a dark moment, I will first accept it and ask my family and friends for support, as the author did, and then keep learning from it — because a setback may turn out to be a blessing later.**
1 题面：What will you do if you are in a dark moment? Please explain.——做法＋解释；可用依据：I was in therapy myself…the only thing that made it tolerable was support from family and friends／life is a total roller coaster／these experiences present us with valuable opportunities to trust life and cultivate personal growth and learning。
2 候选：①接受＋求助＋继续学习（并说明理由）；②只写 I will be sad；③写"放弃"；④复述作者经历。
3 验算：①→三步做法＋理由（a setback may be a blessing）→成立。②→只有情绪无做法→不成立。③→与原文主旨相反且无理由→次优。④→复述不是"我会怎么做"→排除。
4 干扰：原文的 roller coaster 比喻很生动，容易只写"人生像过山车"；题干要求 will do，须落到行动。
5 意图：考"做法＋解释"，并要求把原文启示转成自身行动。
6 边界：若问 What does the author compare life to? 答 A roller coaster。若问 What can tough experiences bring us? 答 Valuable opportunities to trust life and cultivate personal growth and learning。
7 错误：A 只写 I will feel sad.（错因：无做法）；B 答 I will give up.（错因：与主旨相反）；C 答 Life is a roller coaster.（错因：比喻不作做法）。
8 规则：R88.5 若问 What will you do if you are in a dark moment，then 给 1—2 条具体做法（accept／seek support／keep learning）＋一句解释（setback may be a blessing）；只写情绪、比喻或复述作者经历均不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.5 启示类（做法型）；复用 R64.5（做法取 We should），本条主语是"我"。
10 自检：①我给了几条做法？②有解释吗？③我只写了"难过"吗？

**组小结（G88 · 小蓝书预测卷十五 Passage Two）**
- 考点分布：最严重时刻 1（21）；这一年状况 1（22）；段落寓意 1（23）；感谢原因 1（24）；黑暗时刻做法 1（25）。
- 规则：R88.1 事件 vs 过程（21）；R88.2 状况取负面并列（22）；R88.3 寓意取 As the saying goes（23）；R88.4 反常识原因取 helped 句（24）；R88.5 做法＋解释（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R88.1 与"这一年描述更长"冲突，表语优先；R88.2 与"support 也在文中"冲突，状况句优先；R88.3 与"转学事实"冲突，格言优先；R88.4 与"被赶出的负面"冲突，Ironically 后句优先；R88.5 与"过山车比喻"冲突，做法优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：挫折—转机自述首见；"Ironically 反常识感谢"是 04 的好样本；数字（2016／2017）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十五 · Passage Three

Have you ever gotten stung by a bee? Well, for 18-year-old Mikaila Ulmer from the US,



her first bee sting at the age of 4 was a special experience. It inspired her to make a difference and turned her into an entrepreneur.

The bee sting scared Mikaila, but it also made her interested in the insect. She soon learned how important bees are for the planet and how they are at risk of dying out.

At not even 5 years old, Mikaila wanted to do something to help save the bees. With her parents' help, she set up a lemonade stand in her front yard. She used her grandmother's homemade lemonade recipe and added a little bit of honey to it. The money from every lemonade she sold went to bee protection groups.

But Mikaila wanted to do more. She made her special recipe into a product, called *Me and the Bees Lemonade*. At age 10, she went on a TV show with her dad to try to get funding and public attention. It worked. Now, more than 10 years since her first lemonade, five different drink products are procurable at many restaurants and stores across the country.

In 2020, Mikaila brought out a book about her experience as an entrepreneur called Bee Fearless, Dream Like a Kid. As she explained to CNBC, "I always say that it's important to dream like a kid and that (as a kid) it's the perfect age to start figuring out what you enjoy and trying new things and taking risks."

26. What did Mikaila want to do after she was first stung by a bee?

______

27. How did Mikaila make money at age 5?

______

28. What does the underlined word "procurable" in Para. 4 mean?

______

29. What is Bee Fearless, Dream Like a Kid?

______

30. What do you think of Mikaila? And give your reasons.

______

**〔G89〕小蓝书预测卷十五 · Passage Three（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：She wanted to do something to help save the bees.**
1 题面：What did Mikaila want to do after she was first stung by a bee；原文 "The bee sting scared Mikaila, but it also made her interested in the insect. She soon learned how important bees are for the planet and how they are at risk of dying out. At not even 5 years old, Mikaila wanted to do something to help save the bees."；疑问词 What did sb want to do（问意愿）；诱导信号：scared 就在前一段，情绪强。
2 候选：①to do something to help save the bees；②to avoid bees forever；③to become a beekeeper；④to sell honey。
3 验算：①→Mikaila wanted to do something to help save the bees，want to do 后直接给出→成立。②→与"对蜜蜂产生兴趣"相反→不成立。③→beekeeper 原文无（她做柠檬水）→排除。④→卖蜂蜜是原料，不是目标→次优。
4 干扰：scared 与 interested 并列在一句，情绪词容易被当动机；not even 5 years old 的年龄也抢注意。
5 意图：考"意愿取 want to do 后的目的（help save the bees），情绪反应不作动机"。
6 边界：若问 How did the bee sting affect her? 答 It scared her but made her interested in bees。若问 What did she learn about bees? 答 How important they are and that they are at risk of dying out。
7 错误：A 答 To stay away from bees.（错因：恐惧当动机）；B 答 To become a scientist.（错因：无据）；C 答 To keep bees at home.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R89.1 若问 What did sb want to do after an incident，then 取 want to do 后的目的短语（help save the bees）；事件中的情绪（scared）只作反应，不作动机；年龄（not even 5）只作背景。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 目的（want to do）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条情绪与目的分层。
10 自检：①want to do 后是什么？②scared 是动机吗？③她做的是什么生意？

**27. 答案：By setting up a lemonade stand in her front yard — she used her grandmother's homemade lemonade recipe with a little honey, and the money went to bee protection groups.**
1 题面：How did Mikaila make money at age 5；原文 "At not even 5 years old…With her parents' help, she set up a lemonade stand in her front yard. She used her grandmother's homemade lemonade recipe and added a little bit of honey to it. The money from every lemonade she sold went to bee protection groups."；疑问词 How did sb make money（问方式）；诱导信号：后段 At age 10, she went on a TV show… 是另一个年龄段。
2 候选：①set up a lemonade stand（grandmother's recipe＋honey）；②went on a TV show（10 岁）；③sold five drink products（现在）；④borrowed money from parents。
3 验算：①→set up a lemonade stand in her front yard＋recipe＋honey，与 at not even 5 years old 对应→成立（可补"收入捐给蜜蜂保护组织"）。②→At age 10 才上电视，时点错→不成立。③→five different drink products 是现在的事业规模→排除。④→父母是帮忙，不是资金来源→排除。
4 干扰：TV show 与 five products 都是"赚钱"的高光时刻；题干 at age 5 是时间闸门。
5 意图：考"方式按时点取（5 岁摆摊 vs 10 岁上电视 vs 现在五款产品）"。
6 边界：若问 Where did she set up the stand? 答 In her front yard。若问 Where did the money go? 答 To bee protection groups。
7 错误：A 答 By going on a TV show.（错因：10 岁的事）；B 答 By selling five drink products.（错因：现在）；C 答 By asking her parents for money.（错因：父母是帮忙）。
8 规则：R89.2 若问 How did sb make money at age N，then 只取该年龄段的做法（set up a lemonade stand，用祖母配方加蜂蜜）；后一年龄段（TV show）与现在规模（five products）按时点排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（时点限定）；复用 R69.2（时点截断），本条是"创业阶段"。
10 自检：①5 岁做了什么？②TV show 是几岁？③收入去了哪？

**28. 答案：It means "available" — they can be bought at many restaurants and stores.（可买到的）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "procurable" in Para. 4 mean；原文 "Now, more than 10 years since her first lemonade, five different drink products are procurable at many restaurants and stores across the country."；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 mean（词义题）；诱导信号：procure 的词根（取得）与 product 同现。
2 候选：①available／can be bought；②expensive；③delicious；④popular。
3 验算：①→five drink products are procurable at many restaurants and stores，与"在店里能买到"对应→成立。②→原文未提价格→排除。③→delicious 是口感，与"在店里"无关→排除。④→popular 是结果，且 procurable 讲的是"可获得"→次优。
4 干扰：popular 与全文"成功"基调一致；product 一词也可能让人答"生产的"。
5 意图：考"形容词按地点状语（at many restaurants and stores）定'可买到'"。
6 边界：若问 How many drink products are there now? 答 Five。若问 Where can people buy them? 答 At many restaurants and stores across the country。
7 错误：A 答 Popular.（错因：结果当词义）；B 答 Expensive.（错因：无据）；C 答 Homemade.（错因：与"店里卖"相反）。
8 规则：R89.3 若划线形容词后接"地点／渠道"状语（at many restaurants and stores），then 取"可买到／可获得"义；popular／expensive／delicious 等评价不作词义。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（上下文定值）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（be procurable at）→地点状语→语域（产品铺货）→词面义。
10 自检：①后接什么状语？②popular 能取吗？③我译成"生产的"了吗？

**29. 答案：It is a book about her experience as an entrepreneur (brought out in 2020).**
1 题面：What is Bee Fearless, Dream Like a Kid；原文 "In 2020, Mikaila brought out a book about her experience as an entrepreneur called Bee Fearless, Dream Like a Kid."；疑问词 What is X（问事物性质）；诱导信号：同段还有 TV show 与 five drink products 两类事物。
2 候选：①a book about her experience as an entrepreneur；②a TV show；③a drink product；④a lemonade recipe。
3 验算：①→brought out a book about her experience as an entrepreneur called…，book＋called 后为书名→成立（可补 2020 年）。②→TV show 是 10 岁参加的活动（went on a TV show），不是这本书→排除。③→drink products 是产品线→排除。④→recipe 是祖母的配方→排除。
4 干扰：书名像口号，容易被当成"节目名"；brought out 也可指"推出产品"，须靠 book 一词定性质。
5 意图：考"called 前的中心名词（a book）定性质，书名只是标识"。
6 边界：若问 When did she bring out the book? 答 In 2020。若问 What did she say in the book／to CNBC? 答 It's important to dream like a kid and it's the perfect age to try new things and take risks。
7 错误：A 答 A TV show.（错因：串事）；B 答 A drink.（错因：串物）；C 答 A song.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R89.4 若问 What is X（专名）且原文有 brought out a book called X，then 取 called 前的中心名词（a book about her experience）；同名事物（TV show／product）按中心名词排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.27 定义（中心名词）；复用 R57.1（专名取 called 后），本条反向：靠 called 前的中心名词定性。
10 自检：①called 前是什么名词？②TV show 在哪句？③年份是多少？

**30. 答案：（开放题）I think Mikaila is kind, creative and brave. She started a lemonade stand at five to help save the bees and gave the money to bee protection groups, turned her recipe into a product, and went on TV at ten to get support for it.**
1 题面：What do you think of Mikaila? And give your reasons.——评价＋理由；可用依据：wanted to do something to help save the bees／set up a lemonade stand／money went to bee protection groups／turned her recipe into a product／went on a TV show at 10 to get funding／wrote a book to encourage kids to dream。
2 候选：①kind／creative／brave＋行为；②she is lucky；③she is a child（身份）；④只写 She is great。
3 验算：①→三个品质词各有行为（捐钱保护蜜蜂＝kind；配方变产品＝creative；上电视筹资、写书＝brave）→成立（至少两条）。②→lucky 抹掉她的主动行动→排除。③→身份不是评价→不成立。④→空评价→排除。
4 干扰：not even 5 years old 的年龄让人只写 "she is young"；TV show 的高光也容易替代品质。
5 意图：考"评价＝品质词＋行为"，允许从"年幼创业"取材。
6 边界：若问 What is her advice to kids? 答 It's important to dream like a kid, and it's the perfect age to try new things and take risks。若问 What is her company's product? 答 Me and the Bees Lemonade（five drink products）。
7 错误：A 只写 She is young.（错因：年龄非评价）；B 答 She is lucky.（错因：无据）；C 答 She is a businesswoman.（错因：身份）。
8 规则：R89.5 若问 What do you think of sb? And give your reasons，then 给 2—3 个品质词（kind／creative／brave）并各配一条原文行为；年龄与身份不作评价，空评价不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（品质＋行为）；复用 R69.5／R37.5，本条对象是少年创业者。
10 自检：①品质词有哪几个？②行为配上了吗？③我写成"她很小"了吗？

**组小结（G89 · 小蓝书预测卷十五 Passage Three）**
- 考点分布：意愿（救蜜蜂）1（26）；按时点取赚钱方式 1（27）；渠道定词义（procurable）1（28）；中心名词定性质 1（29）；人物评价 1（30）。
- 规则：R89.1 want to do 取目的（26）；R89.2 时点截断（27）；R89.3 procurable＝可买到（28）；R89.4 called 前中心名词定性质（29）；R89.5 品质＋行为（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R89.1 与"scared 情绪强"冲突，目的优先；R89.2 与"TV show 高光"冲突，5 岁优先；R89.3 与"popular 基调"冲突，地点状语优先；R89.4 与"书名像节目"冲突，book 优先；R89.5 与"年龄醒目"冲突，品质优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：少年创业类首见；本篇"5 岁摆摊→10 岁上电视→现在五款产品→2020 出书"是清晰的时间链，可作 04 的时点样本；数字（4／5／10／2020／10 years／five products）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十五 · Passage Four

People say that a dog is man's best friend. Once dogs find their "people", they will stay by their side until the very end. Sadly, however, many families lost or even gave up their dogs.

Leo is a dog from Thailand. He became popular on the Internet because of his amazing story. About four years ago; the poor dog was left behind by his owners somewhere near a gas



station. Hoping his owners would return for him, the dog never left his spot(地点).

Luckily. Leo was never truly alone. Seeing the poor thing, people there decided to help him out. Saowalak, a 45-year-old woman, took the poor dog back to her home after giving him food. However, Leo just kept on running away only to return to his old spot and wait for someone by the side of the road.

In the end, she let him but still brought over some food every day so that Leo wouldn't be hungry.

Another person, Anuchit, also cared about Leo and decided to put some photos of the dog online to find his family. That's when the Internet did its magic. After being put on the Internet, the photos finally reached Leo's missing family. They called Anuchit, telling him how the dog in the pictures looked like their dog.

It turned out that Leo was their dog. They lost him back in 2015. They looked for him for a week but had little hope of finding him. They thought that they would never see him again.

The family and Leo got the chance to see each other again. But while both seemed happy to be reunited(重逢), it also seemed like something has changed with Leo. When the family asked Leo to get into the car and go home with them, Leo stopped. …

31. Did Leo become popular on the Internet because he was cute?

______

32. Why did Leo keep on running away after Saowalak took him back to her home?

______

33. What did Saowalak do after Leo running away?

______

34. According to the passage, what does "the Internet did its magic" mean?

______

35. What did Leo decide to do next? Please write an ending for the passage.

______

**〔G90〕小蓝书预测卷十五 · Passage Four（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：No, he didn't. He became popular because of his amazing story — he was left behind and kept waiting at the same spot for his owners.**
1 题面：Did Leo become popular on the Internet because he was cute；原文 "Leo is a dog from Thailand. He became popular on the Internet because of his amazing story. About four years ago…the poor dog was left behind by his owners somewhere near a gas station. Hoping his owners would return for him, the dog never left his spot(地点)."；疑问词 Did…because cute（一般疑问＋原因校验）；诱导信号：cute 是人们对宠物的常见想象。
2 候选：①No＋because of his amazing story（等待主人）；②Yes＋because he was cute；③Yes＋because he was from Thailand；④No＋because he was ill。
3 验算：①→He became popular on the Internet because of his amazing story＋never left his spot，原因明确且与 cute 无关→成立（表态 No＋给真实原因）。②→原文未提 cute，且 because of his amazing story 已给原因→不成立。③→Thailand 是产地，不是原因→排除。④→ill 原文无→排除。
4 干扰：cute 是"网红狗"的常识剧本；Thailand 也在首句，像"异国标签"。
5 意图：考"一般疑问＋because 校验：先否掉题干给的原因，再给原文原因"。
6 边界：若问 Why did Leo become popular online? 答 Because of his amazing story（he waited at his old spot for his owners）。若问 Where was Leo left behind? 答 Near a gas station。
7 错误：A 答 Yes, because he was cute.（错因：常识当原因）；B 答 Yes, because he was from Thailand.（错因：产地当原因）；C 答 No.（错因：漏真实原因）。
8 规则：R90.1 若题干以 because＋一个原文没有的原因发问（cute），then 答 No＋原文原因（because of his amazing story／never left his spot）；产地、外貌等标签不作原因，表态后必须补真实原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答（原因校验）；复用 R43.3（Yes/No＋补事实），本条是"否定题干原因"。
10 自检：①原文给的原因是什么？②cute 在文中吗？③我补原因了吗？

**32. 答案：Because he hoped his owners would return for him — he kept returning to his old spot to wait for someone by the side of the road.**
1 题面：Why did Leo keep on running away after Saowalak took him back to her home；原文 "Saowalak, a 45-year-old woman, took the poor dog back to her home after giving him food. However, Leo just kept on running away only to return to his old spot and wait for someone by the side of the road."；疑问词 Why did sb keep doing（问原因）；诱导信号：上一段 Hoping his owners would return for him 已经埋下原因。
2 候选：①he hoped his owners would return／waited at his old spot；②he didn't like Saowalak；③he was hungry；④he was ill。
3 验算：①→Hoping his owners would return for him＋kept on running away only to return to his old spot，两处同向→成立。②→Saowalak 给他食物、带他回家，原文无"不喜欢"→不成立。③→饥饿是 Saowalak 送饭要解决的问题，不是跑走原因→次优。④→原文无生病→排除。
4 干扰：Saowalak 的善意与 Leo 的"逃跑"形成反差，容易推出"他不喜欢她"；饥饿也像理由。
5 意图：考"反复行为的原因取前文心理（hoping owners would return）"。
6 边界：若问 What did Leo do at his old spot? 答 He waited for someone by the side of the road。若问 How old was Saowalak? 答 45。
7 错误：A 答 Because he didn't like Saowalak.（错因：反差推断）；B 答 Because he was hungry.（错因：送饭正是为此）；C 答 Because he wanted to find food.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R90.2 若问 Why did an animal keep returning to a place，then 取前文的心理动机（hoping his owners would return）＋行为描述（waited at his old spot）；对方的善意被拒（不喜欢 Saowalak）属推断，饥饿／生病属另解，均不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（动物动机）；复用 R32.3（动机取自述）的动物版，本条动机由叙述句给出。
10 自检：①hoping 句在哪？②他回到哪？③"不喜欢"有据吗？

**33. 答案：She let him go, but she still brought over some food every day so that Leo wouldn't be hungry.**
1 题面：What did Saowalak do after Leo running away（原题 running 用原形，照抄）；原文 "In the end, she let him but still brought over some food every day so that Leo wouldn't be hungry."；疑问词 What did sb do（问做法）；诱导信号：前文 took the poor dog back to her home 是她最初的做法。
2 候选：①let him go＋brought food every day；②took him home again；③called the police；④stopped feeding him。
3 验算：①→she let him but still brought over some food every day，两半都要（让走＋送饭）→成立。②→took him home 是"after running away"之前的动作→排除。③→原文无报警（报警式情节在另一篇 G85）→排除。④→与 every day 相反→不成立。
4 干扰：took the poor dog back to her home 是同一段的动作，时点在前；let him 后省略 go，容易被读成"她留下了他"。
5 意图：考"做法取 after 之后的两个动作（let him＋brought food），不含初次收留"。
6 边界：若问 Did Saowalak stop caring for Leo? 答 No — she still brought him food every day。若问 Why did she bring food? 答 So that Leo wouldn't be hungry。
7 错误：A 答 She took him home again.（错因：时点在前）；B 答 She gave up on him.（错因：与送饭相反）；C 答 She called the police.（错因：串篇）。
8 规则：R90.3 若问 What did sb do after an event，then 取 after 之后的动作（let him go＋brought food every day），两半都写；同一段但时点在前的动作（took him home）不作答案；let him 要补出"放他走"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.15 动作取全；复用 R67.4（取全部动作），本条按时点截断。
10 自检：①after 之后有哪两个动作？②took home 是什么时候？③let him 是什么意思？

**34. 答案：It means the photos posted online reached Leo's missing family, who called Anuchit and said the dog looked like theirs.（网络起了作用）**
1 题面：According to the passage, what does "the Internet did its magic" mean；原文 "Another person, Anuchit, also cared about Leo and decided to put some photos of the dog online to find his family. That's when the Internet did its magic. After being put on the Internet, the photos finally reached Leo's missing family. They called Anuchit, telling him how the dog in the pictures looked like their dog."；疑问词 What does X mean（句意／习语）；诱导信号：magic 的字面义"魔法"。
2 候选：①照片传到失主家、失主联系 Anuchit（网络起作用）；②网络会变魔术；③Anuchit 用魔法找狗；④Leo 自己上网。
3 验算：①→After being put on the Internet, the photos finally reached Leo's missing family. They called Anuchit，后两句即释义→成立。②→字面义，与后文街道不相干→不成立。③→Anuchit 只是发照片，没有魔法→排除。④→Leo 是狗，不会上网→排除。
4 干扰：magic 的字面义最强；That's when 的时间衔接也可能让人以为"神奇瞬间"而非"传播结果"。
5 意图：考"习语按后文结果句释义（photos reached the family）"。
6 边界：若问 Who put Leo's photos online? 答 Anuchit。若问 How did the family recognize Leo? 答 The dog in the pictures looked like their dog。
7 错误：A 答 The Internet can do magic.（错因：字面义）；B 答 Anuchit used magic.（错因：主体错）；C 答 Leo found his family by himself.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R90.4 若划线为习语（the Internet did its magic），then 取其后结果句（photos reached the family／they called Anuchit）作释义，不译"变魔术"；主体（Anuchit 发照片）不改成"网络／狗自己"。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.3 划线句释义（习语＋结果句）；复用 R38.5（象征动作取结果），本条是"俗语取结果"。
10 自检：①后文发生了什么？②magic 是字面吗？③谁发的照片？

**35. 答案：（开放题，续写结局）When the family asked him to get into the car, Leo stopped. After a while, he turned back and walked to Saowalak, because she had fed him and waited with him every day — so he chose to stay with the person who never left him, though the family could still visit him.**
1 题面：What did Leo decide to do next? Please write an ending for the passage.——续写结局；原文止于 "When the family asked Leo to get into the car and go home with them, Leo stopped. …"（省略号）；前文依据：Saowalak 每天送饭、Anuchit 发照片、family 找了很久但 hope 很小；诱导信号：重逢的喜悦容易让人写"他跟家人回家了"。
2 候选：①他停住→最终选择留在 Saowalak 身边（因她每天照顾他）；②他立刻上车回家；③他跑掉了，谁也没跟；④他咬人。
3 验算：①→Leo stopped＋Saowalak brought food every day，与"停住"一致，且解释了犹豫→成立（结局合理、有据）。②→与 Leo stopped 矛盾（若愿走就不会停）→次优（至少要先写犹豫）。③→跑掉与 family 重逢情节脱节，且无据→次优。④→与全文温情基调相反→排除。
4 干扰： reunited 的喜悦与 family 的寻找都指向"回家"，但原文用 stopped 明确留下悬念；题干 Please write an ending 允许合理想象，但须与人物动机一致。
5 意图：考"开放续写：以最后一句（stopped）为锚，用前文动机（Saowalak 的每日照顾）解释选择"。
6 边界：若问 How did the family find Leo? 答 Anuchit posted photos online and the family saw them。若问 When did the family lose Leo? 答 In 2015。
7 错误：A 答 Leo went home with the family at once.（错因：与 stopped 矛盾）；B 答 Leo bit the family.（错因：与基调相反）；C 答 Leo ran away and was never seen.（错因：无据且断线）。
8 规则：R90.5 若题干要求 write an ending 且原文以省略号停在关键动作，then 以最后一句（Leo stopped）为锚，用前文动机（Saowalak 每日送饭／家人曾放弃寻找）解释选择，写成 1—2 句连贯结局；不得与最后一句矛盾（立刻上车），也不得脱离人物关系（咬人／消失）。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.9 续写结局（开放叙事）；复用 R32.4（might 允许贴文本推测），本条是"结局续写"。
10 自检：①最后一句是什么？②我用了哪条前文动机？③结局与 stopped 冲突吗？

**组小结（G90 · 小蓝书预测卷十五 Passage Four）**
- 考点分布：原因校验（cute）1（31）；动物动机 1（32）；时点前后动作 1（33）；俗语释义 1（34）；续写结局 1（35）。
- 规则：R90.1 否定题干原因并补真实原因（31）；R90.2 动物动机取前文心理（32）；R90.3 after 之后动作取全（33）；R90.4 俗语取结果句（34）；R90.5 结局以末句为锚（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R90.1 与"cute 是网红常识"冲突，原文原因优先；R90.2 与"不喜欢 Saowalak"推断冲突，hoping 句优先；R90.3 与"初次收留"冲突，时点优先；R90.4 与"magic 字面"冲突，结果句优先；R90.5 与"重逢即回家"冲突，stopped 优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**续写结局题首见**（RA-6.9，开放叙事）；动物叙事第 2 篇（G73 Luke／本条 Leo）；本篇"等待—收留—传播—重逢—停住"五段式是 04 叙事链样本；数字（four years ago／2015／45／a week）均照录，**无换算、无推算**；**小蓝书卷十五 4 篇至此完成（G87—G90）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十八 · Passage 1

It's break time. Molly sat at the picnic table alone while the rest of the students were running freely. The new girl was once again excluding herself from the midday celebration. Even though the school had been in session for several weeks already, she remained awkward around her classmates.

Brianna, the class clown, was standing near the playground and making the other students laugh as usual. I interrupted her fun and asked her to come to talk with me. "Brianna, do you see Molly down there?" I asked. "She looks very lonely. Would you mind walking down there and inviting her to come here to be with the rest of us?" I patted her on the shoulder.

Brianna sighed. I could tell she didn't want to waste her precious time on what I was saying, but I also knew her heart. She was sweet and kind and often thought of others, so I chose her for this task on purpose.

Seeing that this choice pained her, I took a D-buck, our class currency, from my pocket. Though it was not the best way to handle this situation, I needed to ensure her cooperation. "Here, I'll pay you for your time," I said. She smiled, grasped the green paper, and headed towards Molly.

My eyes focused on Brianna as she neared the picnic table. After talking for a while, Molly turned to a standing position. Then I felt a sense of relief. The girls walked back together. Several minutes later, Brianna walked to me and handed me the D-buck, saying, "I shouldn't keep this, because I don't want Molly to think I only went to her for a D-buck. She is my friend."

Then Brianna went back to her group. A moment later, they were all laughing again, and Molly was one of them.

**〔G91〕小蓝书预测卷十八 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：She asked Brianna to walk down to Molly and invite her to come and be with the rest of them.**
1 题面：What did the author ask Brianna to do；原文 "'Brianna, do you see Molly down there?' I asked. 'She looks very lonely. Would you mind walking down there and inviting her to come here to be with the rest of us?'"；疑问词 What did sb ask sb to do（问请求内容）；诱导信号：前一句 I interrupted her fun 是背景，不是请求。
2 候选：①walk down and invite Molly to come with the rest；②stop making others laugh；③give Molly a D-buck；④talk with the teacher。
3 验算：①→Would you mind walking down there and inviting her to come here to be with the rest of us，请求内容完整→成立。②→I interrupted her fun 是作者的动作，不是请求内容→次优。③→D-buck 是后文的"报酬"，不是最初的请求→排除。④→角色反了→排除。
4 干扰：I interrupted her fun 就在前面，动作感强；D-buck 情节更戏剧化，容易当"请求"。
5 意图：考"ask sb to do 取 Would you mind doing 的具体内容，背景动作不作请求"。
6 边界：若问 Where was Molly sitting? 答 At the picnic table（alone）。若问 What did Brianna do first? 答 She sighed。
7 错误：A 答 To stop making others laugh.（错因：背景动作）；B 答 To give Molly a D-buck.（错因：后文情节）；C 答 To talk with Molly's parents.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R91.1 若问 What did sb ask sb to do，then 取 Would you mind doing／asked her to do 后的具体请求（invite Molly to come with the rest）；同段的背景动作（interrupted her fun）与后文报酬（D-buck）不作请求内容。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（请求内容）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条是"请求"。
10 自检：①请求句在哪？②interrupted 是谁的动作？③D-buck 是请求吗？

**17. 答案：Because Brianna was sweet and kind and often thought of others — the author knew her heart.**
1 题面：Why did the author select Brianna to finish the task；原文 "Brianna sighed. I could tell she didn't want to waste her precious time on what I was saying, but I also knew her heart. She was sweet and kind and often thought of others, so I chose her for this task on purpose."；疑问词 Why did sb select（问选人理由）；诱导信号：Brianna sighed／didn't want to waste her time 是表面态度。
2 候选：①sweet and kind／often thought of others；②because she was the class clown；③because she had a D-buck；④because she was Molly's friend。
3 验算：①→She was sweet and kind and often thought of others, so I chose her…on purpose，so 前即因→成立。②→class clown 是她的标签，不是选人理由→次优。③→D-buck 是作者给的，不是她的→排除。④→原文未说她们是朋友（后来 Brianna 说 She is my friend）→次优。
4 干扰：class clown 与 sighed 形成"不愿做"的表象；后来"朋友"的说法也像理由。
5 意图：考"选人理由取 so 前的品质句，表面态度不作理由"。
6 边界：若问 How did Brianna react at first? 答 She sighed and seemed unwilling。若问 What did the author give her? 答 A D-buck（class currency）。
7 错误：A 答 Because she was the class clown.（错因：标签）；B 答 Because she was Molly's friend.（错因：时序在后）；C 答 Because she was free.（错因：与 didn't want to waste time 相反）。
8 规则：R91.2 若问 Why did sb select a person，then 取 so I chose her 前的品质句（sweet and kind／often thought of others）；表面态度（sighed／didn't want to）与标签（class clown）不作理由；后文才出现的"朋友"关系按时序排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（选人）；复用 R37.3（判断依据），本条是"选人依据"。
10 自检：①so 前是什么？②sighed 说明什么？③"朋友"在哪句？

**18. 答案：It refers to paying Brianna with a D-buck (the class currency).**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "it" in Paragraph 4 refer to；第 4 段原文 "Seeing that this choice pained her, I took a D-buck, our class currency, from my pocket. Though it was not the best way to handle this situation, I needed to ensure her cooperation."；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 it refers to（代词回指）；诱导信号：同段有 a D-buck／our class currency／this situation 三个名词性成分。
2 候选：①paying her with a D-buck；②the D-buck itself；③this situation；④her cooperation。
3 验算：①→it was not the best way to handle this situation，way 对应"用钱请她"这一做法（paying her for her time）→成立。②→若指"那张纸币"，则"not the best way"讲不通（钱本身不是 way）→次优。③→this situation 是宾语，不是 it 本身→排除。④→cooperation 是目的，不是"方式"→排除。
4 干扰：a D-buck 紧邻在前，最容易被当先行词；"way"的抽象性也容易被跳过。
5 意图：考"it 指'做法'而非'实物'：由 way 一词定回指层级"。
6 边界：若问 Why did the author pay Brianna? 答 To ensure her cooperation。若问 Did Brianna keep the D-buck? 答 No — she gave it back。
7 错误：A 答 The D-buck.（错因：实物 vs 做法）；B 答 Her cooperation.（错因：目的当回指）；C 答 Molly.（错因：人物）。
8 规则：R91.3 若问 it 回指且后接 way／method 作表语（it was not the best way），then it 指前文的"做法"（paying her with a D-buck），不指具体实物（the D-buck）、宾语（this situation）或目的（cooperation）。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.1 代词回指（做法 vs 实物）；复用 R65.3（改名结构回指），本条是"way 定层级"。
10 自检：①后接什么表语？②D-buck 是实物还是做法？③cooperation 是什么成分？

**19. 答案：Because Molly stood up and the girls walked back together — Brianna had succeeded in inviting her.**
1 题面：Why did the author feel a sense of relief；原文 "My eyes focused on Brianna as she neared the picnic table. After talking for a while, Molly turned to a standing position. Then I felt a sense of relief. The girls walked back together."；疑问词 Why did sb feel relief（问原因）；诱导信号：前文 I needed to ensure her cooperation 是动机，不是放松的原因。
2 候选：①Molly stood up and the girls walked back together；②Brianna took the D-buck；③Brianna sighed；④the class laughed。
3 验算：①→Molly turned to a standing position. Then I felt a sense of relief，前句即因；后句 The girls walked back together 加固→成立。②→拿钱发生在"relief"之前，且不是成功标志→排除。③→sighed 是她不愿去时的反应→排除。④→全班大笑在最后，是后续结果→次优。
4 干扰：The girls walked back together 在 relief 之后，容易混淆因果顺序；D-buck 情节也抢注意。
5 意图：考"情绪原因取紧邻前句（Molly stood up），后续结果只作补充"。
6 边界：若问 What did Molly do after talking with Brianna? 答 She turned to a standing position and walked back with Brianna。若问 What happened at the end? 答 They were all laughing again, and Molly was one of them。
7 错误：A 答 Because Brianna took the D-buck.（错因：非成功标志）；B 答 Because the class laughed.（错因：后续结果）；C 答 Because Brianna sighed.（错因：相反情绪）。
8 规则：R91.4 若问 Why did sb feel a sense of relief，then 取紧邻的情绪前句（Molly turned to a standing position）并以"两人一起走回"补证；拿钱、叹气与最后的全班大笑都不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（情绪前句为因）；复用 R31.3（情绪取前邻事件），本条是"释然"。
10 自检：①relief 前一句是什么？②一起走回在 relief 前还是后？③叹气是什么情绪？

**20. 答案：（开放题）I think Brianna is kind and considerate. Although she seemed unwilling at first, she went to Molly, talked with her and brought her back to the group, and she even returned the D-buck because she didn't want Molly to think she went to her only for money — she said "She is my friend."**
1 题面：What do you think of Brianna? Please explain the reason.——评价＋理由；可用依据：She was sweet and kind and often thought of others／she went to Molly and talked with her／handed back the D-buck／"I don't want Molly to think I only went to her for a D-buck. She is my friend."；诱导信号：sighed／didn't want to waste her time 是表面态度。
2 候选：①kind and considerate＋退钱行为；②lazy（因为叹气）；③rich（因为有 D-buck）；④只写 She is nice。
3 验算：①→kind（原文直接说）＋退还 D-buck（行为）→成立（至少两条证据）。②→sighed 只是短暂情绪，后文她完成了任务→不成立。③→D-buck 是作者给的班币→排除。④→空评价→不成立。
4 干扰：Brianna sighed 与 didn't want to waste her precious time 的负面描写在文中很显眼；退钱一节篇幅短，容易被忽略。
5 意图：考"评价＝品质＋行为，且以关键行为（退钱）覆盖表面情绪"。
6 边界：若问 Why did Brianna return the D-buck? 答 Because she didn't want Molly to think she only went to her for money。若问 How did Molly change? 答 She stood up and joined the group。
7 错误：A 答 She is lazy.（错因：以叹气概全）；B 答 She is rich.（错因：无据）；C 答 She is shy.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R91.5 若问 What do you think of sb，then 给 2 个品质词（kind／considerate）并各配一条行为（去邀请、陪她走回、退还 D-buck），表面情绪（sighed）不覆盖整体评价；空评价不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（品质＋行为）；复用 R37.5，本条强调"关键行为压过表面情绪"。
10 自检：①品质词有哪两个？②退钱说明什么？③我用叹气定论了吗？

**组小结（G91 · 小蓝书预测卷十八 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：请求内容 1（16）；选人理由 1（17）；it 回指（做法）1（18）；释然原因 1（19）；人物评价 1（20）。
- 规则：R91.1 请求取具体内容（16）；R91.2 选人取品质句（17）；R91.3 it 指做法非实物（18）；R91.4 释然取前邻事件（19）；R91.5 品质＋行为（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R91.1 与"interrupted her fun 动作强"冲突，请求句优先；R91.2 与"class clown 标签"冲突，品质优先；R91.3 与"D-buck 紧邻"冲突，way 定层级；R91.4 与"一起走回在后"冲突，前邻事件优先；R91.5 与"sighed 负面"冲突，关键行为优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：校园叙事首见（D-buck 班币制度）；本篇"实物 vs 做法"的代词回指（it＝paying her）是 04 的新样本；数字（a D-buck／several minutes）无换算，**本组无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十八 · Passage 2

**A Nation of Animal Lovers**

The British are traditionally a nation of animal lovers. This is clear from the large number of animal programmes on TV. There are programmes about wildlife in Britain and other countries, and about pets at home. There are programmes like *Animal Hospital* about sick animals and the working lives of animal doctors. Some programmes try to find new homes for unwanted or homeless animals. All these programmes are very popular. There is a pet in more than half of the homes in the UK(52.3%). The most popular pets are cats.

**Battersea Dogs and Cats Home**

Battersea Dogs and Cats Home in London is a very famous home for unwanted dogs and cats. It was started in 1860 by Mrs. Mary Tealby, because she was worried about all the homeless animals on the streets of London. Since it opened, the home has taken in more than 3 million dogs and cats. In 2006, over 11,000 dogs and cats came to the home. By the end of the year, homes were found for 5,000 of them. The home even has its own magazine, *Paws*.

> It Can Only Happen in Britain!　The Echo January 13
>
> The rat at platform one has just made your train late!
>
> An officer was called to Stirling station today because passengers were worried about a large white rat on the line. Three trains passed over it, but the rat was unhurt. The Scottish railway company, Scotrail, closed the line. Then passengers watched as the officer carefully caught the rat. It bit him, but he took it away safely.
>
> An officer from Scotrail said, "We try to protect all wild animals and pets. At first the rat was very frightened, but now he's fine."
>
> "We've called him Ronnie. He needs a good home. People think rats are dirty. But they make great pets!"

21. What is the programme Animal Hospital about?



______

22. How many homes in the UK raise pets?

______

23. Why did Mrs. Mary Tealby started Battersea Dogs and Cats Home?

______

24. What was the result of the rat in the train station?

______

25. How will you react if you see some wild animals in cities? Please further explain that.

**〔G92〕小蓝书预测卷十八 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

> 本篇由两段**说明文**＋一则**报刊短讯**（*It Can Only Happen in Britain!　The Echo January 13*）组成，设问跨两种体例。

**21. 答案：It is about sick animals and the working lives of animal doctors.**
1 题面：What is the programme Animal Hospital about；原文 "There are programmes like *Animal Hospital* about sick animals and the working lives of animal doctors."；疑问词 What is X about（问内容）；诱导信号：前后句还提到 wildlife／pets／homeless animals 三类节目，容易串。
2 候选：①sick animals＋the working lives of animal doctors；②wildlife in Britain；③homeless animals；④pets at home。
3 验算：①→programmes like Animal Hospital about sick animals and the working lives of animal doctors，about 后两项并列→成立（两项都写）。②③④→分别属其他节目的题材（about wildlife…／try to find new homes…）→排除。
4 干扰：上文 There are programmes about wildlife…and about pets 与下文 Some programmes try to find new homes 都在同一段，题材密集。
5 意图：考"about 后的两项取全，同段其他节目题材按名称排除"。
6 边界：若问 What is the most popular pet in the UK? 答 Cats。若问 What do some programmes try to do for homeless animals? 答 To find new homes for them。
7 错误：A 答 Wildlife in Britain.（错因：别的节目）；B 答 Homeless animals.（错因：别的节目）；C 答 The working lives of animal doctors only.（错因：漏 sick animals）。
8 规则：R92.1 若问 What is a programme about 且原文用 about A and B，then 两项都写（sick animals＋working lives of animal doctors）；同段其他节目题材（wildlife／pets／homeless animals）按节目名排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.15 并列项取全；复用 R5.1（并列宾语全取），本条是 about 宾语。
10 自检：①about 后有几项？②wildlife 属于谁？③homeless animals 属于谁？

**22. 答案：More than half of the homes in the UK — 52.3%.**
1 题面：How many homes in the UK raise pets；原文 "There is a pet in more than half of the homes in the UK(52.3%)."；疑问词 How many homes（问比例）；诱导信号：同段还有 1860／3 million／11,000／5,000 等数字。
2 候选：①more than half（52.3%）；②52.3 homes；③3 million；④5,000。
3 验算：①→more than half of the homes in the UK(52.3%)，括号给出精确比例→成立（写 more than half 即可，可补 52.3%）。②→52.3 是百分比，不是"户数"→不成立。③→3 million 是 Battersea 收容的动物总数→排除。④→5,000 是 2006 年找到新家的数量→排除。
4 干扰：括号里的 52.3% 与"more than half"同义，学生可能只写 52.3 而丢百分号；3 million 数字最大。
5 意图：考"比例题取 more than half／百分数照抄，不与其他数字串"。
6 边界：若问 How many dogs and cats has Battersea taken in since it opened? 答 More than 3 million。若问 How many animals came to the home in 2006? 答 Over 11,000。
7 错误：A 答 52.3 homes.（错因：百分号丢失）；B 答 3 million.（错因：串数字）；C 答 All homes.（错因：与 more than half 不符）。
8 规则：R92.2 若问 How many homes／people raise pets，then 取比例表达（more than half）并保留百分数（52.3%），不得丢百分号、不得与同段其他数字（3 million／11,000／5,000）互换。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（百分比照抄）；**本稿百分比第 2 例**（第 1 例 R40.1 的 98%），仍属"照抄"类，不是差值。
10 自检：①比例是多少？②52.3 带百分号吗？③3 million 是什么？

**23. 答案：Because she was worried about all the homeless animals on the streets of London.**
1 题面：Why did Mrs. Mary Tealby started Battersea Dogs and Cats Home（原题 started 用过去式，照抄）；原文 "It was started in 1860 by Mrs. Mary Tealby, because she was worried about all the homeless animals on the streets of London."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：同句还有 in 1860 这个年份。
2 候选：①worried about homeless animals on London streets；②because she liked cats；③because she was rich；④because the government asked her。
3 验算：①→because she was worried about all the homeless animals on the streets of London，because 从句直接给因→成立。②→liked cats 原文未提→排除。③→rich 无据→排除。④→government 无据→排除。
4 干扰：1860 与 3 million 的数字都很醒目；"动物爱好者之国"的首段也像原因。
5 意图：考"原因取 because 从句，年份与国别背景不作原因"。
6 边界：若问 When was Battersea started? 答 In 1860。若问 What is the home's own magazine called? 答 Paws。
7 错误：A 答 Because she was rich.（错因：无据）；B 答 Because she loved dogs.（错因：改写）；C 答 Because the railway company asked her.（错因：串到短讯）。
8 规则：R92.3 若问 Why did sb start an organization，then 取 because 从句（worried about homeless animals on London streets）；年份（1860）、国别背景（nation of animal lovers）与无据理由（rich／government）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（because 从句）；复用 R57.3（起因取 because），本条是"创办动机"。
10 自检：①because 后是什么？②1860 是什么？③她有钱吗？

**24. 答案：The railway line was closed, an officer caught the rat (it bit him but was taken away safely), and the rat was named Ronnie and needs a good home.**
1 题面：What was the result of the rat in the train station；短讯原文 "Three trains passed over it, but the rat was unhurt. The Scottish railway company, Scotrail, closed the line. Then passengers watched as the officer carefully caught the rat. It bit him, but he took it away safely."＋"We've called him Ronnie. He needs a good home."；疑问词 What was the result（问结果）；诱导信号：开头 The rat at platform one has just made your train late! 是起因（延误）。
2 候选：①线被关闭＋警官抓到（被咬但安全带走）＋取名 Ronnie 待领养；②火车晚点（起因）；③老鼠被轧死；④老鼠跑掉了。
3 验算：①→closed the line＋caught the rat…took it away safely＋called him Ronnie. He needs a good home，三处结果→成立（写两点即可）。②→train late 是事件影响，不是最终结果→次优。③→but the rat was unhurt 明确否定→不成立。④→took it away safely／needs a good home，说明未跑掉→排除。
4 干扰：首句"让你的火车晚点"最像结果；Three trains passed over it 也像"被轧"。
5 意图：考"结果取短讯后半（关闭线路→捕获→待领养），起因句不作结果"。
6 边界：若问 Why was the line closed? 答 Because passengers were worried about a large white rat on the line。若问 What did the officer say about the rat? 答 At first it was very frightened, but now it's fine。
7 错误：A 答 The train was late.（错因：起因当结果）；B 答 The rat was killed.（错因：与 unhurt 相反）；C 答 The rat bit the passengers.（错因：咬的是警官）。
8 规则：R92.4 若问 What was the result of an incident，then 取事件后半的处置结果（closed the line／caught the rat／named Ronnie／needs a good home），至少两点；起因句（train late）与相反结果（killed）不取；咬人对象是 officer，不是乘客。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.6 结果（处置链）；复用 R79.3（跨段取全），本条是短讯体。
10 自检：①处置有几步？②老鼠死了吗？③咬的是谁？

**25. 答案：（开放题）If I see wild animals in cities, I will keep a safe distance and not hurt or feed them. If they are in danger, I will call the local animal protection group or the police, as the railway staff did for the rat, because wild animals and people can live together safely if we treat them properly.**
1 题面：How will you react if you see some wild animals in cities? Please further explain that.——做法＋进一步解释；可用依据：the officer carefully caught the rat／We try to protect all wild animals and pets／They make great pets／programmes try to find new homes for homeless animals。
2 候选：①保持距离＋不伤害＋必要时联系机构（并解释）；②只写 I will run away；③写"我会打死它"；④复述短讯内容。
3 验算：①→三条做法＋解释（人与动物可共处）→成立。②→只有反应，无解释→不成立。③→与全文保护动物的基调相反→排除。④→复述不是"我会怎么做"→排除。
4 干扰：短讯情节有趣（老鼠咬警官），容易复述；题干 Please further explain 要求解释，不只是动作。
5 意图：考"做法＋解释"，并要求与全文价值观一致。
6 边界：若问 What did the officer do with the rat? 答 He caught it carefully and took it away safely。若问 What does Scotrail try to do? 答 To protect all wild animals and pets。
7 错误：A 只写 I will stay away.（错因：漏解释）；B 答 I will kill it.（错因：与基调相反）；C 答 I will take it home and keep it.（错因：野生动物不宜家养，原文只说 the rat needs a good home）。
8 规则：R92.5 若问 How will you react if you see wild animals 且要求 further explain，then 给 2—3 条做法（keep a distance／not hurt or feed／call protection groups）＋一句解释；只写反应、复述短讯或与保护基调相反的答案都不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.5 启示类（做法＋解释）；复用 R88.5（做法型启示），本条对象是"城市野生动物"。
10 自检：①我给了几条做法？②解释了吗？③我与保护基调一致吗？

**组小结（G92 · 小蓝书预测卷十八 Passage 2）**

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十八 · Passage 3

Every child has a dream of what they want to be, right? When Renee Butts was little, her dream was to become a volunteer firefighter because her father was one. Sadly, when she was 14, her beloved father passed away and she was unable to do volunteer work with him. However, she was determined and never gave up, which makes for a good firefighter.

Now Renee is a member of the Carmel Fire Department, where she is required to be an Emergency Medical Technician. She should also be ready to deal with any emergency, like fighting a fire, dealing with a car accident or helping someone who's sick. Sometimes she is in the driver's seat or using the water pump. Renec works nine to eleven days a month on 24-hour shifts. She also has a family to care for, as her husband is also a busy firefighter. Dealing with housework and working so much can show her great determination.

When I asked Renee what the best part of her job is, she replied, "Helping people and the satisfaction of saving lives." I think that shows signs of being a true hero. She's always willing to do anything for anyone in need. Renee says that her job is frightening at times, but extremely exciting. "The worst part of my job is that I see death. Actually, sometimes, people die in the accident, for which I was very sorry," said Renee.

I was inspired by this because I know I would be very scared to do her job and don't know if I could handle seeing people die. With 140 people in her station, Renee is one of the only three women, but that doesn't bother her. She says everyone gets a fair shot and they all do the same jobs.

We would never live without people like her who have the courage to risk their lives. Renee's determination rubs off on me and helps me believe that I can do anything.

**〔G93〕小蓝书预测卷十八 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

> **重要：本篇与 G37（卷二十三 P3）是同一文本的重复收录**（Renee Butts），措辞略有差异（passed away／satisfaction of saving lives／everyone gets a fair shot）。按"原题不改"原则照本卷文本作答，规则以 R37.1—R37.5 为主，仅 Q27 为新问法，另立 R93.2。

**26. 答案：She is an Emergency Medical Technician (a member of the Carmel Fire Department).**
1 题面：What's Renee's job in the Carmel Fire Department；原文 "Now Renee is a member of the Carmel Fire Department, where she is required to be an Emergency Medical Technician."；疑问词 What's sb's job（问职务）；诱导信号：后文 She should also be ready to deal with any emergency…与 Sometimes she is in the driver's seat 都是职责细节。
2 候选：①an Emergency Medical Technician；②a driver；③a member of the department（身份而非职务）；④a doctor。
3 验算：①→is required to be an Emergency Medical Technician，职务名与 required to be 对应→成立。②→in the driver's seat 是临时动作→排除。③→member 是身份，不是职务→次优。④→EMT 不是执业医师→排除。
4 干扰：四类 like 短语（fighting a fire／car accident／helping the sick）像"工作内容"；member 与 department 同句。
5 意图：考"职务取 required to be 的表语"（与 G37 同一机制）。
6 边界：若问 What is she required to be? 答 An Emergency Medical Technician。若问 What does she sometimes do? 答 She is in the driver's seat or uses the water pump。
7 错误：A 答 A driver.（错因：动作当职务）；B 答 A member.（错因：身份当职务）；C 答 A doctor.（错因：EMT 误作医师）。
8 规则：R93.1（复用 R37.1）若问 What's sb's job，then 取 be required to be 后的职务名（Emergency Medical Technician）；member／driver's seat 等身份与动作不作职务。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.37 职业（职务名 vs 动作）；与 G37 Q26 同题同解，可互证。
10 自检：①required to be 后是什么？②member 是职务吗？③driver's seat 是动作吗？

**27. 答案：Her great determination — dealing with housework and working so much shows her great determination.**
1 题面：What makes Renee balance between doing housework and working so much；原文 "She also has a family to care for, as her husband is also a busy firefighter. Dealing with housework and working so much can show her great determination."；疑问词 What makes sb balance A and B（问支撑因素）；诱导信号：同段罗列了 nine to eleven days a month／24-hour shifts 等事实。
2 候选：①her great determination；②her husband's help；③her 24-hour shifts；④her being one of three women。
3 验算：①→Dealing with housework and working so much can show her great determination，题干两件事与原文同，结论词 determination→成立。②→husband 也是 busy firefighter，原文未说他帮忙→排除。③→24-hour shifts 是工作量，不是"平衡"的原因→次优。④→three women 与性别比例有关，与平衡无关→排除。
4 干扰：事实罗列（9—11 天／24 小时班）具体，容易被当答案；husband 同行的设定也像"有人分担"。
5 意图：考"平衡的原因取 show her great determination 句，工作量事实不作原因"。
6 边界：若问 How many days a month does she work? 答 Nine to eleven days（on 24-hour shifts）。若问 Who else in her family is a firefighter? 答 Her husband。
7 错误：A 答 Her husband's help.（错因：无据）；B 答 Her 24-hour shifts.（错因：工作量非原因）；C 答 Her three female colleagues.（错因：串信息）。
8 规则：R93.2 若问 What makes sb balance A and B，then 取该段结论句（can show her great determination）；工作量事实（9—11 天／24 小时班）与无据的家庭帮助都不作支撑因素。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（支撑因素）；复用 R50.2（并列原因），本条结论词是 determination。
10 自检：①结论句是哪句？②丈夫帮忙有据吗？③9—11 天是什么？

**28. 答案：Because the best part of her job is helping people and the satisfaction of saving lives, and she is always willing to do anything for anyone in need.**
1 题面：Why does the author-think Renee Butts is a true hero（原题连字符，照抄）；原文 "When I asked Renee what the best part of her job is, she replied, 'Helping people and the satisfaction of saving lives.' I think that shows signs of being a true hero. She's always willing to do anything for anyone in need."；疑问词 Why does the author think（问依据）；诱导信号：末段 We would never live without people like her 也是赞美，但属另一层。
2 候选：①helping people＋satisfaction of saving lives（＋willing to help anyone）；②her courage to risk her life（末段）；③she is one of three women；④she works 24-hour shifts。
3 验算：①→that shows signs of being a true hero 的 that 回指前句引语，紧跟的 willing to do anything 同向→成立。②→末段推论，非 true hero 句的直接依据→次优。③④→事实细节，不作依据→排除。
4 干扰：末段 courage to risk their lives 与 hero 语义最贴；three women／140 people 的数字也显眼。
5 意图：考"依据取 that 回指的前句引语"（与 G37 Q28 同机制，本卷版本多了 satisfaction）。
6 边界：若问 What is the best part of her job? 答 Helping people and the satisfaction of saving lives。若问 Why does the author admire people like Renee? 答 Because we would never live without people who have the courage to risk their lives。
7 错误：A 答 Because she risks her life.（错因：远段推论）；B 答 Because she works long shifts.（错因：事实当理由）；C 答 Because she is a woman firefighter.（错因：性别非理由）。
8 规则：R93.3（复用 R37.3）若问 Why does the author think sb is a hero，then 解 that／this 的回指，取前一句引语（helping people＋satisfaction of saving lives）并补 willing to help 句；远段推论与事实细节不作直接依据。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.13 判断依据（that 回指）；与 G37 Q28 同题，可互证（本卷多"satisfaction"一词）。
10 自检：①that 指哪句？②courage 句在哪段？③我答"她勇敢"了吗？

**29. 答案：It means everyone gets an equal (fair) chance and they all do the same jobs.（得到公平的机会）**
1 题面：How do you understand the underlined part in Paragraph 4；划线部分为 "everyone gets a fair shot"（本卷版本），原文 "With 140 people in her station, Renee is one of the only three women, but that doesn't bother her. She says everyone gets a fair shot and they all do the same jobs."；原卷该处有下划线；疑问词 How do you understand（习语释义）。
2 候选：①an equal／fair chance（公平机会）；②a shot in a competition（射击）；③equal pay；④quick promotion。
3 验算：①→前句 one of the only three women, but that doesn't bother her＋后接 they all do the same jobs，与"机会平等"咬合→成立。②→无射击场景→排除。③→pay 原文未提→排除。④→promotion 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：shot 的字面义"射击"最省力；140 people／three women 的数字易被读成"竞争激烈"。
5 意图：考"习语 shot＝机会"（与 G37 Q29 同一习语，本卷版本动词为 gets）。
6 边界：若问 Does the gender imbalance bother her? 答 No, it doesn't。若问 What does "do the same jobs" mean? 答 Women can do the same work as men。
7 错误：A 答 Everyone can shoot well.（错因：字面义）；B 答 Everyone gets equal pay.（错因：换成 pay）；C 答 Everyone can be promoted.（错因：外推）。
8 规则：R93.4（复用 R37.4）若划线为含 shot 的习语（get a fair shot），then 取"公平机会"义，用同段对照（only three women／same jobs）校验；不译"射击"，也不换成 pay／promotion。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（习语·机会义）；与 G37 Q29 同题（本卷用 gets，卷二十三版用 can get）。
10 自检：①shot 是字面还是习语？②同段哪句作校验？③我换成 pay 了吗？

**30. 答案：（开放题）I think Renee is brave, determined and helpful. She never gave up after her father passed away, she became an EMT and works 24-hour shifts while caring for her family, and she is always willing to do anything for anyone in need.**
1 题面：What do you think of Renee? Please give your reasons.——评价＋理由；可用依据：was determined and never gave up／required to be an EMT／nine to eleven days a month on 24-hour shifts／always willing to do anything for anyone in need／the courage to risk their lives。
2 候选：①brave／determined／helpful＋行为；②only "she is a hero"；③poor Renee（同情）；④复述工作时长。
3 验算：①→三个品质词各有行为（父亲去世后坚持＝determined；EMT＋24 小时班＝brave；willing to help＝helpful）→成立。②→标签无据→不成立。③→同情不是评价→次优。④→事实复述无评价→排除。
4 干扰：hero／courage／determination 等褒词密集，容易只抄标签；数字（140／three／9—11）也抢眼。
5 意图：考"评价＝品质＋行为"（与 G37 Q30 同族，本卷版本开头改为 passed away）。
6 边界：若问 What kind of person is Renee? 答 同上。若问 Why is her job frightening? 答 Because she sees death／people die in the accident。
7 错误：A 答 She is a hero.（错因：空标签）；B 答 I feel sorry for her.（错因：同情代评价）；C 答 She works nine to eleven days a month.（错因：事实复述）。
8 规则：R93.5（复用 R37.5）若问 What do you think of sb，then 给 2—3 个品质词并各配一条行为；hero 标签、同情语与数字事实都不作评价。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（品质＋行为）；与 G37 Q30 同题，可互证。
10 自检：①品质词有几个？②每个有行为吗？③我只写了 hero 吗？

**组小结（G93 · 小蓝书预测卷十八 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：职务 1（26）；平衡家庭与工作的因素 1（27）；英雄依据 1（28）；习语（fair shot）1（29）；人物评价 1（30）。
- 规则：R93.1 职务取 required to be（26，复用 R37.1）；**R93.2 平衡取 determination 结论句（27，新）**；R93.3 英雄依据取 that 回指（28，复用 R37.3）；R93.4 fair shot＝机会（29，复用 R37.4）；R93.5 品质＋行为（30，复用 R37.5）。
- 冲突与优先级：R93.1 与"driver's seat"冲突，职务名优先；R93.2 与"9—11 天事实"冲突，结论句优先；R93.3 与"courage 句"冲突，回指优先；R93.4 与"shot 字面"冲突，对照优先；R93.5 与"褒词密集"冲突，证据优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**重复篇目第 1 例**——本篇与 G37（卷二十三 P3）同文异卷，措辞差异已逐条记录（passed away／satisfaction of saving lives／everyone gets a fair shot）；规则以 R37 为主、新增 R93.2，避免同一机制造出两套互相冲突的规则。数字（140／three／nine to eleven days／24-hour）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十八 · Passage 4

HEFEI, Oct. 13 (Xinhua) - A poetry festival kicked off Wednesday to commemorate Li Bai, a famous Chinese poet from the Tang Dynasty (618-907), in Ma'anshan City of east China's Anhui Province.

More than 500 representatives attended the opening ceremony of the 33rd Li Bai poetry festival, including poetry experts, scholars and poetry lovers from across the country. A poem recital activity will also be held online this year between Chinese and Japanese poem enthusiasts to promote bilateral cultural exchange.

Li Bai is a household name in China as Shakespeare to the UK or Tagore to India. He lived between 701 and 762, also a golden age of Chinese poetry, and his poems are brimful of patriotism and romanticism. He spent his last days in Ma'anshan and wrote about 50 poems about the city throughout his life. It is said he was buried at the foot of Daqing Mountain in the city after he passed away.

A total of 871 poems have been submitted to the organizing committee to participate in this year's festival. More than 100 statues of Li Bai and figures that appeared in his poems have been collected from all over China for exhibition at the festival.

Participants will pay homage to places in and around Ma'anshan City which Li Bai once visited. They will also pay a visit to Li Bai's tomb on Thursday.

The first Li Bai poetry festival was held in 1989 in Ma'anshan, and it has become a shining cultural activity of the city ever since. Ma'anshan was named as Chinese City of Poetry by the Poetry Institute of China in 2014.

______

32. Who attended the 33rd Li Bai poetry festival?

______

33. Why is Li Bai recognized as Tagore in India?

______

34. Besides 871 poems submitted to the organizing committee, what else were acquired?

______

35. What influence has the Li Bai poetry festival on the City of Ma'anshan?
