**〔G94〕小蓝书预测卷十八 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

> 本篇是**新华社电讯体**（HEFEI, Oct. 13 (Xinhua)），属"应用文"第 3 个体例（前两例：G78 书信、G92 报刊短讯）。

**31. 答案：To commemorate Li Bai, a famous Chinese poet from the Tang Dynasty.**
1 题面：For what was a poetry festival held in Ma'anshan City；原文 "A poetry festival kicked off Wednesday to commemorate Li Bai, a famous Chinese poet from the Tang Dynasty (618-907), in Ma'anshan City of east China's Anhui Province."；疑问词 For what（问目的）；诱导信号：in Ma'anshan City 是地点，紧跟在目的之后。
2 候选：①to commemorate Li Bai；②to promote bilateral cultural exchange（另一活动）；③to exhibit statues；④to celebrate the city's birthday。
3 验算：①→to commemorate Li Bai, a famous Chinese poet，to do 目的直接给出→成立（可补 Tang Dynasty）。②→A poem recital activity will also be held online…to promote bilateral cultural exchange，是另一项活动的目的→次优。③→statues 是展览内容，不是举办目的→排除。④→原文无城市生日→排除。
4 干扰：promote bilateral cultural exchange 是文中另一个 to do；展出雕像也很具体。
5 意图：考"For what 取 to do 目的，并区分另一活动的目的"。
6 边界：若问 Where was the festival held? 答 In Ma'anshan City, Anhui Province。若问 What online activity will be held? 答 A poem recital activity between Chinese and Japanese poem enthusiasts。
7 错误：A 答 To promote cultural exchange.（错因：另一活动的目的）；B 答 To show statues.（错因：内容当目的）；C 答 To sell poems.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R94.1 若问 For what was X held，then 取 to do 目的（to commemorate Li Bai）；同段另一活动（online recital）的目的（promote bilateral cultural exchange）按活动主体排除；展览内容（statues）不作目的。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 目的（to do）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条区分两个活动的目的。
10 自检：①第一篇的 to do 是什么？②promote 属哪个活动？③地点在哪？

**32. 答案：More than 500 representatives — poetry experts, scholars and poetry lovers from across the country.**
1 题面：Who attended the 33rd Li Bai poetry festival；原文 "More than 500 representatives attended the opening ceremony of the 33rd Li Bai poetry festival, including poetry experts, scholars and poetry lovers from across the country."；疑问词 Who attended（问参加者）；诱导信号：同段还有 Chinese and Japanese poem enthusiasts（线上活动参与者）。
2 候选：①more than 500 representatives（experts／scholars／lovers）；②Chinese and Japanese poem enthusiasts；③participants who visit the tomb；④the organizing committee。
3 验算：①→More than 500 representatives attended the opening ceremony…including poetry experts, scholars and poetry lovers，人数＋构成同句→成立。②→线上诗歌朗诵活动的参与者，不是本届开幕式参加者→次优。③→Participants will pay homage…是后文的安排，范围不同→次优。④→组委会是主办方→排除。
4 干扰：Japanese enthusiasts 让"参加者"范围看起来更广；organizing committee 出现在第 4 段。
5 意图：考"参加者取 attended 的主语（500 余名代表），线上参与者不作本届出席者"。
6 边界：若问 How many editions of the festival have there been? 答 This is the 33rd。若问 Who will visit Li Bai's tomb? 答 The participants（on Thursday）。
7 错误：A 答 Japanese poem enthusiasts.（错因：线上活动）；B 答 Only Chinese scholars.（错因：漏 representatives 与 lovers）；C 答 The Poetry Institute of China.（错因：授予称号的机构）。
8 规则：R94.2 若问 Who attended X，then 取 attended 的主语（more than 500 representatives）＋including 后的构成（experts／scholars／lovers）；线上活动的参与者（Japanese enthusiasts）与主办方（organizing committee）不作出席者。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（出席者）；复用 R63.3（来源取 from 后），本条是 attended 主语。
10 自检：①attended 的主语是什么？②including 后有哪些人？③线上参与者算吗？

**33. 答案：Because Li Bai is a household name in China, just as Tagore is a household name in India (or as Shakespeare is to the UK).**
1 题面：Why is Li Bai recognized as Tagore in India；原文 "Li Bai is a household name in China as Shakespeare to the UK or Tagore to India."；疑问词 Why is X recognized as Y（问类比含义）；诱导信号：Tagore／Shakespeare 都是外国名人，容易被当成"李白去过印度"。
2 候选：①两人都是本国家喻户晓的诗人（household name）；②李白在印度生活过；③李白与泰戈尔是朋友；④李白用印地语写诗。
3 验算：①→Li Bai is a household name in China as Shakespeare to the UK or Tagore to India，as 结构表类比，共同点是 household name→成立。②③④→原文无，且与类比结构不符→排除。
4 干扰：as 引导的类比容易被读成"身份相同"或"经历相同"；两个外国名字也抢注意。
5 意图：考"as 类比取共同属性（household name），不编经历"。
6 边界：若问 What does "a household name" mean? 答 A person everyone knows（家喻户晓的人）。若问 When did Li Bai live? 答 Between 701 and 762。
7 错误：A 答 Li Bai once lived in India.（错因：编造经历）；B 答 They were friends.（错因：无据）；C 答 Both wrote in English.（错因：常识错误）。
8 规则：R94.3 若题干用 as／like 作类比（as Tagore to India），then 取两者的共同属性（household name），不编共同经历／国籍／语言；类比结构中的 as 不译"作为"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（类比取共同点）；复用 R41.1（be characterized by 取属性），本条是"类比取属性"。
10 自检：①as 前后各是谁？②共同点是什么？③我编经历了吗？

**34. 答案：More than 100 statues of Li Bai and figures that appeared in his poems, collected from all over China.**
1 题面：Besides 871 poems submitted to the organizing committee, what else were acquired；原文 "A total of 871 poems have been submitted to the organizing committee to participate in this year's festival. More than 100 statues of Li Bai and figures that appeared in his poems have been collected from all over China for exhibition at the festival."；题干 Besides 已排除 871 poems；疑问词 what else were acquired（问另一类收集物）。
2 候选：①more than 100 statues；②871 poems（题干已排除）；③Li Bai's tomb；④the city's name。
3 验算：①→More than 100 statues of Li Bai and figures…have been collected，collect 与 acquire 同义→成立（可补"来自全国各地"）。②→besides 已排除→不成立。③→tomb 是参访地点，不是收集物→排除。④→城市名不是收集物→排除。
4 干扰：871 与 100 两个数字同段，容易互换；tomb 也是"李白的相关物"。
5 意图：考"Besides 排除已给项、取另一类收集物（雕像）"。
6 边界：若问 How many poems were submitted this year? 答 871。若问 Where were the statues collected from? 答 From all over China。
7 错误：A 答 871 poems.（错因：题干已排除）；B 答 Li Bai's tomb.（错因：参访地）；C 答 100 poems.（错因：数字与对象错配）。
8 规则：R94.4 若题干 Besides A，what else，then 取另一类并列物（more than 100 statues）＋来源（from all over China）；被排除的 A（871 poems）不得重写；参访地点（tomb）不作收集物。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.48 排除域（besides）；复用 R41.5（besides 剔除同域），本条同域是"节庆收集物"。
10 自检：①besides 后是什么？②另一类是什么？③数字配错了吗？

**35. 答案：It has become a shining cultural activity of the city, and Ma'anshan was named Chinese City of Poetry in 2014.**
1 题面：What influence has the Li Bai poetry festival on the City of Ma'anshan；原文 "The first Li Bai poetry festival was held in 1989 in Ma'anshan, and it has become a shining cultural activity of the city ever since. Ma'anshan was named as Chinese City of Poetry by the Poetry Institute of China in 2014."；疑问词 What influence（问影响）；诱导信号：首段说 festival kicked off Wednesday 是本届事实。
2 候选：①成为城市的文化名片（shining cultural activity）＋2014 获"中国诗歌之城"；②本届有 500 人参加；③李白葬于大青山；④共收到 871 首诗。
3 验算：①→has become a shining cultural activity of the city＋named as Chinese City of Poetry in 2014，两句都是"对城市的影响"→成立（两点都写）。②③④→本届规模／墓葬／投稿数是事实，不是"对城市的影响"→排除。
4 干扰：871／500／100 等数字都在文中；"李白葬于此"也很像城市荣誉。
5 意图：考"影响取 has become／was named 两句，规模与史实不作影响"。
6 边界：若问 When was the first festival held? 答 In 1989。若问 Who named Ma'anshan Chinese City of Poetry? 答 The Poetry Institute of China。
7 错误：A 答 500 people attended.（错因：规模当影响）；B 答 Li Bai is buried there.（错因：史实）；C 答 871 poems were submitted.（错因：投稿数）。
8 规则：R94.5 若问 What influence has X on a place，then 取 has become…／was named… 两句（文化名片＋城市称号），两点都写；本届规模、墓葬、投稿数等事实不作影响。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.16 影响（对城市）；复用 R61.5（影响取他人／他地变化），本条对象是城市。
10 自检：①has become 后是什么？②2014 发生了什么？③我写了人数吗？

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十六 · Passage 1

If you enjoy walking for exercise, there's a simple way to meet your demand—change your walk into a ruck, and it's an increasingly popular form of exercise. This kind of exercise has helped more and more people start to love sports.

Rucking is walking with weight on your back. The term "rucking" comes from ruck marching, a core skill used by the military around the world. One of the tests the army normally gives to soldiers is a 12-mile ruck, which they must complete within three hours while carrying a weight of at least 35 pounds.

The reason why rucking is growing in popularity is that it's an easy and all-body exercise. One study in 2019 showed that 10 weeks of weighted walking improved physical performance. Since rucking is usually performed outdoors, there is no doubt that it's also good for your mental health. Lots of studies suggest that the mental health benefits of being in a natural environment are huge.

There are several tips for your rucking when you get started. First, don't be too eager. As with any new exercise, you'll need to begin slowly. Start with an empty backpack (背包) and walk a distance you've already done. When you start adding weight to your pack, try something low, like 10% of your body weight. Adding weight is going to put more stress on your ankles, knees, hips and back, so do it gradually. Another option is to start with a weighted vest (背心) instead of a backpack. This spreads the weight between your front and back. And of course, don't forget your feet. Select a comfortable pair of shoes to prevent getting hurt.

**〔G95〕小蓝书预测卷十六 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：It is walking with weight on your back.**
1 题面：What is rucking；原文 "Rucking is walking with weight on your back. The term 'rucking' comes from ruck marching, a core skill used by the military around the world."；疑问词 What is X（问定义）；诱导信号：下一句的 ruck marching 与 12-mile ruck 都是同源说法。
2 候选：①walking with weight on your back；②ruck marching（来源词）；③a 12-mile test（军队测试）；④walking for exercise（上位）。
3 验算：①→Rucking is walking with weight on your back，主系表直接给定义→成立。②→ruck marching 是词源，不是定义→次优。③→12-mile ruck 是军队测试项目→排除。④→walking for exercise 是上位概念，丢了"负重"这一关键→次优。
4 干扰：comes from ruck marching 紧跟定义句，像"解释"；12-mile／35 pounds 的数字也抢注意。
5 意图：考"定义取 is 后的动名词短语，词源与例证不作定义"。
6 边界：若问 Where does the word "rucking" come from? 答 From ruck marching（a core skill used by the military）。若问 What is the army's ruck test? 答 A 12-mile ruck within three hours carrying at least 35 pounds。
7 错误：A 答 Ruck marching.（错因：词源当定义）；B 答 A 12-mile walk.（错因：测试项目）；C 答 Walking for exercise.（错因：漏"负重"）。
8 规则：R95.1 若问 What is X（术语），then 取 is 后的定义短语（walking with weight on your back），关键限定（with weight）不能丢；词源（comes from）与具体测试（12-mile／35 pounds）只作补充。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.27 定义（术语）；复用 R44.1（术语取定义句），本条是"主系表定义"。
10 自检：①is 后是什么？②ruck marching 是什么？③"负重"丢了吗？

**17. 答案：Because it is an easy and all-body exercise (and it is also good for mental health).**
1 题面：Why is rucking popular；原文 "The reason why rucking is growing in popularity is that it's an easy and all-body exercise. One study in 2019 showed that 10 weeks of weighted walking improved physical performance. Since rucking is usually performed outdoors, there is no doubt that it's also good for your mental health."；疑问词 Why is X popular（问原因）；诱导信号：2019 研究／10 周／户外三段都是支撑，容易只写研究。
2 候选：①easy and all-body exercise（＋good for mental health）；②one study in 2019（证据）；③because the army uses it；④because it is cheap。
3 验算：①→The reason why…is that it's an easy and all-body exercise，表语从句直接给因；后面 outdoors／mental health 是第二条支撑→成立（可两条都写）。②→研究是证据，不是原因本身→次优。③→军队使用是词源背景→排除。④→价格原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：One study in 2019 有年份与数据，最像"原因"；10 weeks 也很具体。
5 意图：考"原因取 The reason why…is that 的表语从句，研究证据不作原因"。
6 边界：若问 What did the 2019 study show? 答 10 weeks of weighted walking improved physical performance。若问 Why is rucking good for mental health? 答 Because it is usually performed outdoors。
7 错误：A 答 Because a study in 2019 showed it.（错因：证据当原因）；B 答 Because soldiers use it.（错因：背景）；C 答 Because it is cheap.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R95.2 若问 Why is X popular，then 取 The reason why…is that 后的表语（easy and all-body exercise），可补第二条（mental health／outdoors）；研究年份与数据只作证据。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（表语从句）；复用 R30.3（so 前为因）的变体，本条标记是 The reason why…is that。
10 自检：①表语从句是什么？②2019 研究算什么？③有第二条原因吗？

**18. 答案：Outdoors.**
1 题面：Where is rucking usually performed；原文 "Since rucking is usually performed outdoors, there is no doubt that it's also good for your mental health."；疑问词 Where（问地点）；诱导信号：首段提到 city roads／parks（那是"新运动"那篇，不是本篇）；本篇的 12-mile ruck 是军队测试。
2 候选：①outdoors；②on city roads；③in the gym；④in parks。
3 验算：①→rucking is usually performed outdoors，地点副词直接给出→成立。②④→属另一篇（卷十六 P3 新运动）的地点，串篇→排除。③→原文无 gym→排除。
4 干扰：新运动篇的 parks／side of roads 与本题同卷相邻，最容易串；military 场景也像"训练场"。
5 意图：考"Where 取 performed 后的地点副词，防同卷串篇"。
6 边界：若问 Why is rucking good for mental health? 答 Because it is performed outdoors（being in nature helps）。若问 Who uses ruck marching? 答 The military。
7 错误：A 答 In parks.（错因：串篇）；B 答 On city roads.（错因：串篇）；C 答 In the gym.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R95.3 若问 Where is X usually performed，then 取 performed 后的地点副词（outdoors）；同卷其他篇章的地点（parks／city roads）与本篇测试场地（military）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（副词）；复用 R80.1（Where 取介词／副词短语），本条是"防串篇"。

**19. 答案：It is mainly about some tips for starting rucking — begin slowly, add weight gradually, try a weighted vest, and wear comfortable shoes.**
1 题面：What is the last paragraph mainly about；末段原文 "There are several tips for your rucking when you get started. First, don't be too eager… Start with an empty backpack… try something low, like 10% of your body weight… Another option is to start with a weighted vest… And of course, don't forget your feet. Select a comfortable pair of shoes to prevent getting hurt."；疑问词 What is Paragraph N mainly about（问段意）；诱导信号：前三段讲定义／流行原因／好处，容易串。
2 候选：①起步建议（慢慢来／渐进加重量／可用背心／穿舒适鞋）；②rucking 的定义；③rucking 的好处；④军队测试标准。
3 验算：①→段首 several tips for your rucking when you get started＋First／Another option／And of course 四条建议→成立（列 2—3 条即可）。②③→在前三段→排除。④→第二段→排除。
4 干扰：10% 与 35 pounds 的数字都在讲"重量"，容易把段意写成"重量标准"；First／Another option 的标志词若不抓，会读成散例。
5 意图：考"段意取段首主题句（several tips）＋标志词列举"。
6 边界：若问 What is the first tip? 答 Don't be too eager — begin slowly。若问 What percentage of body weight is suggested at first? 答 About 10%。
7 错误：A 答 The definition of rucking.（错因：串段）；B 答 The benefits of rucking.（错因：串段）；C 答 The army's weight standard.（错因：数字误解）。
8 规则：R95.4 若问 What is the last paragraph mainly about，then 取段首主题句（several tips for getting started）＋First／Another option 等标志下的 2—3 条建议；前几段的定义、好处与军队标准不作本段段意。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.2 段意概括（建议型）；复用 R82.3（段意取首句＋段末），本条标志词为 First／Another option。
10 自检：①段首主题句是什么？②有几条建议？③10% 是什么？

**20. 答案：To prevent getting hurt.**
1 题面：Why choose a comfortable pair of shoes；原文 "And of course, don't forget your feet. Select a comfortable pair of shoes to prevent getting hurt."；疑问词 Why choose（问目的）；诱导信号：同段另有 10%／weighted vest 等做法，都带各自目的。
2 候选：①to prevent getting hurt；②to walk faster；③to look good；④to save money。

4 干扰：同段"10% of your body weight"与"spreads the weight"都和身体有关，容易串成"为了保护膝盖"（原文此句讲的是加重的压力，不是鞋子）。
5 意图：考"目的取同句 to do，不跨句借理由"。
6 边界：若问 What does a weighted vest do? 答 It spreads the weight between your front and back。若问 What may happen if you add weight too fast? 答 It puts more stress on your ankles, knees, hips and back。
7 错误：A 答 To protect the knees.（错因：跨句借理由）；B 答 To walk faster.（错因：无据）；C 答 To keep warm.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R95.5 若问 Why choose／do a specific thing，then 取该句的 to do 目的（to prevent getting hurt）；同段其他动作的目的（spread the weight／reduce stress）不跨句挪用。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 目的（同句 to do）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条是"末句目的"。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十六 · Passage 2

Most people have ambitions. An ambition is something we want to do, want to be or want to have. A student's ambition, for example, might be to pass his or her exams and then get a good job. An athlete's ambition could be to win an important competition. A businessman's ambition is usually to make a lot of money. These are the most common stories about ambition.

But there are also those whose ambitions are different from what most people understand. Not all ambitions are about success at work, however. Some people just want to be a good people, have a family or help others. It's also an important thing in their lives.

Ben's ambition is to be a sports writer. He writes the sports reports for his class newspaper. He likes most sports, and swimming and football are his favorites. Trudy's ambition is to be a concert pianist. She is very serious about it and practices every day with her best friend Lily. It is very important to her. Harry's ambition changes every day! One day he wants to be an astronaut. The next day he wants to be a pop singer. The next day he wants to drive a racing car. His mother would be happy if his ambition was to get up in time for school every day!

So ambition, no matter how big or small, as long as you can live happily, then it is meaningful.

**〔G96〕小蓝书预测卷十六 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：It is something we want to do, want to be or want to have.**
1 题面：What's an ambition；原文 "Most people have ambitions. An ambition is something we want to do, want to be or want to have."；疑问词 What's X（问定义）；诱导信号：后文举了学生／运动员／商人的三种抱负，容易被当成定义。
2 候选：①something we want to do, want to be or want to have；②a big dream of success（概括）；③a plan for a job；④the three examples（student／athlete／businessman）。
3 验算：①→An ambition is something we want to do, want to be or want to have，三项并列完整→成立（三项都写）。②→原文用三个 want 分述，概括词会丢项→次优。③→plan for a job 太窄→排除。④→例子不是定义→排除。
4 干扰：后三段的人物例子篇幅更大；want to do／be／have 三个短语结构相似，易只抄一项。
5 意图：考"定义取 is 后的三项并列，例子不作定义"。
6 边界：若问 What is an athlete's ambition? 答 To win an important competition。若问 What is a businessman's ambition? 答 To make a lot of money。
7 错误：A 答 A big dream.（错因：概括丢项）；B 答 A job plan.（错因：过窄）；C 答 To make money.（错因：例子当定义）。
8 规则：R96.1 若问 What's X（抽象名词），then 取 is 后的三项并列（want to do／want to be／want to have），三项不省；后文的三个例子只作例证。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.27 定义（三项并列）；复用 R87.4（并列两项），本条是三项。
10 自检：①is 后有几项？②例子能当定义吗？③我漏了哪项？

**22. 答案：It might be to pass his or her exams and then get a good job.**
1 题面：What's a student's ambition；原文 "A student's ambition, for example, might be to pass his or her exams and then get a good job."；疑问词 What's a student's ambition（问例子）；诱导信号：同段还有 athlete's／businessman's 两种抱负。
2 候选：①to pass exams and then get a good job；②to win a competition；③to make a lot of money；④to be a good person。
3 验算：①→might be to pass his or her exams and then get a good job，两步先后清楚→成立（可加 might 的"例如"语气）。②③→运动员／商人的抱负→排除。④→是第二段"另类抱负"的例子→排除。
4 干扰：三个例子并列，容易串；pass exams 与 get a good job 是先后关系，也常被只写一步。
5 意图：考"例子题按主体配对（student→exams＋job）"。
6 边界：若问 What's an athlete's ambition? 答 To win an important competition。若问 What's a businessman's ambition? 答 To make a lot of money。
7 错误：A 答 To make money.（错因：商人）；B 答 To win a competition.（错因：运动员）；C 答 To pass exams.（错因：漏第二步）。
8 规则：R96.2 若问 What's a student's／athlete's ambition，then 按主体名配对同句内容（student→pass exams＋get a good job）；两步先后不省；其他主体的抱负不串。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.41 多主体配对（例子）；复用 R41.4（按名配对），本条主体是"身份"。
10 自检：①student 对应哪句？②两步都写了吗？③我串到商人了吗？

**23. 答案：No, he doesn't. He wants to be a sports writer (not a music writer).**
1 题面：Does Ben want to be a music writer；原文 "Ben's ambition is to be a sports writer."；疑问词 Does…（一般疑问＋近义替换）；诱导信号：writer 一词相同，sports 与 music 只差一个词。
2 候选：①No＋sports writer；②Yes（music writer）；③No＋a concert pianist；④Yes, a sports writer。
3 验算：①→Ben's ambition is to be a sports writer，与 music writer 不同→答 No＋改正→成立。②→与原文不符→不成立。③→concert pianist 是 Trudy 的抱负→排除。④→Yes 与 No 矛盾→排除。
4 干扰：writer 相同，读快了会把 sports 看成 music；Trudy 的 music 相关抱负（concert pianist）也在同段，强化误读。
5 意图：考"一般疑问＋近义替换（music vs sports）：先否定，再给正确项"。
6 边界：若问 What's Trudy's ambition? 答 To be a concert pianist。若问 Who practises every day with Lily? 答 Trudy。
7 错误：A 答 Yes, he does.（错因：music／sports 混）；B 答 No, he wants to be a pianist.（错因：人物错位）；C 答 No, he wants to be an astronaut.（错因：Harry）。
8 规则：R96.3 若一般疑问把原文的词替换成近义词（music writer↔sports writer），then 答 No＋原文正确项；同段他人（Trudy 的 concert pianist）与同段他人抱负（Harry 的 astronaut）不串。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答（近义替换）；复用 R43.3（Yes/No＋补事实），本条是"近义词辨异"。
10 自检：①Ben 想当什么？②music 是谁的？③我答 Yes 了吗？

**24. 答案：No, they aren't. Some people just want to be good people, have a family or help others.**
1 题面：Are all the ambitions about success at work；原文 "Not all ambitions are about success at work, however. Some people just want to be a good people, have a family or help others."；疑问词 Are all…（全称判断）；诱导信号：all 是全称词，原文用 Not all 否定。
2 候选：①No＋some just want to be good people／have a family／help others；②Yes（all about work）；③No（无例子）；④Yes, but not everyone。
3 验算：①→Not all ambitions are about success at work＋Some people just want to…，全称否定＋反例→成立（三条任举）。②→与 Not all 相反→不成立。③→表态对但缺反例→次优。④→Yes 与 all 冲突→排除。
4 干扰：首段三个例子（学生／运动员／商人）都指向"工作成功"，容易让人答 Yes；Not all 的否定范围也易读成"没有"。
5 意图：考"全称判断用 Not all 否定，须给反例"。
6 边界：若问 What do some people want instead of work success? 答 To be good people, have a family or help others。若问 Is such an ambition important? 答 Yes — It's also an important thing in their lives。
7 错误：A 答 Yes, they are.（错因：与 Not all 相反）；B 答 No, no one cares about work.（错因：否定过度）；C 答 No, because ambitions are different.（错因：笼统、无例）。
8 规则：R96.4 若题干用全称词（all），then 按原文 Not all 答 No＋至少一个反例（be good people／family／help others）；不得答 Yes，也不得把 Not all 说成 none。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答（全称否定）；复用 R44.1（定义句取全），本条是"全称量词"。
10 自检：①原文用的是 Not all 吗？②反例有哪几条？③我答"没人关心工作"了吗？

**25. 答案：No, he doesn't (probably). His mother would be happy if his ambition was to get up in time for school every day — which suggests he often doesn't.**
1 题面：Does Harry get up in time for school every day；原文 "Harry's ambition changes every day! One day he wants to be an astronaut. The next day he wants to be a pop singer. The next day he wants to drive a racing car. His mother would be happy if his ambition was to get up in time for school every day!"；疑问词 Does…（一般疑问＋推断）；诱导信号：原文没有直接说"他起不来"，只用一个虚拟语气句。
2 候选：①No（母亲"要是他立志每天按时起床就好了"暗示他做不到）；②Yes（原文没说他迟到）；③Yes, because his mother is happy；④无法判断。
3 验算：①→would be happy if his ambition was to get up in time，虚拟语气表示"现在并非如此"，故推断 No→成立（须写明依据）。②→忽略虚拟语气，字面"没说他迟到"就答 Yes→不成立。③→母亲是"would be happy"（假设），不是现在高兴→排除。④→原文提供了推断线索，不能答"无法判断"→次优。
4 干扰：虚拟语气（would be／was）在中文里不明显，容易按字面读成"如果他立志…"；Harry 志向多变的笑点也可能掩盖"起床"这一句。
5 意图：考"虚拟语气表与事实相反→推断 No，并写明依据"。
6 边界：若问 Why does Harry's mother say that? 答 Because Harry's ambitions change every day and he can't even get up in time。若问 What does the writer think of ambition? 答 No matter how big or small, as long as you can live happily, it is meaningful。
7 错误：A 答 Yes, he does.（错因：忽略虚拟）；B 答 We can't know.（错因：放弃推断）；C 答 No, because he is lazy.（错因：无据评价）。
8 规则：R96.5 若题干问 Does sb do X 且原文只有虚拟语气句（would be happy if…／if only…），then 按"与事实相反"推断 No，并写出依据句；不得照字面答 Yes，也不答"无法判断"。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.16 推断（虚拟语气）；复用 R20.4（情态不升格）的反向：本条是"虚拟反事实"，与 R4.3（would have done 不作事实）同族。
10 自检：①原文是虚拟吗？②与事实相反说明什么？③我写了依据吗？

**组小结（G96 · 小蓝书预测卷十六 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：定义三项 1（21）；例子配对 1（22）；近义替换 Yes/No 1（23）；全称否定 1（24）；虚拟推断 1（25）。
- 规则：R96.1 定义取三项（21）；R96.2 例子按主体配对（22）；R96.3 近义替换先否定再改正（23）；R96.4 全称用 Not all＋反例（24）；R96.5 虚拟语气推断 No（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R96.1 与"例子篇幅大"冲突，定义句优先；R96.2 与"三例并列"冲突，主体配对优先；R96.3 与"writer 相同"冲突，sports／music 辨异优先；R96.4 与"首段三例都指工作"冲突，Not all 优先；R96.5 与"字面没说"冲突，虚拟优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：议论性说明文首见（ambition 的定义—反例—举例—总结）；**虚拟语气推断（R96.5）是 04 的新样本**，此前虚拟只用于"排除不实"（R4.3），本处用于"推出事实的反面"；数字无，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十六 · Passage 3

If a traditional sport bores you, it's time to try something new! Cycling, but outdoors on city roads; surfing, but on the land; playing Frisbee (飞碟游戏), but with a group of people...



New sports have been bringing fresh air to our minds and more joy to exercise.

National fitness has been a part of the national plan, aiming to keep people healthier. With great attention paid in support of national fitness, new sports begin to develop. According to a study by Houlang Research Institute, more than 93%of young people born after 2000 are interested in doing sports in the city.

Why do young people like new sports? Houlang's report says that except for keeping fit as a kind of exercise, many young people pick them up to socialize—allowing them to build up their social circles. Players tend to have online group chats talking about their usual activities and simply sharing their lives.

New sports are also "fit for taking photos and are less prevented by places", ZouQingling, the CEO of Lvmama, told China News Service. Gathered together through social media, people can enjoy new sports at many places in the city, from parks to the side of roads.

*Qianjiang Evening News* also says that new sports are easier for new players to start, different from traditional sports, such as football and basketball, which usually require strict and difficult rules. Thus, new sports are less competitive but could bring more fun.

New sports have brought different lifestyles in China as they express various sorts of youth(青春)and fun. This new thing also shows that more people are prepared to enjoy sports, according to China News Service.

26. What is the aim of national fitness in the national plan?

______

27. What kind of people are more interested in new sports?

______

28. Where can people enjoy new sports in the city?

______

29. According to *Qianjiang Evening News*, what is the difference of new sports from traditional sports?

______

30. What is this passage mainly about?

______

**〔G97〕小蓝书预测卷十六 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：To keep people healthier.**
1 题面：What is the aim of national fitness in the national plan；原文 "National fitness has been a part of the national plan, aiming to keep people healthier."；疑问词 What is the aim（问目的）；诱导信号：下一句 With great attention paid in support of national fitness 是背景。
2 候选：①to keep people healthier；②to develop new sports；③to build more parks；④to help young people socialize。
3 验算：①→aiming to keep people healthier，aiming to do 直接给目的→成立。②→new sports 是"全民健身受重视"的结果，不是目的→次优。③→parks 是运动地点→排除。④→socialize 是年轻人参加新运动的原因→排除。
4 干扰：to develop new sports 紧跟其后（new sports begin to develop），也像目的；parks／socialize 都在段内。
5 意图：考"aim 取 aiming to do，结果（new sports develop）不作目的"。
6 边界：若问 Why do young people like new sports? 答 Because they can socialize（build up social circles）。若问 What percentage of young people born after 2000 are interested? 答 More than 93%。
7 错误：A 答 To develop new sports.（错因：结果当目的）；B 答 To build parks.（错因：地点）；C 答 To socialize.（错因：另一层原因）。
8 规则：R97.1 若问 What is the aim of X，then 取 aiming to do 后的内容（to keep people healthier）；其后出现的结果（new sports develop）与地点、社交等分项不作总目的。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 目的（aiming to do）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条是"政策目的"。
10 自检：①aiming to 后是什么？②new sports develop 是什么？③socialize 属谁？

**27. 答案：Young people born after 2000 — more than 93% of them are interested in doing sports in the city.**
1 题面：What kind of people are more interested in new sports；原文 "According to a study by Houlang Research Institute, more than 93%of young people born after 2000 are interested in doing sports in the city."；疑问词 What kind of people（问人群）；诱导信号：同段还有 many young people pick them up to socialize 的原因句。
2 候选：①young people born after 2000（93%＋）；②old people；③children under 10；④people who like traditional sports。
3 验算：①→more than 93%of young people born after 2000 are interested in doing sports in the city，人群＋比例同句→成立（比例可写）。②③→原文未提，且与"新运动"的社会化特征不符→排除。④→traditional sports 是被对比的一方→排除。
4 干扰：93% 的百分号容易丢；Houlang Research Institute 的机构名也抢注意。
5 意图：考"人群取 young people born after 2000，比例照抄不丢百分号"。
6 边界：若问 What do many young people pick up new sports for besides keeping fit? 答 To socialize（to build up social circles）。若问 What institute did the study? 答 Houlang Research Institute。
7 错误：A 答 Old people.（错因：无据）；B 答 People who like football.（错因：传统运动）；C 答 93 people.（错因：丢百分号）。
8 规则：R97.2 若问 What kind of people are interested in X，then 取人群限定（young people born after 2000）＋比例（more than 93%，百分号不丢）；研究机构名与原因句不作人群。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（人群限定）；复用 R85.2（限定人群），本条带比例。
10 自检：①人群怎么限定？②比例多少？③百分号丢了吗？

**28. 答案：At many places in the city — from parks to the side of roads.**
1 题面：Where can people enjoy new sports in the city；原文 "Gathered together through social media, people can enjoy new sports at many places in the city, from parks to the side of roads."；疑问词 Where（问地点）；诱导信号：同段还有 online group chats（那是社交方式，不是运动地点）。
2 候选：①many places in the city（from parks to the side of roads）；②online（group chats）；③in stadiums only；④at home。
3 验算：①→at many places in the city, from parks to the side of roads，地点＋举例→成立。②→social media／online chats 是组织方式→不成立。③→stadiums 原文未提，且与"不被场地限制"相反→排除。④→at home 无据→排除。
4 干扰：Gathered together through social media 在句首，容易被当地点；"less prevented by places"也像"哪里都行"的笼统说法。
5 意图：考"Where 取 at＋地点＋from…to…举例，线上方式不作地点"。
6 边界：若问 How do people gather for new sports? 答 Through social media。若问 Why are new sports "less prevented by places"? 答 Because they can be enjoyed at many places, from parks to the side of roads。
7 错误：A 答 Online.（错因：方式当地点）；B 答 In stadiums.（错因：与原文相反）；C 答 At school.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R97.3 若问 Where can people enjoy X，then 取 at＋地点（many places in the city）＋from…to…举例（parks／side of roads）；社交方式（social media／online chats）不作地点；与"不受场地限制"相反的选项（stadiums）排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（地点＋举例）；复用 R80.1（Where 取介词短语），本条带范围举例。
10 自检：①at 后是什么？②social media 是什么？③场馆有据吗？

**29. 答案：New sports are easier for new players to start and do not require strict and difficult rules; they are less competitive but bring more fun.**
1 题面：According to *Qianjiang Evening News*, what is the difference of new sports from traditional sports；原文 "*Qianjiang Evening News* also says that new sports are easier for new players to start, different from traditional sports, such as football and basketball, which usually require strict and difficult rules. Thus, new sports are less competitive but could bring more fun."；疑问词 What is the difference（问差异，须带来源）；诱导信号：同段前面有 Zou Qingling 的"适合拍照、不受场地限制"，属他人观点。
2 候选：①easier to start＋no strict rules＋less competitive but more fun；②fit for taking photos（Zou 的观点）；③they need strict rules；④they are more competitive。
3 验算：①→easier for new players to start…which usually require strict and difficult rules＋less competitive but could bring more fun，三处差异→成立（写两三条）。②→是 Lvmama CEO 的说法，不属 Qianjiang Evening News→次优。③→strict rules 是传统运动的特点→不成立（方向反）。④→more competitive 与 less competitive 相反→排除。
4 干扰：Zou Qingling 的"适合拍照"在同一段前文，来源不同容易混；strict rules 属传统运动，最易反向作答。
5 意图：考"来源限定（According to X）＋差异双向（新运动 vs 传统运动）"。
6 边界：若问 What do traditional sports usually require? 答 Strict and difficult rules。若问 What does Zou Qingling say about new sports? 答 They are fit for taking photos and less prevented by places。
7 错误：A 答 They require strict rules.（错因：把传统运动的特点安到新运动）；B 答 They are fit for taking photos.（错因：来源错）；C 答 They are more competitive.（错因：反义）。
8 规则：R97.4 若题干限定 According to＋某媒体／某人，then 只取该来源的句子（Qianjiang Evening News：easier to start／no strict rules／less competitive but more fun）；同段他人的观点（Zou Qingling）不作本问答案；strict rules 属传统运动，方向不可反。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.29 对比结构（取差异）；复用 R40.2（来源限定），本条是"媒体来源限定"。
10 自检：①来源是谁？②Zou 的观点在哪？③strict rules 属于谁？

**30. 答案：It is mainly about new sports — why young people like them and what they bring to China.**
1 题面：What is this passage mainly about；全文：新运动举例（cycling outdoors／land surfing／Frisbee）→全民健身背景与 93% 数据→年轻人喜欢的原因（健身＋社交）→特点（适合拍照、不受场地限制、规则简单、更有趣）→意义（不同生活方式、青春与乐趣）；疑问词 mainly about（问主旨）；诱导信号：具体运动名（Frisbee／cycling）与媒体名（Qianjiang Evening News／China News Service）很多。
2 候选：①new sports（原因＋特点＋意义）；②traditional sports（football／basketball）；③Frisbee only；④national fitness plan only。
3 验算：①→各段都围绕 new sports，且末段 New sports have brought different lifestyles…→成立。②→traditional sports 只作对比→排除。③→Frisbee 是首段一例→排除。④→national fitness 只是背景一半→次优。
4 干扰：Frisbee／surfing 具体例子好记；93% 数据醒目；媒体名多，也像"主旨"。
5 意图：考"主旨取覆盖全文的上位对象（new sports），例子与背景不作主旨"。
6 边界：若问 What examples of new sports are mentioned? 答 Cycling outdoors, land surfing and playing Frisbee。若问 What has national fitness been part of? 答 The national plan。
7 错误：A 答 Frisbee.（错因：一例当主旨）；B 答 Traditional sports.（错因：对比项）；C 答 The national plan.（错因：背景）。
8 规则：R97.5 若问 main idea 且全文围绕一个上位对象展开（new sports），then 取该对象＋其"原因／特点／意义"三层；具体运动例子（Frisbee／cycling）、数据（93%）与背景政策（national fitness）都不作主旨。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.1 主旨（上位对象）；复用 R41.2（主旨取总＋分），本条对象是"新运动"。
10 自检：①全文围绕什么？②Frisbee 是什么？③national fitness 占几段？

**组小结（G97 · 小蓝书预测卷十六 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：政策目的 1（26）；人群＋比例 1（27）；地点＋举例 1（28）；来源限定的差异 1（29）；主旨 1（30）。
- 规则：R97.1 aim 取 aiming to do（26）；R97.2 人群限定＋比例（27）；R97.3 地点＋举例（28）；R97.4 来源限定＋差异双向（29）；R97.5 主旨取上位对象（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R97.1 与"new sports develop 紧跟"冲突，aiming 优先；R97.2 与"93% 醒目"冲突，人群优先；R97.3 与"social media 在句首"冲突，地点优先；R97.4 与"Zou 观点同段"冲突，来源优先；R97.5 与"Frisbee 好记"冲突，上位对象优先。
- 无未归类。
- 覆盖检查：社会现象说明文首见（新运动）；**百分比第 4 例**（93%，照抄类）；**来源限定（According to＋媒体名）第 2 例**（第 1 例 R40.2 段落限定，本条是媒体来源）；数字（93%／2000 后）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十六 · Passage 4

After visiting a friend, Tay, together with her three-year-old son and his "favourite companion", a toy monkey, caught the train to go back to their home in Bristol.

As they switched trains at Birmingham New Street station, Tay realized that the monkey had been left behind. Her son, she said, was heartbroken.

"He just burst into tears," Tay said. "I reassured him that lots of kind people were looking for the monkey and the postman would send it back."

Tay was not hopeful about a reunion but the monkey was a gift to her son on the day he was born, so she passed its sentimental (情感的) value to the train staff.

As she and her disappointed son made their way home, staff at train companies worked together to find the toy. They succeed in finding the monkey. To give the monkey a comfortable place to stay, staff found it a sweater that had been previously used as a Christmas decoration. Next morning, the monkey, was on an early train from Birmingham to Bristol, where Tay was waiting.

"I collected it on my bicycle and brought it home.I just said to' my son 'guess what I've got for you' and pulled it out my bag." She added that the monkey's new sweater had been a "lovely surprise".

In total, four train companies helped the monkey home and it covered an extra 619 miles. Tay said, "The monkey's been with my son ever since and we are keeping it close, so no more adventures for it in the future."

31. What was the son's reaction when he found the monkey lost?

______

32. How did the mother comfort her son?

______

33. Why was the monkey precious to the boy?

______

34. What added to the pleasure of their reunion with the monkey?

______

35. What qualities do you think the railway staff have?

______

**〔G98〕小蓝书预测卷十六 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：He burst into tears (he was heartbroken).**
1 题面：What was the son's reaction when he found the monkey lost；原文 "As they switched trains at Birmingham New Street station, Tay realized that the monkey had been left behind. Her son, she said, was heartbroken. 'He just burst into tears,' Tay said."；疑问词 What was sb's reaction（问反应）；诱导信号：同段还有 Tay was not hopeful about a reunion，那是母亲的感受。
2 候选：①he burst into tears（heartbroken）；②he was angry；③he laughed；④he didn't care。
3 验算：①→was heartbroken＋He just burst into tears，两处同向→成立。②→angry 原文未提→排除。③→laugh 与 heartbroken 相反→排除。④→didn't care 相反→排除。
4 干扰：母亲"不抱希望"与儿子的反应容易混；Birmingham New Street station 的换乘细节也抢注意。
5 意图：考"反应取孩子的直接引语（burst into tears），母亲的感受不作孩子反应"。
6 边界：若问 Where did they realize the monkey was lost? 答 At Birmingham New Street station。若问 How did the mother feel about a reunion? 答 She was not hopeful。
7 错误：A 答 He was angry.（错因：无据）；B 答 He laughed.（错因：相反）；C 答 He didn't care.（错因：相反）。
8 规则：R98.1 若问 What was sb's reaction，then 取该人的直接描写（burst into tears／heartbroken）；同段他人的心理（Tay was not hopeful）按主体排除；地点细节不作反应。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.13 情绪（主体配对）；复用 R74.2（态度按主体），本条是"孩子反应"。
10 自检：①孩子的反应句在哪？②母亲的态度是什么？③我混主体了吗？

**32. 答案：She reassured him that lots of kind people were looking for the monkey and that the postman would send it back.**
1 题面：How did the mother comfort her son；原文 "'I reassured him that lots of kind people were looking for the monkey and the postman would send it back.'"；疑问词 How did sb comfort（问做法）；诱导信号：后文员工真的找到了玩具，容易把"结果"当"安慰的方式"。
2 候选：①reassured him（kind people looking＋postman would send it back）；②bought him a new toy；③promised to go back to the station；④told him to stop crying。
3 验算：①→I reassured him that…and…，reassure 的内容两句并列→成立。②③④→原文均无→排除。
4 干扰：后文的"四家公司帮忙找回"是事实，容易被误当"她当时说的话"；postman 与实际是 train staff 找回，也有反差。
5 意图：考"安慰方式取 reassured 后的两个 that 从句，实际结果不作当时说法"。
6 边界：若问 Who actually found the monkey? 答 Staff at four train companies。若问 What did the son think the postman would do? 答 Send the monkey back（据母亲的说法）。
7 错误：A 答 She bought a new toy.（错因：无据）；B 答 She said the staff had found it.（错因：结果当安慰）；C 答 She told him to stop crying.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R98.2 若问 How did sb comfort another，then 取 reassured sb that 后的从句（kind people looking＋postman would send it back），两个 that 并列不省；后文实际结果不作当时的安慰内容。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（安慰内容）；复用 R43.4（领悟取 that 从句），本条是"reassure 的双宾语"。
10 自检：①reassured 后有几个 that？②postman 是她的话还是事实？③谁真正找到的？

**33. 答案：Because it was a gift to him on the day he was born (so it had great sentimental value).**
1 题面：Why was the monkey precious to the boy；原文 "Tay was not hopeful about a reunion but the monkey was a gift to her son on the day he was born, so she passed its sentimental (情感的) value to the train staff."；疑问词 Why was X precious（问原因）；诱导信号：favourite companion 在首段，是他喜爱的表现，不是"珍贵"的由来。
2 候选：①a gift on the day he was born（sentimental value）；②it was his favourite companion；③it was expensive；④it was a Christmas decoration。
3 验算：①→a gift to her son on the day he was born＋sentimental value，来源＋价值→成立。②→companion 是结果（他喜爱它）→次优。③→expensive 原文未提→排除。④→Christmas decoration 是后来那件毛衣的来历→排除。
4 干扰：favourite companion 在首段、很亲切；sweater 的"Christmas decoration"也容易混。
5 意图：考"珍贵的原因取生日礼物的来历（sentimental value），喜爱的表现不作由来"。
6 边界：若问 What did the mother tell the staff? 答 The monkey's sentimental value。若问 What was the sweater before? 答 A Christmas decoration。
7 错误：A 答 Because it was expensive.（错因：无据）；B 答 Because it was a Christmas decoration.（错因：毛衣的来历）；C 答 Because he liked monkeys.（错因：泛化）。
8 规则：R98.3 若问 Why was an object precious，then 取来历句（a gift on the day he was born）＋价值词（sentimental value）；"最喜欢的玩伴"是表现，价格与别的物件的来历（Christmas decoration）不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（物件来历）；复用 R62.3（原因取价值句），本条是"纪念价值"。
10 自检：①礼物是什么时候的？②sentimental 指什么？③毛衣的来历混了吗？

**34. 答案：The monkey's new sweater — a sweater that had been used as a Christmas decoration — which was a lovely surprise.**
1 题面：What added to the pleasure of their reunion with the monkey；原文 "To give the monkey a comfortable place to stay, staff found it a sweater that had been previously used as a Christmas decoration."＋"She added that the monkey's new sweater had been a 'lovely surprise'."；疑问词 What added to the pleasure（问增色之物）；诱导信号：619 miles／four companies 的数字也在末段。
2 候选：①the new sweater（lovely surprise）；②the 619 extra miles；③four train companies；④the early train。
3 验算：①→staff found it a sweater…＋the monkey's new sweater had been a "lovely surprise"，两处同指→成立。②→619 miles 是行程数据，不是"增色"之物→排除。③→四家公司是帮助者→次优。④→早班车是运输方式→排除。
4 干扰：619 miles 与 four companies 是末段最醒目的信息；"lovely surprise"的引号也容易被跳过。
5 意图：考"增色之物取 lovely surprise 所指（new sweater），数字与协助方不作"。
6 边界：若问 How far did the monkey travel? 答 An extra 619 miles。若问 How many companies helped? 答 Four。
7 错误：A 答 619 miles.（错因：数字当物）；B 答 Four companies.（错因：协助方）；C 答 The early train.（错因：运输方式）。
8 规则：R98.4 若问 What added to the pleasure，then 取评价性引语（lovely surprise）所指的物（the new sweater），并说明其来历（used as a Christmas decoration）；行程数字（619 miles）与协助方（four companies）不作"增色之物"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（增色之物）；复用 R37.3（that 回指），本条是"引语回指物"。
10 自检：①lovely surprise 指什么？②619 是什么？③毛衣原来做什么用？

**35. 答案：（开放题）I think the railway staff are kind, helpful and responsible. Although the monkey was only a toy, staff at four train companies worked together to find it, gave it a sweater to keep it comfortable and sent it back on an early train the next morning.**
1 题面：What qualities do you think the railway staff have；原文 "staff at train companies worked together to find the toy. They succeed in finding the monkey. To give the monkey a comfortable place to stay, staff found it a sweater…Next morning, the monkey, was on an early train from Birmingham to Bristol"；疑问词 What qualities（问品质）；诱导信号：monkey 只是玩具，容易被认为"不值得"，题干问的正是这种"超出职责"的品质。
2 候选：①kind／helpful／responsible＋行为；②lucky；③strict；④只写 They are good。
3 验算：①→三个品质词各有行为（合作寻找＝helpful；给毛衣＝kind；次日送回＝responsible）→成立（至少两条）。②→lucky 抹掉主动付出→排除。③→strict 无据→排除。④→空评价→不成立。
4 干扰：玩具不值钱，容易写出"没必要"的负面评价；四家公司合作的事实也容易被只写"效率高"。
5 意图：考"评价＝品质＋行为"，并理解"小事见品质"。
6 边界：若问 How did the staff help? 答 They worked together to find the toy, gave it a sweater and sent it back。若问 What did Tay say about the sweater? 答 It was a lovely surprise。
7 错误：A 只写 They are good.（错因：空评价）；B 答 They are lucky.（错因：无据）；C 答 They are strict.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R98.5 若问 What qualities do you think sb have，then 给 2—3 个品质词（kind／helpful／responsible）并各配一条行为；不得因"物小"而贬低，也不写空评价或运气。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（群体品质）；复用 R69.5（品质＋行为），本条对象是"群体"。
10 自检：①品质词有几个？②行为配了吗？③我写"没必要"了吗？

**组小结（G98 · 小蓝书预测卷十六 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：反应（主体配对）1（31）；安慰内容 1（32）；珍贵来历 1（33）；增色之物 1（34）；群体品质 1（35）。
- 规则：R98.1 反应取本人描写（31）；R98.2 reassure 取双 that（32）；R98.3 珍贵取来历＋sentimental（33）；R98.4 增色取引语所指物（34）；R98.5 群体品质＋行为（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R98.1 与"母亲不抱希望"冲突，主体优先；R98.2 与"实际找回"冲突，当时说法优先；R98.3 与"favourite companion"冲突，来历优先；R98.4 与"619 miles 醒目"冲突，引语回指优先；R98.5 与"玩具不值钱"冲突，品质优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：温情新闻类第 2 篇（G90 Leo／本条）；本篇"玩具—毛衣—早班车"的细节链是 04 的叙事细节样本；数字（three-year-old／619 miles／four companies）均照录，**无换算、无推算**；**小蓝书卷十六 4 篇至此完成（G95—G98）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十四 · Passage 1

On March 19, Malala Yousafzai, a 15-year-old Pakistani student and women's education activist, returned to the classroom for the first time since being violently attacked by a member of the Taliban — a terrorist organization-on October 9,2012. Malala was shot on her way home from school in Mingora, Pakistan. A Taliban group took responsibility for the attack, claiming that the attack should serve as a warning to others. Members of the group believe girls are not permitted to go to school. Malala was attacked because she was asking for girls' rights to education in Swat Valley, Pakistan.

Malala recovers from the attack at Queen Elizabeth Hospital in Birmingham, England. After a long period of recovery, Malala is starting as a nine-year student at Edgbaston High School. It is the oldest independent girl school in Birmingham, England. Though she has no plans to return to Pakistan, Malala still speaks out as a voice for change in her country and everywhere.

"I am excited that today I have achieved my dreams of going back to school. I want all girls in the world to have this basic opportunity," Malala said in a statement. "I miss my classmates from Pakistan very much but I am looking forward to meeting my teachers and making new friends here in Birmingham."

Malala has been an Internet blogger, or writer, since she was 11 years old. In 2011 she was awarded Pakistan's National Peace Award for her bravery in writing about difficulties of life and education in the shadow of Taliban. She has spoken publicly about children's rights and been nominated for an international children's peace prize.

After the attack in 2012, support for Malala poured in from around the world. The United Nations declared November 10 Malala Day. Former British Prime Minister Gordon Brown said the day honors Malala and shows the world that people of all sexes, all backgrounds and all countries stand behind the heroine.



16. When was Malala violently attacked by Taliban?

______

17. What would Malala do though she couldn't return to Pakistan?

______

18. Why did The United Nations declare November 10 Malala Day?

______

19. What does the underlined words mean?

______

20. What do you think of Malala? Please share your reasons.

______

**〔G99〕小蓝书预测卷十四 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：On October 9, 2012.**
1 题面：When was Malala violently attacked by Taliban；原文 "On March 19, Malala Yousafzai… returned to the classroom for the first time since being violently attacked by a member of the Taliban — a terrorist organization-on October 9,2012."；疑问词 When（问日期）；诱导信号：句首 On March 19 是"重返校园"的日期，紧挨在 attacked 之前。
2 候选：①on October 9, 2012；②on March 19（返校园）；③2011（获奖）；④2012 only。
3 验算：①→since being violently attacked…on October 9,2012，attacked 与日期直接相连→成立（年份＋月日都写）。②→On March 19 是 returned to the classroom 的时间→不成立。③→2011 是她获巴基斯坦国家和平奖的年份→排除。④→只写 2012，丢月日→次优。
4 干扰：首句两个日期（March 19／October 9）夹在同一句里；2012 在正文出现两次（attack／support poured in）。
5 意图：考"日期按事件配对：返校园 vs 遭袭 vs 获奖"。
6 边界：若问 When did Malala return to the classroom? 答 On March 19（2013）。若问 When was she awarded Pakistan's National Peace Award? 答 In 2011。
7 错误：A 答 On March 19.（错因：返校园日期）；B 答 In 2011.（错因：获奖年份）；C 答 On October 9.（错因：漏年份）。
8 规则：R99.1 若问 When was sb attacked，then 取 attacked 同句的日期（October 9, 2012），年月日齐全；同句"返校园"的日期（March 19）与获奖年份（2011）按事件排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（日期—事件配对）；复用 R58.2（时间按事件配对），本条双日期同句。
10 自检：①attacked 与哪个日期相连？②March 19 是什么事？③2011 是什么？

**17. 答案：She still speaks out as a voice for change in her country and everywhere.**
1 题面：What would Malala do though she couldn't return to Pakistan；原文 "Though she has no plans to return to Pakistan, Malala still speaks out as a voice for change in her country and everywhere."；疑问词 What would sb do though…（让步＋做法）；诱导信号：前文 grew up／studied 等经历很多，容易答成"继续上学"。
2 候选：①speaks out as a voice for change；②return to Pakistan；③go back to her old school；④stop writing blogs。
3 验算：①→Though she has no plans to return…, Malala still speaks out as a voice for change，让步后的主句即做法→成立。②→被 Though 从句否定（no plans to return）→不成立。③→她上的是 Birmingham 的新学校→排除。④→她从 11 岁起就是 blogger，未停→排除。
4 干扰：I want all girls in the world to have this basic opportunity 也是她的表态，但不是"不能回国时做什么"；no plans to return 与 still 的对比容易读反。
5 意图：考"though 让步后的主句为做法，被否定的从句不作答案"。
6 边界：若问 Where is Malala studying now? 答 At Edgbaston High School in Birmingham。若问 What does she want for all girls? 答 The basic opportunity to go back to school。
7 错误：A 答 Return to Pakistan.（错因：被 though 从句否定）；B 答 Study in Pakistan.（错因：与 no plans 相反）；C 答 Stop blogging.（错因：与事实相反）。
8 规则：R99.2 若题干含 though／although＋被否定的事实，then 取主句的做法（still speaks out as a voice for change）；被让步从句否定的动作（return to Pakistan）不作答案；其他表态句（want all girls…）属另一问。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（让步结构）；复用 R71.3（让步不作因），本条是"让步后的主句为做法"。
10 自检：①though 从句否定什么？②主句是什么？③still 提示什么？

**18. 答案：Because support for Malala poured in from around the world after the attack, and the day honours her and shows that people of all sexes, backgrounds and countries stand behind her.**
1 题面：Why did The United Nations declare November 10 Malala Day；原文 "After the attack in 2012, support for Malala poured in from around the world. The United Nations declared November 10 Malala Day. Former British Prime Minister Gordon Brown said the day honors Malala and shows the world that people of all sexes, all backgrounds and all countries stand behind the heroine."；疑问词 Why did UN declare（问原因）；诱导信号：the attack in 2012 是背景事件，不是"宣布纪念日"的原因本身。
2 候选：①support poured in＋honours her／shows the world stands behind her；②because she was shot in 2012；③because she is 15；④because she wrote blogs。
3 验算：①→support for Malala poured in from around the world（前句）＋the day honors Malala and shows the world…（后句）→成立（两层：世界支持＋纪念与表态）。②→是袭击事实，解释"为什么有支持"，不是"为什么设纪念日"的直接原因→次优。③→年龄不是原因→排除。④→博客是她 11 岁起的事，与纪念日无直接因果→排除。
4 干扰：the attack in 2012 与 support poured in 相邻，因果容易停在"因为她被枪击"；Gordon Brown 的话较长，后半（all sexes／backgrounds／countries）常被漏。
5 意图：考"原因取前后两句（支持涌入＋纪念与表态），背景事件不替代"。
6 边界：若问 What happened after the attack? 答 Support for Malala poured in from around the world。若问 What did Gordon Brown say? 答 The day honors Malala and shows the world stands behind her。
7 错误：A 答 Because she was attacked by the Taliban.（错因：背景当直接原因）；B 答 Because she was 15 years old.（错因：年龄）；C 答 Because she was a blogger.（错因：无直接因果）。
8 规则：R99.3 若问 Why did an organization declare／set up X，then 取宣布前后的两句（support poured in＋honors her and shows the world stands behind her）；背景事件（the attack）只解释"为何有关注"，不作直接原因；年龄、身份不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（直接 vs 背景）；复用 R85.5（启示取事件链），本条是"纪念日设立原因"。
10 自检：①宣布前一句是什么？②honors 句说什么？③我把 attack 当直接原因了吗？

**19. 答案：It means "to support her" — people of all backgrounds stand on her side.（支持她）**
1 题面：What does the underlined words mean；原文 "Former British Prime Minister Gordon Brown said the day honors Malala and shows the world that people of all sexes, all backgrounds and all countries stand behind the heroine."；原卷该处有下划线（转写未标出，按上下文取 stand behind）；疑问词 underlined words mean（词组释义）；诱导信号：stand behind 的字面义"站在后面"。
2 候选：①support her（站在她一边）；②stand at her back（字面：站在背后）；③follow her；④hide behind her。
3 验算：①→the day honors Malala and shows the world that people…stand behind the heroine，与 honors 同向，取"支持"→成立。②→字面义与 honors 并列不搭→不成立。③→follow 与"支持"不同，且原文无跟随义→排除。④→hide behind 是贬义，与 heroine 语境相反→排除。
4 干扰：stand behind 的字面画面感强；heroine 一词也可能被当成"她躲在后面"的依据。
5 意图：考"身体方位类习语按同向动词（honors）定'支持'"。
6 边界：若问 Who stands behind Malala according to Brown? 答 People of all sexes, all backgrounds and all countries。若问 What does the day honor? 答 Malala（her bravery and her cause）。
7 错误：A 答 Stand at her back.（错因：字面义）；B 答 Follow her.（错因：改写）；C 答 Hide behind her.（错因：贬义）。
8 规则：R99.4 若划线为方位类习语（stand behind sb），then 按同向动词（honors）与上下文取"支持、站在某人一边"；字面"站在后面"与贬义（hide behind）不取。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（方位习语）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（stand behind＋the heroine）→同向（honors）→语域（表彰）→词面义。
10 自检：①与哪个动词同向？②字面义能用吗？③hide behind 是褒是贬？

**20. 答案：（开放题）I think Malala is brave and determined. She kept asking for girls' rights to education even after being shot, she went back to school and speaks out for girls everywhere, and she has been writing about children's rights since she was eleven.**
1 题面：What do you think of Malala? Please share your reasons.——评价＋理由；可用依据：asking for girls' rights to education／was shot on her way home from school／returned to the classroom／still speaks out as a voice for change／has been an Internet blogger since 11／awarded Pakistan's National Peace Award。
2 候选：①brave／determined＋行为；②lucky；③only "she is a hero"；④poor girl（同情）。
3 验算：①→brave（中枪后仍发声）＋determined（返校、持续写作）→成立（至少两条行为）。②→lucky 抹掉她的主动与风险→排除。③→空标签→不成立。④→同情不是评价→次优。
4 干扰：被枪击的遭遇最触目，容易写成"可怜"；奖项与联合国纪念日也像"评价"。
5 意图：考"评价＝品质词＋行为"，悲剧遭遇不作同情式评价。
6 边界：若问 What did Malala ask for? 答 Girls' rights to education。若问 What did the UN do for her? 答 It declared November 10 Malala Day。
7 错误：A 只写 She is a hero.（错因：空标签）；B 答 She is lucky.（错因：无据）；C 答 I feel sorry for her.（错因：同情代评价）。
8 规则：R99.5 若问 What do you think of sb，then 给 2 个品质词（brave／determined）并各配一条行为（中枪后仍发声／返校／持续写作）；奖项与纪念日是外部认可，不替代品质；同情语与空标签不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（品质＋行为）；复用 R69.5，本条对象是"人权活动者"。
10 自检：①品质词有哪两个？②行为配了吗？③我写"可怜"了吗？

**组小结（G99 · 小蓝书预测卷十四 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：日期—事件配对 1（16）；让步后做法 1（17）；纪念日原因 1（18）；方位习语 1（19）；人物评价 1（20）。
- 规则：R99.1 日期按事件配（16）；R99.2 though 后主句为做法（17）；R99.3 原因取宣布前后两句（18）；R99.4 stand behind＝支持（19）；R99.5 品质＋行为（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R99.1 与"March 19 紧邻"冲突，attacked 配对优先；R99.2 与"no plans to return"冲突，主句优先；R99.3 与"attack 事实最醒目"冲突，直接原因优先；R99.4 与"stand behind 字面"冲突，honors 同向优先；R99.5 与"遭遇最触目"冲突，品质优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：人物事迹类第 6 篇（G54／G61／G66／G82／G99）；本篇"两个日期同句＋though 让步"是 04 的时间与让步样本；数字（15／11／2011／2012／November 10）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十四 · Passage 2

How can we gain benefits from feedback practices while reducing their disadvantages? There are some ways to help you.

Feedback works best for the people whose main goal is self-improvement. It should be given in a developmental approach and future-focused, highlighting areas in which the recipient (接收者) can improve, and offering clear, actionable strategies.

First, we should consider using terms besides "feedback". Some studies have suggested replacing "feedback" with terms such as "advice", which often contain more practical information. Offering feedback as advice encourages recipients to focus on improving their future performance.

Next, focus on the advantages. Excellence in teaching is often influenced by our own feelings, with lots of effective approaches for any given topic. Research suggests we improve ourselves when others focus on our advantages. A key to effective feedback is highlighting existing patterns of excellence.

Then, we must learn how to give feedback. Delivering feedback can be challenging, especially if the person receiving the feedback is the person who has the same social position as you or the information could be sensed as critical (批评的). To avoid such situations, reducing unpleasant messages may help.

Receiving feedback, as well as giving it, is a skill. Therefore, helping teachers build skills around receiving practice-based information, feedback, or advice, such as listening with an open mind, thinking critically about the information, asking for specific advice and



"making a thoughtful choice" about the quality and effectiveness of the feedback, can improve the whole process.

Finally, focus on the "what" of feedback. While much attention is given to the "how" of feedback delivery, the real value lies in the "what" of feedback, that is the richness of its information. "High information" feedback should include two important points: checking the correctness of the teacher's approach when there is only one correct method and offering information to fill gaps in understanding and guide the recipient towards a desired approach.

We know that feedback is quite important for teachers' professional development. After reading the information above, with established effective feedback methods, we can make the feedback process more effective and useful for more teachers in ways that finally improve students' learning.

21. Whom does the feedback work best for?

______

22. How can we encourage recipients to focus on improving their future performance?

______

23. What is a key to effective feedback?

______

24. How can we avoid challenging situations when giving feedback?

______

25. What does this passage mainly talk about?

______

**〔G100〕小蓝书预测卷十四 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：For people whose main goal is self-improvement.**
1 题面：Whom does the feedback work best for；原文 "Feedback works best for the people whose main goal is self-improvement. It should be given in a developmental approach and future-focused…"；疑问词 Whom…work best for（问对象）；诱导信号：同段还有 developmental approach／future-focused 等做法，容易被当对象。
2 候选：①people whose main goal is self-improvement；②teachers only；③students with poor grades；④people who give feedback。
3 验算：①→works best for the people whose main goal is self-improvement，for 后定语从句直接给出→成立。②→teachers 是全文的受益群体，但不是"work best for"的限定对象→次优。③→poor grades 原文未提→排除。④→给反馈的人是另一侧→排除。
4 干扰：末段 improve students' learning 与 teachers' professional development 都很显眼，容易把"学生／教师"当答案。
5 意图：考"Whom 取 for 后的定语从句（self-improvement），不取全文受益群体"。
6 边界：若问 Who is feedback important for? 答 Teachers（their professional development）。若问 How should feedback be given? 答 In a developmental approach and future-focused。
7 错误：A 答 Teachers.（错因：受益群体）；B 答 Students.（错因：末段结果）；C 答 People who give feedback.（错因：方向反）。
8 规则：R100.1 若问 Whom does X work best for，then 取 for 后的定语从句（people whose main goal is self-improvement）；全文受益群体（teachers／students）不作限定对象。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（限定对象）；复用 R85.2（限定人群），本条用定语从句。
10 自检：①for 后是什么？②teachers 属哪一层？③我答学生了吗？

**22. 答案：By offering feedback as advice — replacing "feedback" with terms such as "advice".**
1 题面：How can we encourage recipients to focus on improving their future performance；原文 "Some studies have suggested replacing 'feedback' with terms such as 'advice', which often contain more practical information. Offering feedback as advice encourages recipients to focus on improving their future performance."；疑问词 How can we encourage（问做法）；诱导信号：下一段 focus on the advantages 是另一条建议。
2 候选：①offering feedback as advice（replace with "advice"）；②focusing on advantages；③reducing unpleasant messages；④giving more information。
3 验算：①→Offering feedback as advice encourages recipients to focus on improving their future performance，题干与原文逐字对应→成立。②③→是后两条建议，对应别的问题→排除。④→more information 属"what"（最后一条）→排除。
4 干扰：四条建议（advice／advantages／how to give／what）并列，题干只对应第一条；future performance 与 future-focused 也容易混。
5 意图：考"How 取与题干结果同句的做法（offering feedback as advice）"。
6 边界：若问 What should we replace "feedback" with? 答 Terms such as "advice"。若问 Why is "advice" better? 答 It often contains more practical information。
7 错误：A 答 By focusing on advantages.（错因：另一条建议）；B 答 By reducing unpleasant messages.（错因：第三条）；C 答 By giving high information.（错因：最后一条）。
8 规则：R100.2 若问 How can we encourage sb to do X，then 取与 X 同句的做法（Offering feedback as advice），并可用前句（replace with "advice"）补足；其余三条建议按各自对应的问题排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（做法与结果同句）；复用 R84.3（做法取动作链），本条是"一条建议对一个问题"。
10 自检：①哪句含 focus on improving future performance？②同句的做法是什么？③其他建议对应哪问？

**23. 答案：Highlighting existing patterns of excellence (that is, focusing on the advantages).**
1 题面：What is a key to effective feedback；原文 "Research suggests we improve ourselves when others focus on our advantages. A key to effective feedback is highlighting existing patterns of excellence."；疑问词 What is a key to（问关键）；诱导信号：前句 Research suggests… 是依据，后句才是"key"。
2 候选：①highlighting existing patterns of excellence；②reducing unpleasant messages；③giving advice；④listening with an open mind。
3 验算：①→A key to effective feedback is highlighting existing patterns of excellence，主系表直接给出→成立（可解释为 focus on advantages）。②→是"避免尴尬"的做法→排除。③→是第一条建议→排除。④→是"接收反馈"的技能→排除。
4 干扰：focus on our advantages 在前一句，与 key 句同义但形式不同；listening with an open mind 也在文中，属接收方。
5 意图：考"key 取主系表，前句研究依据不作答案但可作同义解释"。
6 边界：若问 Why should we focus on advantages? 答 Because research suggests we improve ourselves when others focus on our advantages。若问 What is a key skill for receiving feedback? 答 Listening with an open mind（and thinking critically）。
7 错误：A 答 Reducing unpleasant messages.（错因：另一条）；B 答 Giving advice.（错因：另一条）；C 答 Listening with an open mind.（错因：接收方技能）。
8 规则：R100.3 若问 What is a key to X，then 取 A key to…is 后的表语（highlighting existing patterns of excellence），并可用同义句（focus on advantages）解释；研究依据句与其余建议不作 key。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（关键项）；复用 R44.4（find 取补足），本条是"key is"。
10 自检：①key 句在哪？②focus on advantages 是什么？③我取了别的建议吗？

**24. 答案：By reducing unpleasant messages (when we learn how to give feedback).**
1 题面：How can we avoid challenging situations when giving feedback；原文 "Then, we must learn how to give feedback. Delivering feedback can be challenging, especially if the person receiving the feedback is the person who has the same social position as you or the information could be sensed as critical (批评的). To avoid such situations, reducing unpleasant messages may help."；疑问词 How can we avoid（问做法）；诱导信号：especially if 从句很长，容易把"同地位的人"当答案。
2 候选：①reducing unpleasant messages；②giving feedback to people of the same position；③sensing information as critical；④learning how to receive feedback。
3 验算：①→To avoid such situations, reducing unpleasant messages may help，To avoid 目的直接对应→成立。②③→是"挑战情形"的构成，不是避免办法→排除。④→learn how to receive 是下一段（接收方）→排除。
4 干扰：especially if the person…same social position 条件句长且具体，容易被当答案；critical 的括注也抢注意。
5 意图：考"To avoid such situations 后的做法（reducing unpleasant messages），条件从句不作办法"。
6 边界：若问 What makes delivering feedback challenging? 答 When the receiver has the same social position as you, or the information could be sensed as critical。若问 What skills help teachers receive feedback? 答 Listening with an open mind, thinking critically, asking for specific advice and making a thoughtful choice。
7 错误：A 答 By giving feedback to people of the same position.（错因：条件当办法）；B 答 By sensing information as critical.（错因：挑战本身）；C 答 By learning to receive feedback.（错因：另一段）。
8 规则：R100.4 若问 How can we avoid X 且原文有 To avoid such situations，then 取该句的做法（reducing unpleasant messages）；especially if 引导的条件（same social position／sensed as critical）是"挑战的构成"，不作避免办法。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（To avoid 后取做法）；复用 R41.5（排除域），本条是"条件 ≠ 办法"。
10 自检：①To avoid 后是什么？②same social position 属什么？③receive 是哪一段？

**25. 答案：It is mainly about how to gain benefits from feedback while reducing its disadvantages — some ways to make feedback more effective.**
1 题面：What does this passage mainly talk about；原文首段 "How can we gain benefits from feedback practices while reducing their disadvantages? There are some ways to help you."＋四到五条建议（advice／advantages／how to give／receiving skills／"what" of feedback）＋末段 with established effective feedback methods, we can make the feedback process more effective；疑问词 mainly talk about（问主旨）；诱导信号：各条建议都很具体，任取一条都像"主旨"。
2 候选：①how to make feedback more effective（benefits－disadvantages）；②how to give advice；③how to receive feedback；④why feedback is important。
3 验算：①→首段设问＋末段 with established effective feedback methods…more effective，首尾呼应→成立。②③→只是其中一条→排除。④→feedback 的重要性只在末段一句带过→次优。
4 干扰：五条建议各有小标题式开头（First／Next／Then／Finally），容易被当成五个主旨；末句 improve students' learning 也像主旨。
5 意图：考"主旨取首段设问＋末段收束，单条建议不作主旨"。
6 边界：若问 What is the real value of feedback? 答 The "what" of feedback — the richness of its information。若问 What should "high information" feedback include? 答 Checking the correctness of the approach and offering information to fill gaps。
7 错误：A 答 How to give advice.（错因：一条建议）；B 答 Why feedback is important.（错因：局部）；C 答 How to improve students' learning.（错因：末句结果）。
8 规则：R100.5 若问 main idea 且首段为设问（How can we…），then 取该设问所指向的方案（ways to gain benefits and reduce disadvantages），并用末段收束句验证；单条建议与末句结果不作主旨。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.1 主旨（设问式）；复用 R7.5（设问式主旨 how to），本条是"how to＋并列目标"。
10 自检：①首段设问是什么？②五条建议算主旨吗？③末段收束句是什么？

**组小结（G100 · 小蓝书预测卷十四 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：限定对象 1（21）；做法与结果同句 1（22）；关键项 1（23）；To avoid 后取做法 1（24）；设问式主旨 1（25）。
- 规则：R100.1 Whom 取 for 后定语从句（21）；R100.2 做法与结果同句（22）；R100.3 key 取表语（23）；R100.4 To avoid 后取做法（24）；R100.5 主旨取首段设问（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R100.1 与"teachers／students 醒目"冲突，限定对象优先；R100.2 与"五条建议并列"冲突，同句对应优先；R100.3 与"研究依据在前"冲突，key 句优先；R100.4 与"条件从句具体"冲突，To avoid 句优先；R100.5 与"单条建议具体"冲突，首尾呼应优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：教育方法说明文首见；本篇"一条建议对一个问题的配对"（advice→future performance／advantages→key／reduce unpleasant→avoid）是 04 的配对样本；数字无，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十四 · Passage 3

The most wonderful thing that has come into my life is a Golden Retriever called Bonny. Bonny has been trained by an organization called Assistance Dogs for Independence, so she could help me become independent. I often rely on other people in my life, and it even keeps me from making my own decisions in most situations. Why? Because when you have to depend on others, the decision does not become totally yours.

I developed Cerebral Palsy(脑瘫) at the age of twelve months as a result of food poisoning(中毒). That made me physically disabled, making me totally rely on others. Because of that, I often felt sad. I considered myself to be useless and was often in a low mood.

My recent visit to the Spastic Centre with Bonny caused the therapists(治疗师) to notice



the change in my attitude and mood. They always tried to help me become positive, but they said it was Bonny that had made such a difference. They were so impressed that they invited me to talk to Assistance Dogs for Independence about such dogs because they were sure that other people like me would also need the assistance of such a dog.

I totally agreed with them and decided to do that. The costs of carers who are paid to help people like me are very high. And family members have to spend a lot of time taking care of such people as me. With such a dog as Bonny, things could be much easier.

However, I will still need the carers' help in areas where a dog can't help. I just want to say such a dog is really helpful to such people as me.

26. Why can't the author make his own decisions sometimes?

______

27. How did the author develop Cerebral Palsy?

______

28. What does the underlined word "assistance" in Paragraph 3 mean?

______

29. What does the author think of carers for such people as him?

______

30. What do you think of such dogs as Bonny after reading the text? Why?

______

**〔G101〕小蓝书预测卷十四 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：Because he has to depend on others — when you depend on others, the decision does not become totally yours.**
1 题面：Why can't the author make his own decisions sometimes；原文 "I often rely on other people in my life, and it even keeps me from making my own decisions in most situations. Why? Because when you have to depend on others, the decision does not become totally yours."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：前文 a Golden Retriever called Bonny 是帮助者，容易被当原因。
2 候选：①he depends on others（decision not totally yours）；②because Bonny helps him；③because he is 12 months old；④because his family stops him。
3 验算：①→when you have to depend on others, the decision does not become totally yours，Why? Because…直接给出→成立。②→Bonny 帮他独立，方向相反→不成立。③→twelve months 是他发病年龄→排除。④→家人照顾他，原文未说阻止→排除。
4 干扰：Bonny 是全文主角，容易当"原因"；depend on others 与 rely on other people 同义重复，也可能被读成"结论"。
5 意图：考"原因取 Why? Because 后的从句（依赖他人→决定不全属于自己）"。
6 边界：若问 What does the author often rely on others for? 答 For help in his life（he is physically disabled）。若问 What did Bonny help him do? 答 To become independent。
7 错误：A 答 Because Bonny helps him.（错因：方向反）；B 答 Because he is a child.（错因：年龄误读）；C 答 Because his family decides for him.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R101.1 若问 Why can't sb make his own decisions，then 取 Why? Because 后的从句（depend on others→decision not totally yours）；帮助者（Bonny）与被照顾事实（family time）不作原因；年龄只作发病时间。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（Why? Because 自问自答）；复用 R57.3（起因取 because），本条为"自问自答"结构。
10 自检：①Why? 后是什么？②Bonny 起什么作用？③twelve months 是什么？

**27. 答案：As a result of food poisoning at the age of twelve months.**
1 题面：How did the author develop Cerebral Palsy；原文 "I developed Cerebral Palsy(脑瘫) at the age of twelve months as a result of food poisoning(中毒)."；疑问词 How did sb develop（问成因）；诱导信号：That made me physically disabled 是结果，不是成因。
2 候选：①as a result of food poisoning（at 12 months）；②because he was born disabled；③because of an accident；④because of old age。
3 验算：①→developed Cerebral Palsy at the age of twelve months as a result of food poisoning，as a result of 直接给因→成立（含年龄更好）。②→原文说"12 个月时发病"，非先天→不成立。③→accident 原文无→排除。④→作者非老年人→排除。
4 干扰：That made me physically disabled 紧接其后，因果方向容易混；12 months 的年龄也很小，容易被读成"先天"。
5 意图：考"成因取 as a result of 后（food poisoning），后果句不作成因"。
6 边界：若问 What did Cerebral Palsy make him do? 答 It made him physically disabled, making him totally rely on others。若问 How did he feel then? 答 Sad — he considered himself useless and was often in a low mood。
7 错误：A 答 He was born with it.（错因：非先天）；B 答 Because of an accident.（错因：无据）；C 答 Because of a high fever.（错因：改写）。
8 规则：R101.2 若问 How did sb develop an illness，then 取 as a result of 后的成因（food poisoning）＋年龄（twelve months）；后果句（made me disabled）与"先天"假设不作成因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（as a result of）；复用 R65.2（As a result 前为因），本条是"as a result of 后为因"。
10 自检：①as a result of 后是什么？②made me disabled 是什么？③是先天吗？

**28. 答案：It means "help".（帮助、协助）**
1 题面：What does the underlined word "assistance" in Paragraph 3 mean；第 3 段原文 "They were so impressed that they invited me to talk to Assistance Dogs for Independence about such dogs because they were sure that other people like me would also need the assistance of such a dog."；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 mean（词义题）；诱导信号：assistance 与 assist 同根，且机构名里也出现 Assistance Dogs。
2 候选：①help；②company；③training；④money。
3 验算：①→need the assistance of such a dog，dogs help people like him（前文 help me become independent）→成立。②→company 与"需要一只狗的陪伴"近义，但全文强调"帮助独立、取代部分护理"→次优。③→training 是狗的训练，不是他需要的东西→排除。④→money 与犬只帮助无关→排除。
4 干扰：company 在情感上说得通（他常感孤独、低落），容易取代 help；机构名 Assistance Dogs 也可能被当成"导盲犬"专用词。
5 意图：考"assistance＝help，按全文功能（become independent／carers 的作用）定值"。
6 边界：若问 What organization trained Bonny? 答 Assistance Dogs for Independence。若问 What can such a dog help disabled people do? 答 Become more independent（and make things easier）。
7 错误：A 答 Company.（错因：情感联想）；B 答 Training.（错因：对象错）；C 答 Money.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R101.3 若划线为抽象名词（assistance），then 按全文功能定值（help／协助），可参考同根词与前后句（help me become independent／need the assistance of such a dog）；情感联想（company）与对象错位（training／money）不取。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（抽象名词）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（need the assistance of）→全文功能（独立、替代护理）→语域（残障辅助）→词面义。
10 自检：①前后句怎么用这个词？②company 说得通吗？③机构名提示什么？

**29. 答案：He thinks their costs are very high and that family members have to spend a lot of time caring for people like him — though carers are still needed in areas where a dog can't help.**
1 题面：What does the author think of carers for such people as him；原文 "The costs of carers who are paid to help people like me are very high. And family members have to spend a lot of time taking care of such people as me. With such a dog as Bonny, things could be much easier."＋"However, I will still need the carers' help in areas where a dog can't help."；疑问词 What does sb think of X（问看法，含两面）；诱导信号：With such a dog…things could be much easier 是对比，不是否定护理者。
2 候选：①costs high＋family time＋仍需要（两面）；②carers are useless；③carers are cheap；④he doesn't need carers at all。
3 验算：①→costs are very high＋family members spend a lot of time＋However, I will still need the carers' help，三处合起来是"贵、费时，但仍必需"→成立（两面都写）。②→与 still need 相反→不成立。③→与 very high 相反→排除。④→与 still need 相反→排除。
4 干扰：With such a dog…things could be much easier 容易被读成"有了狗就不需要护理者"；However 的转折也常被漏。
5 意图：考"看法取两面（贵且费时＋仍必需），转折句不可省"。
6 边界：若问 Why are carers expensive? 答 Because they are paid to help people like the author。若问 Can Bonny replace carers completely? 答 No — the author still needs carers' help in areas where a dog can't help。
7 错误：A 答 Carers are useless.（错因：与 still need 相反）；B 答 Carers are cheap.（错因：与 very high 相反）；C 答 He wants no carers.（错因：转折句漏读）。
8 规则：R101.4 若问 What does sb think of X 且文中有 However 转折，then 两面都写（costs high／family time＋still need carers）；With such a dog…easier 是对比说明，不作"取代"；只取一面即不完整。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.12 观点（含转折两面）；复用 R37.2（but 两侧都写），本条是 However。
10 自检：①正面（贵、费时）在哪？②However 后是什么？③我写"不需要"了吗？

**30. 答案：（开放题）I think such dogs as Bonny are very helpful. They can help disabled people become more independent and improve their mood, as Bonny did for the author, and they also make life easier for carers and family members — though they cannot take the place of carers completely.**
1 题面：What do you think of such dogs as Bonny after reading the text? Why?——评价＋理由；可用依据：she could help me become independent／therapists noticed the change in my attitude and mood／it was Bonny that had made such a difference／With such a dog, things could be much easier／still need carers in areas where a dog can't help。
2 候选：①very helpful（独立＋情绪＋减轻护理负担），并说明限度；②only cute；③useless；④只写 I like dogs。
3 验算：①→三条理由都能落到原文，且保留"不能完全替代"的限度→成立。②→cute 是外表，不答"helpful"层面→次优。③→与全文相反→排除。④→空评价→不成立。
4 干扰：Bonny 可爱、忠诚的画面容易让人只写"喜欢狗"；"不能完全替代"的限度也常被忽略。
5 意图：考"评价＋理由"，并要求用文中功能（独立、情绪、减轻负担）而非外表。
6 边界：若问 What did the therapists notice? 答 The change in the author's attitude and mood。若问 Why did they invite him to talk to the organization? 答 Because they were sure other people like him would also need such a dog。
7 错误：A 只写 They are cute.（错因：外表）；B 答 They are useless.（错因：与全文相反）；C 答 They can replace carers.（错因：忽略限度）。
8 规则：R101.5 若问 What do you think of such dogs，then 给评价（helpful／life-changing）＋2 条文中功能（独立／情绪／减轻护理负担），可补一句限度（不能完全替代 carers）；外表（cute）与空评价不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（事物评价）；复用 R87.5（表态＋理由），本条对象是"辅助犬"。
10 自检：①评价词是什么？②理由有几条？③我写限度了吗？

**组小结（G101 · 小蓝书预测卷十四 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：依赖他人作决定 1（26）；发病成因 1（27）；抽象名词词义 1（28）；护理者看法（两面）1（29）；辅助犬评价 1（30）。
- 规则：R101.1 Why? Because 取从句（26）；R101.2 as a result of 后为因（27）；R101.3 assistance＝help（28）；R101.4 看法取两面（29）；R101.5 评价＋功能理由（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R101.1 与"Bonny 是主角"冲突，依赖句优先；R101.2 与"后果句紧邻"冲突，as a result of 优先；R101.3 与"company 情感联想"冲突，功能优先；R101.4 与"things could be easier"冲突，However 优先；R101.5 与"cute 外表"冲突，功能优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：残障辅助题材首见（与 G75 独臂运动员并列）；本篇"两面看法（贵、费时，但仍必需）"是 04 的转折样本；数字（twelve months／40 years 见后篇）无换算，**本组无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷十四 · Passage 4

Marga Allen might be around 93 years old. However, she wouldn't put her feet up. Every week, she leads a 90-minute fitness class in her community for her ladies, and the youngest of them is 60. The class is a mixture of Scottish dancing, line-dancing and routine. "I want to make it fun for them," says Marga, "I've been teaching classes since 1965." At that time, 8 ladies attended her class, but now there are as many as 18.

And when Marga isn't out, she is a writer of poetry. She has written 6 books and is now going on a seventh. "I write in the evenings, about anything and everything," say Marga. In writing about her life, Marga isn't short of materials. Born in the 1920s, Marga was a gifted pianist from a young age and even won a scholarship to the Royal College at the age of 14. Marga stopped work as a railway worker when she had the first child. Then she was a volunteer of the Red Cross for more than 40 years.

She now has four grandchildren and four great-grandchildren; the youngest of them is



just six-month old. In spite of her astonishing activity level for her age, Marga says that loneliness is the concern of society and that all the things she does still don't fill up her time.

Whenever she gets lonely or down, she picks up the phone and chats with friends, which makes her in high spirits. "I miss people most of all. But a lot of people are lonely, and I'd love to help them all."

31. Why does Marga Allen give a fitness class in her community each week?

______

32. Why doesn't Marga Allen lack materials when writing about her life?

______

33. What does the underlined part in Paragraph 1 mean?

______

34. What does Marga Allen usually do when she feels depressed?

______

35. What do you think of Marga Allen? And why?

______

**〔G102〕小蓝书预测卷十四 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：Because she wants to make it fun for her ladies (and she has been teaching classes since 1965).**
1 题面：Why does Marga Allen give a fitness class in her community each week；原文 "Every week, she leads a 90-minute fitness class in her community for her ladies, and the youngest of them is 60… 'I want to make it fun for them,' says Marga, 'I've been teaching classes since 1965.'"；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：she wouldn't put her feet up 是她的性格，同段还有 8 ladies／18 的人数变化。
2 候选：①to make it fun for them；②because she is 93；③because she needs money；④because the youngest is 60。
3 验算：①→I want to make it fun for them，直接引语给因→成立（可补 since 1965 的长期习惯）。②→年龄是背景，不是原因→排除。③→原文无收费信息→排除。④→60 是学员年龄，不是原因→排除。
4 干扰：93 岁与 90-minute、18 ladies 等数字密集；"不肯闲下来"的性格也像原因。
5 意图：考"原因取直接引语（make it fun），年龄与人数不作原因"。
6 边界：若问 How long is the class? 答 90 minutes。若问 How many ladies attended at first and now? 答 8 at first, as many as 18 now。
7 错误：A 答 Because she is 93.（错因：年龄当原因）；B 答 Because she needs money.（错因：无据）；C 答 Because the class is popular.（错因：结果当原因）。
8 规则：R102.1 若问 Why does sb give／teach X，then 取直接引语中的目的（I want to make it fun for them），并可用 since＋年份补长期习惯；年龄、人数与班级规模不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（引语目的）；复用 R32.3（动机取引语），本条是"教学动机"。
10 自检：①引语说了什么目的？②93 岁是什么？③人数变化说明什么？

**32. 答案：Because she has lived a rich and varied life — she was born in the 1920s, was a gifted pianist, won a scholarship at 14, worked as a railway worker and was a Red Cross volunteer for more than 40 years.**
1 题面：Why doesn't Marga Allen lack materials when writing about her life；原文 "In writing about her life, Marga isn't short of materials. Born in the 1920s, Marga was a gifted pianist from a young age and even won a scholarship to the Royal College at the age of 14. Marga stopped work as a railway worker when she had the first child. Then she was a volunteer of the Red Cross for more than 40 years."；疑问词 Why doesn't sb lack materials（问原因）；诱导信号：isn't short of materials 是结论，理由在其后整段。
2 候选：①rich and varied life（pianist／scholarship／railway／Red Cross 40 years）；②because she is old；③because she writes in the evenings；④because she has grandchildren。
3 验算：①→isn't short of materials＋其后四项经历，构成"素材多"的原因→成立（列 2—3 项即可）。②→old 是背景，不能解释素材→排除。③→I write in the evenings 是写作时间→排除。④→ grandchildren 是家庭信息，非写作素材→次优。
4 干扰：I write in the evenings, about anything and everything 紧接其后，像原因；born in the 1920s 也容易被当唯一原因。
5 意图：考"原因取经历链（四项），写作习惯与家庭信息不作素材来源"。
6 边界：若问 When does she write? 答 In the evenings。若问 What did she do for more than 40 years? 答 She was a volunteer of the Red Cross。
7 错误：A 答 Because she is old.（错因：背景）；B 答 Because she writes in the evenings.（错因：习惯非素材）；C 答 Because she has grandchildren.（错因：家庭信息）。
8 规则：R102.2 若问 Why doesn't sb lack materials／ideas，then 取其后列举的经历链（pianist／scholarship at 14／railway worker／Red Cross 40 years），列 2—3 项；写作时间（in the evenings）与家庭信息不作素材来源。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（经历链）；复用 R67.4（取全部动作），本条是"经历列举"。
10 自检：①经历有哪几项？②in the evenings 是什么？③我答"她老了"了吗？

**33. 答案：It means she wouldn't rest or take it easy — she keeps active.（不肯闲下来、不肯享清福）**
1 题面：What does the underlined part in Paragraph 1 mean；划线部分 "she wouldn't put her feet up"，原文 "Marga Allen might be around 93 years old. However, she wouldn't put her feet up. Every week, she leads a 90-minute fitness class in her community…"；原卷该处有下划线；疑问词 What does the underlined part mean（习语释义）；诱导信号：put one's feet up 的字面义"把脚翘起来"。
2 候选：①she wouldn't rest／take it easy；②she wouldn't put her feet on the chair（字面）；③she couldn't walk；④she wouldn't teach any more。
3 验算：①→However, she wouldn't put her feet up＋Every week, she leads a 90-minute fitness class，转折＋行为证明"不肯闲下来"→成立。②→字面义与后面的教学行为不搭→不成立。③→与 leads a fitness class 相反→排除。④→与事实相反→排除。
4 干扰：put one's feet up 画面感强；However 与 93 years old 的对比也容易被读成"她不能动"。
5 意图：考"习语按后文行为（90 分钟课／每周）定'不歇着'"。
6 边界：若问 How old is Marga Allen? 答 Around 93。若问 What does she do every week? 答 She leads a 90-minute fitness class in her community。
7 错误：A 答 She put her feet on a chair.（错因：字面义）；B 答 She couldn't walk.（错因：与事实相反）；C 答 She stopped teaching.（错因：与事实相反）。
8 规则：R102.3 若划线为身体动作习语（put one's feet up＝休息），then 按转折词（However）与其后行为（每周 90 分钟课）取"不歇着、保持活跃"；字面动作与"不能动"的误读不取。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（身体习语）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（wouldn't put her feet up）→转折后行为→语域（老年生活）→词面义。
10 自检：①However 后是什么？②字面义说得通吗？③她每周做什么？

**34. 答案：She picks up the phone and chats with friends, which makes her in high spirits.**
1 题面：What does Marga Allen usually do when she feels depressed；原文 "Whenever she gets lonely or down, she picks up the phone and chats with friends, which makes her in high spirits."；疑问词 What does sb do when…（问做法）；诱导信号：前段 I miss people most of all 是她的感慨，不是做法。
2 候选：①picks up the phone and chats with friends；②writes poetry；③visits her grandchildren；④leads a fitness class。
3 验算：①→Whenever she gets lonely or down, she picks up the phone and chats with friends，时间从句＋做法→成立（可补 in high spirits）。②→写诗是她的爱好，不是"情绪低落时"的做法→次优。③→原文未说探访孙辈→排除。④→上课是每周固定活动，不是情绪低落时的应对→排除。
4 干扰：writes poetry／grandchildren 都在文中，容易当"低落时的做法"；I miss people most of all 也像做法。
5 意图：考"做法取 Whenever…down 后的动作，爱好与家庭成员不作应对方式"。
6 边界：若问 What makes her in high spirits? 答 Chatting with friends on the phone。若问 What does she say about loneliness? 答 It is the concern of society and all she does still doesn't fill up her time。
7 错误：A 答 She writes poetry.（错因：爱好）；B 答 She visits her grandchildren.（错因：无据）；C 答 She stays alone.（错因：与 chats with friends 相反）。
8 规则：R102.4 若问 What does sb do when he/she feels down，then 取该时间从句后的动作（picks up the phone and chats with friends）；爱好（写诗）与家庭成员信息不作应对方式。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（情绪应对）；复用 R39.4（目的取 so that），本条是"whenever 后的做法"。
10 自检：①whenever 后是什么？②写诗属哪类？③她为什么说 miss people？

**35. 答案：（开放题）I think Marga Allen is energetic, optimistic and caring. At about 93 she still leads a 90-minute fitness class every week, she writes poetry and chats with friends when she feels down, and she says she would love to help lonely people.**
1 题面：What do you think of Marga Allen? And why?——评价＋理由；可用依据：wouldn't put her feet up／leads a 90-minute class every week／teaching since 1965／has written 6 books／chats with friends when down／I'd love to help them all。
2 候选：①energetic／optimistic／caring＋行为；②lucky；③只写 She is great；④poor old lady（同情）。
3 验算：①→三个品质词各有行为（93 岁仍带课＝energetic；情绪低落时主动聊天＝optimistic；想帮助孤独者＝caring）→成立（至少两条）。②→lucky 抹掉主动性→排除。③→空评价→不成立。④→同情与她的活跃形象相反→排除。
4 干扰：93 岁的年龄容易引出"可怜／需要照顾"的误判；6 books／40 years 的数字也可能被当评价。
5 意图：考"评价＝品质＋行为"，老年题材尤须避免同情式评价。
6 边界：若问 What does she think of loneliness? 答 It is the concern of society, and all she does still doesn't fill up her time。若问 How many books has she written? 答 Six（and is going on a seventh）。
7 错误：A 只写 She is great.（错因：空评价）；B 答 She is lonely and poor.（错因：同情/无据）；C 答 She is lucky.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R102.5 若问 What do you think of sb，then 给 2—3 个品质词（energetic／optimistic／caring）并各配一条行为；老年题材不得用同情语替代评价；空评价与"运气"不合格。
9 位置：04→RA-6→RA-6.1 评价类（品质＋行为）；复用 R69.5，本条对象是"高龄活跃者"。
10 自检：①品质词有几个？②行为配了吗？③我写"可怜"了吗？

**组小结（G102 · 小蓝书预测卷十四 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：教学动机 1（31）；素材来源（经历链）1（32）；身体习语 1（33）；情绪应对 1（34）；人物评价 1（35）。
- 规则：R102.1 动机取引语目的（31）；R102.2 素材取经历链（32）；R102.3 put one's feet up＝不歇着（33）；R102.4 when down 取做法（34）；R102.5 品质＋行为（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R102.1 与"93 岁醒目"冲突，引语目的优先；R102.2 与"写作时间紧邻"冲突，经历链优先；R102.3 与"字面动作"冲突，转折后行为优先；R102.4 与"写诗是爱好"冲突，whenever 句优先；R102.5 与"高龄同情"冲突，品质优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：高龄人物特写首见；本篇"数字密集（93／90／60／8／18／6／7／1920s／14／40）但无一处运算"再次印证小蓝书无差值题；**小蓝书卷十四 4 篇至此完成（G99—G102）**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷四 · Passage 1

Have you heard of the Moser lamp? It is a lamp (灯) that uses no electricity. It was invented by Alfredo Moser, a Brazilian engineer, and it brings light to homes and small businesses in some poor countries.

The Moser lamp is made of a plastic bottle (塑料瓶) filled with water and a little bleach (漂白剂). It is fixed into a round hole in the top of a building, so that the upper part appears



in the sun and the lower part hangs down into the room. The sunshine falls on the upper part of the bottle and makes the water produce light, so the bottom of the bottle shines like an electric bulb (灯泡).
