Although it doesn't work at night, it is widely used in many very poor and crowded areas. In those areas, houses often have small windows or none at all. Even during the day, the room is dark. So in this way, the light bulb can really help a lot to these people. They can have a better life than they used to do.

Then how did this idea come up? The idea of this lamp came up because of a power cut (停电). That day, Moser and his friends talked about how to live without electricity. They imagined if they were lost in the wild, how could they give the alarm? One suggested using a lens (透镜) to focus the sunshine and start a fire. If they didn't have a lens, they could find a plastic bottle with water. This would act as a lens. This idea came into Moser's head. Almost by accident, he developed the lamp. Thanks to this accident, we now have the great Moser lamp.

16. What does Alfredo Moser do?

He is a(n) __________.

17. What materials are needed to make a Moser lamp?

A plastic bottle, some bleach and __________ are needed.

18. What does Paragraph 2 mainly talk about?

It mainly talks about __________.

19. Why is the Moser lamp widely used in many very poor and crowded areas?

Because rooms there are usually __________ even during the daytime.

20. Which word means "聚焦" in the reading?

It is "__________".

**〔G103〕小蓝书预测卷四 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

> 本组为**补全式简答**（RA-5），五题分别落在同位语、材料清单、段意、原因与"释义→词"。

**16. 答案：engineer（He is a Brazilian engineer.）**
1 题面：What does Alfredo Moser do?；框架 "He is a(n) __________."；空位在 a(n) 后，须为单数可数名词（职业）；原文 "It was invented by Alfredo Moser, a Brazilian engineer"；诱导信号：Brazilian 就在名词前，容易被当答案。
2 候选：①engineer；②Brazilian；③inventor（由 invented 反推）；④lamp。
3 验算：①→a Brazilian engineer，空位填 engineer，a(n) 与单数名词吻合→成立（可写 a Brazilian engineer 全短语）。②→Brazilian 是国籍形容词／人，填 a Brazilian 也通，但题干问 does（职业）→次优。③→inventor 是成就反推，原文用 engineer→次优。④→lamp 是发明物→排除。
4 干扰：Brazilian 紧邻 a(n) 位；invented 也像"发明家"。
5 意图：考"空位在 a(n) 后取职业名词（engineer），国籍只作定语"。
6 边界：若问 Who invented the Moser lamp? 答 Alfredo Moser, a Brazilian engineer。若问 What is the Moser lamp made of? 答 A plastic bottle filled with water and a little bleach。
7 错误：A 填 Brazilian.（错因：国籍当职业）；B 填 inventor.（错因：改写）；C 填 lamp.（错因：对象错）。
8 规则：R103.1 若补全式空位在 a(n) 后，then 取同位语中的职业名词（engineer），国籍／形容词只作定语；由动词反推的身份（inventor）须以原文用词为准。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（a(n)＋单数名词）；复用 R43.1（身份取同位语），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①a(n) 后要什么词？②Brazilian 是职业吗？③原文用 engineer 还是 inventor？

**17. 答案：water（A plastic bottle, some bleach and water are needed.）**
1 题面：What materials are needed to make a Moser lamp?；框架 "A plastic bottle, some bleach and __________ are needed."；空位在并列材料末项，须为名词（不可数）；原文 "The Moser lamp is made of a plastic bottle filled with water and a little bleach."；诱导信号：filled with 结构里 water 在前、bleach 在后，与框架顺序相反。
2 候选：①water；②a little bleach（框架已给）；③sunshine；④a lens。
3 验算：①→a plastic bottle＋water＋a little bleach，三项材料齐全→成立。②→框架已有 some bleach，重复→不成立。③→sunshine 是发光条件，不是制作材料→排除。④→lens 是"类比"里的东西（This would act as a lens），不是材料→排除。
4 干扰：filled with water and a little bleach 的顺序与框架相反，抄写时容易重复 bleach；lens 在末段出现两次。
5 意图：考"材料清单按框架裁剪（框架已给 bleach，只补 water）"。
6 边界：若问 What is the plastic bottle filled with? 答 Water and a little bleach。若问 What makes the water produce light? 答 The sunshine falling on the upper part of the bottle。
7 错误：A 填 bleach.（错因：重复框架）；B 填 sunshine.（错因：条件非材料）；C 填 a lens.（错因：类比物）。
8 规则：R103.2 若补全式空位在材料并列清单末项且框架已给某材料，then 只补缺的材料（water），不重复已给项；条件（sunshine）与类比物（lens）不作材料。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.5 框架去重与裁剪；复用 R52.1（并列项去重），本条是"材料清单"。
10 自检：①框架已给什么？②原文材料有哪三项？③lens 是材料吗？

**18. 答案：how the Moser lamp is made (and how it works)（It mainly talks about how the lamp is made.）**
1 题面：What does Paragraph 2 mainly talk about?；框架 "It mainly talks about __________."；第 2 段原文 "The Moser lamp is made of a plastic bottle filled with water and a little bleach. It is fixed into a round hole in the top of a building… The sunshine falls on the upper part of the bottle and makes the water produce light, so the bottom of the bottle shines like an electric bulb."；诱导信号：首段讲"是什么／谁发明"，第 2 段讲"怎么做／怎么亮"。
2 候选：①how the lamp is made（and how it works）；②what the lamp is（定义）；③who invented it；④why it is used in poor areas。
3 验算：①→材料＋固定方式＋发光原理，三段内容合起来是"制作与原理"→成立（用 how 引导的名词性从句最贴框架）。②→定义在首段→排除。③→inventor 在首段→排除。④→poor areas 在第 3 段→排除。
4 干扰：首段也提到 made of 之外的信息，界线容易被拉宽；第 3 段的"穷地区使用"也像"主要讲什么"。
5 意图：考"段意按段落边界取（第 2 段＝制作与原理）"，并用 how 从句填框架。
6 边界：若问 What does Paragraph 3 mainly talk about? 答 Why the lamp is widely used in poor and crowded areas。若问 Who invented it? 答 Alfredo Moser。
7 错误：A 填 what the lamp is.（错因：首段）；B 填 who invented it.（错因：首段）；C 填 why it is widely used.（错因：第 3 段）。
8 规则：R103.3 若补全式问某段 mainly talks about 且空位在 about 后，then 用 how／why 等名词性从句概括该段（第 2 段＝how the lamp is made and how it works）；相邻段的定义、发明者、用途按段落边界排除。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（about 后从句）＋RA-3.2 段意；复用 R82.3（段意按边界），本条须写成从句。
10 自检：①第 2 段讲什么？②定义在哪段？③用途在哪段？

**19. 答案：dark（Because rooms there are usually dark even during the daytime.）**
1 题面：Why is the Moser lamp widely used in many very poor and crowded areas?；框架 "Because rooms there are usually __________ even during the daytime."；空位在 are usually 后（表语），须为形容词；原文 "In those areas, houses often have small windows or none at all. Even during the day, the room is dark."；诱导信号：small windows or none at all 是原因，空位要的是结果形容词。
2 候选：①dark；②small；③crowded；④poor。
3 验算：①→Even during the day, the room is dark，与 even during the daytime 逐字对应→成立。②→small 修饰 windows，不修饰 rooms→排除。③→crowded 修饰 areas，不修饰 rooms→排除。④→poor 修饰 areas→排除。
4 干扰：small windows 与 poor／crowded 都在同段，形容词多，容易填错中心词。
5 意图：考"空位在 are usually 后取形容 rooms 的形容词（dark），同段其他形容词按中心词排除"。
6 边界：若问 Why do houses there have small windows? 答 原文未解释（只说 houses often have small windows or none at all）。若问 What can the lamp help these people do? 答 Have a better life than they used to。
7 错误：A 填 small.（错因：修饰 windows）；B 填 crowded.（错因：修饰 areas）；C 填 poor.（错因：修饰 areas）。
8 规则：R103.4 若补全式空位在 are usually 后，then 取能形容该主语的形容词（rooms→dark），同段其他形容词（small windows／crowded areas／poor countries）按中心词排除。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（表语形容词）；复用 R51.1（表语位），本条是形容词表语。
10 自检：①空位形容谁？②small 修饰谁？③even during the daytime 对应哪句？

**20. 答案：focus（It is "focus".）**
1 题面：Which word means "聚焦" in the reading?；框架 "It is "__________"."；原文 "One suggested using a lens (透镜) to focus the sunshine and start a fire."；疑问方式：给中文释义找英文词（**反向词义**，复用 R60.4）；诱导信号：lens／sunshine／alarm 等词都与"光"或"信号"有关。
2 候选：①focus；②shine；③start；④lens。
3 验算：①→using a lens to focus the sunshine，focus 与"聚焦"对应→成立。②→shine 是"发光"，主语是 the bottom of the bottle→排除。③→start 是"生火"（start a fire），不是聚焦→排除。④→lens 是"透镜"，工具而非动作→排除。
4 干扰：lens 的注释（透镜）紧挨 focus，且"用透镜"像"聚焦"；shine／light 在全文反复出现。
5 意图：考"释义→词：须找与中文释义同义的原文词（focus），工具名（lens）不作答案"。
6 边界：若问 Which word means "透镜"? 答 lens。若问 What did one of them suggest doing? 答 Using a lens to focus the sunshine and start a fire。
7 错误：A 填 lens.（错因：工具当动作）；B 填 shine.（错因：发光≠聚焦）；C 填 start.（错因：生火≠聚焦）。
8 规则：R103.5（复用 R60.4）若题干给中文释义找英文词，then 到原文找同义词（focus），并在原句核对搭配（focus the sunshine）；工具名（lens）与近义动作（shine／start）不取；答案须是单个词。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.6 反向词义（释义→词）；与 R60.4（rude）同族，本条动词。
10 自检：①"聚焦"对应哪句？②lens 是什么词性？③答案是一个词吗？

**组小结（G103 · 小蓝书预测卷四 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：同位语职业 1（16）；材料清单裁剪 1（17）；段意（how 从句）1（18）；表语形容词 1（19）；反向词义 1（20）。
- 规则：R103.1 a(n) 后取职业（16）；R103.2 材料裁剪（17）；R103.3 how 从句段意（18）；R103.4 表语按中心词（19）；R103.5 释义→词（20，复用 R60.4）。
- 冲突与优先级：R103.1 与"Brazilian 紧邻"冲突，职业优先；R103.2 与"filled with 顺序反"冲突，去重优先；R103.3 与"首段定义"冲突，段落边界优先；R103.4 与"small／poor 同段"冲突，中心词优先；R103.5 与"lens 紧邻"冲突，同义动作优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：补全式第 5 整组（G51／G52／G59／G60／本条）；本篇把 RA-5 的"同位语／材料裁剪／从句段意／表语形容词／释义→词"五种空位走了一遍；数字（1,731 grams 见后篇）无换算，**本组无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷四 · Passage 2

These days, with the rapid development of technology, the ways of celebrating the Spring Festival are very different from before.

Xiao Yao is a college student from China. He loves Spring Festival and often spends it with his closest family members and classmates. He always has lots of traditions to follow during the Spring Festival. These traditions include those that his parents told him, and those he learned as he grew up.



At the start of a new year, Chinese families used to give out lucky money in a red envelope to their children for good luck. It used to be a very popular tradition. However, in recent years, Xiao has taught his family members how to give *hongbao* through WeChat wallets on their mobile phones. "The *hongbao* is often grabbed (抢) by group members in only a few seconds. We compete against one another. It's fun," said Xiao. "The world is developing as social needs are changing."

According to a report by *China Youth Daily*, having parties and going skating are the most popular activities for the young to celebrate the Spring Festival. These newly-born ways of celebrating a traditional festival represent the changes of our society and our lives. While new ideas are appearing, many young people still believe following traditions can make them feel close to the older generation. Li Yu, a college student, said that putting up couplets on the doors and watching the Spring Festival Gala on television with parents have never been missed. More and more people are calling for actions to save and pass on the old traditions.

However, whatever way people choose to spend the new year, what is the most important is still the love to people around ourselves and the good wishes to the upcoming year.

21. Who can get lucky money at the start of a new year?

__________ can get lucky money.

22. How have Xiao's family members given *hongbao* in recent years?

They have given *hongbao* to a group through __________.

23. What are the most popular activities for the young to celebrate the Spring Festival?

__________ are the most popular activities for them.

24. Which English word in the last paragraph means "对联"?

It's "__________".

25. How many traditions have Li Yu never missed during the Spring Festival?

He has never missed __________ traditions.

**〔G104〕小蓝书预测卷四 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

> 本组为**补全式简答**（RA-5）第 6 整组。第 24 题题干写"in the last paragraph"，但 couplets 实际出现在倒数第二段，属原文表述不精确——照抄不改，按词义取词。

**21. 答案：Children（Children can get lucky money.）**
1 题面：Who can get lucky money at the start of a new year?；框架 "__________ can get lucky money."；空位在句首作主语，须为"人"的名词；原文 "At the start of a new year, Chinese families used to give out lucky money in a red envelope to their children for good luck."；诱导信号：Chinese families 在给钱一方，紧挨 lucky money。
2 候选：①children；②Chinese families；③group members；④the young。
3 验算：①→give out lucky money…to their children，to 后的对象＝收钱人→成立。②→families 是给钱方，方向反→排除。③→group members 是抢 hongbao 的人（电子红包）→次优。④→the young 范围偏大，原文用 children→次优。
4 干扰：Chinese families 与 lucky money 同句且在前；group members 也在本段出现。
5 意图：考"主语位取 give…to 后的对象（children），给钱方不作主语"。
6 边界：若问 Who used to give out lucky money? 答 Chinese families。若问 What do group members do with the hongbao? 答 They grab it in only a few seconds。
7 错误：A 填 Chinese families.（错因：方向反）；B 填 Group members.（错因：电子红包场景）；C 填 Parents.（错因：原文用 families／children）。
8 规则：R104.1 若补全式空位在句首作主语且原文有 give…to sb，then 取 to 后的对象（children）；给钱方（families）不作主语；同段的"抢红包者"（group members）按场景排除。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（主语位）；复用 R51.2（主语位取名词），本条是"收受对象"。
10 自检：①to 后是谁？②families 是给还是收？③group members 属于哪种红包？

**22. 答案：WeChat wallets（on their mobile phones）（They have given hongbao to a group through WeChat wallets.）**
1 题面：How have Xiao's family members given hongbao in recent years?；框架 "They have given hongbao to a group through __________."；空位在 through 后，须为媒介名词；原文 "in recent years, Xiao has taught his family members how to give hongbao through WeChat wallets on their mobile phones."；诱导信号：a red envelope 是旧方式，同段对比。
2 候选：①WeChat wallets；②a red envelope；③mobile phones（载体）；④group chats。
3 验算：①→give hongbao through WeChat wallets，through 后即媒介→成立（可补 on their mobile phones）。②→red envelope 是"used to"的旧方式，与 in recent years 相反→不成立。③→mobile phones 是载体，through 后更常接"钱包／App"→次优。④→group chats 是抢红包的场景→排除。
4 干扰：a red envelope 与 lucky money 同段反复出现；mobile phones 紧跟其后。
5 意图：考"through 后取媒介（WeChat wallets），旧方式（red envelope）按时间排除"。
6 边界：若问 How did families use to give lucky money? 答 In a red envelope。若问 How fast is a hongbao grabbed? 答 In only a few seconds。
7 错误：A 填 a red envelope.（错因：旧方式）；B 填 mobile phones.（错因：载体非媒介）；C 填 group chats.（错因：场景）。
8 规则：R104.2 若补全式空位在 through 后，then 取媒介名词（WeChat wallets），可补载体（on their mobile phones）；被 in recent years 对立的旧方式（a red envelope）与抢包场景（group chats）不作媒介。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性锁定（介词宾语）；复用 R19.2（through 取方式），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①through 后是什么？②red envelope 是现在还是过去？③group chats 是什么？

**23. 答案：Having parties and going skating（Having parties and going skating are the most popular activities for them.）**
1 题面：What are the most popular activities for the young to celebrate the Spring Festival?；框架 "__________ are the most popular activities for them."；空位在句首作主语，谓语是 are，须为复数／并列的动名词短语；原文 "having parties and going skating are the most popular activities for the young to celebrate the Spring Festival."；诱导信号：原文用动名词，框架主语位须保持 -ing 形式。
2 候选：①Having parties and going skating；②Have parties and go skating（原形）；③having parties（只取一项）；④the Spring Festival Gala。
3 验算：①→having parties and going skating are the most popular activities，两项动名词并列作主语→成立（首字母大写，两项都写）。②→原形动词不能作主语（与 are 搭配）→不成立。③→只取一项，与 are／activities 复数不合→次优。④→Gala 是 Li Yu 家保留的传统，不是"最受欢迎的活动"→排除。
4 干扰：原文小写 having／going，抄写时容易改成原形；Gala 也在文中，且是"春节"活动。
5 意图：考"主语位保持动名词形式（形式随框架），两项并列取全"。
6 边界：若问 What activities are popular for the young? 答 Having parties and going skating。若问 What has Li Yu never missed? 答 Putting up couplets and watching the Spring Festival Gala。
7 错误：A 填 Have parties and go skating.（错因：形式错）；B 填 Having parties.（错因：漏一项）；C 填 Watching the Gala.（错因：别人的传统）。
8 规则：R104.3 若补全式空位在句首作主语且谓语为 are，then 取原文的动名词并列并保持 -ing（Having parties and going skating），两项都写；原形改写与单项都不合框架；他人保留的传统（Gala）不作"最受欢迎"。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（动名词作主语）；复用 R59.2（形式随框架改），本条是"动名词主语"。
10 自检：①谓语是 are 还是 is？②原文是 -ing 吗？③Gala 是谁的传统？

**24. 答案：couplets（It's "couplets".）**
1 题面：Which English word in the last paragraph means "对联"?；框架 "It's "__________"."；原文（倒数第二段）"Li Yu, a college student, said that putting up couplets on the doors and watching the Spring Festival Gala on television with parents have never been missed."；疑问方式：给中文释义找英文词（反向词义，复用 R60.4／R103.5）；诱导信号：题干说 last paragraph，但该词在倒数第二段——按词义取词即可。
2 候选：①couplets；②Gala；③envelope；④traditions。
3 验算：①→putting up couplets on the doors，couplets 与"对联（贴上门）"对应→成立。②→Gala 是"联欢晚会"，不是对联→排除。③→envelope 是红包信封→排除。④→traditions 是上位词→排除。
4 干扰：Gala 与 couplets 在同一并列结构里，都是"过年做的事"；envelope 与 couplets 都与"红／门"沾边。
5 意图：考"释义→词：找同义原文词（couplets），并核对搭配（put up couplets）"。
6 边界：若问 What does Li Yu never miss? 答 Putting up couplets and watching the Spring Festival Gala。若问 Which word means "晚会"? 答 Gala。
7 错误：A 填 Gala.（错因：晚会）；B 填 envelope.（错因：信封）；C 填 traditions.（错因：上位词）。
8 规则：R104.4 若题干给中文释义找英文词，then 取同义原文词（couplets）并用搭配核对（put up couplets on the doors）；同并列结构的另一项（Gala）与上位词（traditions）不取；题干段落标注不精确时按词义取，不因此改写原文。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.6 反向词义（释义→词）；复用 R60.4，本条名词复数形式不丢 -s。
10 自检：①"对联"对应哪个词？②Gala 是什么？③复数 -s 写了吗？

**25. 答案：two（He has never missed two traditions.）**
1 题面：How many traditions have Li Yu never missed during the Spring Festival?；框架 "He has never missed __________ traditions."；空位在数词位，须为基数词；原文 "putting up couplets on the doors and watching the Spring Festival Gala on television with parents have never been missed."；诱导信号：同段还有 having parties／going skating（年轻人的新方式），容易一起数。
2 候选：①two；②three；③four；④one。
3 验算：①→putting up couplets＋watching the Gala，两项→成立。②→加入 having parties 或 going skating 就错（那是"最受欢迎的活动"，不是 Li Yu 的传统）→不成立。③→同上，多算→排除。④→只算一项，漏另一项→排除。
4 干扰：段落里活动名词密集（parties／skating／couplets／Gala）；"traditions"一词也出现在"following traditions can make them feel close"里。
5 意图：考"清点题按主体（Li Yu）与类别（traditions）双重限定"。
6 边界：若问 How many activities are the most popular for the young? 答 Two（having parties and going skating）。若问 What are Li Yu's two traditions? 答 Putting up couplets and watching the Gala。
7 错误：A 填 three.（错因：混入新方式）；B 填 four.（错因：全段活动都数）；C 填 one.（错因：漏一项）。
8 规则：R104.5 若问 How many traditions have sb never missed，then 按主体（Li Yu）与类别（traditions）清点该句的并列项（couplets＋Gala＝two）；同段"年轻人最受欢迎的活动"（parties／skating）不混入。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（清点＋主体限定）；复用 R45.2（清点去重），本条是"按主体筛"。
10 自检：①Li Yu 保留几项？②parties／skating 是谁的？③traditions 一词还出现在哪？

**组小结（G104 · 小蓝书预测卷四 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：主语位（收受者）1（21）；through 媒介 1（22）；动名词主语 1（23）；反向词义 1（24）；清点＋主体 1（25）。
- 规则：R104.1 收受者取 to 后对象（21）；R104.2 through 取媒介（22）；R104.3 动名词主语保 -ing（23）；R104.4 释义→词（24）；R104.5 按主体清点（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R104.1 与"families 紧邻"冲突，to 后对象优先；R104.2 与"red envelope 反复"冲突，in recent years 优先；R104.3 与"原文小写"冲突，框架形式优先；R104.4 与"Gala 同并列"冲突，同义词优先；R104.5 与"活动密集"冲突，主体＋类别双重限定。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：春节习俗题材首见；本篇"新旧对比（red envelope→WeChat wallets）"是 04 的时间对比样本；数字（few seconds／two traditions／nineteen 无）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷四 · Passage 3

New rules and behavior standards for middle school students came out in March. Middle schools are going to use a new way to decide who the top students are. The best students won't only have high marks. The following are some of the new rules.

Tell the truth. Have you ever cheated in an exam? Don't do it again! That's not



something an honest students should do. It is very important to keep honest in tests, because it is where you can find out your weaknesses and try to improve them.

Do more at school. Good students love animals and care for other people. April is Bird-loving month in China. Is your school doing anything to celebrate it? You should join! In that way, you can learn more about animals and how to protect them.

Be open to new ideas. Have you ever thought people could live on the moon? Maybe you'll find another earth in space in the future. Everyone's now ideas are important. If you have some creative ideas, you should pay good attention to them and treasure them, because those ideas can make you stand out among others.

Protect yourself. Has a thief ever taken money from one of your classmates? Don't let it happen to you. If you have to go back home late, you should let your parents know.

Use the Internet carefully. The Internet can be very useful for your study. But some things on the Internet aren't for kids, so try to look at the good web pages. You can use the web pages for fun or homework.

**〔G105〕小蓝书预测卷四 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：In March.**
1 题面：When did the new rules come out；原文 "New rules and behavior standards for middle school students came out in March."；疑问词 When（问月份）；诱导信号：首段还有 April is Bird-loving month 的月份。
2 候选：①in March；②in April；③this year；④at the start of the term。
3 验算：①→came out in March，came out 与 When 直接对应→成立。②→April 是"爱鸟月"，属另一条建议→排除。③→this year 原文未给→排除。④→原文未提学期→排除。
4 干扰：April 在同一段（Do more at school 部分），两个月份容易混。
5 意图：考"时间取 came out 同句的月份"。
6 边界：若问 Why is April important in the passage? 答 Because April is Bird-loving month in China。若问 What are the new rules about? 答 How to decide who the top students are。
7 错误：A 答 In April.（错因：爱鸟月）；B 答 This year.（错因：无据）；C 答 In September.（错因：改写）。
8 规则：R105.1 若问 When did X come out，then 取 came out 同句的时间（in March）；同段另一月份（April）属另一条建议，按事件排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（月份—事件配对）；复用 R58.2（时间按事件配对），本条是"月份"。
10 自检：①came out 与哪个月同句？②April 是什么？③我编了年份吗？

**27. 答案：They shouldn't cheat (in an exam).**
1 题面：What shouldn't students do in an exam；原文 "Tell the truth. Have you ever cheated in an exam? Don't do it again! That's not something an honest students should do."；疑问词 What shouldn't（问禁止行为）；诱导信号：同段还有 keep honest in tests 的正面说法。
2 候选：①cheat；②tell the truth；③keep honest；④find out weaknesses。
3 验算：①→cheated in an exam? Don't do it again，禁止的正是 cheat→成立。②③→是正面要求（Tell the truth／keep honest）→不成立（方向反）。④→find out weaknesses 是考试的作用→排除。
4 干扰：Tell the truth 是小标题式祈使句，最像"该做的事"；keep honest 也与考试相关。
5 意图：考"不应该做的事取 Don't do it again 指代的行为（cheat），正面要求不作禁止项"。
6 边界：若问 What should students do in tests? 答 Keep honest（tell the truth）。若问 Why is honesty important in tests? 答 Because it is where you can find out your weaknesses and try to improve them。
7 错误：A 答 Tell the truth.（错因：正面要求）；B 答 Help others.（错因：另一条）；C 答 Use the Internet.（错因：另一条）。
8 规则：R105.2 若问 What shouldn't sb do，then 取 Don't do it again／否定句指代的行为（cheat）；同段正面祈使句（Tell the truth／keep honest）不作禁止项。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（禁止项）；复用 R17.2（否定还原），本条是"Don't 指代"。
10 自检：①Don't do it 指什么？②Tell the truth 是禁止还是要求？③keep honest 呢？

**28. 答案：You should let your parents know.**
1 题面：What should you do if you have to go back home late；原文 "Protect yourself…If you have to go back home late, you should let your parents know."；疑问词 What should you do if（问做法）；诱导信号：同段还有 thief／money 的例子。
2 候选：①let your parents know；②stay at school；③walk home alone quickly；④call the police。
3 验算：①→If you have to go back home late, you should let your parents know，条件＋建议→成立。②→原文无→排除。③→与 Protect yourself 相反→排除。④→原文未提报警→排除。
4 干扰：thief／money 的例子在前，像"应对办法"；Protect yourself 的小标题也容易被当答案本身。
5 意图：考"条件句后取 should do，例子不作做法"。
6 边界：若问 What should you do if a thief takes money from a classmate? 答 原文未给具体做法，只说 Don't let it happen to you。若问 What is the last tip about? 答 Using the Internet carefully。
7 错误：A 答 Call the police.（错因：无据）；B 答 Protect yourself.（错因：标题当作法）；C 答 Stay with classmates.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R105.3 若问 What should you do if…，then 取该条件句后的 should do（let your parents know）；同段举例（thief／money）与小标题（Protect yourself）不作具体做法。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（条件＋建议）；复用 R20.1（To do 即目的），本条是"if 条件＋should"。
10 自检：①条件句后是什么？②thief 例子给了办法吗？③标题能当做法吗？

**29. 答案：No, they aren't. The web pages can be used for fun or homework.**
1 题面：The web pages are only used for fun, aren't they?；反意疑问句；原文 "You can use the web pages for fun or homework."；疑问方式：反意疑问＋only（全称限制）；诱导信号：fun 在前，homework 在后，容易只读前半。
2 候选：①No＋for fun or homework；②Yes（only for fun）；③No（without reason）；④Yes, only for fun。
3 验算：①→for fun or homework，or 表示两者皆可，否定 only→答 No＋依据→成立。②④→与 or homework 冲突→不成立。③→表态对但缺依据→次优。
4 干扰：only 是题干强加的限定，原文没有；fun 出现在前，homework 在后容易被截断。
5 意图：考"反意疑问＋only：先否掉 only，再给完整范围"。
6 边界：若问 What can the Internet be useful for? 答 For your study（and homework）。若问 What should you try to look at? 答 The good web pages。
7 错误：A 答 Yes, they are.（错因：漏 or homework）；B 答 No, they are only for homework.（错因：另一极端）；C 答 Yes, only for fun.（错因：重复题干）。
8 规则：R105.4 若反意疑问句含 only，then 到原文找 or／both 类并列（for fun or homework），答 No＋完整范围；不得只取一项，也不得反向极端（only homework）；表态后须补依据。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.34 一般疑问句简答（only 型）；复用 R56.2（only 必找反例），本条是反意疑问。
10 自检：①原文有 only 吗？②or 后是什么？③我补依据了吗？

**30. 答案：Five（Tell the truth; Do more at school; Be open to new ideas; Protect yourself; Use the Internet carefully）.**
1 题面：How many tips (建议) are there in the passage；原文以五个祈使句小标题分段：Tell the truth／Do more at school／Be open to new ideas／Protect yourself／Use the Internet carefully；诱导信号：每段内部还有例子（Bird-loving month／moon／thief），容易被当成"建议条数"。
2 候选：①five；②four；③six；④three。
3 验算：①→五个祈使句小标题各领一段→成立（可列名）。②→漏一条即少算，如漏 Protect yourself→不成立。③→把例子当建议会多算→排除。④→明显少算→排除。
4 干扰：各段的例子（爱鸟月／登月想象／小偷）在视觉上像"小标题"；最后一段 Use the Internet carefully 与前面格式一致，容易被漏。
5 意图：考"清点按祈使句小标题，例子不计数"。
6 边界：若问 What is the first tip? 答 Tell the truth。若问 What is the last tip? 答 Use the Internet carefully。
7 错误：A 答 Four.（错因：漏一条）；B 答 Six.（错因：例子计入）；C 答 Three.（错因：少算）。
8 规则：R105.5 若问 How many tips are there，then 按祈使句小标题清点（五条），段内例子（爱鸟月／moon／thief）不计；可列出五条以自证。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（按小标题清点）；复用 R64.1（小标题取全），本条是计数。
10 自检：①五个小标题是什么？②例子算吗？③我漏了哪条？

**组小结（G105 · 小蓝书预测卷四 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：时间（月份）1（26）；禁止项 1（27）；条件＋建议 1（28）；反意疑问（only）1（29）；小标题清点 1（30）。
- 规则：R105.1 月份按事件（26）；R105.2 Don't 指代取行为（27）；R105.3 条件后取 should（28）；R105.4 only 型答 No＋完整范围（29）；R105.5 小标题清点（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R105.1 与"April 同段"冲突，came out 优先；R105.2 与"Tell the truth 祈使句"冲突，否定行为优先；R105.3 与"thief 例子"冲突，条件句优先；R105.4 与"fun 在前"冲突，or 并列优先；R105.5 与"例子像标题"冲突，祈使句优先。

### 2024湖北专升本小蓝书预测卷四 · Passage 4

Chang'e-5 has returned from the moon to Earth. The mission's success made China the third country to bring back samples（样本）from the moon. The successful return of Chang'e-5 from the moon to Earth has brought great excitement and pride to many Chinese people. It not only finished the task, but also made great contributions to the country.

Chang'e-5 was China's third mission to land on the moon, and it's first to get samples from the moon. What is amazing is that there were no astronauts on this trip. Scientists ran



the mission with robotic machines.

Chang'e-5 was *launched* (发射) from Wenchang Spacecraft Launch Site on November 24th, 2020. On December 1st, it got to the moon. During the stay on the moon, it got 1,731 grams of lunar samples. On December 3rd, our national flag was shown on the moon. After that, Chang'e-5 was ready to go home. On December 17th, Chang'e-5 landed safely in Inner Mongolia.

Chang'e-5 was the first mission to get samples from the moon in over 40 years. The samples will help scientists better understand the history of the moon and the solar system.

The Chang'e-5 mission has made many Chinese people excited and proud of their country's success. The mission's success shows China's capabilities in space exploration and its commitment（承诺）to advancing scientific knowledge. The mission also showed that China has a first-rate (一流的) space program that is able to compete with other countries.

**〔G106〕小蓝书预测卷四 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

> **本组 Q33 是小蓝书全 100 篇里第一处真正的"日期差值"题**（11 月 24 日发射→12 月 17 日着陆，须算出天数）；此前只有"年份加算"（R70.5）与"语义校正"（R63.2）。

**31. 答案：Yes, it was. (It was China's first mission to get samples from the moon.)**
1 题面：Was Chang'e-5 China's first mission to get samples from the moon；原文 "Chang'e-5 was China's third mission to land on the moon, and it's first to get samples from the moon."＋"Chang'e-5 was the first mission to get samples from the moon in over 40 years."；疑问词 Was…first（一般疑问）；诱导信号：同句有 third（第三次登月），容易混淆。
2 候选：①Yes（first to get samples）；②No（third mission）；③No（first to land）；④Yes, third。
3 验算：①→it's first to get samples from the moon＋the first mission to get samples in over 40 years，两处支持→成立。②→third 修饰 mission to land，不是 get samples→不成立。③→它是第三次登月，不是首次登月→排除。④→Yes 与 third 混搭，自相矛盾→排除。
4 干扰：third 与 first 同句并列，两个序数词容易互换；in over 40 years 也像"不是首次"。
5 意图：考"first／third 按名词中心（get samples vs land）配对"。
6 边界：若问 How many missions had landed on the moon before Chang'e-5? 答 Two（它是第三次）。若问 What did Chang'e-5 bring back? 答 1,731 grams of lunar samples。
7 错误：A 答 No, it was the third.（错因：third 修饰 land）；B 答 No, it was the first to land.（错因：与 third to land 矛盾）；C 答 Yes, it was the third.（错因：自相矛盾）。
8 规则：R106.1 若题干问 Was X the first to do A 且原文同时有 third to do B，then 按名词中心配对（first to get samples／third to land），答 Yes＋first to get samples；两个序数词不可互换。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.19 序数／最高级指向；复用 R33.1（最高级只认搭配主语），本条是序数词。
10 自检：①first 修饰什么？②third 修饰什么？③是首次登月吗？

**32. 答案：On November 24th, 2020.**
1 题面：When was Chang'e-5 launched；原文 "Chang'e-5 was launched (发射) from Wenchang Spacecraft Launch Site on November 24th, 2020."；疑问词 When（问日期）；诱导信号：本段有五个日期（Nov 24／Dec 1／Dec 3／Dec 17＋in over 40 years）。
2 候选：①November 24th, 2020；②December 1st；③December 17th；④December 3rd。
3 验算：①→was launched…on November 24th, 2020，launched 与日期同句→成立。②→got to the moon 的日期→排除。③→landed safely 的日期→排除。④→national flag shown 的日期→排除。
4 干扰：五个日期连续出现，动词不同（launched／got to／shown／landed），不按动词配对就会串。
5 意图：考"日期按动词配对（launched→Nov 24）"。
6 边界：若问 When did it land? 答 On December 17th（2020）。若问 When did it get to the moon? 答 On December 1st。
7 错误：A 答 December 1st.（错因：到达月球）；B 答 December 17th.（错因：着陆）；C 答 2020 only.（错因：漏月日）。
8 规则：R106.2 若问 When was X launched，then 取 launched 同句的完整日期（November 24th, 2020）；同段其他动词的日期（got to／shown／landed）按动词配对排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（日期—动词配对）；复用 R99.1（日期按事件配对），本条五个日期同段。
10 自检：①launched 与哪个日期同句？②Dec 17 是什么？③年份写了吗？

**33. 答案：About 23 days（from November 24th to December 17th, 2020）.**
1 题面：How long has Chang-5 been in space（原题 Chang-5 缺 'e，照抄）；原文 "launched…on November 24th, 2020…On December 17th, Chang'e-5 landed safely in Inner Mongolia."；疑问方式：给两个日期，要求算天数（**差值**）；诱导信号：原文没有直接写"在轨多少天"，必须自己相减。
2 候选：①23 days（11/24→12/17）；②24 days（把首尾都算）；③about a month（约数）；④from November 24th to December 17th（只描述区间）。
3 验算：①→11 月 24 日到 11 月 30 日为 6 天，12 月 1 日到 17 日为 17 天，合计 23 天→成立（须落笔算）。②→首尾都计入会多 1 天→不成立。③→about a month 太粗，且 23 天＜一个月→次优。④→只复述两个日期，未回答"多久"→次优。
4 干扰：原文没有"23 days"这个数字，学生容易只抄两个日期；11 月只有 30 天，跨月计算也易错（把 11 月当 31 天会得 24 天）。
5 意图：考"跨月日期相减"，这是小蓝书唯一需要真正笔算的题。
6 边界：若问 When did Chang'e-5 land? 答 On December 17th, 2020。若问 How long had it stayed on the moon? 答 原文只给 Dec 1 到达与 Dec 3 展示国旗，未给离开日期，不可强算。
7 错误：A 答 24 days.（错因：首尾都算／11 月按 31 天）；B 答 From November 24th to December 17th.（错因：区间当天数）；C 答 About 40 days.（错因：与 over 40 years 混）。
8 规则：R106.3 若问 How long has X been in space 且原文只给发射与着陆两个日期，then 用两日期相减（11/24→12/17＝23 天），答案须为天数；不得首尾都算，不得只复述区间，也不得把 in over 40 years 的"40 年"拿来用。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（**日期差值，本稿首例**）；与 R70.5（年份加算）并列，构成"数字推算"两型。
10 自检：①两个日期各是什么？②11 月有几天？③我落笔算了吗？

**34. 答案：Scientists.**
1 题面：Who could use the samples to do some research；原文 "The samples will help scientists better understand the history of the moon and the solar system."；疑问词 Who（问人群）；诱导信号：同段还有 China／many Chinese people（情感主体）。
2 候选：①scientists；②Chinese people；③astronauts；④the government。
3 验算：①→help scientists better understand the history of the moon，help sb do 的主语受益者→成立。②→Chinese people 是感到骄傲的人，不是做研究的人→排除。③→原文明确 there were no astronauts on this trip→排除。④→government 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：astronauts 是航天题材的高频词，但原文特意说"没有宇航员"；Chinese people 在首尾段反复出现。
5 意图：考"Who 取 help 的受益对象（scientists），并注意 no astronauts 的否定"。
6 边界：若问 Were there any astronauts on Chang'e-5? 答 No, there were no astronauts（scientists ran the mission with robotic machines）。若问 What will the samples help scientists understand? 答 The history of the moon and the solar system。
7 错误：A 答 Astronauts.（错因：与 no astronauts 相反）；B 答 Chinese people.（错因：情感主体）；C 答 The government.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R106.4 若问 Who could use X to do research，then 取 help 的受益对象（scientists）；同段的"感到骄傲的人"（Chinese people）与题材高频词（astronauts，且被 no 否定）不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（受益对象）；复用 R33.3（多主体配对），本条是"受益者"。
10 自检：①help 后是谁？②有宇航员吗？③Chinese people 做什么？

**35. 答案：We feel excited and proud (of our country's success).**
1 题面：As Chinese, how do we feel about Chang'e-5's success；原文 "The successful return of Chang'e-5 from the moon to Earth has brought great excitement and pride to many Chinese people."＋"The Chang'e-5 mission has made many Chinese people excited and proud of their country's success."；疑问词 How do we feel（问感受）；诱导信号：同段还有 shows China's capabilities／commitment 等评价，属意义而非感受。
2 候选：①excited and proud；②worried；③surprised only；④indifferent。
3 验算：①→brought great excitement and pride＋made many Chinese people excited and proud，两处同向→成立（两个形容词都写）。②→与 excitement／pride 相反→排除。③→surprised 原文未用，且漏 proud→次优。④→indifferent 相反→排除。
4 干扰：shows China's capabilities 与 first-rate space program 是"意义"，容易被当感受；great excitement and pride 是名词形式，需转形容词。
5 意图：考"感受取 excitement／pride 两处，意义句不作感受；名词可转形容词"。
6 边界：若问 What does the success show? 答 China's capabilities in space exploration and its commitment to advancing scientific knowledge。若问 Why is the mission important for science? 答 The samples will help scientists understand the history of the moon and the solar system。
7 错误：A 答 We feel China is strong.（错因：意义当感受）；B 答 We feel worried.（错因：相反）；C 答 We feel surprised.（错因：漏 proud）。
8 规则：R106.5 若问 How do we feel about X，then 取 excitement／pride 类情感词并转为形容词（excited and proud），两词都写；意义句（capabilities／commitment／first-rate program）不作感受。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.13 情绪（名词转形容词）；复用 R37.2（引语双面），本条是"情感名词转换"。
10 自检：①情感词有哪些？②capabilities 属什么？③我漏了 proud 吗？

**组小结（G106 · 小蓝书预测卷四 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：序数词配对 1（31）；日期按动词 1（32）；**日期差值 1（33）**；受益对象 1（34）；情感词转换 1（35）。
- 规则：R106.1 first／third 按名词中心（31）；R106.2 日期按动词配对（32）；**R106.3 日期相减得天数（33）**；R106.4 受益对象取 scientists（34）；R106.5 情感名词转形容词（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R106.1 与"third 同句"冲突，名词中心优先；R106.2 与"五个日期"冲突，动词配对优先；R106.3 与"只抄区间"冲突，落笔相减优先；R106.4 与"astronauts 高频"冲突，no astronauts 优先；R106.5 与"意义句"冲突，情感词优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**日期差值首见（Q33＝23 天）**——小蓝书 100 篇里第一处真正需要笔算的题，与 R70.5（年份加算）合为"数字推算"两型；**百分比差值仍 0**；图表仍 0；应用文 3 例；**小蓝书卷四 4 篇至此完成（G103—G106），小蓝书 100 篇全部收官**。


> 小蓝书：100 块

### 新题型考前冲刺预测卷10 · Passage 1

Directions: Read the following passage. After reading it, you should give brief answers to the 5 questions (No.11 to No.15) that follow. The answers (in no more than 3 words) should be written after



the corresponding numbers on the Answer Sheet.

（Mike is telling a story. It happened when he was seven.）

It was New Year's Eve. In the morning, I heard Grandma tell Mum she needed a football for the New Year's Eve dinner.

"A football for the dinner? What's it for?" I wondered. "Anyway, I will get one! I can do something nice for Grandma."

I remembered my friend Joe had an old football. I went out quietly and found him. I gave him my favorite model car in exchange for his football.

I took the football home, shined it and put it on the living room table secretly. I waited in my room for Grandma to notice it.

"Mike!" Mum shouted. I ran to the living room. "Why can't you put your things where they belong? Get the football out of here!"

"But it's for Grandma! She said she needed a football for the New Year's Eve dinner." I said.

"A football for the dinner?" Mum laughed, "No, Grandma needs a fruit bowl, not a football."

"Fruit bowl sounds like football! I have done a silly thing!" I went back to my room, embarrassed and disappointed.

Before dinner, Mum came in and asked me to meet my uncles and aunts. When I walked into the living room, Grandma was showing them a fruit bowl with the old football in its center. I was surprised.

"Look!" Grandma said, "Today Mike brought me a nice present, this football. Isn't it beautiful?" She continued, "It's beautiful, yes—because anything from a child is beautiful."

11. How old was Mike when the story happened?

He was ______________________________.

12. What did Mike give Joe to get the football?

His favorite ______________________________.



13. Whom did Mike expect to notice the football?

His ______________________________.

14. Why did Mike think he had done a silly thing?

Because he misunderstood his grandma's words "fruit bowl" ______________________________.

15. What did Grandma do with the football?

Grandma put the old football in the center of ______________________________.

Finding a good work-at-home job is not easy. Although you see all the online advertising, there aren't that many of them. Those that are available may require that you live in a certain area or spend at least some time in the office. Others may be only part-time jobs.

To get started, consider your job search as your job. Spend as many hours per week on your job search as you would spend working. If you're looking for full-time work, you should be spending full-time hours seeking a job.

Networking（人际联系）remains the top way to find a job and it does work. Develop contacts—friends, family, even the other job seekers—anyone who might have the information you need. You can take a direct approach and ask for job information or try a less formal approach and ask for information and advice. Contact everyone you know and tell them you want to work from home. You may be surprised



by the people they know and the job information they can provide.

### 新题型考前冲刺预测卷11 · Passage 2

Directions: Read the following passage. After reading it, you should give brief answers to the 5 questions (No.16 to No.20) that follow. The answers (in no more than 3 words) should be written after the corresponding numbers on the Answer Sheet.

Scientists believe that 4.5 billion years ago, Mars and Earth began their existence under similar conditions. During the first billion years, liquid water was abundant on the surface of Mars. This is an indication that Mars was much warmer at that time. Mars also had a thicker atmosphere of carbon dioxide (CO₂). Many scientists think it is possible that life began under these favorable conditions. After all, Earth developed the atmosphere which is rich in oxygen and the ozone layer. Ozone (O₃) is a form of oxygen. The ozone layer protects the Earth from harmful ultraviolet light from the Sun. While life not only began on Earth, it also survived and became more complex. In contrast, Mars lost its thick atmosphere of carbon dioxide and ultraviolet radiation intensified (加剧). The planet eventually grew colder, and its water froze.

In 1976, two American spacecraft landed on Mars and performed four experiments. Three experiments tested for biological activity in the soil. Unfortunately, these tests did not lead to any definite results. The fourth experiment looked for any evidence of life, dead or alive, but found none. Scientists



are planning another investigation of Mars. They want to search for fossils, the ancient remains of life. If life ever existed on Mars, the future mission may find records of it under sand or in the ice. Even if the further mission discovers no evidence of past or present life on Mars, the new mission may clarify our understanding of how life begins. Scientists will better understand the conditions that are necessary for the survival of life on Earth or in the universe.

### 新题型考前冲刺预测卷12 · Passage 1

Directions: Read the following passage. After reading it, you should give brief answers to the 5 questions (No.11 to No.15) that follow. The answers (in no more than 3 words) should be written after the corresponding numbers on the Answer Sheet.



Does stress, anger, or sadness drive you to eat? Do you turn to food for comfort, or when you're bored? Many people do. If you often eat for emotional reasons instead of being physically hungry, that can be a problem.

Obeying the urge to eat more than you need is certain to gain weight. It's an even bigger problem if you already have health conditions like high blood pressure.

You can get back in control of your emotional eating. The surprising part is that it's not really about food at all. The solution to emotional eating is less about eating than it is about emotions. You can start with a simple step. "Make a list of what is stressing you, and make a plan to take control of the situation," New York psychologist Patricia Farrell says. If you can change the situation, go for it. If the problem is out of your control, you can manage the way you think about it. If you can notice your stress at the moment, you can choose how you respond, rather than react the way you have done in the past. It helps to add a delay between the urge to eat and actual eating. That gives you time to check how you're feeling and why you want to eat.

When you get the urge to eat a cookie out of sadness or boredom, remember that you have the choice to wait it out. "Tell yourself to have it later," Farrell says. Even if it doesn't, successfully delaying the snack helps you feel more in control.

In addition, consider talking with a doctor so you can better understand what's going on with you and find the best way to handle your emotional eating.

11. When eating can be a problem?

A person often eats for emotional reasons rather than ______________________________.

12. What problem will a person certainly have when he obeys the urge to eat more than he needs?

He will certainly ______________________________.

13. What is the solution to emotional eating more about?

It's more about ______________________________ than eating.

14. What can you do if the problem about emotional eating is out of your control?



You can ______________________________ you think about it.

15. How can you find the best way to handle your emotional eating?

By talking with ______________________________.

### 新题型考前冲刺预测卷12 · Passage 2

Directions: Read the following passage. After reading it, you should give brief answers to the 5 questions (No.16 to No.20) that follow. The answers (in no more than 3 words) should be written after the corresponding numbers on the Answer Sheet.

World Sleep Day, observed on March 21, was created to bring attention to sleep problems worldwide. Sleep is a natural part of human life, but many people in the modern world ignore its importance. As a result, sleep problems are increasingly common.

In 2020, ,scientists at the University of Athens in Greece conducted a survey of over 35,000 people in 10 countries around the world. The survey found that many people suffered from the effects of poor sleep quality, some examples of which were being unable to fall asleep and waking up in the middle of the night. The main factors causing these problems were pressure from school or work and a fast pace of life. The survey's findings were particularly troubling because large numbers of people were found to have difficulty sleeping at night. The short-term effects of this are tiredness and having trouble concentrating. If this lasts for a long time, the risk of putting on weight and having a heart attack may increase.

There are many things you can do to improve the quality of your sleep. First, you should have regular sleep habits. Try to go to bed and wake up around the same time each day. Furthermore, at night, you should also avoid the things that contain caffeine, such as chocolate, coffee and tea, as caffeine may keep you from sleeping.

Getting a good night's sleep is important to everyone. By following the advice above, you can rest better at night and work better during the day.

19. What problem may people easily have if they have sleep problems for a long time?

They may easily gain weight and have a ______________________________.

20. If you want to improve your sleep quality, what should you do?

You should avoid the things which ______________________________ caffeine.

### 新题型考前冲刺预测卷13 · Passage 1

Directions: Read the following passage. After reading it, you should give brief answers to the 5 questions (No.11 to No.15) that follow. The answers (in no more than 10 words) should be written after



the corresponding numbers on the Answer Sheet.

A man wondered if his wife had a hearing problem. One night he stood behind her while she sat reading and asked, "Honey, can you hear me?" There was no response, so he moved closer. "Honey, can you hear me?" There was still no response, so he moved right behind her. "Honey, can you hear me?" "For the third time—yes!"

The inability to hear and understand spoken language is one of the most significant sensory issues that affect older adults. Hearing loss may result from perceptual (感知的) problems in the brain itself. Training programs, such as learning to lip-read, can help older adults optimize (优化) the hearing they do have.

The joke at the beginning shows an important truth about age-related hearing loss: the person with the problem may be the last one to admit it. Many individuals who begin to struggle with hearing loss go through a period of denial; after all, it's easier to tell yourself that other people speak unclearly than it is to confront a significant listening problem. Left untreated, the social isolation created by age-related hearing loss can negatively affect an older adult's quality of life.

It may come as a surprise to learn that baby boomers (出生于婴儿潮时期的人), the first generation exposed to loud music on a regular basis, may actually have better hearing than their parents' generation. This could be due to a decline in smoking rates, lower rates of employment in industrial jobs, and a greater use of hearing protection. However, their own children may not be as fortunate, given the tendency of teenagers to listen to music via earphones at high volume.

______________________________.

______________________________.



14. Baby boomers may have ______________________________ hearing than their parents.

15. Why may baby boomers' children not be so fortunate?

______________________________.

### 新题型考前冲刺预测卷13 · Passage 2

Directions: Read the following passage. After reading it, you should give brief answers to the 5 questions (No.16 to No.20) that follow. The answers (in no more than 10 words) should be written after the corresponding numbers on the Answer Sheet.

A simple message has helped carry Emily Sue Snyder, 32, out of her darkest hours, including hopelessness, domestic violence and a suicide attempt. Now, she is sharing the encouraging expression with anyone who can receive it: "You are enough."

Snyder, a hairstylist (发型师) and mother of two young sons living in Tulsa, Oklahoma, makes it her daily mission to remind others of their value.

"You're always enough; it doesn't matter if you're at your lowest point," Snyder told *USA TODAY*. "You're still enough to be worthy."

Nearly a decade after trying to take her own life, she began leaving small handwritten motivational (励志的) notes in gas stations, grocery stores—"almost anywhere I went," she said.

Conversations about mental health struggles during the pandemic inspired her to spread the positive messages, such as "hey, you're doing a great job!" or "you are loved".

People would share the cards online as they found them. This warmed Snyder's heart, she said.

Her efforts to spread kindness—and the size of her cards—grew in March of 2021, when Snyder put on a red coat during rush hour in the middle of Sapulpa, Oklahoma. She stood on a corner alone for two hours holding a large bright-green poster that read "you are enough".

The outpouring of love from passersby flooded her, she said.

"The thing that really got me was the teenagers and kids that rolled down their car windows to tell



me they love me," Snyder recalled. "It made me realize everybody needs something positive and a little bit of hope in their lives."

She calls her mission "Stay Another Day: Suicide Prevention and Awareness".

Last month, she was "shocked" that a group of 25 joined her recent sign-holding event.

"People are really eager to be part of the movement to let people know they're loved," she said.

______________________________.

______________________________.

19. What did the outpouring of love from the passersby make Snyder realize?

______________________________.

20. Why did a group of 25 people join her recent sign-holding event?

______________________________.

### 新题型考前冲刺预测卷14 · Passage 1

Directions: Read the following passage. After reading it, you should give brief answers to the 5



questions (No.11 to No.15) that follow. The answers (in no more than 10 words) should be written after the corresponding numbers on the Answer Sheet.

Researchers in Japan and Australia said they had made progress in developing a blood test that could one day help doctors identify who might get Alzheimer's disease. The scientists said the test can recognize a protein known as amyloid (淀粉样蛋白) beta, which other studies had linked to Alzheimer's. They said it was correct more than 90 percent of the time in a study involving over 370 people. The findings were published in the journal Namre.

Alzheimer's disease is the most common form of dementia (痴呆). Experts believe dementia affects close to 50 million people worldwide. By the year 2050, it is expected to affect more than 131 million people. Those numbers come from Alzheimer's Disease International, a non-profit group. Currently, doctors have two ways to identify a buildup of amyloid beta in the brain. One is a brain scan or brain imaging; the other is a spinal tap (脊椎抽液). But both tests are invasive, costly and may only show results when the disease has already started to progress. There is no treatment that can slow the progression of Alzheimer's. Current drugs can only ease some of the effects of the disease.

Having a simple, low-cost blood test could make it easier for drug companies to find enough people who are at risk of developing Alzheimer's to test new medicines, said Katsuhiko Yanagisawa. He was one of the leaders of the study. He works at the Japanese National Center for Geriatrics and Gerontology.

Alzheimer's disease is thought to start developing years before patients have any signs of memory loss. Expefis say an important factor in finding an effective treatment will be the ability to recognize signs of the disease early. "You have got to walk before you run," said Colin Masters, a co-leader of the study and a professor at the University of Melbourne in Australia. "You have to learn to diagnose the disease directly before you can hope to see the effect of therapeutic intervention. And that's where the real value in this test will come," Masters added.

12. One advantage of the present test is that it costs __________ than the previous tests.



13. All the three tests identify Alzheimer's disease by detecting a protein named ________.

14. Can doctors cure or slow down the progression of Alzheimer's disease today?

______________________________.

15. Alz;heimer's disease may have already started before patients have any signs of memory ____.

A friend told me an experience she had in the hospital. As she lay terrified on the wheeling bed being rolled towards the operating room, a male orderly (勤杂工) appeared by her side and quietly took her hand. He walked beside her all the way. Her terror became less intense. When they reached the operating room, he gently put her hand down and she was rolled in. She was still terrified, but the feeling of being cared for filled more of her mind than her fear.

When she awoke in her room, the surgery successful, all she remembered was that hand in hers and the safe and cared-for way she felt at that time.

"I don't remember the color of his skin or anything about him," my friend said gently, "but I'll always remember the act of compassion."

My friend will remember that act long after she has forgotten most of the events in her life. This small act of comfort shows the orderly's ability to open his heart to others. The orderly in my friend's life opened himself to her and she will never forget him.

You do not need to hug everyone you meet, but your heart can be open. You do not need to talk to every stranger, but your heart can be open. Openness to others as you would like to be open to is love. Can you live with an open heart, even while others are frightened? Love is not taking advantage of the weaknesses of others. It is making the needs of others as important as your own. Love is like a fire that is



out of control. Once lit, it cannot be contained. You may strive for moderation (适度，节制) in diet, exercise, and work, but striving for moderation in love is like striving for moderation in breathing. Practice moderation in all things except love.

### 新题型考前冲刺预测卷15 · Passage 1

It's no secret that Queen Elizabeth Ⅱ spends a lot of time in some very luxurious places. From Buckingham Palace, with its 775 rooms (one of the must-see attractions in London), to Windsor Castle, where she usually spends her weekends, Her Majesty's haunts are some of the most impressive dwellings in the world. But the place where she's happiest is not one of the places people might most commonly associate with her. In fact, it's not even in England. It's Balmoral Castle, the Queen's holiday home located in Royal Deeside, Aberdeenshire, Scotland.

Balmoral Castle is a stately Scottish Baronial mansion situated on a 50,000-acre estate. It's pretty unique among royal residences in that it's actually owned by the royal family, rather than being the property of the Crown Estate. The only other royal dwelling that's like this is Sandringham House in Norfolk.

The royal family's connection with Balmoral dates back to the 19th century. Queen Victoria and Prince Albert purchased a home there in 1852 and then promptly oversaw the construction of an even bigger home. Upon its completion in 1856, the smaller castle was torn down, leaving the castle that remains today.

Fast-forward to present day, and the current monarch summers there every year. While still, of course, a castle, Balmoral is considerably smaller than Buckingham or Windsor, and the royals use their time there to unwind and take a break from some of the pressures of royal life. Queen Elizabeth Ⅱ has been photographed there doing everything from horseback riding to taking joyrides in a Range Rover.

Whether it's walking quickly to the shops or cycling 20 miles, the benefits of getting physical exercise are indisputable.

There's plenty of research to suggest that walking out leads to better sleep, though scientists aren't sure exactly why. All we know is that it can help you fall asleep faster and stay asleep for longer. This could be because exercise raises temperature.

About a third of over 65s fall every year, which is why it's so important to get active in order to improve balance, mobility and joint health. French researchers studied 706 women ranging from 75 to 85 and found that those who stuck with a two-year exercise programme to improve their balance cut their risk of being injured in a fall by around 20 percent. Movement exercises such as tai chi and yoga are excellent for balance, flexibility and increasing the movement in your joints and muscles.

Increasingly, experts are making the link between exercise and alertness. In 2014, researchers at Stanford University in the US studied 176 college students and found that walking boosted creative output by an average of 60 percent. Meanwhile, last March, a study in the journal *Neurology* revealed that older adults who regularly engaged in exercise stayed sharper and showed a slower rate of cognitive (认知的) decline than those who didn't.

Physical exercise is one of the best things you can do to manage stress. Even a quick walk in the park can work wonders. In 2014 researchers at the University of Michigan found that group nature walks reduced depression, improved well-being, and lowered stress.



The positive effects may come from the helpful anti-stress hormones that are released when you get moving. Some studies have indicated that exercise can be as effective as a treatment for depression as drugs.

The number of suicide attempts immediately fell sharply; perhaps it would have fallen even more if the bridge had been done in pink or baby blue.

Who talks more, women or men? The seemingly contradictory evidence is reconciled(调和) by the difference what I call public and private speaking. More men feel comfortable doing "public speaking", while more women feel comfortable doing "private" speaking. Another way of capturing these differences is by using the terms report-talk and rapport-talk(闲谈).

For most women, the language of conversation is primarily a language of rapport: a way of establishing connections and negotiating relationships. Emphasis is placed on displaying similarities and matching experiences. From childhood, girls criticize peers who try to stand out or appear better than others. People feel their closest connections at home, or in settings where they feel at home during private speaking. But even the most public situations can be approached like private speaking.

For most men, the talk is primarily a means to preserve independence and negotiate and maintain



status in a hierarchical(等级制的) social order. This is done by exhibiting knowledge and skill, and by holding center stage through storytelling, joking, or sharing information. From childhood, men learn to use talking as a way to get and keep attention. So they are more comfortable speaking in larger groups made up most of people they know less well, in the broadest sense, "public speaking". But even the most private situations can be approached like public speaking, more like giving a report than establishing rapport.

### 新题型考前冲刺预测卷6 · Passage 1

Directions: Read the following passage. After reading it, you should give brief answers to the 5



questions (No.11 to No.15) that follow. The answers (in no more than 3 words) should be written after the corresponding numbers on the Answer Sheet.

It's never easy to admit you are in the wrong. Being human, we all need to know the art of apologizing. Look back with honesty and think how often you've judged roughly, said unkind things and pushed yourself ahead at the expense of a friend. Then count the occasions when you indicated clearly and truly that you were sorry. A bit frightening, isn't it? It's frightening because some deep wisdom in us knows that whenever a small wrong has been committed, some mysterious moral feeling is disturbed; and it stays out of balance until fault is acknowledged and regret expressed.

I remember a doctor friend, the late Clarence Lieb, telling me about a man who came to him with a variety of signs: headaches, insomnia（失眠症） and stomach trouble. No physical cause could be found. Finally Dr. Lieb said to the man, "Unless you tell me what's worrying you, I can't help you."

After some hesitation, the man admitted that as the executor of his father's will, he had been cheating his brother, who lived abroad, of his inheritance（遗产）. Then and there the wise old doctor made the man write to his brother asking for forgiveness. He then went with him to the mailbox in the corridor. As the letter disappeared, the man burst into tears, "Thank you. I think I'm cured." And he was.

A heartfelt（真诚的） apology can not only heal a damaged relationship but also make it strong. If you can think of someone who deserves an apology from you, do something about it right now.

The housework they asked people about was: preparing meals, washing dishes, cleaning the house and babysitting. 48% of British husbands said they did these things. 37% of Danish（丹麦的）men helped in the house. But only 15% of Italian men said they did the housework; many of them said they never helped at all!

But there was an interesting point of view from the wives. According to British wives, only 38% of their husbands helped in the house. And Italian wives said that their husbands hardly ever helped. The Italian and British men did not tell the truth! The commission found that Danish men were the most truthful husbands. Their answers were the same as their wives' answers.

### 新题型考前冲刺预测卷7 · Passage 2

Directions: Read the following passage. After reading it, you should give brief answers to the 5



questions (No.16 to No.20) that follow. The answers (in no more than 3 words) should be written after the corresponding numbers on the Answer Sheet.

Imagine we build a robot to explore the planet Mars and provide it with detectors to be away from danger. It is powered by the sun. Should we program the robot to be equally active at all times? The answer is NO. The robot would be using up energy when it was not receiving any. So we would probably program it to stop its activity at night and to wake up the next morning.

Human beings have a pattern of sleeping and waking, as sleep provides some important fresh energy. It is believed that man has been programmed to perform functions at a time when activity would be inefficient. However, sleep does not protect us from trouble that comes looking for us. So we sleep well when we are in a safe place, but we sleep lightly when we fear that bears will nose into the tent.

Sleep among creatures is different. Why do cats, for example, sleep so much, while horses sleep so little? Cats can afford to have long periods of inactivity because they spend little time eating and are unlikely to be attacked when in sleep. Horses must spend almost all their waking hours eating, because what they eat is low in energy value. Moreover, they cannot afford to sleep too long or too deeply, because their survival depends on their ability to run away from attackers.

A detailed written contract between you and the contractor（承包人）you hire is essential to any renovation or home repair project, no matter what its size is. Even the smallest job should be put in writing.

Why? To begin with, a written contract constitutes a binding legal agreement between you and your contractor. It spells out the responsibilities and rights of both parties and ensures there is a clear record of the agreement between you and the contractor.

A proper contract also reduces your risk. It helps safeguard you from financial loss or personal liability in case of accidents or injuries during the project.

Finally, a contract establishes the foundation for a good working relationship between you and your contractor. A detailed and clearly written contract reduces confusion and misunderstandings and helps you both see the work the same way.

Should you feel awkward about asking for a contract? Absolutely not! Professional contractors run a business and know that a written contract is an indispensable part of good business practice. It protects them as well as their customers. But what if a contractor suggests that you go ahead without a contract, or won't put anything on paper? Don't do it! The risks are simply too high.

### 新题型考前冲刺预测卷9 · Passage 2

Directions: Read the following passage. After reading it, you should give brief answers to the 5 questions (No.16 to No.20) that follow. The answers (in no more than 3 words) should be written after the corresponding numbers on the Answer Sheet.

I do a lot of management training each year for the Circle K Corporation, which is a national chain of convenience stores（便利店）. Among the topics we discuss in our seminars（研讨会）is how to keep good employees working at our company—a real challenge to managers when you consider the low pay in the service industry. During these discussions, I ask the participants, "What has caused you to stay long enough to become a manager?" After a while a new manager, Cynthia, took up the question, and slowly, with her voice almost breaking, said, "It was a $19 baseball glove（手套）."

Cynthia told the group that she had originally taken a Circle K clerk job as a temporary（临时的）position while she looked for something better. On her second or third day behind the counter, she received a phone call from her nine-year-old son, Jessie. He needed a baseball glove for Little League. She explained that as a single mother, money was very tight, and her first check would have to go for paying bills. Perhaps she could buy his baseball glove with her second or third check.

When Cynthia arrived for work the next morning, Patricia, the store manager, asked her to come to the small room in the back of the store that served as an office. Cynthia wondered if she had done something wrong or left some part of her job incomplete from the day before. She was upset and confused.

Patricia handed her a box. "I overheard you talking to your son yesterday," she said, "and I know



that it is hard to explain things to kids. This is a baseball glove for Jessie because he may not understand how important he is, even though you have to pay bills before you can buy gloves. You know we can't pay good people like you as much as we would like to; but we do care, and I want you to know you are important to us."

The thoughtfulness, passion and love of this convenience store manager demonstrate vividly that people remember more how much an employer shows care and concern than how much the employer pays—an important lesson for the price of a Little League baseball glove.

19. How did Cynthia feel when the manager Patricia called her to the office?

She felt ______________________________.

20. What important lesson can we learn from Cynthia's story?

Advertisement is thought of the means of making known in order to buy or sell goods or services, which aims to increase people's awareness and arouse interest. It tries to inform and to persuade. The media are all used to spread the message. The press offers a fairly cheap method, and magazines are used to reach special sections of the market. The cinema and commercial radio are useful for local market. Television, although more expensive, can be very effective. Public notices are fairly cheap and more permanent in their power of attraction. Other ways of increasing consumer interest are through exhibitions and trade fairs as well as direct mail advertisement.

There can be no doubt that the growth in advertisement is one of the most striking features of the western world in this century. Many businesses such as those handling frozen foods, liquor, tobacco and medicines have been built up largely by advertisement.

We might ask whether the cost of advertisement is paid for by the producer or by the customer. Since




advertisement forms part of the cost of production, which has to be covered by the selling price, it is clear that it is the customer who pays for the advertisement. However, if large-scale advertisement leads to increased demand, production costs are reduced, and the customer pays less.

It is difficult to measure exactly the influence of advertisement on sales. When the market is growing, advertisement helps to increase demand. When the market is shrinking, advertisement may prevent a bigger fall in sales than would occur without its support. What is clear is that businesses would not pay large sums for advertisement if they were not convinced of its value to them.

> **套号映射（按本分册文件顺序，即目录字典序）**：第0套＝卷1、第1套＝卷10、第2套＝卷11、第3套＝卷12、第4套＝卷13、第5套＝卷14、第6套＝卷15、第7套＝卷2、第8套＝卷3、第9套＝卷4、第10套＝卷5、第11套＝卷6、第12套＝卷7、第13套＝卷8、第14套＝卷9。G107—G136 与文内 30 篇先后一致（G107/02＝卷1、G109/04＝卷10、……G135/30＝卷9）。若主控按"第N套＝卷N+1"的数字口径合并，只需按上表换算组号，正文无需改动。原卷 Passage 1 题号 11—15、Passage 2 题号 16—20，与进度表"26—30"同指每篇 5 题；本册照原卷题号书写，**原题一字未改**。

### G107 · 卷1 Passage 1（晋升通知信）· 11—15（3 words）

**11. 答案：Deputy Marketing Manager.**
1 题面：题干 What position will Mr. Smith be promoted to?；原文 "management has decided to promote you to the position of Deputy Marketing Manager, effective April 15th, 2023"；疑问词 What position（职务名）；诱导信号：同段 "Mr. Li Xiaojun, Marketing Manager of the department" 是上级职务，与答案同含 Marketing Manager，且框架已给 The position of。
2 候选：Deputy Marketing Manager（完整职务名）；Marketing Manager（上级职务／截断）；Mr. Li Xiaojun（人名）；manager（上位词）；Deputy Marketing Manager, effective April 15th（越界带时间）。
3 验算：填 Deputy Marketing Manager→"The position of Deputy Marketing Manager." 与 to the position of 后逐字对应，框架的 position 不重复→成立。填 Marketing Manager→指 Mr. Li Xiaojun 的职务，主体错位且丢 Deputy（副职降级）→排除。填 Mr. Li Xiaojun→人名不占职务位→排除。填 manager→原文有专名，上位词违"具体优先"→次优。填带日期项→超 3 词且时间归 12 题→排除。
4 干扰：两个 Marketing Manager 同形，只靠 Deputy 一词区分；学生按"最近出现"或"最长专名"抄都会错。
5 意图：考应用文（晋升信）职务名的完整性——职级定语 Deputy 属构词部分；区分抓句子主干的人与抓高频词的人。
6 边界：若问 Who will Mr. Smith work under? 取 Mr. Li Xiaojun（人不是职务）；若问 What is Mr. Li Xiaojun's position? 取 Marketing Manager（不带 Deputy）。
7 错误：A 答 Marketing Manager（截掉 Deputy，把上级职务当受任职务）；B 答 Mr. Li Xiaojun（疑问词是 position 却答人）；C 答 the position of Deputy Marketing Manager（框架重复）。
8 规则：**R141** 若应用文问 What position will sb be promoted to／apply for，then 取 to／for the position of 后的**完整职务名**，含 Deputy／Assistant／Senior 等职级定语，逐字照抄、首字母大写；例外：题干问的是上级或下属职务时按该句主语换人取职务，不得共用同一职务名。
9 位置：04→RA-1 细节→**RA-1.50 职务名（应用文）**；与 R37.1（职务取 required to be）、R43.1（身份取同位语）同族；冲突时"完整职务名优先于最近名词"。
10 自检：①抄的是受任人还是上级的职务？②Deputy 丢没丢？③框架 The position of 是否被我重复？

**12. 答案：April 15th, 2023.**
1 题面：题干 What is the effective date...?；原文 "effective April 15th, 2023"；疑问词 What date；诱导信号：同段 for the past two years（考核期）与 two years（时长）两处时间表达更靠前。
2 候选：April 15th, 2023（月日＋年）；April 15th（丢年）；2023（丢月日）；the past two years（考核期）；two years（时长）。
3 验算：填 April 15th, 2023→"The effective date is April 15th, 2023." 逐字对应→成立。填 April 15th→日期成立但丢年份，原文年月日同写，属截断→次优。填 2023→不成立。填 the past two years→是评估期不是生效日→排除。填 two years→时长→排除。
4 干扰：首段同时出现"生效日"与"过去两年"，学生见 date 就抓第一个数字串，或把 two years 读成"生效已两年"。
5 意图：考日期三层（月＋日＋年）整体截取，以及"生效日≠考核期"。
6 边界：若问 How long has he worked as a marketing assistant? 答 (for) two years；若问 When did the evaluation start? 原文无起止，不能拿 April 15th 顶替。
7 错误：A 答 April 15th（丢年）；B 答 two years（考核期当生效日）；C 答 On April 15th, 2023（多写介词，超 3 词）。
8 规则：**R142** 若应用文问 effective date／start date，then 取 effective 后紧跟的完整日期（月＋日＋年），介词不写；例外：原文只给月份（effective May）时只答月份，不补日。
9 位置：04→RA-1.1 时间（日期三层）＋应用文"生效条款"位；复用 R1.1（时间状语整体截取），新增锚点 effective。
10 自检：①年有没有丢？②答的是生效日还是考核期？③有没有多写介词？

**13. 答案：marketing assistant.**
1 题面：题干 What is Mr. Smith's current position?；原文 "your performance for the past two years as a marketing assistant"；疑问词 What position（现任）；诱导信号：段首 promote you to the position of Deputy Marketing Manager 是**将任**职务，同形且重复出现（首段＋结尾 new role）。
2 候选：marketing assistant（as 后身份）；Deputy Marketing Manager（将任）；marketing／assistant（截断）；a marketing assistant（带冠词）。
3 验算：填 marketing assistant→"The position of marketing assistant." 与 as a marketing assistant 对应，框架已含 the position of 故去冠词→成立。填 Deputy Marketing Manager→时点错（题干 current）→排除。填 marketing／assistant→截断复合职务名→排除。填 a marketing assistant→语法可通但冠词冗余→次优。
4 干扰：全文只有两个职务名，"将任"那个出现两次、频率更高；按频率选必错。
5 意图：考应用文时间轴上的"现任 vs 将任"切分。
6 边界：若问 What position will he take? 答 Deputy Marketing Manager；若问 What did he do two years ago? 可答 marketing assistant，但不得加公司名。
7 错误：A 答 Deputy Marketing Manager（时点错）；B 答 assistant（截断）；C 答 the position of a marketing assistant（框架重复＋冠词冗余）。
8 规则：**R143** 若同一应用文出现两个职务名，then 先按题干时点（current／will be promoted to）分配，再取对应句 as／to the position of 后的名词；例外：题干无时点词时取"信函主语 you 的现状句"（as 后一项）。
9 位置：04→RA-1.50 职务名→时点切分；与 R9.1（身份转变动词配时间）同族。
10 自检：①current 指向哪句？②取的是 as 后还是 position of 后？③复合职务名有没有被截？

**14. 答案：amazing performance.**
1 题面：题干 Why has management decided to promote Mr. Smith?；原文 "It was decided to entrust you with higher responsibilities based on your amazing performance of your work."；疑问词 Why；框架 Because of his ___ of his work；诱导信号：同段 appreciate your hard work and commitment 两个名词更靠前，且 hard work 与 of his work 语义近。
2 候选：amazing performance；hard work；commitment；efforts；amazing performance of the work（重复框架）。
3 验算：填 amazing performance→"Because of his amazing performance of his work." 与原文 amazing performance of your work 对应（your→his）→成立，且 3 词。填 hard work→"his hard work of his work" 不通，且它出在感谢句、不是 decided 的 based on 依据→排除。填 commitment→同句并列但 of his work 搭配弱，且它是 to the company→次优。填 efforts→reward you for your efforts 是结果不是依据→排除。填带 of the work→重复框架→排除。
4 干扰：同段"感谢"（hard work／commitment）与"依据"（based on…performance）并列书写，情感词更抢眼。
5 意图：考因果标记 based on 后的名词短语，以及框架 his…of his work 的槽位约束。
6 边界：若问 What did management appreciate? 答 hard work and commitment；若问 How long did the evaluation take? 答 two years。reward for 后的 efforts 不作原因。
7 错误：A 答 hard work（取感谢句不取 based on）；B 答 commitment（并列项错位，搭配不成立）；C 答 amazing performance of the work（重复框架）。
8 规则：**R144** 若应用文用 based on／in view of 引出晋升依据，then 取该介词短语的名词核心（amazing performance）并嵌入题干 his…of his work 槽位；感谢句（appreciate／reward for）里的名词不作依据；例外：原文用 because 从句时取从句谓语所述事实。
9 位置：04→RA-1.4 原因→应用文"依据（based on）"；复用 R29.1（so 前为因）的"标记词定因果"，标记换成 based on。
10 自检：①依据句标记是 based on 还是 appreciate？②槽位允许几个词？③有没有把感谢当原因？

**15. 答案：updated contract.**
1 题面：题干 What is attached to this letter?；原文 "We have attached your updated contract with new employment terms for your review."；疑问词 What；框架 A copy of the ___；诱导信号：with new employment terms 紧跟宾语，for your review 紧随其后。
2 候选：updated contract；contract with new employment terms；new employment terms；your updated contract；contract。
3 验算：填 updated contract→"A copy of the updated contract." 成立，updated 是必要限定（区分新旧合同）。填 contract→丢 updated→次优。填 new employment terms→是合同内容不是被附物→排除。填 your updated contract→框架已给 A copy of the，人称冗余→次优。填 contract with new employment terms→5 词超限且 with 短语是内容→排除。
4 干扰：attached 后三名连缀，学生按"最后一个名词"取 terms，或按"最长短语"抄。
5 意图：考 attach 的宾语核心与限定词不可丢——应用文"附件"是固定考点。
6 边界：若问 What should Mr. Smith do with the contract? 答 review it；若问 What are the new terms? 原文未展开，不可编。
7 错误：A 答 new employment terms（内容当附件）；B 答 contract（丢 updated）；C 答 your updated contract with new employment terms（超词＋未截核心）。
8 规则：**R145** 若问 What is attached／enclosed，then 取 attach／enclose 的宾语核心名词＋必要限定（updated contract），with 短语属内容说明不取；例外：原文用被动（A copy of the contract is attached）时同样取主语核心。
9 位置：04→RA-1.15（并列宾语全取）的反面——"宾语核心＋限定，不取 with 内容"；与 R12.2（框架裁剪）同法。
10 自检：①attach 的宾语核心是哪个名词？②updated 能不能丢？③with 短语是否被我当成附件？

**〔G107 组小结〕**
- 考点分布：职务名 2（11、13，含现任／将任时点切分）；日期 1（12）；原因（based on 依据）1（14）；附件宾语 1（15）。文本全为**晋升通知信（应用文·信函）**，补主册"应用文 0 例"缺口首组。
- 规则清单：R141 职务名完整（11）；R142 effective date 三层（12）；R143 两职务按时点分配（13）；R144 based on 取依据（14）；R145 attach 取宾语核心（15）。复用：R13.3（具体优先，11、15）、R1.1（时间整体截取，12）、R9.1（身份转变配时间，13）、R12.2（框架裁剪，14、15）。
- 冲突与优先级：①时点（current／will be）优先于出现频率（13 与"Deputy 出现两次"冲突）；②因果标记 based on 优先于情感词 appreciate（14）；③宾语核心优先于 with 短语（15）；④框架已给成分不重复优先于"抄全"（11、14、15）。
- 未归类：0。5 题分别挂 RA-1.50（新）／RA-1.1／RA-1.50／RA-1.4／RA-1.15。
- 覆盖检查：应用文·信函子类首见（主册 0 例）；"职级定语不可截"为本组新增判别点，04 需单列；百分比／图表仍无。

### G108 · 卷1 Passage 2（Discover It 信用卡广告）· 16—20（3 words）

**16. 答案：first late payment.**
1 题面：题干 In what case are you not charged for your late payment?；原文 "There's also no late fee for your first late payment and no increase to your APR for paying late."；疑问词 In what case（条件）；框架 If it is your ___；诱导信号：同段并列五个 no fee（annual／pay-by-phone／foreign transaction／over-limit），only first 的限定被排比淹没。
2 候选：first late payment；late payment；first payment；first late fee；payment。
3 验算：填 first late payment→"If it is your first late payment." 与 for your first late payment 对应→成立（3 词）。填 late payment→丢 first，变成"任何逾期都免费"，与原文 only first 语义反转→排除。填 first payment→丢 late，指首次（正常）还款→排除。填 first late fee→原文免的是 fee，fee 不作 is your 的表语→排除。填 payment→上位词＋丢两层限定→排除。
4 干扰：段落用排比 no annual fee／no pay-by-phone fee…，形成"全免"印象；APR 句紧跟，又添"逾期"话题。
5 意图：考限定词 first／only 是答案的一部分，反排比式略读。
6 边界：若问 How much is the late fee? 答 None (for the first late payment)；若问 Is there any late fee? 须分次答，不能笼统 No。
7 错误：A 答 late payment（丢 first，语义反转）；B 答 first payment（丢 late）；C 答 no late fee（结论不占 your 后名词位）。
8 规则：**R146** 若广告用"no X for your first Y"型让步，then 答案须同时保留序数限定（first）与被免对象（late payment），只取对象即语义反转；例外：题干已给 first 时只补对象。
9 位置：04→RA-1 细节→**RA-1.51 条件（If it is your…）**；复用 R17.2（not unlimited 还原肯定）的"限定词不可省"。
10 自检：①first 有没有丢？②答的是"逾期"还是"还款"？③框架 your 后要名词还是从句？

**17. 答案：5%.**
1 题面：题干 How much cash can you earn back in rotating categories each quarter?；原文 "Earn 5% cash back in rotating categories each quarter…, up to the quarterly maximum each time you activate."；疑问词 How much（比例）；框架 You can get ___ cash back；诱导信号：第四段密集金额 $10→$20、$50→$100、$100→$200。
2 候选：5%；5 percent；5% cash；$10（match 举例基数）；$100（周转上限例）；twice（match 倍数）。
3 验算：填 5%→"You can get 5% cash back." 与 Earn 5% cash back 对应→成立（1 词）。填 5 percent→同义改写，成立但非照抄→次优。填 5% cash→与框架 cash back 的 cash 重复→排除。填 $10／$100→是 Cashback Match 的举例金额，不是返现比例→排除。填 twice→是 match 倍数→排除。
4 干扰：金额数字更大更醒目，5% 只出现一次且用符号缩写。
5 意图：考"比例题的答案单位是 %，不是金额"；区分抓数字大小的人与抓疑问词单位的人。
6 边界：若问 How much cash back will you get in total in your first year? 才涉及 $10→$20 的翻倍（换算类）；本问只问比例。若问 What is the quarterly maximum? 原文未给具体数，不可编。
7 错误：A 答 $100（举例金额当比例）；B 答 5% cash（与框架重复）；C 答 twice（倍数当比例）。
8 规则：**R147** 若问 How much／What percentage 且原文给 %，then 只写百分数（5%），不带货币符号、不重复框架名词；同段举例金额一律不作比例；例外：题干问 amount／money 时才取金额。
9 位置：04→RA-1.7 数量→百分数（照抄，复用 R40.1／R11.1）；本组新增"比例 vs 举例金额"干扰型。
10 自检：①题干问比例还是金额？②% 有没有被改成 $？③cash 与框架是否重复？

**18. 答案：your first year.**
1 题面：题干 When can you receive all the money the bank matches?；原文 "we'll automatically match all the cash back you've earned at the end of your first year"；疑问词 When；框架 At the end of ___；诱导信号：第三段 each quarter／each time you activate 两个时间短语更靠前且属"返现"话题。
2 候选：your first year；the first year；first year；your first year of membership；each quarter。
3 验算：填 your first year→"At the end of your first year." 逐字对应→成立（3 词）。填 the first year→人称不符（原文 your）→次优。填 first year→缺限定词→次优。填 your first year of membership→5 词超限且 membership 原文无→排除。填 each quarter→那是获得 5% 的频率，不是 match 的时点→排除。
4 干扰：each quarter 与题目主题（返现）更近，at the end of your first year 在下一段。
5 意图：考同一广告多个时间短语的归属，按题干动词配对。
6 边界：若问 How often do you earn 5% cash back? 答 Each quarter；两问时间短语不可互换。
7 错误：A 答 each quarter（张冠李戴）；B 答 the first year（人称次优）；C 答 your first year of membership（超词＋加信息）。
8 规则：**R148** 若同一广告有两个时间短语，then 按题干动词配对（earn→each quarter；match／receive→at the end of your first year）；例外：题干含两个动作时按主句动词定。
9 位置：04→RA-1.1 时间→多时间短语按动词配对；复用 R53.3（颜色—人数同句配对）的配对原则，对象换成动词—时间。
10 自检：①题干动词是 earn 还是 receive／match？②each quarter 属于谁？③人称 your 保留了吗？

**19. 答案：alerts you.**
1 题面：题干 What does the bank do to protect your account security?；原文 "Discover It monitors every purchase and alerts you if we spot something suspicious."；疑问词 What does…do；框架 monitors every purchase and ___ if it spots something suspicious；诱导信号：后句 "you're never responsible for unauthorized purchases" 也像"保护"。
2 候选：alerts you；alerts；warns you；protects you；pays you back。
3 验算：填 alerts you→"monitors every purchase and alerts you if it spots…" 与原文并列谓语逐字对应→成立（2 词）。填 alerts→缺宾语 you（原文 alerts you），且 alerts 在此必带宾语→次优。填 warns you→同义改写可通，但非照抄→次优。填 protects you→概括词，不占并列谓语位→排除。填 pays you back→属免责条款，不是监测后的动作→排除。
4 干扰：and 连接两个谓语，学生常只抄 monitors（框架已给）或把免责当保护动作。
5 意图：考并列谓语的后项不可省——框架已给前项，答案必须是后项。
6 边界：若问 What happens if you make an unauthorized purchase? 答 You are never responsible；若问 How are you alerted? 原文未说方式，不可编。
7 错误：A 答 monitors every purchase（抄框架已给项）；B 答 pays you back（免责当动作）；C 答 alerts（丢宾语）。
8 规则：**R149** 若框架已给并列谓语前项（monitors every purchase and ___），then 只补后项谓语＋宾语（alerts you），前项一字不抄；例外：框架用 instead of／rather than 连接时补被否项。
9 位置：04→RA-5.5 框架去重与裁剪（复用 R12.2／R16.4）；本组新增"并列谓语槽位"。
10 自检：①框架已给哪个谓语？②alerts 的宾语能省吗？③抄的是并列项还是概括项？

**20. 答案：service number.**
1 题面：题干 What should you do if you have any questions about Discover It?；原文 "Just call our service number if you have a question or need an explanation."；疑问词 What should you do；框架 Call the bank's ___；诱导信号：紧邻 "We're available 24 hours a day" 与 "We won't try to sell you other products"。
2 候选：service number；service phone；customer service；number；hotline。
3 验算：填 service number→"Call the bank's service number." 与 call our service number 对应（our→the bank's）→成立（2 词）。填 service phone→原文无 phone→次优。填 customer service→原文无 customer→排除。填 number→丢 service，指代不明→次优。填 hotline→原文无此词，属常识替换→排除。
4 干扰：24 小时服务让人联想 hotline；service 作前置定语易被跳过；末尾"不推销"句抢注意力。
5 意图：考联系方式取 call 的宾语，改写只换人称不换名词。
6 边界：若问 When can you call? 答 24 hours a day；若问 What won't the bank do? 答 Sell you other products。
7 错误：A 答 24 hours（服务时间当方式）；B 答 hotline（常识替换）；C 答 the bank's service number（框架重复）。
8 规则：**R150** 若问联系方式（What should you do／How can you contact），then 取 call／contact 的宾语名词（service number），人称按题干改写、名词照抄；同段的可用时间与承诺不作联系方式；例外：原文给 email／address 时取该具体方式。
9 位置：04→RA-1.26 手段取词＋应用文"联系栏"；复用 R15.3（use 取手段）、R57.2（uses＋to do）。
10 自检：①call 的宾语是什么？②有没有用常识词替换？③框架 the bank's 是否重复？

**〔G108 组小结〕**
- 考点分布：条件限定 1（16）；比例 1（17）；时间归属 1（18）；并列谓语后项 1（19）；联系方式 1（20）。文本＝**信用卡广告（应用文·广告）**，主册应用文缺口第 2 组。
- 规则清单：R146 first 限定不可省（16）；R147 比例不换金额（17）；R148 动词—时间配对（18）；R149 并列谓语补后项（19）；R150 联系方式取 call 宾语（20）。复用：R40.1／R11.1（比例照抄）、R12.2／R16.4（框架裁剪）、R15.3（手段取词）、R17.2（限定词还原）。
- 冲突与优先级：①限定词优先于排比印象（16）；②疑问词单位优先于数字大小（17）；③题干动词优先于邻近时间短语（18）；④框架已给项优先于"抄全"（19）；⑤原文名词优先于常识同义词（20）。
- 未归类：0。挂 RA-1.51（新）／RA-1.7／RA-1.1／RA-5.5／RA-1.26。
- 覆盖检查：广告类应用文首见；"比例 vs 举例金额"为主册未有的干扰型；**换算仍无题**（$10→$20 的翻倍未入题）。

### G109 · 卷10 Passage 1（Mike 与"水果碗"）· 11—15（3 words）

**11. 答案：seven (years old).**
1 题面：题干 How old was Mike when the story happened?；原文篇首括注 "（Mike is telling a story. It happened when he was seven.）"；疑问词 How old；框架 He was ___；诱导信号：正文叙事无年龄，只有 New Year's Eve／in the morning 等时间。
2 候选：seven；seven years old；seven-year-old；a seven-year-old boy；seven years。
3 验算：填 seven→"He was seven." 口语省略 years old，成立（1 词）。填 seven years old→"He was seven years old." 成立且更完整（3 词）→并列可。填 seven-year-old→复合形容词不作表语（He was seven-year-old 不成立）→排除。填 a seven-year-old boy→4 词超限→排除。填 seven years→"He was seven years" 缺 old，不成立→排除。
4 干扰：年龄藏在舞台说明式括注里，正文全是叙事；学生扫正文找不到就编或空着。
5 意图：考"括注／舞台说明也是原文信息"，以及数词作表语的两种合法形式。
6 边界：若问 When did the story happen? 答 On New Year's Eve；年龄与节日不可互换。
7 错误：A 答 seven years（缺 old，语法不成立）；B 答 a seven-year-old boy（超词＋句法位错）；C 留空（只读正文不读括注）。
8 规则：**R151** 若问 How old 而正文无数词，then 回篇首括注／舞台说明找 when he was＋数词，答案写 seven 或 seven years old；例外：原文用 in his seventies 等约数时照抄约数、不换算。
9 位置：04→RA-1.7 数量（年龄）＋"括注可用"；与 R1.1（时间）在同段分工。
10 自检：①括注读了吗？②seven 与 seven years 哪个合语法？③词数 ≤3？

**12. 答案：model car.**
1 题面：题干 What did Mike give Joe to get the football?；原文 "I gave him my favorite model car in exchange for his football."；疑问词 What；框架 His favorite ___；诱导信号：in exchange for his football 紧跟宾语，football 又是全文关键词，方向极易反。
2 候选：model car；car；model；football；model car in exchange。
3 验算：填 model car→"His favorite model car." 与 my favorite model car 对应→成立（2 词）。填 car→丢 model，指代变宽→次优。填 model→model 是定语，中心是 car→排除。填 football→是换来的东西（in exchange for），方向反→排除。填带 in exchange→框架不成立且超词→排除。
4 干扰：give A in exchange for B 把付出与得到写在一句，学生按最近名词 football 取。
5 意图：考 exchange 结构的方向切分（A 付出、B 得到）。
6 边界：若问 What did Mike get from Joe? 答 (an old) football；若问 Who did Mike give the car to? 答 Joe。
