〔G137〕慧航第一套 · Section A（Passage 1，26—30）十层研究**

> **Section A 体例说明**：本套 Section A 的 Directions 声明"4 passages，每篇 5 题，用恰当的词写出答案"，但文件中实际只有 3 篇（26—40）。本篇为该节第 1 篇，题号 26—30，**26／28／30 为补全式（框架已给），27／29 为完整问句**——Section A 与 Passage 的唯一区别是"答案要求用恰当的词写出"，不要求在正式卷上写完整句，故第 6／9 层按"短答"处理。

**26. 答案：arouse interest（The purpose of advertisement is to increase customers' awareness and arouse interest.）**
1 题面：框架 "The purpose of advertisement is to increase customers' awareness and __________."；空位在 and 后、与 increase 并列，须为动词原形短语；原文 "which aims to increase people's awareness and arouse interest"；诱导信号：同段还有 It tries to inform and to persuade，也是并列不定式。
2 候选：①arouse interest；②to inform and persuade（另一句）；③make known（定义）；④buy or sell goods。
3 验算：①→increase people's awareness and arouse interest，与题干 and 结构一致，customers' 换 people's 属题干改写→成立。②→inform／persuade 是另一个并列句，不在 and 后→次优。③→making known 是"广告"的定义，不是目的→排除。④→buy or sell 是广告的用途对象（goods or services），不是"提高意识并…"的并列项→排除。
4 干扰：It tries to inform and to persuade 紧跟其后，动词短语密集；定义句 making known 也像"目的"。
5 意图：考"补全式空位在 and 后取并列动词原形（arouse interest）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：只写 arouse interest 即可；若写成 to arouse interest，与前方 increase 的并列形式不统一，属形式不合（RA-5.9）。若问 What does advertisement try to do? 答 To inform and to persuade。
7 错误：A 填 to inform and persuade.（错因：另一并列句）；B 填 buy or sell goods.（错因：对象）；C 填 make known.（错因：定义）。
8 规则：R107.1 若补全式空位在 and 后与前一动词原形并列，then 取同结构的动词原形短语（arouse interest），不加 to；Section A 短答只写该短语即可。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（并列不定式省略 to）＋RA-5.1 空位词性；Section A 与 Passage 的差别只在"答案长度"，规则同。
10 自检：①and 前是什么形式？②我加了 to 吗？③inform／persuade 在哪句？

**27. 答案：The cinema and commercial radio (are useful for local market).**
1 题面：According to the passage, which kinds of media are useful for local market；原文 "The cinema and commercial radio are useful for local market."；疑问词 which kinds of media（问媒体种类，复数）；诱导信号：同段列举了 press／magazines／television／public notices 五种媒体。
2 候选：①the cinema and commercial radio；②the press and magazines；③television；④public notices。
3 验算：①→The cinema and commercial radio are useful for local market，与题干 local market 逐字对应→成立（两项都写）。②→press 是 fairly cheap method，magazines 是 reach special sections→排除。③→television 是 more expensive but effective→排除。④→public notices 是 cheap and more permanent→排除。
4 干扰：五种媒体各配一个特点，题干只取 local market；television 最"强"也最易被误选。
5 意图：考"媒体按用途配对（local market→cinema＋commercial radio）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The cinema and commercial radio 即可。若问 Which media is the cheapest? 答 The press（and public notices）。
7 错误：A 答 Television.（错因：只对 effective）；B 答 The press.（错因：cheap）；C 答 Magazines.（错因：special sections）。
8 规则：R107.2 若问 which kinds of media are useful for X，then 按用途配对同句媒体（local market→the cinema and commercial radio），两项都写；其他媒体的特点（cheap／special sections／effective）按用途排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.41 多主体配对（媒体—用途）；复用 R41.4（按名配对），本条主体是媒体。
10 自检：①local market 与哪些媒体同句？②television 的特点是什么？③两项写全了吗？

**28. 答案：many businesses（The growth in advertisement largely contributes to building many businesses.）**
1 题面：框架 "The growth in advertisement largely contributes to building __________."；空位在 building 后，须为名词（复数）；原文 "Many businesses such as those handling frozen foods, liquor, tobacco and medicines have been built up largely by advertisement."；诱导信号：同段还有 one of the most striking features，是"现象"而非"建成物"。
2 候选：①many businesses（of those kinds）；②the western world；③striking features；④goods or services。
3 验算：①→Many businesses…have been built up largely by advertisement，build up 与 contributes to building 对应→成立（可补 such as frozen foods 等）。②→the western world 是范围→排除。③→striking features 是"增长本身"的特征→排除。④→goods or services 是广告的对象→排除。
4 干扰：frozen foods／liquor／tobacco／medicines 四个行业名具体，容易被当答案（它们是 businesses 的例子）。
5 意图：考"build up 的宾语取上位名词（many businesses），行业名只是举例"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 many businesses 即可；若要具体可加 such as frozen foods, liquor, tobacco and medicines。若问 Which industries have been built up by advertisement? 答 Frozen foods, liquor, tobacco and medicines。
7 错误：A 填 frozen foods.（错因：举例当上位）；B 填 the western world.（错因：范围）；C 填 striking features.（错因：错位）。
8 规则：R107.3 若补全式空位在 build up／contribute to building 后，then 取被建成的上位名词（many businesses），such as 后的行业名只作举例；同段的"特征／范围"不作建成物。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词复数）＋RA-1.25 类 vs 例；复用 R15.2（取类名），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①built up 的宾语是什么？②四个行业是类还是例？③我填了行业名吗？

**29. 答案：The customer.**
1 题面：Who actually pays for the cost of advertisement；原文 "Since advertisement forms part of the cost of production, which has to be covered by the selling price, it is clear that it is the customer who pays for the advertisement."；疑问词 Who（问承担者）；诱导信号：同句前半出现 the producer，且有 whether…or… 的设问。
2 候选：①the customer；②the producer；③the media；④the government。
3 验算：①→it is the customer who pays for the advertisement，强调句直接给出→成立。②→We might ask whether…by the producer or by the customer 是设问，答案在后→不成立。③→media 是传播渠道→排除。④→government 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：设问句里的 producer 在前，且"生产成本由售价覆盖"的逻辑容易让人答"生产者"；强调句 it is…who 的结构也可能被读成普通句。
5 意图：考"Who 取强调句焦点（the customer），设问中的另一项不取"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The customer 即可。若问 How is the cost covered? 答 By the selling price。若问 When does the customer pay less? 答 When large-scale advertisement leads to increased demand and production costs are reduced。
7 错误：A 答 The producer.（错因：设问项）；B 答 The media.（错因：渠道）；C 答 Both.（错因：原文明确 the customer）。
8 规则：R107.4 若问 Who actually pays for X 且原文有 it is A who pays 的强调句，then 取强调句焦点（the customer）；同句 whether A or B 的设问项（producer）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（强调句焦点）；复用 R37.3（that 回指依据），本条是 it is…who。
10 自检：①强调句焦点是谁？②producer 在哪句？③"both"有依据吗？

**30. 答案：pay large sums for advertisement（If convinced of the value of advertisement, businesses would pay large sums for it.）**
1 题面：框架 "If convinced of the value of advertisement, businesses would __________."；空位在 would 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "What is clear is that businesses would not pay large sums for advertisement if they were not convinced of its value to them."；疑问方式：由否定＋虚拟句反推肯定（虚拟语气反转）；诱导信号：原文是 would not pay…if not convinced，题干改成 If convinced…would。
2 候选：①pay large sums for advertisement；②not pay large sums（照抄否定）；③increase demand；④reduce production costs。
3 验算：①→would not pay…if not convinced 双重否定→If convinced, they would pay large sums，形式与语义都合→成立（would＋原形）。②→照抄否定，与 If convinced 矛盾→不成立。③→increase demand 是广告的效果（if large-scale），不是"确信价值后的行为"→次优。④→reduce costs 是需求增加的结果→排除。
4 干扰：原文的 not…if not 双重否定容易让人照抄 not pay；increase demand／reduce costs 也在段内，像"后果"。
5 意图：考"虚拟＋双重否定反推：If convinced…would pay"，与 R106.3 之外的"逻辑反转"同族。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 pay large sums for advertisement 即可（would 已给，不重复）。若问 What happens if large-scale advertisement leads to increased demand? 答 Production costs are reduced and the customer pays less。
7 错误：A 填 not pay large sums.（错因：照抄否定）；B 填 increase demand.（错因：另一条件）；C 填 to pay large sums.（错因：would 后不加 to）。
8 规则：R107.5 若题干把原文的"否定＋虚拟"改为"肯定条件＋would"，then 反推为肯定动作（pay large sums for advertisement），would 后接原形、不加 to；不得照抄 not，也不得把别的条件结果（increase demand／reduce costs）搬来。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（would＋原形）＋RA-3.16 推断（双重否定反转）；复用 R4.3（虚拟不作事实）的反向：本条是"由虚拟反推条件成立时的结果"。
10 自检：①原文是否定＋虚拟吗？②would 后要什么形式？③我照抄 not 了吗？

**组小结（G137 · 慧航第一套 Section A／Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：并列不定式 1（26）；媒体按用途配对 1（27）；类 vs 例 1（28）；强调句焦点 1（29）；双重否定＋虚拟反转 1（30）。
- 规则：R107.1 and 后取原形并列（26）；R107.2 媒体按用途配（27）；R107.3 build up 取上位（28）；R107.4 强调句焦点（29）；R107.5 否定＋虚拟反推肯定（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R107.1 与"inform／persuade 近邻"冲突，and 结构优先；R107.2 与"television 最强"冲突，用途配对优先；R107.3 与"四行业具体"冲突，上位优先；R107.4 与"producer 在前"冲突，强调句优先；R107.5 与"照抄 not"冲突，反推优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**Section A 首见**（短答体例：只写恰当词／短语，不要求完整句）；与 Passage 的区别仅在第 6／9 层注明，规则体系不变；数字（4 passages／5 questions 见 Directions，实为 3 篇）按原卷照抄并已在题头注明；**本组无推算**。

### 第一套 · Passage 2

One of the most authoritative voices speaking to us today is, of course, the voice of the advertisers. It shouts at us from the television screen and the radio loudspeakers; waves to us from every page of the newspaper; signals to us from the roadside bill-boards all day and flashes messages to us in colored lights all night.

Advertising has been among England's biggest growth industries since the war. Perhaps the reason is that advertising saves the manufacturers from having to think about the customer.

At the stage of designing and developing a product, there is quite enough to think about without worrying over whether anybody will want to buy it. The designer is busy enough without adding customer-appeal to all his other problems of man-hours and machine tolerance and stress factors. So they just go ahead and make the thing and leave it to the advertiser to find clever ways of making it appeal to purchasers after they have finished it, by pretending that it confers (赋予) status, or attracts love, or signifies manliness.

Other manufacturers find advertising saves them from changing their product. And manufacturers hate change. The ideal product is one that goes on unchanged forever. If, therefore, for one reason or another, some alteration seems called for—how much better to change the image, the packet or the pitch made by the product, rather than go to all the inconvenience of changing the product itself.




31. What is the most authoritative voice speaking to us today?

____________________

32. Why has advertising been among England's biggest growth industries?

Because advertising saves the manufacturers from having to ____________________.

33. Who is responsible for giving a product customer-appeal?

____________________

34. What is an ideal product?

____________________

35. When some changes in a product are necessary, what will a manufacturer do?

He will choose to change ____________________.

**〔G138〕慧航第一套 · Passage 2（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：The voice of the advertisers.**
1 题面：What is the most authoritative voice speaking to us today；原文 "One of the most authoritative voices speaking to us today is, of course, the voice of the advertisers."；疑问词 What is the most authoritative voice（问主体）；诱导信号：后句列举 television／radio／newspaper／bill-boards／colored lights 五种载体。
2 候选：①the voice of the advertisers；②television；③the radio；④the newspaper。
3 验算：①→One of the most authoritative voices…is the voice of the advertisers，主系表直接给出→成立。②③④→都是"广告声音"的传播载体→排除。
4 干扰：It shouts at us from the television screen… 一句里五种载体排比，画面感强，容易被当答案。
5 意图：考"主语取 the voice of the advertisers，载体不作主体"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 the voice of the advertisers 即可。若问 Through which media does advertising speak to us? 答 Television, radio, newspapers and bill-boards（and colored lights）。
7 错误：A 答 Television.（错因：载体）；B 答 The manufacturers.（错因：另一段主体）；C 答 The customers.（错因：对象）。
8 规则：R108.1 若问 What is the most authoritative voice，then 取主系表的表语（the voice of the advertisers）；排比列举的载体（television／radio／newspaper）只说明"怎么传播"，不作主体。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（主体取词）；复用 R63.1（并列主语取全），本条是"主体 vs 载体"。
10 自检：①is 后是什么？②television 是主体吗？③五种载体怎么处理？

**32. 答案：think about the customer（Because advertising saves the manufacturers from having to think about the customer.）**
1 题面：框架 "Because advertising saves the manufacturers from having to __________."；空位在 having to 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "Perhaps the reason is that advertising saves the manufacturers from having to think about the customer."；诱导信号：后两段讲 designing／changing product，都是"不用操心"的具体表现。
2 候选：①think about the customer；②change their product；③design the product；④find clever ways。
3 验算：①→saves the manufacturers from having to think about the customer，与题干逐字对应→成立。②→change their product 是另一段（manufacturers hate change）的观点，不在此句→次优。③→design 是他们仍要做的事→排除。④→find clever ways 是广告商做的→排除。
4 干扰：change their product 在下一段反复出现，主题感强；designing and developing 也在段首。
5 意图：考"补全式空位取 having to 后的原形短语（think about the customer）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：只写 think about the customer。若问 What does the designer worry about? 答 Man-hours, machine tolerance and stress factors（not customer-appeal）。
7 错误：A 填 change their product.（错因：后段观点）；B 填 to think about the customer.（错因：having to 后不加 to）；C 填 design the product.（错因：他们仍要设计）。
8 规则：R108.2 若补全式空位在 having to 后，then 取动词原形短语（think about the customer），不加 to；下一段的观点（change their product）与设计师的职责（design）不作本空。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（having to＋原形）＋RA-5.1 空位词性；复用 R59.2（形式随框架改），本条是 having to。
10 自检：①having to 后要什么形式？②change product 在哪段？③我加了 to 吗？

**33. 答案：The advertiser.**
1 题面：Who is responsible for giving a product customer-appeal；原文 "So they just go ahead and make the thing and leave it to the advertiser to find clever ways of making it appeal to purchasers after they have finished it."；疑问词 Who（问责任者）；诱导信号：The designer is busy enough without adding customer-appeal 里的 designer 也出现"customer-appeal"。
2 候选：①the advertiser；②the designer；③the manufacturer；④the purchaser。
3 验算：①→leave it to the advertiser to find clever ways of making it appeal to purchasers，leave it to sb to do 结构指明责任者→成立。②→designer 恰恰"不加 customer-appeal"→不成立。③→manufacturers 是把这件事"留给"别人的人→排除。④→purchasers 是被吸引的对象→排除。
4 干扰：designer 与 customer-appeal 在同一句，且"设计"直觉上该管"吸引力"；manufacturers 是全文主语。
5 意图：考"leave it to sb to do 取责任者（the advertiser），同句被否定的 designer 不取"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The advertiser。若问 What does the advertiser pretend the product does? 答 That it confers status, or attracts love, or signifies manliness。
7 错误：A 答 The designer.（错因：被否定项）；B 答 The manufacturer.（错因：委托方）；C 答 The purchaser.（错因：对象）。
8 规则：R108.3 若问 Who is responsible for doing X 且原文有 leave it to sb to do，then 取 to 前的责任者（the advertiser）；同句"不加 X"的 designer 与委托方 manufacturers 不作责任者。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（责任者）；复用 R80.5（Who 取主语），本条是 leave it to sb。
10 自检：①leave it to 后是谁？②designer 被肯定还是否定？③purchaser 是什么角色？

**34. 答案：A product that goes on unchanged forever.**
1 题面：What is an ideal product；原文 "The ideal product is one that goes on unchanged forever."；疑问词 What is an ideal product（问定义）；诱导信号：前句 And manufacturers hate change 是原因，后句 If…some alteration seems called for 是假设。
2 候选：①one that goes on unchanged forever；②one that sells well；③one with a good image；④one that is cheap。
3 验算：①→The ideal product is one that goes on unchanged forever，主系表＋定语从句→成立。②→sells well 原文未提→排除。③→image 是"可改的东西"之一→排除。④→cheap 未提→排除。
4 干扰：manufacturers hate change 是最醒目的态度句，容易被当定义；change the image 的对比也像"理想产品"。
5 意图：考"定义取 is one that 后的定语从句（unchanged forever）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 A product that goes on unchanged forever 即可。若问 Why do manufacturers hate change? 答 原文只说符合其利益（ideal product is unchanged），未给原因。
7 错误：A 答 One that sells well.（错因：无据）；B 答 One with a good image.（错因：可改项）；C 答 One that is cheap.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R108.4 若问 What is an ideal X，then 取 is one that 后的定语从句（goes on unchanged forever）；同段的"态度句"（hate change）与"可改项"（image／packet／pitch）不作定义。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.27 定义（定语从句）；复用 R44.1（术语取定义），本条是 one that。
10 自检：①is 后是什么？②hate change 是定义吗？③image 属哪类？

**35. 答案：the image, the packet or the pitch（He will choose to change the image, the packet or the pitch made by the product.）**
1 题面：框架 "He will choose to change __________."；空位在 change 后，须为名词短语；原文 "how much better to change the image, the packet or the pitch made by the product, rather than go to all the inconvenience of changing the product itself."；诱导信号：rather than 后的 changing the product itself 是被排除项。
2 候选：①the image, the packet or the pitch；②the product itself；③the manufacturer；④the design。
3 验算：①→change the image, the packet or the pitch…rather than…changing the product itself，rather than 前为选择→成立（三项任写／全写）。②→rather than 后是被排除项→不成立。③→manufacturer 是施动者→排除。④→design 原文未单列→次优。
4 干扰：rather than changing the product itself 与"change"同词根，最易被当答案；三项并列也可能只写一项。
5 意图：考"rather than 取前项（image／packet／pitch），后项为被排除项"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 the image, the packet or the pitch 即可。若问 What would a manufacturer rather do than change the product? 答 Change the image, the packet or the pitch。
7 错误：A 填 the product itself.（错因：rather than 后）；B 填 the design.（错因：无据）；C 填 the price.（错因：无据改写）。
8 规则：R108.5 若题干为 choose to change ___ 且原文有 rather than，then 取 rather than 前的并列项（image／packet／pitch），后项（the product itself）为被排除项；三项至少写两项。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词短语）＋RA-1.29 对比取前项；复用 R16.5（not A but B 取 B）的反向：本条是 rather than 取前项。
10 自检：①rather than 前有几项？②后项是什么？③我抄了 product itself 吗？

**组小结（G138 · 慧航第一套 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：主体 vs 载体 1（31）；having to 后原形 1（32）；责任者 1（33）；定义（one that）1（34）；rather than 取前项 1（35）。
- 规则：R108.1 主体取 advertisers（31）；R108.2 having to 后原形（32）；R108.3 leave it to sb 取责任者（33）；R108.4 定义取 one that（34）；R108.5 rather than 取前项（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R108.1 与"五种载体排比"冲突，表语优先；R108.2 与"change product 主题感"冲突，同句优先；R108.3 与"designer 同句"冲突，leave it to 优先；R108.4 与"hate change"冲突，定义句优先；R108.5 与"product itself 同词根"冲突，rather than 优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：广告业说明文（第 2 篇，与 G137 同一题材、不同角度）；本篇"主体 vs 载体""责任者 vs 委托方"两组配对是 04 的样本；数字（hundred／one hundred／nine out of ten 见后篇）无换算，**本组无推算**。

### 第一套 · Passage 3

Be aware of those who use the truth to cheat. When someone tells you something that is true, but leaves out important information that should be included, he can create a false impression. For example, someone might say, "I just won a hundred dollars on the lottery. It was great. I took that dollar ticket back to the store and changed it for one hundred dollars!"

This guy's a winner, maybe right, maybe not. We then discovered that he bought two hundred tickets, and only one was a winner. He's really a big loser!

He didn't say anything that was false, but he deliberately left out some important information. That's called a half-truth. Half-truths are not technically lies, but they are just as not honest.

Untrustworthy candidates in political campaigns often use this strategy. Let's say that during Governor Smith's last term, her state lost one million jobs and gained three million jobs.

Then she seeks another term. One of her opponents runs an advertisement saying, "During Governor Smith's term, the state lost one million jobs!" That's true. However, an honest statement would have been, "During Governor Smith's term, the state had a net gain of two million jobs."

Advertisers will sometimes use half-truths. It's against the law to make false claims so they try to mislead you with the truth. An advertisement might boast, "Nine out of ten doctors recommend Yucky Pills to cure nose pimples." It fails to mention that they only asked ten doctors and nine of them work for the Yucky Corporation.

This kind of deception happens too often. It's a sad fact of life: Lies are lies, and sometimes the truth can lie as well.




36. What is called a half-truth?

A half-truth is that somebody doesn't say anything wrong but ____________________ on purpose.

37. What kind of people usually use half-truths in political campaigns?

____________________

38. How did Governor Smith's opponent try to mislead people in the political advertisement?

Her opponent misled people by saying during her term, ____________________.

39. Why do advertisers sometimes use half-truths to mislead consumers?

____________________

40. In the last paragraph, which word has a similar meaning to "deception"?

____________________

**〔G139〕慧航第一套 · Passage 3（36—40）十层研究**

**36. 答案：leaves out important information（A half-truth is that somebody doesn't say anything wrong but leaves out important information on purpose.）**
1 题面：框架 "A half-truth is that somebody doesn't say anything wrong but __________ on purpose."；空位在 but 后、与 doesn't say 并列，须为第三人称单数动词短语；原文 "He didn't say anything that was false, but he deliberately left out some important information. That's called a half-truth."；诱导信号：technically lies 一句是补充说明，不是定义。
2 候选：①leaves out important information；②tells a lie；③creates a false impression；④uses the truth to cheat。
3 验算：①→didn't say anything false, but deliberately left out important information，与 but 结构一致；题干用 on purpose 替换 deliberately，主语 somebody 为单数→leaves out 形式吻合→成立。②→tells a lie 与"technically not lies"冲突→不成立。③→creates a false impression 是结果（首段），不是"half-truth 的做法"→次优。④→uses the truth to cheat 是全文首句的概括→次优。
4 干扰：首句 Be aware of those who use the truth to cheat 与 creates a false impression 都在前，像定义；tells a lie 的否定（not technically lies）也容易漏。
5 意图：考"补全式：but 后第三人称单数（leaves out），并与 technically not lies 对照"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 leaves out important information 即可。若问 Is a half-truth technically a lie? 答 No, but it is just as not honest。
7 错误：A 填 tells a lie.（错因：与 not technically lies 冲突）；B 填 leave out important information.（错因：主语 somebody 单数，形式不合）；C 填 creates a false impression.（错因：结果当定义）。
8 规则：R109.1 若补全式为 A half-truth is that somebody doesn't…but ___ on purpose，then 取第三人称单数动词短语（leaves out important information），依据原文 but he deliberately left out；不得填"说谎"（technically lies 已否定）；结果句（false impression）不作定义。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（三人称单数）＋RA-5.1 空位词性；复用 R59.2（形式随框架改），本条是主谓一致。
10 自检：①but 前是什么主语？②动词要加 -s 吗？③half-truth 是 lie 吗？

**37. 答案：Untrustworthy candidates (in political campaigns).**
1 题面：What kind of people usually use half-truths in political campaigns；原文 "Untrustworthy candidates in political campaigns often use this strategy."；疑问词 What kind of people（问人群）；诱导信号：上文 Governor Smith 的例子很具体，容易被当答案。
2 候选：①untrustworthy candidates；②Governor Smith；③her opponent；④advertisers。
3 验算：①→Untrustworthy candidates in political campaigns often use this strategy，人群＋场景同句→成立。②→Smith 是被攻击的对象，且她本人未必用 half-truths→排除。③→opponent 是"举例中的使用者"，不是"这类人"的统称→次优。④→advertisers 出现在后一段（商业广告）→次优。
4 干扰：Smith 与 opponent 的故事篇幅最长、最具体；advertisers 也在下段"使用 half-truths"。
5 意图：考"kind of people 取统称（untrustworthy candidates），例子中的人物不作类别"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 untrustworthy candidates 即可。若问 How did the opponent mislead people? 答 By saying the state lost one million jobs（but leaving out the gain of three million）。
7 错误：A 答 Governor Smith.（错因：被攻击者）；B 答 Her opponent.（错因：个例）；C 答 Advertisers.（错因：另一段）。
8 规则：R109.2 若问 What kind of people usually use X，then 取统称（untrustworthy candidates）；同段例子中的具体人物（Smith／her opponent）与下一段的另一群体（advertisers）不作类别。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（统称 vs 个例）；复用 R15.2（类 vs 例），本条是人物类。
10 自检：①统称是什么？②Smith 用了 half-truth 吗？③advertisers 在哪段？

**38. 答案：the state lost one million jobs（Her opponent misled people by saying during her term, the state lost one million jobs.）**
1 题面：框架 "Her opponent misled people by saying during her term, __________."；空位在逗号后，须为完整从句（主语＋谓语）；原文 "One of her opponents runs an advertisement saying, 'During Governor Smith's term, the state lost one million jobs!'"；诱导信号：下一句 However, an honest statement would have been…net gain of two million jobs 是"诚实版本"。
2 候选：①the state lost one million jobs；②the state gained three million jobs；③the state had a net gain of two million jobs；④she lost one million jobs（主语 she）。
3 验算：①→saying, "During Governor Smith's term, the state lost one million jobs!"，直接引语→成立。②→gained three million 是原文补充的另一半，对手没有说→不成立。③→net gain 是"诚实版本"，不是对手的话→次优。④→主语 she 与 the state 不符→排除。
4 干扰：净增两百万（3−1）最"完整"，但它是对手故意省略后的诚实版；gained three million 也在同段。
5 意图：考"补全式取直接引语（对手说的话），不取诚实版本／补充信息"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 the state lost one million jobs 即可。若问 What would an honest statement be? 答 The state had a net gain of two million jobs。
7 错误：A 填 the state gained three million jobs.（错因：对手没说）；B 填 the state had a net gain of two million jobs.（错因：诚实版）；C 填 she lost one million jobs.（错因：主谓搭配错）。
8 规则：R109.3 若补全式为 misled people by saying…，then 取直接引语的原话（the state lost one million jobs），须补主语 the state；诚实版本（net gain of two million）与未说的另一半（gained three million）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（从句）＋RA-1.10 引语定位；复用 R38.3（引语按场合照录），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①对手原话是什么？②net gain 是谁的说法？③主语补了吗？

**39. 答案：Because it is against the law to make false claims (so they try to mislead you with the truth).**
1 题面：Why do advertisers sometimes use half-truths to mislead consumers；原文 "Advertisers will sometimes use half-truths. It's against the law to make false claims so they try to mislead you with the truth."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：后文 Nine out of ten doctors… 的广告例子很具体。
2 候选：①it's against the law to make false claims；②because they want to sell more；③because doctors recommend them；④because consumers like truth。
3 验算：①→It's against the law to make false claims so they try to mislead you with the truth，so 前即因→成立（可补"so"后的做法）。②→想多卖是常识，原文未说→次优。③→医生推荐是例子内容，不是原因→排除。④→无据→排除。
4 干扰：Nine out of ten doctors 的数字与"only asked ten doctors"的反转很抢眼；⑤ 商业动机也符合直觉。
5 意图：考"原因取 so 前的法律限制（against the law），例子与常识动机不作原因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Because it is against the law to make false claims 即可。若问 How did the advertisement mislead people? 答 It said nine out of ten doctors recommend the pills but failed to mention only ten were asked and nine work for the company。
7 错误：A 答 Because they want to sell more.（错因：常识）；B 答 Because doctors recommend the pills.（错因：例子）；C 答 Because the law allows half-truths.（错因：改写）。
8 规则：R109.4 若问 Why do advertisers use half-truths，then 取 so 前的法律限制（it is against the law to make false claims）；例子（nine out of ten doctors）与常识动机（sell more）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（so 前为因）；复用 R30.3（so 前为因），本条是"法律限制"。
10 自检：①so 前是什么？②医生例子说明什么？③"多卖"有依据吗？

**40. 答案：lies（It is "lies".）**
1 题面：In the last paragraph, which word has a similar meaning to "deception"；原文末段 "This kind of deception happens too often. It's a sad fact of life: Lies are lies, and sometimes the truth can lie as well."；疑问方式：给英文词找同义词（词义族）；诱导信号：末段还有 truth／fact of life，且 lie 以 lies／lie 两种形式出现。
2 候选：①lies；②truth；③fact；④advertisement。
3 验算：①→Lies are lies, and sometimes the truth can lie as well，lie 与 deception 同义，且末段以 lies 形式出现→成立（写 lies 或 lie 均可）。②→truth 是反义→不成立。③→fact of life 是短语→排除。④→advertisement 是主题词，不在此段末句→排除。
4 干扰：truth 与 lie 在末句成对出现，反义最容易误取；deception 本身也在末段首句。
5 意图：考"同义词题：原文须有该词（lies／lie），反义词（truth）不取"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 lies 即可（写 lie 也算对）。若问 Which word in the last paragraph is opposite to "lies"? 答 truth。
7 错误：A 答 truth.（错因：反义）；B 答 fact.（错因：短语成分）；C 答 half-truth.（错因：本段未出现）。
8 规则：R109.5 若题干给英文词找同义词，then 到指定段落找同义原文词（lies／lie），并核对形式（复数）；反义词（truth）与同段其他名词（fact／advertisement）不取。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.6 同义／反义词（释义→词）；复用 R60.4／R103.5，本条是"英文词→同义词"。
10 自检：①末段哪个词＝deception？②truth 是什么关系？③写 lie 行吗？

**组小结（G139 · 慧航第一套 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：定义补全（三人称单数）1（36）；统称 vs 个例 1（37）；引语补全 1（38）；so 前为因 1（39）；同义词 1（40）。
- 规则：R109.1 定义补全保主谓一致（36）；R109.2 统称不取个例（37）；R109.3 引语原话（38）；R109.4 so 前为因（39）；R109.5 同义词须原文有该词（40）。
- 冲突与优先级：R109.1 与"tells a lie"冲突，technically not lies 优先；R109.2 与"Smith／opponent 篇幅长"冲突，统称优先；R109.3 与"net gain 更完整"冲突，原话优先；R109.4 与"医生例子"冲突，法律限制优先；R109.5 与"truth 成对出现"冲突，同义词优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：广告伦理／半真半假题材（第 3 篇）；**第一套 3 篇至此完成（G137—G139）**；Directions 称 4 篇而实际 3 篇，已在 G137 题头注明、照抄不改；数字（one hundred／two hundred／one million／three million／two million／nine out of ten／ten doctors）密集，但**无一题需运算**（净增两百万是原文直接给出的"honest statement"，非学生计算），**本组无推算**。

### 第七套 · Passage 1

It is crucial for us to understand how to ensure our safety when traveling in foreign countries. We have all heard stories of travelers having their wallets stolen or getting lost in unfamiliar neighborhoods. Therefore, it is essential to exercise extra caution when traveling abroad.

Remember to always carry a small amount of cash and a copy of your ID with you. There is no need to bring large sums of cash. When shopping, use your credit card instead. Put the wallet in your front pocket so that there is no way that someone's hand could get in there without your noticing it.

If possible, travel with a companion or a business partner. It is always safer to travel in pairs rather than alone. Familiarize yourself with the directions and routes to your destination. Take a look at the map before leaving the hotel so that you are aware of where you are going and how to get there.

Secure your valuable belongings either in the safe provided in your hotel room or in the main hotel safe.

Stay alert and be aware of your surroundings. When walking, make sure to look around and avoid keeping your head down.

21. Why is it essential to be especially cautious when traveling abroad?

22. Apart from a copy of your ID, what should you always carry with you when traveling?

____________________

23. To keep your wallet safe, you'd better ______.

24. To know where you are going, you are supposed to refer to ______.

25. Where should you keep your valuables if there isn't a safe in your hotel room?

____________________

**〔G140〕慧航第七套 · Passage 1（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：Because travelers have had their wallets stolen or got lost in unfamiliar neighborhoods.**
1 题面：Why is it essential to be especially cautious when traveling abroad；原文 "It is crucial for us to understand how to ensure our safety when traveling in foreign countries. We have all heard stories of travelers having their wallets stolen or getting lost in unfamiliar neighborhoods. Therefore, it is essential to exercise extra caution when traveling abroad."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：首句 It is crucial for us to understand… 是总起，两例才是原因。
2 候选：①wallets stolen／lost in unfamiliar neighborhoods；②because traveling is expensive；③because foreign countries are beautiful；④because hotels are unsafe。
3 验算：①→We have all heard stories of travelers having their wallets stolen or getting lost…Therefore, it is essential to exercise extra caution，Therefore 前即因→成立（两例都写）。②③④→原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：首句"safety in foreign countries"像原因；therefore 前有两个例子，容易只写一个。
5 意图：考"原因取 Therefore 前的两个例子，总起句不作原因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Because travelers may have wallets stolen or get lost。若问 What is the key to safety abroad? 答 Extra caution（and the tips that follow）。
7 错误：A 答 Because foreign countries are dangerous.（错因：笼统改写）；B 答 Because hotels are unsafe.（错因：无据）；C 答 Because travel costs much.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R110.1 若问 Why is it essential to do X，then 取 Therefore 前的两个具体例子（wallets stolen／getting lost），两例并列；总起句（understand how to ensure safety）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（Therefore 前为因）；复用 R30.3（so 前为因），本条是 Therefore。
10 自检：①Therefore 前有哪两例？②首句是原因吗？③我写笼统了吗？

**22. 答案：A small amount of cash.**
1 题面：Apart from a copy of your ID, what should you always carry with you when traveling；原文 "Remember to always carry a small amount of cash and a copy of your ID with you."；题干 Apart from 已排除 a copy of your ID；疑问词 what should you carry（问所带之物）；诱导信号：下一句 There is no need to bring large sums of cash 是数量限定。
2 候选：①a small amount of cash；②large sums of cash；③a credit card；④a map。
3 验算：①→carry a small amount of cash and a copy of your ID，Apart from 后只剩 cash→成立（保留 small amount 限定）。②→There is no need to bring large sums of cash 明确否定→不成立。③→credit card 是"购物时用"的替代手段，不是"随身必带"清单项→次优。④→map 用于认路（第 24 题）→排除。
4 干扰：credit card／map 都在后文，像"随身物"；large sums 与 small amount 是同一名词的不同量，容易答成"带钱"而丢限定。
5 意图：考"Apart from 排除已给项，取剩余项并保留数量限定（small amount）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 A small amount of cash。若问 What should you use when shopping? 答 Your credit card。
7 错误：A 答 Large sums of cash.（错因：被否定）；B 答 A credit card.（错因：手段非清单）；C 答 Money.（错因：丢 small amount）。
8 规则：R110.2 若题干 Apart from X，what should you carry，then 取同一并列清单的另一项（a small amount of cash），保留数量限定；被否定项（large sums）与后文手段（credit card／map）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.48 排除域（Apart from）；复用 R44.5（排除原文法），本条是"清单内排除"。
10 自检：①并列清单有哪两项？②large sums 被肯定吗？③credit card 是什么？

**23. 答案：put the wallet in your front pocket（To keep your wallet safe, you'd better put the wallet in your front pocket.）**
1 题面：框架 "To keep your wallet safe, you'd better __________."；空位在 you'd better 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "Put the wallet in your front pocket so that there is no way that someone's hand could get in there without your noticing it."；诱导信号：同一段的 use your credit card 是购物建议，不是"钱包放哪"。
2 候选：①put the wallet in your front pocket；②use your credit card；③carry large sums；④keep it in your bag。
3 验算：①→Put the wallet in your front pocket so that…，与"keep your wallet safe"同句目的→成立。②→购物方式，与"放哪"无关→次优。③→被否定→排除。④→keep it in your bag 原文无，且后口袋／包里更危险→排除。
4 干扰：use your credit card 同样在本段、同样防偷，容易被当答案。
5 意图：考"补全式 you'd better 后取原形短语（put…in your front pocket）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 put the wallet in your front pocket。若问 Why is the front pocket safer? 答 Because a hand can't get in without your noticing it。
7 错误：A 填 use your credit card.（错因：另一建议）；B 填 to put the wallet in your front pocket.（错因：'d better 后不加 to）；C 填 keep it in your back pocket.（错因：无据且危险）。
8 规则：R110.3 若补全式为 you'd better ___，then 取动词原形短语（put the wallet in your front pocket），不加 to；同段并列的另一建议（use your credit card）按题干目的排除。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（had better＋原形）；复用 R59.2，本条是 had better。
10 自检：①you'd better 后要什么形式？②credit card 属哪条建议？③我加了 to 吗？

**24. 答案：the map（To know where you are going, you are supposed to refer to the map.）**
1 题面：框架 "To know where you are going, you are supposed to refer to __________."；空位在 refer to 后，须为名词；原文 "Familiarize yourself with the directions and routes to your destination. Take a look at the map before leaving the hotel so that you are aware of where you are going and how to get there."；诱导信号：同句还有 directions and routes，像"参考对象"。
2 候选：①the map；②directions and routes（要熟悉的对象）；③a companion；④the hotel。
3 验算：①→Take a look at the map…so that you are aware of where you are going，与题干 where you are going 同句→成立。②→directions and routes 是"熟悉"的对象，不是"refer to"的对象；且与题干 where 对应的是 map→次优。③→companion 属"结伴同行"建议→排除。④→hotel 是出发地点→排除。
4 干扰：directions and routes 与 map 同段同义场；题干 refer to 与 familiarize yourself with 也近义。
5 意图：考"补全式 refer to 后取同句目的的工具名（the map）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 the map。若问 What should you do before leaving the hotel? 答 Take a look at the map。若问 Why travel with a companion? 答 It is safer to travel in pairs。
7 错误：A 填 directions and routes.（错因：熟悉对象）；B 填 a companion.（错因：另一建议）；C 填 your ID.（错因：另一段）。
8 规则：R110.4 若补全式为 you are supposed to refer to ___，then 取与"知道去哪"同句的工具（the map）；"熟悉"的对象（directions／routes）与结伴建议（companion）不作 refer to 的宾语。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（介词宾语）；复用 R6.1（介词后取宾语），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①refer to 后要名词吗？②map 与 where 同句吗？③directions 是什么动词的宾语？

**25. 答案：In the main hotel safe.**
1 题面：Where should you keep your valuables if there isn't a safe in your hotel room；原文 "Secure your valuable belongings either in the safe provided in your hotel room or in the main hotel safe."；疑问词 Where…if there isn't（条件分支）；诱导信号：either…or… 给两个选项，题干否定了第一个。
2 候选：①in the main hotel safe；②in the safe in your hotel room；③in your front pocket；④with a companion。
3 验算：①→either in the safe in your room or in the main hotel safe，题干否定前项→取后项→成立。②→题干已排除（there isn't a safe in your room）→不成立。③→front pocket 是钱包，不是贵重物品→次优。④→companion 是同行建议→排除。
4 干扰：either…or 两选项并列，不按题干条件筛就会答前项；front pocket 在本篇反复出现。
5 意图：考"条件分支：题干否掉 either 项后取 or 项"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 In the main hotel safe。若问 Where can you keep valuables if your room has a safe? 答 In the safe in your hotel room。
7 错误：A 答 In the safe in your room.（错因：题干已否定）；B 答 In your front pocket.（错因：钱包）；C 答 With you all the time.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R110.5 若题干用 if there isn't A 否掉 either…or 中的 A，then 取 or 后的 B（the main hotel safe）；被否定的 A 与另段的钱包建议不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（条件分支）；复用 R56.2（only／条件必找对应项），本条是 either…or。
10 自检：①either 项是什么？②or 项是什么？③题干否定了哪个？

**组小结（G140 · 慧航第七套 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：Therefore 前两例 1（21）；Apart from 取余项 1（22）；had better 后原形 1（23）；refer to 取工具 1（24）；either…or 条件分支 1（25）。
- 规则：R110.1 Therefore 前为因（21）；R110.2 Apart from 取余项（22）；R110.3 had better＋原形（23）；R110.4 refer to 取工具（24）；R110.5 either…or 按条件取（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R110.1 与"首句总起"冲突，Therefore 前优先；R110.2 与"credit card 同段"冲突，清单项优先；R110.3 与"use credit card 同段"冲突，题干目的优先；R110.4 与"directions 近义"冲突，同句目的优先；R110.5 与"either 项在前"冲突，题干条件优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：旅行安全建议文首见（五条建议与四个小问一一对应）；本篇三题是补全式（23／24＋22 的排除），Section A 短答体例延续 G137；数字（small amount／large sums）为量词对照，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第七套 · Passage 2

Thank you for your interest in Calibre Cassette (盒式录音带) library. This letter tells you about our service. With it we are sending you an application form, so that you can join if you would like to try it.

Calibre library aims to provide the pleasure of reading to anyone who cannot read ordinary print books because of sight problems. We currently have over 7,000 books available for reading pleasure, including 1,000 specially for children. All our books are recorded cover-to-cover on ordinary cassettes and can be played on any cassette player. They are sent and returned by post, free of charge.

When we receive your application, we will send you a book and an information tape. They will explain how to



use the service. The easy way to use Calibre library is to tell us what sorts of books you like, and we will keep you supplied with books we think you will enjoy. Or you can send us a list of books you would like to read, and we will then send you books from this list whenever possible. In that case you will need to use our website, or buy one or more of our catalogues (目录).

26. According to the first paragraph, the library sends the application form to the readers so that they can ______.

27. Calibre library provides service mainly for people who suffer from ______.

28. The service of sending and returning books by post is ______.

29. What is the easy way to use the library service?

____________________

30. 30. What is the main purpose of this letter?

____________________

**〔G141〕慧航第七套 · Passage 2（26—30）十层研究**

> 本篇是一封**业务信函**（"This letter tells you about our service"），属应用文第 4 例（书信体第 2 例，第 1 例为 G78 私人书信）；五题中 26／27／28 为补全式，29／30 为完整问句。

**26. 答案：join（the library）（…so that they can join if they would like to try it.）**
1 题面：框架 "According to the first paragraph, the library sends the application form to the readers so that they can __________."；空位在 can 后，须为动词原形；原文 "With it we are sending you an application form, so that you can join if you would like to try it."；诱导信号：application form 后紧跟 so that，中间只隔一个从句。
2 候选：①join；②read books；③try the service（同句 if 从句里的说法）；④fill in the form。
3 验算：①→so that you can join if you would like to try it，can 后原形 join→成立。②→read 是服务内容，不是表格的用途→次优。③→try it 是条件从句里的说法，不是 can 后的动词→次优。④→fill in 原文未用→排除。
4 干扰：read books／try it 都在附近，语义相关；so that 从句与 if 从句嵌套也容易读混。
5 意图：考"补全式 can 后取原形（join），条件从句的说法不作主句动词"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 join 即可（可补 the library）。若问 What is sent with the letter? 答 An application form。
7 错误：A 填 to join.（错因：can 后不加 to）；B 填 try it.（错因：从句说法）；C 填 fill in the form.（错因：原文未用）。
8 规则：R111.1 若补全式空位在 can 后，then 取原形动词（join），不加 to；同一句 if 从句里的动词短语（try it）与相关动作（read／fill in）不作主句谓语。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（can＋原形）；复用 R59.2，本条是 can。
10 自检：①can 后要什么形式？②if 从句说什么？③我加了 to 吗？

**27. 答案：sight problems（Calibre library provides service mainly for people who suffer from sight problems.）**
1 题面：框架 "Calibre library provides service mainly for people who suffer from __________."；空位在 suffer from 后，须为名词；原文 "Calibre library aims to provide the pleasure of reading to anyone who cannot read ordinary print books because of sight problems."；诱导信号：同句还有 print books，像"阅读障碍"。
2 候选：①sight problems；②reading problems；③print books；④old age。
3 验算：①→cannot read ordinary print books because of sight problems，suffer from 与 because of 后的病因对应→成立。②→reading problems 是表现（cannot read），不是病因→次优。③→print books 是读物→排除。④→old age 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：cannot read 是"阅读困难"，容易答 reading problems；print books 也在同句。
5 意图：考"病因取 because of 后的名词（sight problems），表现（cannot read）不作病因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 sight problems。若问 Why can't these people read ordinary books? 答 Because of sight problems。若问 What is recorded on the cassettes? 答 All their books（cover-to-cover）。
7 错误：A 填 reading problems.（错因：表现当病因）；B 填 print books.（错因：读物）；C 填 eye disease.（错因：改写过度）。
8 规则：R111.2 若补全式空位在 suffer from 后，then 取原文 because of 后的病因（sight problems）；表现（cannot read）与读物（print books）不作病因；不得改写为更具体的病名。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（介词宾语）；复用 R6.1（介词后取宾语），本条是病因。
10 自检：①because of 后是什么？②cannot read 是病因吗？③我改写成具体病名了吗？

**28. 答案：free of charge（The service of sending and returning books by post is free of charge.）**
1 题面：框架 "The service of sending and returning books by post is __________."；空位在 is 后（表语），须为形容词或介词短语；原文 "They are sent and returned by post, free of charge."；诱导信号：同段有 over 7,000 books／1,000 specially for children 的数字。
2 候选：①free of charge；②expensive；③slow；④by post。
3 验算：①→sent and returned by post, free of charge，free of charge 与 is 后表语对应→成立。②→与 free 相反→排除。③→原文未提速度→排除。④→by post 已在题干里（sending and returning books by post）→重复→不成立。
4 干扰：by post 与题干重复，容易再填一次；数字（7,000／1,000）也可能被当"服务特点"。
5 意图：考"表语取免费（free of charge），题干已给的方式（by post）不重复"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 free of charge。若问 How many books does the library have? 答 Over 7,000（including 1,000 for children）。
7 错误：A 填 by post.（错因：重复题干）；B 填 expensive.（错因：相反）；C 填 free.（错因：不完整，缺 of charge 也可接受但原文用短语）。
8 规则：R111.3 若补全式空位在 is 后且题干已给方式（by post），then 取费用类表语（free of charge），不重复已给方式；数字（7,000／1,000）不作表语。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（表语）＋RA-5.5 框架去重；复用 R51.1（表语位），本条是介词短语表语。
10 自检：①is 后要什么？②by post 重复了吗？③费用怎么说？

**29. 答案：To tell the library what sorts of books you like (and they will keep you supplied with books you enjoy).**
1 题面：What is the easy way to use the library service；原文 "The easy way to use Calibre library is to tell us what sorts of books you like, and we will keep you supplied with books we think you will enjoy."；疑问词 What is the easy way（问做法）；诱导信号：后文 Or you can send us a list of books… 是另一种（较麻烦）的方式。
2 候选：①tell them what sorts of books you like；②send them a list of books（另一种方式）；③buy their catalogues；④use their website。
3 验算：①→The easy way…is to tell us what sorts of books you like，主系表直接给出→成立（可补"他们会持续供书"）。②→Or you can send us a list… 是"Or"引出的另一方式，且需 website／catalogues→次优。③→buy catalogues 是第二种方式的配套→排除。④→website 同样是第二种方式的条件→排除。
4 干扰：send a list／website／catalogues 都在同段，信息密集；easy way 与另一方式用 Or 并列。
5 意图：考"easy way 取 is to do 的表语（tell them what sorts of books you like），Or 后的另一方式不作答案"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 By telling the library what sorts of books you like。若问 What do you need if you send a list of books? 答 The website or one of their catalogues。
7 错误：A 答 Send them a list of books.（错因：另一方式）；B 答 Buy their catalogues.（错因：配套条件）；C 答 Use their website.（错因：同上）。
8 规则：R111.4 若问 What is the easy way to do X，then 取 The easy way…is to do 后的表语（tell them what sorts of books you like）；Or 引出的另一方式（send a list）与其条件（website／catalogues）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（easy way）；复用 R20.5（选择＋理由）的反向：本条是"两种方式取易者"。
10 自检：①is to 后是什么？②Or 后是什么？③website 属哪种方式？

**30. 答案：To tell readers about the Calibre Cassette library service (and invite them to join).**
1 题面：What is the main purpose of this letter（原题编号重号"30. 30."，照抄）；原文 "Thank you for your interest in Calibre Cassette library. This letter tells you about our service. With it we are sending you an application form, so that you can join if you would like to try it."；疑问词 main purpose（问写作目的）；诱导信号：正文大量介绍馆藏与服务细节。
2 候选：①to tell readers about the service（and invite them to join）；②to sell cassettes；③to explain how to record books；④to praise the library's history。
3 验算：①→This letter tells you about our service＋so that you can join，两句合起来即目的→成立。②→cassettes 是载体，不是售卖品→排除。③→recording 是他们的工作，不是信的目的→排除。④→历史／赞誉原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：7,000 books／1,000 for children 等细节多，容易把"介绍馆藏"当目的；application form 也只答一半。
5 意图：考"书信目的取 This letter tells you about…＋so that you can join 两句"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 To tell readers about the service（and invite them to join）。若问 What is enclosed with the letter? 答 An application form。
7 错误：A 答 To sell cassettes.（错因：载体）；B 答 To explain recording.（错因：工作细节）；C 答 To thank readers only.（错因：漏"介绍＋邀请"）。
8 规则：R111.5 若问 main purpose of a letter，then 取"This letter tells you about…"＋"so that you can join"两句（介绍服务＋邀请加入）；馆藏数字与工作细节不作目的。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.1 主旨／写作目的；复用 R60.5（主旨取总起句），本条是书信体。
10 自检：①This letter tells 后是什么？②so that 后是什么？③我答"卖磁带"了吗？

**组小结（G141 · 慧航第七套 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：can 后原形 1（26）；病因 1（27）；表语（免费）＋去重 1（28）；easy way 1（29）；书信目的 1（30）。
- 规则：R111.1 can 后原形（26）；R111.2 病因取 because of 后（27）；R111.3 表语取费用、去重（28）；R111.4 easy way 取表语（29）；R111.5 书信目的取两句（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R111.1 与"if 从句 try it"冲突，主句动词优先；R111.2 与"cannot read 表现"冲突，病因优先；R111.3 与"by post 重复"冲突，去重优先；R111.4 与"Or 后另一方式"冲突，easy way 优先；R111.5 与"馆藏细节"冲突，目的句优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**应用文第 4 例（书信体第 2 例）**——业务信函（介绍服务＋附申请表＋邀请加入），与 G78 私人书信并列；三题补全式、两题完整问句，Section A 短答体例延续；数字（7,000／1,000／cover-to-cover）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第七套 · Passage 3

Have you ever wondered where the first doughnut (炸面圈) was made? Who thought up the idea of a fried cake with a hole in the center?

No one knows for sure who made the first doughnut. Some people think that doughnut probably began in the 1800s as Dutch "olykoeks" or "oily cakes." In those days, a cook would not want to waste any scraps of food. Leftover pieces of bread dough (生面团) were put into hot oil and fried. Olykoeks were tasty on the outside, but soft and uncooked in the center.

Some people say that the mother of a New England sea captain invented the first real doughnut. Her name was Elizabeth Gregory. She replaced the soft center with spices and nuts. But, Elizabeth's son, Captain Gregory, did not like nuts. He punched out the center, and the consequence was the first hole in a doughnut.

Others say the real story is that Captain Gregory had difficulty steering his ship while trying to eat doughnut. He asked the ship's cook to make his doughnuts with holes so he could hang them on the steering wheel! Others think that Captain Gregory saw holed cakes in Europe and brought the idea back to America with him.

During World War I, homesick American soldiers in Europe were served doughnuts by the Salvation Army. These brave women volunteering for the job were called "Doughnut Girls." They often worked in dangerous conditions near the soldiers, so the Doughnut Girls wore helmets and uniforms. The women made doughnut cutters out of a large can with a smaller can inside it to cut out the hole. They could set up a kettle of hot oil to fry the



dough almost anywhere.

In the 1920s, doughnut machines were invented. Doughnuts were produced faster and easier than ever before. Still, many people preferred to make their favorite doughnuts at home.

31. What were the features of Olykoeks?

____________________

32. ______ were used to replace the uncooked center to improve doughnuts.

33. According to paragraph 3, how did the the first hole in a doughnut create?

____________________

34. In order to protect themselves, what did the doughnut Girls do when they were working?

____________________

35. The passage is mainly about the inventors of ______.

**〔G142〕慧航第七套 · Passage 3（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：They were tasty on the outside but soft and uncooked in the center.**
1 题面：What were the features of Olykoeks；原文 "Olykoeks were tasty on the outside, but soft and uncooked in the center."；疑问词 What were the features（问特点，双面）；诱导信号：前句讲 leftover dough 被油炸（做法），后句才是特点。
2 候选：①tasty outside＋soft and uncooked center；②made of leftover bread dough（做法）；③fried in hot oil（做法）；④invented in the 1800s（时间）。
3 验算：①→were tasty on the outside, but soft and uncooked in the center，两面对照→成立（两面都写）。②③→是制作方式，不是"特点"→次优。④→时间背景→排除。
4 干扰：Leftover pieces of bread dough were put into hot oil and fried 紧挨在前，动作感强；tasty 是正面词，容易只写这一面。
5 意图：考"features 取双面（外脆内软），制作方式与时间不作特点"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Tasty on the outside but soft and uncooked in the center。若问 How were Olykoeks made? 答 Leftover bread dough was fried in hot oil。
7 错误：A 答 Made of leftover dough.（错因：做法）；B 答 Tasty.（错因：只一面）；C 答 Round with a hole.（错因：那是后来的 doughnut）。
8 规则：R112.1 若问 What were the features of X，then 取双面描写（tasty outside／soft and uncooked center），两面都写；制作方式（fried in oil）与时间（1800s）不作特点。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（特点双面）；复用 R37.2（but 两侧都写），本条是 were 描写。
10 自检：①but 两侧各是什么？②油炸是什么？③只写 tasty 行吗？

**32. 答案：Spices and nuts（Spices and nuts were used to replace the uncooked center.）**
1 题面：框架 "__________ were used to replace the uncooked center to improve doughnuts."；空位在句首作主语，谓语 were，须为复数名词；原文 "She replaced the soft center with spices and nuts."；诱导信号：同段还有 her name was Elizabeth Gregory，是人名。
2 候选：①spices and nuts；②Elizabeth Gregory；③Captain Gregory；④a large can。
3 验算：①→replaced the soft center with spices and nuts，with 后即替换物→成立（两项都写）。②→Elizabeth 是做替换的人，不是替换物→排除。③→Captain 是"打洞"的人→排除。④→a large can 是战时做切模的材料→排除。
4 干扰：Elizabeth／Captain 两个人物在同一段，动作分工容易混；soft center 与 uncooked center 也是同义改写。
5 意图：考"replace A with B 取 B（spices and nuts），施动者不作替换物"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Spices and nuts。若问 Who replaced the center with spices and nuts? 答 Elizabeth Gregory。
7 错误：A 填 Elizabeth Gregory.（错因：施动者）；B 填 nuts only.（错因：漏 spices）；C 填 a large can.（错因：串到战时段）。
8 规则：R112.2 若补全式为 ___ were used to replace X，then 取 replace…with 后的 B（spices and nuts），两项都写；施动者（Elizabeth／Captain）与工具（can）不作替换物；主语须为复数。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（复数主语）＋RA-5.9 形式随框架；复用 R59.2（形式随框架改），本条是主谓一致。
10 自检：①with 后是什么？②谁做的替换？③两项写全了吗？

**33. 答案：Captain Gregory punched out the center (because he did not like nuts).**
1 题面：According to paragraph 3, how did the the first hole in a doughnut create（原题重复 the，照抄）；第 3 段原文 "But, Elizabeth's son, Captain Gregory, did not like nuts. He punched out the center, and the consequence was the first hole in a doughnut."；疑问词 how did…create（问做法）；诱导信号：第 4 段还有两种"别人说"的版本（船上吃、欧洲带回），题干限定 paragraph 3。
2 候选：①punched out the center（because he didn't like nuts）；②asked the cook to make doughnuts with holes（第 4 段）；③saw holed cakes in Europe（第 4 段）；④used a large can as a cutter（战时段）。
3 验算：①→He punched out the center, and the consequence was the first hole，与题干"第一个洞怎么来的"直接对应→成立。②③→第 4 段"Others say"的版本，题干限定 paragraph 3→不成立。④→Doughnut Girls 时期的工具→排除。
4 干扰：第 4 段两种版本更戏剧化（挂方向盘／欧洲带回），且紧邻其后；punched out 的动作很短，容易漏。
5 意图：考"段落限定（paragraph 3）＋做法（punched out the center）"，Others say 的版本不作答案。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Captain Gregory punched out the center。若问 Why did he punch out the center? 答 Because he did not like nuts。
7 错误：A 答 He hung doughnuts on the steering wheel.（错因：第 4 段版本）；B 答 He brought the idea from Europe.（错因：第 4 段版本）；C 答 His mother made a hole.（错因：母亲只是换馅）。
8 规则：R112.3 若题干限定 According to paragraph N，then 只取该段的说法（第 3 段：Captain Gregory punched out the center）；下一段的 Others say 版本（方向盘／欧洲）与战时工具不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 做法（段落限定）；复用 R40.2（段落限定），本条是"版本冲突"。
10 自检：①题干限定哪段？②第 3 段的做法是什么？③方向盘在第几段？

**34. 答案：They wore helmets and uniforms.**
1 题面：In order to protect themselves, what did the doughnut Girls do when they were working；原文 "They often worked in dangerous conditions near the soldiers, so the Doughnut Girls wore helmets and uniforms."；疑问词 what did sb do to protect themselves（问做法）；诱导信号：同段还有 made doughnut cutters out of a large can，是工作方法。
2 候选：①wore helmets and uniforms；②made doughnut cutters；③set up a kettle of hot oil；④worked near the soldiers。
3 验算：①→wore helmets and uniforms，与"危险环境"直接对应，且 so 引出→成立。②③→是制作方法，不是防护→排除。④→worked near the soldiers 是危险来源→排除。
4 干扰：made cutters／set up a kettle 都在同段，动作具体；helmets and uniforms 只是名词并列。
5 意图：考"防护做法取 wore helmets and uniforms，工作方法不作防护"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 They wore helmets and uniforms。若问 How did they cut out the hole? 答 With a large can with a smaller can inside it。
7 错误：A 答 They made doughnut cutters.（错因：工作方法）；B 答 They worked near soldiers.（错因：危险来源）；C 答 They wore aprons.（错因：无据改写）。
8 规则：R112.4 若问 what did sb do in order to protect themselves，then 取防护动作（wore helmets and uniforms）；同段的工作方法（made cutters／set up a kettle）与危险环境（near soldiers）不作防护。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（防护）；复用 R39.4（目的取 so that／in order to），本条是 so 结果。
10 自检：①防护动作是什么？②切模属什么？③危险来自哪里？

**35. 答案：the doughnut（The passage is mainly about the inventors of the doughnut.）**
1 题面：框架 "The passage is mainly about the inventors of __________."；空位在 of 后，须为名词（物品）；全文讲 doughnut 的起源与多个"发明者"说法（Dutch olykoeks／Elizabeth Gregory／Captain Gregory／Doughnut Girls／machines）；诱导信号：文中人物多（Elizabeth／Captain／Doughnut Girls），容易被当答案。
2 候选：①the doughnut；②Captain Gregory；③the Doughnut Girls；④the doughnut machine。
3 验算：①→全文各段都在讲"谁发明了 doughnut／洞怎么来"，of 后取物品名→成立。②→只是其中一位"发明者"→排除。③→一战时期的服务者→排除。④→1920s 的机器，是最后一环→排除。
4 干扰：人物多、故事性强，容易把某个人当"主要对象"；题干的 of 结构也要求学生填"物"而非"人"。
5 意图：考"主旨补全式取上位物品（the doughnut），具体人物／机器是分支"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 the doughnut。若问 Who invented the first real doughnut according to some people? 答 Elizabeth Gregory（and her son made the hole）。
7 错误：A 填 Captain Gregory.（错因：分支人物）；B 填 the Doughnut Girls.（错因：分支）；C 填 the doughnut machine.（错因：末端分支）。
8 规则：R112.5 若补全式为 mainly about the inventors of ___，then 取上位物品（the doughnut）；文中出现的具体人物（Elizabeth／Captain／Doughnut Girls）与机器（1920s machine）都是分支，不作 of 的宾语。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（of 后名词）＋RA-3.1 主旨；复用 R41.2（主旨取上位），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①全文讲什么物品？②of 后能填人吗？③机器是哪段？

**组小结（G142 · 慧航第七套 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：特点双面 1（31）；替换物 1（32）；段落限定的做法 1（33）；防护做法 1（34）；主旨上位物品 1（35）。
- 规则：R112.1 特点取双面（31）；R112.2 replace with 取 B（32）；R112.3 段落限定取该段版本（33）；R112.4 防护取动作（34）；R112.5 主旨取上位物品（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R112.1 与"油炸动作在前"冲突，特点句优先；R112.2 与"Elizabeth 紧邻"冲突，with 后优先；R112.3 与"第 4 段更戏剧"冲突，段落限定优先；R112.4 与"切模方法具体"冲突，防护目的优先；R112.5 与"人物故事性强"冲突，上位物品优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：食物史说明文首见（多版本起源 + 时间线 1800s→一战→1920s）；本篇"Others say 版本 vs 段落限定"是 04 的版本冲突样本；数字（1800s／1920s／World War I）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第七套 · Passage 4

The world's rain-forests cover less than ten percent of the earth's surface, but contain over forty percent of all plant and animal species. The biggest rainforest is in South America, which is called the Amazon.

Amazon is by far the largest remaining rainforest area left on our planet. It's about 6 to 7 million square kilometers. It's about two-thirds of the size of the United States including Alaska. It's enormous. Sixty percent of it is in Brazil, but the rainforest also extends into Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador, Colombia, Venezuela, French Guiana and Surinam. And amazingly each year the Amazon provides twenty percent of the world's fresh water. Here you can find at least 60-70 thousand plant species and at least 3 thousand species of fresh water fish. And more monkeys than you find anywhere else on earth. In Brazil alone nine new species of monkeys have been identified over the last year.

But many of those species, known and unknown, are destroyed every day. Moreover, constant logging, mining and raising domestic animals cause a gradual disappearance of the Amazon jungles.

36. Over forty percent of all plant and animal species on the earth live in ______.

37. From the passage, we learn that the Amazon lies in ______.



38. How many new species of monkeys have been identified in Brazil alone over the last year?

____________________

39. The underlined word "constant" in Para.3 means ______.

40. According to the passage, what are the causes of the gradual disappearance of the Amazon jungles?

____________________

**〔G143〕慧航第七套 · Passage 4（36—40）十层研究**

**36. 答案：rain-forests（Over forty percent of all plant and animal species on the earth live in rain-forests.）**
1 题面：框架 "Over forty percent of all plant and animal species on the earth live in __________."；空位在 in 后，须为地点名词；原文 "The world's rain-forests cover less than ten percent of the earth's surface, but contain over forty percent of all plant and animal species."；诱导信号：同句 less than ten percent 与 over forty percent 成对照，容易把"地表比例"当地点。
2 候选：①rain-forests；②the earth's surface；③South America；④the Amazon。
3 验算：①→rain-forests…contain over forty percent of all plant and animal species，contain 与 live in 对应→成立。②→surface 是"覆盖"的对象，比例是 ten percent→排除。③④→South America／the Amazon 是"最大的雨林"所在地，属下一句的具体化，范围小于全部雨林→次优。
4 干扰：两个百分比（10%／40%）在同一句，容易张冠李戴；he Amazon 在下一句主题位置。
5 意图：考"40% 的主语取 rain-forests，10% 属 surface，具体雨林不作全体"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 rain-forests。若问 How much of the earth's surface do rain-forests cover? 答 Less than ten percent。
7 错误：A 填 the earth's surface.（错因：10% 项）；B 填 the Amazon.（错因：个体雨林）；C 填 South America.（错因：洲）。
8 规则：R113.1 若补全式空位在 live in 后且同句有"覆盖比例＋含有比例"两个百分数，then 取含有比例的主语（rain-forests）；覆盖比例的主语（the earth's surface）与个体雨林（the Amazon）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（介词宾语）＋RA-1.7 百分比；复用 R51.4（后置定语占位）的反向：本条是"百分比配对主语"。
10 自检：①40% 属谁？②10% 属谁？③the Amazon 范围够大吗？

**37. 答案：South America（We learn that the Amazon lies in South America.）**
1 题面：框架 "From the passage, we learn that the Amazon lies in __________."；空位在 in 后，须为地点（洲／国家）；原文 "The biggest rainforest is in South America, which is called the Amazon."＋"Sixty percent of it is in Brazil, but the rainforest also extends into Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador, Colombia, Venezuela, French Guiana and Surinam."；诱导信号：国家清单很长，Brazil 出现频率最高。
2 候选：①South America；②Brazil（＋七国）；③the United States；④Alaska。
3 验算：①→The biggest rainforest is in South America, which is called the Amazon，洲名与"lies in"对应→成立（可补"主要在 Brazil"）。②→Brazil 占 60%，但雨林还延伸到另外七国，单答一国不完整→次优。③→the United States 是"面积比较"对象（about two-thirds of the size of the United States）→不成立。④→Alaska 是"包括阿拉斯加"的说明成分→排除。
4 干扰：Brazil 60% 的比例很醒目；the United States／Alaska 在"面积比较"句里，也像地点。
5 意图：考"lies in 取洲名（South America），单国与比较对象不作答案"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 South America。若问 Which country has the largest share of the Amazon? 答 Brazil（sixty percent）。
7 错误：A 填 Brazil.（错因：只一国）；B 填 the United States.（错因：面积比较）；C 填 Alaska.（错因：说明成分）。
8 规则：R113.2 若补全式问 the Amazon lies in ___，then 取洲名（South America）；Brazil（60%）与其余七国是具体分布，比较对象（the United States／Alaska）不作地点。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（介词宾语）＋RA-1.16 地点层级；复用 R26.1（取小镇＋国家），本条是"洲 vs 国"。
10 自检：①洲名在哪句？②Brazil 占多少？③美国为什么要提？

**38. 答案：Nine.**
1 题面：How many new species of monkeys have been identified in Brazil alone over the last year；原文 "In Brazil alone nine new species of monkeys have been identified over the last year."；疑问词 How many（问数量）；诱导信号：本段数字密集（60%／20%／60-70 thousand／3 thousand／9）。
2 候选：①nine；②three thousand（fish species）；③60-70 thousand（plant species）；④sixty percent（Brazil 占比）。
3 验算：①→nine new species of monkeys，数量与"monkeys"同句且限定 Brazil alone／last year→成立。②→3 thousand 修饰 fresh water fish→排除。③→60-70 thousand 修饰 plant species→排除。④→60% 是 Brazil 占雨林的比例→排除。
4 干扰：四个数字都在同一段、句式相似（at least…species）；题干三个限定（Brazil alone／last year／monkeys）是筛子。
5 意图：考"数字按名词中心＋限定配对（monkeys→nine）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Nine。若问 How many plant species can be found in the Amazon? 答 At least 60-70 thousand。
7 错误：A 答 Three thousand.（错因：fish）；B 答 60-70 thousand.（错因：plants）；C 答 Sixty percent.（错因：面积占比）。
8 规则：R113.3 若问 How many＋名词，then 按名词中心配对数字（monkeys→nine），并核对限定（Brazil alone／over the last year）；同段其他数字（fish／plants／percentage）按名词排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（名词配对）；复用 R53.3（按名配对），本条是三限定。
10 自检：①nine 修饰什么？②3 thousand 是什么？③题干有三个限定吗？

**39. 答案：continuous（It means "continuous" or "ongoing". 持续不断的）**
1 题面：框架 "The underlined word "constant" in Para.3 means __________."；第 3 段原文 "Moreover, constant logging, mining and raising domestic animals cause a gradual disappearance of the Amazon jungles."；原卷该词有下划线；疑问词 means（词义题）；诱导信号：constant 的常见义"不变的、恒定的"。
2 候选：①continuous／ongoing；②unchanging（恒定的）；③rare；④small。
3 验算：①→constant logging, mining and raising…cause a gradual disappearance，与 gradual（逐渐）对立，指"不停地进行"→成立。②→unchanging 与"砍伐、采矿"搭配不自然（活动不是"不变的"）→次优。③→rare 与 cause disappearance 矛盾→排除。④→small 与"导致逐渐消失"力度不符→排除。
4 干扰：constant 的词典首义"不变的"最省事；gradual 与 constant 一个"渐"一个"恒"，容易混。
5 意图：考"形容词按搭配（constant logging/mining）取'持续不断的'，不取'恒定的'"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 continuous（或 ongoing）。若问 What does "gradual" mean here? 答 Happening slowly over time。
7 错误：A 答 Unchanging.（错因：词典义）；B 答 Rare.（错因：反义）；C 答 Occasional.（错因：与持续相反）。
8 规则：R113.4 若划线形容词修饰"活动名词"（logging／mining），then 取"持续不断的"（continuous／ongoing），不取"恒定不变的"（unchanging）；反义（rare／occasional）排除。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（形容词按搭配）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：搭配（constant＋活动名词）→对立词（gradual）→语域（环境破坏）→词面义。
10 自检：①constant 修饰什么？②与哪个词对立？③"不变的"搭配自然吗？

**40. 答案：Logging, mining and raising domestic animals.**
1 题面：According to the passage, what are the causes of the gradual disappearance of the Amazon jungles；原文 "Moreover, constant logging, mining and raising domestic animals cause a gradual disappearance of the Amazon jungles."；疑问词 what are the causes（问原因，复数）；诱导信号：前句 But many of those species…are destroyed every day 也是破坏，但没给原因。
2 候选：①logging／mining／raising domestic animals；②species being destroyed（结果）；③the rainforest extending into 8 countries（分布）；④climate change（常识补入）。
3 验算：①→constant logging, mining and raising domestic animals cause a gradual disappearance，cause 的主语三项→成立（三项都写）。②→是结果（are destroyed）→排除。③→分布事实→排除。④→原文未提 climate change→排除（常识不作答案）。
4 干扰：前句 species are destroyed every day 与 cause disappearance 语义近，容易把"物种被毁"当原因；常识（气候变暖）也像原因。
5 意图：考"cause 的主语取三项并列，结果句与常识不作原因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Logging, mining and raising domestic animals。若问 What is the biggest rainforest called? 答 The Amazon（in South America）。
7 错误：A 答 Species are destroyed.（错因：结果）；B 答 Climate change.（错因：常识补入）；C 答 Logging only.（错因：漏两项）。
8 规则：R113.5 若问 what are the causes of X，then 取 cause 的主语并列三项（logging／mining／raising domestic animals），三项都写；结果句（species destroyed）与原文未提的常识（climate change）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（并列取全）；复用 R70.2（两原因取全），本条是三项。
10 自检：①cause 的主语有哪三项？②species destroyed 是原因吗？③climate change 原文有吗？

**组小结（G143 · 慧航第七套 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：百分比配对主语 1（36）；洲 vs 国 1（37）；数字名词配对 1（38）；形容词按搭配 1（39）；三项原因 1（40）。
- 规则：R113.1 40% 属 rain-forests（36）；R113.2 lies in 取洲名（37）；R113.3 数字按名词配对（38）；R113.4 constant＝持续不断（39）；R113.5 causes 取三项（40）。
- 冲突与优先级：R113.1 与"10% 同句"冲突，含有比例优先；R113.2 与"Brazil 60%"冲突，洲名优先；R113.3 与"四数字同段"冲突，名词＋三限定优先；R113.4 与"词典首义"冲突，搭配优先；R113.5 与"结果句近义"冲突，cause 主语优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：环保说明文（第 3 篇，G64／G57 之后）；本篇百分比最密（10%／40%／60%／20%）但**无一题需运算**；**第七套 4 篇至此完成（G140—G143）**；数字（6-7 million／2/3／60-70 thousand／3 thousand／9）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第三套(1) · Section A

**Direction:** *In this section, some sentences have been removed. For Questions 21-25, choose the most suitable one from the list A-G to fit into each of the numbered blanks. There are two extra choices, which do not fit into any of the blanks. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET.*



Fitness Magazine recently ran an article titled "Five Reasons to Thank Your Workout Partner." One reason was: "You'll actually show up if you know someone is waiting for you at the gym, " while another read: " __21__ " With a workout partner, you will increase your training effort as there is a subtle (微妙) competition. So, how do you find a workout partner?

First of all, decide what you want from that person. __22__ Or do you just want to be physically fit, able to move with strength and flexibility? Think about the exercises you would like to do with your workout partner.

You might think about posting what you are looking for on social media, but it probably won't result in a useful response. __23__ If you plan on working out in a gym, that person must belong to the same gym.

My partner posted her request on the notice board of a local park. Her notice included what kind of training she wanted to do, how many days a week and how many hours she wanted to spend on each session, and her age. It also listed her favorite sports and activities, and provided her phone number. __24__

You and your partner will probably have different skills. __25__ Over time, both of you will benefit — your partner will be able to lift more weights and you will become more physically fit. The core (核心) of your relationship is that you will always be there to help each other.

A. Your first meeting may be a little awkward.
B. A workout partner usually needs to live close by.
C. You'll work harder if you train with someone else.
D. Do you want to be a better athlete in your favorite sport?
E. How can you write a good "seeking training partner" notice?
F. Just accept your differences and learn to work with each other.
G. Any notice for a training partner should include such information.

### 第九套 · Section A

**Directions:** *There are 4 passages in this section. After each passage there are 5 questions. Please read the passage and write down the answer to each question with proper words.*

### 第九套 · Passage 1

**Notice of Baggage Inspection (检查)**

In order to ensure your safety and that of other passengers, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) is legally obligated to inspect all checked baggage. As part of this process, certain bags are selected for inspection



and may be opened and examined. Your bag happened to be one of those selected for inspection.

During the inspection, your bag and its contents may have been searched for prohibited (违禁的) items. Once the inspection was completed, the contents were returned to your bag.

In situations where the TSA officer encountered a locked bag that could not be opened for inspection, they might have been compelled to break the locks. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by this action. However, please note that TSA cannot assume responsibility for any damage to your locks resulting from this necessary security measure.

To ensure a hassle-free trip and secure your baggage during future travels, we highly recommend visiting the www.tsa.gov website for useful packing tips and suggestions.

We greatly appreciate your understanding and cooperation. If you have any questions, comments, or concerns, please feel free to reach out to the TSA Contact Center for further assistance.

16. ______________________________________ is required to inspect your baggage by law.

17. What do TSA officers do during the inspection?

____________________________________________________________________________

18. If your bag is locked, the TSA officer may have to ______________________________________.

19. According to the passage, the damage to your locks will be considered as a ______.

20. Where can passengers find useful packing tips and suggestions?

____________________________________________________________________________

**〔G144〕慧航第九套 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

> 本篇是**机场安检通知**（Notice of Baggage Inspection），属应用文第 5 例（通知体首例）；五题中 16／18／19 为补全式，17／20 为完整问句。

**16. 答案：The Transportation Security Administration (TSA)（…is required to inspect your baggage by law.）**
1 题面：框架 "__________ is required to inspect your baggage by law."；空位在句首作主语，须为机构名；原文 "In order to ensure your safety and that of other passengers, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) is legally obligated to inspect all checked baggage."；诱导信号：同段还有 certain bags are selected for inspection，像"主语"。
2 候选：①the Transportation Security Administration (TSA)；②certain bags；③the TSA officer；④other passengers。
3 验算：①→the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) is legally obligated to inspect all checked baggage，legally obligated 与题干 by law／is required 对应→成立（机构名可简写 TSA）。②→certain bags 是被检查对象→排除。③→officer 是执行人，不是"被法律要求"的机构→次优。④→passengers 是受益者→排除。
4 干扰：TSA officer 在第三段反复出现，像主语；certain bags 紧挨 inspection。
5 意图：考"主语取 legally obligated 的机构名（TSA），执行人（officer）不作机构"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The TSA 即可（全称亦可）。若问 Why does TSA inspect baggage? 答 To ensure passengers' safety。
7 错误：A 填 A TSA officer.（错因：执行人）；B 填 Certain bags.（错因：对象）；C 填 The airport.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R114.1 若补全式空位在句首作主语且原文有机构名＋is legally obligated to do，then 取该机构（the TSA），首字母大写；执行人（officer）与被检查对象（bags）不作主语。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（主语位）＋RA-1.3 人物／机构；复用 R51.2（主语位取名词），本条是机构。
10 自检：①legally obligated 的主语是谁？②officer 是什么角色？③我写了小写 tsa 吗？

**17. 答案：They search your bag and its contents for prohibited items (and return the contents to your bag after the inspection).**
1 题面：What do TSA officers do during the inspection；原文 "During the inspection, your bag and its contents may have been searched for prohibited (违禁的) items. Once the inspection was completed, the contents were returned to your bag."；疑问词 What do officers do（问动作）；诱导信号：第三段的 break the locks 是特殊情况，不是常规动作。
2 候选：①search the bag and contents for prohibited items（＋return the contents）；②break the locks（特殊情况）；③select bags for inspection（选择环节）；④apologize for inconvenience。
3 验算：①→may have been searched for prohibited items＋contents were returned，常规动作两步→成立（写"检查违禁品"即可）。②→locked bag 的特殊处理，非"during the inspection"的常规→次优。③→selection 发生在 inspection 之前→排除。④→道歉是通知的礼貌语→排除。
4 干扰：break the locks 情节具体、易记；select bags 也在前文。
5 意图：考"常规动作取 searched for prohibited items，特殊情况（break locks）不作通例"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 They search the bag and its contents for prohibited items。若问 What happens to the contents after the inspection? 答 They are returned to your bag。
7 错误：A 答 They break the locks.（错因：特殊情况）；B 答 They select bags.（错因：前一环节）；C 答 They keep the contents.（错因：与 returned 相反）。
8 规则：R114.2 若问 What do officers do during X，then 取该环节的常规动作（search for prohibited items＋return the contents）；特殊情况（locked bag→break the locks）与前置环节（select bags）不作通例。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（常规 vs 特殊）；复用 R63.2（other 排除本体）的反向：本条是"特殊不作通例"。
10 自检：①常规动作是什么？②break locks 何时发生？③contents 最后怎样？

**18. 答案：break the locks（If your bag is locked, the TSA officer may have to break the locks.）**
1 题面：框架 "If your bag is locked, the TSA officer may have to __________."；空位在 have to 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "In situations where the TSA officer encountered a locked bag that could not be opened for inspection, they might have been compelled to break the locks."；诱导信号：后句 apologize for any inconvenience 是态度，不是动作。
2 候选：①break the locks；②open the bag（尝试动作）；③search the contents；④return the bag。
3 验算：①→compelled to break the locks，have to 与 compelled to 对应→成立。②→open 是目的（could not be opened），未成功才破锁→次优。③→search 是常规、非锁住时特有→排除。④→return 是检查后→排除。
4 干扰：could not be opened 就在前面，open 像答案；apologize 的情感色彩也强。
5 意图：考"have to 后取被迫动作（break the locks），目的（open）不作答案"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 break the locks。若问 Who pays for the damage to the locks? 答 Nobody — TSA cannot assume responsibility（the passenger bears it）。
7 错误：A 填 open the bag.（错因：目的未达成）；B 填 to break the locks.（错因：have to 后不加 to）；C 填 return the bag.（错因：检查后动作）。
8 规则：R114.3 若补全式为 may have to ___，then 取被迫动作原形（break the locks），不加 to；同句目的（open）与后续动作（return）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（have to＋原形）；复用 R59.2，本条是 have to。
10 自检：①have to 后要什么形式？②open 是目的吗？③谁赔锁？

**19. 答案：necessary security measure（…will be considered as a necessary security measure.）**
1 题面：框架 "According to the passage, the damage to your locks will be considered as a ______."；空位在 a 后，须为单数名词短语；原文 "TSA cannot assume responsibility for any damage to your locks resulting from this necessary security measure."；诱导信号：同句 apologize for any inconvenience 也像"定性"。
2 候选：①necessary security measure；②inconvenience；③mistake；④crime。
3 验算：①→resulting from this necessary security measure，this 回指破锁行为→成立。②→inconvenience 是道歉的对象，不是损坏的定性→次优。③→mistake 与"必要措施"相反→排除。④→crime 与"法律授权"相反→排除。
4 干扰：inconvenience 与 apologize 相邻，最像"定性"；cannot assume responsibility 的否定也容易让人答"TSA 的责任"。
5 意图：考"定性取 this necessary security measure，道歉语不作定性"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 a necessary security measure。若问 Will TSA pay for the damage? 答 No — TSA cannot assume responsibility for it。
7 错误：A 填 an inconvenience.（错因：道歉对象）；B 填 TSA's responsibility.（错因：与 cannot 相反）；C 填 a mistake.（错因：相反）。
8 规则：R114.4 若补全式为 will be considered as a ___，then 取 this 回指的同位语（a necessary security measure）；道歉语（inconvenience）与责任归属（responsibility）不作定性。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（单数名词）＋RA-2.1 回指；复用 R65.3（回指取旧物），本条是 this 回指行为。
10 自检：①this 指什么？②inconvenience 是什么？③TSA 赔吗？

**20. 答案：At the www.tsa.gov website.**
1 题面：Where can passengers find useful packing tips and suggestions；原文 "we highly recommend visiting the www.tsa.gov website for useful packing tips and suggestions."；疑问词 Where（问渠道）；诱导信号：同段还有 the TSA Contact Center，用于 questions／comments／concerns。
2 候选：①at the www.tsa.gov website；②at the TSA Contact Center；③at the airport；④in the notice。
3 验算：①→visiting the www.tsa.gov website for useful packing tips and suggestions，for 后即内容→成立。②→Contact Center 用于 questions／comments／concerns，不是 packing tips→不成立。③→airport 原文未提→排除。④→notice 是载体→排除。
4 干扰：TSA Contact Center 与 website 在同一段、都以"联系渠道"出现；两个网址／机构名相似。
5 意图：考"Where 取 for＋用途对应的渠道（website），Contact Center 按用途排除"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 At the www.tsa.gov website。若问 Where can passengers ask questions? 答 At the TSA Contact Center。
7 错误：A 答 At the TSA Contact Center.（错因：用途不符）；B 答 At the airport.（错因：无据）；C 答 In the letter.（错因：载体）。
8 规则：R114.5 若问 Where can sb find X，then 取 for＋X 对应的渠道（the www.tsa.gov website）；同段的另一渠道（Contact Center）按用途（questions／concerns）排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点／渠道（按用途配对）；复用 R41.4（按名配对），本条是"渠道—用途"。
10 自检：①for 后是什么？②Contact Center 管什么？③网址抄对了吗？

**组小结（G144 · 慧航第九套 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：机构主语 1（16）；常规动作 vs 特殊 1（17）；have to 后原形 1（18）；this 回指定性 1（19）；渠道按用途 1（20）。
- 规则：R114.1 机构主语（16）；R114.2 常规不作特殊（17）；R114.3 have to＋原形（18）；R114.4 this 回指同位语（19）；R114.5 渠道按用途（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R114.1 与"officer 反复出现"冲突，机构优先；R114.2 与"break locks 具体"冲突，常规优先；R114.3 与"open 紧邻"冲突，被迫动作优先；R114.4 与"inconvenience 相邻"冲突，this 回指优先；R114.5 与"Contact Center 同段"冲突，用途配对优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**通知体应用文首见（第 5 例应用文）**；本篇"常规 vs 特殊""渠道 vs 用途"两组配对是 04 的样本；数字无，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第九套 · Passage 2

**Things You Should Know about Your Library Card**

**Library cards**

— Cards are free to all library users. Cards are renewed annually.

— Your library card enables you to register at other public libraries in the city.

**Responsibility**

— Users are responsible for returning all materials borrowed on their card by the date due (到期的) and for any charges on items that are overdue, lost or damaged.

— Please report your lost card immediately. Items borrowed on the card are still your responsibility.

— Charges for lost or damaged materials are based on the cost and the handling fees.



**Renewals (续借)**

— Most items can be renewed twice unless someone has requested them.

— There are no renewals on DVDs, videos, or CD-ROMs.

**Fines**

— Borrowing is free if materials are returned by the date due. If your material are returned late, fines (罚款) are charged:

— 30 cents per day for most adult items

— 10 cents per day for most junior materials

— $1 per day for adult DVDs

— 50 cents for junior DVDs

21. According to the passage, the library card can be registered at ______________________.

22. Users are required to pay charges on items that are ______________________________.

23. What are charges for lost or damaged materials based on?

____________________________________________________________________________

24. According to the passage, how many times can you renew most of the items?

____________________________________________________________________________

25. If you don't return the junior materials by the date due, how much will you be charged?

____________________________________________________________________________

**〔G145〕慧航第九套 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

> 本篇是**图书馆读者须知**（分栏条目式），属应用文第 6 例（说明型通知）；五题中 21／22 为补全式，23／24／25 为完整问句。

**21. 答案：other public libraries in the city（…the library card can be registered at other public libraries in the city.）**
1 题面：框架 "According to the passage, the library card can be registered at __________."；空位在 at 后，须为地点名词；原文 "Your library card enables you to register at other public libraries in the city."；诱导信号：上一行 Cards are free to all library users 讲费用，不在 at 后。
2 候选：①other public libraries in the city；②all library users（人）；③the city（范围）；④the library's website。
3 验算：①→register at other public libraries in the city，at 后即地点→成立。②→users 是人，不能作 register at 的宾语→排除。③→the city 太大，且原文限定 other public libraries→次优。④→website 原文未提（另一篇 G141 有）→排除。
4 干扰：the city 与 other public libraries 同句；free to all library users 也像"注册对象"。
5 意图：考"at 后取地点短语（other public libraries in the city），人／范围不作地点"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 other public libraries in the city。若问 How much does a library card cost? 答 Nothing — cards are free。
7 错误：A 填 all library users.（错因：人）；B 填 the city.（错因：范围过大）；C 填 the website.（错因：串篇）。
8 规则：R115.1 若补全式空位在 at 后，then 取地点短语（other public libraries in the city），保留限定 other；人（users）与范围（the city）不作地点。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（介词宾语）；复用 R6.1（介词后取宾语），本条是地点。
10 自检：①at 后是什么？②other 丢了吗？③users 能作地点吗？

**22. 答案：overdue, lost or damaged（Users are required to pay charges on items that are overdue, lost or damaged.）**
1 题面：框架 "Users are required to pay charges on items that are __________."；空位在 are 后（表语），须为形容词并列；原文 "Users are responsible for returning all materials borrowed on their card by the date due and for any charges on items that are overdue, lost or damaged."；诱导信号：by the date due 是时间条件，不是"收费对象的状态"。
2 候选：①overdue, lost or damaged；②borrowed on their card（定语）；③by the date due（时间）；④free。
3 验算：①→charges on items that are overdue, lost or damaged，三个形容词并列→成立（三项都写）。②→borrowed on their card 修饰 materials，不是 charges 的条件→次优。③→by the date due 是"免费归还"的期限→排除。④→free 与 charges 相反→排除。
4 干扰：by the date due 与 overdue 语义相关，容易混作"到期"；borrowed on their card 紧挨 items。
5 意图：考"表语取三个并列形容词（overdue／lost／damaged），时间与定语不作状态"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 overdue, lost or damaged。若问 When is borrowing free? 答 If materials are returned by the date due。
7 错误：A 填 borrowed on their card.（错因：定语）；B 填 by the date due.（错因：时间）；C 填 late only.（错因：漏两项）。
8 规则：R115.2 若补全式空位在 items that are 后，then 取三个并列形容词（overdue／lost／damaged），三项都写；定语（borrowed on their card）与时间短语（by the date due）不作状态。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（表语形容词）；复用 R51.1（表语位），本条是三并列。
10 自检：①that are 后有几项？②by the date due 是什么？③我漏项了吗？

**23. 答案：The cost and the handling fees.**
1 题面：What are charges for lost or damaged materials based on；原文 "Charges for lost or damaged materials are based on the cost and the handling fees."；疑问词 What are charges based on（问依据）；诱导信号：同栏还有 Please report your lost card immediately，属另一条责任。
2 候选：①the cost and the handling fees；②the date due；③the card itself；④30 cents per day。
3 验算：①→are based on the cost and the handling fees，based on 后两项→成立（两项都写）。②→date due 是归还期限→排除。③→card 是凭证→排除。④→30 cents 是逾期罚款（adult items），不是丢损赔偿依据→排除。
4 干扰：Fines 一栏四个费率很醒目，容易被当"丢损依据"；lost card 的责任条目也含 lost。
5 意图：考"based on 取两项（cost＋handling fees），逾期费率不作丢损依据"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The cost and the handling fees。若问 What should you do if you lose your card? 答 Report it immediately。
7 错误：A 答 30 cents per day.（错因：逾期费率）；B 答 The date due.（错因：期限）；C 答 The card.（错因：凭证）。
8 规则：R115.3 若问 What are charges based on，then 取 based on 后的两项（the cost＋the handling fees）；同栏的逾期费率（30 cents）与归还期限（date due）不作丢损依据。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.17 介词宾语（based on）；复用 R6.1，本条是两项并列。
10 自检：①based on 后有几项？②30 cents 属什么？③丢卡该做什么？

**24. 答案：Twice.**
1 题面：According to the passage, how many times can you renew most of the items；原文 "Most items can be renewed twice unless someone has requested them."＋"There are no renewals on DVDs, videos, or CD-ROMs."；疑问词 How many times（问次数）；诱导信号：下一行 no renewals on DVDs 是例外，容易与"多数"混。
2 候选：①twice；②once；③three times；④none。
3 验算：①→Most items can be renewed twice，次数直接给出→成立。②→once 与 twice 不符→排除。③→three times 无据→排除。④→none 指 DVDs 等例外，不是"多数"→不成立。
4 干扰：no renewals on DVDs 紧接其后，容易被当"都不能续借"；unless someone has requested them 的条件也易混。
5 意图：考"多数取 twice，例外（DVDs）不作通例"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Twice。若问 Can you renew a DVD? 答 No — there are no renewals on DVDs, videos or CD-ROMs。
7 错误：A 答 None.（错因：例外当通例）；B 答 Once.（错因：数字错）；C 答 Three times.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R115.4 若问 how many times can you renew most items，then 取 twice；下一行的例外（no renewals on DVDs／videos／CD-ROMs）只说明例外，不覆盖"most"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（通例 vs 例外）；复用 R63.2（other 减本体）的反向：本条是"例外不覆盖通例"。
10 自检：①twice 修饰谁？②DVDs 的规则是什么？③unless 句说明什么？

**25. 答案：Ten cents per day（10 cents per day）.**
1 题面：If you don't return the junior materials by the date due, how much will you be charged；原文 Fines 栏三项并列："30 cents per day for most adult items"／"10 cents per day for most junior materials"／"$1 per day for adult DVDs"／"50 cents for junior DVDs"；疑问词 how much（问费率）；诱导信号：四个费率并列，且 junior materials 与 junior DVDs 只差一个词。
2 候选：①10 cents per day；②30 cents per day；③$1 per day；④50 cents。
3 验算：①→10 cents per day for most junior materials，与题干 junior materials 逐字对应→成立。②→30 cents 是 adult items→排除。③→$1 是 adult DVDs→排除。④→50 cents 是 junior DVDs（缺少 per day）→次优（类别与计费方式都不符）。
4 干扰：junior DVDs 与 junior materials 只差一词；50 cents 也是 junior 类，最易混。
5 意图：考"费率按类别四档配对，junior materials≠junior DVDs"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 10 cents per day。若问 How much for adult DVDs? 答 $1 per day。若问 How much for junior DVDs? 答 50 cents（once, not per day）。
7 错误：A 答 30 cents per day.（错因：adult）；B 答 50 cents.（错因：junior DVDs）；C 答 $1 per day.（错因：adult DVDs）。
8 规则：R115.5 若问某类资料的逾期费，then 按类别四档配对（adult items 30¢／junior materials 10¢／adult DVDs $1／junior DVDs 50¢）；junior materials 与 junior DVDs 不可混，per day 的计费方式也不可丢。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（费率分类配对）；复用 R53.3（按名配对），本条是四档费率。
10 自检：①题干是哪一类？②junior DVDs 多少钱？③per day 写了吗？

**组小结（G145 · 慧航第九套 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：at 后地点 1（21）；三并列表语 1（22）；based on 两项 1（23）；通例 vs 例外 1（24）；四档费率配对 1（25）。
- 规则：R115.1 at 后取地点（21）；R115.2 三并列形容词（22）；R115.3 based on 两项（23）；R115.4 通例不取例外（24）；R115.5 费率按类别配（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R115.1 与"the city 同句"冲突，限定 other 优先；R115.2 与"borrowed 定语"冲突，表语优先；R115.3 与"30 cents 醒目"冲突，based on 优先；R115.4 与"no renewals 紧接"冲突，most 优先；R115.5 与"junior DVDs 近形"冲突，类别全称优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**读者须知／条目式应用文（第 6 例）**；本篇"四档费率"是小蓝书之外少见的"分类查表"型数字题，但**仍不需运算**（只按类别取一档）；数字（30¢／10¢／$1／50¢／twice）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第九套 · Passage 3

People in the United States love their dogs and treat them well. They frequently use various expressions incorporating the word "dog". Here are some examples: Some people say we live in a "dog-eat-dog world", indicating that we exist in a highly competitive environment and a great number of individuals are struggling for the same resources or opportunities. They also say that a person has to "work like a dog" if he wants to succeed, so "work like a dog" here means "work very hard". Besides, people say "Every dog has its day."
