This implies that everyone will experience a phase of achievement or prosperity throughout their lifetime. If a man tells you that he is "in the doghouse", he might have been punished by his wife. However, the husband may decide that it is best to leave things alone and not to cause more trouble. He might decide to "let sleeping dogs lie".



Dog expressions are also used to describe the weather. "The dog days of summer" refers to the hottest days of the year. A rainstorm may cool the weather, but to "rain cats and dogs" is not what we want.

26. There are many expressions with word "dog" in America probably because ______.

27. Which phrase indicates many people are competing for the same thing?

____________________________________________________________________________

28. The expression "work like a dog" means ______________________________________.

29. When you say everyone enjoys a successful period during his or her life, you would say ______.

30. "The dog days of summer" and "rain cats and dogs" are used to describe ______.

**〔G146〕慧航第九套 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

> 本篇为**习语释义型说明文**，五题**全部是补全式**（框架已给），考"英文习语→中文释义／英英解释"的双向转换。

**26. 答案：they love their dogs and treat them well（…probably because they love their dogs and treat them well.）**
1 题面：框架 "There are many expressions with word "dog" in America probably because __________."；空位在 because 后，须为从句（主语＋谓语）；原文 "People in the United States love their dogs and treat them well. They frequently use various expressions incorporating the word "dog"."；诱导信号：下一句 Here are some examples 是举例，不是原因。
2 候选：①they love their dogs and treat them well；②they use many expressions（循环）；③dogs are useful animals；④America is a big country。
3 验算：①→love their dogs and treat them well＋They frequently use various expressions，首句是因、次句是果→成立（两句都写最好）。②→用 many expressions 与"为什么有很多说法"循环→不成立。③→useful 原文未提→排除。④→国土大小无关→排除。
4 干扰：They frequently use various expressions 与题干"many expressions"字面重合，最容易被当原因（实为结果）。
5 意图：考"because 后取首句事实（love and treat well），同词复现的结果句不作原因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Because they love their dogs and treat them well。若问 Why do Americans use dog expressions? 答 Because dogs are loved and well treated（and the expressions are vivid）。
7 错误：A 填 they use many expressions.（错因：循环）；B 填 dogs are useful.（错因：无据）；C 填 America is big.（错因：无关）。
8 规则：R116.1 若补全式空位在 probably because 后，then 取首句的"态度事实"（love their dogs／treat them well），而"使用很多说法"是结果，与题干循环，不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（从句）＋RA-1.4 原因；复用 R57.3（起因取 because），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①首句说什么？②"use expressions"是原因吗？③要写从句吗？

**27. 答案："dog-eat-dog world"（A "dog-eat-dog world" indicates many people are competing for the same thing.）**
1 题面：Which phrase indicates many people are competing for the same thing；原文 "Some people say we live in a "dog-eat-dog world", indicating that we exist in a highly competitive environment and a great number of individuals are struggling for the same resources or opportunities."；疑问词 Which phrase（问习语）；诱导信号：同段还有 work like a dog／Every dog has its day／in the doghouse／let sleeping dogs lie。
2 候选：①"dog-eat-dog world"；②"work like a dog"；③"Every dog has its day"；④"let sleeping dogs lie"。
3 验算：①→indicating that we exist in a highly competitive environment＋struggling for the same resources，与题干 competing for the same thing 对应→成立（引号照抄）。②→means work very hard→排除。③→everyone will have a successful period→排除。④→leave things alone→排除。
4 干扰：五个习语排在同一段，只有 dog-eat-dog 讲"竞争"；work like a dog 也含努力，像"竞争"。
5 意图：考"习语按释义配对（competing→dog-eat-dog world），引号与连字符照抄"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 "dog-eat-dog world"（引号可省，连字符不可省）。若问 What does "in the doghouse" mean? 答 Being punished by one's wife（in trouble）。
7 错误：A 答 "work like a dog".（错因：努力≠竞争）；B 答 "Every dog has its day".（错因：成功期）；C 答 "dog world".（错因：漏 eat）。
8 规则：R116.2 若问 Which phrase indicates X，then 按释义配对习语（competing→"dog-eat-dog world"）；同段其他习语按各自释义排除；连字符与复数不丢。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（习语释义配对）；词义族停止扩类，本条按 RA-2 四步：引号内短语→后置 indicating 释义→语域（美国习语）→词面义。
10 自检：①哪个习语指"竞争"？②work like a dog 指什么？③连字符写了吗？

**28. 答案：work very hard（The expression "work like a dog" means work very hard.）**
1 题面：框架 "The expression "work like a dog" means __________."；空位在 means 后，须为动词短语；原文 "They also say that a person has to "work like a dog" if he wants to succeed, so "work like a dog" here means "work very hard"."；诱导信号：if he wants to succeed 是条件，不是释义。
2 候选：①work very hard；②succeed；③be treated badly；④work like an animal（字面）。
3 验算：①→so "work like a dog" here means "work very hard"，so 引出释义→成立。②→succeed 是目的→排除。③→be treated badly 是"像狗一样被对待"，与"努力工作"不同→次优。④→字面义与 means 后的引号释义冲突→排除。
4 干扰：字面"像狗一样"最直观；if he wants to succeed 也在同句。
5 意图：考"means 后取原文引号释义（work very hard），字面与条件不作释义"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 work very hard。若问 What does "Every dog has its day" mean? 答 Everyone will have a successful period。
7 错误：A 填 be treated badly.（错因：字面联想）；B 填 succeed.（错因：目的）；C 填 work like an animal.（错因：字面）。
8 规则：R116.3 若补全式为 X means ___，then 取原文 so…means 后引号内的释义（work very hard）；字面义（like an animal）与条件（if he wants to succeed）不作释义。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（动词短语）＋RA-2.4；复用 R44.1（术语取定义），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①means 后是什么？②字面义能用吗？③succeed 是释义吗？

**29. 答案："Every dog has its day."（You would say "Every dog has its day."）**
1 题面：框架 "When you say everyone enjoys a successful period during his or her life, you would say __________."；空位在 say 后，须为习语原句；原文 "Besides, people say "Every dog has its day." This implies that everyone will experience a phase of achievement or prosperity throughout their lifetime."；诱导信号：同段还有 in the doghouse／let sleeping dogs lie。
2 候选：①"Every dog has its day."；②"let sleeping dogs lie"；③"in the doghouse"；④"dog days of summer"。
3 验算：①→This implies that everyone will experience a phase of achievement or prosperity，与题干 successful period 对应→成立（引号照抄，句号可省）。②→leave things alone→排除。③→被妻子惩罚→排除。④→最热的日子（天气）→排除。
4 干扰：四个习语同段；"day" 与"period"也容易让人联想 dog days。
5 意图：考"习语反查（释义→习语），注意 dog days 是天气、不是人生成功期"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 "Every dog has its day"。若问 What does "in the doghouse" mean? 答 He might have been punished by his wife。
7 错误：A 答 "dog days".（错因：天气）；B 答 "let sleeping dogs lie".（错因：别惹事）；C 答 "in the doghouse".（错因：受罚）。
8 规则：R116.4 若题干给释义要求填习语，then 按释义反查（successful period→"Every dog has its day"）；同段的天气习语（dog days）与处境习语（in the doghouse／let sleeping dogs lie）按释义排除；引号与所有格 its 不丢。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（习语）＋RA-2.6 反向词义（释义→词）；复用 R60.4，本条是"释义→习语"。
10 自检：①哪个习语指"人人有出头日"？②its 写了吗？③dog days 指什么？

**30. 答案：the weather（"The dog days of summer" and "rain cats and dogs" are used to describe the weather.）**
1 题面：框架 ""The dog days of summer" and "rain cats and dogs" are used to describe __________."；空位在 describe 后，须为名词；原文 "Dog expressions are also used to describe the weather. "The dog days of summer" refers to the hottest days of the year. A rainstorm may cool the weather, but to "rain cats and dogs" is not what we want."；诱导信号：两个习语一个讲热、一个讲雨，容易被答成"夏天／雨"。
2 候选：①the weather；②summer；③rain；④dogs。
3 验算：①→Dog expressions are also used to describe the weather，两句都是其例证→成立。②③→分别只是两个习语各自的义域，不能概括二者→次优。④→dogs 是词源，不是描述对象→排除。
4 干扰：hottest days／rainstorm 都很具体，容易取代上位词 weather。
5 意图：考"两个习语的上位对象取 weather（段首主题句），个别词义不作概括"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 the weather。若问 What does "rain cats and dogs" mean? 答 Rain very heavily。
7 错误：A 填 summer.（错因：只一个习语）；B 填 rain.（错因：只一个习语）；C 填 dogs.（错因：词源）。
8 规则：R116.5 若题干并列两个习语问 describe 什么，then 取段首主题句的上位词（the weather）；单个习语的义域（summer／rain）只覆盖其一，不作概括。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词）＋RA-3.2 段意；复用 R41.2（主旨取上位），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①段首主题句是什么？②两个习语各指什么？③weather 是上位吗？

**组小结（G146 · 慧航第九套 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：原因从句 1（26）；习语按释义配对 1（27）；means 取引号释义 1（28）；释义反查习语 1（29）；上位词概括 1（30）。**五题全为补全式**。
- 规则：R116.1 because 取态度事实（26）；R116.2 习语按释义配（27）；R116.3 means 取引号释义（28）；R116.4 释义反查（29）；R116.5 上位词概括（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R116.1 与"use expressions 字面重合"冲突，态度事实优先；R116.2 与"work like a dog 也含努力"冲突，竞争义优先；R116.3 与"字面像狗"冲突，引号释义优先；R116.4 与"dog days 也含 day"冲突，成功期优先；R116.5 与"summer／rain 具体"冲突，上位词优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**习语型说明文首见**（dog 习语七条）；本篇把"习语→释义"与"释义→习语"两个方向都考到（R116.2／R116.4），与 RA-2.6 反向词义呼应；数字无，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第九套 · Passage 4

It is a blow for the Ugly Bettys and Plain Janes—research shows that good looks lead to better pay. A study of 4,000 young men and women found that beauty boosted pay checks more than intelligence. Those judged to be the more attractive earned up to 10 percent more than their less attractive friends and colleagues. Applied to the average salary of £25,000 a year, the "plainness penalty (处罚)" would make a difference of £2,500 a year—or around £50 a week.

It is unclear what is behind the phenomenon but it may be that beauty creates confidence. The self-confident may appear to be doing better than they are and will not hesitate about asking for a pay rise.

Researcher Jason Fletcher, of Yale University in the U.S., rated the attractiveness of the 4,000 men and women. Just over half were judged average, while 7 percent were felt to be very attractive and 8 percent were judged unattractive or very unattractive. The volunteers also sat an IQ test and reported their salary. It became clear that pay scales were far from fair. For instance, a 14-point increase on the IQ score was associated with a 3 to 6 percent increase in wage. But being of above-average looks increased pay by 5 to 10 percent.

For a plain person to be paid the same as a very attractive one, they would have to be 40 percent brighter, the journal *Economics Letters* reports.

Dr Fletcher said: "The results do show that people's looks have an impact on their wages and it can be very important."

31. The meaning of "plainness penalty" is to be paid ______ for being ordinarily-looking.



32. The average annual salary of a person is ______________________________________.

33. Good-looking people are usually paid more probably because beauty creates ______.

34. How many people were rated as very attractive in Jason Fletcher's study?

____________________________________________________________________________

35. What is the main idea of this passage?

______________________________________________________ contribute to extra penny.

**〔G147〕慧航第九套 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

> **本组 Q34 是全稿第一处"百分比→人数"换算题**（4,000 人×7%＝280 人）；此前只有"年份加算"（R70.5）与"日期相减"（R106.3）。

**31. 答案：less（…to be paid less for being ordinarily-looking.）**
1 题面：框架 "The meaning of "plainness penalty" is to be paid __________ for being ordinarily-looking."；空位在 paid 后，须为副词／比较短语；原文 "Those judged to be the more attractive earned up to 10 percent more than their less attractive friends and colleagues. Applied to the average salary of £25,000 a year, the "plainness penalty" would make a difference of £2,500 a year—or around £50 a week."；诱导信号：10 percent more 是"好看者多拿"，题干问"普通长相者"，方向相反。
2 候选：①less（10 percent less／£2,500 less a year）；②more；③the same；④nothing。
3 验算：①→plainness penalty 与 more attractive earned…more 相对，指"少拿"→成立（可写 10 percent less 或 £2,500 less）。②→more 与 penalty 相反→排除。③→the same 与"差距 £2,500"矛盾→排除。④→nothing 与 penalty 矛盾→排除。
4 干扰：同段 10 percent more 与 £2,500 都是数字，方向极易搞反；penalty 一词的"处罚"义也可能被理解成"罚款"。
5 意图：考"penalty 的方向取'少拿'，且用对比项（more attractive→more）反推"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 less（或 10 percent less）。若问 How much more do attractive people earn? 答 Up to 10 percent more（about £2,500 a year）。
7 错误：A 填 more.（错因：方向反）；B 填 the same.（错因：与 difference 矛盾）；C 填 a fine.（错因：penalty 误作罚款）。
8 规则：R117.1 若问 X penalty 的含义且原文用 A earn more than B 的对比，then 取相反方向（less），可带具体幅度（10 percent less／£2,500 less）；不得照抄 more，也不把 penalty 译成"罚款"。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（比较副词）＋RA-1.29 对比取侧；复用 R13.2（对比取侧＋指代对号），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①对比两侧各是谁？②penalty 指多还是少？③我抄了 more 吗？

**32. 答案：£25,000（a year）（The average annual salary of a person is £25,000 a year.）**
1 题面：框架 "The average annual salary of a person is __________."；空位在 is 后，须为金额；原文 "Applied to the average salary of £25,000 a year, the "plainness penalty" would make a difference of £2,500 a year—or around £50 a week."；诱导信号：同句还有 £2,500 与 £50 两个金额。
2 候选：①£25,000 a year；②£2,500 a year；③£50 a week；④10 percent。
3 验算：①→the average salary of £25,000 a year，of 后即年薪→成立（保留 a year）。②→£2,500 是"差距"（difference）→排除。③→£50 是每周折算→排除。④→10 percent 是比例→排除。
4 干扰：三个金额同句，£2,500 紧跟 average salary 之后；£50 是"每周"折算值。
5 意图：考"金额按名词配对（average salary→£25,000；difference→£2,500；a week→£50）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 £25,000 a year。若问 How big is the plainness penalty? 答 £2,500 a year（around £50 a week）。
7 错误：A 填 £2,500.（错因：差距）；B 填 £50.（错因：周折算）；C 填 £25,000 a week.（错因：时间单位错）。
8 规则：R117.2 若补全式问 average annual salary，then 取 of 后的金额（£25,000 a year），保留 a year；difference（£2,500）与周折算（£50）按名词排除。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（金额）＋RA-1.7 数量；复用 R53.3（按名配对），本条是金额。
10 自检：①of 后是什么？②£2,500 是什么？③单位写了吗？

**33. 答案：confidence（Good-looking people are usually paid more probably because beauty creates confidence.）**
1 题面：框架 "Good-looking people are usually paid more probably because beauty creates __________."；空位在 creates 后，须为名词；原文 "It is unclear what is behind the phenomenon but it may be that beauty creates confidence. The self-confident may appear to be doing better than they are and will not hesitate about asking for a pay rise."；诱导信号：下文 self-confident／asking for a pay rise 是解释，不是 creates 的宾语。
2 候选：①confidence；②a pay rise；③intelligence；④a good job。
3 验算：①→beauty creates confidence，creates 后直接给出→成立（可补 self-confident 的解释）。②→pay rise 是自信者的行为结果→排除。③→intelligence 是研究中被"美貌胜过"的对照项→排除。④→a good job 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：intelligence 在首段与美貌对比（beauty boosted pay checks more than intelligence），像"原因"；pay rise 也在同段。
5 意图：考"creates 的宾语取 confidence，后文 self-confident 是解释；对照项 intelligence 不作原因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 confidence。若问 Why may confident people earn more? 答 They appear to be doing better and will not hesitate to ask for a pay rise。
7 错误：A 填 intelligence.（错因：对照项）；B 填 a pay rise.（错因：结果）；C 填 good looks.（错因：循环）。
8 规则：R117.3 若补全式空位在 creates 后，then 取直接宾语（confidence），并用后文（self-confident／ask for a pay rise）验证；对照项（intelligence）与结果（pay rise）不作宾语。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词）＋RA-1.4 原因；复用 R44.1（定义取表语），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①creates 后是什么？②intelligence 是什么角色？③pay rise 是原因吗？

**34. 答案：About 280 people（4,000 × 7% = 280）.**
1 题面：How many people were rated as very attractive in Jason Fletcher's study；原文 "Researcher Jason Fletcher… rated the attractiveness of the 4,000 men and women. Just over half were judged average, while 7 percent were felt to be very attractive and 8 percent were judged unattractive or very unattractive."；疑问词 How many people（问人数）；诱导信号：题干问"多少人"，原文只给"7 percent"与总人数 4,000。
2 候选：①about 280 people（4,000×7%）；②7 percent（只写比例）；③4,000（总人数）；④8 percent（unattractive）。
3 验算：①→4,000×7%＝280，与"多少人"对应→成立（须落笔算）。②→7 percent 是比例，未回答"多少人"→次优（严格说未答所问）。③→4,000 是被评总人数→排除。④→8 percent 是"不好看"组→排除。
4 干扰：原文只给百分数，学生容易直接抄 7 percent；"just over half were average"也容易被当答案。
5 意图：考"百分比→人数换算"，是全稿第一处此类题。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 About 280（people）。若问 What percentage were judged unattractive? 答 8 percent。若问 How many were judged average? 答 Just over half of 4,000（over 2,000）。
7 错误：A 答 7 percent.（错因：未换算）；B 答 4,000.（错因：总人数）；C 答 8 people.（错因：比例当人数）。
8 规则：R117.4 若问 How many people 而原文只给"百分数＋总人数"，then 用总人数×百分数（4,000×7%＝280），答案须为人数；只写百分比属未答所问（次优），不得把总人数或另一组百分比当答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（**百分比→人数换算，本稿首例**）；与 R70.5（年份加算）、R106.3（日期相减）合为"数字推算"三型。
10 自检：①总人数是多少？②百分比是多少？③我落笔算了吗？

**35. 答案：Good looks（beauty）（Good looks contribute to extra penny.）**
1 题面：框架 "______________________________________________________ contribute to extra penny."；空位在 contribute 前作主语，须为复数名词短语；原文首段 "research shows that good looks lead to better pay"＋"beauty boosted pay checks more than intelligence"；诱导信号：intelligence 也在首段，作对照。
2 候选：①good looks（beauty）；②intelligence；③confidence；④the research。
3 验算：①→good looks lead to better pay／beauty boosted pay checks，与 contribute to extra penny 对应→成立（用复数 good looks 与 contribute 一致）。②→intelligence 被"美貌胜过"，方向相反→排除。③→confidence 是中介机制（beauty creates confidence），不是"带来额外收入"的主语概括→次优。④→the research 是来源，不是原因→排除。
4 干扰：intelligence 与 beauty 并列出现，最易混；confidence 在第二段，也像"原因"。
5 意图：考"主旨补全取首段论断（good looks→better pay），机制（confidence）与对照项（intelligence）不作主语"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Good looks（或 Beauty）。若问 What is the mechanism behind the phenomenon? 答 Beauty creates confidence。
7 错误：A 填 Intelligence.（错因：对照项）；B 填 Confidence.（错因：机制）；C 填 The research.（错因：来源）。
8 规则：R117.5 若补全式为 ___ contribute to extra penny，then 取首段论断的主语（good looks／beauty），并保持复数与 contribute 一致；机制（confidence）与对照项（intelligence）不作主语。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（主语）＋RA-3.1 主旨；复用 R41.2（主旨取上位），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①首段论断的主语是什么？②confidence 是什么？③单复数与 contribute 一致吗？

**组小结（G147 · 慧航第九套 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：penalty 方向 1（31）；金额按名配对 1（32）；creates 宾语 1（33）；**百分比→人数换算 1（34）**；主旨主语 1（35）。
- 规则：R117.1 penalty＝less（31）；R117.2 金额按名配对（32）；R117.3 creates 取 confidence（33）；R117.4 百分比换算人数（34）；R117.5 主旨主语 good looks（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R117.1 与"10 percent more 同段"冲突，方向反转优先；R117.2 与"£2,500 紧邻"冲突，名词配对优先；R117.3 与"intelligence 并列"冲突，creates 宾语优先；R117.4 与"7 percent 可直接抄"冲突，换算优先；R117.5 与"confidence 在第二段"冲突，首段论断优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**百分比→人数换算首见（Q34＝280）**——推算由 2 例增至 3 例（年份加算／日期相减／百分比换算）；**百分比差值仍 0**（无两百分比相减）；图表仍 0；**第九套 4 篇至此完成（G144—G147）**。

### 第二套 · Section A

**Directions:** *There are 4 passages in this section. After each passage there are 5 questions. Please read the passage and write down the answer to each question with proper words.*

### 第二套 · Passage 1

Once upon a time, there was a rich elderly man who lived by himself in a large house. As he became increasingly unable to look after himself, he decided to employ a nurse to assist with the housework and his personal care.



One day, the old man interviewed two nurses-Tony and Frank. Tony happened to be a young and handsome man, while Frank looked quite ordinary. The old man asked Tony to make tea for him. After Tony left, the old man turned to Frank and said, "Tony has given me a very bad account of you. He said you are rude and untrustworthy. Is this correct?"

Frank thought for a minute and said, " If Tony has a bad opinion of me, there must be something wrong with me. I should take some time to change these things."

The old man was very impressed by Frank's character. Meanwhile, Tony returned with a cup of tea for the old man. The old man sent Frank to make breakfast for him. He then turned to Tony and told him, "Frank spoke very poorly of you while you were gone. What do you think about this?" After hearing this, Tony became angry and started cursing.

In the end, the old man hired Frank. Although Frank looked quite ordinary, he had impressive inner beauty.

16. The old man wanted a nurse to ____________________.

17. What did Tony look like?

____________________

18. Frank thought if Tony has a bad opinion of him, ____________________.

19. What was the old man impressed by?

____________________

20. According to the passage, what is more important than appearance?

____________________

**〔G148〕慧航第二套 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：assist with the housework and his personal care（The old man wanted a nurse to assist with the housework and his personal care.）**
1 题面：框架 "The old man wanted a nurse to __________."；空位在 to 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "As he became increasingly unable to look after himself, he decided to employ a nurse to assist with the housework and his personal care."；诱导信号：employ 与 wanted 都表"雇用"，后接 to do 才对。
2 候选：①assist with the housework and his personal care；②look after himself（老人做不到的事）；③make tea（后文情节）；④interview two nurses。
3 验算：①→employ a nurse to assist with the housework and his personal care，to 后两项并列→成立（两项都可写，写 assist 即可）。②→look after himself 是"他做不到"的，不能作护士的职责复述→次优。③→make tea 是面试中的一个测试→排除。④→interview 是老人自己的动作→排除。
4 干扰：look after himself 就在前一分句，像"目的"；make tea 情节有趣。
5 意图：考"to 后取护士职责（assist with…），前句的困难不作职责"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 assist with the housework and his personal care。若问 Why did the old man employ a nurse? 答 Because he became unable to look after himself。
7 错误：A 填 look after himself.（错因：困难当职责）；B 填 make tea.（错因：测试情节）；C 填 to assist with…（错因：to 后不加 to）。
8 规则：R118.1 若补全式空位在 wanted sb to 后，then 取原形动词短语（assist with the housework and his personal care），不加 to；前句的困难（unable to look after himself）与情节动作（make tea）不作职责。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（to＋原形）；复用 R111.1（can 后原形），本条是 to。
10 自检：①to 后要什么形式？②look after himself 属谁？③两项都写了吗？

**17. 答案：He was young and handsome.**
1 题面：What did Tony look like；原文 "Tony happened to be a young and handsome man, while Frank looked quite ordinary."；疑问词 What did sb look like（问外貌）；诱导信号：while 后 Frank looked quite ordinary 也在同一句。
2 候选：①young and handsome；②quite ordinary（Frank）；③rich；④tall。
3 验算：①→Tony happened to be a young and handsome man，两个形容词→成立（两个都写）。②→是 Frank 的外貌，while 表对比→不成立。③→rich 修饰 elderly man→排除。④→tall 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：while 结构把两人外貌并列，主从容易读反；ordinary 也是外貌词。
5 意图：考"look like 按主体取（Tony→young and handsome），while 后是他人"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Young and handsome。若问 What did Frank look like? 答 Quite ordinary。
7 错误：A 答 Quite ordinary.（错因：Frank）；B 答 Rich.（错因：老人）；C 答 Tall and strong.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R118.2 若问 What did sb look like 且原文用 while 对比两人外貌，then 按主体取（Tony→young and handsome），while 后的他人外貌不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.38 外形（主体配对）；复用 R74.2（主体配对），本条是外貌。
10 自检：①Tony 对应哪半句？②ordinary 是谁？③两个形容词都写了吗？

**18. 答案：there must be something wrong with him（…if Tony has a bad opinion of him, there must be something wrong with him.）**
1 题面：框架 "Frank thought if Tony has a bad opinion of him, __________."；空位在逗号后，须为完整从句；原文 "Frank thought for a minute and said, "If Tony has a bad opinion of me, there must be something wrong with me. I should take some time to change these things.""；诱导信号：I should take some time… 是后续行动，不是"if"的直接结论。
2 候选：①there must be something wrong with him；②he should change these things；③Tony is rude；④he should tell the old man。
3 验算：①→If Tony has a bad opinion of me, there must be something wrong with me，条件句＋主句→成立（写 there must be something wrong with him 即可）。②→I should take some time to change these things 是紧跟的下一步行动→次优。③→Tony is rude 是 Tony 对 Frank 的污蔑内容，不是 Frank 的想法→排除。④→原文无→排除。
4 干扰：change these things 语气更"积极"，容易被当结论；题干 if 从句与原文 if 从句几乎逐字一致，主句才是考点。
5 意图：考"if 从句后取主句（there must be something wrong with him），后续行动不作结论"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 There must be something wrong with him。若问 What did Frank decide to do? 答 To take some time to change these things。
7 错误：A 填 he should change these things.（错因：后续行动）；B 填 Tony is rude.（错因：他人评价）；C 填 he should leave.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R118.3 若补全式给出 If 从句，then 取原文同结构的主句（there must be something wrong with him）；紧随其后的行动句（change these things）不作结论；他人评价（Tony is rude）不作 Frank 的想法。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（从句）；复用 R51.5（because of 转 there be），本条是 if…there be。
10 自检：①主句是什么？②change these things 是什么？③rude 是谁说的？

**19. 答案：Frank's character（The old man was impressed by Frank's character.）**
1 题面：What was the old man impressed by；原文 "The old man was very impressed by Frank's character."；疑问词 What was sb impressed by（问对象）；诱导信号：上一段 Frank 的回答（if Tony has a bad opinion…）是原因，不是"被什么打动"的直接名词。
2 候选：①Frank's character；②Frank's answer（具体内容）；③Tony's cursing；④Frank's appearance。
3 验算：①→impressed by Frank's character，by 后直接给出→成立。②→answer 是 character 的表现→次优。③→cursing 是 Tony 的反应，令老人反感→排除。④→appearance 是 Frank 的短板（quite ordinary）→排除。
4 干扰：Frank 的回答内容（there must be something wrong with me）感染力强，容易被当答案；appearance 与 character 在结尾对照出现。
5 意图：考"impressed by 取抽象名词（character），具体回答是表现"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Frank's character。若问 Who did the old man hire? 答 Frank。若问 Why did he hire Frank? 答 Because of his impressive inner beauty。
7 错误：A 答 Frank's answer.（错因：表现）；B 答 His appearance.（错因：短板）；C 答 Tony's anger.（错因：相反）。
8 规则：R118.4 若问 What was sb impressed by，then 取 by 后的抽象名词（Frank's character）；具体表现（answer）与相反表现（cursing）不作对象；appearance 与 character 是文中对照，不可互换。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.17 介词宾语（impressed by）；复用 R6.1（介词后取宾语），本条是抽象名词。
10 自检：①by 后是什么？②answer 属什么？③appearance 是谁的？

**20. 答案：Inner beauty（According to the passage, inner beauty is more important than appearance.）**
1 题面：According to the passage, what is more important than appearance；原文 "In the end, the old man hired Frank. Although Frank looked quite ordinary, he had impressive inner beauty."；疑问词 what is more important（问主旨性判断）；诱导信号：末句 Although…he had impressive inner beauty 是转折结构。
2 候选：①inner beauty；②appearance；③age；④money。
3 验算：①→Although Frank looked quite ordinary, he had impressive inner beauty，让步＋转折表明"内在美更重要"→成立。②→appearance 是让步项（ordinary）→不成立。③→age 原文未比较→排除。④→money 与"rich elderly man"有关，非比较项→排除。
4 干扰：Although 从句在前、信息量大，容易被当答案；ordinary 也是外貌词。
5 意图：考"Although 让步后的主句（inner beauty）为作者判断"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Inner beauty。若问 What did Frank look like? 答 Quite ordinary。若问 Who was hired? 答 Frank。
7 错误：A 答 Appearance.（错因：让步项）；B 答 Age.（错因：无据）；C 答 Money.（错因：无关）。
8 规则：R118.5 若问 what is more important than X 且原文用 Although＋转折（looked ordinary, but inner beauty），then 取转折后的品质（inner beauty）；让步项（appearance／ordinary）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.19 寓意（转折定判断）；复用 R81.4（寓意取祈使／判断句），本条是 Although 转折。
10 自检：①转折后是什么？②ordinary 是让步吗？③答案要名词还是形容词？

**组小结（G148 · 慧航第二套 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：to 后职责 1（16）；外貌按主体 1（17）；if 后主句 1（18）；impressed by 宾语 1（19）；转折定判断 1（20）。
- 规则：R118.1 to 后原形（16）；R118.2 外貌按主体（17）；R118.3 if 后取主句（18）；R118.4 impressed by 取抽象名词（19）；R118.5 转折取品质（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R118.1 与"look after himself 紧邻"冲突，职责优先；R118.2 与"while 并列"冲突，主体优先；R118.3 与"change 更积极"冲突，主句优先；R118.4 与"answer 感染力"冲突，抽象名词优先；R118.5 与"Although 从句信息量大"冲突，转折优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：寓言式叙事首见（对照人物 + 道德判断）；本篇"表现 vs 品质"（answer vs character；ordinary vs inner beauty）是 04 的抽象层级样本；数字（two nurses）无换算，**本组无推算**。

### 第二套 · Passage 2

In 1848, a settler in remote undeveloped California discovered gold near Sacramento (萨克拉曼多). As the news spread, a great tide of gold-hungry men flowed into California. They came from all parts of the United States in tens of thousands. There were even gold-seekers from Europe. Some of the people moved across the country by wagon, traveling almost half a year and meeting many hardships and dangers. Others sailed all the way around South America, finally reaching the California shore. Since the first discovery were tiny pieces of gold at the bottom of a stream, many of them searched the rivers for the precious bits of yellow metal. Others made channels to draw off flowing water in order to examine it carefully for bits of gold. They worked with almost full determination and fierce competition.

Life was hard and rough in the days of the California gold rush. A few of the adventurers became rich, but




most of them were bitterly disappointed. After having left their homes and traveling the long dangerous road to California, they had found little or nothing. Some returned home. But many remained in California to work and to settle as ordinary citizens without the riches they had dreamed of.

21. Why did many people rush to California?

Because a settler discovered ____________________.

22. Apart from all parts of the United States, where were gold seekers perhaps from?

____________________

23. According to the passage, how many people became rich in the so-called gold rush?

____________________

24. Where was gold first discovered?

____________________

25. What had most of the adventurers found in California after having left their homes?

They had found ____________________.

**〔G149〕慧航第二套 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：gold（Because a settler discovered gold.）**
1 题面：框架 "Because a settler discovered __________."；空位在 discovered 后，须为名词；原文 "In 1848, a settler in remote undeveloped California discovered gold near Sacramento."；诱导信号：near Sacramento 是地点状语，不是 discovered 的宾语。
2 候选：①gold；②Sacramento（地点）；③California（地点）；④tiny pieces of gold at the bottom of a stream（后文）。
3 验算：①→discovered gold near Sacramento，宾语是 gold→成立。②③→near Sacramento／California 是地点状语→排除。④→是"最早发现物的形态"，属后文补充→次优。
4 干扰：Sacramento 紧跟在 discovered 后，位置最像宾语；California 在第一句。
5 意图：考"discovered 取宾语 gold，地点状语不作宾语"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 gold。若问 Where was gold discovered? 答 Near Sacramento, California。
7 错误：A 填 Sacramento.（错因：地点）；B 填 the bottom of a stream.（错因：形态）；C 填 a precious metal.（错因：上位改写）。
8 规则：R119.1 若补全式为 Because sb discovered ___，then 取 discovered 的宾语（gold）；地点状语（near Sacramento／California）与后文形态（tiny pieces）不作宾语。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（宾语）＋RA-1.15；复用 R22.2（include 取全），本条是 discovered 宾语。
10 自检：①discovered 的宾语是什么？②Sacramento 是状语吗？③形态能作宾语吗？

**22. 答案：Europe（Apart from all parts of the United States, gold seekers were perhaps from Europe.）**
1 题面：Apart from all parts of the United States, where were gold seekers perhaps from；原文 "They came from all parts of the United States in tens of thousands. There were even gold-seekers from Europe."；题干 Apart from 已排除美国各地；疑问词 where…from（问来源地）；诱导信号：后文还提到 by wagon／around South America（路线，不是来源）。
2 候选：①Europe；②South America（绕行路线）；③Sacramento；④California。
3 验算：①→There were even gold-seekers from Europe，Apart from 后唯一条目→成立。②→sailed all the way around South America 是航线→不成立。③④→是美国境内地点→排除。
4 干扰：around South America 与 from Europe 同段，方向相反（路线 vs 来源）；Sacramento 是发现地。
5 意图：考"Apart from 排除美国后取唯一来源（Europe），路线不作来源"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Europe。若问 How did some people travel to California? 答 By wagon（or by ship around South America）。
7 错误：A 答 South America.（错因：路线）；B 答 California.（错因：目的地）；C 答 Asia.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R119.2 若题干 Apart from X，where were they from，then 取 from＋来源地（Europe）；同段的航线（around South America）与目的地（California）不作来源。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（来源 vs 路线）；复用 R44.5（排除原文法），本条是"排除后取唯一"。
10 自检：①from 后是什么？②South America 是来源吗？③题干排除什么？

**23. 答案：A few (of the adventurers)（Only a few adventurers became rich.）**
1 题面：According to the passage, how many people became rich in the so-called gold rush；原文 "A few of the adventurers became rich, but most of them were bitterly disappointed."；疑问词 how many people became rich（问人数）；诱导信号：同段还有 most of them were bitterly disappointed，容易被答成"没有人"。
2 候选：①a few；②most of them；③all of them；④none。
3 验算：①→A few of the adventurers became rich，数量短语直接给出→成立。②→most 是"失望"的人→不成立。③→all 与 most disappointed 矛盾→排除。④→none 与 a few became rich 矛盾→排除。
4 干扰：most were bitterly disappointed 信息量大，容易推向"几乎没人富"；tens of thousands 也像"很多人"。
5 意图：考"how many 取数量短语（a few），并用 but 后的对照（most）校验"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 A few。若问 What happened to most adventurers? 答 They were bitterly disappointed（found little or nothing）。
7 错误：A 答 Most of them.（错因：失望者）；B 答 None.（错因：与 a few 矛盾）；C 答 Tens of thousands.（错因：涌入人数）。
8 规则：R119.3 若问 how many people became rich，then 取数量短语（a few），并用 but 后的对照（most were disappointed）校验；涌入人数（tens of thousands）与"没有"（none）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（对照校验）；复用 R45.2（清点），本条是"数量短语＋对照"。
10 自检：①a few 修饰谁？②most 指什么？③tens of thousands 是什么？

**24. 答案：Near Sacramento (in California), at the bottom of a stream.**
1 题面：Where was gold first discovered；原文 "In 1848, a settler in remote undeveloped California discovered gold near Sacramento."＋"Since the first discovery were tiny pieces of gold at the bottom of a stream"；疑问词 Where（问地点）；诱导信号：California 是州，Sacramento 是具体地点，at the bottom of a stream 是最初发现物的位置。
2 候选：①near Sacramento（＋at the bottom of a stream）；②California（州）；③South America（路线）；④Europe。
3 验算：①→discovered gold near Sacramento＋tiny pieces of gold at the bottom of a stream，两级地点→成立（写 near Sacramento 即可，可补 stream）。②→California 范围过大，原文用 remote undeveloped California 作背景→次优。③④→路线／来源→排除。
4 干扰：California 在句首、更醒目；bottom of a stream 与 Sacramento 分处两段。
5 意图：考"Where 取最具体的地点（near Sacramento；at the bottom of a stream），州名只作范围"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Near Sacramento, California。若问 How did many search for gold? 答 They searched the rivers（or made channels to draw off water）。
7 错误：A 答 California.（错因：范围过大）；B 答 South America.（错因：路线）；C 答 Europe.（错因：来源）。
8 规则：R119.4 若问 Where was X first discovered，then 取最具体的两个地点（near Sacramento；at the bottom of a stream），州名（California）只作范围；路线与来源地不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（具体 vs 范围）；复用 R54.3（Where 取 to 后目的地），本条是地点层级。
10 自检：①最具体的地点是哪？②California 是什么层级？③stream 在哪段？

**25. 答案：little or nothing（They had found little or nothing.）**
1 题面：框架 "What had most of the adventurers found in California after having left their homes? They had found __________."；空位在 had found 后，须为名词性短语；原文 "After having left their homes and traveling the long dangerous road to California, they had found little or nothing."；诱导信号：前句 A few of the adventurers became rich 是少数派。
2 候选：①little or nothing；②gold and riches；③riches they had dreamed of（被否定的）；④hardships and dangers。
3 验算：①→they had found little or nothing，与 most 对应→成立。②→与 most were disappointed 矛盾→不成立。③→without the riches they had dreamed of，原文明确"没有"→排除。④→hardships 是路上的经历，不是"found in California"→排除。
4 干扰：became rich（少数）与 riches they had dreamed of 都在同段；hardships and dangers 也在前段。
5 意图：考"most 的结果取 little or nothing，少数致富与被否定的梦想不作答案"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 little or nothing。若问 What did some of them do after the rush? 答 Some returned home; many stayed and settled as ordinary citizens。
7 错误：A 填 gold and riches.（错因：少数）；B 填 the riches they had dreamed of.（错因：被否定）；C 填 hardships.（错因：路上经历）。
8 规则：R119.5 若补全式问 most of them had found，then 取 little or nothing；少数人的结果（became rich）与被明文否定的梦想（without the riches）不作答案；路上的经历（hardships）不属"found in California"。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词短语）＋RA-1.6 结果；复用 R63.2（other 排除本体）的反向：本条是"多数 vs 少数"。
10 自检：①most 的结果是什么？②少数怎样？③hardships 属哪一段？

**组小结（G149 · 慧航第二套 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：discovered 宾语 1（21）；来源 vs 路线 1（22）；数量短语＋对照 1（23）；地点层级 1（24）；多数结果 1（25）。
- 规则：R119.1 discovered 取宾语（21）；R119.2 来源不作路线（22）；R119.3 a few＋对照（23）；R119.4 具体地点优先（24）；R119.5 多数取 little or nothing（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R119.1 与"Sacramento 紧邻"冲突，宾语优先；R119.2 与"around South America 同段"冲突，来源优先；R119.3 与"most disappointed 信息量大"冲突，数量短语优先；R119.4 与"California 醒目"冲突，具体优先；R119.5 与"少数致富"冲突，多数优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：历史事件说明文首见（淘金热）；本篇"多数 vs 少数""来源 vs 路线""具体 vs 范围"三组对照，是 04 的分流样本；数字（1848／tens of thousands／half a year）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第二套 · Passage 3

Coco Chanel, a French woman is very famous for her success in the fashion world. The life of Coco Chanel is a classic rags-to-riches story. Born in 1883, she was abandoned by her father after her mother died. She was raised by her aunts who taught her to sew and gave her the nickname Coco, which means "little pet".

Starting out as a hat designer, Coco went against the fancy hats being worn at the time. "How can a brain function under those things," she wondered. Instead, she created simple, but beautiful designs which became popular with fashionable young women of Paris.

Strangely enough, World War I gave her the chance to develop her idea of simple elegance from hats to clothing. Due to the shortage of material during the war, she took the opportunity to show that less can truly be more, introducing turtle-neck (叠领) sweater and pants for women.

In 1923, Coco launched her line of perfumes. "A woman who does not wear perfume has no future!" she said, and women believed her. Since its first appearance, Chanel No. 5 has been the world's most popular perfume, with another bottle being sold every 30 seconds. And Coco herself inspired generations of women designers and businesswomen to pursue their dreams.




26. What is Coco Chanel famous for?

____________________

27. How did Coco Chanel start her career in fashion?

____________________

28. How did World War I affect Coco Chanel's fashion designs?

She took the chance that World War I gave her to introduce ____________________.

29. What did Coco Chanel say about women wearing perfume?

____________________

30. What does Coco Chanel's success story mean to women designers and businesswomen?

____________________

**〔G150〕慧航第二套 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：Her success in the fashion world.**
1 题面：What is Coco Chanel famous for；原文 "Coco Chanel, a French woman is very famous for her success in the fashion world."；疑问词 What is sb famous for（问成名领域）；诱导信号：下一句 The life of Coco Chanel is a classic rags-to-riches story 是她的人生概括。
2 候选：①her success in the fashion world；②her rags-to-riches life（人生）；③her perfume（产品）；④her hats（早期产品）。
3 验算：①→is very famous for her success in the fashion world，for 后直接给出→成立。②→rags-to-riches 是对一生的评价，不是"成名于"→次优。③→perfume 是 1923 年后的产品→排除。④→hats 是职业起点→排除。
4 干扰：rags-to-riches story 紧随其后、故事性强；perfume 与 Chanel No.5 也极有名。
5 意图：考"famous for 取领域（success in the fashion world），人生概括与产品不作领域"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Her success in the fashion world。若问 What kind of story is her life? 答 A classic rags-to-riches story。
7 错误：A 答 Her perfume.（错因：产品）；B 答 A rags-to-riches story.（错因：人生评价）；C 答 Her hats.（错因：起点）。
8 规则：R120.1 若问 What is sb famous for，then 取 for 后的领域（her success in the fashion world）；人生概括（rags-to-riches）与具体产品（perfume／hats）不作领域。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（领域）；复用 R6.1（介词后取宾语），本条是 famous for。
10 自检：①for 后是什么？②rags-to-riches 是什么？③perfume 哪年？

**27. 答案：As a hat designer.**
1 题面：How did Coco Chanel start her career in fashion；原文 "Starting out as a hat designer, Coco went against the fancy hats being worn at the time."；疑问词 How did sb start（问起步方式）；诱导信号：同段 It is a classic rags-to-riches story 是一生概括。
2 候选：①as a hat designer；②as a perfume maker；③as a sweater designer；④as a businesswoman。
3 验算：①→Starting out as a hat designer，as 后即起步身份→成立。②→perfume 是 1923 年（后段）→排除。③→sweater 是一战后（第三段）→排除。④→businesswoman 是后人评价（inspired generations of…businesswomen）→排除。
4 干扰：perfume／sweater 都更"有名"，容易被当起点；题干 start 是时间闸门。
5 意图：考"How did sb start 取 as＋起点身份（a hat designer），后期成就按时间排除"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 As a hat designer。若问 What did she think of the fancy hats? 答 "How can a brain function under those things?"（she went against them）。
7 错误：A 答 As a perfume maker.（错因：后期）；B 答 As a sweater designer.（错因：一战时期）；C 答 As a model.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R120.2 若问 How did sb start his/her career，then 取 as＋起点身份（a hat designer）；后期成就（perfume／sweater）按时间排除；题干 start 是筛子。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.37 职业（起点）；复用 R25.4（职业取表语），本条是 as 短语。
10 自检：①as 后是什么？②perfume 哪年？③sweater 哪段？

**28. 答案：turtle-neck sweater and pants for women（She took the chance that World War I gave her to introduce turtle-neck sweater and pants for women.）**
1 题面：框架 "She took the chance that World War I gave her to introduce __________."；空位在 introduce 后，须为名词短语；原文 "Due to the shortage of material during the war, she took the opportunity to show that less can truly be more, introducing turtle-neck (叠领) sweater and pants for women."；诱导信号：less can truly be more 是理念，introducing 后才是产品。
2 候选：①turtle-neck sweater and pants for women；②less can truly be more（理念）；③fancy hats（被反对的）；④perfume（后段）。
3 验算：①→introducing turtle-neck sweater and pants for women，introducing 后两项→成立（两项都写）。②→是理念，introduce 的宾语应是产品→次优。③→fancy hats 是她"went against"的→排除。④→perfume 在 1923 年→排除。
4 干扰：less can truly be more 是全文金句，最容易被当宾语；shortage of material 也像"introduce 的内容"。
5 意图：考"introduce 取产品并列（sweater＋pants），理念句不作宾语"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 turtle-neck sweater and pants for women。若问 What did the shortage of material lead her to show? 答 That less can truly be more。
7 错误：A 填 less can truly be more.（错因：理念）；B 填 fancy hats.（错因：被反对）；C 填 perfume.（错因：后段）。
8 规则：R120.3 若补全式空位在 introduce 后，then 取产品并列（turtle-neck sweater and pants for women），两项都写；理念句（less can truly be more）与被反对项（fancy hats）不作宾语。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词短语）＋RA-1.15；复用 R22.2（include 取全），本条是 introducing。
10 自检：①introducing 后有几项？②less is more 是什么？③帽子被赞成还是反对？

**29. 答案：She said, "A woman who does not wear perfume has no future!"**
1 题面：What did Coco Chanel say about women wearing perfume；原文 "'A woman who does not wear perfume has no future!' she said, and women believed her."；疑问词 What did sb say（问原话）；诱导信号：同段 Chanel No.5 has been the world's most popular perfume 是产品成绩。
2 候选：①"A woman who does not wear perfume has no future!"；②Chanel No.5 is the most popular perfume（事实）；③another bottle is sold every 30 seconds（数据）；④women should wear simple clothes（另一主题）。
3 验算：①→直接引语，与"say about women wearing perfume"对应→成立（引号照录）。②③→是产品与销量事实，不是她的话→排除。④→simple elegance 是一战时期的设计理念，不是"关于香水"的话→排除。
4 干扰：Chanel No.5 与 30 seconds 的数据很抢眼；simple elegance 也是她的名言式主张。
5 意图：考"What did sb say 取直接引语，产品成绩与数据不作原话"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 "A woman who does not wear perfume has no future!"。若问 How popular is Chanel No.5? 答 It is the world's most popular perfume, with a bottle sold every 30 seconds。
7 错误：A 答 Chanel No.5 is popular.（错因：事实）；B 答 A bottle is sold every 30 seconds.（错因：数据）；C 答 Women should wear simple clothes.（错因：另一主题）。
8 规则：R120.4 若问 What did sb say，then 取引号内原话（"A woman who does not wear perfume has no future!"）；产品成绩（most popular）与销量数据（30 seconds）不作原话。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.10 引语定位；复用 R38.3（引语照录），本条是"名言＋数据"分离。
10 自检：①引号内是什么？②30 seconds 是什么？③我抄了事实吗？

**30. 答案：It inspired them to pursue their dreams.**
1 题面：What does Coco Chanel's success story mean to women designers and businesswomen；原文 "And Coco herself inspired generations of women designers and businesswomen to pursue their dreams."；疑问词 What does X mean to sb（问意义）；诱导信号：前句 Chanel No.5 的成绩是产品层面。
2 候选：①it inspired them to pursue their dreams；②it made them rich；③it taught them to wear perfume；④it showed them how to make hats。
3 验算：①→inspired generations of women designers and businesswomen to pursue their dreams，inspired sb to do 与题干 mean to 对应→成立。②→rich 原文未提（rags-to-riches 是她个人）→排除。③④→具体产品／技艺，不是"意义"→排除。
4 干扰：rags-to-riches 让人想到"致富"；hats／perfume 是具体成就。
5 意图：考"意义取 inspired sb to do（pursue their dreams），财富与技艺不作意义"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 It inspired them to pursue their dreams。若问 What did she inspire generations of women to do? 答 To pursue their dreams。
7 错误：A 答 It made them rich.（错因：财富）；B 答 It taught them to make perfume.（错因：技艺）；C 答 It showed them how to sew.（错因：童年经历）。
8 规则：R120.5 若问 What does sb's story mean to a group，then 取 inspired sb to do（pursue their dreams）；财富（rich）与具体技艺（hats／perfume）不作意义。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.16 影响（对群体）；复用 R61.5（影响取他人行为），本条是励志影响。
10 自检：①inspired sb to do 后是什么？②rich 有依据吗？③hats 属哪段？

**组小结（G150 · 慧航第二套 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：famous for 领域 1（26）；职业起点 1（27）；introduce 产品 1（28）；直接引语 1（29）；影响（励志）1（30）。
- 规则：R120.1 famous for 取领域（26）；R120.2 起点取 as 身份（27）；R120.3 introduce 取产品（28）；R120.4 引语照录（29）；R120.5 影响取 inspired sb to do（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R120.1 与"rags-to-riches 故事性强"冲突，领域优先；R120.2 与"perfume 更出名"冲突，start 时间闸门优先；R120.3 与"less is more 金句"冲突，产品优先；R120.4 与"销量数据醒目"冲突，引语优先；R120.5 与"致富联想"冲突，inspired 优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：名人传记（时尚界）第 6 篇；本篇"理念 vs 产品"（less is more vs sweater／pants）是 04 的抽象层级样本；数字（1883／1923／30 seconds）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第二套 · Passage 4

People in some countries cannot use their native language for Web addresses. Neither can Chinese speakers, who now have to rely on pinyin. But last Friday, ICANN, the Web's governing body, approved the use of up to 16 languages for the new system. More will follow in the coming years.

The Internet is about to start using the 16 languages of the world. People will soon be able to use addresses in characters (字符) other than those of the Roman alphabet (字母表). The change will also allow the suffix (后缀) to be expressed in 16 other alphabets, including traditional and simplified Chinese characters.

But there are still some problems to work out. Experts have discussed what to do with characters that have several different meanings. This is particularly true of Chinese.

Most experts doubt the change will have a major effect on how the Internet is used. "There will be some competition between companies to obtain popular words for addresses."

32. What will the approval of the use of 16 languages by ICANN allow web users to do?

____________________

including ____________________.




34. What is one of the problems in using the new system?

____________________

35. Many experts do not believe that ____________________.

**〔G151〕慧航第二套 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

**31. 答案：pinyin（For Web addresses, Chinese speakers now have to depend on pinyin.）**
1 题面：框架 "For Web addresses, Chinese speakers now have to depend on __________."；空位在 depend on 后，须为名词；原文 "People in some countries cannot use their native language for Web addresses. Neither can Chinese speakers, who now have to rely on pinyin."；诱导信号：native language 是"不能用"的，方向相反。
2 候选：①pinyin；②their native language；③the Roman alphabet；④16 languages。
3 验算：①→who now have to rely on pinyin，rely on 与 depend on 同义→成立。②→cannot use their native language 是否定项→不成立。③→Roman alphabet 是现状的另一说法（characters other than those of the Roman alphabet），但题干问"依靠什么"，原文给 pinyin→次优。④→16 languages 是 ICANN 新批准的系统→排除。
4 干扰：native language 与 pinyin 都是语言，方向相反；Roman alphabet 也在文中。
5 意图：考"depend on 取 rely on 后的宾语（pinyin），被否定项（native language）不取"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 pinyin。若问 What did ICANN approve last Friday? 答 The use of up to 16 languages for the new system。
7 错误：A 填 their native language.（错因：否定项）；B 填 16 languages.（错因：新系统）；C 填 English.（错因：无据改写）。
8 规则：R121.1 若补全式空位在 depend on 后，then 取同义动词（rely on）的宾语（pinyin）；被否定项（native language）与新批准事项（16 languages）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（介词宾语）；复用 R6.1（介词后取宾语），本条是同义动词换算。
10 自检：①rely on 后是什么？②native language 被肯定吗？③16 languages 是什么？

**32. 答案：To use addresses in characters other than those of the Roman alphabet (and to express the suffix in 16 other alphabets).**
1 题面：What will the approval of the use of 16 languages by ICANN allow web users to do；原文 "People will soon be able to use addresses in characters (字符) other than those of the Roman alphabet (字母表). The change will also allow the suffix (后缀) to be expressed in 16 other alphabets…"；疑问词 What will X allow users to do（问功能）；诱导信号：同句还有 suffix 的表达，是并列功能。
2 候选：①use addresses in non-Roman characters（＋suffix in 16 alphabets）；②use their native language for Web addresses only；③make the Internet faster；④sell more domain names。
3 验算：①→be able to use addresses in characters other than those of the Roman alphabet＋allow the suffix to be expressed，两项功能→成立（写一项亦可）。②→native language 是"以前不能"，表述不完整（新系统是 16 languages，不是所有母语）→次优。③④→原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：native language 在首句，像"目的"；16 languages 是系统名，不是功能。
5 意图：考"allow sb to do 取不定式内容（use non-Roman characters），并可补并列功能（suffix）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 To use addresses in characters other than the Roman alphabet。若问 What can the suffix be expressed in? 答 16 other alphabets（including traditional and simplified Chinese）。
7 错误：A 答 Use their native language.（错因：表述不完整）；B 答 Make the Internet faster.（错因：无据）；C 答 Sell domain names.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R121.2 若问 What will X allow users to do，then 取 allow／be able to 后的不定式（use addresses in characters other than the Roman alphabet），可补并列功能（suffix）；系统名（16 languages）与无据结果不作功能。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（功能）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条是 allow sb to do。
10 自检：①be able to 后是什么？②suffix 属并列吗？③native language 表述完整吗？

**33. 答案：traditional and simplified Chinese characters（…including traditional and simplified Chinese characters.）**
1 题面：框架 "The new system will allow the suffix to be expressed in 16 other alphabets, including __________."；空位在 including 后，须为名词短语；原文 "The change will also allow the suffix (后缀) to be expressed in 16 other alphabets, including traditional and simplified Chinese characters."；诱导信号：同段还有 characters other than those of the Roman alphabet，范围更宽。
2 候选：①traditional and simplified Chinese characters；②the Roman alphabet；③pinyin；④16 languages。
3 验算：①→including traditional and simplified Chinese characters，两项并列→成立（两项都写）。②→Roman alphabet 是被"other than"排除的→不成立。③→pinyin 是现状依靠物→排除。④→16 languages 是被 including 说明的整体→排除。
4 干扰：Roman alphabet 与 Chinese characters 在同一段对照；pinyin 在首段。
5 意图：考"including 取列举项（traditional and simplified Chinese characters），整体与对照项不作列举"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 traditional and simplified Chinese characters。若问 What does ICANN govern? 答 The Web（it is the Web's governing body）。
7 错误：A 填 the Roman alphabet.（错因：被排除）；B 填 16 languages.（错因：整体）；C 填 pinyin.（错因：现状）。
8 规则：R121.3 若补全式空位在 including 后，then 取列举项（traditional and simplified Chinese characters），两项都写；整体（16 alphabets）与被排除项（the Roman alphabet）不作列举。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词短语）＋RA-1.15；复用 R22.2（include 取全），本条是 including。
10 自检：①including 后几项？②Roman 被排除吗？③两项写全了吗？

**34. 答案：Characters that have several different meanings (this is particularly true of Chinese).**
1 题面：What is one of the problems in using the new system；原文 "But there are still some problems to work out. Experts have discussed what to do with characters that have several different meanings. This is particularly true of Chinese."；疑问词 one of the problems（问问题之一）；诱导信号：后段 There will be some competition between companies 是另一层（商业竞争），不是"系统使用的问题"。
2 候选：①characters with several different meanings；②companies competing for popular words；③the Internet will be slower；④people can't use pinyin。
3 验算：①→what to do with characters that have several different meanings，problems 后的第一条→成立（可补 particularly Chinese）。②→是专家对影响的预测，不是"使用新系统的问题"→次优。③④→原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：competition between companies 也在问题段附近，容易被当"问题"；particularly true of Chinese 是补充。
5 意图：考"problems 后的第一条取 characters with several meanings，商业竞争属影响预测"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Characters that have several different meanings。若问 What do experts doubt about the change? 答 That it will have a major effect on how the Internet is used。
7 错误：A 答 Competition between companies.（错因：影响预测）；B 答 The Internet will be slower.（错因：无据）；C 答 Chinese can't use computers.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R121.4 若问 one of the problems，then 取 problems to work out 后列举的第一条（characters with several meanings）；后文的商业竞争（competition for popular words）属影响预测，不作系统问题。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（问题之一）；复用 R64.1（小标题清点），本条是"问题清单"。
10 自检：①problems 后第一条是什么？②competition 属什么？③particularly 指什么？

**35. 答案：the change will have a major effect on how the Internet is used（Many experts do not believe that the change will have a major effect on how the Internet is used.）**
1 题面：框架 "Many experts do not believe that __________."；空位在 that 后，须为完整从句；原文 "Most experts doubt the change will have a major effect on how the Internet is used."；诱导信号：doubt 与 do not believe 是同义否定，题干已把 doubt 改写为 do not believe。
2 候选：①the change will have a major effect on how the Internet is used；②the change will have no effect（多否一层）；③companies will compete for words；④Chinese will be widely used。
3 验算：①→Most experts doubt [the change will have a major effect…]，doubt＝do not believe，去掉否定后从句即原句→成立（不得再加 no）。②→多否一层，变成"相信没有影响"，与 doubt 的单层否定不符→不成立。③→是另一句的预测（There will be some competition），不在 doubt 后→排除。④→原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：doubt 的否定意味在中文里不明显，容易写成"相信没有影响"（双重否定）；competition 句紧随其后也像 doubt 的内容。
5 意图：考"doubt＝do not believe 单层否定：从句照原句，不加 no"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 the change will have a major effect on how the Internet is used。若问 What do most experts think of the change? 答 They doubt it will have a major effect。
7 错误：A 填 the change will have no effect.（错因：双重否定）；B 填 companies will compete.（错因：另一句）；C 填 Chinese will replace English.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R121.5 若题干把 doubt 改写为 do not believe，then 从句照原句（the change will have a major effect），不得再加 no；相邻的预测句（competition）不属 doubt 的内容。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（宾语从句）＋RA-3.16 推断（否定范围）；复用 R20.4（情态不升格），本条是 doubt 的否定范围。
10 自检：①doubt 等于什么？②从句要不要加 no？③competition 在哪句？

**组小结（G151 · 慧航第二套 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：depend on 宾语 1（31）；allow 功能 1（32）；including 列举 1（33）；问题之一 1（34）；doubt 否定范围 1（35）。
- 规则：R121.1 depend on 取宾语（31）；R121.2 allow 取不定式（32）；R121.3 including 取列举（33）；R121.4 问题取第一条（34）；R121.5 doubt 单层否定（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R121.1 与"native language 同类"冲突，否定项优先排除；R121.2 与"native language 首句"冲突，allow 后不定式优先；R121.3 与"Roman 同段"冲突，including 后优先；R121.4 与"competition 近邻"冲突，problems 后优先；R121.5 与"doubt≈加 no"冲突，单层否定优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：科技政策说明文首见（ICANN 多语言域名）；本篇"doubt 的否定范围"是 04 的新样本（与 R4.3 虚拟否定、R121.5 双重否定相邻）；数字（16 languages／30 seconds 见前篇）无换算，**本组无推算**；**第二套 4 篇至此完成（G148—G151）**。

### 第五套 · Section A

**Directions:** *There are 4 passages in this section. After each passage there are 5 questions. Please read the passage and write down the answer to each question with proper words.*

### 第五套 · Passage 1

The development of telephones, televisions, radios, and the Internet has greatly facilitated global communication. Unlike in the past when it would take weeks or even months for news to travel between continents, these devices allow information to be transmitted across the globe within seconds or hours.

This increased speed of communication has had a profound impact on the world. Two hundred years ago, the



long time required for communication between continents influenced people's actions and decisions. For example, during the War of 1812 between England and the United States, several battles could have been avoided if the news of a peace agreement had reached America in time. However, due to the six-week time difference, the Battle of New Orleans occurred after the peace treaty (条约) had already been signed, resulting in unnecessary loss of life.

In the past, the world seemed much larger. News and information were primarily transmitted through slow methods such as ships, which needed weeks or months to travel. With the advent of modern technology, the speed of communication has dramatically improved, allowing ideas, news, and assistance to be shared rapidly across borders. This has brought people closer together and made the world feel more interconnected. The ease and speed with which information now travels has transformed various aspects of society, enabling prompt collaborations, sharing of knowledge, and faster responses to emergencies or disasters occurring in remote locations.

16. What devices have greatly facilitated global communication?

____________________

17. How long would it take for news to travel between continents in the past?

____________________

18. Which battle could have been avoided if news had reached America six weeks earlier?

____________________

19. The primary ways to send information in the past were ____________________.

20. What contributes to the improved speed of communication?

____________________

**〔G152〕慧航第五套 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

**16. 答案：Telephones, televisions, radios and the Internet.**
1 题面：What devices have greatly facilitated global communication；原文 "The development of telephones, televisions, radios, and the Internet has greatly facilitated global communication."；疑问词 What devices（问设备，复数）；诱导信号：第二段还有 modern technology 的概括说法。
2 候选：①telephones, televisions, radios and the Internet；②modern technology（上位）；③ships（过去的工具）；④computers。
3 验算：①→four devices＋has greatly facilitated global communication，主语即答案→成立（四项都写）。②→modern technology 是上位概念，题干问 devices（具体）→次优。③→ships 是过去的方式→排除。④→computers 原文未单列→排除。
4 干扰：modern technology 在第三段反复出现，像"总答案"；四项并列长，容易只写一两项。
5 意图：考"devices 取首句四项并列，上位词（modern technology）不作具体设备"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Telephones, televisions, radios and the Internet。若问 What did ships do in the past? 答 They carried news and information slowly（weeks or months）。
7 错误：A 答 Modern technology.（错因：上位）；B 答 Ships.（错因：过去）；C 答 Computers and phones.（错因：漏项／改写）。
8 规则：R122.1 若问 What devices have facilitated X，then 取首句的四项并列（telephones／televisions／radios／the Internet），四项都写；上位词（modern technology）与过去工具（ships）不作具体设备。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.15 并列取全；复用 R5.1（并列宾语全取），本条是并列主语。
10 自检：①首句有几项？②modern technology 是设备吗？③ships 属哪段？

**17. 答案：Weeks or even months.**
1 题面：How long would it take for news to travel between continents in the past；原文 "Unlike in the past when it would take weeks or even months for news to travel between continents, these devices allow information to be transmitted across the globe within seconds or hours."；疑问词 How long（问时长）；诱导信号：同句还有 within seconds or hours（现在），方向相反。
2 候选：①weeks or even months；②seconds or hours（现在）；③six weeks（1812 例子）；④two hundred years。
3 验算：①→in the past when it would take weeks or even months，in the past＋时长→成立。②→these devices allow…within seconds or hours 是现在→不成立。③→six-week 是 1812 例子的具体差时→次优。④→two hundred years 是时间背景→排除。
4 干扰：seconds or hours 与 weeks or months 在同一句对照，现在／过去容易读反；six weeks 数字具体。
5 意图：考"过去时长取 in the past 同句（weeks or months），现在的时长不取"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Weeks or even months。若问 How long does it take now? 答 Within seconds or hours。
7 错误：A 答 Seconds or hours.（错因：现在）；B 答 Six weeks.（错因：个例）；C 答 Two hundred years.（错因：背景）。
8 规则：R122.2 若问 How long did it take in the past，then 取 in the past 分句的时长（weeks or even months）；同句"现在"的时长（seconds or hours）与个例（six weeks）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（过去 vs 现在）；复用 R58.3（时长取整体表达），本条是对照结构。
10 自检：①in the past 分句说什么？②seconds 是哪一边？③six weeks 属什么？

**18. 答案：The Battle of New Orleans.**
1 题面：Which battle could have been avoided if news had reached America six weeks earlier；原文 "For example, during the War of 1812 between England and the United States, several battles could have been avoided if the news of a peace agreement had reached America in time. However, due to the six-week time difference, the Battle of New Orleans occurred after the peace treaty had already been signed…"；疑问词 Which battle（问战役名）；诱导信号：War of 1812 是战争名，不是战役名。
2 候选：①the Battle of New Orleans；②the War of 1812；③the Battle of America；④the peace treaty。
3 验算：①→the Battle of New Orleans occurred after the peace treaty had already been signed，即"本可避免的战役"→成立。②→War of 1812 是整场战争→排除。③→无此战役→排除。④→peace treaty 是条约，不是战役→排除。
4 干扰：War of 1812 在句首、更像"大局"；several battles 是复数概括，容易被直接抄。
5 意图：考"Which battle 取具体战役名（the Battle of New Orleans），战争名与泛指（several battles）不作答案"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The Battle of New Orleans。若问 Why could it have been avoided? 答 Because the news of the peace agreement did not reach America in time（six-week difference）。
7 错误：A 答 The War of 1812.（错因：战争名）；B 答 Several battles.（错因：泛指）；C 答 The peace treaty.（错因：条约）。
8 规则：R122.3 若问 Which battle，then 取具体战役专名（the Battle of New Orleans）；战争名（the War of 1812）、泛指（several battles）与条约（the peace treaty）不作战役名；虚拟条件（could have been avoided）说明"未避免"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.40 事件核（战役名）；复用 R31.1（结论性事件），本条是专名层级。
10 自检：①战役名是什么？②War of 1812 是什么？③条约是战役吗？

**19. 答案：ships（The primary ways to send information in the past were ships.）**
1 题面：框架 "The primary ways to send information in the past were __________."；空位在 were 后，须为名词（复数）；原文 "News and information were primarily transmitted through slow methods such as ships, which needed weeks or months to travel."；诱导信号：同句 slow methods 是上位说法，such as 后才是具体工具。
2 候选：①ships；②slow methods（上位）；③modern technology；④telephones。
3 验算：①→through slow methods such as ships，such as 后即具体工具；were 与复数 ships 一致→成立。②→slow methods 是上位，题干 ways 已用"ways"，需具体→次优。③④→是现代工具→排除。
4 干扰：slow methods 与题干 ways 语义最近；modern technology 在下一段反复出现。
5 意图：考"such as 取具体工具（ships），上位词（slow methods）不作具体"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 ships。若问 What were the slow methods like? 答 They needed weeks or months to travel。
7 错误：A 填 slow methods.（错因：上位）；B 填 modern technology.（错因：现在）；C 填 letters.（错因：无据改写）。
8 规则：R122.4 若补全式空位在 were 后且原文有 such as，then 取 such as 后的具体工具（ships），保持复数与 were 一致；上位词（slow methods）与现代工具不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（复数名词）；复用 R15.2（kind 取类名）的反向：本条要"例"不要"类"。
10 自检：①such as 后是什么？②slow methods 是什么层级？③单复数一致吗？

**20. 答案：The advent of modern technology.**
1 题面：What contributes to the improved speed of communication；原文 "With the advent of modern technology, the speed of communication has dramatically improved, allowing ideas, news, and assistance to be shared rapidly across borders."；疑问词 What contributes to（问原因）；诱导信号：同段还提到 people closer together／world more interconnected，那是结果。
2 候选：①the advent of modern technology；②people's ideas（结果）；③prompt collaborations（结果）；④ships（过去）。
3 验算：①→With the advent of modern technology, the speed…has dramatically improved，With 短语即原因→成立。②③→是 improved speed 的结果→排除。④→ships 是过去的方式→排除。
4 干扰：prompt collaborations／faster responses to emergencies 都是"好处"，容易被当原因；modern technology 与 devices 同义场。
5 意图：考"原因取 With 短语（the advent of modern technology），结果（collaborations／responses）不作原因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The advent of modern technology。若问 What has the improved speed brought? 答 People closer together and a more interconnected world。
7 错误：A 答 Prompt collaborations.（错因：结果）；B 答 Ships.（错因：过去）；C 答 Faster responses.（错因：结果）。
8 规则：R122.5 若问 What contributes to X，then 取 With＋名词短语（the advent of modern technology）；同段的结果（collaborations／faster responses／closer people）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（With 短语）；复用 R57.3（起因取 because），本条是 With 短语。
10 自检：①With 后是什么？②collaborations 是原因吗？③ships 属哪段？

**组小结（G152 · 慧航第五套 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：设备四项 1（16）；过去时长 1（17）；战役专名 1（18）；such as 取具体 1（19）；With 短语为因 1（20）。
- 规则：R122.1 设备取四项（16）；R122.2 过去时长（17）；R122.3 战役专名（18）；R122.4 such as 取具体（19）；R122.5 With 短语为因（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R122.1 与"modern technology 上位"冲突，四项具体优先；R122.2 与"seconds 同句"冲突，in the past 优先；R122.3 与"War of 1812 更像大局"冲突，战役专名优先；R122.4 与"slow methods 语义近"冲突，具体工具优先；R122.5 与"collaborations 像原因"冲突，With 短语优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：科技影响说明文首见（通信史 + 1812 实例）；本篇"过去 vs 现在""上位 vs 具体"两组对照，是 04 的分流样本；数字（two hundred years／six weeks／seconds or hours）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第五套 · Passage 2

Marketing furniture to the public can be challenging for a small business owner. Consumers buy furniture pieces only occasionally. However, there are several furniture promotion ideas that can be used to help you reach your target market.

One thing you can do is to talk with real estate (房地产) agents to allow you to display your furniture in a new home or open house setting. This is a good way to reach a key target market — new home buyers — who may need new furniture for their future homes. Increasing foot traffic (顾客流量) is also important for a furniture store. To get more people to the store, you can advertise a raffle event (抽奖活动). This event can be promoted in your local media and through direct mail campaigns or front door advertisements to generate more interest.

In tough economic times, small business owners often suffer most as a result of slow consumer spending. To




fight back against this, you have to make it easier for your customers to buy furniture. If you can, offer in-store financing, or drop the interest rate on your company's credit terms. Consider lowering your prices and holding two-for-one events to arouse more consumers' interest.

21. Why is it a challenge for small businesses to sell furniture to the public?

____________________

22. According to the writer, what does "new home buyers" mean?

____________________

23. To get more customers to your store, you are advised to ____________________.

24. The purpose of holding two-for-one events is to ____________________.

25. The passage is mainly about ____________________.

**〔G153〕慧航第五套 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：Because consumers buy furniture pieces only occasionally.**
1 题面：Why is it a challenge for small businesses to sell furniture to the public；原文 "Marketing furniture to the public can be challenging for a small business owner. Consumers buy furniture pieces only occasionally."；疑问词 Why is it a challenge（问原因）；诱导信号：下一句 However, there are several furniture promotion ideas 是解决方向，不是原因。
2 候选：①consumers buy furniture pieces only occasionally；②because there are many promotion ideas；③because furniture is expensive；④because real estate agents refuse to help。
3 验算：①→challenging…Consumers buy furniture pieces only occasionally，原因句紧邻→成立。②→ideas 是解决办法→不成立。③→expensive 原文未提→排除。④→原文说 talk with real estate agents 是建议，不是拒绝→排除。
4 干扰：several promotion ideas 在段末，像"为什么难"的答案（其实是出路）；expensive 是常识。
5 意图：考"原因取紧邻的事实句（buy only occasionally），解决建议不作原因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Because consumers buy furniture pieces only occasionally。若问 What can help reach the target market? 答 Several furniture promotion ideas（e.g. displaying furniture in a new home）。
7 错误：A 答 Because furniture is expensive.（错因：常识）；B 答 Because there are many ideas.（错因：相反）；C 答 Because agents refuse.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R123.1 若问 Why is it challenging to sell X，then 取紧邻的事实句（consumers buy…only occasionally）；解决办法（promotion ideas）与常识（expensive）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（紧邻事实）；复用 R57.3（起因取事实），本条是商业语境。
10 自检：①原因句在哪？②ideas 是什么？③expensive 有据吗？

**22. 答案：People who may need new furniture for their future homes (those who buy new homes).**
1 题面：According to the writer, what does "new home buyers" mean；原文 "This is a good way to reach a key target market — new home buyers — who may need new furniture for their future homes."；疑问词 What does X mean（问词义／解释）；诱导信号：破折号引出的 who 从句就是解释。
2 候选：①people who may need new furniture for their future homes；②real estate agents（前句）；③people who sell homes；④furniture store owners。
3 验算：①→new home buyers — who may need new furniture for their future homes，定语从句即释义→成立。②→agents 是合作对象→排除。③→sellers 与 buyers 相反→排除。④→store owners 是营销方→排除。
4 干扰：real estate agents 就在同句前半，动作相关；buyers／sellers 词形近。
5 意图：考"术语释义取破折号后的定语从句（may need new furniture），合作方不作释义"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 People who may need new furniture for their future homes。若问 Who can help display the furniture? 答 Real estate agents。
7 错误：A 答 Real estate agents.（错因：合作方）；B 答 People who sell houses.（错因：反义）；C 答 New furniture.（错因：物）。
8 规则：R123.2 若问 What does a term mean 且原文用破折号＋定语从句，then 取 who 从句的释义（may need new furniture for their future homes）；同句的合作方（agents）与反义（sellers）不作释义。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.4 词义（术语释义）；复用 R44.1（术语取定义），本条是破折号定语从句。
10 自检：①破折号后是什么？②agents 是什么角色？③buyers 与 sellers 反义吗？

**23. 答案：advertise a raffle event（To get more people to the store, you can advertise a raffle event.）**
1 题面：框架 "To get more customers to your store, you are advised to __________."；空位在 to 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "Increasing foot traffic is also important for a furniture store. To get more people to the store, you can advertise a raffle event."；诱导信号：前文 display your furniture in a new home 是另一条建议（针对 new home buyers）。
2 候选：①advertise a raffle event；②display furniture in a new home；③lower your prices；④offer in-store financing。
3 验算：①→To get more people to the store, you can advertise a raffle event，目的与做法同句→成立。②→针对 new home buyers，不是"more people to the store"→次优。③④→是"经济困难时期"的建议（第三段）→排除。
4 干扰：lower prices／in-store financing 更"实在"，也在段内（但属第三段）；显示家具是首条建议。
5 意图：考"目的句（To get more people）取同句做法（advertise a raffle event），其他建议按目的排除"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 advertise a raffle event。若问 Where can the raffle event be promoted? 答 In local media, through direct mail campaigns or front door advertisements。
7 错误：A 填 display furniture in a new home.（错因：另一目的）；B 填 lower your prices.（错因：第三段）；C 填 offer in-store financing.（错因：第三段）。
8 规则：R123.3 若补全式为 To get more customers, you are advised to ___，then 取同目的句的做法（advertise a raffle event）；其他建议（display in a new home／lower prices／financing）按各自目的排除。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（to＋原形）；复用 R111.1（can 后原形），本条是 to。
10 自检：①目的句在哪？②raffle event 怎么推广？③另外三条建议属哪段？

**24. 答案：arouse more consumers' interest（The purpose of holding two-for-one events is to arouse more consumers' interest.）**
1 题面：框架 "The purpose of holding two-for-one events is to __________."；空位在 to 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "Consider lowering your prices and holding two-for-one events to arouse more consumers' interest."；诱导信号：lowering your prices 与 holding two-for-one events 并列，都是手段。
2 候选：①arouse more consumers' interest；②lower your prices（并列手段）；③make it easier to buy；④fight back against slow spending。
3 验算：①→holding two-for-one events to arouse more consumers' interest，to do 即目的→成立。②→与 holding 并列的另一手段→排除。③→是整段的总体目的（make it easier for customers to buy）→次优（层级更高）。④→是第三段首句的目的→次优。
4 干扰：lower your prices 紧挨在前；make it easier to buy 是本段总目的，像答案。
5 意图：考"目的取同句 to do（arouse interest），并列手段与上位目的不作本目的"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 to arouse more consumers' interest（框架已给 to，只写 arouse…）。若问 Why lower prices? 答 Same purpose — to arouse more consumers' interest。
7 错误：A 填 lower your prices.（错因：手段）；B 填 make it easier to buy.（错因：上位目的）；C 填 fight back.（错因：段首目的）。
8 规则：R123.4 若补全式问 The purpose of doing X is to ___，then 取同句 to do（arouse more consumers' interest），框架已给 to 不重复；并列手段（lower prices）与上位目的（make it easier to buy）不作本目的。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（to 已给）＋RA-1.4 目的；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①to do 是什么？②lower prices 是手段吗？③上位目的是哪句？

**25. 答案：furniture promotion ideas (for small businesses)（The passage is mainly about furniture promotion ideas.）**
1 题面：框架 "The passage is mainly about __________."；空位在 about 后，须为名词短语；原文首段 "However, there are several furniture promotion ideas that can be used to help you reach your target market."＋三段分别给建议（display in new homes／raffle／financing／two-for-one）；诱导信号：某一条建议（raffle event）很具体，容易被当主旨。
2 候选：①furniture promotion ideas；②a raffle event（一条建议）；③real estate agents（合作方）；④the furniture business（过宽）。
3 验算：①→several furniture promotion ideas，首段点题，三段分述→成立。②→只是其中一条→排除。③→是第一条建议的合作对象→排除。④→过宽，且未点"promotion"→次优。
4 干扰：raffle event 情节具体；in-store financing 也很"商业"。
5 意图：考"主旨取首段点题的复数名词（furniture promotion ideas），单条建议不作主旨"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 furniture promotion ideas。若问 What is the first idea? 答 Display your furniture in a new home（through real estate agents）。
7 错误：A 填 a raffle event.（错因：一条）；B 填 real estate agents.（错因：合作方）；C 填 the furniture business.（错因：过宽）。
8 规则：R123.5 若补全式问 mainly about 且首段有 several＋ideas，then 取该复数名词短语（furniture promotion ideas）；单条建议与合作方不作主旨；过宽的上位（the furniture business）也排除。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词短语）＋RA-3.1 主旨；复用 R41.2（主旨取总＋分），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①首段点题的是什么？②raffle 是几条之一？③"business"够具体吗？

**组小结（G153 · 慧航第五套 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：原因（紧邻事实）1（21）；术语释义 1（22）；目的＋做法 1（23）；同句 to do 目的 1（24）；主旨取复数名词 1（25）。
- 规则：R123.1 原因取紧邻事实（21）；R123.2 术语取定语从句（22）；R123.3 目的句取做法（23）；R123.4 本目的取同句 to do（24）；R123.5 主旨取首段复数名词（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R123.1 与"promotion ideas 段末"冲突，事实句优先；R123.2 与"agents 同句"冲突，定语从句优先；R123.3 与"lower prices 实在"冲突，目的句优先；R123.4 与"上位目的"冲突，同句 to do 优先；R123.5 与"raffle 具体"冲突，复数名词优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：商业营销说明文首见；本篇"三条建议各配一目的"是 04 的配对样本（与 G100 feedback 四条建议同型）；数字无，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第五套 · Passage 3

The key to any successful garage sale (家庭旧物出售) is to get the word out. The best means of advertising your sale is to place an ad in the local newspaper. If you have a city paper, make sure you advertise in it. The ad should be large enough that it stands out. It should also include information on where the sale is located with directions, the "hot" items you're selling and the time the sale will start and end. An ad should be placed at least two days before the sale and run until the day of your event. That way people can plan their route (路线) to the sale in advance.

Signs are another great way to inform your community. Post them in places where people gather, such as stores and community centers. Some businesses have a central bulletin board (布告栏), which is the best place to advertise. Other places to post are at the local college or university campus. This is especially helpful if your sale is happening in August or early September when students have returned to school and are looking for cheap finds.

Post signs around your neighborhood. You should also place both ads and direction signs, especially if you're located on a side street without a major presence. Signs will attract and direct people. Just make sure you print in bold letters and use large direction signs so people can read the information from the front seat of their car.

26. The best way of getting out the news of your garage sale is to ____________________.




27. You should place an ad at least two days before the sale so that people can ____________________.

28. Why should signs be posted in a community center?

Because it is a good place where ____________________.

29. Why is it helpful to post your ads at the local college in August?

Because it is the time when students have returned to school and ____________________.

30. In order that people can see the signs in their cars, how should you print them?

____________________

> 本篇五题**全部是补全式**（框架已给），考"建议文"里"做法—目的"的逐条配对。

**26. 答案：place an ad in the local newspaper（The best way of getting out the news of your garage sale is to place an ad in the local newspaper.）**
1 题面：框架 "The best way of getting out the news of your garage sale is to __________."；空位在 to 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "The key to any successful garage sale is to get the word out. The best means of advertising your sale is to place an ad in the local newspaper."；诱导信号：Signs are another great way 是第二种方式。
2 候选：①place an ad in the local newspaper；②post signs（第二种方式）；③advertise in a city paper（同句补充）；④use a bulletin board。
3 验算：①→The best means…is to place an ad in the local newspaper，best means 与题干 the best way 对应→成立。②→Signs are another great way，是"另一"而非"最好"→排除。③→If you have a city paper, make sure you advertise in it，是补充条件→次优。④→bulletin board 是 signs 的张贴点→排除。
4 干扰：signs 篇幅更长（两段）；city paper 与 local newspaper 也容易混。
5 意图：考"best way 取 best means 同句的做法（place an ad），another way 不作最佳"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 place an ad in the local newspaper。若问 What is another great way? 答 Posting signs。
7 错误：A 填 post signs.（错因：另一方式）；B 填 use a bulletin board.（错因：张贴点）；C 填 advertise on TV.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R124.1 若补全式问 the best way of doing X is to ___，then 取 best means 同句的做法（place an ad in the local newspaper）；"another way"（signs）与张贴点（bulletin board）不作最佳方式。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（to＋原形）；复用 R123.3（目的句取做法），本条是"最佳 vs 另一"。
10 自检：①best means 后是什么？②signs 是"另一"吗？③city paper 是条件吗？

**27. 答案：plan their route to the sale in advance（…so that people can plan their route to the sale in advance.）**
1 题面：框架 "You should place an ad at least two days before the sale so that people can __________."；空位在 can 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "An ad should be placed at least two days before the sale and run until the day of your event. That way people can plan their route (路线) to the sale in advance."；诱导信号：同段前句讲广告内容（where／hot items／time），不是目的。
2 候选：①plan their route to the sale in advance；②know where the sale is located（广告内容）；③see the hot items（广告内容）；④run the ad until the event。
3 验算：①→That way people can plan their route to the sale in advance，That way 回指"提前登广告"→成立。②③→是广告应包含的信息，不是提前登的目的→次优。④→run until the day 是广告投放时长→排除。
4 干扰：where the sale is located／hot items／time 三项列举很具体，像"目的"；That way 的指代也需还原。
5 意图：考"so that／That way 后取目的（plan their route），广告内容不作目的"。

**28. 答案：people gather（Because it is a good place where people gather.）**
1 题面：框架 "Why should signs be posted in a community center? Because it is a good place where __________."；空位在 where 后，须为从句（主谓）；原文 "Post them in places where people gather, such as stores and community centers."；诱导信号：such as 后的 stores／community centers 是举例，不是"为什么"。

1 题面：框架 "Why is it helpful to post your ads at the local college in August? Because it is the time when students have returned to school and __________."；空位在 and 后、与 have returned 并列，须为谓语（现在进行时）；原文 "This is especially helpful if your sale is happening in August or early September when students have returned to school and are looking for cheap finds."；诱导信号：August or early September 是时间条件。

**30. 答案：In bold letters（/ with large direction signs）（You should print them in bold letters.）**
1 题面：框架 "In order that people can see the signs in their cars, how should you print them?"；空位要求回答"怎么印"；原文 "Just make sure you print in bold letters and use large direction signs so people can read the information from the front seat of their car."；诱导信号：so people can read…from the front seat of their car 是目的，与题干 in their cars 对应。
2 候选：①in bold letters（＋use large direction signs）；②on a computer；③in small letters；④in color。
3 验算：①→print in bold letters and use large direction signs，与"车内可读"直接对应→成立（两点都可写）。②→打印工具，与可读性无关→排除。③→small letters 与"可读"相反→排除。④→in color 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：large direction signs 与 in bold letters 并列，题干只问 print（印刷），"字体加粗"才是直接答案；size 也相关。
5 意图：考"how should you print 取 in bold letters（＋large signs），工具与无关属性不作答案"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 In bold letters。若问 Why should the signs be large? 答 So people can read them from the front seat of their car。
7 错误：A 填 In small letters.（错因：相反）；B 填 On a computer.（错因：工具）；C 填 In English.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R124.5 若问 how should you print，then 取 print in＋方式（bold letters），可补并列的 large direction signs；打印工具（computer）与无关属性（color／language）不作答案；目的（so people can read）是校验句。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（print in＋字体）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条是方式。
10 自检：①print in 后是什么？②large signs 是并列吗？③目的是哪句？

**组小结（G154 · 慧航第五套 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：best way 1（26）；so that 目的 1（27）；where 从句 1（28）；并列谓语 1（29）；print 方式 1（30）。**五题全为补全式**。
- 规则：R124.1 best way 取 best means（26）；R124.2 so that 取目的（27）；R124.3 where 从句（28）；R124.4 并列谓语保时态（29）；R124.5 print in＋方式（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R124.1 与"signs 篇幅长"冲突，best means 优先；R124.2 与"广告三项内容"冲突，That way 目的优先；R124.3 与"such as 地点"冲突，where 从句优先；R124.4 与"have returned 已给"冲突，并列谓语优先；R124.5 与"large signs 相关"冲突，print 的方式优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：生活指南型说明文首见（garage sale 建议）；五题全补全式，是 RA-5 在慧航的连续样本；数字（two days／August／early September）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

**〔G155〕慧航第五套 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

> 本篇是**网站推介文**（PowerShow.com），属应用文第 7 例（广告／推介体首见）；五题**全部是补全式**。

**31. 答案：shares presentations and slideshows（PowerShow.com is a website which shares presentations and slideshows.）**
1 题面：框架 "According to the first paragraph, PowerShow.com is a website which __________."；空位在 which 后，须为谓语（第三人称单数）；原文 "*PowerShow.com* is a leading presentation and slideshows(展示与放映幻灯片) sharing website."；诱导信号：Whether your application is about… 一句是用途范围，不是定义。
2 候选：①shares presentations and slideshows；②offers free online training（用途之一）；③sells PowerPoint software；④teaches business skills。
3 验算：①→a leading presentation and slideshows sharing website，sharing 与 which shares 对应，主谓一致（website 单数＋-s）→成立。②→online training 是适用领域之一→次优。③→原文说 free，不卖软件→排除。④→education／business 是领域→排除。
4 干扰：Whether your application is about business, how-to, education… 列举很长，像"网站功能"；free 也反复出现。
5 意图：考"which 从句取同位语（sharing website→shares），用途列举不作定义；注意第三人称单数"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 shares presentations and slideshows。若问 What can you find on the website? 答 Sample PowerPoint presentations on almost any topic。
7 错误：A 填 offers online training.（错因：领域）；B 填 sells presentations.（错因：与 free 相反）；C 填 share presentations（错因：主谓不一致）。
8 规则：R125.1 若补全式为 a website which ___，then 取同位语中的核心动作（shares presentations and slideshows），须用第三人称单数；用途领域列举（business／education…）不作定义。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（三人称单数）；复用 R109.1（定义补全保主谓一致），本条是 which 从句。
10 自检：①sharing 对应什么动词？②网站是单数吗？③列举的是用途吗？

**32. 答案：free and easy to use（Most of PowerShow.com's features are free and easy to use.）**
1 题面：框架 "Most of *PowerShow.com*'s features are __________."；空位在 are 后（表语），须为形容词并列；原文 "And, best of all, most of its cool features are free and easy to use."；诱导信号：同段后文 For a small fee, you can get… 是少数收费项。
2 候选：①free and easy to use；②paid and difficult；③for business only；④2D and 3D。
3 验算：①→most of its cool features are free and easy to use，两个表语→成立（两项都写）。②→与 free 相反→排除。③→business 是领域之一→排除。④→2D and 3D 是转换效果→排除。
4 干扰：For a small fee 让人以为"多数收费"；2D／3D 很具体。
5 意图：考"表语取 free and easy to use，少数收费项不作多数"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 free and easy to use。若问 What can you get for a small fee? 答 The industry's best online privacy（or top rankings for your presentations）。
7 错误：A 填 paid.（错因：少数项）；B 填 for business only.（错因：领域）；C 填 2D and 3D.（错因：效果）。
8 规则：R125.2 若补全式空位在 features are 后，then 取两个并列表语（free and easy to use），两项都写；少数收费项（for a small fee）与效果（2D／3D）不作多数特征。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（表语）＋RA-5.5 去重；复用 R51.1（表语位），本条是并列形容词。
10 自检：①表语有哪两个？②small fee 对应什么？③2D／3D 是什么？

**33. 答案：improve your own slides and presentations（By using PowerShow.com, you can learn to improve your own slides and presentations.）**
1 题面：框架 "By using *PowerShow.com*, you can learn to __________."；空位在 to 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "You can use *PowerShow.com* to find and download sample PowerPoint presentations on just any topic you can imagine, so you can learn how to improve your own slides and presentations for free."；诱导信号：find and download 是手段，improve 是目的。
2 候选：①improve your own slides and presentations；②find and download sample presentations（手段）；③change presentations into Flash；④promote your presentations。
3 验算：①→so you can learn how to improve your own slides and presentations，learn 后即目的→成立。②→是"用来找和下载"的手段→次优。③→change into Flash 是免费附加服务→排除。④→promote with top rankings 是收费服务→排除。
4 干扰：find and download 紧挨在前、动作具体；Flash 转换也像"学习内容"。
5 意图：考"learn to 后取目的（improve），前置手段（find／download）不作学习内容"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 improve your own slides and presentations。若问 What can you download? 答 Sample PowerPoint presentations on almost any topic。
7 错误：A 填 find and download presentations.（错因：手段）；B 填 change them into Flash.（错因：附加服务）；C 填 promote presentations.（错因：收费项）。
8 规则：R125.3 若补全式空位在 learn to 后，then 取目的（improve your own slides and presentations）；前置手段（find／download）与附加服务（Flash／promote）不作学习内容。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（to＋原形）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条是 learn how to。
