**34. 答案：pay a small fee（If you want to get the industry's best online privacy, you need to pay a small fee.）**
1 题面：框架 "If you want to get the industry's best online privacy, you need to __________."；空位在 to 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "For a small fee, you can get the industry's best online privacy(网络隐私) or publicly promote your presentations and slide shows with top rankings(排名)."；诱导信号：But aside from that, it's FREE 是转折，说明这是例外。
2 候选：①pay a small fee；②use it for free；③download presentations；④change files into Flash。
3 验算：①→For a small fee, you can get the industry's best online privacy，For a small fee 与 pay 对应→成立。②→use for free 与"要付费"相反→不成立。③④→是免费服务→排除。
4 干扰：But aside from that, it's FREE 紧跟其后，强调免费，容易让人答"免费使用"；download 也反复出现。
5 意图：考"if you want X（收费项），需要 pay a small fee；free 是其余部分"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 pay a small fee。若问 What else can you get for a small fee? 答 Top rankings for your presentations（public promotion）。
7 错误：A 填 use it for free.（错因：相反）；B 填 download presentations.（错因：免费项）；C 填 register an account.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R125.4 若题干 if you want X 且原文用 For a small fee, you can get X，then 取 pay a small fee；同段的"免费"（aside from that, it's FREE）只说明其余项目，不作本项答案。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（need to＋原形）；复用 R111.3（表语取费用），本条是 need to pay。

**35. 答案：PowerShow.com（Introduction to PowerShow.com.）**
1 题面：框架 "Which of the following could be the title of the passage? Introduction to __________."；空位在 Introduction to 后，须为专名；全文介绍 *PowerShow.com* 的功能、免费特性与收费项；诱导信号：business／education 等适用领域很多，容易被当标题。
2 候选：①PowerShow.com；②PowerPoint presentations；③online training；④free websites。
3 验算：①→全文以 PowerShow.com 为介绍对象，Introduction to＋专名符合框架→成立（专名照抄，含 .com）。②→PowerPoint 是它所分享的文件类型→排除。③→online training 是领域之一→排除。④→free websites 是泛称，不指特定站点→排除。
4 干扰：PowerPoint presentations 与网站功能直接相关；适用领域列举长，也像主题。
5 意图：考"标题取被介绍的对象专名（PowerShow.com），文件类型与领域列举不作对象"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 PowerShow.com。若问 What is the passage mainly about? 答 It introduces the website PowerShow.com and its free features。
7 错误：A 填 PowerPoint presentations.（错因：文件类型）；B 填 Online training.（错因：领域）；C 填 Free websites.（错因：泛称）。
8 规则：R125.5 若标题框架为 Introduction to ___，then 取全文介绍的对象专名（PowerShow.com），大小写与 .com 照抄；文件类型（PowerPoint）与适用领域（online training）不作对象；泛称（free websites）也排除。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.4 拟标题（对象型）；复用 R45.5（标题三检验），本条是"Introduction to＋专名"。

**组小结（G155 · 慧航第五套 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：which 从句定义 1（31）；并列表语 1（32）；learn to 目的 1（33）；收费条件 1（34）；标题对象 1（35）。**五题全为补全式**。

### 第八套 · Section A

**Directions:** *There are 3 passages in this section. After each passage there are 5 questions. Please read the passage and write down the answer to each question with proper words.*

### 第八套 · Passage 1

During our more than 60-year history, Trafalgar has been dedicated to creating perfectly designed travel experiences and lasting memories for our valued customers.

**Exceptional value**

By choosing to travel with Trafalgar, you can enjoy savings of up to 40% compared with independent travel.



We take care of all the details, including finding the right hotels and restaurants for you. Moreover, our charges include entrance fees, tolls (道路通行费), and other expenses. As the largest touring company with great buying power, we are able to pass on these savings directly to you.

**Fast-track entrance**

When you travel with us, you won't have to waste time standing in line at major attractions. Trafalgar takes care of all the little details, ensuring that you always have priority access to the front of the line.

**Travel with like-minded friends**

As a truly global company, you will have the opportunity to travel with English-speaking individuals from around the world. This not only enhances your travel experience but also fosters lifelong friendships with like-minded people who share your passion for exploration.

**Great savings**

We offer various ways to help you save money on your travels. Take advantage of our Early Payment Discount and Frequent Traveler Savings.

**Fast check-in**

Once you have made your booking with us, we recommend checking in online via the official website. This allows you to conveniently meet your fellow travelers before your departure, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable journey together.

16. How much can customers save by traveling with Trafalgar compared with traveling independently?

____________________

17. Which service can prevent customers from standing in line at major attractions?

____________________

18. Whom will you have the opportunity to make friends with when choosing Trafalgar?

____________________

19. To help customers save money, Trafalgar offers Frequent Traveler Savings and ______.

20. After having made the booking, customers are advised to check in ______.

**〔G156〕慧航第八套 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

> 本篇是**旅行社推介文**（Trafalgar），五个小标题分述卖点，属应用文第 8 例（广告／推介体第 2 例）。

**16. 答案：Up to 40%（They can save up to 40% compared with independent travel.）**
1 题面：How much can customers save by traveling with Trafalgar compared with traveling independently；原文 "By choosing to travel with Trafalgar, you can enjoy savings of up to 40% compared with independent travel."；疑问词 How much（问幅度）；诱导信号：同段还有 tolls／entrance fees 等费用项，容易被当"省多少"。
2 候选：①up to 40%；②40%；③all the details（服务内容）；④entrance fees and tolls（包含项）。
3 验算：①→savings of up to 40% compared with independent travel，与题干 compared with 逐字对应→成立（保留 up to 的约量）。②→丢 up to，变精确值→次优。③④→是"包含的费用"，不是节省幅度→排除。
4 干扰：40% 前的 up to 容易漏；included fees 也在同段。
5 意图：考"How much 取 savings of up to 40%，保留约量词；包含费用不作幅度"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Up to 40%。若问 What do Trafalgar's charges include? 答 Entrance fees, tolls and other expenses（as well as hotels and restaurants）。
7 错误：A 答 40%.（错因：漏 up to）；B 答 Entrance fees.（错因：包含项）；C 答 60%.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R126.1 若问 How much can sb save，then 取 savings of＋约量（up to 40%），约量词不丢；同段的包含项（entrance fees／tolls／hotels）不作节省幅度。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（百分比＋约量）；复用 R52.2（约量词不可省），本条是百分比。
10 自检：①savings of 后是什么？②up to 丢了吗？③entrance fees 是什么？

**17. 答案：The fast-track entrance（service）.**
1 题面：Which service can prevent customers from standing in line at major attractions；原文小标题 **Fast-track entrance**＋"When you travel with us, you won't have to waste time standing in line at major attractions. Trafalgar takes care of all the little details, ensuring that you always have priority access to the front of the line."；疑问词 Which service（问服务名）；诱导信号：五个小标题并列（Exceptional value／Fast-track entrance／Travel with like-minded friends／Great savings／Fast check-in）。
2 候选：①the fast-track entrance；②fast check-in（退房／值机）；③exceptional value；④great savings。
3 验算：①→小标题 Fast-track entrance 下的正文正是"不用排队、优先入场"→成立。②→fast check-in 讲的是 online check-in 与同行旅客见面→排除。③→exceptional value 讲节省 40%→排除。④→great savings 讲折扣→排除。
4 干扰：fast check-in 与 fast-track entrance 都含 fast，最易混；priority access 的表述也可被当成"值机优先"。
5 意图：考"服务名按小标题—正文配对（standing in line→fast-track entrance）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The fast-track entrance。若问 What does fast check-in allow you to do? 答 To meet your fellow travelers before departure（by checking in online）。
7 错误：A 答 Fast check-in.（错因：形近）；B 答 Great savings.（错因：折扣）；C 答 Priority luggage.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R126.2 若问 which service prevents X，then 按小标题与正文配对（standing in line→fast-track entrance）；形近的小标题（fast check-in）与其他卖点（savings／value）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（服务名配对）；复用 R41.4（按名配对），本条是小标题—正文。
10 自检：①哪个小标题讲排队？②fast check-in 讲什么？③priority access 属哪节？

**18. 答案：English-speaking individuals from around the world (like-minded people who share your passion for exploration).**
1 题面：Whom will you have the opportunity to make friends with when choosing Trafalgar；原文小标题 **Travel with like-minded friends**＋"As a truly global company, you will have the opportunity to travel with English-speaking individuals from around the world. This not only enhances your travel experience but also fosters lifelong friendships with like-minded people who share your passion for exploration."；疑问词 Whom…make friends with（问对象）；诱导信号：同段还有 fellow travelers（fast check-in 节）与 valued customers（首段）。
2 候选：①English-speaking individuals from around the world；②fellow travelers（另一节）；③valued customers（首段）；④local guides。
3 验算：①→travel with English-speaking individuals from around the world＋fosters lifelong friendships with like-minded people，两句同指→成立（可写 like-minded people）。②→fellow travelers 出自 fast check-in 节，指同行旅客，未限定"世界各地、说英语"→次优。③→valued customers 是商家对顾客的称呼→排除。④→local guides 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：fellow travelers 与"同行者"近义；like-minded 与 English-speaking 两个限定也易只取一个。
5 意图：考"对象取 Travel with like-minded friends 节的两个限定（English-speaking＋around the world）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 English-speaking individuals from around the world。若问 What does the company foster? 答 Lifelong friendships with like-minded people。
7 错误：A 答 Fellow travelers.（错因：另一节）；B 答 Local guides.（错因：无据）；C 答 Valued customers.（错因：称呼）。
8 规则：R126.3 若问 Whom will you make friends with，then 取该小标题节的限定对象（English-speaking individuals from around the world／like-minded people）；另一节的 fellow travelers 与泛称（valued customers）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（限定对象）；复用 R85.2（限定人群），本条是两个限定。
10 自检：①哪一节讲交朋友？②两个限定是什么？③fellow travelers 在哪节？

**19. 答案：the Early Payment Discount（Trafalgar offers Frequent Traveler Savings and the Early Payment Discount.）**
1 题面：框架 "To help customers save money, Trafalgar offers Frequent Traveler Savings and __________."；空位在 and 后，须为专名（优惠名）；原文 **Great savings** 节 "We offer various ways to help you save money on your travels. Take advantage of our Early Payment Discount and Frequent Traveler Savings."；诱导信号：同段 savings of up to 40% 是另一节的数字。
2 候选：①the Early Payment Discount；②savings of up to 40%（另一节）；③entrance fees（包含项）；④priority access（另一节）。
3 验算：①→Early Payment Discount and Frequent Traveler Savings，与题干 and 结构对应（顺序相反）→成立（专名首字母大写照抄）。②→是 Exceptional value 节的数字→排除。③→是收费包含项→排除。④→是 Fast-track 节的说法→排除。
4 干扰：up to 40% 就在前文、数字醒目；两个优惠名一个在 and 前、一个在后，顺序容易抄反但两个都是答案。
5 意图：考"and 后取另一优惠专名（the Early Payment Discount），跨节数字不作优惠名"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 the Early Payment Discount。若问 What is Frequent Traveler Savings? 答 One of the ways Trafalgar helps customers save money。
7 错误：A 填 savings of up to 40%.（错因：数字）；B 填 entrance fees.（错因：包含项）；C 填 frequent traveler discount.（错因：专名改写）。
8 规则：R126.4 若补全式空位在 and 后与另一优惠名并列，then 取该专名（the Early Payment Discount），大小照抄、顺序可换；跨节的百分比（up to 40%）与包含项（entrance fees）不作优惠名。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（专名）；复用 R57.1（专名照抄），本条是并列专名。
10 自检：①and 前是什么？②另一优惠名是什么？③40% 属哪节？

**20. 答案：online (via the official website)（After having made the booking, customers are advised to check in online.）**
1 题面：框架 "After having made the booking, customers are advised to check in __________."；空位在 check in 后，须为副词／方式；原文 **Fast check-in** 节 "Once you have made your booking with us, we recommend checking in online via the official website."；诱导信号：同节 This allows you to conveniently meet your fellow travelers 是目的。
2 候选：①online；②at the airport（常识）；③via the official website（方式状语，与 online 同指）；④before departure（时间）。
3 验算：①→recommend checking in online，方式副词→成立（可补 via the official website）。②→airport 原文未提→排除。③→与 online 同指，可作补充，但空位在 check in 后更贴 online→次优。④→before departure 是目的句里的时间→排除。
4 干扰：at the airport 是常识；via the official website 紧随 online，也像答案。
5 意图：考"check in 后取方式副词（online），常识（at the airport）与同指短语不作首选"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 online。若问 Why is online check-in recommended? 答 To meet fellow travelers before departure。
7 错误：A 填 at the airport.（错因：常识）；B 填 before departure.（错因：时间）；C 填 by phone.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R126.5 若补全式空位在 check in 后，then 取方式副词（online），可补同指短语（via the official website）；常识（at the airport）与时间（before departure）不作方式。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（副词）；复用 R51.1（表语位），本条是方式副词。
10 自检：①check in 后是什么？②official website 是同指吗？③airport 有据吗？

**组小结（G156 · 慧航第八套 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：百分比＋约量 1（16）；小标题—服务配对 1（17）；限定对象 1（18）；并列专名 1（19）；方式副词 1（20）。
- 规则：R126.1 up to 40%（16）；R126.2 小标题配对（17）；R126.3 限定对象（18）；R126.4 并列专名（19）；R126.5 check in online（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R126.1 与"包含费用"冲突，savings 优先；R126.2 与"fast check-in 形近"冲突，正文配对优先；R126.3 与"fellow travelers"冲突，本节限定优先；R126.4 与"40% 醒目"冲突，并列专名优先；R126.5 与"airport 常识"冲突，原文方式优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**旅行社推介文（应用文第 8 例）**；五节小标题各配一题，是"小标题—正文配对"的完整样本；数字（40%／60-year）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第八套 · Passage 2

Life expectancy (寿命) is rising in much of the world. But doctors are seeing another trend that is disturbing. Some people are choosing lifestyles that result in early death. A new US study looks at four lifestyle choices that prevent people from staying healthy and living longer.



It used to be rare for people to live to 100. But babies born in the US today can hope to live that long. In the 20th century, life expectancy in wealthy nations increased by as much as 30 years. Average life expectancy for Americans is 78. But doctors are seeing people adopt bad habits that can cut their lives short, such as eating too much fast food, exercising too little and smoking cigarettes. These habits increase the risk for cancer, heart disease and stroke.

Researchers at Harvard University and the University of Washington wanted to find out how many years are lost with these lifestyle choices. They found that high blood pressure, smoking and overweight account for five years of loss of life expectancy in men and about four years in women at the national level. The researchers broke the data into race, income and location, and they found even greater differences. Middle-income whites have the best blood pressures. But Asian-Americans have fewer bad habits and the best health. They are not getting heart disease because of low blood pressure. They are not getting cancer because they have low risk factors for cancer, including smoking.

21. Some people's early death is the result of their ______.

22. Babies born nowadays in the US can be expected to live to ______.

23. What is the average life expectancy for Americans?

____________________

24. Exercising too little and smoking cigarettes can increase the risk for ______.

25. Compared with Asian-Americans, middle-income whites have ______.

**〔G157〕慧航第八套 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：lifestyles（lifestyle choices）（Some people's early death is the result of their lifestyles.）**
1 题面：框架 "Some people's early death is the result of their ______."；空位在 their 后，须为名词（复数）；原文 "Some people are choosing lifestyles that result in early death."＋"doctors are seeing people adopt bad habits that can cut their lives short"；诱导信号：bad habits 是 lifestyles 的具体内容。
2 候选：①lifestyles（lifestyle choices）；②bad habits（具体）；③fast food（更具体）；④race and income。
3 验算：①→choosing lifestyles that result in early death，result in 与题干 result of 对应（主客对调）→成立。②→bad habits 是 lifestyles 的下位，可作补充→次优。③→fast food 是 bad habits 之一→排除。④→race／income 是研究分组维度→排除。
4 干扰：bad habits 与 fast food 都很具体，容易被当"result of"的对象；第一段末 four lifestyle choices 也提示答案是 lifestyles。
5 意图：考"result of their 取上位名词（lifestyles），具体习惯不作概括"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 their lifestyles（lifestyle choices）。若问 What habits can cut lives short? 答 Eating too much fast food, exercising too little and smoking。
7 错误：A 填 bad habits.（错因：下位）；B 填 fast food.（错因：更下位）；C 填 race and income.（错因：分组维度）。
8 规则：R127.1 若补全式为 the result of their ___，then 取上位名词（lifestyles），具体习惯（bad habits／fast food）只作补充；研究分组维度（race／income／location）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（复数名词）＋RA-1.4 原因；复用 R15.2（取类名），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①lifestyles 与 result in 怎么对应？②bad habits 是上位吗？③race 是什么维度？

**22. 答案：100（Babies born nowadays in the US can be expected to live to 100.）**
1 题面：框架 "Babies born nowadays in the US can be expected to live to ______."；空位在 to 后，须为年龄数字；原文 "It used to be rare for people to live to 100. But babies born in the US today can hope to live that long."；诱导信号：下一句 In the 20th century, life expectancy…increased by as much as 30 years 是另一个数字。
2 候选：①100；②78（average）；③30 years（增幅）；④century（改写）。
3 验算：①→used to be rare to live to 100＋babies can hope to live that long，that 回指 100→成立。②→78 是"美国人平均寿命"（第 23 题）→不成立。③→30 years 是 20 世纪的增幅→排除。④→century 是改写，题干要年龄→次优。
4 干扰：78 与 30 都在同段；that long 的回指需要还原到 100。
5 意图：考"live to 取年龄 100（that 回指），平均寿命与增幅不作本句"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 100（或 a century）。若问 How much did life expectancy increase in the 20th century? 答 By as much as 30 years。
7 错误：A 填 78.（错因：平均值）；B 填 30 years.（错因：增幅）；C 填 60.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R127.2 若补全式空位在 live to 后，then 取年龄数字（100），并解 that 回指；同段的平均值（78）与增幅（30 years）不作本句答案。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（数字）＋RA-2.1 回指；复用 R65.3（回指取旧物），本条是 that long。
10 自检：①that 指什么？②78 是什么？③30 years 是什么？

**23. 答案：78.**
1 题面：What is the average life expectancy for Americans；原文 "Average life expectancy for Americans is 78."；疑问词 What is the average（问数值）；诱导信号：同段 100／30 years／78 三个数字并列。
2 候选：①78；②100；③30；④60。
3 验算：①→Average life expectancy for Americans is 78，主系表直接给出→成立。②→100 是"婴儿有望活到"的目标→排除。③→30 是 20 世纪增幅→排除。④→60 无据→排除。
4 干扰：100 更醒目、更"美好"；30 years 紧跟 increase。
5 意图：考"average life expectancy 取 78，目标值与增幅不作平均"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 78。若问 What can babies born today hope to do? 答 To live to 100。
7 错误：A 答 100.（错因：目标值）；B 答 30.（错因：增幅）；C 答 82.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R127.3 若问 average life expectancy，then 取 is 后的数字（78）；同段的目标值（100）与增幅（30 years）按名词排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（数值配对）；复用 R53.3（按名配对），本条是统计值。
10 自检：①average 对应哪个数字？②100 是什么？③30 是什么？

**24. 答案：cancer, heart disease and stroke（Exercising too little and smoking cigarettes can increase the risk for cancer, heart disease and stroke.）**
1 题面：框架 "Exercising too little and smoking cigarettes can increase the risk for __________."；空位在 for 后，须为疾病并列；原文 "These habits increase the risk for cancer, heart disease and stroke."；诱导信号：These habits 回指上一句三项习惯（fast food／little exercise／smoking）。
2 候选：①cancer, heart disease and stroke；②heart disease only；③early death；④high blood pressure。
3 验算：①→increase the risk for cancer, heart disease and stroke，三项并列→成立（三项都写）。②→漏两项→次优。③→early death 是结果，不是"risk for"的疾病→排除。④→high blood pressure 是第三段的"折寿因素"之一，不是本句的 risk for 清单→次优。
4 干扰：high blood pressure 与 smoking／overweight 在第三段并列，像"同义答案"；三项并列长，容易只写一项。
5 意图：考"risk for 取三项疾病并列，第三段的折寿因素不作本句清单"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 cancer, heart disease and stroke。若问 What do high blood pressure, smoking and overweight account for? 答 Five years of lost life expectancy in men and about four in women。
7 错误：A 填 early death.（错因：结果）；B 填 high blood pressure.（错因：另一段因素）；C 填 cancer only.（错因：漏项）。
8 规则：R127.4 若补全式空位在 increase the risk for 后，then 取三项疾病并列（cancer／heart disease／stroke）；结果（early death）与另一段的折寿因素（high blood pressure）不作本句清单。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词并列）；复用 R22.2（include 取全），本条是 risk for。
10 自检：①for 后有几项？②high blood pressure 在哪段？③early death 是疾病吗？

**25. 答案：the best blood pressures（Compared with Asian-Americans, middle-income whites have the best blood pressures.）**
1 题面：框架 "Compared with Asian-Americans, middle-income whites have __________."；空位在 have 后，须为名词短语；原文 "Middle-income whites have the best blood pressures. But Asian-Americans have fewer bad habits and the best health."；诱导信号：But 后是 Asian-Americans 的优势（fewer bad habits／best health），题干问的是"中产白人"。
2 候选：①the best blood pressures；②the best health；③fewer bad habits；④lower risk factors。
3 验算：①→Middle-income whites have the best blood pressures，主语配对→成立。②③④→都是 Asian-Americans 的优势（fewer bad habits and the best health／low risk factors）→排除。
4 干扰：But 后的 best health 更"强"，容易被当答案；题干的 Compared with 结构也让人去找"对方更好"的项。
5 意图：考"compared with 问的是前者（middle-income whites）的项，but 后是对方优势，不可换位"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 the best blood pressures。若问 What are Asian-Americans' advantages? 答 Fewer bad habits and the best health（low blood pressure, low cancer risk factors）。
7 错误：A 填 the best health.（错因：对方优势）；B 填 fewer bad habits.（错因：对方优势）；C 填 the best income.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R127.5 若题干 Compared with B, A have ___，then 取 A 对应的项（middle-income whites→the best blood pressures）；But 后属 B 的优势（best health／fewer bad habits）不换位。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.41 多主体配对（对比结构）；复用 R13.2（对比取侧），本条是 Compared with。
10 自检：①A 是谁？②A 的优势是什么？③But 后是谁的优势？

**组小结（G157 · 慧航第八套 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：上位名词 1（21）；年龄＋回指 1（22）；统计值 1（23）；三项疾病 1（24）；对比取侧 1（25）。
- 规则：R127.1 上位 lifestyles（21）；R127.2 live to 100（22）；R127.3 average 78（23）；R127.4 risk for 三项（24）；R127.5 Compared with 取 A（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R127.1 与"bad habits 具体"冲突，上位优先；R127.2 与"78／30 同段"冲突，that 回指优先；R127.3 与"100 醒目"冲突，average 配对优先；R127.4 与"high blood pressure 并列"冲突，本句清单优先；R127.5 与"But 后 best health"冲突，主语配对优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：健康统计说明文首见（寿命研究 + 群体差异）；本篇四个数字（100／30／78／4-5 年）均照录，**无换算、无推算**（4-5 年是原文给出，不需计算）。

### 第八套 · Passage 3

Borrowing to start a business is not easy. Getting a bank loan, particularly for a new small business, is like going through the eye of a needle.

Banks favor established business people with a solid credit rating and a large bank account. They should also have experience in the business they propose to enter, and offer well-prepared business plans that show the ability to repay the loans. If you are not such a person, then you need to double your preparations to convince the banker to lend you that much needed start-up capital. If your business is new and small, bankers will need to know as much as possible about you and your business.

However, many small business owners often make the mistake of not being well prepared when going to the bank to apply for the loan. Surprisingly, many loan applicants don't even have the slightest idea how or when they intend to repay the money they request. Often they don't even know how much money they need. When asked how



much money they want to borrow, many people give these two common responses: "How much money can I get?" and "As much as possible." Is it any wonder that lenders say no?

Therefore, the key step before requesting a loan is to thoroughly prepare before you ask for a loan.

26. The underlined sentence in paragraph 1 means getting a bank loan is ______.

27. What kind of people do banks prefer to give a loan to?

____________________

28. If your business is in the start stage, why do you need to be well-prepared?

____________________

29. A common mistake made by numerous small business owners is ______.

30. What is the most important thing before borrowing a loan?

____________________

**〔G158〕慧航第八套 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：very difficult（The underlined sentence means getting a bank loan is very difficult.）**
1 题面：框架 "The underlined sentence in paragraph 1 means getting a bank loan is ______."；划线句为 "Getting a bank loan, particularly for a new small business, is like going through the eye of a needle."；疑问词 means（句意／比喻释义）；诱导信号：eye of a needle 的字面义"针眼"。
2 候选：①very difficult；②very easy；③very cheap；④very fast。
3 验算：①→is like going through the eye of a needle，针眼极窄，喻"极难"；且前句 Borrowing to start a business is not easy 同向→成立。②→与 not easy 相反→不成立。③④→原文未提费用／速度→排除。
4 干扰：needle 的字面画面强；not easy 只是轻描淡写，学生可能答"not easy"（可接受但不如 very difficult 贴切）。
5 意图：考"比喻句取喻义（very difficult），字面（针眼）不译文"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 very difficult（或 not easy）。若问 What is the passage mainly about? 答 How to prepare for a business loan。
7 错误：A 答 very easy.（错因：反义）；B 答 like a needle.（错因：字面）；C 答 expensive.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R128.1 若划线句为比喻（like going through the eye of a needle），then 取喻义（very difficult），并用前句（not easy）印证；字面（needle）与无关属性（cheap／fast）不译。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.3 划线句释义（比喻）；复用 R36.4（比喻拆解），本条是"窄门"喻。
10 自检：①针眼喻什么？②前句说了什么？③我译了字面吗？

**27. 答案：Established business people with a solid credit rating and a large bank account.**
1 题面：What kind of people do banks prefer to give a loan to；原文 "Banks favor established business people with a solid credit rating and a large bank account. They should also have experience in the business they propose to enter, and offer well-prepared business plans that show the ability to repay the loans."；疑问词 What kind of people（问人群）；诱导信号：后句 They should also have experience… 是附加条件。
2 候选：①established business people with a solid credit rating and a large bank account；②people with experience only；③new small businesses；④people with well-prepared plans only。
3 验算：①→Banks favor established business people with a solid credit rating and a large bank account，favor 的宾语＋两个 with 限定→成立（写主句即可，可补经验与计划）。②④→They should also… 是附加条件，单写一项不完整→次优。③→new small business 恰是"难贷"的对象→排除。
4 干扰：experience／well-prepared plans 在下一句，像"主要条件"；new small business 是全文主题词。
5 意图：考"prefer 的对象取 favor 的主句（established＋credit rating＋bank account），附加条件不作主体"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Established business people with a solid credit rating and a large bank account。若问 What else should they have? 答 Experience and well-prepared business plans。
7 错误：A 答 New small businesses.（错因：相反）；B 答 People with good plans only.（错因：附加条件）；C 答 Anyone with an idea.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R128.2 若问 What kind of people do banks prefer，then 取 favor 的主句（established business people＋solid credit rating＋large bank account），可补附加条件（experience／plans）；new small business 是反面对象，不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（条件链）；复用 R85.2（限定人群），本条是三个限定。
10 自检：①favor 后是什么？②experience 属主句吗？③new small business 能取吗？

**28. 答案：To convince the banker to lend you the start-up capital.**
1 题面：If your business is in the start stage, why do you need to be well-prepared；原文 "If you are not such a person, then you need to double your preparations to convince the banker to lend you that much needed start-up capital."；疑问词 why（问目的）；诱导信号：If you are not such a person 是条件，to convince 才是目的。
2 候选：①to convince the banker to lend the start-up capital；②to show the ability to repay（前句，针对已有企业者）；③to open a bank account；④to find a partner。
3 验算：①→double your preparations to convince the banker to lend you that much needed start-up capital，to do 即目的→成立。②→show the ability to repay 是 well-prepared plans 的作用（前句主语是 established people）→次优。③④→原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：show the ability to repay the loans 就在前句、语气正式；start-up capital 一词较专业。
5 意图：考"目的取 to convince 句（说服银行家放贷），前句的作用不作本问目的"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 To convince the banker to lend you the start-up capital。若问 What should a business plan show? 答 The ability to repay the loans。
7 错误：A 答 To show the ability to repay.（错因：前句作用）；B 答 To open an account.（错因：无据）；C 答 To borrow as much as possible.（错因：反面做法）。
8 规则：R128.3 若问 why do you need to be well-prepared，then 取 to do 目的（convince the banker to lend the start-up capital）；前句对"已有企业者"的要求（show ability to repay）不作本问目的。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 目的（to do）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条是条件＋目的。
10 自检：①to do 是什么？②show ability 针对谁？③我是" newcomers"吗？

**29. 答案：not being well prepared（A common mistake made by numerous small business owners is not being well prepared.）**
1 题面：框架 "A common mistake made by numerous small business owners is __________."；空位在 is 后，须为动名词短语（否定）；原文 "However, many small business owners often make the mistake of not being well prepared when going to the bank to apply for the loan."；诱导信号：后文两个例子（不知道何时还、不知道要多少）是表现。
2 候选：①not being well prepared；②not knowing how much money they need（表现之一）；③asking for as much as possible（表现之二）；④not having a bank account。
3 验算：①→make the mistake of not being well prepared，mistake of＋动名词→成立。②③→是"没准备好"的具体表现→次优。④→原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：两个引语（How much can I get?／As much as possible）很生动，容易被当"mistake"本身。
5 意图：考"mistake 取 of 后的概括（not being well prepared），具体表现不作概括"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 not being well prepared。若问 What do many applicants not know? 答 How or when they intend to repay, and how much they need。
7 错误：A 填 asking for as much as possible.（错因：表现）；B 填 not knowing how much they need.（错因：表现）；C 填 borrowing too much.（错因：改写）。
8 规则：R128.4 若补全式为 a common mistake is ___，then 取 mistake of 后的动名词概括（not being well prepared）；具体表现（不知何时还／不知要多少／要得越多越好）不作概括。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（动名词）＋RA-1.5；复用 R34.3（抽象取上位），本条是 mistake of。
10 自检：①mistake of 后是什么？②两个引语属什么？③要否定的动名词怎么写？

**30. 答案：To prepare thoroughly (before asking for a loan)（The most important thing before borrowing a loan is to prepare thoroughly.）**
1 题面：What is the most important thing before borrowing a loan；原文 "Therefore, the key step before requesting a loan is to thoroughly prepare before you ask for a loan."；疑问词 What is the most important thing（问关键步骤）；诱导信号：前文列的"不知道要多少"等是错误，不是关键步骤。
2 候选：①to prepare thoroughly（before asking）；②to know how much you need（前文错误的反面）；③to find a bank with low interest；④to have a large bank account。
3 验算：①→the key step before requesting a loan is to thoroughly prepare，主系表直接给出→成立。②→是"准备"的一部分，范围偏窄→次优。③④→原文未提（large account 是银行偏好）→排除。
4 干扰：know how much you need 与"准备"直接相关；large bank account 在前段。
5 意图：考"key step 取主系表（to thoroughly prepare），具体准备项不作概括"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 To prepare thoroughly。若问 What is the key step? 答 Thorough preparation before asking for a loan。
7 错误：A 答 To know how much you need.（错因：具体项）；B 答 To borrow as much as possible.（错因：错误做法）；C 答 To have a large account.（错因：银行偏好）。
8 规则：R128.5 若问 the most important thing before doing X，then 取 the key step is to do 的表语（prepare thoroughly）；具体准备项（know how much／repay plan）与银行偏好（large account）不作概括。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.1 主旨／关键步骤；复用 R41.2（主旨取总），本条是 key step。
10 自检：①key step 后是什么？②具体项能替代吗？③large account 是谁的条件？

**组小结（G158 · 慧航第八套 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：比喻句释义 1（26）；条件链取主句 1（27）；目的 to do 1（28）；mistake 取概括 1（29）；关键步骤取表语 1（30）。
- 规则：R128.1 针眼喻"极难"（26）；R128.2 favor 主句取三限定（27）；R128.3 目的取 to convince（28）；R128.4 mistake 取动名词概括（29）；R128.5 key step 取 prepare thoroughly（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R128.1 与"字面针眼"冲突，喻义优先；R128.2 与"experience／plans 附加条件"冲突，主句优先；R128.3 与"show ability 前句"冲突，to convince 优先；R128.4 与"两个引语生动"冲突，概括优先；R128.5 与"具体准备项"冲突，key step 优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：创业贷款说明文首见；本篇"错误—正确"对照（不准备 vs 充分准备）与 G82 的"条件—策略"互补；数字无，**无换算、无推算**；**第八套 3 篇至此完成（G156—G158）**。

### 第六套 · Section A

**Directions:** *There are 4 passages in this section. After each passage there are 5 questions. Please read the passage and write down the answer to each question with proper words.*

### 第六套 · Passage 1

Sea horses are unusual animals. The female sea horses lay the eggs, but unlike other creatures, it's the males that give birth to the young.

Male sea horses have a brood pouch (育儿袋). During the breeding season, the sea horse's pouch swells to receive eggs. A female sea horse lays up to 200 eggs at a time in the pouch. Then she swims off, leaving her male



partner to care for the developing eggs and give birth to young sea horses. The female will return every day to check on her mate and the eggs, but she doesn't stay long, nor does she take part in the birth.

It takes about six weeks for the eggs in the male's pouch to develop. During this time the male avoids open water and hides in sea grass. His big pouch makes it difficult for him to swim, so the male often uses his tail to grasp a piece of sea grass. Firmly gripping the grass, he will stay perfectly still for hours or even days. The male sea horse will change his color to blend with his surroundings. The eggs hatch inside the male's pouch. When the babies begin moving around, the male sea horse knows it's time for them to be born. He grabs a sea grass stem with his tail and begins rocking, bending his body back and forth. This causes the opening to enlarge until it is wide enough for the first baby sea horse to shoot out. Sometimes he has to press his pouch against a rock or some stiff seaweed to force the young out.

Usually it takes two days for the father sea horse to give birth to all his young. He is very tired when it's over.

16. Who gives birth to the young sea horses?

____________________

17. How long does it take for the eggs in the male's pouch to develop?

____________________

18. When the male is taking care of the eggs, the female sea horse checks on ______.

19. How does the male sea horse protect himself and his eggs?
He grasps a piece of sea grass, stays still for long, and ______.

20. The male sea horse rocks and bends his body back and forth in order to ______.

**〔G159〕慧航第六套 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

> 本篇为**动物科普说明文**（海马），五题中 18／19／20 为补全式；注意第 2 段在 04 转写中跨页断行（"leaving her male｜partner…"），第 3 段一整段合为一行，均照抄不改。

**16. 答案：The males (male sea horses).**
1 题面：Who gives birth to the young sea horses；原文 "The female sea horses lay the eggs, but unlike other creatures, it's the males that give birth to the young."；疑问词 Who gives birth（问施动者）；诱导信号：同句前半 The female sea horses lay the eggs 是最醒目的主语。
2 候选：①the males；②the females；③both parents；④the pouch。
3 验算：①→it's the males that give birth to the young，强调句焦点即答案→成立。②→female 只负责产卵→不成立。③→nor does she take part in the birth，母海马不参与生产→排除。④→pouch 是器官→排除。
4 干扰：The female sea horses lay the eggs 在最前，主语先入；unlike other creatures 的对比也容易被忽略。
5 意图：考"Who 取强调句焦点（the males），产卵者（female）不作生产者的答案"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The males。若问 What do female sea horses do? 答 They lay the eggs（up to 200 at a time in the pouch）。
7 错误：A 答 The females.（错因：产卵当生产）；B 答 Both parents.（错因：与 nor does she take part 相反）；C 答 The pouch.（错因：器官）。
8 规则：R129.1 若问 Who gives birth，then 取 it is…that 强调句的焦点（the males）；产卵者（the females）与不参与方（nor does she take part）按动作分工排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（施动者）；复用 R80.5（Who 取主语），本条是强调句。
10 自检：①强调句焦点是谁？②female 做什么？③pouch 是什么？

**17. 答案：About six weeks.**
1 题面：How long does it take for the eggs in the male's pouch to develop；原文 "It takes about six weeks for the eggs in the male's pouch to develop."；疑问词 How long（问时长）；诱导信号：末段 Usually it takes two days for the father sea horse to give birth 是另一个时长。
2 候选：①about six weeks；②two days（生产时长）；③24 hours；④200 eggs（数量）。
3 验算：①→It takes about six weeks for the eggs…to develop，主句直接给出→成立（保留 about）。②→two days 是"生完所有小海马"的时长→不成立。③→原文无→排除。④→200 是产卵数量→排除。
4 干扰：two days 在末段、也讲海马生产，容易与六周混；200 数字醒目。
5 意图：考"How long 取对应事件的时长（develop→six weeks），另一事件（give birth→two days）按事件配对"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 About six weeks。若问 How long does the father take to give birth to all his young? 答 About two days。
7 错误：A 答 Two days.（错因：生产时长）；B 答 Six weeks.（错因：漏 about，可接受但原文有 about）；C 答 200.（错因：数量）。
8 规则：R129.2 若问 How long does it take for X to develop，then 取同句时长（about six weeks），保留 about；同篇另一事件的时长（two days 生产）按事件排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（时长按事件）；复用 R58.3（时长取整体表达），本条是两事件对照。
10 自检：①develop 对应多长？②two days 是什么事件？③200 是什么？

**18. 答案：her mate and the eggs（When the male is taking care of the eggs, the female sea horse checks on her mate and the eggs.）**
1 题面：框架 "When the male is taking care of the eggs, the female sea horse checks on __________."；空位在 checks on 后，须为名词并列；原文 "The female will return every day to check on her mate and the eggs, but she doesn't stay long…"；诱导信号：but she doesn't stay long 是补充，不是 check on 的宾语。
2 候选：①her mate and the eggs；②her mate only；③the young；④the pouch。
3 验算：①→check on her mate and the eggs，两项并列→成立（两项都写）。②→漏 the eggs→次优。③→the young 尚未出生（此时是蛋）→排除。④→pouch 是雄海马的器官→排除。
4 干扰：her mate 在前、更像"重点"；every day 的频率也抢注意。
5 意图：考"check on 取两项并列（mate＋eggs），频率与补充说明不作宾语"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 her mate and the eggs。若问 How often does she return? 答 Every day（but she doesn't stay long）。
7 错误：A 填 her mate.（错因：漏项）；B 填 the young.（错因：时点错）；C 填 the pouch.（错因：器官）。
8 规则：R129.3 若补全式空位在 check on 后，then 取两项并列（her mate and the eggs），两项都写；频率（every day）与器官（pouch）不作宾语；the young 在此阶段尚未出生。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词并列）；复用 R22.2（include 取全），本条是 check on。
10 自检：①check on 后有几项？②the young 出生了吗？③pouch 是谁的？

**19. 答案：changes his color to blend with his surroundings（He grasps a piece of sea grass, stays still for long, and changes his color to blend with his surroundings.）**
1 题面：框架 "He grasps a piece of sea grass, stays still for long, and __________."；空位在 and 后、与 grasps／stays 并列，须为第三人称单数谓语；原文 "Firmly gripping the grass, he will stay perfectly still for hours or even days. The male sea horse will change his color to blend with his surroundings."；诱导信号：前句的 gripping 是分词，框架已改成 grasps。
2 候选：①changes his color to blend with his surroundings；②change his color（原形）；③hatches the eggs（事实错）；④presses his pouch against a rock（后文，生产阶段）。
3 验算：①→will change his color to blend with his surroundings，与 and 前两谓语并列，改三人称单数→成立（to blend 表目的）。②→change 与 grasps／stays 形式不一致→不成立。③→the eggs hatch inside the pouch，不是他孵→排除。④→presses against a rock 是"生产时"的动作，不属"保护自己与卵"这一组→次优。
4 干扰：后文 He grabs a sea grass stem…begins rocking 与"抓草"重复，容易混入；hatch 的主语也易弄错。
5 意图：考"and 后并列谓语取 changes his color（三人称单数），并把后段的生产动作 excluded"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 changes his color to blend with his surroundings。若问 Why does he change color? 答 To blend with his surroundings（to hide）。
7 错误：A 填 change his color.（错因：形式不合）；B 填 hatches the eggs.（错因：主语错）；C 填 presses his pouch against a rock.（错因：生产动作）。
8 规则：R129.4 若补全式空位在 and 后与前两个三人称单数谓语并列，then 取 changes his color（to blend…），形式随框架改；生产阶段的动作（presses against a rock／begins rocking）不属"保护"这组；hatch 的主语是蛋，不是雄海马。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（并列谓语）＋RA-1.30；复用 R124.4（并列谓语保形式），本条是三人称单数。
10 自检：①and 前是什么形式？②hatch 的主语是谁？③presses 属哪个阶段？

**20. 答案：make the opening enlarge (wide enough for the first baby to shoot out)（The male sea horse rocks and bends his body back and forth in order to make the opening enlarge.）**
1 题面：框架 "The male sea horse rocks and bends his body back and forth in order to __________."；空位在 in order to 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "He grabs a sea grass stem with his tail and begins rocking, bending his body back and forth. This causes the opening to enlarge until it is wide enough for the first baby sea horse to shoot out."；诱导信号：This causes… 的 This 回指"摇动、前后弯身"。
2 候选：①make the opening enlarge（wide enough）；②press his pouch against a rock（备选办法）；③grasp a sea grass stem（前置动作）；④hatch the eggs（事实错）。
3 验算：①→This causes the opening to enlarge until it is wide enough，与"rocking／bending"因果相连→成立（可补 wide enough for the baby to shoot out）。②→Sometimes he has to press… 是"有时"的备选，不是摇动的目的→次优。③→grasp 是前置动作（抓草以固定身体）→排除。④→hatch 主语是蛋→排除。
4 干扰：press against a rock 紧随其后、也讲"开口"；grasp a sea grass stem 与"抓草"重复出现。
5 意图：考"in order to 取 This causes 的宾语补足（make the opening enlarge），备选办法不作目的"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 make the opening enlarge（/ to make the opening wide enough for the baby to shoot out）。若问 What does he do if the opening is not wide enough? 答 He presses his pouch against a rock or some stiff seaweed。
7 错误：A 填 press his pouch against a rock.（错因：备选）；B 填 grasp a sea grass stem.（错因：前置动作）；C 填 hatch the eggs.（错因：主语错）。
8 规则：R129.5 若补全式问 in order to，then 取 This causes…to do 的补足（make the opening enlarge），可补 until 从句的结果（wide enough for the baby to shoot out）；"Sometimes he has to…"的备选办法与前置动作不作目的。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（in order to＋原形）＋RA-1.4 目的；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条是 causes＋to do。
10 自检：①This 指什么？②causes 后是什么？③press 是备选吗？

**组小结（G159 · 慧航第六套 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：施动者（强调句）1（16）；时长按事件 1（17）；check on 两项 1（18）；并列谓语取色变 1（19）；目的取 causes＋to do 1（20）。
- 规则：R129.1 强调句焦点（16）；R129.2 时长按事件（17）；R129.3 check on 两项（18）；R129.4 并列谓语取 changes（19）；R129.5 目的取 make the opening enlarge（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R129.1 与"female 先出现"冲突，强调句优先；R129.2 与"two days 同篇"冲突，事件配对优先；R129.3 与"mate 更像重点"冲突，并列取全；R129.4 与"hatch 语义近"冲突，主语优先；R129.5 与"press 紧随"冲突，本期目的优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：动物科普首见（海马：雄性育儿）；本篇"产卵 vs 生产""发育 vs 出生"两组事件分工是 04 的样本；数字（200 eggs／six weeks／two days）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第六套 · Passage 2

Subways are underground trains, which usually operate 24 hours a day. They are found in larger cities and usually run between suburbs and downtown areas. Maps and schedules are available from the ticket office. If you take the subway often, you can save money by purchasing a monthly pass (月票).

City-operated buses run on various routes (线路) and are designed to be at certain places at certain times. Maps and schedules may be posted at certain stops, or they may be available at local banks, libraries, student unions, or from bus drivers. Buses run mainly during the day. Fare is paid by exact change in coins, or by monthly passes.



Taxis are generally more expensive in the United States than in other countries. If you use a taxi, be sure you ask the amount of the fare before you agree to ride. The driver usually expects a tip (小费) of 15 percent of the fare.

____________________

22. According to the passage, subways are underground trains, which usually run ______.

23. Where can you get the maps and schedules?

____________________

24. How is fare paid?

____________________

25. When you take a taxi, you'd better first ______.

**〔G160〕慧航第六套 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：24 hours a day.**
1 题面：How long do underground trains operate a day；原文 "Subways are underground trains, which usually operate 24 hours a day."；疑问词 How long（问时长）；诱导信号：同段还有 monthly pass／larger cities 等信息。
2 候选：①24 hours a day；②during the day（公交）；③from suburbs to downtown；④every day。
3 验算：①→operate 24 hours a day，与 How long 直接对应→成立。②→Buses run mainly during the day 是公交的运营时间→不成立。③→是运行区间，不是时长→排除。④→every day 是频次，不是"一天内多长"→次优。
4 干扰：Buses run mainly during the day 在下一段，两种交通工具的时长容易混；downtown 出现两次。
5 意图：考"How long 取 24 hours a day（地铁），公交的白天运营不作地铁时长"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 24 hours a day。若问 When do buses run? 答 Mainly during the day。
7 错误：A 答 During the day.（错因：公交）；B 答 Every day.（错因：频次）；C 答 Between suburbs and downtown.（错因：区间）。
8 规则：R130.1 若问 How long do subways operate，then 取 24 hours a day；同段/下一段公交的"白天"与频次（every day）不作地铁时长。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（时长）；复用 R58.3（时长取整体表达），本条是"全天"。
10 自检：①地铁运营多久？②公交何时运营？③区间是哪句？

**22. 答案：between suburbs and downtown areas（Subways are underground trains, which usually run between suburbs and downtown areas.）**
1 题面：框架 "According to the passage, subways are underground trains, which usually run __________."；空位在 run 后，须为地点状语；原文 "They are found in larger cities and usually run between suburbs and downtown areas."；诱导信号：同段 Maps and schedules are available from the ticket office 是另一信息。
2 候选：①between suburbs and downtown areas；②in larger cities（范围）；③during the day（时间）；④on various routes（公交）。
3 验算：①→usually run between suburbs and downtown areas，run 后地点状语→成立。②→in larger cities 是"出现在哪"，不是"运行区间"→次优。③→during the day 是公交时间→排除。④→various routes 是公交的线路特点→排除。
4 干扰：in larger cities 紧挨在 run 前，像地点；various routes 也是线路。
5 意图：考"run 后取区间状语（between suburbs and downtown areas），出现范围不作区间"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 between suburbs and downtown areas。若问 Where can subways be found? 答 In larger cities。
7 错误：A 填 in larger cities.（错因：范围）；B 填 during the day.（错因：公交时间）；C 填 on various routes.（错因：公交）。
8 规则：R130.2 若补全式空位在 run 后，then 取区间状语（between suburbs and downtown areas）；出现范围（in larger cities）与公交特征（during the day／various routes）不作区间。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（地点状语）；复用 R6.1（介词后取宾语），本条是 between…and。
10 自检：①run 后是什么？②in larger cities 是什么？③various routes 属谁？

**23. 答案：（For subways）from the ticket office；（for buses）at certain stops, local banks, libraries, student unions, or from bus drivers.**
1 题面：Where can you get the maps and schedules；原文地铁段 "Maps and schedules are available from the ticket office."；公交段 "Maps and schedules may be posted at certain stops, or they may be available at local banks, libraries, student unions, or from bus drivers."；疑问词 Where（问地点，两段各有答案）。
2 候选：①from the ticket office（地铁）＋at stops／banks／libraries／student unions／drivers（公交）；②only from the ticket office；③only from bus drivers；④at the ticket office and the airport。
3 验算：①→两段分别给出渠道，合并作答→成立（可按交通工具分答，或只答地铁的 ticket office）。②→只覆盖地铁→次优。③→只覆盖公交的一种→次优。④→airport 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：题干预设单一答案，实际两段各有一套；banks／libraries／student unions 列举长，容易只抄一个。
5 意图：考"Where 按交通工具分答（地铁 ticket office；公交 stops／banks／libraries／student unions／drivers）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 From the ticket office（for subways）；for buses, at certain stops, local banks, libraries, student unions or from bus drivers。若问 How can you save money on the subway? 答 By purchasing a monthly pass。
7 错误：A 答 Only from the ticket office.（错因：只地铁）；B 答 From bus drivers only.（错因：只一种）；C 答 At the airport.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R130.3 若问 Where can you get maps and schedules，then 按交通工具分答（地铁→ticket office；公交→stops／banks／libraries／student unions／drivers）；只答一侧即不完整；原文没有的地点（airport）不补。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（分主体作答）；复用 R79.3（跨轮取全），本条是"分段合并"。
10 自检：①地铁在哪拿？②公交在哪拿？③我只答一侧了吗？

**24. 答案：By exact change in coins, or by monthly passes.**
1 题面：How is fare paid；原文公交段 "Fare is paid by exact change in coins, or by monthly passes."；疑问词 How is fare paid（问支付方式）；诱导信号：地铁段提到 monthly pass（可以省钱），taxi 段提到 tip。
2 候选：①by exact change in coins or by monthly passes；②by credit card；③by monthly pass only；④with a tip。
3 验算：①→Fare is paid by exact change in coins, or by monthly passes，两个方式并列→成立（两项都写）。②→信用卡原文未提→排除。③→漏现金方式→次优。④→tip 是给司机的小费（15%），不是车费支付方式→排除。
4 干扰：monthly pass 在地铁段也出现（save money），容易只答它；tip 15% 数字醒目。
5 意图：考"How is fare paid 取两项并列（coins／monthly passes），小费不作车费方式"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 By exact change in coins or by monthly passes。若问 How much tip does a taxi driver expect? 答 15 percent of the fare。
7 错误：A 答 By monthly pass only.（错因：漏现金）；B 答 By credit card.（错因：无据）；C 答 With a tip.（错因：小费）。
8 规则：R130.4 若问 How is fare paid，then 取两项并列（exact change in coins／monthly passes）；小费（tip）与未提的方式（credit card）不作车费支付；地铁段的 monthly pass 可互证。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.2 方式（支付）；复用 R52.1（并列项取全），本条是支付方式。
10 自检：①两种方式是什么？②tip 是什么？③我只答月票了吗？

**25. 答案：ask the amount of the fare（When you take a taxi, you'd better first ask the amount of the fare.）**
1 题面：框架 "When you take a taxi, you'd better first __________."；空位在 first 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "If you use a taxi, be sure you ask the amount of the fare before you agree to ride."；诱导信号：The driver usually expects a tip of 15 percent 是后文补充。
2 候选：①ask the amount of the fare；②give the driver a tip；③pay by monthly pass；④ask the driver's name。
3 验算：①→be sure you ask the amount of the fare before you agree to ride，与 first 对应→成立。②→tip 是到达后的事，不是"先做"→次优。③→monthly pass 用于公交→排除。④→原文无→排除。
4 干扰：tip 15% 是本段唯一数字，容易被当"要点"；before you agree to ride 的时间关系也需还原。
5 意图：考"first 取 before 之前的动作（ask the fare），小费与公交方式不作先做"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 ask the amount of the fare。若问 Why should you ask first? 答 Because taxis are generally more expensive and the driver expects a tip。
7 错误：A 填 give a tip.（错因：后做）；B 填 pay by monthly pass.（错因：公交）；C 填 check the map.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R130.5 若补全式空位在 first 后且原文有 before you agree to ride，then 取该 before 前的动作（ask the amount of the fare）；小费（tip）与公交方式不作先做。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（had better＋原形）；复用 R110.3（had better＋原形），本条是 first。
10 自检：①before 前是什么动作？②tip 何时给？③monthly pass 用于什么？

**组小结（G160 · 慧航第六套 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：运营时长 1（21）；运行区间 1（22）；地图获取（分主体）1（23）；车费支付方式 1（24）；打车先做什么 1（25）。
- 规则：R130.1 24 hours a day（21）；R130.2 run between（22）；R130.3 分主体取渠道（23）；R130.4 两项支付方式（24）；R130.5 first 取 before 前动作（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R130.1 与"公交白天"冲突，主体优先；R130.2 与"in larger cities 紧邻"冲突，区间优先；R130.3 与"题干预设单一答案"冲突，分主体合并；R130.4 与"monthly pass 双现"冲突，两项并列优先；R130.5 与"tip 数字醒目"冲突，before 前动作优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：交通出行说明文首见（地铁／公交／出租三段并列）；本篇"分主体作答"（R130.3）与"before 前为 first"（R130.5）是 04 的样本；数字（24 hours／15 percent）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第六套 · Passage 3

A share house is money-saving. When you share a house, your rent bills and possible food cost will be much lower. If the house is already established, you don't have to worry about buying things like a fridge and TV.

**Choosing good housemates (合租人)**

Moving in with friends can be fun but it can result in conflict (冲突) and a loss of friendship. Think carefully about the type of person suited to your character.

Ask advice from friends who have lived in share houses, or consult a youth worker or a relative.

**Setting some guidelines**

Every share house is different, but there are some guidelines (准则) that can help you avoid conflict.

\* Issue or ask for a receipt (收据) when you pay or collect the rent.

\* Where possible, deal with problems through face-to-face communication.

Our Living in a Share House web page has some advice and ideas to help make sharing with your housemates a great experience.

**〔G161〕慧航第六套 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

> 本篇是**分节指南**（share house：省钱理由／选室友／立规矩），属应用文第 9 例（指南体）。

**26. 答案：Because rent bills and possible food cost will be much lower (and you needn't buy things like a fridge and TV if the house is established).**
1 题面：According to the first paragraph, why can you save your money when you share a house；原文 "A share house is money-saving. When you share a house, your rent bills and possible food cost will be much lower. If the house is already established, you don't have to worry about buying things like a fridge and TV."；疑问词 why can you save money（问原因）；诱导信号：If the house is already established 是附加条件，不是主因。
2 候选：①rent bills and food cost lower（＋不用买冰箱电视）；②because the house is already established（条件）；③because you live with friends；④because you can cook。
3 验算：①→your rent bills and possible food cost will be much lower，主因；后句补充"不用买家当"→成立（两项主因都写最好）。②→是附加条件（If…you don't have to worry），不是"省钱"的主因→次优。③→与朋友同住是"选室友"的话题，不是省钱原因→排除。④→原文未提做饭→排除。
4 干扰：fridge and TV 很具体；money-saving 是首句结论，原因在其后。
5 意图：考"原因取 rent bills＋food cost 两项，附加条件（established house）不作主因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Because rent bills and food cost will be much lower。若问 What needn't you buy in an established house? 答 Things like a fridge and TV。
7 错误：A 答 Because the house is established.（错因：条件）；B 答 Because you live with friends.（错因：另一话题）；C 答 Because rent is free.（错因：改写过度）。
8 规则：R131.1 若问 why can you save money，then 取两项主因（rent bills＋food cost will be lower），可补附加条件（established house→不用买家当）；"与朋友同住"不作省钱原因；"免费"属改写。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（主因＋条件）；复用 R36.2（并列原因取全），本条是条件与主因分层。
10 自检：①两项主因是什么？②established 是什么？③"免费"有据吗？

**27. 答案：It can result in conflict and a loss of friendship.**
1 题面：What are the potential disadvantages of moving in with friends；原文 "Moving in with friends can be fun but it can result in conflict (冲突) and a loss of friendship."；疑问词 What are the disadvantages（问缺点，复数）；诱导信号：前半 can be fun 是优点，but 后才是缺点。
2 候选：①conflict and a loss of friendship；②it can be fun（优点）；③higher rent；④buying a fridge。
3 验算：①→but it can result in conflict and a loss of friendship，两项缺点→成立（两项都写）。②→是 but 前的优点→不成立。③→与"省钱"相反→排除。④→是 established house 免去的事→排除。
4 干扰：can be fun 在前、语气积极；conflict 与 loss of friendship 是两个抽象名词，容易只写一个。
5 意图：考"but 后取两项缺点（conflict＋loss of friendship），but 前优点不作缺点"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Conflict and a loss of friendship。若问 What can moving in with friends be? 答 Fun（but also risky）。
7 错误：A 答 It can be fun.（错因：优点）；B 答 Higher rent.（错因：相反）；C 答 Buying furniture.（错因：另一段）。
8 规则：R131.2 若问 disadvantages，then 取 but 后的两项（conflict／a loss of friendship），两项都写；but 前的优点（fun）与"更贵"等相反项不作缺点。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（but 后取缺点）；复用 R37.2（but 两侧都写），本条是"取缺点一侧"。

**28. 答案：The type of person suited to your character.**
1 题面：When selecting a good housemate, what should you consider carefully；原文 "Think carefully about the type of person suited to your character."；疑问词 what should you consider（问考虑对象）；诱导信号：Ask advice from friends… 是下一步建议，不是"考虑什么"。
2 候选：①the type of person suited to your character；②friends' advice（下一步）；③the rent；④the house location。

4 干扰：Ask advice from friends who have lived in share houses 紧接其后，像"该考虑什么"；rent 在首段出现。

6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The type of person suited to your character。若问 Who can give you advice? 答 Friends who have lived in share houses（or a youth worker or a relative）。
7 错误：A 答 Friends' advice.（错因：下一步）；B 答 The rent.（错因：首段）；C 答 The house size.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R131.3 若问 what should you consider carefully，then 取 think about 后的宾语（the type of person suited to your character）；下一步建议（ask advice）与租金／地点不作考虑对象。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（考虑对象）；复用 R6.1（介词后取宾语），本条是 think about。
10 自检：①think about 后是什么？②ask advice 是什么？③租金在哪段？

**29. 答案：Issue or ask for a receipt（It is recommended to issue or ask for a receipt when you pay or collect the rent.）**
1 题面：In order to prevent a problem, what is recommended to you when you pay for your rent；原文 **Setting some guidelines** 节 "* Issue or ask for a receipt (收据) when you pay or collect the rent."；诱导信号：另一条 guideline 是 face-to-face communication，属"处理问题"而非"付租金"。
2 候选：①issue or ask for a receipt；②deal with problems face to face；③ask friends for advice；④keep a written contract。
3 验算：①→Issue or ask for a receipt when you pay or collect the rent，与"付租金时"逐字对应→成立（issue／ask 两个动作）。②→是"处理问题"的准则，不是付租金时→次优。③→是选室友段的建议→排除。④→written contract 原文未提→排除。

7 错误：A 答 Deal with problems face to face.（错因：另一条）；B 答 Ask friends for advice.（错因：选室友段）；C 答 Sign a contract.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R131.4 若问 what is recommended when you pay rent，then 取该场景的 guideline（issue or ask for a receipt），两个动词都写；另一条 guideline（face-to-face communication）按场景排除；原文没有的合同不作答案。

1 题面：Which web page can you ask for help if needed；原文 "Our Living in a Share House web page has some advice and ideas to help make sharing with your housemates a great experience."；疑问词 Which web page（问网页名）；诱导信号：前文 Ask advice from friends… 是人际渠道，不是网页。
