5 意图：考"web page 取专名（Living in a Share House），人际渠道不作网页"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The "Living in a Share House" web page。若问 Who else can you ask for advice? 答 Friends who have lived in share houses, a youth worker or a relative。
7 错误：A 答 Friends' web page.（错因：人际渠道）；B 答 A youth worker.（错因：人）；C 答 The share page.（错因：改写专名）。
8 规则：R131.5 若问 which web page，then 取专名（Living in a Share House web page），大小写照抄；人际渠道（friends／youth worker／relative）不作网页；专名不得缩写改写。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.45 专名（网页名）；复用 R57.1（专名照抄），本条是网页名。
10 自检：①网页名是什么？②friends 是网页吗？③专名写全了吗？

**组小结（G161 · 慧航第六套 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：省钱原因（主因＋条件）1（26）；but 后缺点 1（27）；考虑对象 1（28）；准则按场景 1（29）；网页专名 1（30）。
- 规则：R131.1 两项主因（26）；R131.2 but 后缺点（27）；R131.3 think about 取宾语（28）；R131.4 准则按场景（29）；R131.5 网页专名（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R131.1 与"established 条件"冲突，主因优先；R131.2 与"fun 在前"冲突，but 后优先；R131.3 与"ask advice 紧随"冲突，about 宾语优先；R131.4 与"face-to-face 更像防冲突"冲突，场景配对优先；R131.5 与"friends 也讲求助"冲突，专名优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**指南体应用文（第 9 例）**；两条 guideline 各配一场景（R131.4），是 04 的"准则—场景"样本；数字无，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第六套 · Passage 4

Do you have bright ideas? Ideas for inventions that change society or, at least, make life easier for somebody. Perhaps we all do sometimes, but we don't often make the idea a reality. Recently, in Britain, there was a competition called British Designers for Tomorrow. The competition encouraged young people to carry out their bright ideas. There were two groups in the contest: Group One was for school children under 16; Group Two was for school children over 16. And there were eleven prize winners altogether.

Neil Gunt, one of the prize winners, was called Sunshine Superman by one newspaper writing about his design. Most sunshine recorders only record direct sunlight. Neil's is more accurate and this is very important for research into ways of using solar power. With his prize of $100, Neil plans to carry on inventing.

You can do much with animation. Look at Simon West's idea from animated road signs. He uses pictures which appear to move as you go nearer to or farther away from them. This isn't a new idea. But it is new to use these pictures on road signs. "We found that people were more likely to see moving signs," said Simon.

The ideas in the competition were so inventive that we are surprised that British industry doesn't ask more schoolchildren for suggestions. Perhaps this will be the start of Pupil Power!

31. What competition was carried out recently in Britain?

____________________

32. The aim of the competition was to ______.

33. How many winners there were altogether in the competition?

____________________



34. Neil Hunt was called Sunshine Superman because his research into ______.

35. Who invented animated road signs?

____________________

**〔G162〕慧航第六套 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

> 本篇讲英国"British Designers for Tomorrow"发明比赛；注意**人名不一致**：正文作 "Neil Gunt"，题干 Q34 作 "Neil Hunt"，按"原题不改"照抄，作答时以正文所指人物为准。

**31. 答案：British Designers for Tomorrow.**
1 题面：What competition was carried out recently in Britain；原文 "Recently, in Britain, there was a competition called British Designers for Tomorrow."；疑问词 What competition（问比赛名）；诱导信号：同段还有 two groups（Group One／Group Two）与 eleven prize winners。
2 候选：①British Designers for Tomorrow；②Pupil Power（末段口号）；③Group One／Group Two（组别）；④Sunshine Superman（绰号）。
3 验算：①→a competition called British Designers for Tomorrow，called 后即比赛名→成立（专名照抄、首字母大写）。②→Perhaps this will be the start of Pupil Power 是末段设想→排除。③→组别，不是比赛名→排除。④→报纸给 Neil 的绰号→排除。
4 干扰：Pupil Power 很醒目，像"活动名"；两个组别也是比赛的一部分。
5 意图：考"比赛名取 called 后的专名，口号（Pupil Power）与组别不作名称"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 British Designers for Tomorrow。若问 How many groups were there? 答 Two（under 16／over 16）。
7 错误：A 答 Pupil Power.（错因：口号）；B 答 Group One.（错因：组别）；C 答 Sunshine Superman.（错因：绰号）。
8 规则：R132.1 若问 what competition，then 取 called 后的专名（British Designers for Tomorrow）；口号（Pupil Power）、组别（Group One／Two）与绰号（Sunshine Superman）不作名称。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.45 专名（赛事名）；复用 R57.1（专名照抄），本条是赛事。
10 自检：①called 后是什么？②Pupil Power 是什么？③组别有几个？

**32. 答案：encourage young people to carry out their bright ideas（The aim of the competition was to encourage young people to carry out their bright ideas.）**
1 题面：框架 "The aim of the competition was to __________."；空位在 to 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "The competition encouraged young people to carry out their bright ideas."；诱导信号：首句 Ideas for inventions that change society… 是引子，不是目的。
2 候选：①encourage young people to carry out their bright ideas；②change society（引子的作用）；③make life easier（引子）；④give prizes（结果）。
3 验算：①→The competition encouraged young people to carry out their bright ideas，encouraged 与 aim 对应，改不定式→成立（可写 encourage young people to carry out their ideas）。②③→是"bright ideas"可能带来的效果（change society／make life easier）→次优。④→给奖是结果与细节（$100）→排除。
4 干扰：change society／make life easier 在首两句、语义积极；prize of $100 也像"目的"。
5 意图：考"aim 取 encouraged 后的不定式（carry out their bright ideas），引子的效果不作目的"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 encourage young people to carry out their bright ideas。若问 What prize did Neil get? 答 $100。
7 错误：A 填 change society.（错因：引子效果）；B 填 give prizes.（错因：结果）；C 填 make life easier.（错因：引子效果）。
8 规则：R132.2 若补全式为 the aim was to ___，then 取 encouraged sb to do 后的不定式（carry out their bright ideas）；引子里的效果（change society／make life easier）与结果（prizes）不作目的；框架已给 to，答案不重复 to。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（to 已给）＋RA-1.4 目的；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①encouraged 后是什么？②change society 是什么？③我加 to 了吗？

**33. 答案：Eleven.**
1 题面：How many winners there were altogether in the competition；原文 "And there were eleven prize winners altogether."；疑问词 How many（问数量）；诱导信号：同段还有 two groups／under 16／over 16 与 $100。
2 候选：①eleven；②two（组数）；③$100（奖金）；④16（年龄）。
3 验算：①→eleven prize winners altogether，数量直接给出→成立。②→two groups 是组别数→不成立。③→$100 是 Neil 的奖金→排除。④→16 是年龄分界→排除。
4 干扰：two groups 与 eleven winners 都是数字，容易混；$100 也醒目。
5 意图：考"How many winners 取 eleven，组数与奖金不作人数"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Eleven。若问 How many groups were there? 答 Two。若问 How much did Neil win? 答 $100。
7 错误：A 答 Two.（错因：组数）；B 答 $100.（错因：奖金）；C 答 Sixteen.（错因：年龄）。
8 规则：R132.3 若问 how many winners，then 取 winners／altogether 同句的数字（eleven）；组数（two）、奖金（$100）与年龄（16）按名词排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（名词配对）；复用 R53.3（按名配对），本条是人数。
10 自检：①winners 对应哪个数字？②two 是什么？③$100 是谁的？

**34. 答案：ways of using solar power（Neil Hunt was called Sunshine Superman because his research into ways of using solar power.）**
1 题面：框架 "Neil Hunt was called Sunshine Superman because his research into __________."；空位在 research into 后，须为名词短语；原文 "Neil Gunt, one of the prize winners, was called Sunshine Superman by one newspaper writing about his design. Most sunshine recorders only record direct sunlight. Neil's is more accurate and this is very important for research into ways of using solar power."；诱导信号：Most sunshine recorders only record direct sunlight 是对比，不是研究内容。
2 候选：①ways of using solar power；②direct sunlight（对比项）；③sunshine recorders（他的发明）；④animated road signs（另一人）。
3 验算：①→this is very important for research into ways of using solar power，into 后即研究内容→成立。②→direct sunlight 是"多数记录器只记录"的对象→次优。③→sunshine recorder 是他的设计，不是"研究内容"→次优。④→animated road signs 属 Simon West→排除。
4 干扰：sunshine recorders 与 Sunshine Superman 同词根，最易混；animated road signs 也在本篇。
5 意图：考"research into 取 ways of using solar power，发明物（recorder）不作研究内容"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 ways of using solar power。若问 What did Neil invent? 答 A more accurate sunshine recorder。
7 错误：A 填 direct sunlight.（错因：对比项）；B 填 sunshine recorders.（错因：发明物）；C 填 animated road signs.（错因：他人）。
8 规则：R132.4 若问 research into ___，then 取 into 后的名词短语（ways of using solar power）；对比项（direct sunlight）与发明物（recorder）不作研究内容；他人设计（animated road signs）不取。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（research into）；复用 R6.1（介词后取宾语），本条是研究内容。
10 自检：①into 后是什么？②recorder 是什么？③road signs 是谁的？

**35. 答案：Simon West.**
1 题面：Who invented animated road signs；原文 "You can do much with animation. Look at Simon West's idea from animated road signs. He uses pictures which appear to move as you go nearer to or farther away from them."；疑问词 Who（问发明者）；诱导信号：Neil 的名字在前、且有 $100 奖金。
2 候选：①Simon West；②Neil Gunt（Neil Hunt）；③British industry；④Pupil Power。
3 验算：①→Look at Simon West's idea from animated road signs，idea 与人名直接对应→成立。②→Neil 的是 sunshine recorder→排除。③→British industry 是被批评的对象（不向学生求建议）→排除。④→Pupil Power 是末段口号→排除。
4 干扰：Neil 出现在前一节、名字与"阳光"相关；British industry 看似"出资方"。
5 意图：考"Who 取该发明的所属人名（Simon West），前一人物的发明按对象排除"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Simon West。若问 What did Simon's signs do? 答 The pictures appear to move as you go nearer or farther。
7 错误：A 答 Neil Hunt.（错因：他人）；B 答 British industry.（错因：机构）；C 答 Pupil Power.（错因：口号）。
8 规则：R132.5 若问 Who invented X，then 取 X 所在句的人名（Simon West）；同一篇前一发明的作者（Neil）与机构／口号不作发明者。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（发明者）；复用 R80.5（Who 取主语），本条是所属格。
10 自检：①animated road signs 与谁同句？②Neil 发明了什么？③Pupil Power 是什么？

**组小结（G162 · 慧航第六套 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：赛事专名 1（31）；目的（encouraged to do）1（32）；获奖人数 1（33）；研究内容 1（34）；发明者 1（35）。
- 规则：R132.1 赛事专名（31）；R132.2 目的取 encouraged to do（32）；R132.3 eleven（33）；R132.4 research into 取内容（34）；R132.5 发明者取人名（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R132.1 与"Pupil Power 醒目"冲突，called 后优先；R132.2 与"change society 积极"冲突，encouraged 后优先；R132.3 与"two groups"冲突，winners 配对优先；R132.4 与"recorder 同词根"冲突，into 后优先；R132.5 与"Neil 在前"冲突，对象配对优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**发明比赛报道（应用文第 10 例）**；本篇"人名不一致（Gunt／Hunt）"按原题照抄、以正文所指为准，已记入原文风险；数字（two groups／eleven winners／$100／16）均照录，**无换算、无推算**；**第六套 4 篇至此完成（G159—G162）**。

### 第十套 · Section A

**Directions:** *There are 4 passages in this section. After each passage there are 5 questions. Please read the passage and write down the answer to each question with proper words.*

### 第十套 · Passage 1

A U.N. report says water is in demand around the world as temperatures on Earth's surface rise and demand grows along with populations. The report was released this week at the World Water Forum in Brasilia. The conference has been described as the world's largest water-related event.

Federal District Governor Rodrigo Rollemberg spoke at a panel discussion on Tuesday at the forum. He



described water shortages as a worldwide problem. The public water supply has less water because of low rainfall as well as fast and disorderly growth in Brasilia, which is part of the Federal District, Rollemberg said. In January 2016, after three years of little rain, district officials began limiting how much water people could consume. The governments of the Federal District and the nearby state of Goias also gave $166 million to develop water infrastructure.

Demand around the world is expected to increase by nearly one-third by 2050. By then, five billion people could be left with poor access to water, the U.N. warned in its 2018 World Water Development Report. To avoid such a crisis, U.N. officials called for "nature-based solutions" that use or copy natural processes that should be used to increase water availability. They said solutions could include sustaining water in soil, collecting rainwater, and protecting wetlands. The officials also proposed rebuilding floodplains and said that plants could be grown on housetops. Such proposals will become more important as water industries grow.

16. Where was the World Water Forum held?

____________________________________________________________________________

17. Who made a speech on water shortage at panel discussion on Tuesday?

____________________________________________________________________________

18. The shortage of the public water supply is the result of low rainfall and ____________________.

19. When did district officials start limiting water consumption?

____________________________________________________________________________

20. Collecting rainwater is one of the ways that are included in ______________________.

**〔G163〕慧航第十套 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

> 本篇为**联合国水报告新闻**（World Water Forum），属应用文第 11 例（报道体）；五题中 18／20 为补全式。

**16. 答案：In Brasilia.**
1 题面：Where was the World Water Forum held；原文 "The report was released this week at the World Water Forum in Brasilia. The conference has been described as the world's largest water-related event."；疑问词 Where（问地点）；诱导信号：同段还有 Earth's surface／populations 等泛泛地点。
2 候选：①in Brasilia；②in Brazil（国家）；③in the Federal District（行政区）；④at the U.N.。
3 验算：①→at the World Water Forum in Brasilia，in 后即举办地→成立（专名照抄）。②→Brazil 是国家，范围偏大（Brasilia 是其首都）→次优。③→Federal District 是 Brasilia 所在的行政区（下一段提到）→次优。④→U.N. 是报告发布方→排除。
4 干扰：Brazil／Brasilia 形近；Federal District 在下一段反复出现。
5 意图：考"Where 取 in 后的城市名（Brasilia），国家与行政区不作城市"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 In Brasilia。若问 Where is Brasilia? 答 In Brazil（it is part of the Federal District）。
7 错误：A 答 In Brazil.（错因：国家）；B 答 In the Federal District.（错因：行政区）；C 答 At the U.N.（错因：发布方）。
8 规则：R133.1 若问 Where was a conference held，then 取 in 后的城市名（Brasilia），专名照抄；国家（Brazil）与行政区（the Federal District）不作城市；发布机构（U.N.）不作地点。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（城市 vs 国家）；复用 R54.1（年份按地点配对），本条是城市层级。
10 自检：①in 后是什么？②Brazil 是什么层级？③U.N. 是什么角色？

**17. 答案：Federal District Governor Rodrigo Rollemberg.**
1 题面：Who made a speech on water shortage at panel discussion on Tuesday；原文 "Federal District Governor Rodrigo Rollemberg spoke at a panel discussion on Tuesday at the forum. He described water shortages as a worldwide problem."；疑问词 Who（问发言者）；诱导信号：同段还有 the governments of the Federal District and Goias（给钱方）。
2 候选：①Rodrigo Rollemberg；②the governments of the Federal District and Goias；③U.N. officials；④the U.N. report。
3 验算：①→Rodrigo Rollemberg spoke at a panel discussion on Tuesday，spoke 的主语＝发言者→成立（可带职务 Federal District Governor）。②→gave $166 million 是出资方→排除。③→U.N. officials 在末段"呼吁 nature-based solutions"，不是周二发言→排除。④→报告是文件，不是人→排除。
4 干扰：U.N. officials 也在文中"发言"（called for）；governments 给钱的动作也强。
5 意图：考"Who 取 spoke 的主语（Rollemberg），出资方与另一位发言者按事件排除"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Rodrigo Rollemberg。若问 What did he describe water shortages as? 答 A worldwide problem。
7 错误：A 答 U.N. officials.（错因：另一处发言）；B 答 The governments.（错因：出资方）；C 答 The U.N. report.（错因：文件）。
8 规则：R133.2 若问 Who made a speech，then 取 spoke 的主语（Rodrigo Rollemberg），可带职务；同段的出资方（governments）与另一处发言者（U.N. officials）按事件排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（发言者）；复用 R80.5（Who 取主语），本条是职务＋姓名。
10 自检：①spoke 的主语是谁？②governments 做了什么？③U.N. officials 说了什么？

**18. 答案：fast and disorderly growth in Brasilia（The shortage of the public water supply is the result of low rainfall and fast and disorderly growth in Brasilia.）**
1 题面：框架 "The shortage of the public water supply is the result of low rainfall and __________."；空位在 and 后，须为名词短语；原文 "The public water supply has less water because of low rainfall as well as fast and disorderly growth in Brasilia, which is part of the Federal District, Rollemberg said."；诱导信号：同段 after three years of little rain 是时间背景。
2 候选：①fast and disorderly growth in Brasilia；②three years of little rain（时间）；③$166 million（投资）；④the Federal District（行政区）。
3 验算：①→because of low rainfall as well as fast and disorderly growth in Brasilia，as well as 后即第二原因→成立（两项并列）。②→after three years of little rain 是"限水"的时间条件（下一题）→次优。③→是补救投资→排除。④→是 Brasilia 所属行政区，作 growth 的地点限定→不单独作原因。
4 干扰：three years of little rain 与 low rainfall 语义近，容易被当第二原因；$166 million 数字醒目。
5 意图：考"as well as 后取第二原因（fast and disorderly growth），时间条件与投资不作原因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 fast and disorderly growth in Brasilia。若问 How much did the governments give? 答 $166 million（to develop water infrastructure）。
7 错误：A 填 three years of little rain.（错因：时间条件）；B 填 $166 million.（错因：投资）；C 填 the Federal District.（错因：地名）。
8 规则：R133.3 若补全式空位在 low rainfall and 后，then 取 as well as 后的第二原因（fast and disorderly growth in Brasilia）；时间条件（three years of little rain）与投资（$166 million）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词短语）＋RA-1.4 原因；复用 R36.2（并列原因取全），本条是 as well as。
10 自检：①as well as 后是什么？②three years 是什么？③$166 million 用来做什么？

**19. 答案：In January 2016.**
1 题面：When did district officials start limiting water consumption；原文 "In January 2016, after three years of little rain, district officials began limiting how much water people could consume."；疑问词 When（问时间）；诱导信号：after three years of little rain 是时长，不是时点。
2 候选：①in January 2016；②after three years of little rain；③this week（报告发布）；④by 2050（预测）。
3 验算：①→In January 2016…began limiting，时间与动作同句→成立。②→是"限水前已旱三年"的说明，不是时点→次优。③→this week 是报告发布→排除。④→2050 是需求预测→排除。
4 干扰：three years 与 January 2016 相邻；this week／2050 都是时间词。
5 意图：考"When 取动作同句的时点（In January 2016），时长（three years）不作时点"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 In January 2016。若问 How long had it been dry before that? 答 Three years（of little rain）。
7 错误：A 答 After three years of little rain.（错因：时长）；B 答 This week.（错因：报告发布）；C 答 By 2050.（错因：预测）。
8 规则：R133.4 若问 When did sb start doing X，then 取动作同句的时点（In January 2016）；时长短语（after three years）与其他事件时间（this week／2050）不作时点。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（时点 vs 时长）；复用 R67.2（年份按事件配对），本条是时点。
10 自检：①In January 2016 与哪个动作同句？②three years 是什么？③2050 是什么？

**20. 答案："nature-based solutions"（Collecting rainwater is one of the ways that are included in "nature-based solutions".）**
1 题面：框架 "Collecting rainwater is one of the ways that are included in __________."；空位在 in 后，须为名词短语（引号内术语）；原文 "U.N. officials called for "nature-based solutions" that use or copy natural processes that should be used to increase water availability. They said solutions could include sustaining water in soil, collecting rainwater, and protecting wetlands."；诱导信号：同段还列了三项具体做法（sustaining water／collecting rainwater／protecting wetlands）。
2 候选：①"nature-based solutions"；②"sustaining water in soil"（一项做法）；③"increasing water availability"（目的）；④"rebuilding floodplains"（另一项）。
3 验算：①→solutions could include…collecting rainwater，collecting 是 solutions 的下位，故 included in "nature-based solutions"→成立（引号照抄）。②④→是 include 后的并列项，不能反过来包含 collecting→排除。③→是目的（increase water availability），不是上位类别→排除。
4 干扰：三项做法都具体、都在同句；题干 included in 的方向（下位→上位）容易读反。
5 意图：考"included in 取上位术语（nature-based solutions），同句并列项是下位不作上位"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 "nature-based solutions"。若问 What are the three examples of nature-based solutions? 答 Sustaining water in soil, collecting rainwater and protecting wetlands。
7 错误：A 填 sustaining water in soil.（错因：并列下位）；B 填 increasing water availability.（错因：目的）；C 填 rebuilding floodplains.（错因：另一并列项）。
8 规则：R133.5 若补全式为 one of the ways included in ___，then 取上位术语（"nature-based solutions"），引号照抄；同句 include 后的并列项（sustaining／collecting／protecting）与目的（increase availability）都是下位或另一层，不作上位。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（术语）＋RA-1.25 类 vs 例；复用 R15.2（取类名），本条是引号术语。
10 自检：①include 后有哪些项？②哪一个是上位？③引号写了吗？

**组小结（G163 · 慧航第十套 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：城市名 1（16）；发言者 1（17）；as well as 第二原因 1（18）；时点 vs 时长 1（19）；上位术语 1（20）。
- 规则：R133.1 城市名（16）；R133.2 spoke 主语（17）；R133.3 as well as 第二原因（18）；R133.4 时点（19）；R133.5 上位术语（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R133.1 与"Brazil 形近"冲突，城市优先；R133.2 与"U.N. officials 也发言"冲突，周二 panel 优先；R133.3 与"three years 语义近"冲突，as well as 优先；R133.4 与"three years 相邻"冲突，动作同句优先；R133.5 与"三项做法具体"冲突，上位优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**联合国水报告报道（应用文第 11 例）**；本篇"下位→上位"（R133.5）与"时点 vs 时长"（R133.4）是 04 的样本；数字（$166 million／2050／five billion／one-third）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第十套 · Passage 2

The United States covers a large part of the North American continent. Its neighbors are Canada to the north and Mexico to the south. Although the United States is a big country, it is not the largest in the world. In 2000, its population was over 222 million.

When this land first became a nation, after winning its independence from England, it had thirteen states. Each of the states was represented on the American flag by a star. All these states were in the eastern part of the continent. As the nation grew toward the west, new states were added and new stars appeared on the flag. For a long time, there were 48 stars. In 1959, however, two more stars were added to the flag, representing the new states of Alaska and Hawaii.



Indians were the first people of the land which is now the United States. There are still many thousands of Indians now living in all parts of the country. Sometimes it is said that the Indians are "the only real Americans". Most Americans come from all over the world. Those who came first in the greatest numbers to make their homes on the eastern coast of North America were mostly from England. It is for that reason that the language of the United States is English and that its culture and customs are more like those of England than those of any other country in the world.

21. What are the United States' neighbors?

____________________________________________________________________________

22. After winning its independence, how many states did the United States have?

____________________________________________________________________________

23. What did a star on the American flag mean?

____________________________________________________________________________

24. When did the United States have fifty states?

____________________________________________________________________________

25. Who came first on the eastern coast of North America?

____________________________________________________________________________

**〔G164〕慧航第十套 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：Canada (to the north) and Mexico (to the south).**
1 题面：What are the United States' neighbors；原文 "Its neighbors are Canada to the north and Mexico to the south."；疑问词 What are the neighbors（问邻国，复数）；诱导信号：同段还有 the North American continent／over 222 million。
2 候选：①Canada and Mexico；②England and France（历史来源）；③Alaska and Hawaii（新州）；④North America（洲）。
3 验算：①→neighbors are Canada…and Mexico…，两项并列→成立（两项都写）。②→England 是殖民来源国，不是陆上邻国→排除。③→Alaska／Hawaii 是 1959 年加入的州→排除。④→North America 是洲名，含美国自身→排除。
4 干扰：England 在第三段反复出现；Alaska／Hawaii 也在第二段。
5 意图：考"neighbors 取两个邻国（Canada／Mexico），历史来源与洲名不作邻国"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Canada and Mexico。若问 Where is Canada? 答 To the north of the United States。
7 错误：A 答 England and France.（错因：来源国）；B 答 North America.（错因：洲）；C 答 Alaska and Hawaii.（错因：州）。
8 规则：R134.1 若问 What are the neighbors，then 取两项邻国（Canada＋Mexico），两项都写；来源国（England）、洲名（North America）与新州（Alaska／Hawaii）不作邻国。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（邻国）；复用 R45.1（清单取全），本条是地理项。
10 自检：①两个邻国是谁？②England 是什么角色？③North America 能作邻国吗？

**22. 答案：Thirteen (states).**
1 题面：After winning its independence, how many states did the United States have；原文 "When this land first became a nation, after winning its independence from England, it had thirteen states."；疑问词 how many states（问数量）；诱导信号：同段还有 48 stars／two more stars／fifty（推算值）。
2 候选：①thirteen；②forty-eight；③fifty；④two。
3 验算：①→it had thirteen states，数量直接给出→成立。②→48 是"很长一段时间"的星数→排除。③→fifty 是 1959 年后的总数（48＋2）→排除。④→two 是 1959 年新增的州数→排除。
4 干扰：48／50／two 三个数字都与州数有关；题干 after winning its independence 是时间限定。
5 意图：考"how many 取建国初的数目（thirteen），后期数字按时间排除"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Thirteen。若问 How many stars were on the flag for a long time? 答 48。
7 错误：A 答 Fifty.（错因：1959 年后）；B 答 Forty-eight.（错因：长期）；C 答 Two.（错因：新增数）。
8 规则：R134.2 若问 how many states after independence，then 取 thirteen（原文 it had thirteen states）；后期的 48／50 与新增的 two 按时间排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（按时间限定）；复用 R69.2（时点截断），本条是历史数量。
10 自检：①建国时几个州？②48 是什么时期？③two 是什么？

**23. 答案：It represented one state (each state had its own star).**
1 题面：What did a star on the American flag mean；原文 "Each of the states was represented on the American flag by a star."；疑问词 What did a star mean（问含义）；诱导信号：后文 new states were added and new stars appeared 是同一机制的展开。
2 候选：①it represented one state；②it represented one city；③it represented independence；④it represented a president。
3 验算：①→Each of the states was represented…by a star，star 与 state 一一对应→成立。②→city 原文未提→排除。③→independence 是历史事件→排除。④→president 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：winning its independence 在同段，容易被当"星的含义"；fifty stars 的总数也像答案。
5 意图：考"含义取 be represented by 的对应关系（one state per star）"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 It represented one state。若问 How many stars are there now? 答 Fifty。
7 错误：A 答 Independence.（错因：历史事件）；B 答 A city.（错因：无据）；C 答 Fifty states.（错因：总数）。
8 规则：R134.3 若问 what did a star mean，then 取 be represented by 的对应关系（one state per star），答案写成"一个州"；独立事件与星数总数不作含义。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.20 象征定义（星＝州）；复用 R47.5（象征取同位），本条是国旗符号。
10 自检：①star 与什么对应？②independence 是什么？③总数是多少？

**24. 答案：In 1959.**
1 题面：When did the United States have fifty states；原文 "For a long time, there were 48 stars. In 1959, however, two more stars were added to the flag, representing the new states of Alaska and Hawaii."；疑问词 When（问年份）；诱导信号：题干 fifty 在原文没有直接出现，需由 48＋2 得出。
2 候选：①in 1959；②for a long time（48 星时期）；③in 2000（人口）；④in 1706（另一篇）。
3 验算：①→In 1959…two more stars were added（48＋2＝50），与 fifty states 对应→成立（年份即可，无须写算式）。②→for a long time 是 48 星时期，不是五十州时点→不成立。③→2000 是人口统计年份（下一段开头）→排除。④→1706 是 Franklin 出生年（另一篇）→排除。
4 干扰：题干 fifty 需一步加法（48＋2），容易被"for a long time"或"two more"干扰；2000 也在本篇首段。
5 意图：考"时间取 1959（48＋2＝50 的年份），48 星时期与其它年份不作答案"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 In 1959。若问 Which two states were added in 1959? 答 Alaska and Hawaii。
7 错误：A 答 For a long time.（错因：48 星时期）；B 答 In 2000.（错因：人口年份）；C 答 In 1948.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R134.4 若问 When did the US have fifty states，then 取 48＋2 那一年（In 1959）；"for a long time"（48 星时期）与其它年份（2000／1706）不作答案；答案写年份即可，不必写算式。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（推算年份）；复用 R70.5（年份加算）的思路：48＋2＝50，本条只需给年份。
10 自检：①48＋2 发生在哪年？②for a long time 指什么？③2000 是什么？

**25. 答案：People from England (English settlers).**
1 题面：Who came first on the eastern coast of North America；原文 "Those who came first in the greatest numbers to make their homes on the eastern coast of North America were mostly from England."；疑问词 Who came first（问人群）；诱导信号：上一句 Indians were the first people of the land 也含 first，但说的是"这片土地最早的居民"。
2 候选：①people from England；②Indians；③people from all over the world；④the Puritans only。
3 验算：①→Those who came first…were mostly from England，与 eastern coast 同句→成立（可写 English settlers）。②→Indians 是"the first people of the land"，不是"来到东海岸的第一批移民"→次优（题干 came 指向移民）。③→Most Americans come from all over the world 是总体，不是"最先"→排除。④→Puritans 是另一篇（Franklin 父母）的身份→排除。
4 干扰：Indians were the first people 就在上句，first 字面重合；Puritans 也在同套另一篇。
5 意图：考"came first 取'最早大批来定居'的人群（from England），原住民不是'来'的移民"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 People from England。若问 Who were the first people of the land? 答 Indians。
7 错误：A 答 Indians.（错因：原住民≠移民）；B 答 People from all over the world.（错因：总体）；C 答 The Puritans.（错因：串篇）。
8 规则：R134.5 若问 Who came first on the eastern coast，then 取 came first…were mostly from＋来源地（England）；原住民（Indians，the first people of the land）与总体来源（all over the world）不作"来定居的第一批"；别篇身份（Puritans）不串。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（原住民 vs 移民）；复用 R74.1（主体配对），本条是"came vs were"的分工。
10 自检：①came first 与谁同句？②Indians 是"来"的吗？③Puritans 在哪篇？

**组小结（G164 · 慧航第十套 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：邻国 1（21）；建国州数 1（22）；星的含义 1（23）；五十州年份 1（24）；最早移民来源 1（25）。
- 规则：R134.1 两项邻国（21）；R134.2 thirteen（22）；R134.3 星＝一州（23）；R134.4 1959（24）；R134.5 came first 取英格兰移民（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R134.1 与"England 反复出现"冲突，邻国优先；R134.2 与"48／50／two"冲突，时间限定优先；R134.3 与"independence 同段"冲突，represent 对应优先；R134.4 与"for a long time"冲突，48＋2 年份优先；R134.5 与"Indians the first people"冲突，came 指向移民。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：国情地理说明文首见（美国疆域与移民史）；本篇"原住民 vs 移民"（R134.5）与"48＋2＝50 的年份"（R134.4）是 04 的样本；数字（222 million／thirteen／48／two／1959／2000）均照录，**无新增推算**（1959 只需给年份，不写算式）。

### 第十套 · Passage 3

For a long time, doctors have been aware that incredibly intense noises have the potential to cause hearing damage or even loss. The noise can be the sound of a jet airplane or machines in factories or loud music or other common sounds found at home or at work. A person only needs to be exposed to the noise for slightly longer than a second for it to have an impact on them.

An American scientist has discovered that taking aspirin(阿司匹林) can temporarily(暂时地) increase hearing loss or damage caused by loud noise. He did an experiment, using a number of male students at a university who all had normal hearing. He gave them different amounts of aspirin for different periods of time, and then he tested their hearing ability. He found that the students who were given four grams of aspirin a day for two days suffered much greater temporary hearing loss than those who did not use aspirin. The degree of hearing loss was approximately twice as severe. The scientist said millions of people in the United States use much larger amounts of aspirin than were used in the study. He said these people face a serious danger of suffering hearing loss from loud noise.



26. What can extremely loud noises cause?

____________________________________________________________________________

27. When exposed to the noise, how long does it take for a person to be affected?

____________________________________________________________________________

28. What is the link between aspirin and hearing loss?

____________________________________________________________________________

29. In the experiment, the students who took aspirin suffered hearing loss ______ as severely as those who didn't use aspirin.

30. Millions of Americans are in danger of suffering hearing loss from loud noise because they ______.

**〔G165〕慧航第十套 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

**26. 答案：Hearing damage or even loss.**
1 题面：What can extremely loud noises cause；原文 "For a long time, doctors have been aware that incredibly intense noises have the potential to cause hearing damage or even loss."；疑问词 What can X cause（问结果）；诱导信号：后句列举 jet airplane／machines／loud music 三类噪声源。
2 候选：①hearing damage or even loss；②jet airplanes（噪声源）；③loud music（噪声源）；④temporary deafness only。
3 验算：①→have the potential to cause hearing damage or even loss，cause 后两项并列→成立（可写 hearing damage/loss）。②③→是噪声的例子，不是结果→排除。④→temporary 是后文 aspirin 实验的限定（temporary hearing loss），不是本题的"结果"→次优。
4 干扰：三类噪声源并列，最像"cause"的对象；temporary 在后段反复出现。
5 意图：考"cause 取结果（hearing damage or even loss），噪声源不作结果"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Hearing damage or even loss。若问 What kinds of noise are mentioned? 答 Jet airplanes, machines in factories, loud music and other common sounds。
7 错误：A 答 Jet airplanes.（错因：噪声源）；B 答 Temporary deafness.（错因：后段限定）；C 答 Headache.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R135.1 若问 What can loud noises cause，then 取 cause 后的结果（hearing damage or even loss）；噪声源列举（jet／machines／music）不作结果；temporary 是后文实验的限定，不前置。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.6 结果；复用 R63.1（并列取全），本条是 cause 宾语。
10 自检：①cause 后是什么？②噪声源有哪三类？③temporary 属哪段？

**27. 答案：Slightly longer than a second.**
1 题面：When exposed to the noise, how long does it take for a person to be affected；原文 "A person only needs to be exposed to the noise for slightly longer than a second for it to have an impact on them."；疑问词 how long（问时长）；诱导信号：同段还有 for a long time（"长期以来医生已知"），方向相反。
2 候选：①slightly longer than a second；②for a long time（医生已知的时间）；③two days（实验时长）；④four grams（剂量）。
3 验算：①→for slightly longer than a second for it to have an impact，时长＋结果→成立。②→For a long time, doctors have been aware… 是"医生认识多久"，不是"暴露多久"→不成立。③→two days 是实验给药时长→排除。④→four grams 是剂量→排除。
4 干扰：For a long time 在段首、同是时间短语；two days／four grams 数字醒目。
5 意图：考"how long 取暴露时长（slightly longer than a second），医生的认识时间不作答案"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Slightly longer than a second。若问 How long were students given aspirin? 答 Two days。
7 错误：A 答 For a long time.（错因：另一时间）；B 答 Two days.（错因：实验时长）；C 答 Four grams.（错因：剂量）。
8 规则：R135.2 若问 how long does it take to be affected，then 取暴露时长（slightly longer than a second）；"for a long time"（医生认识时间）与实验参数（two days／four grams）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（事件配对）；复用 R129.2（时长按事件），本条是暴露时长。
10 自检：①暴露多久就受影响？②for a long time 讲什么？③two days 是什么？

**28. 答案：Taking aspirin can temporarily increase hearing loss or damage caused by loud noise.**
1 题面：What is the link between aspirin and hearing loss；原文 "An American scientist has discovered that taking aspirin can temporarily increase hearing loss or damage caused by loud noise."；疑问词 What is the link（问关系）；诱导信号：后文实验细节（four grams／two days／twice）是证据。
2 候选：①aspirin temporarily increases hearing loss caused by loud noise；②aspirin cures hearing loss；③aspirin causes deafness by itself；④aspirin has nothing to do with hearing。
3 验算：①→taking aspirin can temporarily increase hearing loss or damage caused by loud noise，主句即关系→成立（保留 temporarily 与"由噪声引起"两限定）。②→cures 与 increase 相反→排除。③→by itself 过头：原文限定"loud noise 引起的"且"temporary"→不成立。④→与 discovered 相反→排除。
4 干扰：deafness 的严重程度容易被夸大；temporarily 与 caused by loud noise 两个限定常被丢。
5 意图：考"关系取主句并保留两限定（temporarily／caused by loud noise），不夸大"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Taking aspirin can temporarily increase hearing loss caused by loud noise。若问 How much aspirin did students take? 答 Four grams a day for two days。
7 错误：A 答 Aspirin causes deafness.（错因：夸大、丢限定）；B 答 Aspirin cures hearing loss.（错因：相反）；C 答 Aspirin has no effect.（错因：相反）。
8 规则：R135.3 若问 the link between A and B，then 取主句（A can temporarily increase B caused by…），保留 temporarily 与限定来源（loud noise）；不得夸大为"导致耳聋"或反向"治愈"。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（关系）；复用 R43.4（领悟取 that 从句），本条是 discovered that。
10 自检：①关系句是什么？②两个限定是什么？③我夸大了吗？

**29. 答案：about twice（approximately twice）（The students who took aspirin suffered hearing loss about twice as severely as those who didn't use aspirin.）**
1 题面：框架 "In the experiment, the students who took aspirin suffered hearing loss __________ as severely as those who didn't use aspirin."；空位在 as severely as 前，须为程度副词／倍数；原文 "He found that the students who were given four grams of aspirin a day for two days suffered much greater temporary hearing loss than those who did not use aspirin. The degree of hearing loss was approximately twice as severe."；诱导信号：much greater 是笼统比较，approximately twice 是具体倍数。
2 候选：①about twice；②much greater（笼统）；③four times；④the same。
3 验算：①→approximately twice as severe，与 as…as 结构吻合→成立（about／approximately 同义）。②→much greater 不能直接进 as severely as 框架（缺倍数）→次优。③→four times 原文无（four grams 是剂量）→排除。④→the same 与 greater 矛盾→排除。
4 干扰：four grams 的 four 容易被误作倍数；much greater 也在同句。
5 意图：考"倍数取 approximately twice（约两倍），剂量数字（four grams）不作倍数"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 about twice。若问 How much aspirin was given? 答 Four grams a day for two days。
7 错误：A 填 four times.（错因：剂量当倍数）；B 填 much greater.（错因：笼统比较）；C 填 the same.（错因：相反）。
8 规则：R135.4 若补全式空位在 as…as 前，then 取具体倍数（approximately twice→about twice）；笼统比较（much greater）填不进框架；剂量（four grams）不作倍数。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（倍数）＋RA-1.7 数量；复用 R53.3（按名配对），本条是倍数。
10 自检：①倍数是几倍？②four grams 是什么？③as…as 需要什么词？

**30. 答案：use much larger amounts of aspirin than were used in the study（Millions of Americans are in danger of suffering hearing loss from loud noise because they use much larger amounts of aspirin than were used in the study.）**
1 题面：框架 "Millions of Americans are in danger of suffering hearing loss from loud noise because they __________."；空位在 they 后，须为谓语（动词短语）；原文 "The scientist said millions of people in the United States use much larger amounts of aspirin than were used in the study. He said these people face a serious danger of suffering hearing loss from loud noise."；诱导信号：前句 four grams a day for two days 是研究用量。
2 候选：①use much larger amounts of aspirin than were used in the study；②take four grams a day（研究用量）；③are exposed to loud noise（另一半原因）；④take aspirin for two days。
3 验算：①→use much larger amounts of aspirin than were used in the study，与"处于危险"直接相连→成立（保留比较结构）。②④→是研究中的用量，不是"美国人"的用量→不成立。③→是危险的另一半（from loud noise），题干 because 后要的是"人的行为"→次优。
4 干扰：four grams／two days 同段；loud noise 也是危险来源。
5 意图：考"because they 取人的行为（use much larger amounts of aspirin），研究用量与噪声不作人的行为"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 use much larger amounts of aspirin than were used in the study。若问 What danger do they face? 答 A serious danger of hearing loss from loud noise。
7 错误：A 填 take four grams a day.（错因：研究用量）；B 填 are exposed to loud noise.（错因：另一半原因）；C 填 have normal hearing.（错因：相反）。
8 规则：R135.5 若补全式空位在 because they 后，then 取人的行为（use much larger amounts of aspirin than were used），保留比较结构；研究用量（four grams／two days）与噪声暴露（from loud noise）不作"他们的行为"。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（谓语）＋RA-1.4 原因；复用 R59.2（形式随框架改），本条是 because 从句。
10 自检：①they 做什么？②four grams 是谁的用量？③loud noise 是什么角色？

**组小结（G165 · 慧航第十套 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：结果 1（26）；暴露时长 1（27）；关系（两限定）1（28）；倍数 1（29）；原因从句 1（30）。
- 规则：R135.1 cause 取结果（26）；R135.2 暴露时长（27）；R135.3 关系保留两限定（28）；R135.4 倍数 about twice（29）；R135.5 because 从句取行为（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R135.1 与"噪声源并列"冲突，结果优先；R135.2 与"for a long time 段首"冲突，事件配对优先；R135.3 与"deafness 夸大"冲突，限定优先；R135.4 与"four grams 的 four"冲突，倍数优先；R135.5 与"four grams 同段"冲突，主语行为优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：科学实验说明文（第 2 篇，G77 孤独与饥饿之后）；本篇"剂量 vs 倍数"（R135.4）与"两限定不丢"（R135.3）是 04 的样本；数字（four grams／two days／twice／millions）均照录，**无换算、无推算**（倍数由原文给出）。

### 第十套 · Passage 4

Volunteering is a good way to practice important skills used in the workplace. If you're considering a new career, volunteering can help you get experience in your area of interest and meet people in the field.

You might feel more comfortable stretching your wings at work once you've gained these skills in a volunteer position.

Volunteering offers you the opportunity to try out a new career. Without making a long-term effort, it is also a great way to gain experience in a new field. You can volunteer directly at an organization that does the kind of work you're interested in. Your volunteer work might also introduce you to professional organizations that could be of benefit to your career.

Volunteer work is unpaid, but this does not mean the skills you learn are basic. Many volunteering opportunities provide a wide range of training. Volunteering can also help you build upon skills you already have and use them to benefit the greater community. For instance, if you hold a successful sales position, you can further develop and improve your public speaking, communication, and marketing skills.

31. If you're considering a new career, volunteering can help you ____________________.

32. By saying "stretching your wings at work" (Para. 2), the author means being ______ at work.

33. Volunteering can also offer you a chance to ______________________________.



34. The skills you gain from a sales position in volunteering can help you develop and strengthen your ______________________________.

35. The best title of the passage might be "________________ Does Benefit Your Career".

**〔G166〕慧航第十套 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

> 本篇五题**全部是补全式**（框架已给），主题为"志愿服务对职业的益处"。

**31. 答案：get experience in your area of interest and meet people in the field（If you're considering a new career, volunteering can help you get experience in your area of interest and meet people in the field.）**
1 题面：框架 "If you're considering a new career, volunteering can help you __________."；空位在 help you 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "If you're considering a new career, volunteering can help you get experience in your area of interest and meet people in the field."；诱导信号：前句 Volunteering is a good way to practice important skills 是总起。
2 候选：①get experience in your area of interest and meet people in the field；②practice important skills（总起句）；③try out a new career（下段）；④build upon skills you already have（末段）。
3 验算：①→help you get experience…and meet people…，两个原形并列→成立（两项都写）。②→是首句的概括，不是 if 从句后的具体帮助→次优。③→try out a new career 是第三段的机会→次优。④→是末段的另一益处→排除。
4 干扰：practice important skills 在最前；try out a new career 也很近。
5 意图：考"help you 后取同句两个原形并列（get experience＋meet people），总起句与其他段的益处不作本句"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 get experience in your area of interest and meet people in the field。若问 What can help you practice workplace skills? 答 Volunteering。
7 错误：A 填 practice important skills.（错因：总起句）；B 填 try out a new career.（错因：另一段）；C 填 get a job in the field.（错因：改写）。
8 规则：R136.1 若补全式空位在 help you 后，then 取同句的动词原形并列（get experience／meet people），两项都写；总起句（practice skills）与其他段的益处（try out／build upon）按段落排除。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（help sb do）＋RA-1.5；复用 R111.1（can 后原形），本条是 help sb do。
10 自检：①help you 后有几项？②practice 在哪句？③try out 在哪段？

**32. 答案：more comfortable（…the author means being more comfortable at work.）**
1 题面：框架 "By saying "stretching your wings at work" (Para. 2), the author means being ______ at work."；划线短语所在句 "You might feel more comfortable stretching your wings at work once you've gained these skills in a volunteer position."；疑问方式：习语／比喻释义（stretch one's wings）；诱导信号：stretch 的字面"伸展"。
2 候选：①more comfortable；②more skillful；③more tired；④more careful。
3 验算：①→You might feel more comfortable stretching your wings at work，feel more comfortable 与 being…at work 对应→成立。②→skillful 是"gained these skills"的结果，不是该短语的释义→次优。③④→原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：gained these skills 在前半句，容易被当"being skillful"；stretch 字面也像"更用力"。
5 意图：考"比喻短语取同句的情感词（feel more comfortable），技能不是释义"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 more comfortable。若问 What might you feel after gaining skills in a volunteer position? 答 More comfortable stretching your wings at work。
7 错误：A 填 more skillful.（错因：技能结果）；B 填 more tired.（错因：无据）；C 填 more confident.（错因：近义改写，原文用 comfortable）。
8 规则：R136.2 若问 By saying X, the author means being ___ at work，then 取同句的情感词（more comfortable）；技能结果（gained these skills→skillful）与无据词不作释义。
9 位置：04→RA-2→RA-2.3 划线句释义（比喻）；复用 R36.4（比喻拆解），本条是"伸展翅膀"。
10 自检：①同句情感词是什么？②skillful 从哪来？③我改写成 confident 了吗？

**33. 答案：try out a new career（Volunteering can also offer you a chance to try out a new career.）**
1 题面：框架 "Volunteering can also offer you a chance to __________."；空位在 to 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "Volunteering offers you the opportunity to try out a new career."；诱导信号：同段 Without making a long-term effort, it is also a great way to gain experience in a new field 是并列益处。
2 候选：①try out a new career；②gain experience in a new field（并列）；③meet people in the field（上一段）；④build upon skills（末段）。
3 验算：①→offers you the opportunity to try out a new career，opportunity 与 chance 同义→成立。②→是 also a great way to 后的另一益处，可并列但题干句式对应 opportunity→次优。③→是上一段的帮助→排除。④→末段益处→排除。
4 干扰：gain experience in a new field 与 try out 在同一段、语义近；meet people 也像"机会"。
5 意图：考"chance 取 opportunity to do 后的原形（try out a new career），同段并列益处可次选"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 try out a new career。若问 What is another benefit of volunteering? 答 Gaining experience in a new field。
7 错误：A 填 gain experience in a new field.（错因：并列益处，句式不贴）；B 填 meet people.（错因：上一段）；C 填 get a long-term job.（错因：与 without long-term effort 相反）。
8 规则：R136.3 若补全式空位在 a chance to 后，then 取 opportunity to do 后的原形（try out a new career）；同段并列益处（gain experience）可次选但句式不贴；上一段／末段益处与"长期工作"不取。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（to＋原形）；复用 R80.3（同句 to do），本条是 opportunity to。
10 自检：①opportunity 后是什么？②gain experience 是什么？③long-term 怎么说的？

**34. 答案：public speaking, communication and marketing skills（The skills you gain from a sales position in volunteering can help you develop and strengthen your public speaking, communication and marketing skills.）**
1 题面：框架 "The skills you gain from a sales position in volunteering can help you develop and strengthen your __________."；空位在 your 后，须为名词并列；原文 "For instance, if you hold a successful sales position, you can further develop and improve your public speaking, communication, and marketing skills."；诱导信号：同段 Many volunteering opportunities provide a wide range of training 是概括。
2 候选：①public speaking, communication and marketing skills；②a wide range of training（概括）；③volunteer work experience；④a successful sales position。
3 验算：①→develop and improve your public speaking, communication, and marketing skills，三项并列→成立（三项都写）。②→是"培训机会"的概括，不是具体技能→次优。③→是志愿经历，不是技能→排除。④→是前提条件（if you hold…）→排除。
4 干扰：a wide range of training 紧随前句；sales position 也在题干里出现。
5 意图：考"skills 取三项具体并列（public speaking／communication／marketing），概括（training）不作技能"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 public speaking, communication and marketing skills。若问 What does volunteer work provide besides skills? 答 A wide range of training。
7 错误：A 填 a wide range of training.（错因：概括）；B 填 sales skills.（错因：改写）；C 填 volunteer experience.（错因：经历）。
8 规则：R136.4 若补全式空位在 develop and strengthen your 后，then 取三项具体技能并列（public speaking／communication／marketing），三项都写；概括（training）与前提（sales position）不作技能。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（名词并列）；复用 R22.2（include 取全），本条是三项并列。
10 自检：①三项技能是什么？②training 是什么？③sales position 是什么成分？

**35. 答案：Volunteering（"Volunteering Does Benefit Your Career"）**
1 题面：框架 "The best title of the passage might be "__________ Does Benefit Your Career"."；空位在 Does 前作主语，须为动名词；全文讲志愿服务的益处（技能、经验、尝试新职业、培训）；诱导信号：段落中反复出现 volunteering／volunteer work。
2 候选：①Volunteering；②Training；③Sales；④Teamwork。
3 验算：①→全文主语是 volunteering，且 "Volunteering Does Benefit Your Career" 语法完整→成立（动名词作主语，Does 强调）。②→training 是其中一项益处→排除。③→sales 只是末段例子→排除。④→teamwork 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：training／sales 都在文中，像主题词；Does 的强调结构也可能让人误填动词。
5 意图：考"标题主语取全文主题动名词（Volunteering），分支词（training／sales）不作主语"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Volunteering。若问 What is the main idea? 答 Volunteering can benefit your career in many ways。
7 错误：A 填 Training.（错因：分支）；B 填 Sales.（错因：例子）；C 填 Volunteer Work Does（错因：与 Does 重复）。
8 规则：R136.5 若标题框架为 "___ Does Benefit Your Career"，then 取全文主题动名词（Volunteering），须与 Does 的单数一致；分支词（training／sales）不作主语；不得再写 Does。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.4 拟标题（主语型）；复用 R45.5（标题三检验），本条是"主题词＋强调句"。
10 自检：①全文主题是什么？②training 是什么？③我重复 Does 了吗？

**组小结（G166 · 慧航第十套 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：help you 两项 1（31）；比喻释义 1（32）；chance to 1（33）；三项技能 1（34）；标题主语 1（35）。**五题全为补全式**。
- 规则：R136.1 help you 取两项（31）；R136.2 stretching wings＝more comfortable（32）；R136.3 chance 取 opportunity to do（33）；R136.4 三项技能（34）；R136.5 标题取 Volunteering（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R136.1 与"practice skills 总起"冲突，if 从句后优先；R136.2 与"gained skills"冲突，情感词优先；R136.3 与"gain experience 并列"冲突，句式对应优先；R136.4 与"training 概括"冲突，具体并列优先；R136.5 与"training／sales 在文中"冲突，主题词优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：职业建议说明文首见（志愿服务与职业）；五题全补全式，是 RA-5 在慧航第十套的连续样本；数字无，**无换算、无推算**；**第十套 4 篇至此完成（G163—G166）**。

### 第四套 · Section A

**Directions:** *There are 4 passages in this section. After each passage there are 5 questions. Please read the passage and write down the answer to each question with proper words.*

### 第四套 · Passage 1

Welcome to Ontario Parks, a new body set up to manage Ontario's most treasured special places: the parks in our area.

We are entering a very exciting year for Ontario Parks. Last season we asked over fifteen thousand visitors in forty-five parks how we could improve our programs and services. We also looked at the thousands of comment



cards we received. As a result, new comfort stations have been added, the number of campsites has been increased and we've made other facility (设施) improvements. In addition, we'll be providing more educational programs. This year, for example, more than 40 parks will offer special day and evening activities to excite your curiosity about nature and history.

Come and discover what Ontario Parks has to offer. Our parks are places to go with families and friends for relaxation and fun. They are places where we can enrich our souls or simply get away from it all. They provide chances to explore nature, see wildlife, swim, canoe, camp, hike, picnic, ride a bike and so on. You'll enjoy some of the best outdoor experiences available anywhere in the world.

We urge you to come out and have an Ontario Parks experience!

16. What are considered as the most precious places in Ontario?

____________________

17. How many visitors did Ontario Parks ask for advice to make improvements?

____________________

18. Many parks will provide special day and evening activities which may ____________________.

19. Why should people visit Ontario Parks?

Because people can relax, have fun, enrich the soul, or ____________________.

20. The purpose of this passage is to attract ____________________.

**〔G167〕慧航第四套 · Passage 1（16—20）十层研究**

> 本篇是**公园宣传文**（Ontario Parks），属应用文第 12 例（宣传／推介体第 3 例）。

**16. 答案：The parks (in our area)（Ontario's parks are considered the most precious places.）**
1 题面：What are considered as the most precious places in Ontario；原文 "Welcome to Ontario Parks, a new body set up to manage Ontario's most treasured special places: the parks in our area."；疑问词 What are considered as the most precious places（问对象）；诱导信号：冒号前的 Ontario Parks 是机构名，冒号后才是对象。
2 候选：①the parks（in our area）；②Ontario Parks（机构）；③comfort stations（新建设施）；④campsites。
3 验算：①→Ontario's most treasured special places: the parks in our area，冒号后即对象→成立。②→Ontario Parks 是管理这些地方的机构→排除。③④→是改进项目，不是"珍贵的地方"→排除。
4 干扰：Ontario Parks 在句首、最醒目；comfort stations／campsites 也很具体。
5 意图：考"冒号后取对象（the parks），机构名不作被管理对象"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The parks（in our area）。若问 What is Ontario Parks? 答 A new body set up to manage the parks。
7 错误：A 答 Ontario Parks.（错因：机构）；B 答 Comfort stations.（错因：设施）；C 答 Campsites.（错因：设施）。
8 规则：R137.1 若问 what are the most precious places，then 取冒号后的对象（the parks in our area）；机构名（Ontario Parks）与设施（comfort stations／campsites）不作对象。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（对象）；复用 R60.5（总起句取对象），本条是冒号结构。
10 自检：①冒号后是什么？②Ontario Parks 是什么？③campsites 属哪类？

**17. 答案：Over fifteen thousand（visitors）.**
1 题面：How many visitors did Ontario Parks ask for advice to make improvements；原文 "Last season we asked over fifteen thousand visitors in forty-five parks how we could improve our programs and services."；疑问词 How many visitors（问人数）；诱导信号：同句还有 forty-five parks 与 thousands of comment cards。
2 候选：①over fifteen thousand；②forty-five（parks）；③thousands（cards）；④40（parks with activities）。
3 验算：①→over fifteen thousand visitors，数量＋名词直接对应→成立（保留 over）。②→forty-five 修饰 parks→排除。③→thousands of comment cards 是卡片数→排除。④→40 是"提供活动的公园数"→排除。
4 干扰：三个数字（15,000／45／40）都与"公园/访客"相关；thousands 也在同段。
5 意图：考"how many visitors 取 visitors 前的数量（over fifteen thousand），公园数与卡片数不作人数"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Over fifteen thousand。若问 How many parks were involved? 答 Forty-five。
7 错误：A 答 Forty-five.（错因：公园数）；B 答 Thousands.（错因：卡片）；C 答 Forty.（错因：活动公园数）。
8 规则：R137.2 若问 how many visitors，then 取 visitors 前的数量（over fifteen thousand），保留 over；同段的公园数（45／40）与卡片数（thousands）按名词排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（名词配对）；复用 R53.3（按名配对），本条是访客数。
10 自检：①visitors 前是什么？②45 修饰什么？③thousands 指什么？

**18. 答案：excite your curiosity about nature and history（Many parks will provide special day and evening activities which may excite your curiosity about nature and history.）**
1 题面：框架 "Many parks will provide special day and evening activities which may __________."；空位在 may 后，须为动词原形短语；原文 "This year, for example, more than 40 parks will offer special day and evening activities to excite your curiosity about nature and history."；诱导信号：目的在原文用 to do，题干改成 which may，须改为原形。
2 候选：①excite your curiosity about nature and history；②improve programs and services（前文）；③add comfort stations（前文）；④explore nature and see wildlife（下一段）。
3 验算：①→to excite your curiosity about nature and history，改 which may 后原形不变→成立。②③→是"改进"的内容，不是活动的作用→排除。④→是"公园能提供的体验"（下一段），不是 day／evening activities 的作用→次优。
4 干扰：explore nature／see wildlife 也在文中，语义近；programs and services 是前一段的改进对象。
5 意图：考"may 后取原形（excite your curiosity），前段改进项与下段体验不作活动作用"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 excite your curiosity about nature and history。若问 What new facilities were added? 答 New comfort stations（and more campsites）。
7 错误：A 填 improve programs and services.（错因：前段）；B 填 explore nature.（错因：下段体验）；C 填 to excite your curiosity.（错因：may 后不加 to）。
8 规则：R137.3 若补全式空位在 which may 后，then 取原文 to do 的动词原形（excite your curiosity about nature and history），不加 to；前段改进项与下段体验不作本句作用。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（情态＋原形）；复用 R59.2（形式随框架改），本条是 to do→may do。
10 自检：①原文是 to do 吗？②may 后要什么形式？③explore nature 在哪段？

**19. 答案：get away from it all（Because people can relax, have fun, enrich the soul, or get away from it all.）**
1 题面：框架 "Because people can relax, have fun, enrich the soul, or __________."；空位在 or 后、与 relax／have fun／enrich 并列，须为动词原形短语；原文 "Our parks are places to go with families and friends for relaxation and fun. They are places where we can enrich our souls or simply get away from it all."；诱导信号：同段后面还有 explore nature／see wildlife／swim 等一长串活动。
2 候选：①get away from it all；②explore nature（后续活动）；③see wildlife（后续活动）；④swim and canoe（后续活动）。
3 验算：①→we can enrich our souls or simply get away from it all，or 并列→成立（simply 可省）。②③④→是"They provide chances to…"的后续列举，与 relax／have fun／enrich 不在同一 or 结构→次优。
4 干扰：explore nature／see wildlife／swim／canoe 等动词多，容易任取一个；simply 一词也容易被当成必需。
5 意图：考"or 并列取同结构的 get away from it all，后续 chances to 列举不作本句"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 get away from it all。若问 What chances do the parks provide? 答 Chances to explore nature, see wildlife, swim, canoe, camp, hike and picnic。
7 错误：A 填 explore nature.（错因：后续列举）；B 填 swim and canoe.（错因：后续列举）；C 填 simply get away.（错因：漏 it all）。
8 规则：R137.4 若补全式空位在 or 后、与三个原形并列，then 取同结构的 get away from it all；下一句 chances to 的列举（explore／swim／canoe）不作本句并列项；simply 可省但 it all 不省。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.9 形式随框架改（并列原形）；复用 R124.4（并列谓语保形式），本条是 or 并列。
10 自检：①or 前有几个原形？②explore 属哪句？③it all 丢了吗？

**20. 答案：visitors（to come out and have an Ontario Parks experience）（The purpose of this passage is to attract visitors.）**
1 题面：框架 "The purpose of this passage is to attract __________."；空位在 attract 后，须为名词（人）；原文末句 "We urge you to come out and have an Ontario Parks experience!"＋全文"欢迎、介绍、邀请"的语气；诱导信号：全文列举大量活动，容易被答成"activities"。
2 候选：①visitors（/more visitors）；②activities；③families and friends；④wildlife。
3 验算：①→We urge you to come out…＋Come and discover what Ontario Parks has to offer，全文在"招徕游客"→成立（写 visitors 即可）。②→activities 是吸引手段，不是被吸引的人→不成立。③→families and friends 是"和谁一起来"，属游客的一部分→次优。④→wildlife 是观看对象→排除。
4 干扰：activities／families and friends 都在文中，像"吸引对象"；urge 的祈使语气也需读出"宣传目的"。
5 意图：考"purpose 取 attract＋人（visitors），活动与同行者不作被吸引对象"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 visitors（/more visitors）。若问 What can visitors do in the parks? 答 Explore nature, see wildlife, swim, canoe, camp, hike and picnic。
7 错误：A 填 activities.（错因：手段）；B 填 families and friends.（错因：同行者）；C 填 wildlife.（错因：观看对象）。
8 规则：R137.5 若补全式为 the purpose is to attract ___，then 取"人"（visitors），全文的 urge／come out 语气为证；活动（activities）、同行者（families and friends）与观看对象（wildlife）不作被吸引者。
9 位置：04→RA-3→RA-3.1 主旨／写作目的；复用 R60.5（目的取总起＋收束），本条是宣传文。
10 自检：①attract 后要什么词？②activities 是什么？③urge 句说明什么？

**组小结（G167 · 慧航第四套 Passage 1）**
- 考点分布：对象（冒号后）1（16）；访客数 1（17）；活动作用 1（18）；or 并列 1（19）；写作目的 1（20）。
- 规则：R137.1 冒号后取对象（16）；R137.2 访客数（17）；R137.3 which may 取原形（18）；R137.4 or 并列取 get away（19）；R137.5 目的取 visitors（20）。
- 冲突与优先级：R137.1 与"Ontario Parks 醒目"冲突，冒号后优先；R137.2 与"45／40 数字"冲突，名词配对优先；R137.3 与"explore nature 近义"冲突，本句 to do 优先；R137.4 与"activities 列举长"冲突，or 并列优先；R137.5 与"activities 手段"冲突，人优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**宣传文（应用文第 12 例）**；本篇"手段 vs 对象"（activities vs visitors）与"or 并列 vs 后续列举"是 04 的样本；数字（15,000／45／40）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第四套 · Passage 2

Benjamin Franklin was born in 1706 in Boston, Massachusetts. His mother and father were Puritans (清教徒). They left England and moved to the English colony of Massachusetts in order to escape persecution (迫害) for their religion. In Boston, Franklin left school when he was ten years old and worked for his father for two years. Then he went to work on his brother's newspaper. He became the editor of this paper when he was sixteen. Because he wanted to be independent, he went to Philadelphia. There he began his own newspaper. He worked hard and saved his money. And by the age of 24, he was one of the most successful men in Philadelphia.

In 1732, Franklin published a book *Poor Richards Almanac* (年鉴). Most almanacs contained information for farmers, such as information about the days and weeks of the year and about the weather. To his almanacs, Franklin added wise sayings and his observations about life. Some of these sayings are still famous today, for example "Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise." "Waste not, want not." and "A penny saved is a penny earned."

**〔G168〕慧航第四套 · Passage 2（21—25）十层研究**

**21. 答案：Boston, Massachusetts（Benjamin Franklin was originally from Boston, Massachusetts.）**
1 题面：框架 "Benjamin Franklin was originally from __________."；空位在 from 后，须为地点；原文 "Benjamin Franklin was born in 1706 in Boston, Massachusetts."；诱导信号：同段还有 England（父母来处）与 Philadelphia（他去的地方）。
2 候选：①Boston, Massachusetts；②England（父母来处）；③Philadelphia（他迁往处）；④Massachusetts only（州）。
3 验算：①→was born in 1706 in Boston, Massachusetts，出生地即"originally from"→成立。②→England 是父母离开的地方，不是他的出生地→次优。③→Philadelphia 是他成年后去的城市→排除。④→Massachusetts 是州，范围大于出生城市→次优。
4 干扰：England 在第二句、与他家庭相关；Philadelphia 也是地名。
5 意图：考"originally from 取出生地（Boston, Massachusetts），父母来处与迁往地不作出生地"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Boston, Massachusetts。若问 Where did he move later? 答 Philadelphia。
7 错误：A 答 England.（错因：父母来处）；B 答 Philadelphia.（错因：迁往地）；C 答 Massachusetts only.（错因：范围过大）。
8 规则：R138.1 若问 was originally from，then 取出生地（Boston, Massachusetts），城市＋州都写；父母来处（England）与迁往地（Philadelphia）不作出生地。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（出生地 vs 迁往地）；复用 R26.1（取城市＋国家），本条是城市＋州。
10 自检：①出生地在哪句？②England 是谁的来处？③Philadelphia 是什么地方？

**22. 答案：To escape persecution for their religion.**
1 题面：Why did Benjamin Franklin's parents move to Massachusetts；原文 "They left England and moved to the English colony of Massachusetts in order to escape persecution (迫害) for their religion."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：同句还有 moved to the English colony 的定语。
2 候选：①to escape persecution for their religion；②to find a better job；③to be near Boston；④because they were Puritans。
3 验算：①→in order to escape persecution for their religion，目的句直接给出→成立。②→原文未提→排除。③→Boston 是他出生地，不是迁移原因→排除。④→Puritans 是身份，不是原因（身份导致被迫害）→次优。
4 干扰：Puritans（清教徒）一词的宗教色彩强，容易被当"原因"；English colony 也像"为了殖民"。
5 意图：考"原因取 in order to 后的迫害（escape persecution），身份（Puritans）不作原因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 To escape persecution for their religion。若问 What religion were they? 答 Puritan。
7 错误：A 答 Because they were Puritans.（错因：身份）；B 答 To find jobs.（错因：无据）；C 答 To join the colony.（错因：结果）。
8 规则：R138.2 若问 why did sb move，then 取 in order to 后的原因（escape persecution for their religion）；身份（Puritans）与其结果（English colony）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（in order to）；复用 R20.1（句首 To do 即目的），本条是 in order to。
10 自检：①in order to 后是什么？②Puritans 是原因吗？③colony 是什么？

**23. 答案：His father（He worked for his father at the age of 11.）**
1 题面：Whom did Benjamin Franklin work for at the age of 11；原文 "In Boston, Franklin left school when he was ten years old and worked for his father for two years. Then he went to work on his brother's newspaper."；疑问词 Whom（问雇主）；诱导信号：下一句 his brother's newspaper 也含亲属。
2 候选：①his father；②his brother；③the newspaper editor；④a printer。
3 验算：①→left school at ten and worked for his father for two years，10—12 岁即"11 岁时"→成立。②→brother's newspaper 是"Then"之后的下一阶段（约 12 岁后）→不成立。③→editor 是他 16 岁时的身份→排除。④→printer 原文未提→排除。
4 干扰：his brother 在紧接的下一句；16 岁当编辑也像"工作"。
5 意图：考"时间闸门（11 岁）＋雇主配对：10—12 岁给父亲干，之后才去哥哥报社"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 His father。若问 When did he become an editor? 答 At sixteen。
7 错误：A 答 His brother.（错因：时间在后）；B 答 The editor.（错因：身份错位）；C 答 A printer.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R138.3 若问 whom did sb work for at age N，then 用年龄链定位（10 岁离校→给父亲干两年→之后哥哥报社），取该年龄段的雇主（his father）；后一阶段（brother）与身份（editor）按时间排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.3 人物（雇主＋时间闸门）；复用 R69.2（时点截断），本条是年龄链。
10 自检：①10 岁后给谁干？②哥哥报社是哪一年？③16 岁是什么身份？

**24. 答案：Because he wanted to be independent.**
1 题面：Why did Benjamin Franklin move to Philadelphia；原文 "Because he wanted to be independent, he went to Philadelphia. There he began his own newspaper."；疑问词 Why（问原因）；诱导信号：There he began his own newspaper 是结果，不是原因。
2 候选：①because he wanted to be independent；②to begin his own newspaper（结果）；③to study printing；④to be near his brother。
3 验算：①→Because he wanted to be independent, he went to Philadelphia，because 从句直接给因→成立。②→began his own newspaper 是到费城之后的结果→次优。③→原文未提→排除。④→brother 在波士顿（哥哥的报社）→排除。
4 干扰：began his own newspaper 在紧接的句子，因果顺序容易倒置；independent 一词抽象。
5 意图：考"原因取 because 从句（wanted to be independent），后续结果（began his own newspaper）不作原因"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Because he wanted to be independent。若问 What did he do in Philadelphia? 答 He began his own newspaper（and worked hard, saving money）。
7 错误：A 答 To begin his own newspaper.（错因：结果）；B 答 To work for his brother.（错因：前一阶段）；C 答 To find a printer.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R138.4 若问 why did sb move to a city，then 取 because 从句（wanted to be independent）；到该地后的结果（began his own newspaper）与前段经历（brother's paper）不作原因。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（because 从句）；复用 R57.3（起因取 because），本条是心理动机。
10 自检：①because 后是什么？②began newspaper 是原因吗？③哥哥的报社在哪？

**25. 答案：Information for farmers（such as the days and weeks of the year and the weather）.**
1 题面：What did Franklin's almanacs most contain；原文 "Most almanacs contained information for farmers, such as information about the days and weeks of the year and about the weather. To his almanacs, Franklin added wise sayings and his observations about life."；疑问词 What did they most contain（问主要内容）；诱导信号：Franklin 添加的 wise sayings 更著名。
2 候选：①information for farmers；②wise sayings（Franklin 附加）；③his observations about life（附加）；④newspaper articles。
3 验算：①→Most almanacs contained information for farmers，most 与题干 most 对应→成立（可补 such as 的两项）。②③→是他"added"的附加内容，不是"most contain"的→次优。④→newspaper 是另一件事→排除。
4 干扰：wise sayings（Early to bed…）最著名，容易被当"主要内容"；题干 most 是关键词。
5 意图：考"most contain 取 Most almanacs contained 的主干（information for farmers），added 的部分不作主体"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Information for farmers。若问 What did Franklin add to his almanacs? 答 Wise sayings and his observations about life。
7 错误：A 答 Wise sayings.（错因：附加）；B 答 Observations about life.（错因：附加）；C 答 News.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R138.5 若问 what did X mostly contain，then 取 Most＋contained 的主干（information for farmers），可补 such as 例证；"added"的附加内容（wise sayings／observations）不作主体；most 不可丢。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（主干 vs 附加）；复用 R45.1（清单取全），本条是"主体 vs 附加"。
10 自检：①Most 后是什么？②wise sayings 是他 added 的吗？③such as 有哪两项？

**组小结（G168 · 慧航第四套 Passage 2）**
- 考点分布：出生地 1（21）；迁移原因 1（22）；11 岁雇主 1（23）；迁费城原因 1（24）；年鉴主体 1（25）。
- 规则：R138.1 出生地（21）；R138.2 in order to 取原因（22）；R138.3 年龄链定雇主（23）；R138.4 because 取动机（24）；R138.5 most contain 取主干（25）。
- 冲突与优先级：R138.1 与"England／Philadelphia"冲突，出生地优先；R138.2 与"Puritans 身份"冲突，in order to 优先；R138.3 与"brother 紧邻"冲突，年龄闸门优先；R138.4 与"began newspaper 紧邻"冲突，because 优先；R138.5 与"wise sayings 著名"冲突，most 优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：人物传记（美国）第 7 篇；本篇年龄链（10→11→12→16→24）清晰，是"时间闸门"的密集样本；数字（1706／ten／two years／sixteen／24／1732）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第四套 · Passage 3

Passengers and their baggage must be checked in at least 45 minutes before departure for domestic flights and 60 minutes for international flights. Government-issued photo identification is required for all passengers. Passengers traveling across any international boundary (边界) are responsible for obtaining all necessary travel documents. Passengers may be denied boarding if travel documents are not in order. When check-in requirements are not met, a passenger may be separated from his/her bag. Frontier Airlines will gladly hold the bag in the destination baggage service office for pick-up at the passenger's convenience. Passengers must be at the gate 20 minutes before departure for boarding.

**Free Baggage Allowance for Each Ticketed Passenger**

Frontier Airlines, Inc. will accept, per ticketed passenger, two free checked bags not to exceed 62 inches and 50 pounds per piece — one carry-on bag and one personal item (purse, laptop, etc.)

NOTE: A ticket passenger may check one carry-on bag if it is within established limitations. All carry-on items must be put under a shared overhead compartment (行李舱).

**Excessive (超重) Baggage Charges**

An excess charge will be made for each piece of baggage over the free allowance and for each piece of oversized or over-weight baggage.

**〔G169〕慧航第四套 · Passage 3（26—30）十层研究**

> 本篇是**航空公司行李与值机规定**（Frontier Airlines），属应用文第 13 例（规章体）。

**26. 答案：60 minutes（A passenger who'd like to fly abroad should check in at least 60 minutes before departure.）**
1 题面：框架 "A passenger who'd like to fly abroad should check in at least __________ before departure."；空位在 at least 后，须为时间量；原文 "Passengers and their baggage must be checked in at least 45 minutes before departure for domestic flights and 60 minutes for international flights."；题干 fly abroad 即 international；诱导信号：同句 45 minutes 是 domestic。
2 候选：①60 minutes；②45 minutes（国内）；③20 minutes（登机口）；④62 inches（行李尺寸）。
3 验算：①→60 minutes for international flights，与 fly abroad 对应→成立。②→45 minutes 是 domestic flights→不成立。③→20 minutes 是"到登机口"的时间→排除。④→62 inches 是行李尺寸→排除。
4 干扰：45 与 60 在同一句对照，国内／国际容易读反；20 minutes 也是时间。
5 意图：考"时间按航班类型配对（international→60 minutes），国内与登机口时间不作国际值机"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 60 minutes。若问 How early must domestic passengers check in? 答 At least 45 minutes。
7 错误：A 答 45 minutes.（错因：国内）；B 答 20 minutes.（错因：登机口）；C 答 62 inches.（错因：尺寸）。
8 规则：R139.1 若问 international／abroad 的值机时间，then 取 60 minutes；国内（45 minutes）与登机口（20 minutes）按场景排除；尺寸（62 inches）不作时间。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.1 时间（按航班类型）；复用 R54.1（年份按地点配对），本条是分钟数配对。
10 自检：①国际是多少分钟？②45 是哪类？③20 指什么？

**27. 答案：Government-issued photo identification.**
1 题面：What is required of both domestic and international passengers for check-in；原文 "Government-issued photo identification is required for all passengers."；疑问词 What is required of both（问共同要求）；诱导信号：同段还有 travel documents（只针对国际旅客）。
2 候选：①government-issued photo identification；②travel documents（只国际）；③a ticket（常识）；④a visa（只部分国家）。
3 验算：①→is required for all passengers，all 与 both domestic and international 对应→成立。②→Passengers traveling across any international boundary are responsible for obtaining… 只针对国际→次优。③→ticket 原文未单列要求→排除。④→visa 是 travel documents 的一种→排除。
4 干扰：travel documents 同段、且"国际"限定容易被忽略；visa 是常识补充。
5 意图：考"both／all 取 all passengers 的共同要求（photo identification），只针对国际的 documents 不作共同项"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Government-issued photo identification。若问 What must international passengers obtain? 答 All necessary travel documents。
7 错误：A 答 Travel documents.（错因：只国际）；B 答 A visa.（错因：具体化）；C 答 A boarding pass.（错因：无据）。
8 规则：R139.2 若问 what is required of both A and B，then 取 for all passengers 的共同要求（government-issued photo identification）；只对国际旅客的 travel documents（及 visa）不作共同项。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.5 内容（共同 vs 专属）；复用 R63.1（并列取全），本条是 all 对应。
10 自检：①all passengers 对应哪句？②travel documents 针对谁？③visa 是什么？

**28. 答案：Two free checked bags (not exceeding 62 inches and 50 pounds per piece).**
1 题面：How much baggage is a ticketed passenger allowed free of charge；原文 "Frontier Airlines, Inc. will accept, per ticketed passenger, two free checked bags not to exceed 62 inches and 50 pounds per piece — one carry-on bag and one personal item (purse, laptop, etc.)."；疑问词 How much baggage（问免费额度）；诱导信号：破折号后的 one carry-on＋one personal item 是随身物品，不是"免费托运"。
2 候选：①two free checked bags；②one carry-on bag（随身）；③two pieces of any size（无限尺寸）；④62 inches and 50 pounds（尺寸／重量）。
3 验算：①→two free checked bags not to exceed 62 inches and 50 pounds per piece，数量＋限制→成立（可补尺寸／重量）。②→随身物品，另算→次优。③→漏 not to exceed 的限制→不成立。④→是每件的尺寸／重量上限，不是"几件"→次优。
4 干扰：破折号后的 one carry-on／one personal item 紧接，像"两件"的说明；62 inches／50 pounds 数字醒目。
5 意图：考"免费额度取 two free checked bags 并保留尺寸／重量限制，随身物品与上限不作件数"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Two free checked bags。若问 What are the size and weight limits? 答 62 inches and 50 pounds per piece。
7 错误：A 答 One carry-on bag.（错因：随身）；B 答 Two bags of any size.（错因：漏限制）；C 答 62 inches.（错因：尺寸）。
8 规则：R139.3 若问 free baggage allowance，then 取 two free checked bags，并保留 not to exceed 62 inches／50 pounds per piece 的限制；破折号后的随身物品（carry-on／personal item）与单一上限不作件数。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.7 数量（件数＋限制）；复用 R52.2（限制词不可省），本条是行李额度。
10 自检：①免费托运几件？②随身物品算吗？③尺寸限制是多少？

**29. 答案：Under a shared overhead compartment（in the overhead bin）.**
1 题面：Where must the carry-on bag be put during the flight；原文 "NOTE: A ticket passenger may check one carry-on bag if it is within established limitations. All carry-on items must be put under a shared overhead compartment (行李舱)."；疑问词 Where（问放置处）；诱导信号：同段还提到 under the seat（常见常识，但原文未说）。
2 候选：①under a shared overhead compartment；②under the seat in front；③in the baggage service office（超规行李）；④at the gate。
3 验算：①→All carry-on items must be put under a shared overhead compartment，must＋地点→成立（可写 in the overhead bin）。②→原文未提，属常识补充→不成立。③→是"行李与旅客分离"时的存放处→排除。④→gate 是登机处→排除。
4 干扰：under the seat 是乘机常识；baggage service office 在同段出现。
5 意图：考"Where 取原文 must be put 后的位置（shared overhead compartment），常识与另一场景不作答案"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Under a shared overhead compartment。若问 Where will the bag be held if check-in requirements are not met? 答 In the destination baggage service office。
7 错误：A 答 Under the seat.（错因：常识）；B 答 In the baggage service office.（错因：另一场景）；C 答 At the gate.（错因：地点错）。
8 规则：R139.4 若问 where must the carry-on be put，then 取 must be put 后的位置（under a shared overhead compartment）；常识（under the seat）与另一场景（baggage service office／gate）不作答案。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.16 地点（must 后）；复用 R56.2（only／must 必找对应），本条是规定位置。
10 自检：①must be put 后是什么？②under the seat 有据吗？③service office 何时用？

**30. 答案：Pay an excess charge（They will have to pay an excess charge for each piece）.**
1 题面：What will passengers have to do if their baggage is over the free allowance；原文 "An excess charge will be made for each piece of baggage over the free allowance and for each piece of oversized or over-weight baggage."；诱导信号：同段 NOTE 讲 carry-on 的限制，不是超规处理。
2 候选：①pay an excess charge；②leave the bag behind；③buy a new bag；④check in earlier。
3 验算：①→An excess charge will be made for each piece over the free allowance，与"超规怎么办"对应→成立（写 pay an excess charge 即可）。②→原文未提"留下"→排除。③→原文未提→排除。④→check in earlier 是值机时间，不是超规处理→排除。
4 干扰：be separated from his/her bag 是"未满足值机要求"的后果，容易与"超规"混。
5 意图：考"超规处理取 excess charge，旅客与行李分离（另一情形）不作超规后果"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 Pay an excess charge。若问 What happens if check-in requirements are not met? 答 The passenger may be separated from his/her bag。
7 错误：A 答 Leave the bag.（错因：另一情形）；B 答 Buy another ticket.（错因：无据）；C 答 Pay nothing.（错因：相反）。
8 规则：R139.5 若问 what if baggage is over the free allowance，then 取 excess charge（pay an excess charge）；"与行李分离"属未满足值机要求，不作超规后果；无据项（买新包／再买票）排除。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.6 结果（超规处理）；复用 R63.1（并列取全），本条是费用结果。
10 自检：①超规要付什么？②separated 是哪种情形？③我写了"留下"吗？

**组小结（G169 · 慧航第四套 Passage 3）**
- 考点分布：分钟数按航班类型 1（26）；共同要求 1（27）；免费额度 1（28）；放置位置 1（29）；超规处理 1（30）。
- 规则：R139.1 国际 60 minutes（26）；R139.2 共同要求取 photo ID（27）；R139.3 两件免费托运（28）；R139.4 overhead compartment（29）；R139.5 excess charge（30）。
- 冲突与优先级：R139.1 与"45 同句"冲突，航班类型优先；R139.2 与"travel documents 同段"冲突，all passengers 优先；R139.3 与"随身物品破折号"冲突，checked bags 优先；R139.4 与"under the seat 常识"冲突，must 后优先；R139.5 与"separated 情形"冲突，超规专属优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：**规章体应用文（第 13 例）**；本篇"国际／国内""共同／专属""超规／未满足值机"三组对照，是 04 的分流样本；数字（45／60 minutes／20 minutes／62 inches／50 pounds）均照录，**无换算、无推算**。

### 第四套 · Passage 4

There are a few reasons why a home-based business may have trouble in securing business financing (筹集资金) through a bank or credit union:

* **Your business isn't firmly established:** If your business is less than two years old, it's unlikely that a traditional lender will be willing to take a chance on funding your business.

* **Your business credit score is lacking:** Once you apply for an employer identification (雇主识别) number, you have to start building a business credit score. You can improve the score by paying your bills, establishing trade credit accounts, and staying in business. The business and personal credit score both affect whether a lender is willing to offer you business financing.

* **You lack a demonstrated (证明的) need:** Taking on debt is a common way for raising funds. However, you should never do so unless you need to. Lenders will refuse to finance a business that can't clearly show why they need funding, and how they'll pay it back.

If, as a home business owner, you discover an area that requires serious investment, you should be able to state your reasons to lenders, whether they are your local bank or an online lender.

31. A traditional lender will NOT be willing to provide funds to a business if ____________________.

32. Whether a business can obtain financing is likely to be decided by ____________________.

33. To secure business financing, a business owner should clearly demonstrate to the lender ____________________




34. If you discover an area which requires serious investment, what should you do?

____________________

35. The passage is mainly about why a home-based business has difficulty ____________________.

**〔G170〕慧航第四套 · Passage 4（31—35）十层研究**

> **本组是全稿最后一组（G170）**；本篇讲家庭企业向银行／信用社融资难的三个原因，属说明文（分条列举体）。

**31. 答案：it is less than two years old（A traditional lender will not be willing to provide funds to a business if it is less than two years old.）**
1 题面：框架 "A traditional lender will NOT be willing to provide funds to a business if __________."；空位在 if 后，须为完整从句；原文 "**Your business isn't firmly established:** If your business is less than two years old, it's unlikely that a traditional lender will be willing to take a chance on funding your business."；诱导信号：小标题 isn't firmly established 是概括，if 从句才是具体条件。
2 候选：①it is less than two years old；②it isn't firmly established（概括）；③it has no credit score（第二条）；④it lacks a demonstrated need（第三条）。
3 验算：①→If your business is less than two years old, it's unlikely…，if 从句与题干 Not willing 对应→成立（保留 two years）。②→是标题式概括，题干要 if 后的具体条件→次优。③④→是另两条原因（credit score／demonstrated need）→排除。
4 干扰：三个小标题并列，每条都"可能"是原因；less than two years old 是唯一带数字的。
5 意图：考"if 从句取该条的具体条件（less than two years old），标题概括与另两条不作本空"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 it is less than two years old。若问 Why won't a lender fund a new business? 答 Because it isn't firmly established。
7 错误：A 填 it isn't firmly established.（错因：标题概括）；B 填 it has no credit score.（错因：第二条）；C 填 it needs no money.（错因：第三条）。
8 规则：R140.1 若补全式空位在 if 后，then 取该小标题条目的具体条件（less than two years old），保留数字；标题概括（isn't firmly established）与另两条（credit score／demonstrated need）不作本空。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（从句）＋RA-1.4 原因；复用 R51.5（补全从句），本条是 if 条件。
10 自检：①if 后是什么？②标题概括能代替吗？③另两条是什么？

**32. 答案：the business and personal credit score（Whether a business can obtain financing is likely to be decided by the business and personal credit score.）**
1 题面：框架 "Whether a business can obtain financing is likely to be decided by __________."；空位在 by 后，须为名词；原文 "The business and personal credit score both affect whether a lender is willing to offer you business financing."；诱导信号：同条还提 employer identification number 与 trade credit accounts（提高分数的手段）。
2 候选：①the business and personal credit score；②the employer identification number（前提）；③trade credit accounts（手段）；④the business plan。
3 验算：①→The business and personal credit score both affect whether a lender is willing to offer financing，affect 与 decided by 对应→成立（两项都写）。②→是"申请后才开始建立分数"的前提→次优。③→是提高分数的手段→排除。④→business plan 属另一篇（G158）→排除。
4 干扰：employer identification number 与 credit score 在同条、因果相邻；trade credit accounts 也像"决定因素"。
5 意图：考"decided by 取 affect 的主语（business＋personal credit score），前提与手段不作决定因素"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 The business and personal credit score。若问 How can you improve the score? 答 By paying your bills, establishing trade credit accounts and staying in business。
7 错误：A 填 the employer identification number.（错因：前提）；B 填 trade credit accounts.（错因：手段）；C 填 the business plan.（错因：串篇）。
8 规则：R140.2 若问 what is it decided by，then 取 affect 的主语两项（business and personal credit score）；前提（employer identification number）与手段（trade credit accounts／paying bills）不作决定因素。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.4 原因（affect 主语）；复用 R36.2（并列原因取全），本条是两项。
10 自检：①affect 的主语是什么？②EIN 是什么？③trade credit 是什么？

**33. 答案：why they need funding and how they will pay it back（…should clearly demonstrate to the lender why they need funding and how they'll pay it back.）**
1 题面：框架 "To secure business financing, a business owner should clearly demonstrate to the lender __________."；空位在 lender 后，须为宾语从句（两项）；原文 "Lenders will refuse to finance a business that can't clearly show why they need funding, and how they'll pay it back."；诱导信号：同段 Taking on debt is a common way for raising funds 是背景。
2 候选：①why they need funding and how they'll pay it back；②how much money they want（不完整）；③their business plan（上位改写）；④their credit score（另一条）。
3 验算：①→can't clearly show why they need funding, and how they'll pay it back，两项从句→成立（两项都写）。②→只覆盖"要多少"，漏"为什么"与"怎么还"→次优。③→business plan 是上位，原文用的是两句具体内容→次优。④→credit score 是第二条原因→排除。
4 干扰：business plan 很"专业"，像标准答案；how much they want 也像"demonstrate"的内容。
5 意图：考"demonstrate 后取两个宾语从句（why＋how），上位词（business plan）不作具体内容"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 why they need funding and how they'll pay it back。若问 What will lenders refuse to do? 答 To finance a business that can't clearly show these two things。
7 错误：A 填 their business plan.（错因：上位）；B 填 how much money they want.（错因：不完整）；C 填 their credit score.（错因：另一条）。
8 规则：R140.3 若补全式空位在 demonstrate to the lender 后，then 取两个宾语从句（why they need funding＋how they'll pay it back），两项都写；上位词（business plan）与单一项（how much）不作具体内容；credit score 属另一条。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（宾语从句）；复用 R51.5（补全从句），本条是两从句并列。
10 自检：①show 后有几个从句？②business plan 是原文词吗？③credit score 属哪条？

**34. 答案：State your reasons to lenders（You should be able to state your reasons to lenders）.**
1 题面：If you discover an area which requires serious investment, what should you do；原文 "If, as a home business owner, you discover an area that requires serious investment, you should be able to state your reasons to lenders, whether they are your local bank or an online lender."；疑问词 what should you do（问做法）；诱导信号：whether they are your local bank or an online lender 是"对谁"的补充。
2 候选：①state your reasons to lenders；②borrow as much as possible；③avoid taking on debt；④apply for an employer identification number。
3 验算：①→you should be able to state your reasons to lenders，should 与题干 should do 对应→成立。②→与"never do so unless you need to"相反→排除。③→是总原则（Taking on debt…never do so unless you need to），不是"发现需投资时"的做法→次优。④→是第一条里建立信用分的前提→排除。
4 干扰：never do so unless you need to 的告诫语很强，像"该做什么"；EIN 也在本篇。
5 意图：考"做法取 you should be able to 后的动作（state your reasons），总原则与他条前提不作具体做法"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 State your reasons to lenders。若问 To whom should you state them? 答 To your local bank or an online lender。
7 错误：A 答 Avoid taking on debt.（错因：总原则）；B 答 Borrow as much as possible.（错因：相反）；C 答 Get an EIN.（错因：他条）。
8 规则：R140.4 若问 what should you do if you find an area needing investment，then 取 should be able to 后的动作（state your reasons to lenders）；总原则（never do so unless…）与他条前提（EIN）不作具体做法；whether 从句说明对象（local bank／online lender）。
9 位置：04→RA-1→RA-1.30 举措取词（should 后）；复用 R123.3（目的句取做法），本条是条件句取做法。
10 自检：①should 后是什么？②never do so 是原则吗？③EIN 属哪条？

**35. 答案：securing business financing（The passage is mainly about why a home-based business has difficulty securing business financing.）**
1 题面：框架 "The passage is mainly about why a home-based business has difficulty __________."；空位在 difficulty 后，须为动名词短语；原文首句 "There are a few reasons why a home-based business may have trouble in securing business financing (筹集资金) through a bank or credit union"；诱导信号：后文三条原因（not established／credit score／demonstrated need）都是"难"的具体原因。
2 候选：①securing business financing；②paying bills（手段）；③building a credit score（第二条）；④taking on debt（背景）。
3 验算：①→have trouble in securing business financing，trouble in 与 difficulty 对应→成立（动名词，保留 financing）。②③→是提高信用分的手段／第二条原因→排除。④→是融资的常见方式（背景）→排除。
4 干扰：building a credit score 是三条原因之一，像"主旨"；three reasons 的列举也容易让人取某一条。
5 意图：考"difficulty 后取首句的动名词短语（securing business financing），三条原因之一不作主旨"。
6 边界（Section A 短答）：写 securing business financing。若问 What are the three reasons? 答 The business isn't firmly established, its credit score is lacking, and it lacks a demonstrated need。
7 错误：A 填 building a credit score.（错因：原因之一）；B 填 paying bills.（错因：手段）；C 填 taking on debt.（错因：背景）。
8 规则：R140.5 若补全式问 mainly about why X has difficulty ___，then 取首句 trouble in 后的动名词（securing business financing）；三条原因之一（credit score）与手段（paying bills）／背景（taking on debt）不作主旨；difficulty 后须用动名词。
9 位置：04→RA-5→RA-5.1 空位词性（动名词）＋RA-3.1 主旨；复用 R41.2（主旨取总起句），本条是补全式。
10 自检：①trouble in 后是什么？②三条原因能作主旨吗？③difficulty 后要什么形式？

**组小结（G170 · 慧航第四套 Passage 4）**
- 考点分布：if 条件（小标题具体化）1（31）；affect 主语两项 1（32）；两宾语从句 1（33）；should 后做法 1（34）；主旨动名词 1（35）。
- 规则：R140.1 if 取具体条件（31）；R140.2 credit score 两项（32）；R140.3 demonstrate 两从句（33）；R140.4 should 后取做法（34）；R140.5 主旨取动名词（35）。
- 冲突与优先级：R140.1 与"标题概括"冲突，if 从句优先；R140.2 与"EIN 相邻"冲突，affect 主语优先；R140.3 与"business plan 专业"冲突，两从句优先；R140.4 与"never do so 告诫"冲突，should 后优先；R140.5 与"三条原因之一"冲突，首句主旨优先。
- 未归类：无。
- 覆盖检查：分条说明文（融资难三因）；三条小标题各配一题，是"标题—条件—对策"的完整样本；数字（two years）照录，**无换算、无推算**；**第四套 4 篇至此完成（G167—G170），慧航 34 篇、全稿 G1—G170 全部收官**。

### 三、规则总表（700 条，按组）

- **R1（2024P1）**：R1.1 时间状语整体截取；R1.2 选择疑问句以原文事实为准；R1.3 Who 取施动者（also／couldn't 定顺位）；R1.4 Why 取隐性因果（分词／不定式）；R1.5 What 感叹句译"多么…啊"。
- **R2（2024P2）**：R2.1 一般问取概括句；R2.2 so 前为因；R2.3 胜负句取主语、队名不编；R2.4 数字按名词中心＋动作双匹配；R2.5 同词异类分工（love 动/名）。
- **R3（2026P3）**：R3.1 人称对齐前置；R3.2 引号内数字直取；R3.3 关键词缺失先查截断再定待核；R3.4 引语与评论分离；R3.5 by＋抽象名词、never too…to 译法。
- **R4（2026P4）**：R4.1 时段隔离；R4.2 mean 取宾语、不取邻近 it 指代；R4.3 情绪词性转换＋虚拟非事实排除；R4.4 decide to do 直取；R4.5 多义形容词＋比较级译法。
